model_requirements.description: Life and Annuity Insurance is a financial services industry providing life insurance policies, annuities, retirement planning, and wealth protection products to individuals and families, managing long-term risk and investment portfolios.

model.name: Life Insurance
model.description: Life and Annuity Insurance is a financial services industry providing life insurance policies, annuities, retirement planning, and wealth protection products to individuals and families, managing long-term risk and investment portfolios.

model.data_domains: Policyholder, Policy, Underwriting, Claims, Billing, Annuity, Reinsurance, Actuarial, Investment, Agent and Distribution, Product, Compliance, Finance, Commission, Document Management

model.industry_governing_body: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC), State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states plus territories), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) — for variable products, Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) — for variable products and broker-dealer oversight, Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — IRC Sections 7702 and 72 for tax compliance, Department of Labor (DOL) — ERISA and fiduciary standards for employer-sponsored plans, Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) — ASC 944 and LDTI, International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS), ACORD (Association for Cooperative Operations Research and Development) — data standards, Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) — AML/BSA compliance

domains.name: policyholder
domains.description: Single source of truth for all insured individuals, contract owners, annuitants, and beneficiaries. Owns KYC/AML identity verification, demographic profiles, SSN/TIN records, beneficiary designations, customer relationship hierarchies (ILIT, trust ownership), and CLTV analytics. Supports both B2C retail and B2B group policy relationships, NPS tracking, and customer segmentation across the policyholder lifecycle.

products.name: insured
products.description: Role record for every insured individual covered under a life insurance policy or annuity contract. Captures the person whose life is the basis of coverage — distinct from the contract owner or annuitant. Stores role-specific attributes: tobacco/health status, occupation class, insurable interest flags, and coverage-specific risk indicators not on the party supertype. References the party record via FK for demographic identity (name, DOB, gender, SSN/TIN). SSOT for the insured-life role across underwriting, claims, and policy domains. Supports both individual and group certificate insured records.

attributes.name: insured_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the insured-life role record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the insured entity; globally unique across all policies and group certificates.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party supertype record that holds demographic identity (legal name, date of birth, gender, SSN/TIN, address). The insured entity is a role record; all identity attributes are owned by the party record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; NAIC Party Model

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract under which this insured-life role exists. Links the insured to the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST) policy record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: primary_insured_party_id
attributes.description: FK to policyholder.party.party_id — The insured role record must link to the party supertype for demographic resolution. This is the foundational in-domain FK enabling the party-role pattern that the policyholder domain is built on.

attributes.name: adb_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured is eligible for the ADB (Accidental Death Benefit) rider, which pays an additional death benefit if death results from a covered accident. Eligibility is determined during underwriting based on age, occupation, and health status.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST)

attributes.name: adl_impairment_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Activities of Daily Living (ADL) Impairment Count
attributes.description: Number of ADLs (Activities of Daily Living) with which the insured requires assistance, as assessed for LTC rider benefit eligibility. Standard ADLs include bathing, dressing, eating, toileting, transferring, and continence. Benefit triggers typically require impairment in 2 or more ADLs.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; HIPAA; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: aps_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the APS (Attending Physician Statement) was received from the insured's attending physician. Used to track underwriting cycle time and NIGO resolution. Null if APS was not required or not yet received.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: aps_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an APS (Attending Physician Statement) was required from the insured's treating physician as part of the underwriting process. Triggered by age, face amount thresholds, or medical history disclosures. Sourced from the Underwriting Workbench.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); HIPAA

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: Current age of the insured as of the most recent policy anniversary or valuation date, expressed in whole years. Used in COI (Cost of Insurance) calculations for UL/IUL products, NAR (Net Amount at Risk) determination, and ongoing actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline; SOA Mortality Tables; FASB ASC 944 LDTI

attributes.name: aviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured has disclosed aviation activity (private pilot, commercial pilot, or frequent flyer in non-commercial aircraft) that constitutes a hazardous avocation. Triggers aviation exclusion riders or flat extra premium charges in underwriting.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: citizenship_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the insured's country of citizenship. Used in AML/KYC compliance screening, OFAC sanctions checks, foreign national underwriting guidelines, and FATCA/FBAR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FinCEN AML/BSA; OFAC; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for this insured-life role became effective (policy issue date or certificate effective date for group). Used in actuarial valuation, reserve calculations, and claims adjudication to determine coverage period.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for this insured-life role ended or is scheduled to end. Null for in-force policies. Populated upon lapse, surrender, maturity, or death claim settlement.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944 LDTI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insured-life role record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements under SOX, and ETL processing tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the insured individual. Critical for issue age and attained age calculations, MEC (Modified Endowment Contract) testing under IRC Section 7702, RMD (Required Minimum Distribution) tracking for annuities, and mortality risk assessment.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; HIPAA; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_rider_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the exclusion rider(s) attached for this insured, specifying the excluded condition, activity, or body part. Used by claims adjusters during adjudication to determine whether a claim falls within an excluded category.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Claims Management System (Guidewire ClaimCenter; Majesco Claims)

attributes.name: exclusion_rider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more exclusion riders have been attached to the policy for this insured, limiting coverage for specific pre-existing conditions, hazardous activities, or body parts. Relevant for claims adjudication to determine benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Claims Management System (Guidewire ClaimCenter)

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: The death benefit (DB) face amount of coverage for this insured-life role, expressed in USD. Represents the base sum insured excluding riders. Used in NAR (Net Amount at Risk) calculation, reinsurance cession determination, and actuarial reserve calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: flat_extra_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the flat extra premium surcharge expires for the insured. After this date, the insured reverts to the base table rating without the temporary extra charge. Null if no flat extra applies or if the flat extra is permanent.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: flat_extra_premium
attributes.description: Additional per-thousand or per-unit premium charged to substandard insured lives for a defined period, typically reflecting temporary extra mortality risk (e.g., post-surgery recovery, hazardous occupation). Expressed as a dollar amount per $1,000 of face amount per year.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: foreign_travel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured has disclosed travel to or residence in countries with elevated mortality or political risk, as assessed during underwriting. May result in exclusion riders, flat extra premiums, or declination depending on destination and duration.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); OFAC sanctions list

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the insured as recorded for underwriting and actuarial purposes. M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Other, U=Unknown. Used in gender-distinct mortality table selection where permitted by state regulation. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance regulations; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: group_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number assigned to an insured under a group life insurance master policy. Uniquely identifies the individual certificate within the group. Null for individual policies. Used in group policy administration, billing, and claims processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Insurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: insurable_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid insurable interest relationship has been verified between the policy owner and the insured at the time of application. Required by state insurance law to prevent wagering contracts and STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) arrangements.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; STOLI regulations

attributes.name: insurable_interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurable interest relationship between the policy owner and the insured. Self indicates the owner and insured are the same person. Business_partner and key_person apply to business-owned life insurance (BOLI). Trust applies to ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|child|business_partner|employer|key_person|trust|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; IRC Section 101

attributes.name: insured_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the Policy Administration System to uniquely identify this insured-life role on a policy. Used in ACORD transactions, bordereaux reporting, and reinsurance cession records.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: insured_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insured-life role record. Active indicates coverage is in force; deceased triggers claims adjudication; lapsed/surrendered/terminated reflect policy end states; pending indicates underwriting not yet complete.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: issue_age
attributes.description: Age of the insured at the time the policy was issued, expressed in whole years. Fundamental actuarial input for mortality table selection, premium rate determination, and reserve calculations under PBR and LDTI.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline; Society of Actuaries (SOA) Mortality Tables; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: ltc_rider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an LTC (Long-Term Care) rider is attached to the policy for this insured, providing accelerated death benefits upon inability to perform ADLs (Activities of Daily Living). Triggers LTC benefit administration and state LTC regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: mib_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the MIB (Medical Information Bureau) inquiry conducted during underwriting for this insured. A 'hit' indicates a prior medical disclosure that requires further investigation. Used in underwriting risk assessment and NIGO (Not In Good Order) tracking.
attributes.references: MIB Group Inc. Data Standards; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; HIPAA

attributes.name: military_status
attributes.description: Military service status of the insured as disclosed on the application. Active duty military may trigger war exclusion clauses or special underwriting considerations. Relevant for SGLI (Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance) coordination and exclusion rider application.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA); Underwriting Workbench

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: NAR (Net Amount at Risk) for this insured life, calculated as the death benefit minus the policy account value or reserve. Represents the insurer's net mortality exposure. Used in COI charge calculation for UL/IUL products, reinsurance cession amounts, and actuarial reserve modeling.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline; SOA Mortality Tables; FASB ASC 944 LDTI; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: occupation_class
attributes.description: Occupational risk classification assigned to the insured based on their profession and associated hazard level. Used in DI (Disability Income) underwriting and life underwriting for hazardous occupations. Typically coded as Class 1 (professional) through Class 4+ (hazardous). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: class_1|class_2|class_3|class_4|class_5|unclassifiable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Disability Income Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: occupation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the insured's occupation as stated on the application. Used in underwriting risk assessment, hazardous occupation exclusion determination, and DI benefit eligibility. Sourced from the Underwriting Workbench application data.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of the risk on this insured life has been ceded to a reinsurer under an automatic or facultative treaty. Triggers reinsurance bordereaux reporting and cession processing in the Reinsurance Management System (Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Reinsurance Management System (Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance)

attributes.name: residency_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the insured's state of residency at the time of policy issue. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, mandated benefit provisions, and state-specific exclusion limitations. Used in regulatory reporting to State Departments of Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: Underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured based on medical, financial, and lifestyle risk assessment. Determines the mortality table and premium rate band applied. Substandard/rated classes carry table ratings or flat extras. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated|declined — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insured's role on the policy. Primary insured is the primary life covered; secondary/joint applies to survivorship or joint-life products; group_certificate identifies an insured under a group master policy; dependent covers riders; key_person identifies business key-person coverage.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this insured record was sourced (e.g., FAST, SAPIENS_LIFEPRO, ORACLE_IPAS). Supports data lineage tracking, multi-system reconciliation, and Silver layer ETL audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Health Data Standards; NAIC Data Model; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Numerical or alphabetical table rating applied to substandard insured lives (e.g., Table 2, Table D). Each table increment typically represents an additional 25% of standard mortality. Used in premium surcharge calculation and reinsurance cession pricing.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: tobacco_status
attributes.description: Tobacco use classification of the insured as determined during underwriting. Directly impacts mortality risk class, premium rates, and COI charges. Non-tobacco and preferred non-tobacco classes receive lower rates. Status may be re-evaluated at policy anniversary for certain products.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: Final underwriting decision rendered for this insured-life role. Approved indicates standard or preferred issuance; approved_rated indicates substandard issuance with table rating or flat extra; approved_modified indicates policy issued with exclusion riders; postponed indicates deferred pending additional information; declined indicates coverage refused.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: underwriting_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final underwriting decision was rendered for this insured-life role. Used to measure underwriting cycle time (NB processing KPI), track NIGO resolution, and support regulatory reporting on new business processing timelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insured-life role record was last modified in the Silver layer data product. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance under SOX. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the AWL (Automatic Waiver of Premium) rider is active for this insured, waiving premium payments during a qualifying disability period. Relevant for billing system integration to suspend premium billing and for claims adjudication of disability claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST); Billing System

products.name: contract_owner
products.description: Role record for the legal owner of a life insurance policy or annuity contract. The owner may be an individual, a trust (ILIT), a corporation, or another legal entity — and may differ from the insured or annuitant. Stores ownership type (individual, trust, corporate, ILIT), ownership effective date, ownership transfer history flags, and role-specific attributes not on the party supertype. References the party record via FK for identity attributes (legal name, TIN/SSN, entity details). SSOT for policy ownership role identity, supporting 1035 exchange tracking, beneficiary designation authority, and collateral assignment governance.

attributes.name: contract_owner_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contract_owner

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract for which this party holds the owner role. A single policy may have one active owner at a time; history is tracked via ownership transfer flags.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle OIPA)

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party supertype record that holds identity attributes (legal name, SSN/TIN, date of birth, contact details) for this contract owner. Supports individual, trust, corporate, and ILIT ownership structures.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: trust_id
attributes.description: FK to policyholder.trust

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Contract owners are established during application underwriting. Linking owner to originating application tracks ownership from inception, supports STOLI investigations (ownership patterns from applic

attributes.name: absolute_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an absolute (irrevocable) assignment of ownership has occurred, transferring all ownership rights to a new party. When True, the original owner loses all policy rights and the new owner record becomes active.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk classification assigned to the contract owner based on KYC due diligence, transaction patterns, and OFAC/sanctions screening. Drives enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements and transaction monitoring thresholds.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; OFAC SDN List; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_authority
attributes.description: Level of authority the contract owner holds to change beneficiary designations on the policy. 'full' allows unrestricted changes; 'restricted' requires co-owner or irrevocable beneficiary consent; 'none' applies when ownership rights have been assigned.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: collateral_assignee_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lender or creditor to whom the policy has been collaterally assigned. Required for death benefit payment processing and CSV surrender authorization when collateral_assignment_flag is True.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral assignment of the policy became effective. Used to determine priority of claims against policy proceeds and to track assignment duration for servicing restrictions.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy has been assigned as collateral to a lender or creditor by the contract owner. When True, the assignee has priority rights over the cash surrender value (CSV) and death benefit proceeds up to the loan balance.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: correspondence_preference
attributes.description: Contract owner's preferred method for receiving policy correspondence, statements, and regulatory notices. Drives document delivery routing in the Policy Administration System and CRM platform.
attributes.references: CRM and Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud); NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: electronic_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract owner provided consent for electronic document delivery. Required for regulatory audit trails under the NAIC Electronic Transactions Model Act and state e-delivery regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Electronic Transactions Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; E-SIGN Act (15 USC 7001)

attributes.name: electronic_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner has provided affirmative consent to receive policy documents and regulatory notices electronically, as required by the NAIC Electronic Transactions Model Act and applicable state e-delivery laws.
attributes.references: NAIC Electronic Transactions Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; E-SIGN Act (15 USC 7001)

attributes.name: entity_state_of_formation
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the trust, corporation, partnership, or other non-individual entity was legally formed or domiciled. Used for state regulatory compliance and premium tax situs determination.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: exchange_1035_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership record is associated with a tax-free 1035 exchange transaction, where the policy was funded by proceeds from a prior life insurance policy or annuity contract. Triggers specific IRS cost-basis tracking requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 544; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: insurable_interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal insurable interest relationship between the contract owner and the insured life. Required at policy issuance to validate that the owner has a legitimate financial interest in the continued life of the insured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|dependent|business_partner|employer|creditor|trust — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_also_annuitant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner is also the annuitant on an annuity contract. Relevant for annuity tax treatment, RMD calculations, and death benefit trigger rules under IRC Section 72.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity)

attributes.name: is_also_insured
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner is also the insured life on the policy. When True, the owner-insured relationship triggers specific tax treatment under IRC Section 7702 and MEC testing rules.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; IRS Publication 559; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_primary_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is the primary (first-named) owner of the policy or annuity contract. The primary owner holds full beneficiary designation authority and receives all policy correspondence.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification status for the contract owner. Drives AML compliance workflows and may restrict policy servicing transactions until verification is complete.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract owner's identity was most recently verified and KYC status was set to 'verified'. Used for AML periodic review scheduling and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: ofac_last_screened_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Last Screened Date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract owner was most recently screened against OFAC sanctions lists. Used to ensure periodic re-screening compliance and to trigger alerts when screening is overdue.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; FinCEN AML/BSA; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: ofac_screening_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and sanctions list screening for the contract owner. 'blocked' status prevents policy issuance and servicing transactions per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; FinCEN AML/BSA; USA PATRIOT Act; 31 CFR Part 500

attributes.name: owner_role_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the Policy Administration System to uniquely identify this ownership role record. Used in correspondence, 1035 exchange documentation, and collateral assignment notices.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle OIPA); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: ownership_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's ownership role became legally effective for the policy or annuity contract. For original owners, this aligns with the policy issue date. For transferred ownership, this is the assignment effective date.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle OIPA); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 1035

attributes.name: ownership_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's ownership role ended, due to absolute assignment, policy surrender, death of owner, or contract termination. Null for currently active ownership records.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage share of ownership held by this party when multiple co-owners exist on a single policy or annuity contract. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%). Must sum to 100.00 across all active owners for a given policy.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: ownership_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal indicating the order of ownership for a given policy, used to distinguish primary owner (1) from co-owners (2, 3, etc.) and to order historical ownership records chronologically.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract owner role. Transitions from pending (application stage) to active (policy issued), and may move to transferred (absolute assignment) or terminated (policy lapse/surrender/maturity).
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the transfer of policy ownership from a prior owner to this contract owner. Supports 1035 exchange tracking, gift tax reporting, and estate planning audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: absolute_assignment|divorce_decree|court_order|gift|sale|ilit_transfer|estate_transfer|bankruptcy — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 559; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity type holding ownership of the policy or annuity contract. Drives KYC/AML requirements, beneficiary designation authority, and tax reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|trust|corporation|ilit|partnership|estate|government|non_profit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; IRS Publication 559; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: prior_contract_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number of the prior life insurance policy or annuity from which a 1035 exchange was executed. Required for IRS cost-basis carryover calculations and exchange documentation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 544; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract owner role record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX compliance for financial data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract owner role record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer data product. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this contract owner record was sourced (e.g., FAST, SAPIENS_LIFEPRO, ORACLE_OIPA). Used for data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle OIPA); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_owner_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this contract owner record in the originating Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST owner role ID, Sapiens LifePro owner record key). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle OIPA); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: stoli_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract owner relationship has been flagged for Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) review. STOLI arrangements, where a third party with no insurable interest finances a policy, are prohibited in most US states.
attributes.references: NAIC STOLI Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for the contract owner, which may be a Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals or an Employer Identification Number (EIN) for trusts, corporations, and other entities. Required for IRS Form 1099 reporting and AML/KYC compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1212; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: tin_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of IRS TIN certification (W-9 or W-8 form) for the contract owner. Drives backup withholding obligations under IRS regulations. 'backup_withholding' indicates the owner is subject to 28% withholding on taxable distributions.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Form W-8BEN; IRC Section 3406; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of TIN provided by the contract owner: SSN (Social Security Number for individuals), EIN (Employer Identification Number for entities), ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number for non-resident aliens), or foreign (non-US tax identifier).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1212; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

products.name: annuitant
products.description: Role record for the individual whose life expectancy governs annuity benefit calculations and payout duration. Distinct from the contract owner and insured in annuity contracts. Stores role-specific attributes: annuity start date, joint annuitant indicator, mortality table assignment, and payout-phase parameters not on the party supertype. References the party record via FK for demographic identity (name, DOB, gender, SSN/TIN). SSOT for the annuitant-life role used by the Annuity Administration Platform for RMD tracking, GMDB/GMIB/GMWB benefit calculations, and payout phase administration.

attributes.name: annuitant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the annuitant role record in the Annuity Administration Platform. Primary key for the annuitant entity within the policyholder domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract record for which this individual serves as the annuitant. Drives benefit calculations, payout phase administration, and RMD tracking in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party supertype record that holds the annuitant's demographic identity (full name, date of birth, gender, SSN/TIN, address). The annuitant role record is a specialization of the party entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: suitability_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.suitability_review. Business justification: Annuity suitability reviews assess product appropriateness for the annuitant (age, income needs, liquidity). Compliance teams link reviews to specific annuitants for state insurance department exam de

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Annuity contracts originate from underwriting applications. Linking annuitant to application tracks which underwriting case created the annuitant role, essential for suitability reviews, annuity-speci

attributes.name: annuitant_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity / FAST Annuity) to uniquely identify the annuitant role on a contract. Used in bordereaux reporting and customer correspondence.

attributes.name: annuity_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which annuity benefit payments commence (annuitization date). Governs the payout phase schedule, RMD calculation start, and GMIB/GMWB benefit base lock-in. Also known as the income start date or annuitization effective date in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS RMD Rules (IRC Section 401(a)(9)); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: annuity_type
attributes.description: The type of annuity product associated with this annuitant role. 'FIA' = Fixed Indexed Annuity; 'VA' = Variable Annuity; 'SPIA' = Single Premium Immediate Annuity; 'MYGA' = Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity; 'DIA' = Deferred Income Annuity; 'QLAC' = Qualifying Longevity Annuity Contract. Drives product-specific benefit calculation logic and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIA|VA|SPIA|MYGA|DIA|QLAC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Notice 2014-66 (QLAC); NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: benefit_base_amount
attributes.description: The current guaranteed benefit base amount used for GMIB, GMWB, or GMAB calculations. Represents the notional value upon which guaranteed benefit payments or withdrawal amounts are calculated, distinct from the actual account value. Updated annually or upon step-up elections per the rider terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_qualification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is held in a qualified (tax-deferred) or non-qualified (after-tax) account. 'qualified' includes traditional IRA, 401(k), 403(b); 'non_qualified' is funded with after-tax dollars; 'roth_ira' has distinct RMD and distribution rules; 'inherited_ira' applies to beneficiary-owned contracts. Drives RMD applicability, tax withholding, and 1099-R reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-A/590-B; SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: current_age
attributes.description: The annuitant's age in whole years as of the most recent valuation or processing date. Refreshed periodically by the Annuity Administration Platform for RMD factor lookups, benefit recalculations, and payout phase administration. Stored to avoid repeated real-time computation in batch actuarial runs.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 401(a)(9); NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43)

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The annuitant's date of birth as recorded on the annuity contract application. Used directly by the Annuity Administration Platform for mortality table lookups, age-based benefit calculations, RMD required beginning date determination, and GMDB/GMIB/GMWB payout factor selection. Stored here as a role-level denormalization for performance-critical actuarial calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; HIPAA

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The current death benefit amount payable upon the annuitant's death, reflecting the greater of the account value or the GMDB benefit base (if applicable). Updated at each valuation cycle. Used by the Claims Management System for death claim adjudication and by the Actuarial Valuation System for NAR calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: death_benefit_option
attributes.description: The distribution option elected by the beneficiary for the death benefit payable upon the annuitant's death. 'lump_sum' is a single payment; 'annuitize' converts to an income stream; 'five_year_rule' distributes within 5 years per IRC Section 72(s); 'stretch_ira' uses life expectancy distributions for eligible designated beneficiaries under SECURE Act rules.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(s); SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: The date of death of the annuitant as reported and verified by the Annuity Administration Platform. Triggers death benefit processing, payout cessation or continuation (for joint annuitants), beneficiary notification, and claim adjudication workflows. Null for living annuitants.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: death_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annuitant's death was officially verified by the insurer through receipt of a death certificate or equivalent documentation. Distinct from the reported death date. Initiates the formal death claim adjudication process and triggers statutory interest accrual on death benefits.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The annuitant's gender as recorded on the contract application. Used in mortality table selection and payout factor calculations where gender-distinct tables are applied. Some states mandate unisex tables; the mortality_table_code field captures the applicable table assignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance unisex table mandates; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gmab_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) rider is active on this annuitant's contract. When True, the contract guarantees the account value will be at least equal to the GMAB benefit base at the end of the accumulation period, regardless of market performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gmdb_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) rider is active on this annuitant's contract. When True, the death benefit payable upon the annuitant's death is the greater of the account value or the GMDB benefit base. Drives death benefit calculation logic in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gmib_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) rider is active on this annuitant's contract. When True, the annuitant may annuitize at a guaranteed minimum benefit base regardless of account value performance. Drives GMIB benefit base tracking and annuitization calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gmwb_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) rider is active on this annuitant's contract. When True, the annuitant is guaranteed a minimum annual withdrawal amount regardless of account value depletion. Drives GMWB benefit base and maximum annual withdrawal calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_joint_annuitant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this annuitant record represents a joint annuitant on a joint-and-survivor annuity contract. When True, the payout continues to the surviving annuitant at the designated continuation percentage after the primary annuitant's death. Drives joint-life payout factor selection in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: issue_age
attributes.description: The annuitant's age in whole years at the time the annuity contract was issued. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot used for benefit base calculations, payout factor selection, and actuarial reserving. Derived from date_of_birth and contract issue date at time of issuance and stored for audit stability.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43)

attributes.name: joint_survivor_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the primary annuitant's benefit payment that continues to the joint annuitant (survivor) after the primary annuitant's death. Common values are 50%, 66.67%, 75%, and 100%. Null if is_joint_annuitant is False. Used in joint-life payout factor calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: The current Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification status for this annuitant. 'verified' indicates all identity checks have passed; 'pending' indicates verification is in progress; 'failed' indicates a verification failure requiring remediation; 'exempt' applies to certain institutional or trust-owned contracts. Required for AML/BSA compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Rules; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act Section 326

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annuitant's KYC identity verification was most recently completed and confirmed. Used for AML compliance tracking and periodic re-verification scheduling.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Rules; USA PATRIOT Act Section 326; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: mortality_table_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the actuarial mortality table assigned to this annuitant for payout factor calculations and reserve valuation (e.g., '2012 IAR', '2000 CSO', 'UP-1984', 'RP-2014'). Assigned at contract issue and may be updated upon annuitant change. Used by the Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes/AXIS/Prophet) for PBR reserve calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLIII (AG43); NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-21); FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: payout_option_code
attributes.description: The annuity payout option elected for this annuitant's contract. Governs the income stream structure: 'life_only' pays for the annuitant's lifetime only; 'life_period_certain' guarantees payments for a minimum period; 'joint_survivor' continues to a joint annuitant; 'period_certain' pays for a fixed term; 'lump_sum' is a single payment; 'systematic_withdrawal' is a non-annuitized withdrawal schedule. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: life_only|life_period_certain|joint_survivor|period_certain|lump_sum|systematic_withdrawal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: period_certain_years
attributes.description: The number of years guaranteed under a life-with-period-certain or period-certain-only payout option. Common values are 5, 10, 15, or 20 years. Null if the payout option does not include a period-certain guarantee. Used to calculate the minimum benefit obligation and reserve.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this annuitant role record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and SOX compliance. Follows the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this annuitant role record was most recently updated in the Silver layer data product. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance. Follows the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: rmd_calculation_method
attributes.description: The IRS life expectancy table method used to calculate the annuitant's annual RMD amount. 'uniform_lifetime' uses the Uniform Lifetime Table (most common); 'joint_life_expectancy' applies when the sole beneficiary is a spouse more than 10 years younger; 'single_life_expectancy' applies in certain inherited IRA scenarios. Null for non-qualified contracts.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Life Expectancy Tables (Rev. Proc. 2022-38)

attributes.name: rmd_required_begin_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Required Beginning Date
attributes.description: The date by which the annuitant must begin taking Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs) from a qualified annuity contract (IRA, 403(b), etc.). Determined by IRS rules based on the annuitant's date of birth and the applicable SECURE Act age threshold (age 73 under SECURE 2.0). Null for non-qualified contracts.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; SECURE Act 2.0 (2022); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: role_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this annuitant role became effective on the contract. May differ from the contract issue date if the annuitant was added or changed via a contract endorsement or owner-driven change.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: role_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this annuitant role was terminated, replaced, or became inactive. Null for currently active annuitant roles. Populated upon death, contract surrender, or annuitant change endorsement.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: role_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the annuitant role record. 'active' indicates the annuitant is the current measuring life; 'deceased' triggers death benefit processing and payout recalculation; 'replaced' indicates a successor annuitant has been designated; 'cancelled' applies to voided or rescinded contracts.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Classification of the annuitant's role on the contract. 'primary' is the measuring life for payout calculations; 'joint' triggers joint-and-survivor benefit rules; 'contingent' activates if the primary annuitant predeceases; 'successor' applies under certain IRA/qualified plan continuation rules.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_annuitant_code
attributes.description: The native annuitant identifier as assigned by the originating Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, ETL lineage, and audit traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this annuitant record was ingested (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ssn_tin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Number / Taxpayer Identification Number (SSN/TIN)
attributes.description: The annuitant's Social Security Number (SSN) or Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) as recorded on the annuity contract. Required for IRS 1099-R tax reporting, RMD compliance, and AML/KYC identity verification. Stored at the role level to support tax reporting workflows independent of the party supertype.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-R; FinCEN AML/BSA Rules; NAIC Model Regulation; HIPAA

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code of the state in which the annuity contract was issued. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, unisex mortality table requirements, free-look period, surrender charge rules, and state premium tax obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: The status of the annuity suitability review conducted for this annuitant at the time of contract issuance or material change. Required under NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation (#275) and applicable state regulations. 'approved' indicates the product was deemed suitable; 'rejected' blocks issuance; 'waived' applies to certain replacement or exchange transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation (#275); DOL Fiduciary Rule; FINRA Rule 2330

attributes.name: tax_withholding_election
attributes.description: The annuitant's federal income tax withholding election for annuity payments and distributions. 'withhold' elects mandatory withholding; 'do_not_withhold' opts out where permitted; 'state_only' applies state withholding only. Governs 1099-R reporting and payment processing in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3405; IRS Publication 505; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: withholding_pct
attributes.description: The elected federal income tax withholding percentage applied to annuity payments and distributions. Applicable when tax_withholding_election is 'withhold'. Null if the annuitant has elected no withholding or if a flat dollar amount is used instead.

products.name: policyholder_beneficiary
products.description: Master record for each named beneficiary designated to receive death benefit (DB) or contract proceeds upon the insured's or annuitant's death. Stores beneficiary name, relationship to insured, beneficiary type (primary, contingent, tertiary), designation percentage, TIN/SSN, trust/entity name for non-individual beneficiaries, irrevocable flag, and effective/expiry dates. Supports ILIT and trust beneficiary structures. SSOT for beneficiary identity and designation data across policy and annuity domains.

attributes.name: policyholder_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each beneficiary designation record in the policyholder domain. Serves as the primary key for the policyholder_beneficiary data product. Entity role: MASTER_PARTY — represents a named party designated to receive death benefit (DB) or contract proceeds.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Annuity contracts require beneficiary records for death benefit distribution (primary, contingent, per stirpes designations). Current model only links beneficiaries to life insurance policies. Annuity

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract under which this beneficiary designation applies. Enables cross-domain linkage to the policy or annuity contract record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST)

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (contract owner or insured) who made this beneficiary designation. Links the beneficiary record to the owning party in the policyholder master.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST)

attributes.name: trust_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.trust. Business justification: Beneficiaries can be trust entities. Currently trust_formation_date and trust_ein are stored in policyholder_beneficiary. Normalizing to trust.trust_id FK allows joining to the authoritative trust ent

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Beneficiaries are designated during application. Linking beneficiary to application tracks initial designation, supports STOLI investigations (unusual beneficiary patterns from application), and enabl

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the beneficiary's mailing address. Used for claims correspondence, benefit payment delivery, and regulatory reporting. Required for state-mandated unclaimed property (escheatment) compliance when a beneficiary cannot be located.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the beneficiary (apartment, suite, unit, floor, PO Box). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address capture.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: Current status of the beneficiary's AML (Anti-Money Laundering) screening against OFAC sanctions lists, PEP (Politically Exposed Person) databases, and adverse media. 'cleared' indicates no matches found; 'flagged' indicates a potential match requiring review; 'pending' indicates screening is in progress; 'escalated' indicates the case has been referred to the AML compliance team.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; OFAC SDN List; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) disbursement of death benefit proceeds to the beneficiary. Stored in encrypted/tokenized form per PCI DSS and data security standards. Populated only when payment_method is 'eft'.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; SOX

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number (RTN) for the beneficiary's bank, used for EFT disbursement of death benefit proceeds. Nine-digit code identifying the financial institution. Populated only when payment_method is 'eft'.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; PCI DSS

attributes.name: beneficiary_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is a natural person (individual), a legal trust (including ILIT — Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust), the insured's estate, a charitable organization, or another legal entity such as a corporation or partnership. Drives KYC/AML identity verification requirements and tax reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRS Publication 559; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary's priority tier in the designation hierarchy. Primary beneficiaries receive proceeds first; contingent beneficiaries receive proceeds if all primary beneficiaries predecease the insured; tertiary beneficiaries are the third-tier fallback. Governs the order of benefit distribution upon a death benefit (DB) claim.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the beneficiary's mailing address. Used for claims correspondence, state jurisdiction determination, and unclaimed property escheatment filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the beneficiary's country of residence (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Required for FATCA/FBAR foreign beneficiary reporting, AML/KYC country risk assessment, and international claims payment processing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IRS FATCA (IRC Section 1471); FinCEN AML/BSA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual beneficiary. Used to verify identity during claims adjudication, determine minor beneficiary status (requiring guardian or trust appointment), calculate required minimum distributions (RMD) for inherited annuity contracts, and comply with HIPAA and state insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; IRS RMD Rules (IRC Section 401(a)(9)); HIPAA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: designation_form_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier of the signed beneficiary designation or change form submitted by the policyholder. Provides an audit trail linking the data record to the physical or digital source document stored in the Document Management system. Supports compliance and legal dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; SOX; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: designation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage share of the death benefit (DB) or contract proceeds allocated to this beneficiary within their priority tier (primary, contingent, or tertiary). All beneficiaries within the same tier must sum to 100.00%. Governs pro-rata distribution of proceeds at claim settlement.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: designation_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number used to order multiple beneficiaries within the same priority tier (primary, contingent, or tertiary) on a given policy. Supports display ordering on policy documents and beneficiary designation forms. Does not imply priority — all beneficiaries in the same tier share proceeds per their designation_percentage.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST)

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the beneficiary designation record. 'active' indicates the designation is in force; 'revoked' indicates the policyholder has removed this beneficiary; 'superseded' indicates a newer designation has replaced this record; 'pending' indicates the change request is awaiting processing or approval; 'expired' indicates the designation has passed its effective end date.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this beneficiary designation became legally effective. Typically corresponds to the date the signed beneficiary change form was received and processed by the insurer. Used to determine which designation was in force at the time of the insured's death for claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the beneficiary. Used for digital claims notification, document delivery, and beneficiary portal access. Supports CRM-driven customer engagement workflows for beneficiary outreach.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; GDPR Article 4; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the trust, estate, charity, or corporate entity designated as beneficiary. Populated when beneficiary_category is 'trust', 'estate', 'charity', or 'entity'. Supports ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) and other non-individual beneficiary structures. Required for AML entity due diligence.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA; IRS Publication 559; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this beneficiary designation ceases to be effective, if applicable. Null for open-ended designations. Used for time-limited beneficiary arrangements such as collateral assignments or court-ordered designations with defined end dates.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the individual beneficiary as recorded on the beneficiary designation form. Populated only when beneficiary_category is 'individual'. Required for identity verification, KYC compliance, and death benefit (DB) claim processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the individual beneficiary as recorded on the designation form. Used for identity verification during claims processing and for actuarial life expectancy calculations on inherited annuity contracts subject to RMD rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the court-appointed or designated guardian or custodian for a minor beneficiary. Populated only when minor_flag is True. Required for claims payment processing to ensure proceeds are directed to the legal guardian rather than the minor directly.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA

attributes.name: is_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this beneficiary designation is irrevocable. When True, the policyholder cannot change or revoke the beneficiary without the beneficiary's written consent. Common in ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) structures, collateral assignments, and divorce decree requirements. Restricts policy servicing actions such as loans, surrenders, and assignment changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary's KYC identity verification was completed and approved. Used to track the currency of identity verification and trigger re-verification workflows when the verification has aged beyond the insurer's AML program refresh threshold.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary's identity has been verified through the insurer's KYC (Know Your Customer) process. When True, identity documents have been reviewed and validated per AML/BSA program requirements. Required for high-value death benefit (DB) payments and trust/entity beneficiaries.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal surname of the individual beneficiary as recorded on the beneficiary designation form. Populated only when beneficiary_category is 'individual'. Required for identity verification and death benefit (DB) claim processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the individual beneficiary. Used to disambiguate beneficiaries with common first and last names during claims adjudication and identity verification.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual beneficiary is a legal minor (under age 18 or applicable state age of majority) at the time of designation. When True, a guardian, custodian, or trust must be appointed to receive and manage death benefit proceeds on behalf of the minor, triggering special claims handling workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for disbursing death benefit (DB) or contract proceeds to this beneficiary. 'eft' indicates electronic funds transfer to a bank account; 'check' indicates paper check; 'wire' indicates domestic or international wire transfer; 'annuity_settlement' indicates proceeds are to be paid as an annuity settlement option rather than a lump sum.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro, FAST)

attributes.name: per_stirpes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary's share is designated per stirpes (by representation). When True, if this beneficiary predeceases the insured, the beneficiary's share passes to their lineal descendants rather than being redistributed among surviving beneficiaries. Governs death benefit (DB) distribution logic in claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the beneficiary. Used by the claims department to notify and communicate with beneficiaries upon the insured's death. Supports outbound claims notification workflows in the Claims Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; GDPR Article 4; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the beneficiary's mailing address. Used for claims correspondence routing, state jurisdiction determination, and unclaimed property escheatment compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was first created in the system of record. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was most recently modified in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: relationship_to_insured
attributes.description: Describes the legal or familial relationship between the beneficiary and the insured (e.g., spouse, child, parent, sibling, domestic partner, business partner, trust, estate, charity). Used in insurable interest determinations, claims adjudication, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|domestic_partner|business_partner|grandchild|grandparent|other_relative|trust|estate|charity|employer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 101

attributes.name: settlement_option
attributes.description: The elected settlement option governing how death benefit (DB) proceeds will be paid to this beneficiary. 'lump_sum' pays the full amount at once; 'life_income' provides lifetime annuity payments; 'fixed_period' pays over a specified number of years; 'interest_only' retains principal and pays interest; 'joint_survivor' provides income for two lives. Drives annuity contract administration workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this beneficiary designation record was sourced (e.g., FAST, SAPIENS_LIFEPRO, ORACLE_IPAS). Supports data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the beneficiary's mailing address (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Used to determine applicable state insurance regulations, unclaimed property escheatment jurisdiction, and state income tax withholding on death benefit proceeds.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; IRS Publication 559

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The IRS-issued Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for the beneficiary, which may be a Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals or an Employer Identification Number (EIN) for trusts and entities. Required for IRS Form 1099-R tax reporting on death benefit proceeds and for AML/KYC identity verification. Stored in encrypted form per data security standards.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 6109; IRS Form 1099-R; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; SOX

products.name: kyc_verification
products.description: Transactional record capturing each KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) identity verification event performed on a policyholder party (insured, owner, annuitant, or beneficiary). Stores verification type (identity, AML/BSA, OFAC, MIB), verification date, verification method (manual, automated, third-party bureau), verification status (pass, fail, pending, escalated), risk rating assigned, FinCEN/SAR flag, and the identity of the verifying system or analyst.
