Supports NAIC, FinCEN, and state DOI compliance obligations.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for kyc_verification

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or user identifier of the compliance analyst or underwriter who performed or approved the manual verification. Populated for manual and escalated verification methods; null for fully automated checks.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: KYC verification failures trigger compliance issues requiring investigation and remediation. Compliance teams need to track which KYC deficiencies generated formal compliance matters for regulatory re

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder party (insured, owner, annuitant, or beneficiary) who is the subject of this KYC/AML verification event.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN Customer Identification Program (CIP) Rule 31 CFR 1020.220

attributes.name: remediation_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.remediation_plan. Business justification: KYC deficiencies requiring corrective action link to remediation plans. Operations track which KYC gaps are being addressed through formal remediation for regulatory exam responses and ongoing monitor

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: KYC verifications are triggered by underwriting applications to comply with AML/KYC regulations. Linking verification to application tracks compliance at underwriting, supports STOLI/AML risk scoring

attributes.name: aml_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the AML/BSA compliance program ruleset or screening configuration in effect at the time of this verification. Enables audit traceability when program rules are updated.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements 31 CFR 1020.210; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) 31 USC 5318

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficial owner(s) of the policy or annuity contract (e.g., trust beneficiaries, ILIT trustees) were identified and verified as part of this KYC event, as required under FinCEN's Beneficial Ownership Rule for legal entity customers.
attributes.references: FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule 31 CFR 1010.230; FATF Recommendation 24; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this KYC/AML verification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record retention tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; NAIC Record Retention Guidelines

attributes.name: enhanced_due_diligence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is required for this party based on the outcome of this verification event. EDD is mandated for high-risk parties, PEPs, and parties from high-risk jurisdictions under FATF and FinCEN guidelines.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 19; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this KYC/AML verification record expires and re-verification is required. Distinct from next_review_date in that expiry_date represents the hard compliance deadline, while next_review_date may be an earlier scheduled review.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: identity_document_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the identity document used for verification. Expired documents may trigger re-verification requirements under CIP rules.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: identity_document_issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the government authority that issued the identity document. Used for OFAC screening and cross-border AML risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC SDN List; FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220

attributes.name: identity_document_number
attributes.description: The unique number of the government-issued identity document (e.g., passport number, driver's license number, national ID number) used to verify the party's identity. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; HIPAA Privacy Rule; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: identity_document_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identity document presented or verified during the identity proofing process. Required under FinCEN Customer Identification Program rules.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (ISO 3166-2 US subdivision) of the regulatory jurisdiction governing this verification event. Determines applicable state Department of Insurance (DOI) requirements and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC State DOI Regulations; ISO 3166-2; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: kyc_program_type
attributes.description: The specific KYC program tier under which this verification was conducted. CIP (Customer Identification Program) is the baseline; CDD (Customer Due Diligence) is the standard ongoing program; EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence) applies to high-risk parties; ongoing_monitoring covers periodic re-screening.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule 31 CFR 1010.230; FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: mib_check_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Medical Information Bureau (MIB) inquiry was performed as part of this verification event. MIB checks are used in life insurance underwriting to detect undisclosed medical conditions or prior application activity.
attributes.references: MIB Group Data Standards; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: mib_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MIB inquiry returned a coded record match for the party, suggesting prior insurance application activity or a reportable medical condition. Triggers underwriting review when True.
attributes.references: MIB Group Data Standards; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC/AML re-verification of this party, determined by the assigned risk rating and AML program policy. High-risk parties require more frequent review cycles.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: ofac_match_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party's name or identifiers returned a potential match against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list or other OFAC sanctions lists during this verification event.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 CFR Part 501; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: ofac_match_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Match Score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.00–100.00) returned by the OFAC screening engine indicating the degree of similarity between the party's identity data and a potential SDN list match. Used to distinguish true positives from false positives.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List Screening Best Practices; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: The role of the policyholder party being verified in relation to the insurance contract. Determines the applicable KYC/AML requirements and risk thresholds for the verification.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 881; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has been identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) — a current or former senior government official, military officer, or their close associate — requiring enhanced due diligence under FATF and FinCEN guidelines.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy or annuity contract number associated with this KYC/AML verification event, when the verification is triggered by a specific policy transaction. May be null for pre-application or standalone identity checks.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: AML/KYC risk rating assigned to the policyholder party as a result of this verification event. Drives ongoing monitoring frequency, enhanced due diligence requirements, and SAR filing thresholds per FinCEN and NAIC guidelines.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Risk Assessment; FATF Recommendation 10; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (typically 0–100) assigned by the verification system or third-party bureau to quantify the AML/KYC risk level of the party. Complements the categorical risk_rating for fine-grained risk stratification and analytics.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Risk Assessment; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: sar_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KYC/AML verification event has triggered or is associated with a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing with FinCEN. Drives escalation workflows and compliance reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements 31 CFR 1020.320; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) 31 USC 5318(g)

attributes.name: sar_reference_number
attributes.description: The FinCEN-assigned or internal reference number of the Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filed in connection with this verification event. Populated only when sar_flag is True. Classified as confidential due to legal sensitivity of SAR disclosures.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements 31 CFR 1020.320; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) 31 USC 5318(g)

attributes.name: source_of_funds_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the verified source of funds for premium payments or annuity contributions (e.g., 'Employment income', 'Proceeds from real estate sale', 'Inheritance', '1035 Exchange from prior policy'). Classified as confidential due to financial sensitivity.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: source_of_funds_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source of funds for premium payments or annuity contributions was verified during this KYC/AML event. Required for high-risk parties and large premium transactions under AML/BSA program requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 10; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: ssn_tin_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Number (SSN) / Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party's SSN or TIN was successfully verified against IRS or Social Security Administration records during this verification event. Critical for tax compliance and identity proofing.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Matching Program; FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; IRC Section 6109

attributes.name: stoli_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this verification event identified characteristics consistent with a Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) arrangement, where a policy is originated by a third party with no insurable interest. Triggers enhanced review and potential policy rescission.
attributes.references: NAIC STOLI Model Regulation; State DOI Regulations; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event that initiated this KYC/AML verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_business|policy_renewal|beneficiary_change|ownership_change|large_transaction|periodic_review|regulatory_request|reinstatement|1035_exchange|annuity_payout — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this KYC/AML verification record was last modified. Tracks updates to verification status, risk rating, or SAR flag following analyst review or system re-screening.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; NAIC Record Retention Guidelines

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the KYC/AML verification event was initiated or performed. Used for regulatory timeliness tracking and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The operational method used to perform the verification. Manual indicates analyst-driven review; automated indicates rules-engine or system-driven check; third_party_bureau indicates use of an external data provider (e.g., LexisNexis, Experian); document_review indicates physical or digital document inspection; biometric indicates fingerprint, facial recognition, or other biometric confirmation.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: verification_outcome_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation of the reason for the verification outcome, particularly for fail, escalated, or inconclusive statuses. Documents the specific finding (e.g., 'Name mismatch on OFAC SDN list', 'Expired identity document', 'Insufficient documentation provided').
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; NAIC Model Regulation 881; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: verification_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this verification event by the verifying system or third-party bureau, used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KYC/AML verification event. Pass indicates successful identity confirmation; fail indicates identity could not be confirmed or a match was found on a watchlist; pending indicates verification is in progress; escalated indicates the case has been referred for manual review or SAR filing; inconclusive indicates insufficient data to render a determination.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements 31 CFR 1020.320; NAIC Model Regulation 881; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the KYC/AML verification event was executed by the system or analyst. Distinct from verification_date; used for audit trail and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: verification_type
attributes.description: Category of KYC/AML verification performed. Values: identity (standard identity proofing), aml_bsa (Anti-Money Laundering/Bank Secrecy Act screening), ofac (Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions screening), mib (Medical Information Bureau check), enhanced_due_diligence (EDD for high-risk parties), pep_screening (Politically Exposed Person screening).
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA 31 CFR 1020; OFAC SDN List; MIB Group Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 881

attributes.name: verifying_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system, platform, or third-party bureau that performed or facilitated the verification (e.g., 'LexisNexis Risk Solutions', 'Experian IdentityWorks', 'Salesforce FSC KYC Module', 'Manual Review'). Supports audit trail and vendor management.
attributes.references: FinCEN CIP Rule 31 CFR 1020.220; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: watchlist_screened
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or coded identifier of the watchlists and sanctions databases screened during this verification event (e.g., 'OFAC_SDN, EU_SANCTIONS, UN_SANCTIONS, FBI_MOST_WANTED'). Documents the scope of screening for regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; FATF Recommendation 6

products.name: party_address
products.description: Master record for all physical and mailing addresses associated with a policyholder party (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary). Stores address type (home, mailing, business, legal domicile), street, city, state, ZIP+4, county, country, address effective date, and USPS/CASS validation status. Supports state DOI jurisdiction determination, premium tax situs, and regulatory notice delivery. A party may have multiple addresses with one designated as the primary address of record.

attributes.name: party_address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party address record in the policyholder domain. Serves as the primary key for the party_address data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder party (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary, or trust entity) to whom this address belongs. Links the address record to the master party record in the policyholder domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number, street name, and street type (e.g., '123 Main St'). Used for USPS/CASS validation, regulatory notice delivery, and premium tax situs determination.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; ACORD AL3; CASS Certification

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, floor, PO Box, or care-of designations. Supplements address_line_1 for complete deliverability. May be null when not applicable.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; ACORD AL3

attributes.name: address_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating business channel or system through which this address was captured or updated. Used for data quality auditing and tracing address provenance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: application|policy_service|crm|agent_submission|ncoa|self_service|document — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD AL3; Policy Administration System; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. 'active' indicates the address is current and in use; 'inactive' indicates the address is no longer current but retained for history; 'undeliverable' indicates USPS or carrier returned mail as undeliverable; 'pending_validation' indicates the address has been entered but not yet CASS-validated.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address record. 'home' is the primary residential address; 'mailing' is the preferred correspondence address; 'business' is a commercial address; 'legal_domicile' is the address used for state DOI jurisdiction and premium tax situs determination; 'seasonal' is a secondary residence; 'temporary' is a short-term address. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: home|mailing|business|legal_domicile|seasonal|temporary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD AL3 Address Type Codes; NAIC State Jurisdiction Rules

attributes.name: address_verified_by
attributes.description: Identifies the method or service used to verify the accuracy and deliverability of this address. 'usps_cass' indicates USPS CASS certification; 'third_party' indicates a commercial address verification vendor; 'manual' indicates manual review by operations staff; 'self_reported' indicates unverified party-provided data; 'ncoa' indicates updated via USPS NCOA linkage.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards

attributes.name: address_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the address was most recently verified through the method identified in address_verified_by. Used to assess address data currency and trigger re-verification workflows when the verification age exceeds policy thresholds.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: cass_return_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) Return Code
attributes.description: The standardized USPS CASS return/footnote code indicating the result of the address validation process (e.g., 'A' for address corrected, 'B' for PO Box match, 'N' for no match found). Used to assess address quality and deliverability risk for regulatory notices.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification Standards; USPS Publication 28 Appendix

attributes.name: cass_validated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) Validated Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated and standardized through the USPS Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) certification process. CASS validation ensures deliverability and is required for bulk mailing compliance and regulatory notice delivery.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification Standards; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: cass_validation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) Validation Date
attributes.description: The date on which the address was last validated through the USPS CASS certification process. CASS certifications expire periodically; this date is used to determine whether re-validation is required for regulatory notice mailings.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau census tract code for the address location. Used for demographic analytics, Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) compliance reporting, actuarial territory studies, and market penetration analysis.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau; Community Reinvestment Act (CRA); Actuarial Territory Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Municipality or city name of the address. Used in conjunction with state and ZIP code for USPS validation, state DOI jurisdiction determination, and regulatory notice delivery.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; ACORD AL3; NAIC State Jurisdiction Rules

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Required for international policyholders, ILIT trust addresses, and AML/KYC country-of-residence determination. Defaults to 'USA' for domestic policies.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ACORD AL3; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name within the state. Used for local tax jurisdiction determination, actuarial territory assignments, and certain state-level regulatory reporting requirements. May be null for non-US addresses.
attributes.references: NAIC Regulatory Reporting; State DOI Jurisdiction Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this address record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates that the party has requested suppression of physical mail to this address, or that the address has been flagged as undeliverable for mailing purposes. When True, physical correspondence should be suppressed and alternative delivery methods (e.g., electronic) should be used where permitted.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State DOI Consumer Protection Regulations; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: doi_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code identifying the state Department of Insurance (DOI) with regulatory jurisdiction over this party based on their address of record. Used to determine applicable state insurance regulations, required policy forms, mandated notices, and consumer protection rules.
attributes.references: NAIC State Jurisdiction Rules; State DOI Regulations; ACORD AL3

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation_code
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Validation (DPV) confirmation code indicating the deliverability status of the address. 'Y' = confirmed deliverable; 'S' = deliverable to primary number only (secondary missing); 'D' = deliverable to primary number only (secondary not needed); 'N' = not deliverable. Critical for ensuring regulatory notices reach policyholders.
attributes.references: USPS DPV Standards; USPS Publication 28; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this address became the active address of record for the party. Used to establish the timeline of address history, determine applicable state jurisdiction for regulatory notices, and support premium tax situs audits.
attributes.references: NAIC State Jurisdiction Rules; State DOI Regulations; ACORD AL3

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this address record ceased to be the active address of record. Null for currently active addresses. Used to maintain a complete address history for regulatory compliance, audit trails, and KYC/AML reviews.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: fips_county_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) County Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state FIPS + 3-digit county FIPS) for the address location. Used for actuarial territory assignments, catastrophe risk zone mapping, regulatory reporting, and geographic analytics aligned with US Census Bureau standards.
attributes.references: FIPS Publication 6-4; US Census Bureau; NAIC Regulatory Reporting; Actuarial Territory Standards

attributes.name: foreign_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is located outside the United States. Foreign addresses trigger additional AML/KYC review requirements, FATCA reporting obligations, and may affect state DOI jurisdiction determination and premium tax situs.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); IRS Form W-8; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: geocode_quality
attributes.description: Indicates the precision level of the geocoded coordinates for this address. 'rooftop' is the highest precision (exact building location); 'parcel' is parcel-level; 'street' is street-level interpolation; 'zip_centroid' is ZIP code centroid; 'city_centroid' is city centroid; 'failed' indicates geocoding was unsuccessful. Used to assess reliability of geographic analytics.
attributes.references: Actuarial Territory Rating Standards; Catastrophe Risk Modeling Standards

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the designated primary address of record for the party. Only one address per party should have this flag set to True at any given time. The primary address is used for all official regulatory notices, policy documents, and premium billing correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Notice Requirements; ACORD AL3

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Populated through geocoding services. Used for actuarial territory rating, catastrophe risk modeling, geographic segmentation analytics, and proximity-based agent assignment.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709; Actuarial Territory Rating Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Populated through geocoding services. Used in conjunction with latitude for actuarial territory rating, catastrophe risk modeling, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709; Actuarial Territory Rating Standards

attributes.name: msa_code
attributes.description: US Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) code for the address location. Used for market segmentation, distribution analytics, actuarial experience studies, and geographic reporting aligned with OMB statistical area definitions.
attributes.references: OMB Statistical Area Definitions; US Census Bureau; Actuarial Experience Study Standards

attributes.name: ncoa_move_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Move Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent address update identified through the USPS National Change of Address (NCOA) linkage process. Populated when an NCOA match is found, indicating the party has filed a change-of-address with USPS. Used to proactively update policyholder address records.
attributes.references: USPS NCOA Linkage Program; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State DOI Notice Requirements

attributes.name: ncoa_move_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Change of Address (NCOA) Move Type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of USPS National Change of Address (NCOA) move record matched to this party. 'individual' indicates a single person move; 'family' indicates a household move; 'business' indicates a business entity move. Used to determine the scope of address update actions required.
attributes.references: USPS NCOA Linkage Program; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: postal_code_foreign
attributes.description: Postal or postcode for non-US international addresses where the USPS ZIP code format does not apply (e.g., Canadian postal codes, UK postcodes). Used for international policyholder correspondence and AML/KYC country-of-residence verification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166; ACORD AL3; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: province_region
attributes.description: Province, region, or administrative division for non-US addresses where the state_code field is not applicable. Used for international policyholder address records, ILIT trust addresses, and foreign beneficiary addresses. Null for domestic US addresses.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; ACORD AL3; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing integer version number for this address record, incremented on each update. Used for optimistic concurrency control, change history tracking, and ensuring data consistency across distributed Silver Layer processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; Databricks Delta Lake Versioning Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this address record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Policy Administration System such as Sapiens LifePro, FAST, or CRM such as Salesforce Financial Services Cloud). Used for data lineage tracing, ETL reconciliation, and cross-system address matching.
attributes.references: ACORD AL3; Policy Administration System; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this address record was sourced (e.g., 'Sapiens LifePro', 'FAST', 'Salesforce FSC', 'Majesco Billing'). Used for data lineage, ETL audit trails, and multi-system address deduplication.
attributes.references: ACORD AL3; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state or territory abbreviation (e.g., 'CA', 'NY', 'TX'). Critical for determining state Department of Insurance (DOI) jurisdiction, premium tax situs, regulatory filing requirements, and applicable state insurance law. Used in NAIC regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC State Jurisdiction Rules; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: tax_situs_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code designating the state of premium tax situs for this address. Determined from the legal domicile or home address and used by the Finance and Actuarial teams for state premium tax calculations, SAP/GAAP reporting, and NAIC regulatory filings. May differ from state_code when the legal domicile address differs from the mailing address.
attributes.references: NAIC Premium Tax Reporting; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); State DOI Premium Tax Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this address record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer data product. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit USPS ZIP code for the address. Used for mail deliverability, geographic segmentation, premium tax situs, and actuarial territory rating. Combined with zip_plus4 for full ZIP+4 precision.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; ACORD AL3

attributes.name: zip_plus4
attributes.description: Four-digit ZIP+4 extension code assigned by USPS to narrow delivery to a specific block face or building. Enhances mail deliverability precision and is required for CASS-certified address validation. Null when not yet validated or not available.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; CASS Certification Standards

products.name: party_contact
products.description: Master record for all communication contact points for a policyholder party — phone numbers, email addresses, and digital identifiers. Stores contact type (home phone, mobile, work, email, fax), contact value, preferred contact indicator, TCPA consent status, contact verification date, and active/inactive status. One party may have multiple contacts with one designated as primary per channel. Supports CRM outreach, service notifications, and regulatory notice delivery. Contact preferences and restrictions are governed by the communication_preference entity.

attributes.name: party_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contact point record associated with a policyholder party. Serves as the primary key for the party_contact entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Architecture Convention

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder party (insured, contract owner, annuitant, or beneficiary) to whom this contact point belongs. One party may have multiple contact records.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: best_contact_time_end
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format, local to contact time_zone) at which the party prefers to be contacted via this channel. Paired with best_contact_time_start to define the preferred outreach window.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC Regulations; Salesforce Financial Services Cloud

attributes.name: best_contact_time_start
attributes.description: Earliest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format, local to contact time_zone) at which the party prefers to be contacted via this channel. Used by CRM outbound scheduling to respect party preferences and TCPA calling hour restrictions.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC Regulations; Salesforce Financial Services Cloud

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of delivery failures (bounces) recorded for this contact point. For email contacts, tracks hard and soft bounces. For phone contacts, tracks failed delivery attempts. Used to trigger automatic deactivation after a configurable threshold is exceeded.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Salesforce Financial Services Cloud

attributes.name: contact_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority order for attempting contact via this channel when multiple contacts of the same type exist for a party. Lower values indicate higher priority (e.g., rank 1 is attempted before rank 2). Supports fallback outreach sequencing in CRM and claims notification workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. 'bounced' applies to email addresses that have returned delivery failures. 'opted_out' reflects a party's explicit withdrawal from contact via this channel. Drives suppression logic in outreach campaigns.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227

attributes.name: contact_subtype
attributes.description: Further qualifies the contact type to distinguish personal contacts from business, trust (ILIT), or estate-related contacts. Supports customer relationship hierarchy management for complex ownership structures.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the communication channel for this contact record. Drives routing logic for CRM outreach, regulatory notices, billing alerts, and claims correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: home_phone|mobile_phone|work_phone|email|fax|digital_id|pager|social_handle — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_use_purpose
attributes.description: Specifies the business purpose(s) for which this contact point may be used. Enables granular consent and suppression management — for example, a party may allow billing notifications but opt out of marketing. Aligns with GDPR purpose limitation principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Purpose Limitation); CCPA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact point data — phone number, email address, fax number, or digital identifier — stored as a string. Classification tag applies to phone and email values; downstream masking rules are applied based on contact_type. For email values, format follows RFC 5321. For phone values, format follows E.164 international standard.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; E.164 ITU-T Standard; RFC 5321

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code associated with this contact point. Used for international dialing prefix resolution, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and GDPR/CCPA applicability assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; NAIC Model Regulation; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Regulation; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the assessed quality and reliability of this contact record, derived from verification status, bounce history, and last successful contact date. Used by data stewards and CRM teams to prioritize contact data cleansing efforts.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the party has explicitly requested no outreach via this contact point. When true, all non-mandatory communications (marketing, service campaigns) are suppressed. Mandatory regulatory notices (e.g., lapse notices, policy anniversary statements) may still be sent per state insurance regulations.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the do_not_contact flag is set. Supports compliance audit trails and ensures appropriate handling of suppressed contacts. 'legal_hold' indicates a litigation or regulatory hold. 'fraud_flag' indicates a suspected fraudulent contact.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact record is considered valid and active for use in outreach and regulatory notice delivery. Supports bi-temporal data modeling for contact history tracking.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: email_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party provided or last updated their email opt-in consent. Required for CAN-SPAM and GDPR audit trails. Null if email_opt_in_status is opted_out or unsubscribed.

attributes.name: email_opt_in_status
attributes.description: Indicates the party's email marketing and communication opt-in status for this email contact. Applies only when contact_type is email. Governs CAN-SPAM and CASL compliance for outbound email campaigns and service notifications.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act 15 U.S.C. § 7701; CASL; GDPR Article 7; CCPA

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this contact record is no longer considered valid. Null for open-ended active contacts. Used in bi-temporal history management and to enforce contact data retention policies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation)

attributes.name: is_preferred
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the party's overall preferred method of communication across all channels. Distinct from is_primary, which is channel-scoped. Used for CRM campaign targeting and service notification routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud; Microsoft Dynamics 365; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record is the designated primary contact for its channel type. Only one contact per party per contact_type may be flagged as primary. Used by CRM and policy administration systems to determine the default outreach channel.
attributes.references: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_regulatory_notice_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact point is approved for delivery of mandatory regulatory notices (e.g., lapse notices, grace period warnings, annual statements, policy anniversary notices) as required by state insurance regulations. A contact may be suppressed for marketing but still eligible for regulatory notices.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Regulations; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN) indicating the party's preferred language for communications delivered via this contact channel. Supports multilingual regulatory notice delivery and CRM localization.
attributes.references: BCP 47 (IETF RFC 5646); NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent delivery failure for this contact point. Used alongside bounce_count to assess contact data quality and determine whether re-verification or deactivation is warranted.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: last_successful_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent confirmed successful outreach via this contact point (e.g., email delivered without bounce, call answered, SMS delivered). Used to assess contact data quality and trigger re-verification or update workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Salesforce Financial Services Cloud; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context about this contact record, such as special handling instructions, agent-entered remarks, or explanations for non-standard contact configurations. Not used for PII storage.
attributes.references: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: phone_country_dial_code
attributes.description: International dialing prefix (e.g., +1 for USA, +44 for UK) for phone and fax contact types. Populated only when contact_type is home_phone, mobile_phone, work_phone, or fax. Supports E.164 number formatting for outbound dialing systems.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: Optional telephone extension number for work phone contact types, typically used for corporate or group policyholder contacts. Appended after the main phone number during outbound dialing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this contact record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same contact appears in multiple source systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: policy_admin|crm|underwriting|claims|billing|annuity|agent_portal|self_service|reinsurance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_contact_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this contact record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Contact ID, Policy Administration System contact reference). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ETL lineage tracing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tcpa_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date on which the party provided or last updated their TCPA consent for this contact number. Required for audit and regulatory compliance documentation. Null if tcpa_consent_status is not_consented.

attributes.name: tcpa_consent_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Consent Method
attributes.description: Method by which TCPA consent was obtained for this contact. Supports audit trail requirements and legal defensibility in the event of a TCPA complaint or regulatory inquiry.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC Regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: tcpa_consent_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Consent Status
attributes.description: Records the party's consent status under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) for automated calls, robocalls, and text messages to this contact number. Mandatory for mobile_phone contact types. Drives suppression of automated outreach to non-consented numbers.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC Regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago) associated with this contact point. Used by CRM and outbound dialing systems to schedule calls and messages within permissible calling hours per TCPA regulations.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; IANA Time Zone Database; FCC Regulations

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Business user ID or system process identifier that last modified this contact record. Supports audit trail and change accountability requirements under SOX and NAIC market conduct standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this contact record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Regulation; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact point was most recently verified as reachable and accurate. Used to assess contact data freshness and trigger re-verification workflows when contacts exceed the maximum staleness threshold.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify this contact point. Supports audit trail for KYC/AML compliance and regulatory notice delivery confirmation. 'third_party' indicates verification via an external data provider such as LexisNexis or Experian.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation; KYC Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact point has been validated through an outreach verification process (e.g., email confirmation link, SMS OTP, phone call confirmation). Supports KYC/AML compliance and ensures regulatory notices reach the intended party.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; KYC Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

products.name: relationship
products.description: Association record capturing formal legal, familial, or business relationships between two parties in the policyholder domain. Stores relationship type (spouse, parent, child, trustee, ILIT trustee, corporate officer, power of attorney, legal guardian, UTMA custodian), relationship subtype, effective date, termination date, insurable interest basis, and legal documentation reference. For power-of-attorney relationships: POA type (durable, limited, healthcare), attorney-in-fact identity, authorization scope (full or limited to specific transactions), effective date, expiration date, and revocation date — supporting policy servicing, claims, and financial transaction authorization workflows. For guardianship relationships: guardianship type (legal guardian, custodian, UTMA custodian), court appointment date, jurisdiction of appointment, and guardianship expiration date (typically at age of majority) — supporting claims payment to minors, beneficiary designation management, and UTMA/UGMA account coordination. Supports customer hierarchy modeling, ILIT trust ownership chains, group policy member-to-sponsor relationships, and all inter-party legal authorizations. SSOT for all inter-party associations, legal authorizations, power-of-attorney records, and guardianship records within the policyholder domain.

attributes.name: relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the inter-party relationship record within the policyholder domain. Primary key for the relationship data product.

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: Relationship fraud (false insurable interest, undisclosed beneficial ownership) triggers compliance issues. Underwriting and compliance teams link suspicious relationships to formal issues for investi

attributes.name: relationship_party_b_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the second party (object/grantee side) in the relationship. For a power-of-attorney record, this is the attorney-in-fact. For a guardianship record, this is the guardian/custodian. For a spousal relationship, this is the spouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: relationship_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the first party (subject/grantor side) in the relationship. For a power-of-attorney record, this is the principal granting authority. For a guardianship record, this is the ward/minor. For a spousal relationship, this is the policyholder.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: trust_id
attributes.description: FK to policyholder.trust

attributes.name: aml_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship record has been flagged for AML review due to complex ownership structures (e.g., ILIT, corporate ownership, foreign trust), high-risk jurisdictions, or unusual transaction patterns. Triggers referral to the AML compliance team.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which consent was formally obtained from the relevant parties for the establishment and use of this relationship record. Supports HIPAA and state privacy law compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule; State Privacy Laws; NAIC Privacy Model Regulation

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consent has been obtained from the relevant parties for the establishment and use of this relationship record, as required by HIPAA, state privacy laws, and GDPR for international policyholders. Particularly relevant for healthcare POA and medical information sharing relationships.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule; State Privacy Laws; GDPR Article 6; NAIC Privacy Model Regulation

attributes.name: court_appointment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the court formally appointed the guardian or conservator for the ward. Establishes the legal commencement of guardianship authority for claims payment and beneficiary management purposes. Null for non-court-appointed custodial arrangements (e.g., UTMA/UGMA).
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; Uniform Guardianship and Protective Proceedings Act (UGPPA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this relationship record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Establishes the audit trail for record origination and supports SOX and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ACORD Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the relationship became legally effective and operative for policy servicing, claims, and financial transaction authorization purposes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: guardianship_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guardianship or custodianship legally expires, typically corresponding to the ward's age of majority (18 or 21 depending on jurisdiction) or a court-specified termination date. After this date, the ward assumes direct control of policy proceeds and beneficiary designations.
attributes.references: Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA); Uniform Gifts to Minors Act (UGMA); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: guardianship_jurisdiction
attributes.description: US state or territory in which the guardianship or custodianship was legally established and is governed. Two-letter USPS state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Determines applicable state law for guardianship authority, age of majority, and UTMA/UGMA account rules.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA); Uniform Guardianship and Protective Proceedings Act (UGPPA)

attributes.name: guardianship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guardianship or custodial arrangement when relationship_subtype is legal_guardian, utma_custodian, or ugma_custodian. Determines the legal framework governing the guardian's authority over the ward's insurance proceeds and beneficiary designations.
attributes.references: Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA); Uniform Gifts to Minors Act (UGMA); State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level within the customer or ownership hierarchy at which this relationship exists. Level 1 = direct relationship to the policyholder; higher levels represent indirect relationships (e.g., trustee of an ILIT that owns a policy). Supports ILIT ownership chain modeling and group policy member-to-sponsor hierarchy analytics.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: insurable_interest_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis establishing insurable interest between the parties, required for policy issuance and anti-STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) compliance. Documents the economic or familial nexus that justifies the insurance relationship. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: familial|financial_dependency|business_partner|creditor_debtor|employer_employee|trust_beneficiary|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; STOLI Model Act; IRC Section 7702; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: insurable_interest_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurable interest basis has been formally verified and documented during the underwriting or new business application process. Required for STOLI compliance and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: NAIC STOLI Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or controlling relationship of its type for the party pair. For example, a policyholder may have multiple beneficiary relationships but only one primary beneficiary. Used in beneficiary designation management and claims adjudication workflows.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the KYC identity verification process has been completed for the relationship parties, particularly for trust ownership, POA, and ILIT structures subject to AML/BSA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: legal_doc_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system key for the legal instrument establishing this relationship (e.g., marriage certificate, court order, POA document, trust agreement, corporate resolution). Links to the document management system for audit and compliance retrieval.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; State Departments of Insurance; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: legal_doc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal instrument that establishes or evidences this relationship. Drives document verification workflows and compliance audit requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage_certificate|birth_certificate|court_order|poa_document|trust_agreement|corporate_resolution|divorce_decree|adoption_order — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: legal_doc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supporting legal documentation was verified and accepted by the company. Establishes the audit trail for compliance with KYC/AML documentation requirements and policy servicing authorization controls.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; KYC Standards

attributes.name: legal_doc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supporting legal documentation for this relationship has been received, reviewed, and verified by the policy servicing or new business team. Unverified relationships may be restricted from certain transaction types pending document receipt.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about this relationship record entered by policy servicing staff. Examples include documentation of unusual ownership structures, pending legal proceedings, or special handling instructions for claims.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: party_a_role
attributes.description: Functional role of Party A within this specific relationship. Provides semantic context for the relationship direction and governs which policy servicing transactions Party A may initiate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|insured|annuitant|beneficiary|principal|ward|grantor|employer|sponsor — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: party_b_role
attributes.description: Functional role of Party B within this specific relationship. Governs the scope of authority, transaction eligibility, and legal standing of Party B in relation to Party A's policies and accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|dependent|trustee|attorney_in_fact|guardian|custodian|corporate_officer|key_person|employee|member — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: poa_authorization_scope
attributes.description: Scope of authority granted under the power-of-attorney instrument. Full scope permits all policy servicing and financial transactions; limited scope restricts the attorney-in-fact to specific enumerated transactions as documented in the authorization_scope_description field. Null for non-POA relationships.
attributes.references: Uniform Power of Attorney Act (UPOAA); State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: poa_authorization_scope_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Power of Attorney (POA) Authorization Scope Description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific transactions or authorities granted when poa_authorization_scope is limited. Documents the enumerated powers (e.g., premium payments only, surrender requests, beneficiary changes) for policy servicing and compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: Uniform Power of Attorney Act (UPOAA); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: poa_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the power-of-attorney instrument expires and the attorney-in-fact's authority ceases. Null for durable or open-ended POA instruments. System must enforce this date to prevent unauthorized transactions after expiry.
attributes.references: Uniform Power of Attorney Act (UPOAA); State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: poa_revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the principal formally revoked the power-of-attorney instrument, terminating the attorney-in-fact's authority. Null if the POA has not been revoked. Triggers status change to revoked and blocks further transaction authorization.
attributes.references: Uniform Power of Attorney Act (UPOAA); State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: poa_type
attributes.description: Classification of the power-of-attorney instrument when relationship_subtype is power_of_attorney. Durable POA remains effective upon incapacity; limited POA is restricted to specific transactions; healthcare POA covers medical decisions; springing POA activates upon a triggering event. Null for non-POA relationships.
attributes.references: Uniform Power of Attorney Act (UPOAA); State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the relationship record. Drives eligibility for policy servicing transactions, claims authorization, and beneficiary payouts. A terminated or revoked status prevents further use of the relationship for financial transaction authorization.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the inter-party relationship. Drives downstream processing rules for policy servicing, claims authorization, and beneficiary management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: familial|legal_authorization|fiduciary|business|trust_ownership|group_sponsorship — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this relationship record originated. PAS = Policy Administration System; CRM = Customer Engagement Platform; UW = Underwriting Workbench; CLAIMS = Claims Management System; ANNUITY = Annuity Administration Platform; MANUAL = manually entered by operations staff.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_relationship_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this relationship record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Financial Services Cloud relationship ID, FAST Policy Administration relationship key). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the relationship type. Examples include: spouse, domestic_partner, parent, child, sibling, grandparent, trustee, ilit_trustee, corporate_officer, power_of_attorney, legal_guardian, utma_custodian, ugma_custodian, employer_sponsor, key_person. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|domestic_partner|parent|child|sibling|grandparent|trustee|ilit_trustee|corporate_officer|power_of_attorney|legal_guardian|utma_custodian|ugma_custodian|employer_sponsor|key_person — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the relationship was legally terminated, dissolved, or expired. Null for open-ended active relationships. For guardianship, typically the ward's age of majority date.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this relationship record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture, audit trail maintenance, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ACORD Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

products.name: beneficiary_designation
products.description: Transactional record capturing each formal beneficiary designation event — the act of naming, changing, or revoking a beneficiary on a policy or annuity contract. Stores designation effective date, prior beneficiary snapshot, new beneficiary allocation percentages, designation method (written form, e-signature, court order), NIGO flag if the form was not in good order, and processing status. Distinct from the beneficiary master record — this captures the lifecycle of designation changes over time for audit and claims adjudication purposes.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for beneficiary_designation

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Annuity contracts have death benefit beneficiaries (GMDB, standard death benefit). Current model only links beneficiary designations to life insurance policies. Annuity death benefit claims processing

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document management system record containing the scanned or electronic copy of the beneficiary designation form and any supporting legal documents (e.g., court order, divorce decree, trust agreement). Supports regulatory examination and claims adjudication.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Regulation; HIPAA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal service representative or agent who processed this designation change in the Policy Administration System. Used for quality control, audit trail, and operational performance reporting.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract on which this beneficiary designation event was recorded. Links the designation transaction to the governing policy master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: Beneficiary designation deficiencies (missing documentation, STOLI indicators, insurable interest concerns) trigger compliance issues. Market conduct exams scrutinize beneficiary change patterns requi

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder or contract owner who submitted or authorized this beneficiary designation change. Establishes the party reference required for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: policyholder_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the beneficiary master record identifying the individual, trust, estate, or entity being designated. Distinct from the designation event itself — the master record holds the beneficiary's identity and contact details.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: trust_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.trust. Business justification: Beneficiary designations can name trusts as beneficiaries. Currently trust_name and trust_date are stored as strings in beneficiary_designation. Normalizing to trust.trust_id FK allows joining to the

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Beneficiary designations occur at application time. Linking designation to application tracks initial setup, supports underwriting review of insurable interest, and enables audit of designation change

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The legal distribution method governing how proceeds are allocated among beneficiaries. 'per_capita' distributes equally among surviving beneficiaries; 'per_stirpes' passes a deceased beneficiary's share to their descendants; 'specific_dollar' designates a fixed dollar amount; 'specific_percentage' designates a fixed percentage share.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Probate Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage share of the death benefit, annuity proceeds, or account value allocated to this specific beneficiary under this designation. All active primary beneficiary allocations for a given policy must sum to 100.00%. Stored per designation record to support per-beneficiary audit history.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: aml_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AML/KYC screening was performed for this beneficiary designation. Required for regulatory audit trail under FinCEN AML/BSA compliance. Null if screening was not required.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: The AML/KYC screening status of the designated beneficiary at the time of this designation event. Insurers are required under FinCEN AML/BSA rules to screen beneficiaries, particularly for large face amount policies and irrevocable designations. 'flagged' triggers a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) review.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Standards

attributes.name: beneficiary_entity_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the beneficiary is a natural person, a legal entity, or a special designation. Drives downstream tax withholding rules (e.g., trusts and estates have different IRC Section 72 treatment), KYC requirements, and claims payment processing workflows.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation; IRS Publication 590-B; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: The legal or familial relationship of the designated beneficiary to the insured or contract owner. Used for AML/KYC screening, insurable interest validation, tax reporting (spousal rollover eligibility under IRC Section 72), and claims adjudication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|grandchild|domestic_partner|trust|estate|charity|employer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation; AML/BSA FinCEN; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or triggering life event that prompted the beneficiary designation change. Used for actuarial experience studies, compliance monitoring, and customer lifecycle analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_policy|marriage|divorce|death_of_beneficiary|birth_of_child|court_order|owner_request|policy_assignment|adoption|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contingent_condition
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special conditions or contingencies attached to this beneficiary designation (e.g., 'if beneficiary survives insured by 30 days', 'subject to divorce decree dated MM/DD/YYYY'). Supports complex designation structures and court-ordered conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Probate Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit record creation time in the silver layer, distinct from the business effective date and the received date. Required for SOX audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: designation_method
attributes.description: The channel or legal instrument through which the beneficiary designation was submitted. 'paper_form' is a wet-ink signed ACORD or proprietary form; 'e_signature' is a digitally signed electronic form; 'court_order' is a legally mandated designation (e.g., divorce decree, QDRO); 'will_reference' designates the estate; 'online_portal' is a self-service digital submission; 'phone_request' is a voice-recorded request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paper_form|e_signature|court_order|will_reference|online_portal|phone_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; ESIGN Act; UETA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: designation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST) to uniquely reference this designation transaction. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and claims adjudication workflows.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this designation transaction. 'pending' indicates the form has been received but not yet processed; 'active' indicates the designation is in force; 'superseded' indicates a newer designation has replaced this one; 'revoked' indicates the owner formally withdrew the designation; 'rejected' indicates the form was rejected (e.g., NIGO); 'cancelled' indicates administrative cancellation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: designation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary's priority tier and revocability. 'primary' beneficiaries receive proceeds first; 'contingent' receive proceeds if all primary beneficiaries predecease the insured; 'tertiary' is a third-tier designation; 'irrevocable' designations cannot be changed without the beneficiary's written consent; 'revocable' designations may be changed by the owner at any time.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this beneficiary designation becomes legally binding and in force on the policy. Typically the date the completed, good-order form is received and accepted by the insurer. Critical for claims adjudication to determine which designation was active at the time of the insured event.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: The ACORD or proprietary form number used to submit the beneficiary designation change (e.g., ACORD 156 — Beneficiary Change). Supports regulatory compliance, form version tracking, and state-specific form filing requirements.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: form_version
