attributes.description: The version or edition of the designation form used. Insurers must track form versions to ensure state-approved form versions are used and to support regulatory examination of historical designations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance — Form Filing Requirements

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the court-appointed or designated guardian or custodian for a minor beneficiary. Required when minor_beneficiary_flag is True to ensure proceeds can be legally disbursed. Populated only for minor beneficiaries.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this beneficiary designation is irrevocable, meaning the policy owner cannot change or remove the beneficiary without the beneficiary's written consent. Irrevocable designations are common in divorce settlements, ILIT structures, and collateral assignments. Drives policy servicing workflow restrictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Insurance Law; ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) Standards

attributes.name: is_nigo
attributes.description: Flags whether the beneficiary designation form was received in a Not In Good Order (NIGO) condition — i.e., missing required information, unsigned, or otherwise deficient. NIGO forms require follow-up with the policy owner before the designation can be processed and made effective.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this beneficiary designation, typically the state where the policy was issued or the insured resides. Determines applicable state insurance law requirements for designation validity, notarization, and beneficiary rights.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: minor_beneficiary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designated beneficiary is a minor (under age 18 or applicable state age of majority). Minor beneficiaries require a guardian or custodian to receive proceeds, triggering special claims payment workflows and UTMA/UGMA account considerations.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the specific deficiency that caused the designation form to be flagged as NIGO. Examples include missing beneficiary SSN/TIN, missing owner signature, illegible form, or missing notarization. Populated only when is_nigo is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nigo_resolved_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Resolved Date
attributes.description: The date on which all NIGO deficiencies were remediated and the designation form was accepted as complete and in good order. Null if the form has not yet been resolved or was not NIGO. Used to measure NIGO resolution cycle time for operational reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: notarization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary designation form was notarized, if notarization was required. Null if notarization was not required or has not yet been completed. Used to validate the legal completeness of the designation.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: notarization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation form required notarization under applicable state law, policy contract terms, or court order. Notarization is commonly required for irrevocable designations and court-ordered changes.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_beneficiary_snapshot
attributes.description: A serialized summary of the beneficiary designation(s) that were in force immediately before this designation change was processed. Stored as a structured text snapshot (e.g., JSON-encoded summary) to support audit trail requirements and claims adjudication without requiring a full historical join. Captures prior beneficiary name, type, allocation percentage, and effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: The date the designation change was fully processed and recorded in the Policy Administration System. Represents the completion of the administrative workflow, distinct from the received date and the effective date.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the beneficiary designation form or request was physically or electronically received by the insurer or its TPA. May differ from effective_date if the form required NIGO remediation or administrative processing time.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or administrative comments entered by the processing representative regarding this beneficiary designation event. Examples include notes on court order interpretation, special payment instructions, or follow-up actions required.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this designation record originated. 'PAS' = Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro); 'CRM' = CRM and Customer Engagement Platform; 'PORTAL' = online self-service portal; 'TPA' = Third Party Administrator submission; 'PAPER' = paper form manually keyed; 'ANNUITY' = Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; ETL Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stoli_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this beneficiary designation triggered a STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) review. STOLI arrangements involve designating a stranger or investor as beneficiary to circumvent insurable interest requirements. Flagged designations require compliance review and may result in policy rescission.
attributes.references: NAIC STOLI Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) Standards

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this designation was superseded by a subsequent designation change. Null if the designation is currently active or was revoked/rejected. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of the beneficiary designation history for audit and claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks the most recent update to the record for change data capture, audit trail, and data quality monitoring purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation form required a witness signature under applicable state law or policy contract terms. Certain states and irrevocable designations mandate witnessed signatures for legal validity.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

products.name: communication_preference
products.description: Master record storing a policyholder party's explicit communication preferences and all regulatory/consumer-directed contact restrictions. Positive preferences: preferred language, document delivery method (paper, email, e-delivery portal), e-delivery enrollment status, marketing opt-in flags by channel. Negative restrictions (do-not-contact): do-not-call, do-not-mail, do-not-email, cease-and-desist, litigation hold — with restriction type, restriction source (consumer request, TCPA, state DNC registry, legal counsel), effective date, expiration date, and applicable communication channels. SSOT for all outbound contact governance — both preferences and restrictions. Ensures compliance with TCPA, CAN-SPAM, state telemarketing laws, HIPAA-compliant communication management, state DOI e-delivery statutes, and internal legal hold obligations. Consumed by CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems for every outbound contact decision.

attributes.name: communication_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each communication preference record. Primary key for the communication_preference data product in the policyholder domain.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder party (insured, contract owner, annuitant, or beneficiary) whose communication preferences are governed by this record. Links to the master party entity in the policyholder domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: cease_and_desist
attributes.description: Indicates the party has issued a formal cease-and-desist demand requiring all non-legally-required outbound contact to stop immediately. True = all non-mandatory communications suppressed across all channels. Overrides all positive preferences. Triggers legal review workflow and must be honored within legally required timeframes.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FDCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1692c; State Insurance Code

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The specific outbound communication channel to which this preference or restriction applies: phone (voice calls), email (electronic mail), mail (physical postal mail), sms (text messaging), fax (facsimile), e_delivery_portal (secure online document delivery portal). Drives channel-level suppression and routing logic in CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; HIPAA 45 CFR § 164.522; State Telemarketing Laws

attributes.name: consent_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the party submitted their online consent or opt-in for electronic communications. Used as part of the digital consent audit trail to demonstrate affirmative consent under TCPA and e-delivery statutes. Applicable only for online/portal/mobile consent captures.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; E-SIGN Act 15 U.S.C. § 7001; State DOI E-Delivery Statutes

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the consent language, privacy notice, or terms and conditions under which the party provided their communication preference or opt-in consent. Enables tracking of consent obtained under specific regulatory disclosure versions. Critical for demonstrating TCPA prior express written consent and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation; E-SIGN Act

attributes.name: contact_purpose
attributes.description: The business purpose category for which this preference or restriction applies. marketing = promotional and cross-sell outreach; billing = premium notices and payment reminders; policy_service = policy change confirmations and servicing notices; claims = claim status and settlement communications; legal = regulatory and legal notices; all = applies across all contact purposes. Enables granular suppression by purpose.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this communication preference record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail start point for regulatory compliance reviews and market conduct examinations. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dnc_scrub_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the party's contact information was scrubbed against national and state Do-Not-Call registries. Required for demonstrating compliance with FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule requirement to scrub calling lists against DNC registries at least every 31 days.
attributes.references: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule 16 CFR § 310.4(b)(3); TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by telephone for any purpose (marketing or service). True = all outbound voice calls suppressed. Aggregates consumer requests, TCPA restrictions, and state DNC registry matches. Consumed by CRM and dialer systems as the authoritative call suppression signal.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule; National DNC Registry; State DNC Registry Laws

attributes.name: do_not_email
attributes.description: Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by email for any purpose. True = all outbound email suppressed. Consumed by CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems as the authoritative email suppression signal.

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by physical postal mail for any purpose. True = all outbound postal mail suppressed. Consumed by billing and policy servicing systems as the authoritative mail suppression signal.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: do_not_sms
attributes.description: Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by SMS/text message for any purpose. True = all outbound SMS suppressed. Consumed by CRM and notification systems as the authoritative SMS suppression signal.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC TCPA Regulations 47 CFR § 64.1200

attributes.name: document_delivery_method
attributes.description: The party's preferred method for receiving policy documents, statements, and notices: paper = physical mail delivery; email = documents delivered as email attachments or links; e_delivery_portal = secure online portal access; fax = facsimile delivery. Governs delivery of policy contracts, annual statements, premium notices, and regulatory disclosures.
attributes.references: State DOI E-Delivery Statutes; NAIC Electronic Delivery Model Act; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: e_delivery_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the party provided affirmative consent to electronic document delivery. Required for regulatory audit trail demonstrating compliance with state e-delivery consent requirements. Null if e_delivery_enrolled is False.
attributes.references: State DOI E-Delivery Statutes; NAIC Electronic Delivery Model Act; E-SIGN Act 15 U.S.C. § 7001

attributes.name: e_delivery_consent_method
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism through which the party provided e-delivery consent: online_portal = self-service web portal; mobile_app = mobile application; agent_assisted = captured by agent during policy application or servicing; written_form = paper consent form; ivr = interactive voice response system. Supports regulatory audit of consent capture method.
attributes.references: State DOI E-Delivery Statutes; E-SIGN Act 15 U.S.C. § 7001; NAIC Electronic Delivery Model Act

attributes.name: e_delivery_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has affirmatively enrolled in electronic document delivery (e-delivery) for policy documents and notices. True = enrolled and consented to e-delivery; False = not enrolled, paper delivery applies. Required for compliance with state e-delivery consent statutes which mandate affirmative opt-in before electronic delivery of insurance documents.
attributes.references: State DOI E-Delivery Statutes; NAIC Electronic Delivery Model Act; UETA; E-SIGN Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this communication preference or restriction becomes effective and must be honored by all outbound contact systems. For do-not-contact restrictions, this is the date from which suppression is required. For positive preferences, this is the date the preference takes effect.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this communication preference or restriction expires and is no longer binding. Null indicates the preference is open-ended with no expiration. Applicable to time-limited restrictions (e.g., temporary litigation holds, state DNC registry registrations with renewal requirements).
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; State DNC Registry Laws; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: hipaa_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates the party has invoked their HIPAA right to restrict communications related to health information to specific channels or purposes. True = HIPAA-directed communication restriction is in effect; specific restrictions are detailed in the restriction_type and channel fields. Governs HIPAA-compliant communication management for health-related insurance products.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR § 164.522; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: hipaa_restriction_detail
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific HIPAA-directed communication restriction invoked by the party, including restricted channels, restricted purposes, and any alternative contact instructions provided. Null if hipaa_restriction is False. Treated as confidential due to potential health information context.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR § 164.522; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: litigation_hold
attributes.description: Indicates that legal counsel has placed a litigation hold on outbound contact with this party, typically due to pending or anticipated litigation. True = all non-legally-required communications suppressed pending legal clearance. Overrides all positive preferences and marketing opt-ins.
attributes.references: FRCP Rule 37(e); State Insurance Code; Internal Legal Hold Policy

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via email. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs CAN-SPAM and state law compliant outbound marketing email campaigns. Distinct from transactional/service email which may not require opt-in.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act 15 U.S.C. § 7701; NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via physical postal mail. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs outbound direct mail marketing campaigns and suppression list management.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; DMA Guidelines

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_phone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via telephone (voice calls). True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs TCPA-compliant outbound marketing call campaigns. Must be False by default; requires affirmative opt-in.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule; NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via SMS/text message. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs TCPA-compliant outbound marketing text message campaigns. Requires prior express written consent under TCPA for autodialed or prerecorded messages.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC TCPA Regulations 47 CFR § 64.1200

attributes.name: national_dnc_registered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party's phone number is registered on the FTC National Do-Not-Call Registry. True = registered; outbound telemarketing calls are prohibited under FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule. Populated via mandatory periodic scrubbing of the national DNC registry.
attributes.references: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule 16 CFR § 310; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FTC National DNC Registry

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or documentation related to this communication preference record. Examples include specific instructions from legal counsel regarding a litigation hold, details of a consumer complaint that triggered a restriction, or special accommodation notes. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; Internal Legal Hold Policy

attributes.name: opt_out_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the party submitted their opt-out or do-not-contact request: phone = verbal request via inbound call; email = email opt-out request; mail = written postal request; online_portal = self-service web portal; mobile_app = mobile application; agent = captured by agent; written_request = formal written letter. Required for regulatory audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phone|email|mail|online_portal|mobile_app|agent|written_request — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act 15 U.S.C. § 7701; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: The date on which the party submitted an opt-out or do-not-contact request. Distinct from effective_date (when the restriction takes effect) and from the record creation timestamp. Required for regulatory audit trail and for measuring compliance with legally mandated opt-out processing timeframes (e.g., CAN-SPAM 10-business-day requirement).
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act 15 U.S.C. § 7701; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this preference record. Active = currently governing outbound contact decisions. Inactive = deactivated by party or system. Pending = awaiting confirmation or effective date. Expired = past expiration date. Superseded = replaced by a newer preference record.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; State DOI E-Delivery Statutes

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of this preference record: positive_preference (party-directed opt-in or channel/format choice), do_not_contact (regulatory or consumer-directed restriction), cease_and_desist (formal written demand to stop all contact), litigation_hold (legal counsel-directed contact freeze pending litigation).
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_end
attributes.description: The latest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour local time) at which the party prefers to be contacted. Used in conjunction with preferred_contact_time_start to define the party's preferred contact window. Supports TCPA compliance scheduling.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC TCPA Regulations 47 CFR § 64.1200

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_start
attributes.description: The earliest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour local time) at which the party prefers to be contacted. Used by CRM and dialer systems to schedule outbound calls and notifications within the party's preferred window. Supports TCPA compliance by avoiding calls outside permissible hours.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FCC TCPA Regulations 47 CFR § 64.1200

attributes.name: preferred_contact_timezone
attributes.description: The IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago) representing the party's local timezone for scheduling outbound contact. Required to correctly apply TCPA calling hour restrictions (8am–9pm local time) and the party's preferred contact window.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; IANA Time Zone Database

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The party's preferred language for all communications, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN, fr-CA). Governs language selection for policy documents, billing notices, and marketing materials. Required for compliance with state insurance department language access requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Privacy Regulation; State DOI Language Access Requirements; IETF BCP 47

attributes.name: restriction_source
attributes.description: The originating authority or mechanism that established a do-not-contact restriction. consumer_request = party-initiated opt-out; tcpa = Telephone Consumer Protection Act compliance trigger; state_dnc_registry = state Do-Not-Call registry match; legal_counsel = internal or external legal counsel directive; court_order = court-issued injunction; regulatory_order = state DOI or federal regulatory directive. Null for positive preference records.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule; State DNC Registry Laws; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Specific type of do-not-contact restriction when preference_type is do_not_contact, cease_and_desist, or litigation_hold. Null for positive preference records. do_not_call = voice call suppression; do_not_mail = postal mail suppression; do_not_email = email suppression; do_not_sms = text message suppression; cease_and_desist = all-channel formal restriction; litigation_hold = legal hold on all contact. Drives suppression logic in all outbound systems.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule; State DNC Registry Laws

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this communication preference was captured or last updated: crm = CRM/Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce FSC, MS Dynamics); policy_admin = Policy Administration System; billing = Billing and Premium Collection System; annuity_admin = Annuity Administration Platform; agent_portal = agent-facing portal; online_portal = policyholder self-service portal; mobile_app = mobile application; ivr = interactive voice response; manual = manual data entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|policy_admin|billing|annuity_admin|agent_portal|online_portal|mobile_app|ivr|manual — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards

attributes.name: state_dnc_registered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party's phone number has been identified as registered on a state Do-Not-Call registry. True = registered on one or more state DNC registries; outbound marketing calls are prohibited. Populated via periodic DNC registry scrubbing processes. Distinct from consumer-requested do_not_call flag.
attributes.references: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule 16 CFR § 310; State DNC Registry Laws; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227

attributes.name: state_dnc_registry_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code of the state DNC registry on which the party's number is registered. Applicable when state_dnc_registered is True. Used to apply state-specific telemarketing restrictions which may be more restrictive than federal TCPA requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule 16 CFR § 310; State DNC Registry Laws

attributes.name: updated_by_party_type
attributes.description: The type of party who last updated this communication preference record: policyholder = self-service update by the insured or contract owner; agent = licensed agent; broker = independent broker; tpa = Third Party Administrator; legal_counsel = internal or external legal counsel (for litigation holds and cease-and-desist); system = automated system update (e.g., DNC scrub); customer_service = customer service representative. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: policyholder|agent|broker|tpa|legal_counsel|system|customer_service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this communication preference record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail maintenance, and downstream system synchronization. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Exam Standards; SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: group_sponsor
products.description: Master record for employer groups, associations, or plan sponsors that hold group life insurance or group annuity contracts on behalf of their members or employees. Stores sponsor legal name, FEIN/TIN, SIC/NAICS industry code, group size, plan type (employer-sponsored, association, ERISA-qualified), DOL/ERISA plan number, state of domicile, and contract effective date. SSOT for the B2B group relationship that links individual certificate holders to their sponsoring organization. Supports group billing and ERISA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: group_sponsor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the group sponsor (employer, association, or plan sponsor) record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the master party record representing the B2B group relationship owner.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Group Data Model

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.party. Business justification: Group sponsors are legal entities (employers, associations) that should be represented in the party supertype. Currently group_sponsor stores legal_name and fein directly, but these are party-level at

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk rating assigned to the group sponsor based on entity due diligence, industry type, geographic risk, and transaction patterns. Determines enhanced due diligence requirements and monitoring frequency per FinCEN BSA/AML program.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR Part 1010); NAIC AML Model Regulation; BSA/AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: Frequency at which the group sponsor is billed for group premiums. List bill mode indicates individual certificate-level billing consolidated to the sponsor. Drives premium schedule generation and grace period calculations in the Billing and Premium Collection System.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro/Majesco Billing)

attributes.name: contract_anniversary_date
attributes.description: Annual anniversary date of the group contract, used to trigger renewal underwriting reviews, experience rating adjustments, rate changes, and annual compliance certifications. Typically one year after the contract effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the group insurance or annuity contract between the insurer and the group sponsor became effective. Marks the start of coverage for eligible certificate holders and the beginning of the billing cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the group contract was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for active contracts. Triggers cessation of coverage for all certificate holders and final billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro); ERISA Section 204

attributes.name: contributory_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group plan is employer-paid (non-contributory), employee-paid (voluntary), or cost-shared (contributory). Determines minimum participation requirements, underwriting rules, and premium billing allocation between employer and employee.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA); ERISA Section 3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the group sponsor record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or 'doing business as' name used by the group sponsor if different from the legal name. Supports customer-facing communications and billing statements where the sponsor operates under a trade name.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; State Business Registration

attributes.name: dol_plan_year_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Labor (DOL) Plan Year End Date (MM-DD)
attributes.description: Month and day (MM-DD) representing the end of the ERISA plan year for DOL Form 5500 filing purposes. Determines the annual reporting deadline (7 months after plan year end). Null for non-ERISA plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104; DOL Form 5500 Instructions; 29 CFR Part 2520.104a-5

attributes.name: enrolled_count
attributes.description: Current number of active certificate holders (employees or members) enrolled under the group contract. Used for participation rate monitoring, billing reconciliation, and minimum participation compliance checks.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro); Policy Administration System

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned by the plan sponsor for ERISA-qualified group benefit plans, as reported on DOL Form 5500. Required for ERISA compliance reporting and DOL audit trail. Null for non-ERISA plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104; DOL Form 5500 Instructions; 29 CFR Part 2520

attributes.name: group_size
attributes.description: Total number of eligible employees or members in the group sponsor's organization at the time of contract inception or most recent renewal. Used for underwriting risk assessment, experience rating, and determining minimum participation requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status for the group sponsor entity. Required under FinCEN AML/BSA regulations for business entity due diligence. 'Exempt' applies to governmental entities. Drives AML case creation and onboarding workflow.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR Part 1010); BSA/AML Program Requirements; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the group sponsor's mailing address used for premium billing statements, contract documents, and regulatory correspondence. Typically the street address or P.O. Box.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; USPS Addressing Standards; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the group sponsor's mailing address (suite, floor, department, or attention line). Optional supplemental address information.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City of the group sponsor's mailing address. Used for billing correspondence, regulatory filings, and geographic segmentation of group business.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code of the group sponsor's mailing address. Used for premium tax situs determination and state regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; USPS Addressing Standards; NAIC State Reporting

attributes.name: mailing_zip
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the group sponsor's mailing address. Used for billing correspondence, geographic risk segmentation, and premium tax reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code identifying the primary industry sector of the group sponsor. Preferred over SIC for modern underwriting risk segmentation and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS Manual; NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: ofac_screen_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screen Date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the group sponsor was screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Used to track screening currency and trigger re-screening at required intervals.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 CFR Part 500; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: ofac_screened
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screened Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group sponsor has been screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Required for AML compliance prior to contract issuance and at periodic review intervals.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 CFR Part 500; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: open_enrollment_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) during which the group sponsor conducts its annual open enrollment period, allowing eligible employees to enroll or change coverage elections without evidence of insurability. Drives enrollment processing workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro); ACA Regulations

attributes.name: participation_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of eligible employees or members currently enrolled in the group plan, calculated as enrolled_count divided by group_size. Used to assess compliance with minimum participation requirements (typically 75% for contributory plans) and underwriting eligibility.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group benefit plan type indicating the governing regulatory framework. ERISA-qualified plans are subject to DOL oversight and Form 5500 filing requirements. Governmental and church plans have specific exemptions under ERISA.
attributes.references: ERISA Sections 3 and 4; IRC Section 414; DOL Regulations 29 CFR Part 2510

attributes.name: premium_payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the group sponsor remits premium payments to the insurer. Determines EFT authorization requirements and payment processing workflows in the Billing and Premium Collection System.
attributes.references: Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro/Majesco Billing); NACHA Operating Rules (for ACH/EFT)

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.business_glossary_term: Group Sponsor Primary Contact Email Address
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary HR or benefits administrator contact at the group sponsor. Used for billing notices, enrollment communications, and contract servicing correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; GDPR Article 4 (if applicable); CRM Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary HR or benefits administrator contact at the group sponsor organization. Used for billing inquiries, enrollment communications, and contract servicing. This is an organizational contact, not a policyholder.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Group Sponsor Primary Contact Phone Number
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary HR or benefits administrator contact at the group sponsor. Used for billing inquiries, enrollment support, and contract servicing.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; CRM Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title of the primary contact at the group sponsor (e.g., HR Director, Benefits Manager, CFO). Used for professional correspondence and to assess authorization level for plan changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code identifying the primary industry of the group sponsor. Used for underwriting risk assessment, experience rating, and actuarial grouping. Maintained by the U.S. Department of Labor.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor SIC Manual; NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: situs_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code representing the state where the group insurance contract is delivered and governed. May differ from state of domicile. Determines which state's insurance laws and mandated benefits apply to the group contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational Policy Administration System from which this group sponsor record was sourced (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; ETL Data Lineage Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: source_system_sponsor_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for the group sponsor record in the originating Policy Administration System (e.g., group number in Sapiens LifePro or FAST). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; ETL Data Lineage Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: sponsor_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to the group sponsor by the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST). Used on group contracts, billing invoices, and ERISA filings to uniquely reference the sponsoring organization.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: sponsor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the group sponsor record. Drives eligibility for new certificate issuance, billing processing, and ERISA compliance reporting. 'Pending' indicates the group application is under review; 'Suspended' indicates a temporary hold due to non-payment or compliance issues.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: sponsor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group sponsor entity type. Determines applicable regulatory framework, billing structure, and ERISA qualification rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employer|association|trust|government|taft_hartley|church_plan|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(5); NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; DOL Advisory Opinions

attributes.name: state_of_domicile
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code representing the state where the group sponsor is legally domiciled or incorporated. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, premium tax situs, and state Department of Insurance jurisdiction for group contract compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: tpa_administered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group plan is administered by a Third Party Administrator (TPA) rather than directly by the insurer. When true, TPA contact and agreement details are required for claims adjudication and billing coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC TPA Model Act; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: tpa_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Third Party Administrator (TPA) responsible for administering the group plan on behalf of the sponsor. Populated only when tpa_administered is true. Used for claims routing, billing coordination, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC TPA Model Act; Claims Management System (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Majesco Claims)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the group sponsor record was most recently updated in the Silver layer data product. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days a new employee must be employed before becoming eligible for group coverage. Commonly 0, 30, 60, or 90 days. Used by the Policy Administration System to determine certificate effective dates for new enrollees.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro); ACA Section 2708

products.name: group_member
products.description: Master record for individual members enrolled under a group life insurance or group annuity contract sponsored by a group_sponsor. Stores member certificate number, enrollment date, termination date, eligibility class, coverage tier, employee ID, and member status (active, terminated, COBRA, retired). Links the individual insured to their group sponsor and group contract. Supports group certificate administration, evidence of insurability (EOI) tracking, and ERISA plan participant reporting.

attributes.name: group_member_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the group member record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the group_member data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: group_sponsor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group sponsor (employer, association, or plan sponsor) that administers the group contract under which this member is enrolled. Supports ERISA plan participant reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA; DOL Reporting Requirements; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group insurance or group annuity contract under which this member is enrolled. Links the member to the master group policy agreement.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (insured individual) record in the policyholder domain. Links the group member to their master party record for KYC/AML, demographics, and identity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Group members enroll via applications (certificate applications). Linking member to application tracks enrollment underwriting, supports EOI (evidence of insurability) review, and enables audit of cov

attributes.name: ad_d_coverage_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D) Coverage Amount
attributes.description: The Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D) benefit amount in force for this group member, expressed in USD. Pays in addition to the base life benefit in the event of accidental death or qualifying dismemberment.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: aml_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group member record has been flagged for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review based on FinCEN BSA/AML screening rules. Triggers compliance workflow in the AML case management system.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Regulations; NAIC Model AML Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member has a valid beneficiary designation on file for their group life certificate. If false, death benefits may default to the estate per plan rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: beneficiary_last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member's beneficiary designation was most recently updated. Used to prompt members to review designations following qualifying life events.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The externally-known certificate number issued to the individual member under the group contract. Serves as the member-facing identifier on their certificate of coverage. Sourced from the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST).
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member elected COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event that caused loss of group coverage. Null if the member has not elected COBRA.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); DOL COBRA Regulations; ERISA

attributes.name: cobra_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member's COBRA continuation coverage period expires. Typically 18 or 36 months from the qualifying event date depending on the qualifying event type.

attributes.name: conversion_elected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member has exercised their right to convert group life coverage to an individual permanent life insurance policy without evidence of insurability upon termination of group coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: conversion_election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member elected to convert their group life coverage to an individual policy. Must occur within the conversion period specified in the group contract (typically 31 days from termination).
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of life insurance coverage in force for this group member under the group certificate, expressed in USD. May be a flat amount, a multiple of salary, or determined by the eligibility class schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 79

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier selected by the group member, indicating which dependents are included under the group certificate. Drives premium contribution calculations and dependent eligibility.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the group member record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: eligibility_class
attributes.description: The eligibility classification assigned to the group member by the group sponsor, typically based on employment category, job grade, or union status (e.g., Class 1 - Full-Time Employees, Class 2 - Part-Time Employees). Determines benefit schedule and coverage amounts per the group contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member was enrolled under the group contract and coverage became effective. Represents the start of the member's coverage period. Sourced from the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: The type of enrollment event that resulted in the group member's coverage election. Determines eligibility rules, EOI requirements, and effective date logic per the group contract.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; HIPAA Special Enrollment Rules

attributes.name: eoi_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the underwriting decision was rendered on the group member's Evidence of Insurability (EOI) application.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: eoi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member is required to submit Evidence of Insurability (EOI) for their elected coverage amount. True when the elected coverage exceeds the guaranteed issue limit or when the member is a late enrollee.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: eoi_status
attributes.description: The current status of the Evidence of Insurability (EOI) underwriting review for this group member. Drives whether supplemental or excess coverage is in force or pending approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: eoi_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member submitted their Evidence of Insurability (EOI) application to the insurer for underwriting review.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.description: The three-digit ERISA plan number assigned by the plan sponsor for DOL Form 5500 annual reporting. Identifies the specific welfare benefit plan under which the group member is enrolled.

attributes.name: guaranteed_issue_amount
attributes.description: The maximum coverage amount available to the group member without Evidence of Insurability (EOI) as defined in the group contract. Coverage elections above this threshold require EOI underwriting review.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member's identity has been verified through the Know Your Customer (KYC) process as required by AML/BSA regulations. Must be true before coverage can be placed in force for applicable products.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Regulations; NAIC Model AML Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: member_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the group member's enrollment. Drives eligibility, premium billing, and certificate administration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|terminated|cobra|retired|leave_of_absence|pending|suspended — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161)

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member's enrollment application or supporting documentation was flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO), requiring follow-up from the group sponsor or member before enrollment can be completed.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Internal New Business Processing Standards

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason(s) the group member's enrollment was flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO). Populated only when nigo_flag is true. Used by new business processing teams to track and resolve enrollment deficiencies.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: plan_participant_number
attributes.description: The unique plan participant identifier assigned by the ERISA plan administrator for DOL Form 5500 reporting and ERISA plan participant disclosure purposes. May differ from the certificate number.
attributes.references: ERISA; DOL Form 5500; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: portability_elected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member has elected to port their group life coverage to an individual policy upon termination of employment, as permitted under the group contract portability provision.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualifying life event occurred that triggered the enrollment or coverage change. Used to validate the timeliness of the enrollment election per ERISA and plan rules.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA Special Enrollment Rules (29 CFR 2590.701-6)

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: The type of qualifying life event that triggered a mid-year enrollment or coverage change outside of open enrollment. Required for ERISA compliance and special enrollment period validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|loss_of_other_coverage|death_of_dependent|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA Special Enrollment Rules (29 CFR 2590.701-6); NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: salary_amount
attributes.description: The group member's annual base salary as reported by the group sponsor, expressed in USD. Used to calculate salary-multiple coverage amounts and validate benefit elections against plan maximums.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; IRC Section 79

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Policy Administration System from which this group member record was sourced (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_member_code
attributes.description: The native member or participant identifier as assigned in the originating Policy Administration System. Used for ETL reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and cross-system matching.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: supplemental_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The additional voluntary or supplemental life insurance coverage amount elected by the group member above the basic employer-provided coverage, expressed in USD. Subject to Evidence of Insurability (EOI) requirements above guaranteed issue limits.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group member's enrollment and coverage under the group contract was terminated. Null if the member is currently active. Used for COBRA eligibility determination and ERISA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ERISA; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161)

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the group member's enrollment was terminated. Used for ERISA plan participant reporting, COBRA administration, and actuarial experience studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_termination|involuntary_termination|retirement|death|disability|cobra_exhausted|non_payment|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the group member record was most recently updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports incremental ETL processing, audit trail, and change data capture.
attributes.references: SOX; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group member is eligible for a waiver of premium benefit due to total disability, as defined in the group contract. When true, premiums are waived while the member remains totally disabled.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_status
attributes.description: The current status of the group member's waiver of premium claim. Tracks whether the premium waiver has been approved, is pending review, or has been terminated.
attributes.references: NAIC Group Life Model Regulation; Claims Management System (Guidewire ClaimCenter; Majesco Claims)

products.name: ownership_transfer
products.description: Transactional record capturing each policy or annuity ownership transfer event — absolute assignment, collateral assignment, trust transfer, or corporate ownership change. Stores transfer type, prior owner reference, new owner reference, transfer effective date, transfer reason, legal documentation type (absolute assignment form, court order, divorce decree), NIGO flag, and processing status. Supports policy administration system (FAST, Sapiens LifePro) ownership change workflows and IRC Section 7702 transfer-for-value rule compliance.

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each policy or annuity ownership transfer event record in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_case. Business justification: Ownership transfers for value are AML red flags (life settlements, STOLI). AML teams investigate suspicious transfers requiring case linkage for transaction monitoring alerts, SAR filings, and regulat

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Annuity ownership transfers (absolute assignments, collateral assignments, 1035 exchanges, gifts, sales for value) must be tracked per contract for tax reporting, STOLI review, and insurable interest

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal service representative or automated workflow agent who processed and approved the ownership transfer request within the policy administration system.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); SOX Compliance

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract on which the ownership transfer is being executed.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: primary_ownership_prior_owner_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder party record representing the outgoing owner before the transfer event.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; IRC Section 7702 Transfer-for-Value Rule

attributes.name: trust_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.trust. Business justification: Ownership transfers can transfer policy ownership to a trust (e.g., ILIT). Currently trust_name and trust_tax_id are stored as strings in ownership_transfer. Normalizing to trust.trust_id FK allows jo

attributes.name: aml_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership transfer requires Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review due to risk indicators such as high consideration amounts, unusual transfer patterns, or new owner risk profile.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulations; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: aml_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the AML review for this ownership transfer. A SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) filed status indicates the transfer was reported to FinCEN.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurer formally approved the ownership transfer request after completing all required reviews and documentation verification.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: collateral_assignee_name
attributes.description: Name of the lending institution or creditor to whom the policy is collaterally assigned as loan security. Applicable only when transfer_type is collateral_assignment.

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the policy death benefit or cash value pledged as collateral under a collateral assignment transfer type. Applicable only when transfer_type is collateral_assignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral assignment was released by the assignee upon satisfaction of the underlying debt obligation, restoring full ownership rights to the policy owner.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all administrative processing was finalized, policy records were updated, and confirmation was issued to all parties.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: The monetary consideration (purchase price or value exchanged) paid by the new owner in connection with the ownership transfer. A non-zero value triggers transfer-for-value analysis under IRC Section 7702.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; IRS Publication 525; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: consideration_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the consideration amount paid in connection with the ownership transfer (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership transfer record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the ownership transfer becomes legally effective and the new owner assumes all policy rights and obligations. This is the principal business event date for IRC Section 7702 transfer-for-value compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulations; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: ilit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trust receiving ownership is an Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust (ILIT), which has specific estate planning and tax implications under IRC Section 2042.
attributes.references: IRC Section 2042; IRS Estate Tax Regulations; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: insurable_interest_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new owner's insurable interest in the insured life has been verified as required by state insurance law prior to completing the ownership transfer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; State Departments of Insurance; Insurable Interest Doctrine

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code representing the governing jurisdiction for this ownership transfer, which determines applicable state insurance law requirements for assignment and transfer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; State Departments of Insurance; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: legal_doc_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference number or identifier for the legal instrument (e.g., assignment form, court order, divorce decree) submitted to authorize the ownership transfer.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: legal_doc_type
attributes.description: Type of legal documentation submitted to support and authorize the ownership transfer. Required for compliance validation and NIGO determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: absolute_assignment_form|collateral_assignment_form|court_order|divorce_decree|trust_agreement|power_of_attorney|corporate_resolution — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; ACORD Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: legal_doc_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal documentation was verified as authentic and complete by the authorized reviewer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: legal_doc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitted legal documentation has been reviewed and verified as authentic and complete by the policy servicing team prior to processing the transfer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: new_owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the new owner entity type, distinguishing between individual persons, trusts, corporations, partnerships, estates, and charitable organizations. Drives tax reporting and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Requirements; NAIC Model Regulations; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ownership transfer request was flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO) due to missing, incomplete, or incorrect documentation. A NIGO flag suspends processing until deficiencies are resolved.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Model Regulations; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the specific deficiency that caused the ownership transfer request to be flagged as NIGO, such as missing signature, incomplete assignment form, or unverified notarization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or additional context recorded by the processing team regarding this ownership transfer event.

attributes.name: policy_csv_at_transfer
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the policy or annuity contract at the time of the ownership transfer. Used for IRC Section 7702 transfer-for-value basis calculations and actuarial reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; FASB ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric policy or annuity contract number as assigned by the policy administration system. Provides a human-readable business identifier for the contract subject to the ownership transfer.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership transfer request was formally submitted to the insurer by the policy owner or authorized representative.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the policy administration system of record from which this ownership transfer record was sourced (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS).
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS, EXL); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: source_system_transfer_code
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier assigned by the originating policy administration system for this ownership transfer event. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: stoli_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership transfer has been flagged for Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) review due to patterns suggesting the policy was originated with the intent to transfer to a non-insurable-interest party.
attributes.references: NAIC STOLI Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: transfer_for_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ownership transfer constitutes a transfer-for-value under IRC Section 7702, which may affect the income tax treatment of death benefit proceeds. Critical for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; IRS Publication 525; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or motivation for the ownership transfer event. Used for actuarial analysis, compliance reporting, and customer segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: estate_planning|divorce_settlement|business_succession|loan_collateral|gift|court_order|ilit_funding|corporate_restructuring — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; IRC Section 7702; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: transfer_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the policy administration system (FAST, Sapiens LifePro) to uniquely identify this ownership change transaction for correspondence, audit, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the ownership transfer request within the policy administration system. Drives processing queues and compliance holds.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST, Sapiens LifePro); NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership transfer event indicating the legal mechanism used. Absolute assignment conveys full ownership rights; collateral assignment pledges the policy as loan security; trust transfer moves ownership to a trust entity (e.g., ILIT); corporate ownership change reflects business entity ownership; divorce decree and court order are legally mandated transfers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: absolute_assignment|collateral_assignment|trust_transfer|corporate_ownership_change|divorce_decree|court_order — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership transfer record was most recently modified in the Silver layer lakehouse, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing explicit consumer consent events for data sharing, e-delivery enrollment, marketing communications, and HIPAA authorizations. Stores consent type (HIPAA authorization, e-delivery consent, marketing opt-in, data sharing consent, electronic signature consent), consent date, consent method (wet signature, e-signature, verbal recorded, portal click-through), consent scope, withdrawal date, and regulatory basis. Supports HIPAA Privacy Rule compliance, state e-delivery statutes, and GDPR/CCPA obligations for applicable policyholders.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record in the policyholder domain. Primary key for the consent_record data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Privacy Act

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Annuity contracts require consent tracking (e-delivery enrollment, HIPAA authorizations, marketing opt-ins, suitability acknowledgments). Current model only links consent to life insurance policies. A

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract associated with this consent record, when consent is policy-specific rather than party-wide.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Privacy Act

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the physical or electronic consent document stored in the document management system (e.g., signed HIPAA authorization form, e-delivery enrollment confirmation). Enables retrieval of the original consent artifact for regulatory audits.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.508; NAIC Model Privacy Act; ESIGN Act; SOX

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder, annuitant, beneficiary, or other party who granted or withdrew consent. Links to the master party record in the policyholder domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Privacy Act

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Privacy breach investigations require knowing what consents were in place to assess notification obligations and data exposure scope. Incident response teams link affected consent records to incidents

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or broker who facilitated or witnessed the consent event on behalf of the policyholder. Supports commission and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Privacy Act; State Departments of Insurance agent licensing requirements

attributes.name: superseded_by_consent_record_id
