attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Dividend scales are built from actuarial assumption sets containing mortality, interest, and expense factors. Actuaries use assumption_set to calculate declared_amount and apportionment factors. Real

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the participating whole life policy to which this dividend applies. Links to the policy master record.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Participating whole life dividend calculations are driven by general account portfolio performance (mortality, interest, expense factors). Required for dividend scale setting, apportionment methodolog

attributes.name: processor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Dividend calculation and processing may be outsourced to actuarial vendors or specialized processing services. Tracking the processor vendor supports vendor performance monitoring, audit trails, recon

attributes.name: accumulated_balance
attributes.description: The current balance of dividends left on deposit with the company when the accumulate-at-interest option is elected. Includes principal and accrued interest.

attributes.name: accumulated_interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate credited to accumulated dividends left on deposit. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%). Rate may be guaranteed or declared annually.

attributes.name: accumulated_interest_ytd
attributes.description: The interest credited to accumulated dividends during the current policy year. Used for tax reporting and policy value reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 - Taxable and Nontaxable Income

attributes.name: apportionment_method
attributes.description: The actuarial method used to allocate divisible surplus to this policy. CONTRIBUTION = contribution method; THREE_FACTOR = mortality, interest, expense factors; EXPERIENCE = experience rating; ASSET_SHARE = asset share method.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: cash_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid in cash to the policyholder when the cash dividend option is elected. May differ from declared amount if partial amounts are applied to other options.

attributes.name: cash_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cash dividend payment was issued or electronically transferred to the policyholder. Used for cash flow tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: cash_payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to disburse the cash dividend payment. CHECK = paper check; ACH = automated clearing house; WIRE = wire transfer; EFT = electronic funds transfer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dividend record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the board of directors or authorized committee formally declared the dividend for the policy year. Represents the official authorization date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: declared_amount
attributes.description: The total dividend amount declared for the policy for the dividend year, expressed in the policy currency. Represents the policyholder's share of divisible surplus before any option election.

attributes.name: dividend_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the dividend. DECLARED = authorized but not yet processed; PENDING = awaiting option election; PAID = cash payment issued; APPLIED = applied per elected option; FORFEITED = lost due to lapse; REVERSED = reversed due to policy adjustment.

attributes.name: expense_factor
attributes.description: The expense component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of favorable expense experience relative to pricing assumptions.

attributes.name: illustration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dividend amount was used in a policy illustration. True if included in an illustration provided to the policyholder; false otherwise. Used for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Life Insurance Illustrations

attributes.name: interest_factor
attributes.description: The investment earnings component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of investment income exceeding guaranteed rates.

attributes.name: loan_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dividend applied to reduce the outstanding policy loan balance when the loan reduction option is elected. Reduces principal and/or accrued loan interest.

attributes.name: mortality_factor
attributes.description: The mortality component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of favorable mortality experience for the dividend year.

attributes.name: option_code
attributes.description: The dividend option elected by the policyholder. CASH = cash payment; PREM_RED = premium reduction; PUA = paid-up additions; ACCUM = accumulate at interest; OYT = one-year term insurance; LOAN_RED = loan reduction.

attributes.name: option_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the elected dividend option becomes effective. May differ from declaration date if the policyholder changes their election within the allowed window.

attributes.name: oyt_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of one-year term insurance purchased with the dividend when the OYT option is elected. Provides temporary additional death benefit for one policy year.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Form Standards - One-Year Term Rider

attributes.name: oyt_premium_paid
attributes.description: The portion of the dividend used to purchase the one-year term coverage. Represents the cost of the temporary insurance benefit.

attributes.name: premium_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dividend applied to reduce the next premium due when the premium reduction option is elected. Reduces the net premium payable by the policyholder.

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dividend record was processed by the policy administration system. Represents the system processing event, distinct from business effective dates.

attributes.name: pua_cash_value
attributes.description: The cash surrender value of the paid-up additions purchased with this dividend. Contributes to the total policy cash value and is available for loans or surrender.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Schedule D

attributes.name: pua_face_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of paid-up additional insurance purchased with the dividend when the PUA option is elected. Represents incremental death benefit added to the base policy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Form Standards - Paid-Up Additions Rider

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously declared or paid dividend was reversed. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason for reversing a previously declared or paid dividend. POLICY_LAPSE = policy lapsed before dividend paid; POLICY_RESCISSION = policy rescinded; DATA_CORRECTION = data error correction; CALCULATION_ERROR = actuarial calculation error; OPTION_CHANGE = policyholder changed option election.

attributes.name: scale_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the dividend scale used to calculate this dividend. Links to the actuarial dividend scale table and supports audit trail for rate changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the source policy administration system from which this dividend record originated. Supports multi-system environments and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this dividend record in the source policy administration system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: special_dividend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special or extraordinary dividend declared outside the normal annual dividend cycle. True for special dividends; false for regular annual dividends.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: tax_reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the dividend is reportable for tax purposes. May differ from dividend year due to timing of payment or option application.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 - Taxable and Nontaxable Income

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the dividend that is taxable to the policyholder. Generally zero for participating whole life unless dividends exceed premiums paid, but tracked for IRS reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72 - Annuities; Certain Proceeds of Endowment and Life Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: terminal_dividend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a terminal dividend paid upon policy maturity, death claim, or surrender. True for terminal dividends; false for annual dividends.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dividend record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The policy year or calendar year for which the dividend was declared. Represents the experience period underlying the dividend calculation.

products.name: tax_compliance_test
products.description: Stores the results of IRC Section 7702A Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) testing performed on each policy at issuance and upon material change. Captures test date, test type (7-pay test), 7-pay premium limit, cumulative premiums paid to date, MEC status flag (MEC / non-MEC), material change event type, material change date, corridor test result, GPT/CVAT election, guideline single premium, guideline level premium, and the actuarial system that performed the calculation. Critical for IRS compliance and tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_compliance_test_id
attributes.description: Primary key for tax_compliance_test

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the underwriter or compliance officer who performed the manual override of the MEC test result. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity policy for which this MEC test was performed.

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: MEC and CVAT tests require mortality assumptions to calculate guideline premiums and corridor percentages. IRS compliance testing mandates specific mortality tables. Real regulatory process actuaries

attributes.name: test_run_id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the batch or run in which this MEC test was executed. Used to group tests performed together and trace back to specific actuarial valuation runs.

attributes.name: account_value_at_test
attributes.description: The policy account value (gross cash value before surrender charges) at the time the MEC test was performed. Relevant for universal life and variable universal life products.

attributes.name: actuarial_system_source
attributes.description: The name and version of the actuarial valuation system that performed the MEC test calculation (e.g., MoSes, AXIS, Prophet). Critical for audit trail and calculation reproducibility.

attributes.name: cash_value_accumulation_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cash value the policy can accumulate under the Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if CVAT election was made.

attributes.name: cash_value_at_test
attributes.description: The policy cash surrender value at the time the MEC test was performed. Used in corridor test calculations and CVAT limit assessments.

attributes.name: corridor_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the corridor test which ensures the death benefit maintains a minimum ratio to the cash value. Required for policies to maintain life insurance tax treatment under IRC 7702.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEC test result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_premiums_paid
attributes.description: The total amount of premiums paid into the policy from issuance through the test date. Used to compare against the 7-pay premium limit.

attributes.name: death_benefit_at_test
attributes.description: The policy death benefit amount in effect at the time the MEC test was performed. Death benefit is a key input to the 7-pay premium limit calculation.

attributes.name: definition_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Definition Election (Guideline Premium Test (GPT) or Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT))
attributes.description: The IRC Section 7702 definition of life insurance elected by the policyholder at issuance. GPT uses guideline premiums and cash value corridor; CVAT uses cash value accumulation limits. This election is irrevocable.

attributes.name: exchange_1035_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy was acquired through a Section 1035 tax-free exchange from another life insurance or annuity contract. 1035 exchanges carry forward the MEC status from the original contract.

attributes.name: exchanged_policy_mec_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchanged Policy Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) Status
attributes.description: If this policy was acquired through a 1035 exchange, this field captures the MEC status of the original exchanged policy. MEC status is preserved in 1035 exchanges.

attributes.name: form_1099r_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether distributions from this policy are reportable on IRS Form 1099-R due to MEC status. MEC distributions are subject to income tax and potential early withdrawal penalties.

attributes.name: guideline_level_premium
attributes.description: The maximum level annual premium that can be paid into the policy under the Guideline Premium Test (GPT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if GPT election was made.

attributes.name: guideline_single_premium
attributes.description: The maximum single premium that can be paid into the policy under the Guideline Premium Test (GPT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if GPT election was made.

attributes.name: insured_age_at_test
attributes.description: The age of the insured at the time the MEC test was performed. Age is a key actuarial input to the 7-pay premium limit calculation.

attributes.name: irs_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MEC test result requires reporting to the IRS. True if the policy became a MEC or if a material change occurred that affects tax treatment.

attributes.name: material_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which a material change event occurred, triggering a new 7-pay test period. Null if no material change has occurred.

attributes.name: material_change_event_type
attributes.description: The type of material change event that triggered a new MEC test. Material changes reset the 7-pay test period. If no material change occurred, this field is set to 'none'.
attributes.value_regex: death benefit increase|rider addition|premium increase|policy exchange|none

attributes.name: mec_status
attributes.description: The result of the MEC test indicating whether the policy is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract. MEC status affects the tax treatment of policy distributions and loans.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: If the MEC test result was manually overridden by an underwriter or compliance officer, this field captures the business justification for the override. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the MEC test result was manually overridden. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the policy. Used to determine policy year and the start of the 7-pay test period.

attributes.name: policy_year_at_test
attributes.description: The policy year (anniversary year) in which the MEC test was performed. Relevant for tracking the 7-pay test period which spans the first seven policy years or until a material change.

attributes.name: prior_mec_status
attributes.description: The MEC status of the policy before this test was performed. Used to track status changes and identify when a policy first became a MEC. Set to 'not applicable' for initial issuance tests.

attributes.name: seven_pay_premium_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative premium that can be paid into the policy during the first seven years (or until a material change) without causing the policy to become a MEC. Calculated based on actuarial assumptions and policy death benefit.

attributes.name: test_calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial methodology and assumptions used to calculate the 7-pay premium limit and other test thresholds. May reference specific assumption sets or calculation standards.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the MEC test was performed. This may be at policy issuance or upon a material change event.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments regarding the MEC test, including any special circumstances, assumptions, or actuarial judgments applied during the calculation.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: The processing status of the MEC test. Indicates whether the test calculation has been completed, is pending actuarial review, failed due to data issues, or was manually overridden.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: The type of MEC test performed. The 7-pay test is the primary test under IRC 7702A to determine if cumulative premiums paid exceed the 7-pay premium limit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEC test result record was last modified in the system.

products.name: fund_allocation
products.description: Tracks investment fund allocation instructions and current allocation percentages for universal life (UL, IUL, VUL) and fixed indexed annuity (FIA) policies with investment options. Stores fund code, fund name, allocation percentage, allocation effective date, allocation type (premium allocation, account value rebalance, transfer), rebalancing frequency, dollar cost averaging flag, index strategy code (for IUL/FIA: point-to-point, monthly average, annual reset), cap rate, participation rate, floor rate, spread, and last rebalance date. Sourced from the Policy Administration System investment allocation module.

attributes.name: fund_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each policy fund allocation record. Primary key for the policy fund allocation entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Variable/indexed product fund allocation changes require employee approval for suitability review, especially large reallocations or high-risk fund elections. Regulatory requirement (FINRA, state insu

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent policy contract (UL, IUL, VUL, or FIA) to which this fund allocation applies.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Fixed allocation options in hybrid variable products reference general account portfolios. Required for blended portfolio management, ALM analysis, and unified performance reporting across fixed and v

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.separate_account_fund. Business justification: Variable and indexed product fund allocations must link to the separate account fund master (separate_account_fund) for NAV calculation, performance reporting, prospectus compliance, expense ratio app

attributes.name: allocation_amount
attributes.description: For dollar-based allocations (e.g., DCA programs), the fixed dollar amount allocated to this fund per period. Null for percentage-based allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation instruction was approved and accepted by the policy administration system, completing validation and compliance checks.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this fund allocation instruction became effective and began applying to premium payments or account value rebalancing.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Current percentage of premium or account value allocated to this fund. Must sum to 100% across all allocations for a given policy and allocation type. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.50 for 25.5%).

attributes.name: allocation_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation change was requested by the policyholder or advisor. May differ from effective date due to processing time or future-dated instructions.

attributes.name: allocation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number for multiple fund allocations within the same policy and allocation type. Used for processing priority and display ordering.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: Origin of this allocation instruction: policyholder-elected, system default, advisor-recommended, or automated program-driven.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this fund allocation instruction. Active allocations are applied to transactions; inactive/terminated allocations are historical records.

attributes.name: allocation_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this allocation instruction was terminated or superseded by a new allocation. Null for currently active allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this allocation instruction was terminated. Null for active allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Type of allocation instruction: premium_allocation (applies to new premium payments), account_value_rebalance (periodic rebalancing of existing AV), transfer (one-time fund transfer), systematic_rebalance (automated periodic rebalancing), dollar_cost_averaging (DCA program allocation).
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum interest rate that can be credited to the policy account value for this indexed fund allocation, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.00 for 12%). Applicable to IUL and FIA products with capped index strategies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this allocation record was first created in the policy administration system.

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is part of a dollar cost averaging program where premium is systematically transferred from a fixed account to investment funds over time.

attributes.name: floor_rate
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed interest rate for this fund allocation, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 0.00 for 0% floor). Protects against negative index performance in IUL and FIA products.

attributes.name: fund_category
attributes.description: High-level investment category classification of the fund for reporting and risk management purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equity|fixed_income|balanced|money_market|index|specialty|guaranteed|alternative — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fund_expense_ratio
attributes.description: Annual expense ratio charged by the investment fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0075 for 0.75%). Used for cost disclosure and performance reporting.

attributes.name: fund_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk profile classification of the investment fund used for suitability assessment and portfolio construction.

attributes.name: index_segment_end_date
attributes.description: For IUL and FIA products, the end date of the current index crediting segment or term when index gains/losses are calculated and credited.

attributes.name: index_segment_start_date
attributes.description: For IUL and FIA products, the start date of the current index crediting segment or term. Used to track index performance measurement periods.

attributes.name: index_segment_term_years
attributes.description: Length of the index crediting term in years (e.g., 1, 2, 5, 7) for IUL and FIA products. Determines the measurement period for index performance.

attributes.name: index_strategy_code
attributes.description: For IUL and FIA products, the index crediting strategy method used to calculate interest credits. Not applicable for traditional variable products. Common strategies include point-to-point, monthly average, and annual reset. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: point_to_point|monthly_average|annual_reset|high_water_mark|monthly_cap|annual_cap|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Indexed Universal Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this allocation record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_rebalance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent automatic or manual rebalancing of account value to target allocation percentages was executed.

attributes.name: maximum_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage that can be allocated to this fund per product rules or regulatory requirements. Used for compliance validation during allocation changes.

attributes.name: minimum_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage that must be maintained in this fund per product rules or regulatory requirements. Used for compliance validation during allocation changes.

attributes.name: mortality_and_expense_risk_charge
attributes.description: Annual M&E risk charge assessed against this fund allocation for variable products, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0125 for 1.25%). Covers insurance guarantees and administrative expenses.
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: next_rebalance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next automatic rebalancing transaction based on the rebalancing frequency. Null if no automatic rebalancing is configured.

attributes.name: participation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of index gain that is credited to the policy account value, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 for 85% participation). Applicable to IUL and FIA products.

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the policy account value is automatically rebalanced to match the target allocation percentages. 'none' indicates no automatic rebalancing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the policy administration system or platform that originated this allocation record (e.g., FAST, SAPIENS, ORACLE_IPAS).

attributes.name: spread_rate
attributes.description: Percentage deducted from index gains before crediting to the policy account value, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.50 for 2.5% spread). Alternative to cap rate in some indexed product designs.

products.name: assignment
products.description: Records all absolute and collateral assignments of life insurance policies and annuity contracts. Captures assignment type (absolute, collateral), assignee name, assignee TIN, assignee type (individual, financial institution, employer, trust), assignment effective date, assignment release date, assigned amount (for collateral assignments), assignment status (active, released, foreclosed), lender loan reference number, assignment recording date, and notification sent date. Supports lender notification workflows, collateral release processing, premium financing arrangements, and ownership rights management under UCC Article 9.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy or annuity contract assignment record.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scanned or stored legal assignment document in the document management system.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract being assigned.

attributes.name: processing_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Collateral assignments and absolute assignments require employee processing/approval for compliance verification, especially for executive benefit arrangements (split-dollar, COLI). Audit trail and SO

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Collateral assignments (especially premium financing arrangements) typically involve producer facilitation and documentation. Business tracks producer involvement for compliance verification, commissi

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assignment was approved by the insurer.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval status of the assignment request: approved (accepted by insurer), pending (awaiting review), rejected (denied), or under_review (in evaluation).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the underwriter or operations staff who approved the assignment.

attributes.name: assigned_amount
attributes.description: For collateral assignments, the maximum dollar amount of the loan or debt secured by the policy. Null for absolute assignments.

attributes.name: assigned_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of policy benefits assigned to the assignee. Typically 100% for absolute assignments, may be partial for collateral assignments.

attributes.name: assignee_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the assignee, used for legal notices and correspondence.

attributes.name: assignee_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, apartment, floor) for the assignee.

attributes.name: assignee_city
attributes.description: City of the assignee's address.

attributes.name: assignee_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the assignee's address.

attributes.name: assignee_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for assignee correspondence and notifications.

attributes.name: assignee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual, financial institution, employer, or trust receiving the assignment rights.

attributes.name: assignee_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the assignee.

attributes.name: assignee_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the assignee's address.

attributes.name: assignee_state
attributes.description: State or province code of the assignee's address.

attributes.name: assignee_tin
attributes.description: Tax identification number (SSN or EIN) of the assignee for IRS reporting and identity verification.

attributes.name: assignee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignee entity: individual person, financial institution (bank, lender), employer (for group policy assignments), trust (ILIT or other), or other entity type.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the assignment, often used in correspondence and legal documents.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assignment: active (in force), released (terminated by assignee), foreclosed (lender exercised rights), pending (awaiting approval), or cancelled (voided before activation).

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Type of assignment: absolute (full transfer of ownership rights) or collateral (security interest for a loan).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the assignment, including special instructions, exceptions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assignment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assignment becomes legally effective and the assignee's rights commence.

attributes.name: irrevocable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment is irrevocable (true) or revocable (false). Irrevocable assignments cannot be changed without assignee consent.

attributes.name: lender_loan_reference
attributes.description: External loan or account number from the lending institution, used to correlate the assignment with the underlying debt obligation.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified the assignment record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the assignment record was last modified.

attributes.name: notarization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assignment document was notarized.

attributes.name: notary_public_name
attributes.description: Name of the notary public who notarized the assignment document, if applicable.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurer sent formal notification of the assignment to the policy owner and assignee.

attributes.name: premium_payment_responsibility
attributes.description: Party responsible for paying policy premiums under the assignment: owner (policy owner retains responsibility), assignee (assignee assumes premium payments), or shared (split responsibility).

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business reason or purpose for the assignment, such as premium financing, estate planning, loan collateral, or gift.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assignment was officially recorded in the insurer's policy administration system.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the assignment request was rejected, if applicable.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assignment was released or terminated, returning full rights to the policy owner. Null if assignment is still active.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created the assignment record.

products.name: service_request
products.description: SSOT for all post-issue policy servicing transactions, contractual endorsements, administrative changes, policy conversions, and IRC Section 1035 tax-free exchanges processed through the Policy Administration System. Encompasses administrative service requests, formal contractual amendments (endorsements), term-to-permanent conversions, and 1035 exchange transactions. Captures request/endorsement type (address change, beneficiary change, ownership change, premium mode change, face amount change, dividend option change, name change, duplicate policy contract request, rider addition/removal, collateral assignment, reinstatement, conversion, 1035 exchange), endorsement number (for contractual amendments), amendment effective date, request channel (phone, web portal, agent, mail), request date, effective date, request status (received, in-review, completed, NIGO — Not In Good Order, cancelled), prior value, new value, reason code, NIGO reason code, SLA due date, completion date, processing agent ID, source system transaction ID. For conversions: source policy type (YRT, term), target policy type (WL, UL, IUL), conversion credit amount, conversion privilege expiry date, evidence of insurability waived flag, new policy reference. For 1035 exchanges: exchange type (life-to-life, annuity-to-annuity, life-to-annuity), surrendering carrier name, surrendering policy number, exchange amount transferred, cost basis transferred, gain deferred, IRS Form 1035 attestation flag. Provides full audit trail of all contractual modifications. Supports policy servicing SLA monitoring, NIGO reduction initiatives, and regulatory audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy service request transaction. Primary key for all post-issue policy servicing transactions, contractual endorsements, administrative changes, policy conversions, and IRC Section 1035 tax-free exchanges.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal agent, underwriter, or administrator who processed and completed the service request. Supports workload tracking and quality assurance.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity policy contract being serviced. Links to the master policy record in the Policy Administration System.

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: Service requests may trigger compliance issues (e.g., replacement not properly documented, beneficiary change without insurable interest verification). Linking enables root cause analysis, supports pr

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Service requests (conversions, exchanges, beneficiary changes) are frequently producer-facilitated. Business tracks producer involvement for commission attribution, service quality metrics, compliance

attributes.name: resulting_annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Service requests for 1035 exchanges and policy-to-annuity conversions track the resulting annuity contract for workflow completion verification, customer notifications, and regulatory documentation. E

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_amount
attributes.description: For collateral assignment requests, the maximum amount of the death benefit assigned to the lender as collateral. Limits the lenders claim on policy proceeds.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, UCC Article 9

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_lender_name
attributes.description: For collateral assignment requests, the name of the lending institution or creditor to whom the policy death benefit is assigned as collateral security. Business-confidential financial relationship data.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, UCC Article 9

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the policyholder, agent, or processing administrator regarding the service request. Captures additional context not structured in other fields.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date the service request was fully processed and completed in the Policy Administration System. Used for SLA compliance measurement and audit trail.

attributes.name: conversion_credit_amount
attributes.description: For conversion requests, the monetary credit or value transferred from the original policy to the new converted policy. Represents accumulated value or conversion privilege benefit.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: conversion_privilege_expiry_date
attributes.description: For conversion requests, the last date the policyholder can exercise their contractual conversion privilege without evidence of insurability. Critical for conversion window tracking.

attributes.name: conversion_source_policy_type
attributes.description: For conversion requests, the original policy type being converted from. Typically YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) or term life insurance converting to permanent coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: conversion_target_policy_type
attributes.description: For conversion requests, the new policy type being converted to. Typically permanent life insurance products (WL, UL, IUL, VUL).
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: cost_basis_transferred
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the tax cost basis (investment in the contract) transferred from the surrendering policy. Critical for future tax calculations on distributions and surrenders.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035, IRC Section 72, IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service request record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance, NAIC Record Retention Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the service request change becomes effective on the policy contract. For endorsements, this is the amendment effective date. May differ from request date for future-dated changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, ACORD Standards

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Sequential endorsement identifier for formal contractual amendments to the policy. Null for administrative changes that do not constitute contractual modifications.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_waived_flag
attributes.description: For conversion requests, indicates whether medical underwriting and evidence of insurability requirements were waived under the conversion privilege. True if waived, False if evidence required.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: exchange_1035_type
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the type of tax-free exchange under IRC Section 1035. Determines permissible exchange paths and tax treatment.

attributes.name: exchange_amount_transferred
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the total cash surrender value or account value transferred from the surrendering policy to the new policy. Represents the gross exchange proceeds.

attributes.name: gain_deferred
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the amount of taxable gain deferred through the tax-free exchange. Calculated as exchange_amount_transferred minus cost_basis_transferred. Deferred gain remains taxable upon future surrender or distribution.

attributes.name: irs_form_1035_attestation_flag
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, indicates whether the policyholder has signed and submitted IRS Form 1035 attesting to the tax-free exchange. Required for regulatory compliance and tax reporting.

attributes.name: new_policy_reference
attributes.description: For conversion requests, the policy number or reference of the newly issued converted policy. Links the conversion service request to the resulting new policy contract.

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the policy attribute after the service request change. Combined with prior_value, creates complete before-and-after audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: nigo_reason_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the service request was marked NIGO (Not In Good Order). Identifies missing documents, incomplete information, or deficiencies requiring correction. Critical for NIGO reduction initiatives.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, Internal Quality Standards

attributes.name: prior_value
attributes.description: The value of the policy attribute before the service request change. Provides full audit trail of all contractual and administrative modifications for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason or trigger for the service request. Supports root cause analysis and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: reinstatement_evidence_required_flag
attributes.description: For reinstatement requests, indicates whether evidence of insurability (medical underwriting) is required to reinstate the lapsed policy. Depends on lapse duration and policy provisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_amount
attributes.description: For reinstatement requests, the total premium amount (including back premiums, interest, and fees) required to reinstate a lapsed policy. Must be paid to restore coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the service request was submitted. Supports channel analytics and customer experience optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phone|web_portal|agent|mail|email|fax|in_person — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date the service request was received or initiated by the policyholder, agent, or administrator. Represents the business event timestamp for SLA tracking.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the service request, endorsement, or administrative change. Used for customer and agent communication and tracking.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service request. NIGO (Not In Good Order) indicates incomplete or deficient submission requiring additional information or correction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|in_review|pending_documents|completed|nigo|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the policy service request or endorsement type. Includes administrative changes (address, beneficiary, ownership, premium mode, face amount, dividend option, name, duplicate contract), contractual amendments (rider addition/removal, collateral assignment), policy reinstatements, term-to-permanent conversions, and IRC Section 1035 tax-free exchanges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: address_change|beneficiary_change|ownership_change|premium_mode_change|face_amount_change|dividend_option_change|name_change|duplicate_policy_contract|rider_addition|rider_removal|collateral_assignment|reinstatement|conversion|1035_exchange — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, IRC Section 1035

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: For rider addition or removal requests, the standardized code identifying the specific rider (ADB - Accidental Death Benefit, AWL - Automatic Waiver of Premium, CAR - Company Action Rider, LTC - Long-Term Care, etc.).
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Administration Standards, Internal Product Standards

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date based on service level agreement commitments for the request type. Used for SLA monitoring, NIGO reduction initiatives, and operational performance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Service Standards, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance). Enables traceability back to source system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards, Internal Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: surrendering_carrier_name
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the name of the insurance carrier whose policy is being surrendered and exchanged. Required for IRS Form 1035 reporting.

attributes.name: surrendering_policy_number
attributes.description: For 1035 exchange requests, the policy number of the contract being surrendered at the external carrier. Required for exchange processing and IRS reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service request record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance, NAIC Record Retention Standards

products.name: note
products.description: Captures all free-form and structured annotations, diary entries, and case notes recorded against a policy by servicing representatives, underwriters, agents, and automated systems. Stores note type (servicing note, underwriting note, compliance note, agent note, system-generated), note text, note date, author ID, author role, priority flag, follow-up date, follow-up status (open, closed), related transaction reference, and confidentiality flag. Critical for day-to-day policy servicing, NIGO resolution, complaint tracking, and regulatory examination support. Every PAS operator interacts with policy notes multiple times per day.

attributes.name: note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy note record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user, agent, or system that created the note. May be employee ID, agent code, or system process identifier.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy contract to which this note is attached. Links note to the in-force policy record.

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to an associated document stored in the document management system (e.g., scanned correspondence, email attachment, form).

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: Policy notes may document compliance concerns that later become formal issues (e.g., suitability red flags, AML suspicions). Linking enables audit trail from initial observation to formal issue escala

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Policy notes frequently document producer interactions, field underwriting observations, service requests, or complaints. Business requires producer attribution for service quality tracking, complianc

attributes.name: author_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or system that created the note. Provides human-readable identification for audit and customer service purposes.

attributes.name: author_role
attributes.description: Functional role or job title of the note author at the time of creation (e.g., underwriter, customer service representative, claims adjudicator, agent, system administrator).

attributes.name: complaint_category
attributes.description: Classification of the complaint type for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., claims handling, premium billing, policy servicing, agent conduct).

attributes.name: complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note documents a customer complaint. Triggers regulatory reporting and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note contains confidential or sensitive information with restricted visibility. Controls access permissions and disclosure rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the note record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Target date by which follow-up action on this note should be completed. Used for diary management and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note requires a follow-up action or callback. Used to drive workflow and task management.

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the follow-up action associated with this note. Tracks progress toward resolution.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the note record was last modified in the source system. Tracks the most recent change to the note.

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note is related to a Not In Good Order (NIGO) case, where the policy application or service request is incomplete or requires additional information.

attributes.name: nigo_reason_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific reason the case was marked NIGO (e.g., missing signature, incomplete medical information, payment issue).

attributes.name: note_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification or sub-type of the note for finer-grained categorization (e.g., NIGO resolution, complaint, inquiry, policy change, premium issue).

attributes.name: note_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the note was recorded or the event described in the note occurred. Distinct from system audit timestamps.

attributes.name: note_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or sequence number for the note, used for reference and tracking in Policy Administration System (PAS) and customer service interactions.

attributes.name: note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the note. Indicates whether the note requires follow-up action or has been resolved.

attributes.name: note_text
attributes.description: Free-form text content of the note. Contains the detailed annotation, diary entry, or case narrative recorded by the author. May include sensitive customer information or internal business commentary.

attributes.name: note_type
attributes.description: Classification of the note by functional area or originating process. Determines routing, visibility, and retention rules.

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note is marked as high priority or urgent, requiring expedited attention or escalation.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note content or associated event must be reported to state insurance departments or other regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: related_transaction_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy transaction, service request, claim, or billing event that triggered or is associated with this note.

attributes.name: related_transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction referenced in related_transaction_id (e.g., premium payment, policy change, claim submission, underwriting decision, reinstatement).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or code of the operational system that originated this note (e.g., Policy Administration System, Claims Management System, Customer Relationship Management system).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this note record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: visibility_scope
attributes.description: Defines who is authorized to view this note. Controls whether the note is visible to agents, customers, or restricted to internal staff only.

attributes.name: reply_to_note_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on note (reply_to_note_id)

products.name: nonforfeiture_option
products.description: Tracks nonforfeiture benefit elections and calculations when a permanent life insurance policy lapses — Extended Term Insurance (ETI), Reduced Paid-Up (RPU), and cash surrender. Captures elected option, effective date, and calculated benefit values.

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_option_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the nonforfeiture option election record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the underwriter or manager who approved this nonforfeiture option election, if approval was required.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the permanent life insurance policy for which this nonforfeiture option was elected.

attributes.name: lapse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.lapse_event. Business justification: Nonforfeiture option elections are triggered by lapse events and require lapse_event_id to determine CSV at lapse, outstanding loan balance, lapse date, and option election window for extended term in

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer service representative or agent who processed the nonforfeiture option election.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether underwriting or management approval was required for this nonforfeiture option election (e.g., for large face amounts or special circumstances).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nonforfeiture option election was approved.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Actuarial method or table used to calculate nonforfeiture benefits (e.g., 1980 CSO, 2001 CSO, company-specific tables).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the nonforfeiture option election, processing, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: Total premiums paid into the policy (cost basis) used to calculate taxable gain on surrender.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this nonforfeiture option record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csv_at_election
attributes.description: Cash surrender value of the policy at the time of nonforfeiture option election, used as the basis for calculating ETI or RPU benefits.

attributes.name: default_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this nonforfeiture option was applied as the default option per policy contract terms (typically Extended Term Insurance).

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which surrender proceeds were disbursed to the policyholder.

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which surrender proceeds were disbursed to the policyholder: check, Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT), wire transfer, or Automated Clearing House (ACH).
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules and ACORD Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the nonforfeiture option became effective, typically the lapse date of the original policy.

attributes.name: election_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the nonforfeiture option was elected: agent, customer service, online portal, mail, or automatic (default option).

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policyholder elected this nonforfeiture option.

attributes.name: election_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for nonforfeiture option election (e.g., financial hardship, policy no longer needed, premium affordability).

attributes.name: eti_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Extended Term Insurance coverage expires if no death claim occurs.

attributes.name: eti_face_amount
attributes.description: Death benefit face amount for Extended Term Insurance option, typically equal to the original policy face amount.

attributes.name: eti_term_days
attributes.description: Number of additional days beyond full years for which Extended Term Insurance coverage is provided.

attributes.name: eti_term_years
attributes.description: Number of full years for which Extended Term Insurance coverage is provided based on the net nonforfeiture value.

attributes.name: form_1099r_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1099-R was issued for this surrender transaction.

attributes.name: insured_age_at_election
attributes.description: Attained age of the insured at the time of nonforfeiture option election, used in benefit calculations.

attributes.name: lapse_date
attributes.description: Date on which the original policy lapsed, triggering the nonforfeiture option election.

attributes.name: net_nonforfeiture_value
attributes.description: Net value available for nonforfeiture benefit after deducting outstanding loans and any applicable charges from CSV.

attributes.name: option_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the nonforfeiture option: elected (pending activation), active (in force), expired (ETI term ended), terminated (policy reinstated or surrendered), converted (changed to another option).

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Type of nonforfeiture benefit elected: Extended Term Insurance (ETI), Reduced Paid-Up (RPU), cash surrender, or Automatic Premium Loan (APL).

attributes.name: outstanding_loan_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding policy loan balance at the time of election, deducted from CSV to determine net nonforfeiture value.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Human-readable policy number for business reference and reporting.

attributes.name: policy_year_at_election
attributes.description: Policy year (duration since issue) at the time of nonforfeiture option election.

attributes.name: rpu_cash_value
attributes.description: Cash value of the Reduced Paid-Up policy at the time of conversion, typically equal to the net nonforfeiture value.

attributes.name: rpu_face_amount
attributes.description: Reduced death benefit face amount for Reduced Paid-Up insurance option, calculated based on the net nonforfeiture value and attained age.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source policy administration system from which this nonforfeiture option record originated (e.g., FAST, EXL, Sapiens LifePro).

attributes.name: source_transaction_code
attributes.description: Transaction identifier from the source system that created or modified this nonforfeiture option record.

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: Surrender charge deducted from gross surrender value, if applicable based on policy duration and contract terms.

attributes.name: surrender_gross_amount
attributes.description: Gross cash surrender amount before deductions for loans, surrender charges, or tax withholding.

attributes.name: surrender_net_proceeds
attributes.description: Net cash proceeds paid to the policyholder after all deductions (loans, surrender charges, tax withholding).

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount

products.name: rider
products.description: This association product represents the attachment of a rider definition to an in-force policy contract. It captures the specific terms, coverage amounts, premiums, and status for each rider instance on a policy. Each record links one in_force_policy to one rider_definition with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific rider attachment (effective date, face amount, premium, status, underwriting class, rating).. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, a single policy contract can have multiple riders attached simultaneously (e.g., ADB + waiver of premium + LTC acceleration), and a single rider definition from the product catalog is used across thousands of in-force policies. Each rider attachment has its own coverage terms, premium, effective date, status, and underwriting classification that belong to the specific policy-rider combination, not to the policy alone or the rider definition alone. Policy administration systems actively manage these rider attachments throughout the policy lifecycle.

attributes.name: rider_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rider

products.name: guaranteed_benefit_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between variable annuity/VUL riders with guaranteed benefits (GMWB, GMDB, GMIB, GMAB) and the separate accounts that support those guarantees. It captures how a rider's benefit base is distributed across multiple investment accounts for hedge management and actuarial valuation. Each record links one rider to one separate account with allocation-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, variable annuity and VUL riders with guaranteed benefits (GMWB, GMDB, GMIB, GMAB) require their benefit bases to be allocated across multiple separate accounts for hedge management, risk diversification, and actuarial valuation. A single rider can have its benefit base split across multiple separate accounts (e.g., 40% equity account, 30% bond account, 30% balanced account), and each separate account supports guaranteed benefits from multiple riders across different policies. The business actively manages these allocations through rebalancing, hedge designation, and reserve calculations.

attributes.name: guaranteed_benefit_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this guaranteed benefit allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: policy_rider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the rider with guaranteed benefits (GMWB, GMDB, GMIB, GMAB) that requires allocation tracking

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Benefit Allocation - Separate Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the separate account that supports this portion of the guaranteed benefit

attributes.name: actuarial_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Actuarial reserve held for this specific allocation, calculated based on allocated benefit base and separate account performance. Used for financial statement preparation and statutory reserve requirements.

attributes.name: allocated_benefit_base_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the rider's benefit base allocated to this separate account. Calculated as rider.benefit_base_amount * allocation_percentage. Used for actuarial reserve calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this allocation became effective. Critical for tracking allocation changes over time and aligning with hedge rebalancing events.

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this allocation was terminated or rebalanced. Null for currently active allocations. Used for historical allocation analysis.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the rider's benefit base allocated to this specific separate account. Must sum to 100% across all allocations for a given rider. Used for proportional hedge calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this allocation. Values: Active (allocation is in force), Suspended (temporarily inactive), Terminated (allocation ended), Pending_Rebalance (rebalancing in progress). Used for operational workflow management.

attributes.name: benefit_base_amount
attributes.description: The guaranteed benefit base used to calculate income or withdrawal benefits for living benefit riders (GMIB, GMWB, GMAB). This base may grow over time based on rider terms. Expressed in policy currency. [Moved from rider: While the total benefit_base_amount remains on the rider, the allocated_benefit_base_amount for each separate account belongs to the allocation relationship. The rider attribute represents the total, while the allocation attribute represents the portion allocated to each account.]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: benefit_base_growth_rate
attributes.description: The annual percentage rate at which the benefit base grows for living benefit riders. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 means 5% per year). Null if benefit base does not grow. [Moved from rider: Growth rate may vary by separate account allocation based on account performance and guarantee terms. If different accounts have different growth rates for the same rider, this becomes allocation-specific rather than rider-level.]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this allocation record was created. Used for audit trail and allocation history tracking.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is part of a hedging strategy. Values: Hedged (allocation is hedged with derivatives), Unhedged (allocation carries full market risk), Partially_Hedged (partial hedge coverage). Critical for risk management and GAAP hedge accounting.

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of market risk hedged for this allocation. 100% for fully hedged, 0% for unhedged. Used for risk reporting and hedge effectiveness testing under ASC 815.

attributes.name: last_rebalance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent rebalancing event for this allocation. Used to track rebalancing frequency and compliance with allocation policies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this allocation record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: rebalance_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Percentage deviation threshold that triggers automatic rebalancing of this allocation. Example: 5.00 means rebalance when allocation drifts 5% from target. Used for automated allocation management.

domains.name: underwriting
domains.description: Risk assessment and new business (NB) decisioning for life and annuity applications. Owns medical underwriting (APS, MIB lookups), financial underwriting, automated rules engine outputs, risk classifications, STOLI detection, and facultative/automatic reinsurance placement decisions. products.name: underwriting_risk_assessment
products.description: Comprehensive underwriting risk evaluation master record for a life or annuity application, encompassing medical, financial, and compliance risk dimensions in a single holistic assessment. Medical underwriting: captures mortality and morbidity risk classification outputs, build chart results, aviation/avocation hazard ratings, APS review outcomes, MIB inquiry findings, and overall medical risk score. Financial underwriting: captures insurable interest determination, income replacement multiple analysis, human life value (HLV) calculation, business insurance justification (key person, buy-sell), existing coverage in-force summary, financial statement review notes, and financial underwriting decision outcome — ensures coverage amounts are financially justified and detects potential over-insurance. STOLI/IOLI detection: captures STOLI indicator flags (premium financing with non-recourse loans, investor-owned life insurance indicators, irrevocable trust ownership patterns, life settlement broker involvement, rapid policy transfer intent, unusual beneficiary designations), investigation status, compliance review outcome, state-specific STOLI statute compliance check, SIU referral flag, and STOLI determination (cleared, confirmed, inconclusive). Also captures NAR (Net Amount at Risk) calculations, NAR calculation method, and whether NAR triggers reinsurance cession thresholds. Represents the underwriter's formal holistic risk evaluation tied to a specific application. Sourced from the Underwriting Workbench automated rules engine and manual underwriter review.
products.reference: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; MIB Risk Classification

products.description: Reference table defining all underwriting risk classification categories used in life and annuity mortality and morbidity risk decisioning. Includes standard classifications: Preferred Plus (Super Preferred), Preferred, Standard Plus, Standard, Substandard Table Ratings (Table A through P / Table 1 through 16), Flat Extra per thousand ratings, Decline, and Postpone. products.name: evidence_requirement
products.description: Consolidated master record for all underwriting evidence items ordered, received, and reviewed for a specific application or policy change re-underwriting case. Encompasses all evidence types and their type-specific detail attributes: Attending Physician Statements (APS) with physician name, practice, NPI, request/received dates, medical conditions disclosed, treatment history, medications, lab results, and underwriter review notes; paramedical examinations with exam vendor (ExamOne, APPS), examiner details, exam date/location, height, weight, blood pressure, pulse, specimen collection status, lab results summary, and completion status; MIB inquiries with submission date, MIB member code, applicant consent flag, response codes, condition codes returned, follow-up action required flag, and review status; EKG, blood profiles, urine specimens, treadmill stress tests, financial statements, inspection reports, MVR, prescription drug history (Rx check), cognitive assessments, and functional capacity evaluations. Tracks ordering date, vendor assigned, received date, evidence status (ordered, in-transit, received, under-review, satisfied, waived), evidence type classification, and type-specific extended attributes. Manages the complete evidence workflow within the Underwriting Workbench. Supports both traditional and accelerated underwriting evidence protocols. Subject to HIPAA data handling requirements for medical evidence, FCRA compliance for consumer report evidence, and MIB Group data use agreements.

products.name: rule

For automated rules: stores rule code, rule name, rule category (medical, financial, product eligibility, STOLI detection), rule logic description, effective date, expiration date, product line applicability, face amount threshold, age band applicability, and rule owner. Provides the authoritative catalog of all automated underwriting rules and medical impairment rating guidelines governing NB decisioning and risk classification. Replaces the need for a separate impairment guide entity.

products.name: reinsurance_placement
products.description: Consolidated underwriting reinsurance placement, cession decision, and retention limit record for a specific application. Encompasses the full reinsurance placement workflow: retention limit schedule (product line, plan code, insured age band, gender, risk class, retention limit amount, effective date, reinsurance treaty reference), NAR-based cession threshold evaluation, placement type determination (automatic YRT/coinsurance vs. facultative). For automatic placements: treaty reference, cession amount, and automatic binding confirmation. For facultative placements: submission date, reinsurer(s) submitted to, case summary, medical and financial evidence package transmitted, reinsurer offer details (risk class, table rating, flat extra, exclusions, offer expiration date), accepted offer reference, and facultative placement workflow status from submission through acceptance. Stores reinsurer selected, reinsurer decision, reinsurer risk class assigned, and overall placement status. Bridges the underwriting domain to the reinsurance domain for NAR-based cession decisions made at the time of underwriting.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent underwriting case for which this activity was recorded. Links activity to the application case being underwritten.

attributes.name: uw_decision_id

attributes.name: uw_rules_engine_output_id
