attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Premium bills require producer attribution for commission allocation, servicing responsibility tracking, and producer performance reporting. Essential for commission processing and producer book-of-bu

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Premium bills must reference approved rate filings when implementing DOI-approved rate changes. State insurance departments require traceability between billed premiums and approved filing numbers for

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Premium bills must be associated with reporting periods for revenue recognition, statutory premium income reporting (NAIC Annual Statement), and GAAP/IFRS17 earned premium calculations. Essential temp

attributes.name: ape_amount
attributes.description: The Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) for this billing demand, calculated as the annualized value of the modal premium (e.g., monthly premium × 12). Used for new business production reporting, agent commission calculations, and actuarial valuation inputs.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ACORD Life Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: apl_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) advanced against the policy's cash surrender value (CSV) to cover the unpaid premium for this billing cycle. Null or zero when APL was not triggered.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro APL Module

attributes.name: apl_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was triggered for this billing cycle (True) because the premium was not paid and the policy has sufficient cash surrender value (CSV) to fund the loan. APL prevents lapse by borrowing against the policy's cash value.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro APL Module

attributes.name: base_premium_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the modal premium attributable to the base policy coverage, excluding rider premiums and Cost of Insurance (COI) charges. Supports premium allocation reporting across policy components.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: bill_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing demand was generated and issued by the billing system. Represents the business event timestamp for the billing cycle demand. Used for billing cycle reconciliation and regulatory notice timeline tracking.
attributes.references: ACORD 103 Life Premium Notice; NAIC Model Regulation 615

attributes.name: bill_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable billing demand reference number assigned by the billing system (e.g., BL-2024-00012345). Printed on billing notices and used by policyholders and agents to reference a specific billing cycle demand.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD 103 Life Premium Notice

attributes.name: bill_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing demand. 'issued' = bill generated and sent; 'paid' = full payment received; 'partial' = partial payment received; 'lapsed' = policy lapsed due to non-payment; 'cancelled' = bill voided; 'reinstated' = policy reinstated after lapse.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615 (Grace Period); Sapiens BillingPro Status Codes

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount demanded in this billing notice, which may differ from modal_premium_amount when outstanding balances, NSF fees, reinstatement arrears, or rider adjustments are included. This is the amount printed on the billing notice sent to the policyholder.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD 103 Life Premium Notice; NAIC Model Regulation 615

attributes.name: billing_cycle_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the billing cycle within the policy year (e.g., 1 for the first monthly bill, 12 for the last). Used for billing cycle reconciliation, APE calculations, and identifying the position of this demand within the annual premium schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency elected by the policyholder, determining how often premium demands are generated. Drives Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) calculations (e.g., monthly modal factor = 1/12 of annual premium).
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the coverage period for which this billing demand applies. Defines the end of the modal billing interval and is used for pro-rata premium calculations on mid-term changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the coverage period for which this billing demand applies. Together with billing_period_end_date, defines the modal billing interval (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual).
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: coi_amount
attributes.description: The Cost of Insurance (COI) charge component within the billed amount, applicable to Universal Life (UL), Indexed Universal Life (IUL), and Variable Universal Life (VUL) policies. Represents the mortality charge deducted from the account value for the billing period.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this premium bill record was first created in the billing system or ingested into the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA monitoring for billing cycle processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this billing record (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency policy support and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life Data Standards; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or tracking identifier confirming successful delivery of the billing notice (e.g., USPS tracking number, email message ID, ACH trace number). Serves as the audit trail for regulatory proof-of-notice compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Proof-of-Notice Requirements; ACORD 103

attributes.name: delivery_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether delivery of the billing notice has been confirmed (True) or is unconfirmed/failed (False). For mail, confirmation may be via USPS tracking; for email, via read receipt or delivery receipt; for EFT, via ACH acknowledgment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Proof-of-Notice Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing notice was dispatched to the policyholder via the selected delivery method. Used to establish the regulatory notice timeline (e.g., state DOI mandated days-before-lapse notice requirements).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Notice Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the billing notice was delivered to the policyholder or group administrator (e.g., mail, email, EFT notice, SMS, agent portal). Supports delivery preference management and regulatory proof-of-notice requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Electronic Notice Rules; ACORD 103

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which premium payment must be received to keep the policy in force without entering the grace period. Derived from the policy anniversary date and modal billing frequency.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation 615; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: eft_account_masked
attributes.description: Masked bank account number used for EFT/ACH premium collection, retaining only the last four digits for identification and audit purposes (e.g., XXXX1234). Full account number is stored in the secure payment vault and never persisted in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: grace_period_expiry_date
attributes.description: The last date by which premium payment can be received before the policy lapses. Calculated as the due date plus the state-mandated or contractual grace period (typically 30 or 31 days for life insurance). Drives lapse administration and regulatory notice obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Grace Period Requirements; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: group_bill_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing demand is part of a group billing arrangement (True), where the bill is sent to a group administrator or employer rather than an individual policyholder (False). Drives group vs. individual billing workflow routing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Group Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: modal_premium_amount
attributes.description: The scheduled premium amount due for the current billing mode (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly). Represents the gross base premium before any adjustments, credits, or APL offsets. Core component of Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: notice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing communication type associated with this record. Drives regulatory notice compliance tracking per state DOI mandated timelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_bill|reminder|grace_warning|final_notice|lapse_notice|reinstatement_offer|nsf_notification|apl_notification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Notice Requirements; ACORD 103

attributes.name: nsf_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee assessed on this billing demand as a result of a prior Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) / returned payment event. Included in the billed_amount when applicable. Zero or null when no NSF event has occurred for this billing cycle.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; State DOI Fee Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: nsf_occurrence_count
attributes.description: The number of Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) / returned payment events recorded against this billing demand. Used to determine NSF fee escalation, EFT suspension thresholds, and fraud risk scoring.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The cumulative unpaid premium balance carried forward from prior billing cycles at the time this bill was generated. A non-zero value indicates the policyholder has arrears. Used in lapse determination and reinstatement calculations.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism elected for this billing demand (e.g., EFT/ACH, check, credit card, direct bill, payroll deduction). Drives EFT/ACH processing workflows and NSF risk assessment.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1, 2, 3, ...) in which this billing demand falls, measured from the policy issue date. Used for DAC amortization, persistency analysis, and first-year vs. renewal premium classification in GAAP (ASC 944) and SAP reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; GAAP; SAP; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_ref
attributes.description: Reference code or citation identifying the specific state Department of Insurance (DOI) regulation or NAIC model regulation that mandates the notice type and timeline for this billing communication (e.g., 'CA-INS-10113', 'NAIC-MOD-615'). Supports regulatory audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Notice Requirements; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: reinstatement_arrears_amount
attributes.description: The total past-due premium amount required to reinstate a lapsed policy, representing the sum of all unpaid modal premiums from the lapse date to the reinstatement date. Included in billed_amount when reinstatement_required is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Reinstatement Requirements

attributes.name: reinstatement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing demand is associated with a reinstatement offer following a policy lapse (True). When True, the billed_amount includes arrears premiums and any applicable reinstatement fees required to restore the policy to in-force status.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Reinstatement Requirements; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: rider_premium_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate premium amount attributable to all policy riders (e.g., Accidental Death Benefit (ADB), Waiver of Premium, Long-Term Care (LTC) rider) included in this billing demand. Supports rider-level premium allocation and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: source_system_bill_code
attributes.description: The native bill identifier assigned by the originating billing system (Sapiens BillingPro or Majesco Billing) before lakehouse ingestion. Preserved for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing; ETL Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the state in which the policy was issued. Determines applicable state DOI grace period duration, notice timeline requirements, and lapse/reinstatement regulations governing this billing demand.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 615; State DOI Regulations; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this premium bill record, capturing status changes (e.g., issued → paid, issued → lapsed), payment postings, or notice delivery confirmations. Essential for change data capture (CDC) and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

products.name: billing_premium_payment
products.description: Transactional record of each premium payment received or refund issued against a policy billing obligation. Captures transaction direction (receipt/refund), payment date, amount, payment method (check, EFT/ACH, credit card, wire, payroll deduction, ACH reversal), payment source (policyholder, employer, bank draft), applied billing period, suspense flag, clearance status, bank reference number. For refunds: refund reason (policy cancellation, overpayment, rate correction, death claim premium return, free-look cancellation), refund amount, refund method (check, ACH reversal, credit), pro-rata/short-rate calculation method, refund approval status, and refund issuance date. SSOT for all inbound premium cash receipts and outbound premium refunds within the billing domain. Supports cash application, reconciliation, aging, refund processing, and premium accounting workflows. Source system: Sapiens BillingPro payment processing module.

attributes.name: billing_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium payment or refund transaction record within the billing domain. Primary key for the billing_premium_payment data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account or premium schedule record that owns the billing obligation being satisfied by this payment.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy against which this premium payment or refund is applied. Links the payment transaction to the master policy record.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Premium payments trigger cash receipt journal entries debiting cash and crediting receivables. Fundamental accounting link for cash management, reconciliation, and financial reporting. Required for SO

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (party) who owns the policy associated with this payment. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: NAIC; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Payments apply to policies sold under specific product plans. Essential for product-level revenue recognition, persistency analysis by product, commission calculations tied to product type, and produc

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_bill. Business justification: Payments are applied against specific bills. This FK links each payment transaction to the bill it satisfies. Nullable because advance payments may be received before a bill is generated (is_suspense

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Payments require manual review, exception handling, and posting by billing operations staff. Tracking who processed each payment is essential for SOX controls, fraud prevention, and operational qualit

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Payments are recognized in specific reporting periods for cash flow statements, premium income recognition, and statutory cash receipts reporting. Required for period-end financial position and regula

attributes.name: ape_amount
attributes.description: Annual Premium Equivalent amount derived from this payment, calculated by annualizing the modal premium. APE = annual premium + 10% of single premiums. Used for new business reporting, agent commission calculations, and management KPI tracking per industry standard.
attributes.references: NAIC; APE industry standard; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: apl_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment event triggered an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) to prevent policy lapse. When True, the policy's cash surrender value (CSV) was used to fund the premium obligation in lieu of a cash payment from the policyholder.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied to the policy premium obligation. May differ from payment_amount when a partial application occurs or when a portion is held in suspense.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned reference or trace number for the payment transaction (e.g., ACH trace number, wire confirmation number, check number). Used for bank reconciliation and payment dispute resolution.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the premium billing period to which this payment is applied. Together with billing_period_start_date, defines the coverage interval funded by this payment.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the premium billing period to which this payment is applied. Defines the coverage period being funded by this payment transaction.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number printed on the paper check instrument when payment_method is 'check'. Null for non-check payment methods. Used for check reconciliation and return item processing.

attributes.name: clearance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment instrument was confirmed cleared by the bank. Null for payments not yet cleared or returned. Used for cash reconciliation and float management.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Bank clearance status of the payment instrument. Pending: awaiting bank confirmation. Cleared: funds confirmed received by bank. Returned: check or ACH returned by bank (NSF, account closed). Stopped: stop payment issued. Voided: payment voided before presentment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing_premium_payment record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, CAD). Supports multi-currency policy administration for international life and annuity products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: eft_account_last4
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Account Last 4 Digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number used for EFT/ACH payment. Stored as a masked reference for reconciliation and payor identification without retaining full account details. Null for non-EFT payment methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: grace_period_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was received during the policy grace period (typically 30-31 days after the premium due date per state regulation). Grace period payments prevent lapse but may affect policy values and reinstatement requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: is_suspense
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of this payment is currently held in a suspense account pending identification, resolution, or instruction. True when suspense_amount > 0 and the payment cannot be fully applied.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual

attributes.name: modal_premium_mode
attributes.description: Billing frequency mode associated with this payment, indicating whether the premium was collected on an annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly basis. Drives APE (Annual Premium Equivalent) calculation and billing schedule alignment.

attributes.name: nsf_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee amount assessed to the policyholder as a result of a returned NSF payment. Zero or null when nsf_indicator is False. Governed by state-specific fee limits.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: nsf_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was returned by the bank due to non-sufficient funds (NSF) in the payor's account. True triggers NSF fee assessment, grace period re-evaluation, and potential lapse administration workflow in Sapiens BillingPro.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Model Regulation 520

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the premium payment received or refund issued, expressed in the policy currency. For receipts, this is the total cash collected from the payor. For refunds, this is the total cash disbursed to the payee. This is the base monetary amount before any allocation or adjustment.
attributes.references: NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual; FASB ASC 944; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The real-world business date on which the premium payment was received from the payor or the refund was issued to the payee. This is the principal business event date used for premium accounting, grace period calculation, and billing period application.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to tender the premium payment. Check: paper check. EFT/ACH: electronic funds transfer via Automated Clearing House. Credit card: card payment. Wire: bank wire transfer. Payroll deduction: employer-sponsored payroll withholding. ACH reversal: return of a prior ACH receipt (NSF or stop payment).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by billing operations staff regarding this payment transaction. May include exception handling details, payor instructions, or reconciliation remarks.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable transaction reference number assigned by Sapiens BillingPro at the time of payment receipt or refund issuance. Used for cash application, reconciliation, and customer-facing correspondence.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating party or mechanism that funded the premium payment. Policyholder: direct payment by the insured. Employer: group or payroll-deducted payment. Bank draft: pre-authorized bank account draft. Third party: payment by a non-policyholder payor. Trust: payment from an ILIT or other trust arrangement.
attributes.references: NAIC; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; ILIT regulations

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction within the billing workflow. Pending: received but not yet cleared. Cleared: bank confirmation received. Applied: posted to policy premium account. Reversed: cancelled due to NSF or error. Suspended: held in suspense pending resolution. Failed: payment attempt unsuccessful.

attributes.name: premium_allocation_type
attributes.description: Identifies the policy component to which this payment is allocated. Base policy: core policy premium. Rider: supplemental benefit rider premium (e.g., ADB, LTC, DI). COI: Cost of Insurance charge for universal life products. Load: expense loading. Other: miscellaneous allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_policy|rider|coi|load|waiver|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; ACORD; Sapiens BillingPro; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the payment transaction was recorded in the Sapiens BillingPro system. Used for intraday cash application sequencing, audit trails, and same-day processing cutoff determination.

attributes.name: refund_approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for premium refund transactions. Pending: awaiting authorization. Approved: authorized for disbursement. Rejected: refund request denied. Issued: refund disbursed to payee. Null for non-refund transactions.

attributes.name: refund_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the unearned premium refund amount. Pro-rata: refund proportional to unused coverage days. Short-rate: refund less a penalty for policyholder-initiated cancellation. Flat: full premium refund (e.g., free-look period). Null for non-refund transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: refund_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium refund was disbursed to the payee. Null for non-refund transactions or refunds not yet issued. Used for refund aging and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which a premium refund is disbursed to the payee. Check: paper check mailed. ACH credit: electronic credit to bank account. Policy credit: applied as a credit to the policy account balance. Wire: bank wire transfer. Null for non-refund transactions.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for premium refund transactions. Policy cancellation: refund upon policy surrender or lapse. Overpayment: excess premium collected. Rate correction: refund due to premium rate adjustment. Death claim return: unearned premium returned upon insured death. Free-look cancellation: refund within the free-look period per state regulation. Null for non-refund transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: reinstatement_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is associated with a policy reinstatement event, where a lapsed policy is being restored. Reinstatement payments typically include all past-due premiums plus interest.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: Native payment transaction identifier assigned by the Sapiens BillingPro source system. Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation, audit, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: suspense_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount held in a suspense account pending resolution (e.g., unidentified payor, NIGO application, overpayment pending instruction). Zero when the full payment is applied.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the direction and nature of the premium cash movement: receipt (inbound premium collected), refund (outbound return of premium), reversal (cancellation of a prior receipt, e.g., NSF), adjustment (correction entry), or transfer (reallocation between policies).
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this billing_premium_payment record. Used for change data capture, reconciliation, and audit compliance.

products.name: premium_allocation
products.description: Transactional record detailing how a received premium payment is allocated across policy components — base policy premium, rider premiums (ADB, AWL, CAR, LTC), COI charges for UL/IUL/VUL products, and administrative expense loads. Captures allocation amount per component, component type, and effective date. Essential for UL/IUL/VUL products where premium is split between COI, expense charges, and account value funding.

attributes.name: premium_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium allocation transaction record in the billing system. Primary key for the premium_allocation data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro internal record identifier convention

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account under which the premium payment was received and from which this allocation is derived.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro billing account module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent premium payment transaction from which this allocation is derived. Links the allocation detail back to the received payment header.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro payment processing module

attributes.name: finance_dac_amortization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.dac_amortization. Business justification: Premium allocations to base and riders drive DAC amortization schedules under LDTI. Actual premium collected determines amortization release. Critical for GAAP financial reporting and actuarial-financ

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy to which this premium allocation applies. Establishes the policy context for the allocation record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Oracle Insurance Policy Administration; NAIC Policy Data Standards

attributes.name: original_allocation_premium_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original premium_allocation_id that this record reverses or adjusts. Populated only when allocation_status is REVERSED or ADJUSTED, enabling a complete audit chain from original allocation through all corrections.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro reversal and adjustment audit trail

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (owner) associated with the policy for which this premium is being allocated. Supports customer-level billing analytics and PARTY_REFERENCE requirement.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Premium allocations follow product plan component structure (base premium, rider premiums, COI rates, expense loads). Critical for accurate accounting, DAC calculations, statutory reserve computations

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Premium allocations to base coverage, riders, and COI must be tracked by reporting period for earned premium calculations, DAC amortization schedules, and reserve adequacy testing required in statutor

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Variable life and annuity products require tracking which separate account fund each premium allocation is invested into. This is the core operational link for policyholder-directed investment electio

attributes.name: account_value_credit_amount
attributes.description: The net dollar amount credited to the policy Account Value (AV) after deducting COI charges and expense loads from the gross premium payment. Applicable for UL/IUL/VUL products. Populated when component_type is ACCOUNT_VALUE_FUNDING.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro account value module

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The gross dollar amount of the premium payment allocated to this specific policy component. This is the primary monetary fact for the allocation line. For UL/IUL/VUL products, this represents the portion directed to COI, expense load, rider premium, or account value funding as indicated by component_type.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business effective date on which the premium amount was allocated to the policy component. This is the principal real-world event date for the allocation, used for policy accounting, reserve calculations, and billing period reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this premium allocation record, used in billing statements, reconciliation reports, and policyholder correspondence. Follows the format ALLOC-{YYYYMMDD}-{sequence}.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro allocation reference numbering

attributes.name: allocation_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering the allocation components within a single premium payment. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full allocation breakdown for a given payment_id, supporting reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro allocation sequencing; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this premium allocation record. PENDING = allocation calculated but not yet posted to policy; APPLIED = allocation successfully posted to the policy component; REVERSED = allocation reversed due to payment return (NSF) or correction; ADJUSTED = allocation modified due to billing correction or reallocation; FAILED = allocation processing encountered an error.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro allocation status workflow; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this allocation record was created and posted in the billing system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp and supports intraday reconciliation and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro audit trail

attributes.name: annualized_premium_amount
attributes.description: The annualized equivalent of the allocated component premium, calculated by applying the modal factor to the allocated_amount. Used for Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) reporting, new business value calculations, and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: apl_balance_after
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Premium Loan (APL) Balance After Allocation
attributes.description: The outstanding Automatic Premium Loan (APL) balance on the policy immediately after this allocation is applied. Populated when component_type is APL_REPAYMENT. The difference between apl_balance_before and apl_balance_after equals the allocated_amount for APL repayment lines.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Policy Loans; IRC Section 7702; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: apl_balance_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Premium Loan (APL) Balance Before Allocation
attributes.description: The outstanding Automatic Premium Loan (APL) balance on the policy immediately before this allocation is applied. Populated when component_type is APL_REPAYMENT to track loan reduction. APL is triggered when a premium is unpaid and the policy has sufficient cash value.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Policy Loans; IRC Section 7702; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency under which the premium payment was collected and this allocation was generated. Determines the billing period duration and the modal premium factor applied to the annualized premium.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro modal billing module; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period to which this premium allocation is applied. Together with billing_period_start_date, defines the modal billing interval covered by this allocation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro billing period module; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period to which this premium allocation is applied. Used for modal billing reconciliation (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly) and premium accounting.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro billing period module; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: coi_rate
attributes.description: The Cost of Insurance (COI) rate per thousand dollars of Net Amount at Risk (NAR) applied to calculate the COI charge for this allocation period. Applicable only when component_type is COI. Derived from the policy's mortality table, age, risk class, and policy year.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the policy component to which this allocation amount is applied. BASE_PREMIUM covers the core policy premium; COI (Cost of Insurance) is the mortality charge for UL/IUL/VUL products; RIDER_PREMIUM covers supplemental benefit riders (ADB, AWL, CAR, LTC); EXPENSE_LOAD is the administrative expense charge; APL_REPAYMENT is repayment of an Automatic Premium Loan; ACCOUNT_VALUE_FUNDING is the net amount credited to the policyholder's account value for UL/IUL/VUL.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro component allocation module

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the premium allocation provides coverage or account value credit for the associated policy component. Used to align premium allocation with the billing period and policy anniversary calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which the premium allocation provides coverage for the associated policy component. Defines the end of the billing period covered by this allocation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated amount. Typically USD for domestic US life insurance policies. Required for multi-currency policy support and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: dac_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium allocation is eligible for Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) capitalization under GAAP accounting. DAC-eligible premiums contribute to the deferral of policy acquisition costs amortized over the expected policy life. Relevant for FASB ASC 944 and LDTI compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements); GAAP; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: expense_load_amount
attributes.description: The administrative expense charge deducted from the premium payment before crediting to account value for UL/IUL/VUL products. Represents the per-premium or per-policy expense load as defined in the policy contract. Populated when component_type is EXPENSE_LOAD.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting

attributes.name: grace_period_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium allocation was applied during the policy's grace period. When True, the allocation is a late payment that prevented lapse. Critical for grace period management, lapse administration, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Grace Period Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro grace period management module; State Department of Insurance regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was most recently modified, such as during a reversal, adjustment, or status change. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro audit trail

attributes.name: mec_test_status
attributes.description: The result of the Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) 7-pay test for this premium allocation. PASS = premium does not cause the policy to become a MEC; FAIL = premium causes or contributes to MEC classification; NOT_APPLICABLE = MEC testing not required for this product type. MEC classification has significant tax implications under IRC Section 7702A.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; NAIC MEC Guidelines; IRS Revenue Ruling; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: modal_premium_amount
attributes.description: The scheduled modal premium amount for the policy at the time of this allocation, representing the total premium due for the billing mode (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly). Used to validate that the total allocation equals the expected modal premium.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro modal billing module; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) used in the COI charge calculation for this allocation period, representing the difference between the death benefit and the policy account value. Applicable for UL/IUL/VUL products when component_type is COI.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: nsf_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premium payment associated with this allocation was returned due to Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF). When True, the allocation is typically reversed and the policy may enter a grace period. Supports NSF handling and lapse administration workflows.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro NSF handling module; NAIC Grace Period Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used to remit the premium payment from which this allocation was derived. EFT_ACH = Electronic Funds Transfer via ACH; CHECK = paper check; CREDIT_CARD = credit/debit card; WIRE = wire transfer; DIRECT_BILL = direct billing to policyholder; LIST_BILL = employer or group list billing.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro payment processing module

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known policy contract number associated with this allocation. Denormalized for operational reporting and reconciliation without requiring a join to the policy table.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Policy Data Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1-based integer) in which this premium allocation falls, calculated from the policy issue date. Used for COI rate determination, MEC 7-pay test tracking, DAC amortization, and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance product type associated with the policy for this allocation. Determines applicable allocation logic: UL/IUL/VUL products require COI and expense load splits; WL and TERM products allocate entirely to base premium. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|YRT|TERM|SPIA|FIA|ANNUITY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Product Classification; NAIC Universal Life Model Regulation

attributes.name: reinstatement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium allocation is associated with a policy reinstatement payment, where a lapsed policy is being restored to in-force status. Reinstatement allocations may include back-premium and interest charges.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinstatement Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro reinstatement processing module; State Department of Insurance regulations

attributes.name: reinsurance_ceded_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the premium associated with this allocation has been ceded to a reinsurer under an active reinsurance treaty. When True, the corresponding reinsurance premium cession will be recorded in the reinsurance domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason this allocation was reversed when allocation_status is REVERSED. NSF = Non-Sufficient Funds return; PAYMENT_ERROR = incorrect payment amount; POLICY_CANCEL = policy cancelled retroactively; BILLING_CORRECTION = billing system correction; DUPLICATE = duplicate payment reversal; REINSTATEMENT_REVERSAL = reinstatement declined. Null when allocation has not been reversed.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro reversal processing module; NAIC Premium Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard code identifying the specific rider to which this allocation applies when component_type is RIDER_PREMIUM. ADB = Accidental Death Benefit; AWL = Automatic Waiver of Premium; CAR = Company Action Rider; LTC = Long-Term Care; DI = Disability Income; GMDB/GMWB/GMIB/GMAB = Guaranteed Minimum benefit riders; WP = Waiver of Premium. Null when component_type is not RIDER_PREMIUM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ADB|AWL|CAR|LTC|DI|GMDB|GMWB|GMIB|GMAB|WP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Rider Classification; Sapiens BillingPro rider premium module

attributes.name: seven_pay_premium_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative premium that can be paid in the first 7 policy years without triggering Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) classification under IRC Section 7702A. Used in conjunction with mec_test_status to monitor MEC compliance at the time of each premium allocation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; NAIC MEC Guidelines; IRS Revenue Ruling; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system that originated this premium allocation record (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, FAST_PAS, MAJESCO_BILLING). Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and ETL audit trails in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; SOX Section 404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: tax_qualified_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium allocation is associated with a tax-qualified plan (e.g., 401(k), IRA, pension plan). Tax-qualified allocations may have different contribution limits, tax treatment, and regulatory reporting requirements under ERISA and IRS regulations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; ERISA; DOL Fiduciary Standards; IRS Publication 590; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

products.name: grace_period
products.description: Transactional record tracking the grace period status for a policy following a missed or insufficient premium payment. Captures grace period start date, grace period end date (typically 30-31 days per NAIC model regulation, varies by state), grace period type, triggering bill reference, outstanding premium amount required to cure, notices sent (with dates), and resolution outcome (paid, lapsed, APL triggered, reinstated). SSOT for grace period administration per state DOI requirements. Supports regulatory notice timeline compliance and lapse prevention workflows.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the grace period record. Primary key for the grace_period data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module

attributes.name: assigned_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Grace period cases require active management by collections or customer service staff who contact policyholders, negotiate payment plans, and document resolution attempts. Tracking case ownership is f

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy for which this grace period has been initiated. Links the grace period record to the master policy entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: notice_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Grace periods trigger mandatory regulatory lapse warning notices required by state insurance laws. Real business process: consumer protection compliance, third-party notification requirements, proof o

attributes.name: outbound_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.outbound_notice. Business justification: Grace periods mandate regulatory notices per state insurance law (first notice, second notice, lapse warning). Tracking the specific notice sent for each grace period event is required for regulatory

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (owner) associated with the policy under grace period. Supports customer-level grace period reporting and lapse prevention outreach.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Grace period rules (duration, APL eligibility, notice requirements) are product-specific design features. Required for lapse management, conservation efforts, product design compliance validation, and

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium bill or billing notice that triggered the grace period due to a missed or insufficient payment. Establishes the causal link between the billing event and the grace period.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Premium Billing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Grace periods are triggered by missed payments on a premium schedule. While grace_period references premium_bill, it should also reference the schedule to enable schedule-level grace period tracking a

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Grace period duration (typically 30-31 days) and notice requirements are mandated by state regulation and vary by jurisdiction. Each grace period event must reference the applicable state regulation t

attributes.name: apl_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) applied to cover the outstanding premium, if APL was triggered as the resolution outcome. Null if APL was not triggered.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro — APL Triggers Module

attributes.name: apl_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is eligible for an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) to cover the outstanding premium during the grace period. Eligibility is based on sufficient policy cash surrender value (CSV) and the presence of an APL provision in the policy contract.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency of the policy at the time the grace period was triggered. Determines the premium amount due and the billing cycle context for the grace period. Supports Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Modal Billing Module; ACORD Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this grace period record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the audit creation time for data lineage and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: csv_at_trigger
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash Surrender Value (CSV) at Grace Period Trigger
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the policy at the time the grace period was triggered. Used to determine APL eligibility and the maximum loan amount available to cure the outstanding premium.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this grace period record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency policy administration for international or expatriate life insurance products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: days_remaining
attributes.description: The number of calendar days remaining in the grace period window as of the last record update. Supports lapse prevention workflow prioritization and regulatory notice timeline management. Null if the grace period is closed.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days in the grace period window, as defined by the applicable state regulation or policy contract. Typically 30 or 31 days for life insurance per NAIC model regulation. Stored explicitly to support regulatory compliance validation without requiring date arithmetic.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grace period expires. Typically 30 or 31 days from the start date per NAIC model regulation, but may vary by state DOI requirement, product type, or contractual terms. After this date, the policy lapses if no cure action has been taken.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: first_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the first regulatory grace period notice was sent to the policyholder, informing them of the missed payment and the outstanding premium required to cure. Required for state DOI regulatory notice timeline compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements — Notice of Lapse Regulations; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: lapse_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal lapse notice was sent to the policyholder, notifying them that the policy has lapsed or is imminent to lapse due to non-payment at the end of the grace period. Required by most state DOI regulations.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements — Notice of Lapse Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: modal_premium_amount
attributes.description: The scheduled premium amount due for the billing mode (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly) that was missed, triggering the grace period. Represents the full modal premium before any partial payment credit.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Modal Billing Module; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, exception handling comments, or special circumstances related to this grace period record (e.g., customer hardship accommodation, regulatory exception, manual override reason). Used by billing operations staff.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: notice_channel
attributes.description: The primary channel through which grace period notices were delivered to the policyholder (e.g., postal mail, email, SMS, phone call, online portal). Supports regulatory compliance documentation and lapse prevention workflow tracking.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: nsf_count
attributes.description: The number of Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) payment returns associated with this grace period event. Multiple NSF returns may indicate a pattern requiring escalated lapse prevention action or payment method change.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — NSF Handling Module; NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: outstanding_premium_amount
attributes.description: The net premium amount still required to cure the grace period and restore the policy to active status. Equals the modal premium amount less any partial payments received. This is the cure amount communicated in regulatory notices.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements; Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module

attributes.name: partial_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount of any partial premium payment received during the grace period that has been credited toward the outstanding premium. Zero if no partial payment was received.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Payment Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment method on file for the policy at the time the grace period was triggered. Identifies whether the failure was an EFT/ACH failure, a returned check (NSF), or a direct bill non-response. Supports root cause analysis for lapse prevention.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — EFT/ACH Payment Records Module; NAIC Model Regulation; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grace period record. 'open' indicates the grace period is active and the policy is still in force. 'cured' indicates the outstanding premium was paid within the grace period. 'lapsed' indicates the policy lapsed due to non-payment. 'apl_triggered' indicates an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was applied. 'reinstated' indicates the policy was reinstated after lapse. 'expired' indicates the grace period window closed without resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation §§ 4-6; State DOI Requirements; Sapiens BillingPro — Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grace period based on its governing basis. 'standard' reflects the default NAIC model regulation grace period (30-31 days). 'extended' reflects a grace period longer than standard, granted by company policy or state mandate. 'state_mandated' reflects a grace period required by a specific state DOI regulation. 'contractual' reflects a grace period defined within the policy contract terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the policy under grace period, as assigned by the Policy Administration System. Used for regulatory notices, customer correspondence, and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: premium_due_date
attributes.description: The original scheduled premium due date that was missed or insufficiently paid, triggering the grace period. Used to reconcile the grace period against the premium billing schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Premium Billing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_grace_count
attributes.description: The number of prior grace period events on this policy before the current grace period. A high count indicates a pattern of payment difficulty and may trigger enhanced lapse prevention workflows or underwriting review.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The type of life insurance or annuity product associated with the policy under grace period. Determines applicable grace period rules, state regulatory requirements, and resolution options (e.g., APL eligibility). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_life|term_life|universal_life|variable_universal_life|indexed_universal_life|annuity|disability_income|long_term_care — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; State DOI Requirements; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory grace period or lapse notice is required to be sent to the policyholder under applicable state DOI regulations for this policy. Drives the notice generation workflow in the billing system.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements — Notice of Lapse Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: reinstatement_deadline
attributes.description: The last date by which the policyholder may apply for reinstatement of a lapsed policy, as defined by the policy contract and applicable state regulations. Typically 3-5 years from the lapse date. Null if the policy has not lapsed.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grace period was resolved, either through payment, lapse, APL trigger, reinstatement, or waiver. Null if the grace period is still open.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: The final resolution outcome of the grace period. 'paid' indicates the outstanding premium was paid in full within the grace period. 'lapsed' indicates the policy lapsed due to non-payment. 'apl_triggered' indicates an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was applied to cover the outstanding premium. 'reinstated' indicates the policy was reinstated after lapse. 'waived' indicates the premium was waived (e.g., due to disability waiver rider).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements; Sapiens BillingPro — Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: second_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the second or follow-up grace period notice was sent to the policyholder. Some states require multiple notices during the grace period window. Null if only one notice is required or sent.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements — Notice of Lapse Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational billing or policy administration system from which this grace period record originated. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing; FAST; EXL; Oracle Insurance Policy Administration

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier or reference number assigned to this grace period record in the originating operational system (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro internal grace period ID). Supports cross-system reconciliation and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing; FAST; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grace period commenced, typically the day after the premium due date when payment was not received. This is the principal business event date for the grace period lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Requirements; Sapiens BillingPro — Grace Period Administration Module

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code of the state in which the policy was issued. Determines the applicable state DOI grace period regulations, required notice timelines, and lapse rules that govern this grace period record.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states plus territories); NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: third_party_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lapse notice was sent to the designated third party (e.g., assignee, ILIT trustee). Null if no third party notice is required or if it has not yet been sent.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements — Third Party Notice Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: third_party_notice_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lapse notice must also be sent to a designated third party (e.g., assignee, collateral assignee, or irrevocable beneficiary) per state DOI regulations or policy contract terms. Relevant for ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) and collateral assignment scenarios.
attributes.references: State DOI Requirements — Third Party Notice Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation; ILIT Policy Administration

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: The specific reason that initiated the grace period. 'missed_payment' indicates no payment was received by the due date. 'insufficient_payment' indicates a partial payment was received but did not meet the required premium amount. 'nsf_return' indicates a Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) check was returned. 'eft_failure' indicates an Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT)/ACH payment failed. 'check_return' indicates a physical check was returned unpaid.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro — NSF Handling and EFT/ACH Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this grace period record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the most recent status change, notice sent, or resolution update for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Waiver of Premium rider (e.g., Automatic Waiver of Premium — AWL, or disability waiver) is active on the policy at the time of the grace period. If true, the outstanding premium may be waived, affecting the resolution outcome.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Standards

products.name: lapse_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing the lapse of a policy due to non-payment of premium after expiration of the grace period. Records lapse effective date, lapse reason code, outstanding premium at lapse, cash surrender value at lapse, automatic premium loan (APL) eligibility flag, non-forfeiture option elected (extended term, reduced paid-up), and any regulatory notification requirements. Source: Sapiens BillingPro lapse administration module.

attributes.name: lapse_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each policy lapse event record in the billing domain. Primary key for the lapse_event data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account associated with the lapsed policy. Links the lapse event to the premium billing and collection record in Sapiens BillingPro.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Lapse events occur after grace period expiration. This FK captures the direct causal relationship between the grace period and the resulting lapse. Currently lapse_event has denormalized grace period

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy that has lapsed due to non-payment of premium after expiration of the grace period. Core linkage to the policy master record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: lapse_notice_document_id

attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: plan_id

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lapse processing involves manual review of non-forfeiture options, regulatory notice requirements, and reinstatement eligibility. Tracking the processing employee supports audit trails, quality contro

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Lapse events are key metrics reported by period for persistency analysis, in-force policy counts, and statutory exhibits. Essential for NAIC Annual Statement Schedule T (Exhibit of Policies in Force)
