attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Lapse processing must comply with state-specific nonforfeiture requirements (extended term insurance, reduced paid-up options, cash surrender value calculations). Each lapse event must reference the g

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Lapse events trigger statutory reserve releases and accounting adjustments. Required for SAP reporting, RBC calculations, and regulatory filings. Links policy status changes to reserve valuation and f

attributes.name: apl_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) applied against the policy's Cash Surrender Value (CSV) to fund the outstanding premium. Null if APL was not applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: apl_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was actually applied to prevent or reverse the lapse. True if APL was triggered and the premium was funded via policy loan. Distinct from apl_eligible which reflects eligibility only.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: apl_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is eligible for an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) to prevent lapse. True if the policy has sufficient Cash Surrender Value (CSV) to cover the outstanding premium and the APL provision is active in the policy contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The premium payment frequency mode in effect at the time of lapse. Determines the modal premium amount and grace period calculation. Values: annual, semi_annual, quarterly, monthly.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Premium Billing Module; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this lapse event record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Audit trail timestamp for data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 944; Databricks Silver Layer audit standards

attributes.name: csv_at_lapse
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the policy as of the lapse effective date. Determines eligibility for non-forfeiture options (extended term insurance, reduced paid-up insurance) and Automatic Premium Loan (APL) triggers. Critical for actuarial reserving and policyholder notification.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; FASB ASC 944; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this lapse event record. Typically USD for domestic US life insurance policies.

attributes.name: extended_term_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the extended term insurance coverage expires when the extended_term non-forfeiture option is elected. Calculated based on the CSV at lapse and the net single premium for term coverage. Null if extended term was not elected.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: The original face amount (death benefit) of the lapsed policy as of the lapse effective date. Used for reinsurance cession adjustments, actuarial reserving, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: lapse_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policy officially lapsed, defined as the day following the expiration of the grace period without receipt of the required premium. This is the principal business event date for the lapse transaction.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: lapse_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the lapse event, assigned by the Sapiens BillingPro lapse administration module. Used for cross-system reference and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: lapse_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the policy lapse as recorded in Sapiens BillingPro. 'NSF' = non-sufficient funds; 'EFT_FAIL' = electronic funds transfer failure; 'VOLUNTARY' = policyholder elected to lapse; 'PREMIUM_UNAFFORDABLE' = policyholder cited affordability; 'ADDRESS_UNKNOWN' = undeliverable billing notices; 'POLICY_SURRENDER' = policyholder surrendered; 'OTHER' = other reason. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NSF|EFT_FAIL|VOLUNTARY|PREMIUM_UNAFFORDABLE|ADDRESS_UNKNOWN|POLICY_SURRENDER|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: lapse_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the lapse reason, supplementing the lapse_reason_code. May include notes from the billing administrator or automated system messages from Sapiens BillingPro.

attributes.name: lapse_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the lapse event. 'pending' indicates grace period has expired but lapse is not yet finalized; 'confirmed' indicates lapse is fully processed; 'reinstated' indicates the policy was reinstated after lapse; 'reversed' indicates the lapse was reversed due to payment received; 'written_off' indicates the policy is permanently lapsed with no reinstatement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module

attributes.name: missed_premium_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled premium due date for which payment was not received, triggering the grace period and subsequent lapse. Corresponds to the billing cycle date in the premium schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Premium Billing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: modal_premium_amount
attributes.description: The scheduled periodic premium amount for the billing mode (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly) applicable at the time of lapse. Represents the single missed payment that triggered the grace period.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Premium Billing Module; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: nar_at_lapse
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) at Lapse
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — the difference between the death benefit and the policy reserve or account value — as of the lapse effective date. Used for reinsurance cession termination calculations and actuarial risk analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Reinsurance treaty standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: non_forfeiture_election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the non-forfeiture option was elected by the policyholder or automatically applied by the system. Null if no non-forfeiture option was applicable or elected.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: non_forfeiture_option
attributes.description: The non-forfeiture option elected or automatically applied upon lapse. 'extended_term' = policy continues as term insurance for the original face amount for a limited period; 'reduced_paid_up' = policy continues as paid-up whole life at a reduced face amount; 'cash_surrender' = policyholder receives CSV; 'none' = no non-forfeiture option applicable (e.g., term policy with no CSV).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; State Departments of Insurance; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: outstanding_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total unpaid premium balance outstanding at the time of lapse, including the missed modal premium and any arrears. Expressed in USD. Used for reinstatement calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: policy_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of complete months the policy was in force from issue date to lapse effective date. Used in actuarial lapse rate studies, persistency analysis, and DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) amortization modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements); Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the lapsed policy. Used to calculate policy duration at lapse, which is a key metric for actuarial experience studies and lapse rate analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: policy_loan_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding policy loan balance (including accrued interest) at the time of lapse. Reduces the net CSV available for non-forfeiture options and APL eligibility. Relevant for IRC Section 7702 MEC (Modified Endowment Contract) compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; IRS

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known policy contract number that has lapsed. Denormalized from the policy master for operational reporting and regulatory notification without requiring a join.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the lapse event was formally processed and confirmed in the billing system. Represents the business event timestamp when the lapse transaction was executed in Sapiens BillingPro.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Lapse Administration Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The life insurance product type of the lapsed policy. Drives non-forfeiture option availability, grace period rules, and regulatory notification requirements. Values: WL (Whole Life), UL (Universal Life), IUL (Indexed Universal Life), VUL (Variable Universal Life), term, annuity, DI (Disability Income), LTC (Long-Term Care). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|term|annuity|DI|LTC — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: reduced_paid_up_face_amount
attributes.description: The reduced face amount of the paid-up insurance when the reduced_paid_up non-forfeiture option is elected. Calculated based on the CSV at lapse and the net single premium for paid-up coverage. Null if reduced paid-up was not elected.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory lapse notification must be sent to the policyholder and/or state insurance department. Driven by state-specific requirements for lapse notices, particularly for policies with CSV or for senior policyholders.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Senior Protection in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required regulatory lapse notification was sent to the policyholder and/or state insurance department. Null if notification has not yet been sent or is not required.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: reinstatement_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date by which the policyholder may apply for reinstatement of the lapsed policy under the policy contract terms. Typically 3-5 years from the lapse effective date per state regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lapsed policy is eligible for reinstatement under the policy contract terms and applicable state regulations. Eligibility typically requires reinstatement within 3-5 years of lapse and evidence of insurability.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this lapse event record was sourced. Primarily Sapiens BillingPro lapse administration module. Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: source_system_lapse_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this lapse event record in the source operational system (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro internal lapse transaction ID). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and back-reference to the system of record.

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code where the policy was issued. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, grace period requirements, non-forfeiture rules, and regulatory notification obligations for the lapse event.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: third_party_notice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lapse notice was sent to a designated third party (e.g., assignee, irrevocable beneficiary, ILIT trustee) as required by the policy contract or state regulation. Relevant for ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) and collateral assignment scenarios.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this lapse event record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks updates such as status changes (e.g., lapse reversed upon payment receipt, reinstatement processed). Audit trail for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 944; Databricks Silver Layer audit standards

products.name: billing_reinstatement
products.description: Transactional record of a policy reinstatement following a lapse, capturing reinstatement application date, reinstatement effective date, back-premium amount collected, reinstatement underwriting evidence required (insurability statement, APS), reinstatement approval status, and reinstating agent. Tracks the full reinstatement workflow from application through approval and premium collection. Source: Policy Administration System reinstatement module.

attributes.name: billing_reinstatement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the policy reinstatement record in the billing domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro / FAST reinstatement module)

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: application_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinstatement requires signed application forms, evidence of insurability documents, attending physician statements. Real business process: underwriting review, policy administration workflow, regulat

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy being reinstated. Links this reinstatement transaction to the master policy record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System reinstatement module

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Reinstatements require journal entries to restore reserves, recognize back premiums, and record interest. Essential for financial reporting accuracy and audit trail. Links policy administration events

attributes.name: lapse_event_id

attributes.name: outbound_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.outbound_notice. Operations need to track which notice was sent for each reinstatement decision to support

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder (owner) who submitted the reinstatement application. Used for customer-level reinstatement analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; CRM and Customer Engagement Platform

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Reinstatement rules (evidence requirements, windows, interest calculations) are product-specific. Required for underwriting decision support, product administration compliance, reinstatement rate anal

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Reinstatement restores a lapsed policy's premium schedule. The reinstated schedule may be the original or a modified version. This FK enables tracking which schedules are reinstated and supports reins

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or broker who facilitated the reinstatement application. Used for commission and distribution analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Reinstatements affect in-force counts, premium income restoration, and reserve calculations within the period they occur. Required for accurate period-end financial position and statutory policy count

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Reinstatement eligibility windows (typically 3-5 years post-lapse), evidence of insurability requirements, and back-premium interest calculations are governed by state regulation. Each reinstatement m

attributes.name: underwriter_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Reinstatements requiring underwriting evidence must be reviewed and approved by licensed underwriters. Tracking the decision-maker is a core underwriting workflow requirement for regulatory compliance

attributes.name: aml_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinstatement triggered an Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review under the company's AML/BSA program. Reinstatements with large back-premium payments or unusual patterns may require enhanced due diligence.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA compliance; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model AML Regulation

attributes.name: amount_collected
attributes.description: Actual total amount received from the policyholder in connection with this reinstatement. May differ from total_amount_due if partial payments were accepted or waivers applied.
attributes.references: Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro / Majesco Billing); SAP

attributes.name: apl_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was triggered to fund the back-premium collection at reinstatement. True if the policy's cash value was used via APL to satisfy the reinstatement amount due.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Policy Administration System (APL module); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policyholder formally submitted the reinstatement application. Starts the reinstatement workflow clock and determines eligibility under state-mandated reinstatement windows (typically 3–5 years from lapse).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinstatement application was formally approved by the underwriting or policy servicing team. Null if the application is pending, denied, or withdrawn.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System reinstatement module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reinstatement application. Drives downstream processing: 'approved' triggers policy restoration and premium posting; 'denied' triggers adverse action notice; 'conditionally_approved' requires additional evidence before final approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Policy Administration System reinstatement module

attributes.name: aps_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Attending Physician Statement (APS) was received from the policyholder's physician. Null if APS is not required or not yet received. Tracks evidence collection progress in the reinstatement workflow.
attributes.references: Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum); HIPAA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: back_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total gross premium amount due for the lapsed period that must be collected to reinstate the policy. Covers all modal premiums (base policy plus riders) from the lapse date to the reinstatement effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Billing and Premium Collection System; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: back_premium_interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest charged on the back-premium amount for the lapsed period, calculated at the policy contract rate or state-mandated rate. Added to back_premium_amount to determine total amount due at reinstatement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; State Departments of Insurance; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinstatement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation point for SOX and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 944; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: csv_at_lapse
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the policy at the time of lapse. Used to determine whether APL was available to prevent lapse and to assess the financial position of the policy at reinstatement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Policy Administration System; SAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this reinstatement record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international life insurance portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinstatement application was formally denied. Null if the application is approved, pending, or withdrawn. Required for adverse action notification compliance.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for reinstatement denial (e.g., insurability not demonstrated, back-premium not paid, reinstatement window expired, fraud indicator). Null if not denied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insurability_failed|back_premium_unpaid|window_expired|fraud_indicator|incomplete_evidence|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance adverse action requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policy coverage is restored following successful reinstatement approval and back-premium collection. This is the binding date from which the reinstated policy is in force.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; IRC Section 7702; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: evidence_type
attributes.description: Type of underwriting evidence required or submitted for this reinstatement. 'none' applies when lapse is within the simplified reinstatement window. 'aps' refers to Attending Physician Statement (APS). 'full_underwriting' applies for long lapses or high face amounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum); HIPAA

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: The death benefit face amount of the policy being reinstated. Denormalized from the policy record for reinstatement underwriting thresholds and reinsurance notification requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Reinsurance Management System; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinstatement has been flagged for potential fraud or STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) activity. Triggers enhanced review by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; FinCEN; STOLI detection guidelines; Claims Management System (fraud detection module)

attributes.name: grace_period_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policy's contractual grace period expired, triggering the lapse. Typically 30 or 31 days after the premium due date per state regulation. Used to validate lapse date accuracy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; State Departments of Insurance; Billing and Premium Collection System (grace period management module)

attributes.name: insurability_statement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signed personal statement of insurability (good health declaration) has been received from the policyholder as part of the reinstatement application package.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Policy Administration System reinstatement module

attributes.name: lapse_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the policy was in lapsed status, calculated from lapse_date to application_date. Used to assess reinstatement eligibility, back-premium calculation, and underwriting evidence requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: mib_check_performed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Information Bureau (MIB) Check Performed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Medical Information Bureau (MIB) inquiry was performed as part of the reinstatement underwriting process. MIB checks are standard for reinstatements requiring evidence of insurability.
attributes.references: MIB Group Inc. data exchange standards; HIPAA; Underwriting Workbench

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriter or policy servicing analyst notes regarding special circumstances, conditional requirements, or exceptions associated with this reinstatement. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the back-premium and associated charges were received and posted by the billing system. Null if payment has not yet been collected.
attributes.references: Billing and Premium Collection System; NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to collect the back-premium and reinstatement charges. 'automatic_premium_loan' (APL) indicates the policy loan provision was used to fund reinstatement.
attributes.references: Billing and Premium Collection System (EFT/ACH module); NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: policy_loan_balance_at_lapse
attributes.description: Outstanding policy loan balance at the time of lapse. Relevant for reinstatement calculations as outstanding loan interest may be required to be paid or capitalized as part of the reinstatement amount due.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known policy contract number associated with this reinstatement. Denormalized for operational reporting and policyholder correspondence without requiring a join to the policy table.

attributes.name: prior_reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of times this policy has previously been reinstated. Used for underwriting risk assessment, fraud detection, and STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) screening. Policies with multiple reinstatements may require enhanced scrutiny.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA compliance; STOLI detection guidelines

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance product type being reinstated (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, Term, DI). Used to apply product-specific reinstatement rules and underwriting guidelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing; Policy Administration System; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the reinstatement transaction, assigned by the Policy Administration System reinstatement module. Used in policyholder correspondence and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro / FAST reinstatement module)

attributes.name: reinstatement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinstatement process type. 'standard' requires full underwriting evidence; 'simplified' uses a short-form health statement; 'automatic' applies within the contractual automatic reinstatement window; 'conditional' is subject to additional requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Policy Administration System reinstatement module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational Policy Administration System instance from which this reinstatement record was sourced (e.g., FAST, SAPIENS_LIFEPRO, EXL). Supports multi-system environments and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; EXL; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle Insurance Policy Administration); ACORD Standards

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the state in which the policy was originally issued. Determines which state's reinstatement regulations, grace period rules, and evidence requirements apply.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: Total amount required from the policyholder to complete reinstatement, comprising back-premium amount plus back-premium interest plus any outstanding loan interest. This is the gross amount billed at reinstatement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Billing and Premium Collection System

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: The underwriting outcome for the reinstatement evidence review. 'approved_rated' indicates reinstatement approved with a substandard rating or exclusion. 'not_required' applies when no evidence was needed.
attributes.references: Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum); NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: underwriting_evidence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinstatement requires the policyholder to provide evidence of insurability (e.g., health statement, APS). Typically required when the lapse duration exceeds the contractual or state-mandated threshold.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reinstatement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 944; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: window_expiry_date
attributes.description: The last date by which the policyholder may apply for reinstatement under the policy contract and applicable state law. Typically 3–5 years from the lapse date. Applications received after this date are ineligible.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Life Insurance Policy Act; State Departments of Insurance; Policy Administration System

products.name: nsf_event
products.description: Transactional record of a Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or returned payment event, capturing the original payment reference, NSF date, bank return reason code, NSF fee assessed, grace period impact, policy status at NSF, and remediation action taken (re-presentment, manual payment, lapse initiation). Critical for EFT/ACH payment management and state-mandated NSF notification compliance.

attributes.name: nsf_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each NSF or returned payment event record in the billing system. Primary key for the nsf_event data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro Internal Schema

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account against which the NSF event was recorded. Links the NSF event to the policyholder's premium billing account.

attributes.name: aml_case_id

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency of the policy at the time of the NSF event. Determines the premium amount due and the frequency of potential future NSF exposure. Supports modal billing analysis and APE calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment amount. Typically USD for domestic US life insurance policies. Required for multi-currency policy administration environments.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NSF event. Tracks whether the event is open and awaiting resolution, pending re-presentment, resolved via manual payment, or has triggered lapse initiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|resolved|pending_representment|lapse_initiated|waived|written_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: lapse_initiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policy lapse process was formally initiated as a result of the unresolved NSF event. Null if the NSF was remediated before lapse. Triggers lapse administration workflows in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance Lapse Notification Requirements; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for billing operations staff to record additional context about the NSF event, such as customer communication details, special handling instructions, or escalation notes. Supports customer service and audit review workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Operations Policy; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to deliver the NSF notification to the policyholder. State regulations may mandate specific notification methods (e.g., first-class mail). Supports compliance reporting and customer communication analytics.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance NSF Notification Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation; CRM Platform

attributes.name: nsf_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the bank returned the payment as Non-Sufficient Funds. This is the principal business event date used to trigger grace period calculations and state-mandated notification timelines.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: nsf_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the NSF fee assessed to the policyholder's billing account as a result of the returned payment. Fee amounts are governed by state regulations and policy contract terms. May be zero if the insurer waives the fee.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance Fee Regulations; NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: nsf_fee_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NSF fee was waived for this event. True if the fee was waived (e.g., first-time occurrence, hardship waiver, or state regulatory requirement). Supports fee waiver reporting and customer service analytics.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: nsf_fee_waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the NSF fee was waived. Applicable only when nsf_fee_waived is True. Supports audit compliance and waiver pattern analysis.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; Internal Billing Policy

attributes.name: nsf_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a state-mandated NSF notification must be sent to the policyholder. State regulations vary in their NSF notification requirements. True triggers the notification workflow in the CRM and customer engagement platform.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance NSF Notification Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: nsf_notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state-mandated NSF notification was sent to the policyholder. Null if notification has not yet been sent. Critical for demonstrating compliance with state notification timing requirements.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance NSF Notification Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation; HIPAA (if health-related riders)

attributes.name: nsf_occurrence_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of NSF events recorded for this policy over its lifetime at the time this event was created. Used to identify chronic NSF patterns, assess lapse risk, and determine fee waiver eligibility (e.g., first-occurrence waiver policies).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Internal Risk Management Policy

attributes.name: nsf_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the NSF event, typically assigned by the billing system or bank. Used for correspondence, state NSF notifications, and audit trails.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The gross dollar amount of the original premium payment that was returned NSF. Represents the full EFT/ACH debit amount attempted, which may include base premium, rider premiums, and Cost of Insurance (COI) charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument type used for the original payment that was returned NSF. Most NSF events originate from EFT/ACH transactions, but returned checks and other instruments are also captured.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_status_at_nsf
attributes.description: The status of the life insurance policy at the time the NSF event was recorded. Critical for determining the appropriate remediation workflow — an already-lapsed policy requires reinstatement processing rather than grace period management.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: The action taken to resolve the NSF event. Re-presentment submits the ACH transaction again; manual payment accepts an alternative payment; Automatic Premium Loan (APL) uses policy cash value to cover the premium; lapse_initiated records that no remediation occurred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: representment|manual_payment|apl_triggered|lapse_initiated|reinstated|waived|pending|write_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; NACHA Operating Rules; Policy Contract Terms (APL provision)

attributes.name: remediation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NSF event was successfully resolved through the recorded remediation action. Null if the event remains unresolved. Used to measure time-to-resolution and grace period utilization.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: representment_count
attributes.description: Number of times the original ACH/EFT payment has been re-presented to the bank following the initial NSF return. NACHA rules limit re-presentments to two attempts after the original return. Supports NACHA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules (re-presentment limits); Federal Reserve Regulation E; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: representment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent ACH re-presentment was submitted to the bank. Null if no re-presentment has been attempted. Used to track NACHA re-presentment timing compliance.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: representment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the ACH re-presentment attempt for this NSF event. Tracks whether re-presentment succeeded, was returned again, or has reached the NACHA-mandated re-presentment limit.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational billing system that originated this NSF event record (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, MAJESCO_BILLING). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and multi-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the situs state of the policy at the time of the NSF event. Determines which state's NSF notification requirements, grace period mandates, and fee regulations apply.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the NSF event record, reflecting status changes, remediation actions, re-presentment attempts, or notification updates. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Regulation; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

products.name: eft_authorization
products.description: Master record of a policyholder's or group payer's electronic payment authorization for automatic recurring premium collection via EFT/ACH or direct debit. Captures bank routing number, masked account number, account type (checking/savings), authorization date, authorization method (wet signature, e-sign, voice), effective date, cancellation date, pre-notification status, instruction reference number, originating bank details, collection day, first/last collection dates, instruction status (active, suspended, cancelled), and failure handling rules. SSOT for all electronic payment mandates — both ACH debits and direct debit instructions — supporting personal and corporate payer arrangements. Governed by NACHA operating rules and applicable direct debit scheme rules.

attributes.name: eft_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the EFT/ACH authorization record. Primary key for the eft_authorization data product in the billing domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: EFT authorizations are set up for billing accounts to enable automatic premium collection. This FK links the authorization to the billing_account it serves. While eft_authorization already links to po

attributes.name: authorization_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: EFT authorizations require signed bank authorization forms, ACH mandate documents for regulatory compliance and audit. Real business process: payment processing compliance, NACHA requirements, audit t

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy for which this EFT authorization governs recurring premium collection.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (policyholder, group sponsor, or third-party payer) who owns the bank account and has authorized the EFT debit.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: account_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the full bank account number stored in a PCI-compliant vault. Used by the ACH origination system to retrieve the actual account number at transaction time without storing it in the billing database.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; NACHA Operating Rules; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account from which premiums will be debited. Determines the SEC code and NACHA transaction class used in ACH file generation.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: apl_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policyholder has authorized the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) feature as a fallback when EFT collection fails and the policy has sufficient cash value. When True, the billing system may trigger an APL to prevent lapse.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: authorization_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the payer submitted the EFT authorization. Agent = through licensed agent; Online portal = self-service web/mobile; Call center = telephone; Mail = paper form mailed in; Branch = in-person at office.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; E-SIGN Act; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the payer signed or electronically consented to the EFT debit authorization. This is the legal consent date required by NACHA and Regulation E for audit purposes.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.3; Federal Reserve Regulation E (12 CFR Part 205)

attributes.name: authorization_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payer granted authorization for EFT debits. Wet signature = paper form; E-sign = electronic signature; Voice = recorded verbal authorization; Online portal = self-service digital consent. Required by NACHA for audit trail.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.3; E-SIGN Act (15 U.S.C. § 7001)

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the EFT authorization instruction. Active = currently collecting; Suspended = temporarily halted; Cancelled = permanently terminated; Pending = awaiting pre-notification confirmation; Expired = past end date.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the financial institution holding the payer's account. Used to route ACH transactions through the Federal Reserve or EPN network.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premiums are collected via this EFT authorization. Aligns with the policy's modal billing election (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual). Determines the ACH debit schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EFT authorization was cancelled or revoked by the payer or insurer. Null if the authorization is still active. After this date no further ACH debits may be initiated under this mandate.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.3; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: collection_amount
attributes.description: Authorized recurring debit amount in USD to be collected per billing cycle. Represents the modal premium amount including base policy premium, rider premiums, and any applicable fees authorized under this mandate.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: collection_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–28) on which recurring ACH premium debits are scheduled. Capped at 28 to avoid month-end variability. Drives the billing system's ACH file generation schedule.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: consecutive_failure_count
attributes.description: Running count of consecutive failed ACH debit attempts under this authorization. Used to trigger suspension, lapse initiation, or APL activation per the failure_handling_rule. Reset to zero upon a successful collection.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EFT authorization record was first created in the billing system. Supports audit trail requirements under NACHA, Regulation E, and SOX.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; SOX Section 404; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the collection amount. Typically USD for domestic US life insurance policies. Supports multi-currency arrangements for international policyholders.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: debit_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization covers recurring periodic debits (standard modal premium collection) or a one-time debit (e.g., reinstatement payment, back-premium catch-up).

attributes.name: direct_debit_scheme
attributes.description: Payment scheme under which this authorization operates. ACH = US Automated Clearing House (NACHA); SEPA_DD = Single Euro Payments Area Direct Debit; BACS = UK Bankers Automated Clearing Services; PAD = Canadian Pre-Authorized Debit. Determines applicable scheme rules.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; SEPA Direct Debit Rulebook; BACS Rules; Payments Canada PAD Rules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this EFT authorization becomes operative and the billing system may initiate ACH debits. May differ from authorization_date if a future start was requested.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: failure_handling_rule
attributes.description: Business rule governing how the billing system responds to a returned/failed ACH debit (NSF or other return). Retry_once/twice = re-present per NACHA rules; Suspend = suspend authorization; Lapse = initiate policy lapse process; APL_trigger = activate Automatic Premium Loan (APL) rider.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.12; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: first_collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first ACH debit was or is scheduled to be collected under this authorization. Used to confirm pre-notification lead time compliance and to anchor the recurring schedule.

attributes.name: instruction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this EFT/ACH debit instruction by the billing system or originating bank. Used for reconciliation with NACHA files and bank statements.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.7; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer's identity and bank account ownership have been verified per KYC/AML requirements prior to activating this EFT authorization. Required by FinCEN BSA/AML program rules.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC AML Model Regulation; Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. § 5318)

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which KYC verification of the payer was completed and recorded. Used for AML compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC AML Model Regulation; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: last_collection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful ACH debit collected under this authorization. Updated after each successful collection cycle. Null if no collection has yet occurred.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: last_failure_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent failed ACH debit return under this authorization. Used alongside last_failure_return_code for NSF tracking, grace period management, and lapse administration.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: last_failure_return_code
attributes.description: Most recent NACHA ACH return code received for a failed debit under this authorization (e.g., R01 = Insufficient Funds, R02 = Account Closed, R03 = No Account, R04 = Invalid Account Number, R07 = Authorization Revoked). Null if no failure has occurred.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Appendix Four; Federal Reserve ACH Return Codes

attributes.name: mandate_reference
attributes.description: Scheme-specific mandate reference number assigned to this authorization. For SEPA Direct Debit, this is the Unique Mandate Reference (UMR). For BACS, this is the Service User Number reference. For ACH, this maps to the instruction_reference_number.
attributes.references: SEPA Direct Debit Rulebook; BACS Rules; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: masked_account_number
attributes.description: Masked representation of the payer's bank account number (e.g., last 4 digits visible, remainder replaced with asterisks). Full account number is stored in a tokenized vault; this field supports display and reconciliation without exposing PCI data.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; NIST SP 800-122

attributes.name: max_debit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum single-transaction debit amount authorized by the payer. Applicable when variable_amount_flag is True. Provides a ceiling for flexible premium collections to protect the payer from unauthorized over-debits.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.3.2; Federal Reserve Regulation E; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: max_retry_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a failed ACH debit may be re-presented before the failure_handling_rule escalation is triggered. NACHA limits re-presentment to no more than 2 additional attempts after the original return.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.12.4; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: originating_bank_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Originating Depository Financial Institution (ODFI) as registered with the Federal Reserve or EPN. Used in NACHA file headers for ACH batch origination.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.2; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: originating_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (Originating Depository Financial Institution — ODFI) that holds the payer's account and through which ACH debits are originated.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.2; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: payer_name_on_account
attributes.description: Full legal name of the account holder as it appears on the bank account. Required for NACHA individual name field in ACH transactions and for AML/KYC verification.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC KYC Guidelines

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer entity authorizing the EFT debit. Individual = personal policyholder; Corporate = business entity paying group premiums; Trust = ILIT or other trust arrangement; Group sponsor = employer or association paying group life premiums.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: prenote_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the NACHA pre-notification (zero-dollar test) was transmitted to the ODFI. The first live debit may not occur until at least 3 banking days after this date per NACHA rules.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.7; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: prenote_status
attributes.description: Status of the NACHA pre-notification (zero-dollar test transaction) sent to the ODFI before the first live debit. Pending = prenote initiated; Sent = prenote transmitted; Confirmed = no return received within 3 banking days; Failed = prenote returned with error.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Section 2.7; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: sec_code
attributes.description: NACHA Standard Entry Class code identifying the type of ACH transaction. PPD = Prearranged Payment and Deposit (personal); CCD = Corporate Credit or Debit; WEB = Internet-initiated; TEL = Telephone-initiated. Determines NACHA file formatting and return code rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PPD|CCD|WEB|TEL|ARC|BOC|POP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules Appendix Two; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational billing system from which this EFT authorization record was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, MAJESCO_BILLING). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this EFT authorization record. Tracks changes to authorization status, bank details, or collection parameters for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; SOX Section 404; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: variable_amount_flag

Specific to traditional whole life (WL) and universal life (UL) products with CSV. Source: Policy Administration System APL module.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
