attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Premium adjustments require supervisory approval for financial controls. Tracking the approving employee is a standard SOX control in insurance billing systems, supporting audit trails and segregation

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy whose billing schedule is being adjusted. Links the adjustment to the master policy record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Policy Administration Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Premium adjustments from rate changes, rider additions, or corrections require correcting journal entries. Essential for revenue accuracy, SOX controls, and audit trail. Links billing changes to finan

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Premium adjustments must comply with product plan rules (COLA provisions, face amount change limits, rate adjustment triggers). Required for billing accuracy validation, regulatory compliance audits,

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific premium bill record on which this adjustment is applied, linking the adjustment to the billing cycle in which it takes effect.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; Sapiens BillingPro Premium Adjustment Module

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Premium adjustments modify premium schedules (rate changes, face amount changes, rider additions/removals, COLA adjustments). This FK links the adjustment transaction to the premium schedule being mod

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Premium adjustments impact commission calculations and require producer notification for servicing. Tracking the servicing producer enables proper commission adjustments, chargebacks, and producer com

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_filing. Business justification: Premium adjustments implementing approved rate changes must reference the DOI-approved rate filing. Required for rate compliance verification, audit trail, and ensuring adjustments match approved rate

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Premium adjustments (rate changes, corrections, COLA increases) must be allocated to the correct reporting period for accurate revenue recognition, premium income reporting, and GAAP/statutory reconci

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_premium_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original premium_adjustment_id that this record reverses, when reversal_indicator is True. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal adjustment records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary change in modal premium resulting from this adjustment (new_modal_premium minus prior_modal_premium). A positive value indicates a premium increase; a negative value indicates a decrease. Used for financial reporting and actuarial analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this premium adjustment transaction, assigned by the Policy Administration System or Billing System (e.g., ADJ-2024-00123456). Used for audit trail, correspondence, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the premium adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANNIV_RATE_CHG|ATTAINED_AGE|RIDER_ADD|RIDER_REMOVE|FACE_AMT_CHG|RISK_RECLASS|COLA|REG_RATE_REV|UW_REVISION|BILLING_CORR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the reason for the premium adjustment, providing additional context beyond the standardized reason code. May include details such as the specific rider added, the new risk class assigned, or the regulatory revision reference.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the premium adjustment record. 'pending' indicates awaiting approval; 'approved' indicates authorized but not yet applied to billing; 'applied' indicates posted to the billing schedule; 'reversed' indicates a previously applied adjustment that has been backed out; 'rejected' indicates the adjustment was denied.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro Adjustment Workflow

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the direction and nature of the premium adjustment. 'increase' indicates the new premium is higher than the prior; 'decrease' indicates the new premium is lower; 'correction' indicates a billing error fix with no net change in intended premium; 'reversal' indicates the cancellation of a previously applied adjustment.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium adjustment required and received formal authorization. 'not_required' for system-generated adjustments within automated rules; 'pending' for adjustments awaiting human review; 'approved' for authorized adjustments; 'rejected' for denied adjustments. Supports SOX and market conduct compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this premium adjustment was formally approved by the authorizing user or automated system. Null when approval_status is 'not_required' or 'pending'. Supports SOX audit trail and turnaround time reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the individual or automated process that approved this premium adjustment. Null when approval_status is 'not_required'. Required for SOX audit trail on manual or exception adjustments.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: The insured's attained age (in whole years) at the time of this premium adjustment. Relevant for attained-age recalculation adjustments on Yearly Renewable Term (YRT), Universal Life (UL), and Indexed Universal Life (IUL) products where COI rates are age-banded.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency of the policy at the time of this adjustment (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly). Determines the modal factor applied to convert annual premium to the scheduled payment amount.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: cola_rate
attributes.description: The Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) percentage rate applied to the premium when the adjustment_reason_code is COLA. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 for 3%). Null for non-COLA adjustments.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Consumer Price Index (CPI) Standards

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Identifies the specific premium component affected by this adjustment: 'base' for the base policy premium, 'rider' for a policy rider premium, 'coi' for Cost of Insurance (COI) charges on universal life products, or 'apl' for Automatic Premium Loan (APL) repayment component.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this premium adjustment record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency policy administration for international or expatriate life insurance products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life Data Model

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the premium adjustment becomes effective on the policy billing schedule. This is the business event date — the date from which the new premium amount applies, which may differ from the transaction processing date.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Policy Administration Standards

attributes.name: mec_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium adjustment triggered a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) test review under IRC Section 7702A. True when the adjustment requires validation that the new premium level does not cause the policy to fail the 7-pay test and become classified as a MEC.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRS MEC Compliance Standards

attributes.name: new_annual_premium
attributes.description: The annualized premium amount (Annual Premium Equivalent) that will apply after this adjustment, calculated by annualizing the new modal premium based on the billing mode. Supports APE reporting, actuarial reserving, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: new_face_amount
attributes.description: The policy face amount (death benefit) that applies after this adjustment. Captured when the adjustment is triggered by a face amount change. Used to verify 7702 compliance and recalculate guideline premium limits.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702 GPT/CVAT; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: new_modal_premium
attributes.description: The modal premium amount (per billing frequency) that will apply to the policy billing schedule after this adjustment is applied. This becomes the new scheduled premium for future billing cycles.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: new_risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured after this adjustment (e.g., Preferred Plus, Preferred, Standard, Substandard, Table-rated). Captured when adjustment_reason_code indicates a risk class reclassification event.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Underwriting Standards; MIB Group Data Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, exception handling comments, or supplementary context recorded by the billing operations team regarding this premium adjustment. Not used for structured data; intended for human-readable commentary.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1-based count from policy issue date) in which this premium adjustment is effective. Used for anniversary-based rate change processing, attained age recalculations, and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: prior_annual_premium
attributes.description: The annualized premium amount (Annual Premium Equivalent) in effect before this adjustment, calculated by annualizing the prior modal premium based on the billing mode. Supports APE reporting and actuarial valuation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: prior_face_amount
attributes.description: The policy face amount (death benefit) in effect before this adjustment. Captured when the adjustment is triggered by a face amount change, as face amount directly drives base premium calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702 GPT/CVAT; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_modal_premium
attributes.description: The modal premium amount (per billing frequency) in effect on the policy billing schedule immediately before this adjustment was applied. Provides the baseline for calculating the adjustment delta and supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: prior_risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured before this adjustment (e.g., Preferred Plus, Preferred, Standard, Substandard, Table-rated). Captured when adjustment_reason_code indicates a risk class reclassification event.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Underwriting Standards; MIB Group Data Standards

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the premium adjustment was fully processed and posted to the billing schedule in the Policy Administration or Billing System. Supports audit trail and SLA monitoring for billing operations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Sapiens BillingPro Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The internal product code identifying the life insurance or annuity product type associated with the policy (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, SPIA, FIA). Supports product-level premium adjustment analytics and actuarial segmentation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Product Filing Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_revision_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the regulatory filing, state department of insurance bulletin, or NAIC model regulation revision that mandated this premium rate adjustment. Populated when adjustment_reason_code is REG_RATE_REV. Supports regulatory compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance Rate Filing Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment record is a reversal of a previously applied adjustment. True when this record cancels and backs out a prior adjustment; False for original adjustments. Used in financial reconciliation to net out reversed transactions.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the specific policy rider whose premium is being adjusted, when the component_type is 'rider'. Examples include ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), AWL (Automatic Waiver of Premium), LTC (Long-Term Care), or DI (Disability Income) riders. Null when adjustment applies to base premium or COI.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: seven_pay_premium
attributes.description: The maximum annual premium allowed under the IRC Section 7702A seven-pay test at the time of this adjustment. Captured when mec_test_flag is True to document the compliance threshold against which the new premium was evaluated.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; IRS MEC Compliance Standards; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this premium adjustment transaction. 'PAS' = Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST); 'BILLING' = Billing and Premium Collection System (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro); 'UW_WORKBENCH' = Underwriting Workbench; 'ACTUARIAL' = Actuarial Valuation System; 'MANUAL' = manual override by authorized user.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The transaction identifier from the originating source system (Policy Administration System or Billing System) that authorized and triggered this premium adjustment. Provides end-to-end traceability from the billing data product back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code of the state in which the policy was issued. Determines the applicable state insurance regulations, rate filing requirements, and consumer protection rules governing this premium adjustment.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the premium adjustment transaction was created and recorded in the source system. Represents the system-of-record capture time, distinct from the business effective date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: billing_dispute
products.description: Transactional record of a policyholder or group administrator dispute raised against a premium bill or payment transaction. Captures dispute date, disputed bill or payment reference, dispute reason (incorrect amount, duplicate charge, coverage dispute, rate error), dispute status (open, under review, resolved, escalated), resolution date, resolution description, and adjusted amount. Supports customer service and regulatory complaint tracking.

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each billing dispute record in the Life Insurance billing domain. Primary key for the billing_dispute data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Data Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Billing disputes are raised by billing account holders regarding bills issued to their account. This FK links the dispute to the billing_account context. While billing_dispute already links to policy

attributes.name: billing_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer service representative or billing specialist assigned to investigate and resolve this billing dispute. Supports workload management and performance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; CRM Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: billing_escalated_to_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor, compliance officer, or senior representative to whom the dispute was escalated when the dispute_status is 'escalated'. Null when no escalation has occurred.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.complaint. Business justification: Billing disputes frequently escalate to formal complaints tracked by correspondence for regulatory reporting. Insurance operations need to link disputes to complaints to manage escalation workflows, t

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Billing disputes reference supporting documentation: complaint letters, payment evidence, correspondence. Real business process: complaint resolution workflow, regulatory reporting to state DOI, litig

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Disputes often arise during grace periods when policyholders contest bills or payment demands. Linking disputes to grace periods enables tracking of disputes that may trigger grace period holds or ext

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy against which the billing dispute has been raised. Links the dispute to the underlying policy contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Dispute resolutions requiring credits or adjustments generate journal entries for revenue corrections and receivable adjustments. Required for financial accuracy, customer service reconciliation, and

attributes.name: lapse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.lapse_event. Business justification: Disputes can be raised about lapse decisions, especially when policyholders contest the lapse or claim payments were made. The lapse_risk_indicator attribute on billing_dispute suggests this relations

attributes.name: market_conduct_exam_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.market_conduct_exam. Business justification: Market conduct examiners routinely sample billing disputes to assess complaint handling, timeliness, and consumer treatment. Disputes identified during exams must be tracked back to the exam for remed

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder or group administrator who initiated the billing dispute. Supports customer service tracking and regulatory complaint management.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Dispute resolution requires reference to product plan terms (billing rules, grace periods, fee structures). Needed for customer service support, product-level dispute rate analysis, product design fee

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific premium bill record that is the subject of this dispute. Enables direct linkage to the billing.premium_bill product for context and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Billing disputes frequently require producer intervention for resolution. Tracking the servicing producer enables proper escalation workflows, commission hold processes during dispute resolution, and

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Disputes impact revenue recognition timing, reserve adequacy assessments, and operational metrics (dispute resolution rates) reported by period. Material for management reporting, SOX controls, and re

attributes.name: adjusted_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount approved for adjustment or credit as a result of the dispute resolution. May be zero if the dispute is denied, or equal to the disputed amount if fully upheld. Supports premium reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: ape_impact_amount
attributes.description: The Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) value of the disputed premium amount, calculated as the annualized equivalent of the disputed modal premium. Used for financial reporting and new business value impact assessment when disputes affect APE metrics.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17; NAIC Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency of the disputed premium bill (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly). Provides context for the disputed amount and supports premium schedule reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the policyholder or group administrator submitted the billing dispute (e.g., phone, mail, email, self-service portal, agent, fax). Supports customer experience analytics and channel optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; CRM Platform (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing dispute record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_issued_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a premium credit or refund was issued to the policyholder as part of the dispute resolution. True when a credit or refund has been processed.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: credit_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the premium credit or refund transaction issued to the policyholder following dispute resolution. Null when credit_issued_indicator is False. Enables reconciliation with the billing and payment ledger.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this dispute record (e.g., USD). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the policyholder or group administrator formally raised the billing dispute. This is the principal real-world event date used for SLA measurement and regulatory complaint aging.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the billing dispute at intake. Used in all customer correspondence, regulatory filings, and complaint tracking. Format: DSP-YYYY-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the billing dispute. Drives customer service SLA tracking and regulatory complaint reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_review|resolved|escalated|withdrawn|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the billing dispute by the type of charge or transaction being contested: premium bill, payment transaction, NSF (Non-Sufficient Funds) fee, APL (Automatic Premium Loan) charge, rider premium charge, or COI (Cost of Insurance) charge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium_bill|payment_transaction|nsf_fee|apl_charge|rider_charge|coi_charge — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount the policyholder is disputing on the referenced premium bill or payment transaction. Represents the full amount in question before any investigation or adjustment.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: disputed_bill_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by the disputed premium bill. Used alongside the start date to precisely identify the billing cycle under dispute.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: disputed_bill_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by the disputed premium bill. Provides temporal context for the dispute and supports premium schedule reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing dispute was escalated to a higher authority or regulatory body. Null if the dispute has not been escalated. Used for regulatory complaint aging and SLA breach tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the billing dispute was escalated, such as unresolved within SLA, regulatory complaint filed, or policyholder legal threat. Null if not escalated.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: grace_period_hold_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the grace period lapse clock has been placed on hold pending resolution of this billing dispute. True when lapse processing has been suspended to protect the policyholder during dispute investigation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance; Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro)

attributes.name: group_bill_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the disputed bill is a group or list bill, meaning the dispute was raised by a group administrator on behalf of multiple certificate holders rather than an individual policyholder.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Group Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: lapse_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the unresolved billing dispute poses a risk of policy lapse due to non-payment of the disputed premium. True when the disputed amount represents the outstanding balance that could trigger lapse administration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro); Billing and Premium Collection System

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary amount owed to or from the policyholder after dispute resolution, reflecting the difference between the disputed amount and any approved adjustment. Used for premium ledger reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes field for additional context, internal comments, or supplementary information recorded by customer service or compliance staff during the lifecycle of the billing dispute. Not intended for structured data.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the specific payment transaction (e.g., EFT/ACH trace number, check number, or payment confirmation ID) that is the subject of the dispute, when the dispute relates to a payment rather than a bill. Sourced from the Billing and Premium Collection System.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to the billing dispute for resolution workflow routing. Critical disputes may involve regulatory complaint escalation, lapse risk, or large-dollar amounts requiring expedited handling.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the primary reason the policyholder raised the billing dispute. Drives routing, resolution workflow, and regulatory complaint categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: incorrect_amount|duplicate_charge|coverage_dispute|rate_error|payment_not_applied|unauthorized_charge — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the policyholder or customer service representative describing the specific reason for the billing dispute. Supplements the structured reason code with contextual detail.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the billing dispute was received and logged in the billing system. Used for SLA clock start and audit trail purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: regulatory_complaint_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this billing dispute has been formally filed as a regulatory complaint with a State Department of Insurance or other governing body. True when a regulatory complaint has been lodged.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_complaint_ref
attributes.description: The reference or tracking number assigned by the State Department of Insurance or other regulatory body when a formal complaint has been filed. Null when regulatory_complaint_indicator is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized outcome code indicating how the billing dispute was resolved: upheld (policyholder correct), partially upheld, denied (insurer correct), withdrawn by policyholder, or settled by mutual agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing dispute was formally resolved and closed. Null for open or in-progress disputes. Used to calculate resolution cycle time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explaining the outcome of the billing dispute investigation, including findings, corrective actions taken, and any premium adjustments or credits applied. Required for regulatory complaint documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Department of Insurance Complaint Reporting

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the billing dispute must be resolved per applicable state insurance regulations and internal SLA commitments. Calculated from dispute_date plus the state-mandated or contractual response window.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Complaint Handling Regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this billing dispute record was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, MAJESCO_BILLING, FAST, MANUAL for manually entered records). Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_dispute_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this billing dispute record in the originating operational system (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro or Majesco Billing). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the data lakehouse and the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state in which the underlying policy was issued. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, complaint handling requirements, and response time mandates.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this billing dispute record. Tracks the last state change for audit and SLA monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: refund_transaction
products.description: Master reference table for refund_transaction. Referenced by refund_transaction_id.

attributes.name: refund_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for refund_transaction

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Refunds are processed through billing accounts and affect account balances. Missing FK to account prevents account-level refund tracking and reconciliation. This is essential for account balance integ

attributes.name: billing_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_premium_payment. Business justification: Refunds are issued against specific premium payments. The existing premium_transaction_id is a generic reference; replacing it with a typed FK to billing_premium_payment provides proper lineage tracki

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who approved the refund transaction.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy for which this refund is being processed.

attributes.name: processed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who processed the refund payment.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this refund transaction is assigned for financial reporting and general ledger posting.

attributes.name: base_premium_refund_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount attributable to base policy premium.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number assigned to the refund payment when refund method is check.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this refund transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: fee_refund_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount attributable to policy fees or administrative charges.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the refund transaction is posted for financial accounting.

attributes.name: payee_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number or payment account identifier for electronic refund disbursement. Encrypted at rest.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity receiving the refund payment.

attributes.name: payee_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number (ABA number) for ACH or wire transfer refunds in the United States.

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party receiving the refund: policyholder (policy owner), beneficiary (designated beneficiary), assignee (party with assignment rights), estate (deceased policyholder estate), or third party (other authorized recipient).

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount being refunded to the policyholder or beneficiary, in the policy currency.

attributes.name: refund_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was approved by authorized personnel or automated approval workflow.

attributes.name: refund_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was successfully completed and funds were disbursed to the payee.

attributes.name: refund_effective_date
attributes.description: Business effective date for the refund transaction, used for accounting period assignment and financial reporting.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument or mechanism used to issue the refund: check (paper check), ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, credit card reversal, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer), direct deposit, or policy loan credit (applied to outstanding policy loan).

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the refund transaction, used in customer communications and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: refund_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund payment was processed and submitted to the payment system or treasury.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the detailed reason for the refund, used for regulatory reporting and operational analytics.

attributes.name: refund_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context and details about why the refund was issued.

attributes.name: refund_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was initially requested or identified by the system or customer service representative.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized for processing), processing (payment in progress), completed (refund successfully issued), cancelled (refund request cancelled), failed (payment failed), or reversed (refund was reversed).

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund based on the business reason: overpayment (customer paid more than required), cancellation (policy cancelled within free-look period), lapse (refund of unearned premium after lapse), surrender (cash value refund), death claim (premium refund post-death), policy adjustment (billing correction), or reinstatement reversal (reversal of reinstatement premium).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund transaction was reversed, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this refund transaction has been reversed (True) or is active (False).

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the refund transaction was reversed.

attributes.name: rider_premium_refund_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount attributable to rider premiums.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system or application that originated this refund transaction record.

attributes.name: tax_refund_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount attributable to premium taxes or other tax components.

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment processor or bank transaction reference number for tracking and reconciliation of electronic refunds.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this refund transaction record was last modified.

attributes.name: reversal_refund_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on refund_transaction (reversal_refund_transaction_id)

products.name: transaction
products.description: Master reference table for transaction. Referenced by transaction_id.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for transaction

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Indicates how the transaction amount is allocated across policy components such as base coverage, riders, and cost of insurance.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code received from the payment gateway or card issuer approving the transaction.

attributes.name: automatic_premium_loan_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction was funded through an automatic premium loan against the policy cash value.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the payment batch in which this transaction was processed, used for reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period to which this transaction applies.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period to which this transaction applies.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: External confirmation or reference number provided by the payment processor or financial institution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the transaction was denominated.

attributes.name: customer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the party to this transaction.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or details about the transaction.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for this transaction is expected or required.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied if the transaction involved currency conversion.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Any processing fees, service charges, or administrative fees associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The final date of the grace period during which payment can be made without policy lapse.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final transaction amount after applying all fees, taxes, and adjustments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes or comments recorded by agents or system administrators regarding the transaction.

attributes.name: nsf_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction failed due to non-sufficient funds in the payment account.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The interface or touchpoint through which the transaction was initiated.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency indicating how often premiums are paid for the associated policy.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the transaction.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this transaction.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the transaction was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: processed_by_user_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or agent who processed or approved the transaction.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction was reconciled with external financial records.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction has been reconciled with bank statements and financial records.

attributes.name: reinstatement_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction is part of a policy reinstatement process following a lapse.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction is a reversal of a previous transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original transaction that this transaction reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount applied to the transaction, including premium tax and other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the transaction before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: transaction_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of transaction types for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the transaction occurred or was effective.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique transaction number used for customer communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transaction indicating its processing status.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the transaction was executed or recorded in the system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction indicating its business purpose within the billing domain.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the transaction record was last modified.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date from which the transaction amount becomes effective for interest calculation or valuation purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on transaction (reversal_transaction_id)

domains.name: annuity
domains.description: Dedicated operational domain for annuity contract administration distinct from life policy processing. Owns AV (Account Value), accumulation phase tracking, payout phase calculations, GMWB/GMIB/GMAB benefit base management, RMD tracking, 1035 exchange processing, withdrawal processing (systematic and ad-hoc), annuitization, and FIA index crediting. Manages annuity-specific compliance including tax reporting under IRC Section 72.

products.name: annuity_contract
products.description: Master record for each annuity contract issued by the company, serving as the SSOT for all annuity contract administration. Captures contract type (Fixed, Fixed Indexed, Variable, SPIA, MYGA), issue date, contract status, annuitant identity, owner identity, contract phase (accumulation vs payout), surrender charge schedule (declining charge percentages by contract year, free withdrawal allowance, MVA applicability, and waiver conditions for nursing home, terminal illness, unemployment, disability), market value adjustment (MVA) flag, tax qualification status (qualified IRA, Roth IRA, 403b, 457, non-qualified), IRC Section 72 tax treatment, 1035 exchange indicator, ownership type (individual, joint, trust, entity), and contract currency. Serves as the parent entity for all annuity domain transactions and valuations.
products.reference: ACORD Life and Annuity Contract Record

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: dac_asset_id

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Fixed and indexed annuity general account liabilities are backed by investment portfolios. ALM analysis, reserve adequacy testing, RBC C3 interest rate risk calculations, and ORSA stress testing requi

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ifrs17_contract_group. Required for companies reporting under I

Links contract state_of_issue to jurisdiction license for validation at issue and ongoing compliance monitoring. Prevents una

attributes.name: owner_party_id

Maps to the owner record in the CRM or policyholder master.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity product definition record in the product master, identifying the specific product series, plan code, and feature set (e.g., crediting strategy options, rider availability, surrender charge schedule template) associated with this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Product Filing Requirements

attributes.name: plan_version_id

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id

Links contract to approved form filing for state_of_issue validation. Essential for market conduct exam defense and form usage audits. Prevents

attributes.name: primary_annuity_annuitant_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record representing the annuitant — the individual whose life expectancy governs the payout calculations and upon whose death the death benefit or survivor benefit is triggered. May differ from the contract owner in trust-owned or entity-owned contracts.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or producer record in the Agent and Commission Management System who sold and submitted this annuity contract. Used for commission calculation, suitability review attribution, and distribution analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation #275

attributes.name: servicing_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks current servicing representative for workload management, service quality metrics, compliance audit trails, and customer service escalations. Essential for operational reporting and performance

attributes.name: servicing_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Tracks organizational unit servicing the contract for workload allocation, regional performance reporting, capacity planning, and organizational cost allocation. Essential for operational management a

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Each annuity contract contributes to statutory reserve calculations (CARVM/CRVM) for state regulatory filings, RBC calculations, and NAIC Annual Statement preparation. Required for regulatory capital

attributes.name: surrender_charge_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surrender charge schedule definition record that governs this contract's declining surrender charge percentages by contract year, free withdrawal allowance percentage, MVA applicability, and waiver conditions (nursing home, terminal illness, unemployment, disability). Determined at issuance based on product and state.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: tpa_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Many annuity carriers outsource contract administration to third-party administrators (TPAs). Tracking which vendor administers each contract is essential for service routing, claims processing, custo

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Annuity contracts often originate from underwriting applications (deferred annuities sold with life insurance, standalone annuity applications requiring underwriting for large cases or impaired risk a

attributes.name: account_value
attributes.description: Current Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of the last valuation date — the total accumulated value including all premiums paid, interest/index credits earned, and minus all withdrawals, fees, and charges. The AV is the primary valuation metric for deferred annuity contracts and drives CSV, death benefit, and GMWB benefit base calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: account_value_date
attributes.description: The valuation date as of which the account_value field was last calculated and recorded. Essential for point-in-time reporting, actuarial reserving, and reconciliation with the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., AXIS, Prophet).
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: aml_review_status
attributes.description: The Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review status for this annuity contract under BSA/AML compliance requirements. CLEARED = passed AML screening; PENDING = review in progress; FLAGGED = suspicious activity identified; ESCALATED = referred to compliance or FinCEN. Required for FinCEN BSA compliance and NAIC AML Model Regulation.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Requirements; NAIC AML Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: annuitization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract transitioned from the accumulation phase to the payout (annuitization) phase. Null for contracts still in accumulation. Populated when contract_status = ANNUITIZED. Drives payout benefit calculations and IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio computations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract number assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity) at issuance. Used in all owner correspondence, statements, and regulatory filings. Maps to the contract_id field in the source system.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the annuity contract as maintained in the Annuity Administration Platform. ACTIVE = in-force accumulation or payout; SURRENDERED = full surrender processed; ANNUITIZED = converted to payout phase; LAPSED = terminated for non-payment; PENDING = application received, not yet issued; DEATH_CLAIM = death benefit claim in progress.
attributes.references: NAIC Life & Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the annuity product type: FIXED (traditional fixed annuity), FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity), VARIABLE (Variable Annuity / VUL-linked), SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity), or MYGA (Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity). Drives product-specific processing rules, crediting methods, and regulatory treatment.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation #275; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: The owner's investment in the contract (cost basis) for IRC Section 72 tax purposes — the total after-tax premiums paid minus any previously recovered basis through tax-free distributions. Used to calculate the taxable portion of withdrawals and the exclusion ratio upon annuitization. Carried forward from prior contract in 1035 exchanges.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this annuity contract record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the data ingestion audit trail timestamp, not the contract issue date. Required for SOX audit trail and data lineage compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: csv_amount
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) — the net amount the contract owner would receive upon full surrender, calculated as the Account Value minus applicable surrender charges and market value adjustment (MVA). Represents the owner's actual liquidity value at any point in time.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the annuity contract is denominated (e.g., USD). All monetary values on this contract record are expressed in this currency. Supports multi-currency operations for international annuity products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: current_surrender_charge_pct
attributes.description: The surrender charge percentage currently applicable to this contract based on the current contract year within the surrender charge schedule (e.g., 0.0700 = 7%). Updated annually on the contract anniversary. Used to calculate CSV and net surrender proceeds.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: exchange_prior_contract_number
attributes.description: The contract or policy number of the prior insurance or annuity contract that was exchanged into this contract via a 1035 Exchange. Populated only when is_1035_exchange = True. Required for IRS cost basis continuity and tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: fia_cap_rate
attributes.description: For FIA contracts, the maximum index-linked interest rate that can be credited in a given crediting period, regardless of actual index performance (e.g., 0.0600 = 6% cap). Null for non-FIA contracts or strategies without a cap (e.g., spread-based strategies).
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: fia_index_strategy
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) Index Crediting Strategy
attributes.description: For FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity) contracts, the selected index crediting strategy (e.g., S&P 500 Annual Point-to-Point with Cap, S&P 500 Monthly Sum with Cap, Bloomberg US Dynamic Balance Index). Determines how index-linked interest credits are calculated. Null for non-FIA contract types. May reference a crediting strategy code from the product definition.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: fia_participation_rate
attributes.description: For FIA contracts, the participation rate applied to the index gain when calculating index credits (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% of index gain credited). May be subject to a cap rate. Null for non-FIA contracts. Renewed annually or at the strategy term end.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: free_look_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the owner's free-look (right to return) period expires. During the free-look period, the owner may cancel the contract and receive a full refund of premiums paid. Typically 10–30 days from contract delivery, as mandated by state insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the account value (or premium) that the owner may withdraw each contract year without incurring surrender charges, as defined in the contract (e.g., 0.1000 = 10% free withdrawal allowance). Unused free withdrawal amounts typically do not carry forward.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: initial_premium_amount
attributes.description: The first premium payment received at contract issuance, in contract currency. For single-premium products (SPIA, MYGA), this is the total purchase payment. For flexible-premium products, this is the first deposit. Used as the baseline for surrender charge calculations and cost basis tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this annuity contract was funded via a 1035 Exchange (tax-free exchange of an existing life insurance policy, endowment, or annuity contract under IRC Section 1035). True = funded by 1035 exchange; False = direct premium payment. Affects cost basis tracking and tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Form 1099-R; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_mva_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Market Value Adjustment (MVA) applies to surrenders or withdrawals in excess of the free withdrawal allowance during the surrender charge period. True = MVA applies (adjusts surrender proceeds up or down based on interest rate movements); False = no MVA. Relevant primarily for MYGA and fixed annuity products.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annuity contract was formally issued and became effective. Serves as the anchor date for surrender charge schedule calculations, free-look period, and contract year determinations. Corresponds to the policy_effective_date in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annuity contract reaches its scheduled maturity, typically triggering mandatory annuitization or lump-sum distribution. Relevant for MYGA and deferred annuity products. Null for SPIA contracts which begin payout immediately.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the legal ownership structure of the annuity contract: INDIVIDUAL (single natural person), JOINT (two natural persons, typically spouses), TRUST (e.g., ILIT — Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust), or ENTITY (corporation, partnership, or other non-natural person). Affects tax treatment, RMD rules, and death benefit distribution.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: payout_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which annuity income payments are made to the annuitant or payee during the payout phase (MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMI_ANNUAL, ANNUAL). Null for contracts in accumulation phase or with LUMP_SUM payout option.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: payout_option
attributes.description: The elected payout option governing how annuity income is distributed during the payout phase: LIFE_ONLY (payments for annuitant's lifetime), LIFE_PERIOD_CERTAIN (lifetime with guaranteed minimum period), JOINT_SURVIVOR (payments continue to survivor), PERIOD_CERTAIN (fixed period regardless of survival), LUMP_SUM (single payment). Null for contracts still in accumulation phase.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is currently in the ACCUMULATION phase (premiums growing tax-deferred) or the PAYOUT phase (periodic income distributions being made to the annuitant). Drives which processing modules are active in the Annuity Administration Platform.

attributes.name: rmd_amount_current_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Amount — Current Year
attributes.description: The calculated Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) amount that must be distributed from this contract in the current calendar year, based on the prior year-end account value and the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table. Null if rmd_required = False. Tracked by the RMD module of the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: rmd_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is subject to IRS Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) rules. True = qualified contract (IRA, 403b, etc.) where the owner has reached RMD age and annual distributions are mandated; False = not subject to RMD (non-qualified or owner below RMD age). Drives RMD tracking module in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code of the state in which the annuity contract was issued and delivered. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, surrender charge requirements, free-look period, suitability rules, and tax withholding requirements. Aligns with NAIC state-specific filing requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: The status of the annuity suitability review conducted at point of sale per NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation #275 and the DOL Best Interest Standard. APPROVED = suitability confirmed; PENDING = review in progress; REJECTED = sale flagged as unsuitable; EXEMPT = exempt from review (e.g., direct-to-consumer, employer plan). Required for regulatory compliance and audit.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation #275; DOL Fiduciary Rule; SEC Regulation Best Interest

attributes.name: surrender_charge_period_years
attributes.description: The total number of contract years during which surrender charges apply, as defined by the product's surrender charge schedule (e.g., 7-year, 10-year surrender charge period). After this period, the contract is fully liquid without surrender charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Filing Requirements

attributes.name: tax_qualification_status
attributes.description: Indicates the tax qualification status of the annuity contract under IRS rules. NON_QUALIFIED = funded with after-tax dollars, IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio applies; TRADITIONAL_IRA / ROTH_IRA / 403B / 457B / SEP_IRA / SIMPLE_IRA = qualified plan funding with specific RMD and distribution rules. Drives tax reporting (1099-R) and RMD calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NON_QUALIFIED|TRADITIONAL_IRA|ROTH_IRA|403B|457B|SEP_IRA|SIMPLE_IRA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Sections 72, 408, 403(b), 457; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this annuity contract record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every change event sourced from the Annuity Administration Platform. Required for SOX audit trail, change data capture, and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Data Quality Standards

products.name: account_value
products.description: Authoritative periodic valuation ledger and contract valuation snapshot for each annuity contract, capturing the full financial position at each valuation date (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually). Records beginning-of-period and ending-of-period Account Value (AV), net premiums applied, withdrawals deducted, COI charges, rider charges, credited interest, index credits (FIA), sub-account performance (variable), surrender value (CSV), death benefit amount, GMDB value, GMWB/GMIB/GMAB benefit base snapshots, net amount at risk (NAR) for each guarantee, accrued rider charges, and statutory reserve estimate. Serves as the single source of truth for ALL annuity contract valuations and periodic valuation snapshots (subsumes contract_valuation), supporting policyholder annual statements, ALM, actuarial reserving (LDTI/IFRS 17), valuation cycle feeds, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: account_value_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic account value snapshot record in the annuity valuation ledger. Primary key for this table. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete periodic valuation event for an annuity contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract for which this account value snapshot is recorded. Links to the annuity contract master record in the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity).
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Account values must be attributed to issuing legal entity for consolidated balance sheet reporting, statutory reserve calculations, and regulatory capital adequacy (RBC) filings. Required for multi-en

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract owner (policyholder/annuitant) associated with this valuation record. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for policyholder annual statement generation and KYC/AML compliance.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: bov_account_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Beginning of Valuation Period Account Value (AV)
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) at the beginning of the valuation period (BOY/BOM/BOQ/BOD depending on cycle). Represents the opening balance before any transactions, credits, or charges are applied during the period. Sourced from the Annuity Administration Platform contract administration module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: coi_charge
attributes.description: Cost of Insurance (COI) charge deducted from the account value during the valuation period. Applicable primarily to variable annuities and indexed products with mortality and expense risk charges. Calculated based on the Net Amount at Risk (NAR) and applicable COI rates.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: contract_phase
attributes.description: Current phase of the annuity contract lifecycle at the time of this valuation: accumulation (premium growth phase), annuitization (conversion to income stream), payout (systematic income payments), surrender (contract terminated by owner), or lapse (contract terminated for non-payment). Critical for determining applicable valuation rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year number at the valuation date, calculated from the contract issue date. Used to determine applicable surrender charge rates, free withdrawal corridors, and benefit base roll-up periods.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account value record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP

attributes.name: credited_interest_amount
attributes.description: Total interest credited to the contract account value during the valuation period for fixed and fixed-indexed annuity products. Includes declared interest rates for fixed products and guaranteed minimum interest for FIA products. Excludes index credits which are tracked separately.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: csv
attributes.description: Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the annuity contract at the valuation date, representing the net amount the contract owner would receive upon full surrender after deducting applicable surrender charges, market value adjustments (MVA), and outstanding loans. Key metric for policyholder statements and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Current death benefit (DB) payable upon the death of the annuitant or insured at the valuation date. May equal the account value, a return-of-premium amount, or a stepped-up value depending on the contract terms and any applicable GMDB rider.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: eov_account_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: End of Valuation Period Account Value (AV)
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) at the end of the valuation period (EOY/EOM/EOQ/EOD depending on cycle). Represents the closing balance after all transactions, credits, and charges have been applied. This is the primary AV figure used for policyholder statements, ALM, and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: fia_cap_rate
attributes.description: The maximum index credit rate (cap) applied to the linked index return for FIA products during the crediting period (as a decimal, e.g., 0.06 = 6%). Null for non-FIA products or strategies without a cap.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: fia_floor_rate
attributes.description: The minimum index credit rate (floor) guaranteed for FIA products during the crediting period (as a decimal, e.g., 0.00 = 0%). Protects the contract owner from negative index returns. Null for non-FIA products.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: fia_index_strategy
attributes.description: The index crediting strategy elected by the contract owner for FIA products (e.g., S&P 500 Annual Point-to-Point with Cap, S&P 500 Monthly Sum, MSCI EAFE Participation Rate). Determines how index credits are calculated. Null for non-FIA products.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC SAP

attributes.name: fia_participation_rate
attributes.description: The participation rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.80 = 80%) applied to the linked index return when calculating index credits for FIA products. Null for non-FIA products. Sourced from the Annuity Administration Platform crediting parameters.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount that can be withdrawn from the contract during the current contract year without incurring surrender charges, typically 10% of the account value or premium. Used for withdrawal processing and policyholder servicing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gaap_reserve
attributes.description: GAAP reserve for this annuity contract at the valuation date, calculated per FASB ASC 944 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI). Represents the present value of future benefit payments less the present value of future gross premiums under GAAP accounting.

attributes.name: gmab_benefit_base
