attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) benefit base at the valuation date. Represents the guaranteed minimum account value at the end of the accumulation period. Null if no GMAB rider is attached.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gmdb_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) benefit base at the valuation date. Represents the guaranteed floor for the death benefit, which may be higher than the current account value due to step-up provisions or roll-up features. Used for NAR calculation and actuarial reserving under LDTI.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gmib_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base at the valuation date. Represents the accumulation value used to calculate the guaranteed minimum annuitization income. Null if no GMIB rider is attached.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base at the valuation date. Represents the principal amount from which guaranteed withdrawal amounts are calculated. May grow through roll-up credits or step-ups. Null if no GMWB rider is attached.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gross_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount withdrawn from the contract account value during the valuation period, including both systematic withdrawals and ad-hoc partial surrenders. Used to calculate surrender charges, tax reporting under IRC Section 72, and GMWB benefit base adjustments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: index_credit_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) Index Credit Amount
attributes.description: Index-linked interest credit applied to the contract account value during the valuation period for Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) products. Calculated based on the performance of the linked index (e.g., S&P 500), subject to applicable cap, floor, and participation rate. Zero for non-FIA products.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC FIA Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this annuity contract was funded in whole or in part through a tax-free 1035 Exchange (IRC Section 1035). Affects cost basis tracking, tax reporting, and gain/loss calculations for IRC Section 72 purposes.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035 (1035 Exchange); IRS Regulations; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_mec
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of withdrawals and loans, triggering LIFO tax treatment and potential 10% penalty.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; IRS Regulations; NAIC SAP

attributes.name: is_qualified_contract
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is a qualified contract (held within a tax-qualified retirement plan such as IRA, 401(k), 403(b)) or a non-qualified contract. Determines applicable tax treatment under IRC Section 72 and RMD requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Regulations; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: nar_gmdb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB)
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the GMDB guarantee, calculated as the excess of the GMDB benefit base over the current account value (max of zero). Used for COI charge calculation, reinsurance cession, and actuarial reserving under LDTI/IFRS 17.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: nar_living_benefit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Living Benefit Guarantee
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for living benefit guarantees (GMWB/GMIB/GMAB), representing the present value of the excess of guaranteed benefit payments over the projected account value. Used for actuarial reserving under LDTI and IFRS 17 and reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_premium_applied
attributes.description: Total net premium (after applicable premium loads and taxes) credited to the contract account value during the valuation period. Includes initial premiums, subsequent premiums, and 1035 exchange proceeds applied during the period.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 1035 (1035 Exchange)

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code identifying the annuity product type (e.g., FIA, VUL, SPIA, GMWB annuity). Used to apply product-specific valuation rules, crediting methods, and benefit base calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Product Filing Requirements

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the annuity product: Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA), Variable Annuity (VA), Single Premium Immediate Annuity (SPIA), Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity (MYGA), Fixed Premium Deferred Annuity (FPDA), or Fixed Premium Immediate Annuity (FPIA). Drives crediting method and benefit calculation logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIA|VA|SPIA|MYGA|FPDA|FPIA|RILA|DIA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: rider_charge_total
attributes.description: Total of all rider charges (GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB, LTC, etc.) deducted from the account value during the valuation period. Represents the aggregate cost of all optional benefit riders attached to the contract.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: rmd_amount
attributes.description: Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) amount calculated for this contract for the current tax year, applicable to qualified annuity contracts held in IRAs or employer-sponsored retirement plans. Tracked per IRS regulations to ensure compliance with IRC Section 401(a)(9).
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS RMD Regulations; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity) for this account value snapshot. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability between the operational system and the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 302/404 (Data Lineage)

attributes.name: statutory_reserve
attributes.description: Estimated statutory reserve for this annuity contract at the valuation date, calculated per NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) and Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) requirements. Sourced from or reconciled with the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., MoSes, AXIS, Prophet).
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; NAIC PBR (VM-21 for Variable Annuities; VM-22 for Fixed Annuities); FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: sub_account_gain_loss
attributes.description: Net investment gain or loss from variable annuity sub-account performance during the valuation period. Applicable only to Variable Annuity (VA) and Variable Universal Life (VUL) products. Reflects market value changes in the separate account sub-accounts.
attributes.references: SEC Variable Annuity Regulations; FINRA Rules; NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: Applicable surrender charge that would be assessed if the contract were fully surrendered at the valuation date. Calculated based on the surrender charge schedule and contract duration. Used for CSV calculation and policyholder disclosure.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: surrender_charge_rate
attributes.description: Applicable surrender charge rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.07 = 7%) at the valuation date based on the contract's surrender charge schedule and contract year. Used to calculate the surrender charge amount and free withdrawal corridor.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; NAIC SAP; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account value record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Populated on restatements, corrections, or status changes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP

attributes.name: valuation_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency classification of this valuation snapshot indicating whether it is a daily, monthly, quarterly, or annual valuation record. Drives downstream actuarial and ALM processing cadence.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this account value snapshot. Represents the principal real-world business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). May be daily, month-end, quarter-end, or year-end depending on the valuation cycle. Used for actuarial reserving, ALM, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this account value record indicating whether the valuation is preliminary (in-process), final (approved), restated (corrected after finalization), or voided (cancelled). Supports LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; SOX Section 302/404

products.name: benefit_base
products.description: Manages the guaranteed benefit base amounts for living benefit riders attached to annuity contracts, including GMWB (Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit), GMIB (Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit), and GMAB (Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit). Tracks benefit base inception value, step-up events, roll-up credits, maximum anniversary value, current benefit base balance, rider charge rate, and benefit base type. Critical for actuarial reserving under LDTI and IFRS 17 and for benefit calculation at claim time.

attributes.name: benefit_base_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guaranteed benefit base record associated with a living benefit rider on an annuity contract. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this benefit base and living benefit rider are attached. Links the benefit base to the parent annuity contract record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: hedge_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Living benefit riders (GMWB, GMIB, GMAB) create market risk hedged via derivative portfolios. Actuarial teams calculate net amount at risk, hedge effectiveness (ASC 815), and RBC C3 charges by linking

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Living benefit riders (GMWB/GMIB/GMAB) have version-specific roll-up rates, step-up provisions, and guaranteed withdrawal rates. Essential for benefit base calculations, rider charge assessments, and

attributes.name: policy_rider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific living benefit rider (GMWB, GMIB, or GMAB) attached to the annuity contract that governs this benefit base record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Benefit base values (GMWB, GMIB, GMAB) are calculated during actuarial valuation runs. Regulatory reserve reporting requires tracing benefit base amounts to the specific valuation run that produced th

attributes.name: annual_guaranteed_withdrawal
attributes.description: For GMWB riders, the maximum dollar amount the contract owner may withdraw annually while maintaining the guaranteed benefit base. Calculated as the benefit base multiplied by the guaranteed withdrawal rate. Recalculated upon step-up events.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: benefit_base_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the benefit base record, used in policyholder statements, actuarial reports, and regulatory filings. Typically derived from the contract number with a rider suffix.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Annuity Suitability

attributes.name: benefit_base_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit base. Active = benefit base is in force and accumulating or being drawn down; Suspended = temporarily inactive due to excess withdrawal or contract lapse; Exhausted = benefit base has been fully depleted; Terminated = rider has been surrendered or cancelled; Annuitized = contract has entered payout phase under GMIB election.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: benefit_election_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner has formally elected to begin receiving guaranteed benefits under the rider. Not Elected = owner has not yet begun taking guaranteed withdrawals or income; Elected = owner is actively receiving guaranteed withdrawals (GMWB) or income (GMIB); Annuitized = contract has been annuitized under GMIB; Exhausted = benefit base depleted.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: contract_anniversary_date
attributes.description: The most recent contract anniversary date, used as the reference point for automatic step-up evaluation, roll-up credit application, and annual rider charge assessment. Derived from the contract issue date but stored here for operational processing efficiency.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: cumulative_withdrawals
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of withdrawals that have been charged against the benefit base since rider inception. Used to track benefit base depletion and determine remaining guaranteed withdrawal capacity. Excess withdrawals beyond the annual guaranteed amount reduce the benefit base proportionally.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all benefit base monetary amounts are denominated (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency annuity platforms and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: current_benefit_base
attributes.description: The current guaranteed benefit base balance as of the most recent valuation date, reflecting all roll-up credits, step-up elections, and withdrawal reductions applied since inception. This is the principal amount used to calculate the guaranteed withdrawal or income benefit. Critical for actuarial reserving under LDTI and IFRS 17.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: excess_withdrawal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner has taken a withdrawal in excess of the annual guaranteed withdrawal amount in the current or any prior contract year. An excess withdrawal triggers a proportional reduction of the benefit base rather than a dollar-for-dollar reduction, and may reset or suspend certain rider provisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: first_withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner first took a withdrawal against the benefit base, triggering the transition from the accumulation phase to the distribution phase. Null if no withdrawals have been taken. Marks the end of the roll-up credit period for most product designs.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gmab_guaranteed_floor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Guaranteed Floor
attributes.description: For GMAB riders, the minimum Account Value guaranteed at the GMAB maturity date. If the actual AV at maturity is below this floor, the insurer credits the difference to the contract. Null for GMWB and GMIB riders. Key input for LDTI and IFRS 17 reserve calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17

attributes.name: gmab_maturity_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Maturity Date
attributes.description: For GMAB riders, the contractually defined date on which the guaranteed minimum accumulation amount becomes payable if the contract Account Value is below the guaranteed floor. Null for GMWB and GMIB riders. Triggers actuarial reserve strengthening as the maturity date approaches.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17

attributes.name: gmib_annuitization_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Annuitization Rate
attributes.description: For GMIB riders, the guaranteed annuitization rate (expressed as a decimal income factor per dollar of benefit base) used to convert the benefit base into a guaranteed lifetime income stream upon GMIB election. Null for GMWB and GMAB riders. Locked in at rider inception regardless of prevailing interest rates at annuitization.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gmib_eligible_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Eligible Date
attributes.description: For GMIB riders, the earliest date on which the contract owner may elect to annuitize under the GMIB guarantee. Derived from inception date plus the GMIB waiting period. Null for GMWB and GMAB riders. Used in benefit election processing and policyholder communications.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: gmib_waiting_period_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Waiting Period (Years)
attributes.description: For GMIB riders, the minimum number of contract years that must elapse before the contract owner is eligible to elect the GMIB annuitization option. Typically 10 years. Null for GMWB and GMAB riders.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: guaranteed_withdrawal_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Withdrawal Rate
attributes.description: For GMWB riders, the contractually guaranteed annual withdrawal percentage applied to the benefit base to determine the maximum guaranteed annual withdrawal amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.050000 for 5%). May vary by age band at first withdrawal election.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: in_the_money_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the living benefit guarantee is currently in-the-money, meaning the benefit base exceeds the contract Account Value (AV). True = guarantee is in-the-money (NAR > 0); False = guarantee is out-of-the-money (AV >= benefit base). Used for actuarial triage, reserve prioritization, and risk management reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Framework

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The date on which the living benefit rider and its associated benefit base became effective on the annuity contract. Marks the start of the benefit base accumulation or guarantee period. Used as the anchor date for roll-up credit calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: inception_value
attributes.description: The initial guaranteed benefit base amount established at rider inception, typically equal to the contract Account Value (AV) at the time the rider was issued or the premium amount for a single-premium contract. Serves as the floor for step-up and roll-up calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: last_step_up_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the benefit base was stepped up to the contract Account Value under the step-up provision. Null if no step-up has occurred since inception. Used to track step-up history and determine eligibility for future step-ups.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: last_step_up_value
attributes.description: The benefit base amount recorded at the time of the most recent step-up event. Provides an audit trail of the step-up history and supports actuarial analysis of step-up frequency and magnitude.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: max_anniversary_value
attributes.description: The highest contract Account Value (AV) recorded on any contract anniversary date since rider inception. Used as the step-up candidate value in automatic anniversary step-up provisions. The benefit base is stepped up to the MAV if it exceeds the current benefit base.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: net_amount_at_risk
attributes.description: The excess of the current benefit base over the contract Account Value (AV), representing the insurer's current financial exposure on the living benefit guarantee. A positive NAR indicates the guarantee is in-the-money. Critical input for actuarial reserving under LDTI, IFRS 17, and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Framework; NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: owner_age_at_first_withdrawal
attributes.description: The age of the contract owner (in whole years) at the time of the first withdrawal from the benefit base. Determines the applicable guaranteed withdrawal rate tier for age-banded GMWB products. Null if no withdrawals have been taken.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this benefit base record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and state insurance department data retention regulations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this benefit base record was most recently updated in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental ETL processing and change data capture in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: rider_charge_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annual rider charge is assessed as a percentage of the benefit base or the contract Account Value (AV). Benefit Base = charge applied to the guaranteed benefit base amount; Account Value = charge applied to the current AV. Affects the charge amount when AV diverges from the benefit base.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: rider_charge_rate
attributes.description: The annual fee rate charged for the living benefit rider, expressed as a decimal applied to the benefit base (e.g., 0.010000 for 1.00% per annum). Deducted from the contract Account Value periodically. Used in product profitability analysis and policyholder cost disclosure.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements; FINRA Rule 2330

attributes.name: rider_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the living benefit rider and its associated benefit base guarantee period ends, if applicable. Null for riders with no fixed expiry. Relevant for GMAB riders with a defined accumulation period end date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: rider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the living benefit rider governing this benefit base. GMWB = Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit; GMIB = Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit; GMAB = Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit; GMDB = Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit. Determines the benefit calculation methodology applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17

attributes.name: roll_up_credits_inception_to_date
attributes.description: The total cumulative dollar amount of guaranteed roll-up credits applied to the benefit base from rider inception through the current valuation date. Key metric for actuarial cost-of-guarantee analysis and LDTI/IFRS 17 reserve adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: roll_up_credits_ytd
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount of guaranteed roll-up credits applied to the benefit base in the current contract year. Resets at each contract anniversary. Used for in-force management reporting and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: roll_up_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the guaranteed roll-up credit period expires for this benefit base. Derived from the inception date plus the roll-up period in years, but stored explicitly for operational processing and actuarial projection.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: roll_up_period_years
attributes.description: The maximum number of contract years during which the guaranteed roll-up rate is applied to grow the benefit base. After this period expires, the benefit base no longer accrues roll-up credits. Common values are 10 or 20 years depending on product design.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: roll_up_rate
attributes.description: The contractually guaranteed annual percentage rate at which the benefit base grows during the accumulation phase, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 for 6%). Applied to the benefit base each year regardless of actual contract Account Value performance. Ceases upon first withdrawal or at the end of the roll-up period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational annuity administration system from which this benefit base record was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_ANNUITY, FAST_ANNUITY). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: step_up_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of step-up events that have occurred on this benefit base since rider inception. Used in actuarial experience studies and product profitability analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: step_up_provision
attributes.description: Indicates the type of step-up provision available under the rider. Automatic Anniversary = benefit base is automatically stepped up to the contract AV on each anniversary if AV exceeds current benefit base; Owner Elected = policyholder must actively elect a step-up; None = no step-up provision available.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The most recent date as of which the benefit base values (current benefit base, cumulative withdrawals, roll-up credits) were calculated and recorded. Aligns with the actuarial valuation cycle for LDTI and IFRS 17 reserving.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

products.name: withdrawal_transaction
products.description: Records all withdrawal events and manages standing systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) instructions against annuity contracts — serving as the single source of truth for ALL withdrawal activity, both ad-hoc and systematic (subsumes systematic_withdrawal_plan). For individual withdrawals: captures withdrawal request date, effective date, gross amount, surrender charge applied, MVA adjustment, net proceeds, withdrawal type (systematic, ad-hoc, RMD, full surrender), tax withholding, 1099-R reportable amount, and free withdrawal allowance status. For SWP plans: captures plan start date, frequency, amount or percentage, end date or duration, tax withholding elections (federal and state), payment method and banking instructions, RMD coordination flag, plan status, and SWP suspension/reinstatement history. Sourced from Sapiens Annuity and FAST Annuity withdrawal processing modules.

attributes.name: withdrawal_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each withdrawal transaction or systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) instruction record. Primary key for the withdrawal_transaction data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Withdrawal disbursements are processed through billing accounts containing bank routing and account information. Real business process: payment disbursement, ACH/wire processing, 1099-R tax reporting

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_case. Business justification: Large or structured withdrawals trigger AML monitoring per BSA requirements. Links suspicious withdrawal patterns to AML case investigations. Required for SAR filing and transaction monitoring rule va

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract against which this withdrawal transaction or SWP instruction is recorded. Links to the annuity contract master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks employee who approved withdrawal for compliance verification, fraud prevention, audit trails, and authorization controls. Essential for regulatory compliance, SOX controls, and operational risk

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Withdrawals generate journal entries for cash disbursement (credit), surrender charge revenue (credit), tax withholding liability (credit), and account value reduction (debit). Direct GL posting requi

attributes.name: owner_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract owner (policyholder) who authorized or is associated with this withdrawal transaction. Required for tax reporting and KYC compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: systematic_withdrawal_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standing Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) instruction that generated this withdrawal transaction. Populated only for systematic withdrawal type transactions. Null for ad-hoc, RMD, or surrender transactions.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: account_value_after
attributes.description: The annuity contract's Account Value (AV) immediately after this withdrawal transaction has been applied. Confirms the post-withdrawal contract value for owner statements, benefit base recalculation, and subsequent transaction processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: account_value_before
attributes.description: The annuity contract's Account Value (AV) immediately prior to this withdrawal transaction being applied. Used for surrender charge calculation, benefit base adjustments, and reconciliation of AV movement.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the owner's bank account number used for ACH or direct deposit disbursement of withdrawal proceeds. Stored in masked format for security compliance. Full account details are maintained in the EFT authorization record.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA Operating Rules; NAIC Privacy Model Regulation

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit ABA routing transit number of the financial institution receiving the withdrawal proceeds via ACH or wire transfer. Required for electronic disbursement processing.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: cost_basis_recovered_amount
attributes.description: The non-taxable portion of the withdrawal representing return of the owner's after-tax investment (cost basis) in the annuity contract under IRC Section 72. Reduces the remaining cost basis tracked on the contract.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this withdrawal transaction record was first created in the annuity administration system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this withdrawal transaction. Typically 'USD' for domestic US annuity contracts. Required for the MONETARY_TRIPLET and multi-currency reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: distribution_code
attributes.description: IRS-defined distribution code reported in Box 7 of Form 1099-R indicating the nature of the distribution for tax purposes. Common codes: '1'=early distribution no exception; '2'=early distribution exception applies; '3'=disability; '4'=death; '7'=normal distribution; 'D'=annuity payments from non-qualified annuity; 'Q'=qualified distribution from Roth IRA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|7|D|Q|G|L|M|N|P|R|S|T|U|W — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The contractual effective date on which the withdrawal is applied to the annuity contract's Account Value (AV). This is the valuation date used for surrender charge calculation, MVA adjustment, and 1099-R tax year determination. May differ from request_date due to processing cycles or market close timing.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of federal income tax withheld from this withdrawal per the owner's withholding election or mandatory withholding rules under IRC Section 3405. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 4.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3405; IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: federal_withholding_election
attributes.description: The contract owner's federal income tax withholding election for this withdrawal. 'withhold' = owner elected voluntary withholding; 'do_not_withhold' = owner opted out of withholding; 'mandatory' = mandatory withholding applies (e.g., eligible rollover distributions). Governs IRS Form W-4P compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3405; IRS Form W-4P; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: The contractual free withdrawal allowance amount available for the current contract year, typically 10% of Account Value (AV) or accumulated premiums, within which no surrender charge applies. Used to determine the surrender-charge-free portion of this withdrawal.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base_after
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base After Withdrawal
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base amount immediately after this withdrawal has been applied. Reflects any proportional reduction due to excess withdrawal above the contractual GMWB annual withdrawal amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base Before Withdrawal
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base amount immediately prior to this withdrawal. Excess withdrawals above the GMWB annual withdrawal amount reduce the benefit base proportionally. Required for variable and indexed annuity contracts with GMWB riders.
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross dollar amount of the withdrawal before deduction of surrender charges, Market Value Adjustment (MVA), and tax withholding. Represents the amount deducted from the contract's Account Value (AV). Core monetary field for the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines; IRS Form 1099-R

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this withdrawal is part of a tax-free 1035 Exchange (IRC Section 1035) where proceeds are being transferred directly to another annuity or life insurance contract. True = 1035 exchange; proceeds are not taxable to the owner at time of withdrawal.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 575; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_excess_withdrawal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this withdrawal exceeds the contractual GMWB or GMIB annual withdrawal amount, triggering a proportional reduction of the guaranteed benefit base. True = excess withdrawal occurred; False = withdrawal is within the guaranteed annual withdrawal amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_rmd_coordinated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this withdrawal is coordinated with the contract's Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) calculation under IRC Section 401(a)(9). True = RMD coordination is active and this withdrawal satisfies or partially satisfies the annual RMD obligation. Applicable to qualified annuity contracts.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: is_within_free_withdrawal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entire gross withdrawal amount falls within the contractual free withdrawal allowance corridor and therefore no surrender charge was applied. True = fully within free withdrawal; False = surrender charge applies to some or all of the withdrawal.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: mva_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the Market Value Adjustment (MVA) applied to this withdrawal. Can be positive (in owner's favor when interest rates have fallen) or negative (charge when rates have risen). Applicable only to fixed annuity contracts with MVA provisions. Zero if not applicable.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Fixed Annuities; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: net_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: Net dollar amount disbursed to the contract owner after deducting surrender charges, MVA adjustment, and federal/state tax withholding from the gross withdrawal amount. Represents the actual cash received by the owner. Core monetary field for the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used to deliver net withdrawal proceeds to the contract owner. 'ach' = Automated Clearing House electronic funds transfer; 'check' = paper check mailed to owner; 'wire' = wire transfer; 'direct_deposit' = direct deposit to owner's bank account; '1035_transfer' = direct transfer to receiving carrier for 1035 exchange.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the withdrawal transaction was executed and posted to the annuity contract in the administration system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for audit, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the withdrawal request was received from the contract owner or their authorized representative. Establishes the business event initiation date for processing, valuation, and regulatory timing purposes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: rmd_amount
attributes.description: The calculated Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) amount for the current tax year applicable to this annuity contract under IRC Section 401(a)(9). Populated when is_rmd_coordinated is True. Used to ensure the withdrawal satisfies the minimum distribution requirement and avoid IRS excise tax penalties.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Form 5329

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational annuity administration system that originated this withdrawal transaction record. 'sapiens_annuity' = Sapiens Annuity platform; 'fast_annuity' = FAST Annuity platform. Required for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of state income tax withheld from this withdrawal per the owner's state withholding election or mandatory state withholding requirements. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 14.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R; State Department of Revenue Regulations; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: state_withholding_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state for which income tax withholding was applied on this withdrawal. Determines applicable state withholding rates and mandatory withholding rules. Aligns with the owner's state of residence.
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue Regulations; IRS Form 1099-R; NAIC Privacy Model Regulation

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC) or surrender charge applied to this withdrawal. Calculated based on the contract's surrender charge schedule and the amount withdrawn in excess of the free withdrawal allowance. Zero if within free withdrawal corridor.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: surrender_charge_rate
attributes.description: The applicable surrender charge rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.07 = 7%) applied to the excess withdrawal amount above the free withdrawal allowance. Derived from the contract's contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC) schedule for the current surrender charge year.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: surrender_charge_year
attributes.description: The contract year number within the surrender charge schedule at the time of this withdrawal. Determines the applicable surrender charge rate percentage per the contract's CDSC schedule. For example, year 1 may carry a 7% charge, declining to 0% by year 8.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: swp_amount_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the SWP disbursement is a fixed dollar amount, a percentage of the current Account Value (AV), or a system-calculated RMD amount. Drives the withdrawal amount calculation logic in the annuity administration platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 401(a)(9)

attributes.name: swp_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) instruction is scheduled to terminate or was terminated. Null if the SWP is open-ended (e.g., lifetime income or until contract exhaustion). Populated for fixed-duration SWP plans.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: swp_frequency
attributes.description: The payment frequency of the Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) instruction. Applicable when withdrawal_type is 'systematic'. Determines the schedule on which recurring withdrawals are processed from the annuity contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: swp_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) instruction became effective and the first scheduled withdrawal was processed. Establishes the SWP plan inception date for scheduling and anniversary calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: swp_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) instruction associated with this transaction. 'active' = SWP is running per schedule; 'suspended' = temporarily halted by owner request; 'terminated' = SWP permanently stopped; 'pending_setup' = SWP instruction received but not yet activated.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross withdrawal amount that is taxable as ordinary income under IRC Section 72, reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 2a. Equals gross amount minus the non-taxable cost basis (investment in contract) recovered in this withdrawal.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable transaction reference number assigned by the annuity administration platform (Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity) at the time of withdrawal processing. Used for customer correspondence, audit trails, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the withdrawal transaction or SWP instruction. 'pending' = request received but not yet processed; 'in_process' = funds movement initiated; 'completed' = disbursement confirmed; 'reversed' = transaction unwound; 'cancelled' = request voided before processing; 'suspended' = SWP plan temporarily halted.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this withdrawal transaction record in the annuity administration system. Supports change tracking, reconciliation, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the withdrawal event. 'systematic' = scheduled SWP disbursement; 'ad_hoc' = owner-initiated one-time withdrawal; 'rmd' = Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) mandated under IRC Section 401(a)(9); 'full_surrender' = complete contract liquidation; 'partial_surrender' = partial contract liquidation with surrender charge; 'free_withdrawal' = withdrawal within the contractual free withdrawal allowance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 401(a)(9); NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; IRS Publication 575

products.name: rmd_schedule
products.description: Manages Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) schedules for qualified annuity contracts subject to IRS RMD rules under IRC Section 72 and IRS Publication 590-B. Tracks RMD calculation year, applicable IRS life expectancy table (Uniform, Joint, Single), account value as of December 31 prior year, calculated RMD amount, distributions already taken toward RMD, remaining RMD balance, RMD due date, and RMD satisfaction status. Supports IRS Form 5498 and 1099-R tax reporting obligations.

attributes.name: rmd_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each RMD schedule record within the annuity administration platform. Primary key for the rmd_schedule data product.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified annuity contract for which this RMD schedule is maintained. Links the RMD obligation to the underlying annuity contract in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — contract administration module); IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: RMD calculations use IRS life expectancy tables (Uniform Lifetime, Single Life, Joint Life) which are mortality tables. Required for accurate RMD calculation, IRS compliance, and audit trail of which

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract owner (policyholder) who is subject to the RMD obligation. The owner's age and applicable IRS life expectancy table are derived from this party record.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: RMD distributions must be reported on IRS Form 1099-R (regulatory filing obligation). Links RMD schedules to annual tax reporting filings for qualified contracts. Required for IRS compliance validatio

attributes.name: reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks employee who reviewed RMD calculation for compliance verification, IRS audit support, quality control, and regulatory compliance. Essential for tax compliance operations and audit trail require

attributes.name: aggregation_group_code
attributes.description: Identifier grouping multiple IRA or annuity contracts owned by the same individual for RMD aggregation purposes. IRS rules permit owners to aggregate RMDs across multiple IRAs and satisfy the total from one or more accounts. Used for cross-contract RMD satisfaction tracking and IRS Form 5498 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Reg. 1.408-8; IRS Form 5498

attributes.name: april_1_deferral_elected
attributes.business_glossary_term: April 1 First-Year RMD Deferral Elected Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner has elected to defer the first-year RMD to April 1 of the following calendar year as permitted by IRS rules. Applicable only when first_rmd_year_flag is True. When True, the rmd_due_date is set to April 1 of the year following the first RMD year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5

attributes.name: beneficiary_age_at_rmd_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Designated Beneficiary Age at RMD Year
attributes.description: Age of the designated beneficiary (typically spouse) as of their birthday in the RMD calculation year. Required only when the Joint and Last Survivor Table is applicable (sole beneficiary is a spouse more than 10 years younger than the owner). Null when Uniform Lifetime or Single Life tables are used.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: calculated_rmd_amount
attributes.description: The gross RMD amount calculated for the calendar year, derived by dividing the prior year-end Account Value (AV) by the applicable IRS distribution period factor. This is the minimum amount the contract owner must withdraw to satisfy IRS RMD requirements and avoid the IRC Section 4974 excise tax.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRC Section 4974; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier of the annuity contract as assigned by the Policy Administration System. Used for IRS Form 5498 and 1099-R tax reporting and owner-facing correspondence.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity); ACORD data standards; IRS Form 5498; IRS Form 1099-R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this RMD schedule record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trails, data lineage, and Silver Layer record management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC data governance standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: distribution_period
attributes.description: The life expectancy factor (in years) retrieved from the applicable IRS life expectancy table for the owner's age (and beneficiary's age if Joint table applies) in the RMD year. This divisor is applied to the prior year-end account value to compute the RMD amount. Updated per SECURE Act 2.0 tables effective 2022.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9; SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: excise_tax_exposure_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRC Section 4974 Excise Tax Exposure Amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the potential IRS excise tax exposure under IRC Section 4974 if the RMD is not fully satisfied by the due date. Calculated as 25% of the remaining_rmd_balance (reduced to 10% if corrected within the correction window under SECURE Act 2.0). Supports proactive owner outreach and compliance risk management.
attributes.references: IRC Section 4974; SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: first_rmd_year_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Year Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the first calendar year in which the contract owner is subject to RMD requirements. When True, the owner may elect to defer the first RMD to April 1 of the following year per IRS rules, which may result in two RMDs being taken in the same calendar year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: form_1099r_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1099-R (Distributions From Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans) has been issued to the contract owner for distributions taken toward the RMD in the calendar year. Supports tax reporting compliance and owner communication.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; NAIC

attributes.name: form_5498_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IRS Form 5498 reporting the RMD obligation was filed or transmitted to the IRS. Null if form_5498_reported_flag is False. Supports tax reporting audit trails.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5498; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 408(i)

attributes.name: form_5498_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RMD obligation for this calendar year has been reported to the IRS on Form 5498 (IRA Contribution Information), which requires insurers to report the RMD amount and indicate that an RMD is required for the year. Supports IRS tax reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5498; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 408(i); NAIC

attributes.name: inherited_contract_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is an inherited (beneficiary) contract subject to the IRS 10-year rule or life expectancy payout rules under SECURE Act 2.0. When True, the Single Life Expectancy Table and beneficiary-specific RMD rules apply.
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72(s); IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the RMD notification was delivered to the contract owner. 'suppressed' indicates the owner opted out of notifications or the notification was withheld for a documented reason.
attributes.references: IRS Reg. 1.408-8 Q&A-10; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity); CRM and Customer Engagement Platform

attributes.name: original_owner_dod
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Contract Owner Date of Death
attributes.description: The date of death of the original annuity contract owner, applicable when inherited_contract_flag is True. Determines the commencement of the beneficiary's RMD obligation and the applicable distribution rules under SECURE Act 2.0 (10-year rule vs. life expectancy payout).
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72(s); IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-3

attributes.name: owner_age_at_rmd_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Owner Age at RMD Year
attributes.description: The age of the annuity contract owner as of their birthday in the RMD calculation year. Used to look up the applicable distribution period from the IRS life expectancy table. Per IRS rules, age is determined as of the owner's birthday in the distribution year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: owner_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner was notified of their RMD obligation and calculated amount for the calendar year. IRS regulations require insurers to notify IRA owners of their RMD amount by January 31 of the distribution year. Supports regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Reg. 1.408-8 Q&A-10; IRS Publication 590-B; NAIC

attributes.name: prior_calculated_rmd_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Calculated Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Amount
attributes.description: The RMD amount from the most recent prior calculation before the current recalculation. Populated only when recalculation_flag is True. Supports audit trails and change management for IRS reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: prior_year_end_av
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of December 31 of the year immediately preceding the RMD calculation year. This is the IRS-mandated valuation date for RMD calculation purposes. Sourced from the Annuity Administration Platform's end-of-year account value snapshot.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5; Annuity Administration Platform (FAST Annuity; Sapiens Annuity)

attributes.name: prior_year_end_av_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year-End Account Value (AV) Valuation Date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the prior year-end Account Value (AV) was captured for RMD calculation purposes. Should be December 31 of the prior year. Recorded explicitly to support audit trails and IRS Form 5498 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Form 5498; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: qualified_plan_type
attributes.description: The type of qualified retirement plan or IRA under which the annuity contract is held, which determines the applicable RMD rules, tax treatment, and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: traditional_ira|sep_ira|simple_ira|401k|403b|457b|inherited_ira — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B; ERISA; DOL fiduciary standards; IRS Form 5498

attributes.name: recalculation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RMD amount for this calendar year has been recalculated after the initial calculation, typically due to a correction in the prior year-end account value, a change in the applicable life expectancy table, or a data correction. When True, recalculation_reason should be populated.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: recalculation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the RMD was recalculated for the calendar year. Applicable only when recalculation_flag is True. Examples include account value restatement, beneficiary designation change, table correction, or data quality remediation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: remaining_rmd_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding RMD amount still required to be distributed to satisfy the IRS obligation for the calendar year. Computed as calculated_rmd_amount minus ytd_distributions_applied. A zero or negative value indicates the RMD has been satisfied. Used for proactive owner notifications and IRS compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 4974; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: rmd_calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RMD amount was calculated by the Annuity Administration Platform for the given calendar year. Supports audit trails and recalculation tracking when account values are restated or corrected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: rmd_due_date
attributes.description: The IRS deadline by which the RMD must be fully distributed to avoid the IRC Section 4974 excise tax. For most owners, this is December 31 of the RMD year. For the first RMD year (the year the owner reaches the applicable RMD age), the deadline may be extended to April 1 of the following year per IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRC Section 4974; SECURE Act 2.0 (RMD age changes)

attributes.name: rmd_satisfied_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RMD obligation for the calendar year was fully satisfied (i.e., cumulative distributions reached or exceeded the calculated RMD amount). Null if the RMD has not yet been satisfied. Used for IRS Form 1099-R reporting and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRC Section 4974

attributes.name: rmd_start_age
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated age at which the contract owner is required to begin taking RMDs from the qualified annuity. Reflects the applicable RMD age under current law (e.g., age 73 under SECURE Act 2.0 for owners born 1951–1959; age 75 for owners born 1960 or later). Stored to support historical accuracy as legislation changes.
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0 (Consolidated Appropriations Act 2023); IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: rmd_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RMD obligation for the given calendar year. 'pending' = RMD calculated but no distributions taken; 'in_progress' = partial distributions applied; 'satisfied' = full RMD amount distributed; 'waived' = IRS-approved waiver applied (e.g., first-year RMD deferral); 'overdue' = due date passed without satisfaction; 'cancelled' = contract no longer subject to RMD (e.g., annuitized, surrendered).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 4974 (excise tax on insufficient distributions); SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: rmd_year
attributes.description: The calendar year (YYYY) for which this RMD obligation applies. Each qualified annuity contract generates one RMD schedule record per applicable calendar year. Determines the December 31 prior-year account value snapshot used in the RMD calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B; IRS RMD rules under SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the operational source system record from which this RMD schedule was originated or last updated (e.g., Sapiens Annuity contract ID, FAST Annuity record key). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit trails in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematic Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner is enrolled in the annuity platform's automatic systematic RMD distribution program, which automatically calculates and distributes the RMD amount on a scheduled basis (monthly, quarterly, or annually) to ensure timely satisfaction.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which systematic RMD distributions are scheduled when the owner is enrolled in the automatic RMD program (systematic_rmd_flag = True). Null when systematic RMD is not elected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner's enrollment in the systematic RMD distribution program became effective. Null when systematic RMD is not elected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this RMD schedule record was most recently modified in the data platform. Updated whenever distributions are applied, recalculations occur, or status changes. Supports audit trails and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC data governance standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the RMD obligation has been waived for the calendar year. Applicable only when rmd_status is 'waived'. Examples include first-year deferral election, IRS-approved waiver, contract annuitization, full surrender, or regulatory relief (e.g., COVID-19 CARES Act waiver).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; CARES Act (2020 RMD waiver); SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: ytd_distributions_applied
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of distributions taken from the annuity contract during the RMD calendar year that have been applied toward satisfying the RMD obligation. Updated each time a qualifying withdrawal is processed. Used to compute the remaining RMD balance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; Annuity Administration Platform (FAST Annuity; Sapiens Annuity — withdrawal processing module)

products.name: index_crediting_strategy
products.description: Defines and manages all investment allocation strategies elected for annuity contracts, covering both FIA index crediting strategies and variable annuity sub-account fund allocations — serving as the single source of truth for ALL annuity investment allocation management (subsumes sub_account_allocation). For FIA: captures index name (S&P 500, Russell 2000, MSCI EAFE), crediting method (annual point-to-point, monthly average, monthly cap), cap rate, participation rate, spread/margin, floor rate, buffer rate, and crediting term dates. For variable annuity: captures sub-account fund name, fund CUSIP, allocation percentage, current unit value, number of units held, current market value, allocation effective date, and rebalancing instructions. Common fields: allocation percentage, allocation effective date, strategy/fund election status, and transfer/rebalance history. Supports FIA index credit calculations, VA NAV-based AV calculations, and policyholder allocation reporting.

attributes.name: index_crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each index crediting strategy or sub-account allocation record associated with an annuity contract. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this index crediting strategy or sub-account allocation belongs. Links the strategy to its parent contract in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crediting_strategy. Business justification: Contract-level strategy elections reference product crediting strategy definitions for cap/participation rates, index types, crediting methods, and allocation limits. Essential for index credit calcul

attributes.name: index_security_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.security. Business justification: FIA index strategies reference specific market indices (S&P 500, NASDAQ-100) that are securities in the investment master. Crediting calculations, cap/participation rate setting, and option pricing re

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: FIA crediting strategies with cap rates, participation rates, and index options are version-specific and change with product filings. Required for rate renewal processing, strategy availability valida

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: FIA crediting strategies (cap, participation, spread rates) must match approved policy forms and illustrations. Links strategy elections to approved form language for regulatory compliance validation.

attributes.name: prior_strategy_index_crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predecessor index crediting strategy record that this record replaced or was renewed from. Enables transfer and rebalance history tracking and supports audit trail requirements for policyholder allocation changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of new premium and/or account value directed to this specific strategy or sub-account. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). All active strategy allocations for a contract must sum to 100%. Governs how premium deposits and rebalancing flows are distributed.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this strategy election on the contract. 'active' = currently receiving allocations and crediting; 'pending' = elected but not yet effective; 'terminated' = no longer active; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'transferred' = funds moved to another strategy.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: av_at_term_end
attributes.description: Account Value (AV) allocated to this FIA strategy at the end of the crediting term after interest has been credited, in USD. Reflects the starting AV plus credited interest minus any withdrawals during the term. Null for open terms and VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: av_at_term_start
attributes.description: Account Value (AV) allocated to this FIA strategy at the beginning of the crediting term, in USD. Serves as the basis for interest crediting calculations at term end. Null for VA sub-account strategies where unit-based valuation applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: buffer_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of index loss absorbed by the carrier before the policyholder bears downside risk, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.0000 = 10%). Used in buffered or RILA-style FIA strategies as an alternative to a floor. Null for floor-based strategies and VA sub-accounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; SEC Registration (for registered index-linked annuities)

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum index-linked interest rate that can be credited to the FIA strategy in a given crediting term, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 8.5000 = 8.5%). Limits the upside participation in index gains. Null for uncapped strategies and VA sub-accounts. Set by the carrier and subject to contractual minimums filed with state regulators.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index crediting strategy record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: Actual index-linked interest rate credited to the FIA strategy at the end of the crediting term, expressed as a decimal percentage. Reflects the application of cap, participation rate, spread, floor, and buffer mechanics to the raw index change. Populated only after term completion. Null for open terms and VA sub-accounts.

attributes.name: crediting_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the FIA index crediting term in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for two-year). Defines the measurement period over which index performance is evaluated and interest is credited. Null for VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: declared_interest_rate
attributes.description: Fixed interest rate declared by the carrier for a fixed declared rate strategy bucket, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 3.5000 = 3.5%). Applicable only to FIXED_DECLARED and DECLARED_RATE strategy types. Null for index-linked and variable sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy is part of a Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program, where premium is systematically transferred from a fixed account into this strategy over a defined period. Common in variable annuity new business processing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this strategy election became or becomes effective for the contract. For FIA strategies, this typically aligns with the start of the crediting term. For VA sub-accounts, this is the date the allocation instruction took effect.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: election_source
attributes.description: Identifies the business event that created or last modified this strategy election.
