attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder or contract owner initiating the 1035 exchange. Used for KYC, AML, and tax reporting linkage.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or broker who facilitated the 1035 exchange transaction. Used for commission and suitability tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 2330

attributes.name: source_uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: 1035 exchanges INTO annuities from life insurance policies need to reference the original underwriting application for the surrendered life policy. Real business process: replacement documentation, su

attributes.name: aml_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review conducted for this 1035 exchange transaction. Large or unusual exchanges may trigger enhanced due diligence under BSA/AML requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Prevention Act; USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason for cancellation if the 1035 exchange was cancelled before completion. Captures owner-initiated cancellations, carrier rejections, or regulatory holds.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all funds were received from the source carrier and the exchange was fully processed and posted to the new annuity contract.

attributes.name: cost_basis_transferred
attributes.description: The investment in contract (cost basis) transferred from the source contract to the new annuity contract. Preserves the owner's after-tax basis for future distribution tax calculations under IRC Section 72.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 5498; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1035 exchange record was first created in the annuity administration system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Security Model Law

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this exchange record. Typically USD for domestic US annuity contracts.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the 1035 exchange is legally effective — i.e., when the transferred funds are applied to the new annuity contract and the tax-free treatment is established.

attributes.name: exchange_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business reference number assigned to this 1035 exchange transaction, used in correspondence with the source carrier and the contract owner.

attributes.name: exchange_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the 1035 exchange transaction. 'nigo' indicates the exchange is Not In Good Order and requires remediation before processing can continue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|completed|cancelled|nigo|rejected — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the 1035 exchange based on the source and target contract types as permitted under IRC Section 1035. Annuity-to-annuity and life-to-annuity are the most common types in the annuity domain.

attributes.name: form_1099r_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1099-R has been issued to the contract owner and filed with the IRS for this 1035 exchange transaction.

attributes.name: form_1099r_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 1099-R must be issued for this exchange. A 1099-R is required even for tax-free 1035 exchanges to report the distribution from the source contract, using distribution code 6.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 6047; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: form_5498_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 5498 has been issued to the contract owner and filed with the IRS for this 1035 exchange transaction.

attributes.name: form_5498_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 5498 must be issued by the receiving carrier to report the rollover or exchange contribution to the new annuity contract.

attributes.name: free_look_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the free-look (right to return) period expires for the new annuity contract issued as a result of this exchange. State-mandated free-look periods typically range from 10 to 30 days.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State DOI Free Look Requirements

attributes.name: funds_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transferred funds were actually received from the source carrier by the receiving company. Used to track processing timelines and determine the contract's account value start date.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; NAIC Annuity Administration Standards

attributes.name: gain_deferred
attributes.description: The amount of taxable gain deferred as a result of the 1035 exchange (transferred amount minus cost basis transferred). This gain is not recognized at the time of exchange but will be subject to ordinary income tax upon future distributions.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: is_mec_new_contract
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) New Contract Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new annuity contract issued as a result of this exchange is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC). Determined based on MEC carryover from source and new contract funding.

attributes.name: is_mec_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source contract was classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status carries over to the new contract in a 1035 exchange, affecting tax treatment of distributions.

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason(s) the exchange application was flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO). Documents the specific deficiency requiring remediation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: nigo_resolved_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Resolved Date
attributes.description: The date on which all NIGO deficiencies were resolved and the exchange application was cleared for processing.

attributes.name: nigo_status
attributes.description: Tracks the Not In Good Order (NIGO) resolution status for this exchange application. NIGO occurs when required documentation or information is missing or incorrect, preventing processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: partial_exchange_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a partial 1035 exchange (only a portion of the source contract's value is transferred) as opposed to a full exchange. Partial exchanges have specific IRS rules regarding basis allocation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Revenue Ruling 2003-76; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: replacement_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the replacement notice was sent to the contract owner as required by NAIC Model Regulation #613 and applicable state replacement regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Replacement of Life Insurance and Annuities Model Regulation (#613)

attributes.name: replacement_notice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required replacement notice (NAIC Model Regulation on Replacement of Life Insurance and Annuities) was sent to the contract owner prior to processing the exchange.
attributes.references: NAIC Replacement of Life Insurance and Annuities Model Regulation (#613); State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner formally submitted the 1035 exchange request. Used as the business event initiation date for processing timelines and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_account_value_at_exchange
attributes.description: The total account value (AV) of the source contract at the time of the exchange request. Used for partial exchange basis allocation calculations and suitability documentation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Revenue Ruling 2003-76; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_carrier_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Carrier National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: The five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the source carrier. Used for regulatory identification and carrier verification during the exchange process.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Licensing; NAIC Financial Data Repository

attributes.name: source_carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance company or financial institution from which the existing contract is being exchanged. Required for coordination of transfer and IRS Form 1099-R reporting.

attributes.name: source_contract_issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the source contract being exchanged. Used to determine the contract's age, surrender charge schedule applicability, and MEC status carryover.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: source_contract_number
attributes.description: The policy or contract number of the existing annuity or life insurance contract at the source carrier being surrendered as part of the 1035 exchange. Confidential business identifier.

attributes.name: source_contract_type
attributes.description: The product type of the source contract being exchanged. Determines eligibility under IRC Section 1035 and influences tax treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_annuity|variable_annuity|fia|whole_life|universal_life|term_life — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035(a); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: The surrender charge or contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC) assessed by the source carrier upon surrender of the existing contract as part of the exchange. Reduces the net transferred amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; SEC Rule 22c-1 (variable products)

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the suitability review conducted for this 1035 exchange under NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation and applicable state regulations. Ensures the exchange is in the best interest of the contract owner.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation (Model #275); DOL Fiduciary Rule; FINRA Rule 2330

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year in which the 1035 exchange is reportable for IRS purposes. Determines the tax reporting period for Form 1099-R and Form 5498 filings.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: transfer_method
attributes.description: The method by which funds were transferred from the source carrier to the receiving company. Affects processing timelines and reconciliation procedures.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Annuity Administration Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1035 exchange record was last modified in the annuity administration system. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Security Model Law

products.name: rider_benefit
products.description: Master record for each optional rider or benefit attached to an annuity contract, including GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB (Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit), enhanced death benefit, long-term care (LTC) riders, return-of-premium riders, and earnings enhancement riders. Captures rider type, rider effective date, rider charge rate, benefit election status, benefit trigger conditions, maximum benefit amount, rider termination conditions, and rider version/form number. Distinct from benefit_base which tracks the financial balance of living benefit guarantees; this entity tracks the contractual terms, eligibility rules, and charge structure of the rider.

attributes.name: rider_benefit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rider or optional benefit record attached to an annuity contract. Primary key of this entity. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a contractual benefit attachment with its own lifecycle, charge structure, and eligibility rules.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent annuity contract to which this rider or benefit is attached. Links the rider to its owning contract record in the annuity contract administration system.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: hedge_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Optional riders (death benefit enhancements, income riders) create guaranteed liabilities hedged via derivative portfolios. Risk management calculates net amount at risk, hedge effectiveness, and RBC

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Rider availability, charge rates, benefit structures, and eligibility rules vary by plan version. Essential for rider charge calculations, benefit eligibility validation, and tracking version-specific

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: Rider forms require separate state approval; rider_form_number must match approved filing. Links rider elections to approved form filings for compliance validation. Essential for market conduct exams

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider_definition. Business justification: Contract rider elections reference product rider definitions for benefit structure, charge rate schedules, eligibility rules, and underwriting requirements. Critical for rider charge calculations, ben

attributes.name: adl_trigger_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Activities of Daily Living (ADL) Trigger Count
attributes.description: Minimum number of Activities of Daily Living (ADL) impairments required to trigger benefit eligibility under an LTC rider. Typically 2 out of 6 standard ADLs per HIPAA Section 7702B. Null for non-LTC riders.
attributes.references: HIPAA Section 7702B; NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702B

attributes.name: annuitant_age_at_election
attributes.description: Age of the primary annuitant at the time the rider was elected, in whole years. Used to determine applicable withdrawal rate bands (for GMWB), benefit eligibility, and actuarial pricing. Critical for experience studies and LDTI cohort grouping.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: benefit_base_amount
attributes.description: Current dollar value of the guaranteed benefit base associated with this rider. For GMWB/GMIB/GMAB riders, this is the protected value used to calculate guaranteed withdrawals or income. Distinct from account value (AV); may be higher than AV after market downturns. Tracked separately in benefit_base product but captured here as the rider's principal financial fact.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: benefit_election_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner has formally elected to begin receiving benefits under this rider. Not_elected = rider is in force but benefits not yet activated; Elected = owner has triggered benefit commencement; In_payout = benefit payments are actively being made; Exhausted = benefit pool fully depleted; Waived = owner waived benefit election rights.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: benefit_eligible_date
attributes.description: Earliest calendar date on which the contract owner becomes eligible to elect or receive benefits under this rider, calculated from the effective_date plus any applicable waiting period. Used in customer service, benefit election processing, and proactive outreach campaigns.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: charge_basis
attributes.description: The financial base against which the rider charge rate is applied. Benefit_base = charge applied to the guaranteed benefit base; Account_value = charge applied to the current account value (AV); Premium_base = charge applied to cumulative premiums paid; NAV = charge applied to net asset value for variable products.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: charge_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the rider charge is assessed and deducted from the contract. Drives billing cycle integration and account value deduction scheduling in the annuity administration platform.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: charge_rate
attributes.description: Annual rider charge rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.009500 = 0.95% per annum) assessed against the benefit base or account value. This is the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used in premium billing, account value deduction calculations, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rider benefit record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Policy; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: death_benefit_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of death benefit provided by this rider for GMDB or enhanced death benefit riders. Return_of_premium = beneficiary receives at least cumulative premiums paid; Highest_anniversary = DB equals highest contract anniversary value; Earnings_enhancement = DB includes a percentage of earnings; Standard = base contract DB with no enhancement; None = rider does not provide a death benefit.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the rider becomes contractually effective and benefit guarantees begin to accrue. Marks the start of the rider's binding period. Used in benefit base calculations, waiting period tracking, and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract owner formally elected or added this rider to the annuity contract. May differ from effective_date if there is a processing lag or waiting period. Relevant for suitability review and new business processing audit trails.
attributes.references: FINRA Suitability Rules; NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: inflation_protection_type
attributes.description: Type of inflation protection feature included in the rider, primarily relevant for LTC riders. None = no inflation protection; Simple = benefit increases by a fixed percentage of the original benefit; Compound = benefit increases by a fixed percentage of the current benefit; CPI_linked = benefit increases tied to the Consumer Price Index.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: is_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider, once elected, cannot be removed by the contract owner during the contract's life (True = irrevocable; False = owner may remove the rider). Relevant for LTC riders and certain GMIB riders that become irrevocable upon benefit election.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: is_optional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider was optionally elected by the contract owner (True) or is a mandatory benefit included in the base contract without separate election (False). Drives charge assessment logic and suitability review requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; FINRA Suitability Rules

attributes.name: joint_life_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider covers both the primary annuitant and a joint annuitant (True = joint life coverage; False = single life coverage). Joint life riders typically carry a higher charge rate and provide continued benefits upon the death of the first annuitant.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: ltc_benefit_period_months
attributes.description: Maximum number of months for which long-term care benefits are payable under an LTC rider. Applicable only to LTC rider types. Null for non-LTC riders. Used in LTC benefit pool calculations and NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; HIPAA Section 7702B; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: max_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Contractual ceiling on the total benefit payable under this rider over its lifetime. Applicable to riders with aggregate benefit caps (e.g., LTC riders with lifetime maximum benefit pools, enhanced death benefit riders with maximum DB multiples). Null if no contractual maximum applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: max_charge_rate
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed maximum annual charge rate that the insurer may assess for this rider, expressed as a decimal. Protects the contract owner from unlimited charge increases. Required disclosure under NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance — Policy Form Filing Requirements

attributes.name: max_issue_age
attributes.description: Maximum age of the annuitant at which this rider may be elected, as defined in the rider's contractual terms. Used in new business eligibility validation and underwriting rules engine checks.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance — Policy Form Filing Requirements

attributes.name: min_issue_age
attributes.description: Minimum age of the annuitant at which this rider may be elected, as defined in the rider's contractual terms. Used in new business eligibility validation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance — Policy Form Filing Requirements

attributes.name: reinsurance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk associated with this rider is subject to a reinsurance treaty (True = reinsured; False = retained). Relevant for GMDB and LTC riders which are commonly reinsured. Drives cession processing in the reinsurance management system.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS — Treaty Management Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reserve_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis under which actuarial reserves for this rider are calculated. GAAP = Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (FASB ASC 944 / LDTI); SAP = Statutory Accounting Principles (NAIC); PBR = Principle-Based Reserving; IFRS17 = International Financial Reporting Standards 17. Used in actuarial valuation system configuration.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Principle-Based Reserving (PBR); IFRS 17

attributes.name: rider_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rider or benefit attachment. Active = rider is in force and charges are being assessed; Suspended = rider temporarily not in force (e.g., during free-look period); Terminated = rider has been removed or contract surrendered; Pending = rider elected but not yet effective; Lapsed = rider lapsed due to non-payment of rider charge; Matured = rider has reached its contractual maturity date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: rider_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the rider product design, corresponding to a specific generation of benefit terms, charge rates, and eligibility rules. Insurers periodically update rider versions; this field distinguishes legacy riders from current offerings and is critical for actuarial valuation and reserving under LDTI.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: rollup_period_years
attributes.description: Maximum number of years during which the guaranteed rollup rate is applied to grow the benefit base. After this period, the benefit base stops rolling up but the rider may remain in force. Null if rollup continues indefinitely until benefit election.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: rollup_rate
attributes.description: Annual guaranteed growth rate applied to the benefit base during the accumulation (deferral) phase, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 = 6.00% per annum). Applicable to GMWB, GMIB, and GMAB riders. Null for riders without a rollup feature. Critical input for actuarial reserving and LDTI cash flow projections.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rider benefit record was sourced (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Used for data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and Silver layer audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_rider_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this rider record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Sapiens Annuity internal rider ID). Enables back-referencing to the source system for reconciliation, issue resolution, and ETL lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: state_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes (2-letter USPS abbreviations) in which this rider form has been approved and is available for sale. Null or 'ALL' if available in all states. Used in new business eligibility validation and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance — Policy Form Filing Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: step_up_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the automatic step-up (ratchet) evaluation occurs for the benefit base. Annual = evaluated each contract anniversary; Triennial = every 3 years; Quinquennial = every 5 years; On_demand = owner may request step-up at any time subject to conditions; None = no step-up provision. Null if step_up_provision is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: step_up_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider includes an automatic or optional step-up (ratchet) provision that locks in market gains by resetting the benefit base to the current account value if the account value exceeds the benefit base on a specified anniversary date. True = step-up provision exists; False = no step-up.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the rider was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null if the rider is still in force. Populated upon rider lapse, voluntary removal, contract surrender, annuitization, or death claim settlement.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: termination_trigger
attributes.description: The contractual condition or event that caused or will cause this rider to terminate. Surrender = full contract surrender; Death = death of the annuitant or owner; Annuitization = contract converted to income stream; Account_value_zero = account value depleted to zero; Owner_request = voluntary rider removal by owner; Non_payment = rider charge could not be deducted. Null if rider is still active.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rider benefit record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance under SOX. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: waiting_period_years
attributes.description: Number of contract years that must elapse before the contract owner is eligible to elect benefits under this rider. Common for GMIB riders which typically require a 10-year deferral period before annuitization. Zero if no waiting period applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: withdrawal_rate
attributes.description: Annual guaranteed withdrawal percentage of the benefit base that the contract owner may withdraw each year without reducing the guaranteed benefit, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.050000 = 5.00%). Applicable to GMWB riders. May vary by age band at election. Null for non-GMWB riders.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; Sapiens Annuity — Withdrawal Processing Module

products.name: annuity_premium_payment
products.description: Records all premium and purchase payment transactions applied to annuity contracts, including initial single premiums, subsequent flexible premiums (for flexible premium deferred annuities), and 1035 exchange proceeds received. Captures payment date, payment amount, payment source (check, wire, ACH, 1035 exchange), tax qualification of payment (qualified/non-qualified), cost basis contribution, modal premium schedule reference, and NIGO resolution status. Distinct from billing domain premium billing records; this is the annuity-specific payment receipt ledger.

attributes.name: annuity_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each annuity premium payment transaction record in the annuity payment receipt ledger.

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AML case record in the compliance domain when this payment has been escalated for AML investigation. Null if no AML case has been opened for this payment.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this premium payment is applied. Links the payment to the contract administration record in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Premium receipts require journal entries for cash receipt (debit), premium revenue recognition (credit), premium load (credit), and DAC capitalization (debit). Core accounting transaction for every pr

attributes.name: modal_premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the modal premium schedule that governs the payment frequency and amount for flexible premium deferred annuities. Null for single-premium or ad-hoc payments not tied to a scheduled billing cycle.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: owner_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record of the annuity contract owner who is making or authorizing the premium payment. Used for KYC/AML validation and tax reporting under IRC Section 72.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks employee who processed premium payment for audit trails, error resolution, compliance reviews, and fraud prevention. Required for SOX controls, quality assurance, and operational accountability

attributes.name: suitability_review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the suitability review record in the compliance domain associated with this premium payment, particularly for subsequent premium payments that may trigger re-suitability assessment under NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation (#275); FINRA Rule 2330; DOL Fiduciary Rule

attributes.name: suspense_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the suspense account record where the payment funds are held pending NIGO resolution or contract identification. Null for payments applied directly without suspense.
attributes.references: SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: uw_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Premium payments on annuities may reference the originating underwriting application for audit trail, especially for 1035 exchanges from life policies or initial annuity applications requiring underwr

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: The ACH trace number assigned by the originating depository financial institution (ODFI) for ACH electronic payment transactions. Used for NACHA reconciliation and return item tracking when payment_source is 'ach'.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; FinCEN AML/BSA; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: aml_review_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment has been flagged for AML review due to large cash transaction reporting thresholds, structuring patterns, or other suspicious activity indicators per FinCEN BSA requirements.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The net dollar amount actually credited to the annuity contract Account Value (AV) after deduction of any applicable premium load, surrender charges on exchanged contracts, or other fees. May equal gross_payment_amount if no deductions apply.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: bonus_credited_amount
attributes.description: The actual dollar amount of premium bonus credited to the contract AV as a result of this payment. Calculated as bonus_eligible_amount multiplied by the applicable bonus rate per the contract terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: bonus_eligible_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross payment amount that qualifies for a premium bonus credit under the annuity contract terms. Some annuity products offer a percentage bonus on qualifying premium payments. Null if the contract does not offer a premium bonus.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number printed on the physical check when payment_source is 'check'. Used for bank reconciliation and payment tracing. Null for non-check payment sources.
attributes.references: SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year in which this payment falls, calculated from the contract issue date. Used for surrender charge schedule application, bonus crediting eligibility, and actuarial valuation purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: cost_basis_contribution
attributes.description: The after-tax cost basis amount contributed by this payment to the annuity contract's cumulative investment in the contract (IIC). For non-qualified annuities, this is the after-tax portion of the payment. For qualified annuities, this is typically zero. Critical for IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio calculations and IRS Form 1099-R reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was first created in the annuity administration system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Typically 'USD' for domestic US annuity contracts. Required for multi-currency reporting and GAAP/SAP financial statements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The contract effective date on which the payment is credited to the annuity contract Account Value (AV). May differ from payment_date due to processing lag, back-dating rules, or 1035 exchange settlement timing.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: exchange_cost_basis_received
attributes.description: The cost basis (investment in the contract) transferred from the surrendered contract in a 1035 exchange. This amount carries over to the new annuity contract and is critical for IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio calculations. Null for non-exchange payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: exchange_source_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or financial institution from which 1035 exchange proceeds were transferred. Required for 1035 exchange documentation and AML source-of-funds verification.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: exchange_source_contract_number
attributes.description: The contract or policy number of the surrendered/exchanged contract from which 1035 exchange proceeds originated. Required for IRS Form 1035 documentation and audit trail when is_1035_exchange = true. Null for non-exchange payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Form 1035; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total gross dollar amount of the premium payment as received from the payor before any deductions, fees, or adjustments. This is the base monetary amount used for AV crediting and cost basis calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; SAP

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment represents proceeds received from a tax-free 1035 exchange (IRC Section 1035 — Tax-Free Insurance Policy Exchange). When true, additional 1035 exchange tracking fields apply and the payment requires IRS Form 1035 documentation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Form 1035; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_unscheduled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment is an unscheduled additional premium contribution not tied to the modal premium schedule. Common for flexible premium deferred annuities where owners make ad-hoc contributions.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the NIGO deficiency reason when nigo_status is 'nigo_pending' or 'nigo_rejected'. Examples: missing suitability form, missing signature, missing source of funds documentation, incomplete beneficiary designation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FINRA Suitability Rules; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: nigo_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NIGO deficiency was resolved and the payment was cleared for application to the annuity contract. Null if nigo_status is 'good_order' or 'nigo_pending'.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: nigo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment application was received in good order or flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO). 'good_order' = all required documentation and information received; 'nigo_pending' = deficiency identified, awaiting resolution; 'nigo_resolved' = NIGO deficiency resolved and payment applied; 'nigo_rejected' = NIGO could not be resolved and payment returned.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; FINRA Suitability Rules

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the premium payment was received by the company. This is the principal real-world event date used for contract crediting, cost basis tracking, and IRC Section 72 tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The modal frequency at which this payment is made under the contract's premium schedule. 'single' = one-time single premium; 'annual' = annual mode; 'semi_annual' = semi-annual mode; 'quarterly' = quarterly mode; 'monthly' = monthly mode. Drives premium billing schedule and APE (Annual Premium Equivalent) calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this premium payment transaction by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Used for reconciliation, customer correspondence, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: payment_source
attributes.description: The remittance instrument or channel through which the premium payment funds were received. Drives reconciliation workflows and AML monitoring thresholds. 'check' = personal or cashier's check; 'wire' = wire transfer; 'ach' = ACH electronic funds transfer; '1035_exchange' = proceeds from a 1035 tax-free exchange; 'rollover_check' = qualified plan rollover check; 'credit_card' = credit card payment.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the premium payment transaction. 'pending' = received but not yet applied to contract AV; 'posted' = successfully applied; 'reversed' = payment reversed after posting; 'returned' = payment returned by financial institution (e.g., NSF); 'suspended' = held in suspense pending NIGO resolution; 'rejected' = rejected and not applied.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the premium payment by its business purpose. 'initial_single_premium' = first and only premium for SPIAs or single-premium deferred annuities; 'subsequent_flexible_premium' = additional premium for flexible premium deferred annuities; '1035_exchange_proceeds' = funds received via a tax-free 1035 exchange; 'rollover' = qualified plan rollover (IRA, 401k); 'transfer' = direct trustee-to-trustee transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_single_premium|subsequent_flexible_premium|1035_exchange_proceeds|rollover|transfer|direct_transfer|trustee_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: payor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity that remitted the premium payment. May differ from the contract owner when a third party remits payment. Required for AML/KYC source-of-funds verification and IRS tax reporting.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; IRS Form 1099-R; KYC Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: payor_relationship_to_owner
attributes.description: Describes the relationship of the payor to the annuity contract owner when the payor is not the owner. Used for AML third-party payment monitoring and suitability review. 'self' = owner is the payor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|trust|employer|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: premium_load_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of premium load or front-end charge deducted from the gross payment before crediting to the contract AV. Represents the difference between gross_payment_amount and applied_amount attributable to premium loads.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment reversal was processed and the AV adjustment was made to the annuity contract. Null for non-reversed payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; SAP; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for payment reversal when payment_status is 'reversed'. Examples: duplicate payment, incorrect contract application, owner request, NSF return. Null for non-reversed payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; SAP; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled premium amount for this payment period as defined in the modal premium schedule. Compared against gross_payment_amount to identify over-payments, under-payments, or unscheduled additional premiums.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this payment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY' = Sapiens Annuity platform; 'FAST_ANNUITY' = FAST Annuity platform; 'POLICY_ADMIN' = Policy Administration System; 'MANUAL' = manually entered correction.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier assigned by the originating operational system (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity) for this payment record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between Silver Layer and source systems, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: tax_qualification_code
attributes.description: Indicates the tax qualification status of the premium payment, which determines cost basis treatment and tax reporting obligations under IRC Section 72. 'qualified' = pre-tax qualified plan funds (IRA, 401k, 403b); 'non_qualified' = after-tax funds; 'roth_ira' = Roth IRA funds; 'sep_ira' = SEP-IRA; 'simple_ira' = SIMPLE IRA; '403b' = 403(b) tax-sheltered annuity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qualified|non_qualified|roth_ira|sep_ira|simple_ira|403b|457b|pension — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Annuity Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was last modified in the annuity administration system. Tracks status changes, NIGO resolution updates, and corrections.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: wire_reference_number
attributes.description: The wire transfer reference or IMAD (Input Message Accountability Data) number assigned by the sending financial institution when payment_source is 'wire'. Used for Fedwire reconciliation and AML source-of-funds documentation.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; Federal Reserve Fedwire Standards; ACORD Standards

products.name: cost_basis_ledger
products.description: Tracks the investment in contract (cost basis) for each annuity contract for IRC Section 72 tax reporting purposes. Captures cumulative after-tax premiums paid, cost basis adjustments from 1035 exchanges, partial surrender cost basis recovery, exclusion ratio calculation inputs, total distributions received, remaining investment in contract, and MEC (Modified Endowment Contract) status flag. Essential for accurate 1099-R tax reporting and IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio calculations for non-qualified annuities.
products.reference: IRC Section 72 Investment in Contract / Cost Basis

attributes.name: cost_basis_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cost basis ledger record in the annuity domain. Primary key for the cost_basis_ledger data product.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract for which this cost basis ledger record is maintained. Links to the annuity contract master.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: contract_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract owner (policyholder) party record. The owner is the taxpayer responsible for IRC Section 72 cost basis tracking and 1099-R reporting.

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: Exclusion ratio calculations for annuity taxation use IRS mortality tables (IRC Section 72) to determine expected return. Required for accurate Form 1099-R reporting, tax compliance, and audit defense

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Tax qualification rules, IRC 72 compliance parameters, and exclusion ratio calculations are version-specific. Required for accurate 1099-R reporting, cost basis recovery calculations, and ensuring ver

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_provision. Business justification: Cost basis tracking feeds deferred tax calculations for temporary differences between book and tax basis on annuity contracts. Required for effective tax rate calculation and deferred tax asset/liabil

attributes.name: tax_qualification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_tax_qualification. Business justification: Cost basis tracking and tax treatment rules reference product tax qualification definitions for IRC 72 compliance, distribution codes, withholding requirements, and RMD applicability. Essential for ac

attributes.name: annual_exclusion_amount
attributes.description: The annual dollar amount of annuity payments that is excludable from gross income under the exclusion ratio. Equals the periodic payment amount times payment frequency times the exclusion ratio. Reported as the non-taxable amount on IRS Form 1099-R.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(b); IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: annuitization_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the annuity contract entered the payout (annuitization) phase. Marks the transition from accumulation to distribution phase and triggers the exclusion ratio calculation for periodic payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(b); Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: annuity_start_date_basis
attributes.description: Indicates the event that established the annuity start date for IRC Section 72 purposes. Determines which date is used as the reference point for expected return and exclusion ratio calculations.

attributes.name: contract_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the annuity contract was originally issued. Establishes the start of the investment-in-contract accumulation period for IRC Section 72 cost basis purposes.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; Sapiens Annuity Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: cost_basis_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for the most recent adjustment to the investment in contract. Used for audit trail and tax reporting reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1035_exchange_in|1035_exchange_out|partial_surrender|correction|court_order|divorce_transfer|death_claim|annuitization|premium_addition — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost basis ledger record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: cumulative_premiums_paid
attributes.description: Total after-tax premium contributions made to the annuity contract since inception or since the last 1035 exchange. Represents the gross cost basis before adjustments for tax-free distributions received.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this cost basis ledger record. Typically USD for domestic annuity contracts.

attributes.name: distribution_code
attributes.description: The IRS distribution code to be reported in Box 7 of IRS Form 1099-R. Indicates the type of distribution for tax purposes (e.g., 1=early distribution no exception, 2=early distribution exception applies, 4=death, 6=1035 exchange, 7=normal distribution). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9|A|B|C|D|E|F|G|H|J|K|L|M|N|P|Q|R|S|T|U|W — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: early_withdrawal_penalty_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 10% additional tax on early distributions under IRC Section 72(q) applies to distributions from this contract. True if the owner is under age 59½ and no exception applies.

attributes.name: exchange_basis_received
attributes.description: The cost basis transferred into this annuity contract from a prior contract via a tax-free 1035 exchange. Carries over the investment-in-contract from the surrendered contract per IRC Section 1035.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: exchange_basis_transferred_out
attributes.description: The cost basis transferred out of this annuity contract to a receiving contract via a tax-free 1035 exchange. Reduces the investment-in-contract of this contract.

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the investment in contract to the expected return, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.35000000 = 35%). Applied to each annuity payment to determine the non-taxable portion under IRC Section 72(b). Calculated as remaining_investment_in_contract divided by expected_return.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(b); IRS Publication 939; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio_exhausted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investment in contract has been fully recovered through prior non-taxable distributions. When True, all future annuity payments are fully taxable with no exclusion allowed under IRC Section 72(b)(2).

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio_exhausted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investment in contract was fully recovered and the exclusion ratio was exhausted. Null if the exclusion ratio has not yet been exhausted.

attributes.name: expected_return
attributes.description: The total amount expected to be received under the annuity contract over the payment period, calculated using IRS actuarial tables (life expectancy multiples) per IRC Section 72(c). Used as the denominator in the exclusion ratio calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(c); IRS Publication 939; IRS Actuarial Tables

attributes.name: expected_return_multiple
attributes.description: The life expectancy multiple from the applicable IRS actuarial table (IRS Publication 939) used to calculate the expected return. Expressed in years (e.g., 20.0 years). Multiplied by the annual payment amount to derive the expected return.

attributes.name: form_1099r_box1_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form 1099-R Box 1 Gross Distribution Amount
attributes.description: The gross distribution amount to be reported in Box 1 of IRS Form 1099-R for the applicable tax year. Represents total distributions paid from the contract during the tax year.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 72; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: form_1099r_box2a_amount
attributes.description: The taxable amount to be reported in Box 2a of IRS Form 1099-R for the applicable tax year. Represents the portion of gross distributions that is includable in gross income after applying the exclusion ratio.

attributes.name: form_1099r_taxable_amount_not_determined
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form 1099-R Taxable Amount Not Determined Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the taxable amount cannot be determined by the insurance company and Box 2b 'Taxable amount not determined' should be checked on IRS Form 1099-R. True when the company lacks sufficient cost basis information to compute the taxable amount.

attributes.name: investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The cumulative after-tax investment in the annuity contract as defined under IRC Section 72(e)(6). Represents the total premiums paid less any amounts previously received tax-free. This is the primary cost basis figure used for exclusion ratio calculations and 1099-R reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(e)(6); IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent adjustment to the investment in contract (cost basis). Used for audit trail and reconciliation with the annuity administration platform.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: ledger_as_of_date
attributes.description: The business date through which this cost basis ledger snapshot is current. Used for point-in-time reporting, year-end tax reporting, and 1099-R preparation.

attributes.name: ledger_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost basis ledger record became effective, typically the contract issue date or the date of a 1035 exchange that established the initial investment in contract.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost basis ledger record. Active indicates ongoing tracking; closed indicates the contract has been fully surrendered or annuitized; suspended indicates a hold pending review or correction; pending_review indicates an audit or reconciliation is in progress.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: mec_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was determined to be or not to be a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC). Null if MEC determination has not been triggered.

attributes.name: mec_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of distributions, subjecting them to LIFO (last-in, first-out) income recognition and potential 10% penalty tax.

attributes.name: nontaxable_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as non-taxable return of cost basis (investment in contract) under the IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio. Reduces the remaining investment in contract.

attributes.name: owner_age_at_annuity_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Owner Age at Annuity Start Date
attributes.description: The age of the contract owner at the annuity start date, used for IRS actuarial table lookups (Tables V, VI, VII in IRS Publication 939) to determine the expected return multiple for the exclusion ratio calculation.

attributes.name: partial_surrender_basis_adjustment
attributes.description: Cumulative reduction to the investment in contract resulting from partial surrenders or withdrawals that returned cost basis to the owner. Tracks the pro-rata cost basis recovery applied to partial surrenders of non-qualified annuities.

attributes.name: payout_option
attributes.description: The annuitization payout option elected by the contract owner. Determines the expected return calculation method and applicable IRS actuarial table (Table V, VI, or VII) for the exclusion ratio.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(c); IRS Publication 939; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: periodic_payment_amount
attributes.description: The fixed periodic payment amount received under the annuitization option. Used to calculate the annual exclusion amount (periodic_payment_amount multiplied by payment frequency multiplied by exclusion_ratio).

attributes.name: remaining_investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The remaining unrecovered cost basis in the annuity contract as of the ledger_as_of_date. Calculated as investment_in_contract minus nontaxable_distributions_received. Drives the exclusion ratio for future annuity payments.

attributes.name: source_contract_number
attributes.description: The contract number of the prior annuity or life insurance contract from which cost basis was received via a 1035 exchange. Null if no 1035 exchange occurred.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year for which this cost basis ledger snapshot is prepared. Used for annual 1099-R tax reporting and IRS compliance. Format: YYYY (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: taxable_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as taxable income (earnings above cost basis) under IRC Section 72. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 2a.

attributes.name: total_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative gross distributions (withdrawals, partial surrenders, annuity payments) received from the contract since inception. Used in conjunction with the exclusion ratio to determine the taxable and non-taxable portions of each distribution.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost basis ledger record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: contract_valuation
products.description: Periodic valuation snapshot of each annuity contract capturing the full financial position at a valuation date. Records contract AV, surrender value (CSV), death benefit amount, GMDB value, GMWB benefit base, GMIB benefit base, GMAB benefit base, net amount at risk (NAR) for each guarantee, accrued rider charges, and statutory reserve estimate. Supports actuarial valuation feeds, policyholder annual statements, and LDTI/IFRS 17 reporting. Generated at each valuation cycle (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: contract_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contract valuation snapshot record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract being valued. Links this valuation snapshot to the parent annuity contract master record.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gaap_reserve. Business justification: Valuation outputs feed GAAP reserve calculations for financial statement liability reporting under LDTI. Actuarial cash flow projections and discount rates from valuation runs populate reserve balance

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract owner/policyholder party record. Supports policyholder-level aggregation and annual statement generation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.service_order. Business justification: Actuarial valuation services (statutory reserves, GAAP calculations, assumption reviews) are commonly outsourced to consulting firms. Linking valuations to vendor service orders enables cost tracking

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Valuation run results directly populate statutory reserve amounts for regulatory filings. Actuarial valuation outputs feed reserve balances reported in NAIC Annual Statement and state regulatory submi

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial valuation batch run that produced this record. Enables traceability of valuation results back to a specific run of the actuarial valuation system (MoSes, AXIS, or Prophet). Supports audit and restatement workflows.
attributes.references: SOX; Internal Actuarial Governance Policy; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: account_value
attributes.description: The total Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of the valuation date. Represents the accumulated fund value including premiums paid, credited interest/index credits, and less withdrawals and charges. Core financial metric for annuity contract administration.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: accrued_rider_charges
attributes.description: Total rider charges accrued but not yet deducted from the AV as of the valuation date. Includes charges for GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB, and other optional benefit riders. Used for accurate AV reconciliation and income statement accruals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: annuitization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract transitioned from the accumulation phase to the annuitization/payout phase. Null if the contract has not yet been annuitized. Triggers shift from AV-based to income-stream-based valuation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: cash_surrender_value
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) available to the contract owner upon full surrender as of the valuation date. Equals AV less applicable surrender charges and market value adjustments. Used for policyholder statements and surrender processing.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: contract_phase
attributes.description: Current lifecycle phase of the annuity contract at the valuation date. Accumulation phase tracks AV growth; annuitization/payout phase tracks income stream; surrender and death claim phases indicate terminal events.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The owner's investment in the contract (cost basis) as of the valuation date per IRC Section 72. Represents after-tax premiums paid less any tax-free distributions received. Used to determine the taxable gain upon surrender or annuitization.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract valuation record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX.

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: The current credited interest rate applied to the contract AV for the valuation period. For fixed annuities, this is the declared rate. For FIA contracts, this reflects the effective rate after index crediting. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this valuation record. Typically USD for domestic US annuity contracts.

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The Death Benefit (DB) payable to the beneficiary upon the death of the annuitant or contract owner as of the valuation date. May equal AV, a return-of-premium guarantee, or a stepped-up value depending on contract terms.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: gaap_reserve
attributes.description: The GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) reserve for this contract as of the valuation date, calculated under FASB ASC 944 including LDTI requirements. Supports financial statement reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); GAAP; SOX; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmab_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) benefit base as of the valuation date. Represents the guaranteed minimum AV at the end of the accumulation period, protecting against investment losses.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmab_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMAB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMAB benefit base and maturity guarantee calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: gmdb_value
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) base or benefit amount as of the valuation date. Represents the minimum death benefit guaranteed regardless of investment performance. Applicable for variable and indexed annuities with GMDB riders.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Variable Annuity Reserve Standards; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmib_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base as of the valuation date. Used to calculate the minimum annuitization income stream the contract owner is guaranteed upon exercising the GMIB rider.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmib_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMIB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMIB benefit base calculations and annuitization guarantee valuations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: gmwb_annual_withdrawal_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Annual Withdrawal Amount
attributes.description: The maximum annual withdrawal amount guaranteed under the GMWB rider as of the valuation date. Calculated as the GMWB benefit base multiplied by the applicable withdrawal percentage. Used for RMD compliance checks and policyholder benefit illustrations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS RMD Rules; NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base as of the valuation date. This is the notional amount used to calculate the guaranteed annual withdrawal amount, which may differ from AV due to step-ups, roll-ups, or bonus credits.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmwb_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMWB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMWB benefit base and NAR calculations in the valuation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: index_credit_amount
attributes.description: The index credit amount applied to the contract AV during the current index crediting period as of the valuation date. Applicable for Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) contracts. Reflects the gain linked to the selected index strategy.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract was funded via a 1035 tax-free exchange from a prior insurance or annuity contract. True if funded by 1035 exchange; False if funded by direct premium. Affects cost basis tracking and tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: is_mec
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of withdrawals and loans. True if MEC; False otherwise.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; IRS; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the annuity contract. Used to calculate contract duration, surrender charge schedule position, and benefit base roll-up periods.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: market_value_adjustment
attributes.description: The Market Value Adjustment (MVA) applicable to the contract as of the valuation date. Positive or negative adjustment applied to the surrender value based on changes in interest rates since contract issue. Applicable for MVA-type fixed annuities.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The contractual maturity date of the annuity contract, after which the contract must be annuitized or surrendered per contract terms. Used for GMAB maturity benefit calculations and policyholder notifications.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: nar_gmdb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB)
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the GMDB rider as of the valuation date. Calculated as the excess of the GMDB value over the current AV. Represents the insurer's economic exposure on the death benefit guarantee. Key input for actuarial reserving and reinsurance cession.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: nar_gmwb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB)
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the GMWB rider as of the valuation date. Represents the present value of projected future guaranteed withdrawals in excess of projected AV. Key input for LDTI/IFRS 17 liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System

attributes.name: product_code
