attributes.description: Code identifying the specific annuity product type (e.g., FIA, SPIA, variable annuity, fixed annuity) associated with this contract. Drives product-specific valuation logic and benefit calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; Internal Product Taxonomy

attributes.name: rmd_amount
attributes.description: The Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) amount calculated for the contract for the current tax year as of the valuation date. Applicable for qualified annuity contracts (IRA, 401(k)). Ensures IRS compliance under IRC Section 401(a)(9).
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS RMD Rules; Annuity Administration Platform — RMD Tracking Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system that originated this valuation data. Supports data lineage tracking across the lakehouse Silver layer.

attributes.name: statutory_reserve
attributes.description: The estimated statutory reserve for this contract as of the valuation date, calculated under SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles) per NAIC requirements. Includes Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method (CARVM) or Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) as applicable. Feeds state regulatory reserve filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SAP; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: The contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC) or surrender charge applicable to the contract as of the valuation date. Deducted from AV to arrive at CSV. Typically declines over the surrender charge period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; SEC (for variable products); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: surrender_charge_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the surrender charge period expires for this contract. After this date, the contract owner may surrender without incurring a surrender charge. Key date for policyholder communications and surrender processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: tax_qualification_type
attributes.description: The tax qualification status of the annuity contract. Determines applicable IRC tax rules, RMD requirements, and 1099-R reporting codes. Non-qualified contracts are funded with after-tax dollars; qualified contracts are funded with pre-tax dollars. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_qualified|traditional_ira|roth_ira|401k|403b|sep_ira|simple_ira — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Sections 72, 401, 403, 408; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract valuation record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Tracks restatements, corrections, and status transitions for audit purposes.

attributes.name: valuation_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency classification of this valuation run. Indicates whether the snapshot was generated as part of a daily, monthly, quarterly, or annual valuation cycle. Drives downstream actuarial and reporting workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Internal Actuarial Valuation Policy

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this valuation snapshot. Represents the specific calendar date on which all financial positions (AV, CSV, DB, guarantees) are measured. Used as the primary time dimension for actuarial feeds, LDTI/IFRS 17 reporting, and policyholder statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Actuarial Guideline; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this valuation record. Preliminary records are in-process; final records are approved for reporting; restated records reflect corrections; superseded records have been replaced by a newer run for the same contract and valuation date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Internal Actuarial Governance Policy

attributes.name: ytd_withdrawals
attributes.description: Total withdrawal amounts taken from the contract from the beginning of the current contract year through the valuation date. Used to determine excess withdrawal amounts that may reduce the GMWB benefit base and for IRC Section 72 tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Tax Reporting; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

products.name: systematic_withdrawal_plan
products.description: Defines the standing systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) instructions for annuity contracts where the owner has elected recurring periodic withdrawals. Captures SWP start date, SWP frequency (monthly, quarterly, annual), SWP amount or percentage, SWP end date or duration, tax withholding election (federal and state), payment method and banking instructions, RMD coordination flag, and SWP suspension/reinstatement history. Sourced from Sapiens Annuity and FAST Annuity withdrawal processing modules.

attributes.name: systematic_withdrawal_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the systematic withdrawal plan record in the annuity administration platform. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Systematic withdrawal plans require billing accounts for automated recurring disbursements. Real business process: automated payment scheduling, bank account validation, RMD coordination. Essential fo

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract for which this systematic withdrawal plan is established. Links the SWP to its parent annuity contract record.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — contract administration module

attributes.name: authorization_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Systematic withdrawal plan setup requires signed authorization with bank account verification per operational controls. Links SWP record to authorization document for audit trail, bank account validat

attributes.name: established_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks employee who established systematic withdrawal plan for audit trails, compliance reviews, customer service escalations, and error resolution. Essential for operational accountability in automat

attributes.name: owner_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract owner who elected and authorized the systematic withdrawal plan. Used for tax reporting and owner-level analytics.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: suitability_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.suitability_review. Business justification: SWP elections require suitability assessment per Reg 187 and Best Interest standards, especially when coordinated with GMWB riders or RMD requirements. Tracks suitability determination for systematic

attributes.name: amount_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal instruction is expressed as a fixed dollar amount or as a percentage of the account value (AV). Determines how the gross withdrawal amount is calculated each period.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number designated for ACH disbursement of systematic withdrawal proceeds. Full account number is stored in a tokenized vault; this masked value is retained for display and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; NAIC

attributes.name: bank_account_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the full bank account number stored in the secure payment vault. Used for ACH processing without exposing the raw account number in the data lakehouse. Applicable when payment_method is 'ach'.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; NAIC

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account designated to receive ACH systematic withdrawal disbursements. Applicable when payment_method is 'ach'.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution designated to receive ACH or wire systematic withdrawal disbursements. Used for reconciliation and owner correspondence.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit ABA routing transit number of the financial institution designated to receive ACH systematic withdrawal disbursements. Applicable when payment_method is 'ach'.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; NAIC

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the systematic withdrawal plan was cancelled or permanently terminated by the contract owner or by the system (e.g., upon full surrender or annuitization). Null for active plans.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this systematic withdrawal plan record was first created in the annuity administration system. Represents the audit creation time in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this systematic withdrawal plan. Typically USD for domestic annuity contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the systematic withdrawal plan became or becomes operationally effective in the annuity administration system. May differ from election_date due to processing lead time or contractual notice periods.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner formally elected and submitted the systematic withdrawal plan instructions to the annuity administrator. Represents the business event date of the owner's decision.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the systematic withdrawal plan is set to terminate. Null for open-ended plans with no defined termination date. May be derived from a specified duration or explicitly elected by the owner.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: excess_withdrawal_handling
attributes.description: Instruction governing how the system should handle a scheduled SWP withdrawal that would exceed the free withdrawal limit. 'reduce_to_free_amount' caps the disbursement at the free withdrawal amount; 'process_with_charges' processes the full amount and applies surrender charges; 'reject' cancels the withdrawal and notifies the owner; 'owner_notify' processes and sends an excess withdrawal notice.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: federal_withholding_election
attributes.description: The contract owner's federal income tax withholding election for systematic withdrawal payments. 'withhold' applies the default 10% withholding; 'do_not_withhold' opts out of withholding; 'withhold_at_rate' applies a custom rate specified in federal_withholding_rate.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3405; IRS Form W-4P; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: federal_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The custom federal income tax withholding rate elected by the contract owner, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Applicable only when federal_withholding_election is 'withhold_at_rate'. Null otherwise.

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_limit_pct
attributes.description: The contractual percentage of account value (AV) that may be withdrawn annually without incurring surrender charges, as defined in the annuity contract terms. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). Used to assess whether SWP amounts remain within the free withdrawal corridor.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — contract administration module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Recurring payment frequency for the systematic withdrawal plan. Determines how often withdrawals are processed and disbursed to the contract owner.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: is_gmwb_coordinated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Coordination Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this systematic withdrawal plan is coordinated with a Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) rider on the annuity contract. When true, withdrawal amounts are constrained to the GMWB maximum annual withdrawal amount to preserve the benefit base.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — benefit calculations module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_rmd_coordinated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this systematic withdrawal plan is coordinated with the IRS Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) obligation for the contract. When true, the plan amount is adjusted annually to satisfy the RMD calculated for the contract year.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: next_withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next systematic withdrawal is scheduled to be processed under this plan. Updated after each successful withdrawal cycle.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method elected by the contract owner for receiving systematic withdrawal proceeds. 'ach' indicates electronic funds transfer via ACH; 'check' indicates paper check mailed to address of record; 'wire' indicates wire transfer.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the systematic withdrawal plan as assigned by the annuity administration system (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Used in owner correspondence and service requests.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the systematic withdrawal plan. 'active' indicates withdrawals are being processed per schedule; 'suspended' indicates temporary halt; 'cancelled' indicates permanent termination; 'pending' indicates election received but not yet activated; 'completed' indicates plan reached its natural end date or duration; 'pending_reinstatement' indicates a reinstatement request is in progress.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SWP withdrawal basis. 'fixed_amount' disburses a set dollar amount each period; 'fixed_percentage' disburses a percentage of account value; 'interest_only' disburses credited interest only; 'rmd_driven' is calibrated to satisfy IRS Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) obligations; 'gmwb_maximum' disburses the maximum Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) allowable amount; 'custom' covers non-standard arrangements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B (RMD); NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent suspension of the systematic withdrawal plan was lifted and the plan was reinstated to active status. Null if the plan has never been reinstated.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: rmd_calculation_method
attributes.description: The IRS life expectancy table method used to calculate the annual RMD amount when is_rmd_coordinated is true. 'uniform_lifetime' applies the Uniform Lifetime Table; 'joint_life_expectancy' applies the Joint and Last Survivor Table for a spouse beneficiary more than 10 years younger; 'single_life_expectancy' applies the Single Life Expectancy Table.
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS Publication 590-B; Treasury Regulation 1.401(a)(9)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this systematic withdrawal plan record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer. 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY' indicates Sapiens Annuity platform; 'FAST_ANNUITY' indicates FAST Annuity platform; 'MANUAL' indicates manual entry.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_plan_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this systematic withdrawal plan record in the originating operational system (Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Retained for traceability and reconciliation between the Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the first systematic withdrawal under this plan is scheduled to be processed. Marks the beginning of the recurring withdrawal schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: state_withholding_election
attributes.description: The contract owner's state income tax withholding election for systematic withdrawal payments. 'withhold' applies the applicable state default rate; 'do_not_withhold' opts out; 'withhold_at_rate' applies a custom rate specified in state_withholding_rate.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; State Revenue Authorities; IRC Section 3405

attributes.name: state_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The custom state income tax withholding rate elected by the contract owner, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Applicable only when state_withholding_election is 'withhold_at_rate'. Null otherwise.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; State Revenue Authorities

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the suitability review conducted for this systematic withdrawal plan election, as required under NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation and applicable state regulations. 'approved' indicates the plan passed suitability review; 'pending' indicates review is in progress; 'not_required' indicates the plan is exempt; 'flagged' indicates a suitability concern was identified.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation (#275); DOL Fiduciary Rule; SEC Regulation Best Interest

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the systematic withdrawal plan was most recently suspended. Null if the plan has never been suspended or has been reinstated. Used in conjunction with reinstatement_date for suspension/reinstatement history tracking.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for the most recent suspension of the systematic withdrawal plan. 'owner_request' indicates voluntary suspension by the contract owner; 'rmd_recalculation' indicates suspension pending annual RMD recalculation; 'contract_lapse' indicates suspension due to contract lapse; 'legal_hold' indicates suspension due to a legal or compliance hold; 'system_error' indicates a processing error.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; NAIC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this systematic withdrawal plan record was most recently modified in the annuity administration system. Updated on any change to plan instructions, status, banking details, or withholding elections.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount to be withdrawn each period when amount_type is 'dollar'. Null when amount_type is 'percentage'. Subject to free withdrawal limits and surrender charge calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: withdrawal_day_of_month
attributes.description: The calendar day of the month (1–28) on which the recurring withdrawal is processed. Capped at 28 to avoid month-end ambiguity across February and short months.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module

attributes.name: withdrawal_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the annuity account value (AV) to be withdrawn each period when amount_type is 'percentage'. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Null when amount_type is 'dollar'.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: withholding_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state jurisdiction for which state income tax withholding is applied on systematic withdrawal payments. Typically the owner's state of residence at time of election.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC; IRS Publication 505

products.name: sub_account_allocation
products.description: Manages the sub-account investment allocations for variable annuity (VUL annuity) contracts, defining how the contract AV is distributed across available investment options (equity funds, bond funds, money market, fixed account). Captures sub-account fund name, fund CUSIP, allocation percentage, current unit value, number of units held, current market value, allocation effective date, and rebalancing instructions. Supports NAV-based AV calculations and investment performance attribution for variable annuity contracts.

attributes.name: sub_account_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each sub-account allocation record within a variable annuity contract. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the variable annuity contract to which this sub-account allocation belongs. Links the allocation to the parent annuity contract record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund (sub-account) available within the variable annuity separate account. Identifies the specific fund option selected by the contract owner.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: allocation_instruction_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating source of the allocation instruction. Distinguishes between owner-directed, agent-directed, system-default, automatic rebalancing, DCA transfer, and system-generated allocations. Used for suitability review and audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; DOL Fiduciary Rule; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this sub-account allocation record, as assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity). Used in client statements and correspondence.

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of new premium and/or rebalancing proceeds directed to this sub-account fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). All active allocations for a contract must sum to 100%. Used in premium allocation and rebalancing processing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sub-account allocation. 'active' indicates the allocation is in force; 'pending' indicates awaiting effective date or processing; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'terminated' indicates closed; 'transferred' indicates moved to another fund.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: asset_transfer_rebalance_pct
attributes.description: Target allocation percentage used specifically for automatic rebalancing calculations. May differ from the current allocation_pct if the owner has submitted a pending rebalancing instruction not yet effective.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: Aggregate cost basis (investment in contract) allocated to this sub-account, used for tax reporting under IRC Section 72 to determine the taxable portion of withdrawals and annuity payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sub-account allocation record was first created in the Annuity Administration Platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this allocation record (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency annuity contracts and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: dca_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) transfer program for this sub-account allocation is scheduled to end. Null if DCA is not active or has no defined end date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: dca_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Periodic dollar amount transferred into this sub-account under the Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program per the defined frequency. Applicable only when dollar_cost_averaging_flag is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account allocation participates in a Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program, where funds are systematically transferred from a fixed account or money market into this sub-account over a defined period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sub-account allocation instruction became effective for the contract. Represents the business event date when the allocation was applied, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: expense_ratio
attributes.description: Annual expense ratio of the underlying investment fund expressed as a percentage (e.g., 0.7500 = 0.75%). Includes management fees and fund operating expenses. Required for prospectus disclosure and suitability analysis.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 482; FINRA Rule 2210; NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_default_allocation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account allocation is part of the contract's default investment allocation (e.g., applied when no explicit owner instruction is on file). Used in new business processing and NIGO resolution workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_restricted_fund
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account fund is subject to trading restrictions (e.g., market timing restrictions, fund closure to new investments). When True, new allocations or transfers into this fund may be blocked.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-2 (market timing); FINRA Rule 2010; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: last_transfer_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a fund transfer (in or out) was processed for this sub-account allocation. Used to enforce transfer restriction periods and market timing compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-2; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Current fair market value (FMV) of the contract owner's holdings in this sub-account, calculated as units_held multiplied by unit_value as of the valuation date. Contributes to the total Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 (Fair Value Measurement); NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: mortality_expense_risk_charge_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortality and Expense (M&E) Risk Charge Rate
attributes.description: Annual Mortality and Expense (M&E) risk charge rate assessed against this sub-account's market value, expressed as a percentage. Covers the insurer's mortality risk and expense guarantees. Required for cost disclosure and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: prospectus_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent fund prospectus under which this sub-account allocation was made. Required for SEC disclosure compliance and ensures the contract owner received current fund information.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 482; Securities Act of 1933 Section 10; FINRA Rule 2210

attributes.name: rebalancing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic portfolio rebalancing is enabled for this sub-account allocation. When True, the contract's holdings are periodically rebalanced back to the target allocation percentages per the rebalancing frequency.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which automatic portfolio rebalancing is performed for this sub-account allocation, when rebalancing_flag is True. Determines how often the allocation is reset to the target percentage.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Standardized risk rating category assigned to this sub-account fund based on its investment objective and volatility profile. Used for suitability matching, asset allocation reporting, and client disclosure.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; FINRA Rule 2111; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: separate_account_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance company's registered separate account that holds this sub-account fund. Variable annuity assets are held in separate accounts segregated from the general account per state insurance law.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Variable Annuity Regulation; SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; State Department of Insurance regulations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this allocation record originated (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the suitability review for this sub-account allocation instruction, per NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation and DOL fiduciary standards. Tracks whether the investment selection has been reviewed and approved as suitable for the contract owner.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation (Model #275); DOL Fiduciary Rule; FINRA Rule 2111

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sub-account allocation was terminated, transferred, or zeroed out. Null if the allocation is still active. Used for historical allocation tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days that must elapse between transfers into and out of this sub-account fund. Enforces market timing restrictions per SEC Rule 22c-2 and fund prospectus requirements.

attributes.name: unit_value
attributes.description: Current Net Asset Value (NAV) per accumulation unit for this sub-account fund as of the valuation date. Sourced from the Investment Management System (e.g., Charles River IMS, SimCorp Dimension) daily pricing feed. Used to compute sub-account market value.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-1; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Number of accumulation units held in this sub-account as of the most recent valuation date. Multiplied by the current unit value to derive the sub-account market value. Core field for NAV-based Account Value (AV) calculation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SEC Rule 22c-1 (forward pricing)

attributes.name: units_purchased_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative number of accumulation units purchased in this sub-account during the current calendar year. Used for investment activity reporting and tax cost basis tracking under IRC Section 72.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: units_redeemed_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative number of accumulation units redeemed from this sub-account during the current calendar year due to withdrawals, transfers, or charges. Used for investment activity reporting and cost basis tracking.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this sub-account allocation record. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Business date as of which the unit value, units held, and market value are reported. Corresponds to the NAV pricing date from the Investment Management System. Critical for daily AV reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-1; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 820

products.name: charge_detail
products.description: Transactional ledger recording each fee or charge debited from an annuity contract's account value, including mortality and expense (M&E) charges, administrative fees, rider charges (GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB), fund management fees, and contract maintenance charges. Captures charge date, charge type, charge rate applied, charge basis amount (AV, benefit base, NAR), calculated charge amount, and the account value segment debited. Supports policyholder fee disclosure, actuarial expense studies, and financial reconciliation of total charges assessed.

attributes.name: charge_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each charge transaction record. Primary key for the charge detail ledger.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract from which this charge was assessed.

attributes.name: expense_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_expense_charge. Business justification: Contract charge transactions reference product expense charge definitions for rate schedules, charge basis, accounting treatment, and DAC eligibility. Essential for charge calculations, GL posting, pr

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Rider charges, M&E fees, and surrender charges generate specific journal entries for revenue recognition (credit) and account value reduction (debit). Required for GAAP revenue recognition and statuto

attributes.name: original_charge_detail_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original charge detail record that this transaction reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is True.

attributes.name: policy_rider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rider benefit for which this charge was assessed. Applicable for GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB, and other optional rider charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific investment fund or sub-account from which fund management fees were deducted. Applicable for variable annuity sub-account charges.
attributes.references: SEC Form N-4 Variable Annuity Registration

attributes.name: account_value_segment
attributes.description: Identifies the segment of the account value from which the charge was debited. Segments include fixed account, variable sub-accounts, indexed strategies, or guaranteed accounts.

attributes.name: annualized_charge_rate
attributes.description: The charge rate expressed on an annual basis for standardized comparison and disclosure purposes, regardless of the actual charge frequency.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: av_after_charge
attributes.description: The total account value of the contract immediately after this charge was applied. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: av_before_charge
attributes.description: The total account value of the contract immediately before this charge was applied. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: benefit_base_after_charge
attributes.description: The benefit base value for living benefit riders immediately after this charge was assessed. Applicable for riders where charges reduce the benefit base.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: benefit_base_before_charge
attributes.description: The benefit base value for living benefit riders immediately before this charge was assessed. Applicable for riders where charges reduce the benefit base.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: The calculated dollar amount of the charge assessed against the contract. This is the product of charge_basis_amount and charge_rate, adjusted for frequency.

attributes.name: charge_basis_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount or value on which the charge rate was applied to calculate the charge. For example, the account value at valuation date for M&E charges, or the benefit base for rider charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_basis_type
attributes.description: Indicates the basis on which the charge was calculated. Common bases include Account Value (AV), benefit base for living benefit riders, Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for death benefit riders, premium amount, or fund units held.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the charge was assessed against the annuity contract account value. This is the principal business event timestamp for the charge transaction.

attributes.name: charge_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this type of charge is assessed against the contract. Common frequencies include daily, monthly, quarterly, or annually.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the charge basis to calculate the charge amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.015 for 1.5% annual charge).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the charge transaction indicating whether it has been successfully applied to the account value or reversed.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: charge_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique transaction number for this charge assessment, used for reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the annuity contract for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: contract_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the annuity contract lifecycle at the time of charge assessment. Accumulation phase allows deposits and growth; payout phase involves systematic withdrawals or annuitization.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The policy year of the annuity contract at the time the charge was assessed. Used for surrender charge schedules and experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this charge detail record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the charge amount is denominated.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the charge becomes effective for the contract, which may differ from the assessment date for backdated or scheduled charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The name of the investment fund or sub-account associated with this charge for operational reference and policyholder disclosure.
attributes.references: SEC Form N-4 Variable Annuity Registration

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this charge revenue is posted for financial accounting and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk used as the basis for calculating death benefit rider charges. Represents the difference between the guaranteed death benefit and the account value.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The product code of the annuity contract from which the charge was assessed. Used for product-level profitability analysis and expense studies.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge transaction is a reversal of a previously assessed charge. True if this is a reversal entry, False for original charge assessments.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the charge was reversed. Examples include calculation error, contract adjustment, free-look cancellation, or system correction.

attributes.name: rider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rider for which the charge applies. Includes Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB), Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB), Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB), Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB), Long-Term Care (LTC), and other rider types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gmwb|gmib|gmab|gmdb|ltc|income_enhancement|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this charge transaction record. Examples include annuity administration platform codes or billing system identifiers.

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source operational system, used for end-to-end traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: tax_qualification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is qualified (held within a tax-advantaged retirement account such as IRA, 401k) or non-qualified (purchased with after-tax dollars).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this charge detail record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account value was determined for the purpose of calculating the charge basis amount.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge was waived due to contractual provisions, promotional offers, or special circumstances. True if waived, False if assessed normally.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the charge was waived, if applicable. Examples include promotional period, contractual guarantee, or regulatory requirement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Annuity Disclosure

attributes.name: reversal_charge_detail_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on charge_detail (reversal_charge_detail_id)

products.name: surrender_charge
products.description: Tracks the surrender charge schedule and calculations for annuity contracts. Captures surrender charge percentage by contract year, free withdrawal allowance, market value adjustment (MVA) calculations, and waiver conditions.

attributes.name: surrender_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the surrender charge schedule record.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_filing. Business justification: Surrender charge schedules require rate filing approval in many states. Links surrender charge schedules to approved rate filings for regulatory compliance validation. Required for market conduct exam

attributes.name: charge_application_method
attributes.description: Method by which surrender charges are applied to withdrawals (e.g., pro-rata across all withdrawals, only on amounts exceeding free withdrawal limit, or tiered based on withdrawal amount).

attributes.name: charge_calculation_basis
attributes.description: The basis upon which the surrender charge is calculated (e.g., current account value, premium paid, or withdrawal amount).

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year to which this surrender charge rate applies, starting from 1 at contract issue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender charge schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_free_withdrawal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused free withdrawal amounts from prior years can be carried forward and used in subsequent years.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this surrender charge schedule.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this surrender charge schedule becomes effective for the contract.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the surrender charge schedule expires or is no longer applicable, typically at the end of the surrender charge period.

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_basis
attributes.description: The basis upon which the free withdrawal amount is calculated (e.g., account value, premium paid, or benefit base).

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of account value that can be withdrawn annually without incurring a surrender charge, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10%).

attributes.name: mva_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a market value adjustment is applied to surrenders in addition to the surrender charge.

attributes.name: mva_formula_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific formula or calculation method used to determine the market value adjustment.

attributes.name: mva_index_type
attributes.description: The interest rate index or benchmark used to calculate the market value adjustment (e.g., 10-Year Treasury, LIBOR).

attributes.name: period_years
attributes.description: Total number of years during which surrender charges apply to the contract.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the annuity product to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of annuity product (fixed, variable, indexed, or immediate) to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to calculate the surrender charge for this contract year, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8%).

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the surrender charge schedule, typically aligned with product or contract version.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surrender charge schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the surrender charge schedule, used to track changes over time.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this surrender charge schedule data originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens, EXL).

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the contract was issued, relevant for state-specific surrender charge regulations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender charge schedule record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: waiver_annuitization_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Annuitization Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the contract is annuitized according to the available payout options.

attributes.name: waiver_death_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Death Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived upon the death of the owner or annuitant.

attributes.name: waiver_disability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Disability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner becomes disabled, subject to policy terms.

attributes.name: waiver_ltc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Long-Term Care (LTC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner qualifies for long-term care benefits under the contract.

attributes.name: waiver_nursing_home_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Nursing Home Confinement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner is confined to a nursing home for a specified period.

attributes.name: waiver_rmd_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived for withdrawals taken to satisfy IRS required minimum distribution requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_terminal_illness_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Terminal Illness Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner is diagnosed with a terminal illness.

attributes.name: waiver_unemployment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Unemployment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner becomes involuntarily unemployed.

attributes.name: superseded_surrender_charge_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on surrender_charge (superseded_surrender_charge_id)

products.name: death_benefit_option
products.description: Defines the death benefit options available on annuity contracts — return of premium, highest anniversary value, stepped-up death benefit, and GMDB rider benefits. Captures option type, calculation method, and current benefit amount.

attributes.name: death_benefit_option_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the death benefit option record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this death benefit option applies.

attributes.name: annuitant_age_at_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annuitant Age at Death Benefit Election
attributes.description: Age of the annuitant at the time this death benefit option was elected. Used for underwriting and pricing purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: benefit_base_amount
attributes.description: Base amount used in the death benefit calculation. May represent the initial premium, highest anniversary value, or other reference amount depending on the option type.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate the death benefit amount. Defines the formula or rule applied to determine the benefit payable upon death of the annuitant.

attributes.name: charge_basis
attributes.description: Basis upon which the death benefit rider charge is calculated. Defines whether the charge is applied to account value, benefit base, premium, or as a fixed dollar amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this death benefit option record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this death benefit option record.

attributes.name: current_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Current calculated death benefit amount as of the most recent valuation date. Represents the amount that would be payable to beneficiaries if the annuitant died today.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the death benefit option became effective and in force on the annuity contract.

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract owner elected or selected this death benefit option.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: enhancement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by which the death benefit is enhanced above the base calculation. Applied as a multiplier to the calculated benefit amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 for 40% enhancement).

attributes.name: guaranteed_minimum_amount
attributes.description: Guaranteed minimum death benefit amount regardless of account value fluctuations. Floor amount that will be paid even if account value declines below this level.

attributes.name: last_step_up_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which the death benefit base was increased at the last step-up event. Null if no step-up has occurred.

attributes.name: last_step_up_date
attributes.description: Date when the death benefit base was last stepped up to a higher value. Null if no step-up has occurred.

attributes.name: max_issue_age
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Issue Age for Death Benefit Option
attributes.description: Maximum age of the annuitant at which this death benefit option can be elected or issued. Null if no age restriction applies.

attributes.name: min_issue_age
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Issue Age for Death Benefit Option
attributes.description: Minimum age of the annuitant at which this death benefit option can be elected or issued. Null if no age restriction applies.

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for Death Benefit
attributes.description: Net amount at risk for the death benefit option. Represents the difference between the guaranteed death benefit and the current account value. Used for reserve calculations and risk management.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation of Life Insurance Policies Model Regulation

attributes.name: option_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the death benefit option. Indicates whether the option is currently in force, suspended, or has been terminated.

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Classification of the death benefit option available on the annuity contract. Defines the calculation methodology for the death benefit payable to beneficiaries upon the annuitant's death.

attributes.name: rider_charge_rate
attributes.description: Annual charge rate assessed for the death benefit rider or option. Expressed as a percentage of account value or benefit base. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0075 for 0.75%).

attributes.name: roll_up_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the death benefit roll-up period ends and automatic increases cease.

attributes.name: roll_up_period_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Death Benefit Roll-Up Period in Years
attributes.description: Number of years during which the death benefit base will roll up at the specified rate. After this period, roll-up credits cease.

attributes.name: roll_up_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate at which the death benefit base increases automatically under a roll-up provision. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source operational system from which this death benefit option record originated (e.g., annuity administration platform).

attributes.name: spousal_continuation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the death benefit option allows a surviving spouse to continue the contract with the same death benefit provisions upon the annuitant's death.

attributes.name: step_up_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the death benefit base is evaluated for step-up increases. Defines how often the benefit base can be reset to a higher account value.

attributes.name: step_up_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the death benefit option includes a step-up provision that allows the benefit base to increase based on account value growth at specified intervals.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the death benefit option was terminated or expired. Null if the option is still active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the death benefit option was terminated. Null if the option is still active.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this death benefit option record was last modified. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the current death benefit amount and related values were calculated. Represents the most recent valuation point.

attributes.name: superseded_death_benefit_option_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on death_benefit_option (superseded_death_benefit_option_id)

products.name: bonus_credit

attributes.name: bonus_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bonus credit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this bonus credit applies.

attributes.name: annuity_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the premium payment transaction that triggered this bonus credit, if applicable.

attributes.name: dac_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.dac_asset. Business justification: Bonus credits paid to policyholders are acquisition costs that must be capitalized as DAC and amortized over contract life under GAAP. Links bonus credit transactions to deferred acquisition cost asse

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity product under which this bonus credit is offered.

attributes.name: account_value_after
attributes.description: Account value of the annuity contract immediately after this bonus credit was applied.

attributes.name: account_value_before
attributes.description: Account value of the annuity contract immediately before this bonus credit was applied.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the bonus credit applied to the annuity contract account value.

attributes.name: bonus_basis_amount
attributes.description: The base amount (premium or account value) to which the bonus rate is applied to calculate the bonus credit.

attributes.name: bonus_credit_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this bonus credit transaction, used for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: bonus_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to the premium or account value to calculate the bonus credit amount.

attributes.name: bonus_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bonus credit: pending application, credited to account value, fully vested, recaptured due to early withdrawal, forfeited, or cancelled.

attributes.name: bonus_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bonus credit: first-year premium bonus, persistency bonus, loyalty credit, renewal bonus, index performance bonus, or rollover bonus.

attributes.name: contract_anniversary_date
attributes.description: Contract anniversary date relevant to this bonus credit, used for persistency and loyalty bonus calculations.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the annuity contract receiving the bonus credit.

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: Contract year in which this bonus credit was applied, used for persistency bonus calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bonus credit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_date
attributes.description: Date when the bonus credit was applied to the annuity contract account value.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this bonus credit record.

attributes.name: current_vested_pct
attributes.description: Current percentage of the bonus credit that is vested and not subject to recapture, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the bonus credit becomes effective and begins participating in contract growth.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the eligibility criteria that qualified this contract for the bonus credit (e.g., minimum premium threshold, contract type, distribution channel).

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bonus credit is eligible for contracts funded through a 1035 tax-free exchange.

attributes.name: recapture_date
attributes.description: Date when the bonus credit recapture was processed.

attributes.name: recapture_method
attributes.description: Method used to recapture unvested bonus credits upon early withdrawal or surrender: full recapture of unvested amount, pro-rata based on time elapsed, declining balance over vesting period, or none if no recapture applies.

attributes.name: recapture_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bonus credit is subject to recapture provisions if the contract is surrendered or withdrawn before full vesting.

attributes.name: recaptured_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of bonus credit that has been recaptured due to early withdrawal or surrender before full vesting.

attributes.name: source_system_bonus_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this bonus credit in the source operational system, used for reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source operational system that originated this bonus credit record (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity).

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for the bonus credit: non-taxable at application, tax-deferred until distribution, or taxable event at crediting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bonus credit record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: vesting_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the bonus credit becomes fully vested and no longer subject to recapture.

attributes.name: vesting_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years required for the bonus credit to become fully vested.

attributes.name: vesting_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of vesting schedule applied to the bonus: immediate (no vesting period), cliff (all-or-nothing at end), graded (incremental over time), or pro-rata (proportional to time elapsed).

attributes.name: vesting_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the vesting schedule for this bonus credit begins.

attributes.name: replaced_bonus_credit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bonus_credit (replaced_bonus_credit_id)

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the annuity contract for which this MVA calculation applies.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who authorized or performed the MVA calculation override, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: service_order_id

attributes.name: withdrawal_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the withdrawal or surrender transaction that triggered this MVA calculation.

attributes.name: account_value_subject_to_mva
attributes.description: The portion of the annuity account value that is subject to the Market Value Adjustment calculation. This may be the full account value or a portion depending on free withdrawal provisions.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Market Value Adjustment calculation was performed.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the Market Value Adjustment. Common methods include present value discounting, duration-based adjustments, company-specific formulas, or regulatory standard approaches.

attributes.name: calculation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for this MVA calculation, used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MVA calculation. Indicates whether the calculation is pending, has been calculated, applied to the transaction, reversed, or voided.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the MVA calculation was executed by the system or user.

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year in which the MVA calculation is performed, measured from the contract issue date or most recent guarantee period start date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: current_interest_rate
attributes.description: The current market interest rate at the time of withdrawal or surrender, used to calculate the market value adjustment. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0425 for 4.25%).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Market Value Adjustment becomes effective and is applied to the contract value or withdrawal proceeds.

attributes.name: excess_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the withdrawal that exceeds the free withdrawal provision and is therefore subject to MVA calculation.

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the withdrawal that qualifies under the free withdrawal provision and is therefore exempt from MVA calculation.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the current guarantee period. Withdrawals after this date may not be subject to MVA.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_remaining_years
attributes.description: The number of years remaining in the guarantee period at the time of withdrawal or surrender, used as a factor in the MVA calculation.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the current guarantee period for which the reference interest rate was established and against which the MVA is calculated.

attributes.name: interest_rate_index
attributes.description: The specific interest rate index or benchmark used to determine the current interest rate for MVA calculation (e.g., 10-Year Treasury, LIBOR, company-declared rate).

attributes.name: mva_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The calculated Market Value Adjustment amount to be applied to the withdrawal or surrender proceeds. Positive values indicate an increase in value; negative values indicate a decrease.

attributes.name: mva_adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: The Market Value Adjustment expressed as a percentage of the account value subject to MVA. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., -0.0250 for -2.50%).

attributes.name: mva_cap_rate
attributes.description: The maximum positive adjustment rate (cap) that can be applied to the MVA calculation, as specified in the contract terms. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: mva_floor_rate
attributes.description: The maximum negative adjustment rate (floor) that can be applied to the MVA calculation, as specified in the contract terms. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: mva_formula_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific MVA formula or methodology used for this calculation, as defined in the annuity contract or product specifications.

attributes.name: mva_formula_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the MVA formula or methodology applied, including any product-specific variations or adjustments.

attributes.name: mva_waiver_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether an MVA waiver provision was applied to this calculation, exempting the withdrawal from the market value adjustment (e.g., due to death, disability, nursing home confinement, or RMD).

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the calculated MVA amount was manually overridden by an authorized user, typically for exception handling or customer service reasons.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for any manual override of the calculated MVA amount, including reference to approval authority.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The annuity product code or identifier that defines the specific MVA provisions, formula, and parameters applicable to this calculation.

attributes.name: rate_differential
attributes.description: The calculated difference between the current interest rate and the reference interest rate, used in the MVA formula. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: reference_interest_rate
attributes.description: The original or reference interest rate established at contract issue or guarantee period start, used as the baseline for MVA calculation. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or platform that originated this MVA calculation record (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity, proprietary calculation engine).

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier or reference number for this MVA calculation in the source system, used for reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this MVA calculation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for waiving the Market Value Adjustment, if applicable. Common reasons include death of annuitant, disability, nursing home confinement, Required Minimum Distribution (RMD), annuitization, contract maturity, or free withdrawal provision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death|disability|nursing_home|rmd|annuitization|contract_maturity|free_withdrawal|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: original_mva_calculation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mva_calculation (original_mva_calculation_id)

products.name: contract_crediting_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between annuity contracts and crediting strategies. It captures the policyholder's election to allocate a portion of their account value to a specific crediting strategy for a defined term. Each record links one annuity_contract to one crediting_strategy with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation decision, including the percentage allocated, the term dates, and the specific rates locked in at election time.. Existence Justification: In fixed indexed annuity operations, contract owners actively allocate their account value across multiple crediting strategies simultaneously (e.g., 40% to S&P 500 annual point-to-point, 30% to Russell 2000 monthly average, 30% to fixed account). Each crediting strategy is elected by thousands of contracts. The allocation relationship is an operational business entity that contract administrators actively manage, with specific attributes like allocation percentage, term dates, and locked-in rates that belong to neither the contract nor the strategy alone.

attributes.name: contract_crediting_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contract crediting allocation record

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Crediting Allocation - Annuity Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the annuity contract that has made this crediting strategy allocation

attributes.name: crediting_strategy_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Crediting Allocation - Crediting Strategy Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the crediting strategy elected by the contract owner

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of account value allocated to this crediting strategy at the time of allocation, calculated as allocation_pct × contract account_value. This is a point-in-time snapshot; actual value fluctuates with market performance.

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the contract's account value allocated to this crediting strategy, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 for 25%). Must sum to 1.0000 across all active allocations for a contract.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this allocation: ACTIVE (currently in force), PENDING (elected but not yet effective), EXPIRED (term completed), TERMINATED (ended before term completion)

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The cap rate locked in for this specific allocation at the time of election. This may differ from the current cap_rate in the crediting_strategy table if rates have been adjusted for new elections.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation became effective and the crediting strategy began applying to the allocated portion of account value

attributes.name: election_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the allocation election was made: ONLINE_PORTAL, PHONE (customer service), MAIL (paper form), AGENT (through producer), AUTOMATIC (system-generated renewal)

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner made this allocation election, which may precede the effective_date due to processing time or future-dated requests

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation expires or was terminated, either due to term completion, contract maturity, or policyholder reallocation request

attributes.name: participation_rate
attributes.description: The participation rate locked in for this specific allocation at the time of election. This may differ from the current participation_rate in the crediting_strategy table if rates have been adjusted for new elections.

attributes.name: renewal_election
attributes.description: Indicates the policyholder's election for what happens at term end: AUTO_RENEW (automatically renew into same strategy at current rates), MANUAL_REALLOCATION (policyholder will make new allocation decision), EXPIRED (term completed and funds reallocated), TERMINATED (allocation ended before term completion)

attributes.name: term_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the crediting term for this allocation, marking the conclusion of the index measurement period and when interest credits are applied

attributes.name: term_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the crediting term for this allocation, marking the beginning of the index measurement period or fixed rate period

products.name: hedge_position
products.description: This association product represents the hedging relationship between a living benefit rider's benefit base and derivative contracts used to offset market risk exposure. Each record links one benefit base to one derivative contract and captures hedge-specific attributes including notional allocation, hedge ratio, effectiveness testing results, and rebalancing parameters.
