attributes.description: The ceded account value (AV) or policy reserve deducted from the death benefit in the NAR calculation. For universal life (UL) and indexed universal life (IUL) products, this is the ceded account value; for traditional products, this is the ceded reserve.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer for this cession, calculated as the ceded death benefit minus the ceded policy reserve or account value. NAR is the primary basis for YRT reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: nar_calculation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Calculation Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NAR was most recently calculated for this cession. Used to determine the applicable YRT rate period and to validate that NAR values are current for premium billing cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_calculation_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Calculation Method
attributes.description: The actuarial methodology used to calculate the NAR for this cession. Attained age uses current insured age; issue age uses age at policy issue; select and ultimate uses select mortality tables; net premium uses the net premium reserve method. Drives YRT rate application.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: nar_death_benefit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Death Benefit
attributes.description: The ceded death benefit component used in the NAR calculation for this cession period. Represents the reinsurer's share of the total death benefit (DB) before deducting the account value or reserve.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_effective_from
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Effective Period Start
attributes.description: Start date of the period for which the current NAR amount is applicable. Defines the beginning of the NAR calculation window used for YRT premium billing.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_effective_to
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Effective Period End
attributes.description: End date of the period for which the current NAR amount is applicable. Defines the end of the NAR calculation window used for YRT premium billing.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: The proportional share of the policy risk ceded to the reinsurer, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used in quota share and coinsurance arrangements to determine the reinsurer's proportional liability.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The duration year of the underlying policy as of the cession or NAR calculation date. Used in select-and-ultimate YRT rate table lookups where rates vary by policy duration.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: premium_mode
attributes.description: Frequency at which reinsurance premiums are billed and remitted to the reinsurer under this cession. Aligns with the treaty billing cycle and bordereaux reporting schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recapture of this cession became effective, returning the ceded risk to the ceding company. Null for cessions that have not been recaptured.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession has been or is in the process of being recaptured by the ceding company. True when the ceding company has exercised its contractual right to reclaim the ceded risk from the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty assessed by the reinsurer upon recapture of the cession, as specified in the treaty recapture provisions. Represents the cost to the ceding company for exercising the recapture right.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_trigger
attributes.description: The contractual or business event that triggered the recapture of this cession. Treaty anniversary indicates scheduled recapture window; reinsurer insolvency indicates financial distress trigger; rate increase indicates reinsurer rate action exceeding treaty threshold; voluntary indicates ceding company election; regulatory indicates compliance-driven recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: recaptured_amount
attributes.description: The face amount recaptured from the reinsurer when the ceding company exercises its recapture right. May be a partial recapture (less than the full ceded_face_amount) or full recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for this cession for the current billing period, calculated based on the NAR and applicable YRT rate or coinsurance premium rate. Core financial obligation of the cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: retained_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the policy face amount retained by the ceding company (Life Insurance) after cession. Equals total face amount minus ceded_face_amount. Supports retention limit compliance monitoring and RBC optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; NAIC RBC (Risk-Based Capital) Framework

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: Tobacco/smoking status of the insured, used in mortality rate table selection for YRT reinsurance premium calculation. Smoker and non-smoker rates differ significantly in life reinsurance pricing.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cession record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, FAST Policy Administration). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cession was terminated and reinsurance coverage ceased. Populated when cession_status is terminated or recaptured. Null for active cessions.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the termination of this cession. Lapse indicates premium non-payment; surrender indicates policyholder voluntary termination; death indicates insured mortality claim; conversion indicates policy conversion to another product; recapture indicates ceding company reclaimed the risk; expiry/maturity indicates natural end of coverage period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lapse|surrender|death|conversion|recapture|expiry|maturity — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cession record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

products.name: facultative_submission
products.description: Tracks individual facultative reinsurance submissions where a specific risk cannot be ceded automatically and requires individual underwriting review by the reinsurer. Captures submission date, risk details, requested cession amount, reinsurer assigned, underwriting decision, rated terms offered, and final disposition. Supports the facultative placement workflow distinct from automatic treaty cessions.

attributes.name: facultative_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each facultative reinsurance submission record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer's underwriter or the ceding company's reinsurance underwriter responsible for evaluating this facultative submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy for which facultative reinsurance coverage is being sought. Links the submission to the policy administration system record.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Facultative submissions require underwriting evidence: attending physician statements (APS), medical records, MIB reports, financial statements, and reinsurer decision letters. Underwriting decisions

attributes.name: insured_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.insured. Business justification: Facultative submissions are underwriting requests for specific insureds. Reinsurers evaluate individual risk profiles requiring full insured details (medical history, occupation, risk factors). Critic

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Facultative submissions reference the product being underwritten. Essential for underwriting decisions, capacity management, and reinsurer selection based on product expertise. Product_type is denorma

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Facultative submissions use pricing bases to determine reinsurance premium rates for jumbo cases. Essential for facultative underwriting, pricing consistency, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Facultative submissions are requests for facultative reinsurance coverage that precede cession creation. When a submission is approved and accepted, a cession record is created. This FK tracks the out

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this facultative submission is being placed, if applicable. Nullable when the submission is entirely outside existing treaty arrangements.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) assigned to evaluate and potentially accept this facultative submission. Identifies the specific reinsurer entity in the reinsurer master.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: approved_cession_amount
attributes.description: The actual cession amount approved by the reinsurer, which may differ from the requested cession amount if the reinsurer offered partial coverage or modified terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP

attributes.name: aps_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Attending Physician Statement (APS) was received from the insured's physician and included in the facultative submission evidence package.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; HIPAA Privacy Rule; RGAX AURA

attributes.name: aps_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Attending Physician Statement (APS) was required by the reinsurer as part of the facultative underwriting evidence package for this submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; HIPAA Privacy Rule; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: cession_type
attributes.description: The reinsurance cession structure requested for this facultative submission, defining how risk and reserves are shared between the ceding company and the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facultative submission record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this facultative submission record (e.g., USD, CAD). Supports multi-currency reinsurance arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurer rendered its underwriting decision on the facultative submission. Used to measure turnaround time and track SLA compliance with reinsurance partners.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: decision_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the reinsurer's underwriting decision, particularly for declined or postponed submissions (e.g., cardiovascular risk, BMI, hazardous occupation). Supports experience studies and underwriting analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; MIB Group Standards; RGAX AURA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the facultative reinsurance coverage becomes effective upon acceptance of the submission. Typically aligned with the underlying policy issue date or a negotiated retroactive date.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which the ceding company must accept the reinsurer's facultative offer before it lapses. After this date, a new submission may be required.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: Total face amount (death benefit) of the underlying life insurance policy being submitted for facultative reinsurance. Used to determine the NAR and cession limits.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Model Act; ACORD Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: final_disposition
attributes.description: The ultimate outcome of the facultative submission after all negotiations and decisions are complete. Indicates whether the risk was successfully placed with the reinsurer, partially placed, or not placed.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: flat_extra_duration_years
attributes.description: Number of years the flat extra premium applies from the policy issue date. A value of zero or null indicates a permanent flat extra. Used for temporary substandard rating administration.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: flat_extra_premium
attributes.description: Additional flat extra premium per thousand dollars of coverage charged by the reinsurer for temporary or permanent extra mortality risk not captured by table ratings (e.g., hazardous occupation, aviation risk).
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: mib_checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Medical Information Bureau (MIB) check was performed as part of the underwriting evidence for this facultative submission. Required for compliance with MIB Group member obligations.
attributes.references: MIB Group Standards; NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — the difference between the policy death benefit and the policy reserve or account value at the time of submission. The primary basis for facultative reinsurance premium calculation under YRT structures.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facultative submission has been flagged as a priority case requiring expedited review by the reinsurer, typically due to policy issuance deadlines or large face amounts.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; Internal Reinsurance Operations

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: The annual reinsurance premium amount payable to the reinsurer for the ceded risk under this facultative submission. Calculated from the premium rate applied to the ceded NAR or face amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_rate
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium rate per thousand dollars of NAR or face amount offered or agreed upon for this facultative submission. Used to calculate the reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP

attributes.name: reinsurer_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned by the reinsurer to this facultative submission in their own system (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Used for cross-system reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: requested_cession_amount
attributes.description: The face amount or net amount at risk (NAR) the ceding company is requesting to cede to the reinsurer under this facultative submission. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP

attributes.name: requested_cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total risk the ceding company is requesting to cede to the reinsurer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used alongside requested_cession_amount for proportional treaty structures.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The amount of risk the ceding company retains on its own books after ceding the requested portion to the reinsurer. Retention amount plus cession amount should equal total face amount or NAR.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RBC Guidelines; SAP

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facultative submission involves a retrocession arrangement, where the reinsurer further cedes a portion of the accepted risk to a retrocessionaire.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Mortality risk classification assigned to the insured based on underwriting evaluation. Drives the reinsurance premium rate and terms offered by the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this facultative submission record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the facultative submission was transmitted to the reinsurer (e.g., electronic data interchange, reinsurer portal, manual paper submission). Supports operational efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the facultative submission was formally submitted to the reinsurer for individual underwriting review. This is the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number assigned to the facultative submission, used in all correspondence with the reinsurer and in bordereaux reporting. Format: FAC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the facultative submission within the placement workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through reinsurer decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|declined|withdrawn|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Substandard mortality table rating assigned by the reinsurer's underwriter, indicating the degree of extra mortality risk (e.g., Table B, Table 4). Standard indicates no extra mortality. Used to calculate rated-up reinsurance premiums.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: The formal underwriting decision rendered by the reinsurer on this facultative submission. Drives the final disposition and any rated terms offered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved_standard|approved_rated|approved_modified|declined|postponed|more_info_required — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing underwriting remarks, special conditions, exclusions, or other qualitative information relevant to the facultative submission and the reinsurer's decision. May include medical or financial underwriting commentary.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; HIPAA Privacy Rule; RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this facultative submission record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule

products.name: premium
products.description: Transactional record of reinsurance premiums due and paid to reinsurers for ceded risk. Captures billing period, premium amount by cession, YRT rate applied, modal factor, ceded NAR at billing date, payment due date, payment status, and remittance reference. Supports bordereaux reporting and reinsurance premium accounting. Distinct from the billing domain which owns direct policyholder premiums.

attributes.name: premium_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance premium billing record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy for which reinsurance premium is being billed. Links the reinsurance premium to the direct policy in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Code; ACORD Life Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Reinsurance premium accounting requires direct linkage to GL posting for monthly close reconciliation, audit trail, GAAP/SAP reporting, and SOX controls. Finance teams reconcile premium bordereaux to

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Reinsurance premiums are calculated per product plan. Critical for premium reconciliation, bordereaux preparation, financial reporting, and product profitability analysis. Plan_code is denormalized id

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Reinsurance premium calculations require premium schedule data for modal factors, billing frequency, and paid-to-date status. Actuaries and reinsurance accountants use this to validate ceded premium a

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record that this premium billing is associated with. Links the premium to the specific risk ceded under a treaty or facultative arrangement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this premium is billed. Identifies the governing treaty agreement (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, etc.) between the ceding company and the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re, Munich Re) to whom the premium is remitted. Identifies the reinsurer entity in the reinsurer master.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary adjustment applied to the standard calculated reinsurance premium for this billing period. Positive values indicate additional premium; negative values indicate credits. Null if no adjustment applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for any adjustment to the reinsurance premium from the standard calculated amount. Captures retroactive corrections, rate table updates, NAR recalculations, or treaty amendments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_correction|nar_correction|retroactive_adjustment|treaty_amendment|data_correction|none — promote to reference product if additional reasons are needed]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: The ceding allowance or expense allowance credited back to the ceding company by the reinsurer, representing a portion of the gross premium returned to offset acquisition and administrative costs.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The frequency at which reinsurance premiums are billed to the ceding company under the treaty terms. Determines the billing cycle and modal factor applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the billing period for which this reinsurance premium is charged. Defines the end of the coverage interval for the ceded risk in this billing cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the billing period for which this reinsurance premium is charged. Defines the start of the coverage interval for the ceded risk in this billing cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM formatted reporting period for which this premium is included in the bordereaux report submitted to the reinsurer. Supports monthly bordereaux reconciliation and reinsurer reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; Reinsurance Management System (Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance)

attributes.name: ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the policy face amount (death benefit) ceded to the reinsurer under this cession. Used in coinsurance arrangements and for bordereaux reporting of ceded exposure.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: ceded_nar
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer as of the billing date. Represents the reinsurer's exposure — the difference between the ceded death benefit and the ceded reserve or account value. Used as the basis for YRT premium calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer as of the billing period. Relevant for coinsurance and modified coinsurance (ModCo) treaties where reserves are shared. Supports RBC optimization and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; NAIC PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the risk ceded to the reinsurer under a coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used to calculate the proportional share of premiums and reserves ceded.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reinsurance premium record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this reinsurance premium record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the reinsurance premium must be remitted to the reinsurer per treaty terms. Used for overdue tracking and cash flow management.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: experience_refund_amount
attributes.description: The experience refund or profit commission amount credited back to the ceding company based on favorable claims experience under the treaty. Applicable to treaties with experience refund provisions. Null if no experience refund applies for this period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: gross_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total gross reinsurance premium due for the billing period before any allowances, credits, or adjustments. Represents the full ceded premium obligation to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: insured_attained_age
attributes.description: The attained age of the insured as of the billing period start date. Used to look up the applicable YRT rate from the treaty rate table and for actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: insured_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the insured used for YRT rate table lookup. Unisex rates apply in jurisdictions or products where gender-distinct pricing is not permitted.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurance premium relates to a retrocession arrangement (where the reinsurer further cedes risk to another reinsurer). True = retrocession; False = direct reinsurance cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor
attributes.description: The modal factor applied to convert the annual reinsurance premium to the billing frequency (e.g., monthly = 1/12 = 0.083333, quarterly = 0.25, semi-annual = 0.5, annual = 1.0). Reflects the billing mode agreed in the treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: net_premium_amount
attributes.description: The net reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer after deducting the ceding allowance from the gross premium. This is the actual cash amount remitted. Calculated as gross_premium_amount minus allowance_amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the reinsurance premium was remitted to the reinsurer. Null if payment has not yet been made. Used for reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reinsurance premium billing record. Tracks whether the premium is pending remittance, has been paid, is overdue, has been waived, reversed due to correction, or is under dispute with the reinsurer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|paid|overdue|waived|reversed|disputed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year in force at the time of this reinsurance premium billing. Used for YRT rate table lookup (rates often vary by policy duration) and for experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: premium_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reinsurance premium billing record, as assigned by the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer remittance advice.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

attributes.name: reinsurance_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the reinsurance premium billing. Used for annual bordereaux aggregation, statutory reporting, and reinsurance accounting period alignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: reinsurer_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy or certificate number assigned by the reinsurer to identify the ceded risk in their system. Used for bordereaux reconciliation and reinsurer correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: The payment or wire transfer reference number associated with the actual remittance of this reinsurance premium to the reinsurer. Used for cash reconciliation and bordereaux matching.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification of the insured as applied to the reinsurance treaty rate table (e.g., preferred_plus, preferred, standard, substandard, table_rated). Determines the YRT rate applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard|substandard|table_rated|smoker|non_smoker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this reinsurance premium record was extracted (e.g., SWISS_RE_IRIS, RGA_AURA). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the reinsurance premium remittance, applicable for cross-border reinsurance arrangements subject to withholding tax treaties. Null for domestic arrangements with no withholding obligation.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 881; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reinsurance premium record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: yrt_rate
attributes.description: The Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) rate per unit of Net Amount at Risk (NAR) applied to calculate the reinsurance premium for the billing period. Expressed as a rate per $1,000 of NAR. Sourced from the treaty rate table based on attained age, gender, and risk class.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life Reinsurance Standards

products.name: claim_recoverable
products.description: Tracks reinsurance recoverables arising from ceded claims where Life Insurance is entitled to recover a portion of claim payments from reinsurers, including full dispute lifecycle management for contested recoverables, premium calculations, and treaty interpretations. Captures originating claim reference, ceded claim amount, recoverable percentage per treaty, recoverable status (pending, submitted, received, disputed), submission date, settlement date, and dispute details (dispute type, disputed amount, dispute open date, resolution method, resolution date, dispute status, reinsurer response). This is the single source of truth for all reinsurance recoverables and reinsurance disputes. Critical for RBC optimization, statutory balance sheet reporting, and reinsurance operations/legal oversight of counterparty disputes.

attributes.name: claim_recoverable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance claim recoverable record. Primary key for the claim_recoverable data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating claim record in the Claims Management System (e.g., Guidewire ClaimCenter) from which this reinsurance recoverable arises. Links the recoverable to the underlying insured event.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: exam_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.exam_finding. Business justification: Market conduct exams frequently review reinsurance recoverables for collectability, proper documentation, unauthorized reinsurer usage, and credit for reinsurance compliance. Exam findings often cite

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Claims occurring during grace periods require reinsurers to verify premium payment status before honoring recoverables. Claims examiners check grace period resolution to determine coverage validity an

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy associated with the ceded claim, enabling policy-level recoverable aggregation and RBC reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Claim recoverable booking must link to GL entry for balance sheet reconciliation, reserve adequacy testing, and external audit. Actuarial and finance teams reconcile recoverable balances to journal en

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific cession record that governs the portion of risk ceded to the reinsurer for the underlying policy, linking the recoverable to the cession processing module.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this recoverable is ceded. Determines the applicable cession terms, retention limits, and recoverable percentage.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) responsible for settling this recoverable. Used for counterparty exposure tracking and dispute management.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: Claim recoverables affect reserve positions and must be tracked at calculation level for reserve adequacy testing, statutory reporting (Schedule S Part 3), and RBC credit calculations.

attributes.name: statutory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.statutory_filing. Business justification: Claim recoverables are reported in statutory exhibits (Schedule F Part 3 - Reinsurance Recoverables). Filings must track source recoverables for balance sheet presentation, allowance for doubtful acco

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging classification of the outstanding recoverable balance based on days elapsed since the due_date. Used for statutory balance sheet aging schedules and reinsurer credit risk monitoring per NAIC Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Expense allowance or ceding commission received from the reinsurer as part of the coinsurance or modified coinsurance arrangement, offsetting the ceding company's acquisition and maintenance costs.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: allowance_for_doubtful_recovery
attributes.description: Reserve amount established against this recoverable to reflect the risk that the reinsurer may not pay in full, particularly for disputed or aged recoverables. Impacts statutory surplus and RBC calculations per NAIC Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944; NAIC RBC Model Law

attributes.name: amount_received
attributes.description: Actual cash amount received from the reinsurer to date for this recoverable. May differ from recoverable_amount due to partial payments, disputes, or negotiated settlements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The reporting period (YYYY-MM) in which this recoverable is included in the bordereaux report submitted to the reinsurer. Aligns with monthly cession and recoverable reporting cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_claim_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross claim amount ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable treaty, representing the maximum recoverable before any adjustments or disputes.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: claim_event_date
attributes.description: Date of the insured event (e.g., date of death, date of disability onset) that triggered the underlying claim. The principal real-world business event timestamp for this recoverable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying claim driving the recoverable. Includes Death Benefit (DB), Accidental Death Benefit (ADB), Long-Term Care (LTC), disability, maturity, surrender, and annuity payout claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death_benefit|adb|ltc|disability|maturity|surrender|annuity_payout — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance recoverable record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for SOX and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this recoverable record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaty arrangements.

attributes.name: dispute_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally raised the dispute. Starts the dispute resolution clock and triggers legal/reinsurance operations oversight. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was formally resolved and closed. Null if the dispute is still open. Used to measure dispute cycle time and reinsurer relationship performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method by which the dispute was or is being resolved. Negotiation = bilateral agreement; arbitration = binding third-party decision per treaty arbitration clause; litigation = court proceedings; mediation = non-binding facilitated resolution; withdrawal = reinsurer withdrew the dispute. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current state of the dispute lifecycle. 'open' = newly raised; 'under_review' = being evaluated; 'escalated' = referred to legal or senior management; 'resolved' = agreed outcome reached; 'withdrawn' = reinsurer retracted the dispute. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the reinsurer's dispute. Coverage interpretation disputes involve treaty scope; treaty terms disputes involve contractual language; claim validity disputes challenge the underlying claim; documentation disputes involve missing or insufficient evidence; calculation disputes involve amount computation. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The specific monetary amount contested by the reinsurer. May equal the full recoverable_amount or a partial portion. Null when is_disputed is False. Critical for legal reserve estimation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the reinsurer is obligated to remit payment per the treaty terms. Used for aging bucket analysis and escalation of overdue recoverables.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: gross_claim_amount
attributes.description: Total gross claim payment made by Life Insurance to the claimant before any reinsurance recovery. Represents the full liability settled on the underlying policy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer has formally disputed this recoverable. True when the recoverable_status is 'disputed' or a dispute record is active. Drives legal and reinsurance operations workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: is_facultative
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recoverable is associated with a facultative (individually negotiated) reinsurance arrangement rather than an automatic treaty. Facultative recoverables require additional documentation and underwriting evidence.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recoverable arises from a retrocession arrangement, where the reinsurer has itself ceded a portion of the risk to another reinsurer. True for retrocession recoverables; False for direct treaty recoverables.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_at_cession
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) at Cession
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) on the underlying policy at the time of cession, representing the death benefit minus the policy account value. Used in YRT premium calculations and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC RBC Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the recoverable, calculated as recoverable_amount minus amount_received. Drives statutory balance sheet reporting and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC RBC Model Law

attributes.name: recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The calculated amount Life Insurance expects to recover from the reinsurer, derived from the ceded claim amount multiplied by the recoverable percentage. This is the primary balance sheet asset for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: recoverable_percentage
attributes.description: The contractual percentage of the ceded claim amount recoverable from the reinsurer as defined in the treaty terms. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used in NAR-based cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: recoverable_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to this reinsurance recoverable record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: recoverable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance recoverable. 'pending' = identified but not yet submitted; 'submitted' = sent to reinsurer awaiting payment; 'received' = payment collected; 'disputed' = reinsurer has contested the recoverable; 'closed' = fully resolved; 'waived' = recoverable forgone.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_paid
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premium paid to the reinsurer for the ceded risk on the underlying policy up to the claim event date. Used in net cost-of-reinsurance analysis and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reinsurer_response
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the reinsurer's formal response or position on the recoverable or dispute, as communicated in writing. Captures treaty interpretation arguments, documentation requests, or payment confirmations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer completed payment of the recoverable amount. Null if the recoverable has not yet been settled. Used for cash flow and aging analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Retrocession treaties are executed by specific legal entities for regulatory reporting, RBC calculation, and capital management. Reinsurance teams track retrocession ownership by legal entity for stat

attributes.name: originating_reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ceding reinsurer (the party retroceding risk under this treaty). Enables end-to-end risk chain tracking from direct policy through reinsurance to retrocession.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: primary_retrocession_reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retrocessionaire entity (the party accepting the retroceded risk). Links to the reinsurer/counterparty master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Retrocession arrangements have specific regulatory disclosure requirements in statutory filings and may require prior approval in some jurisdictions. Regulatory obligations govern retrocession reporti

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total liability of the retrocessionaire under this treaty across all cessions in a defined period (typically annual). Once the aggregate limit is exhausted, additional losses are retained by the ceding reinsurer. Expressed in treaty currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: allowance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of retrocession premium returned to the ceding reinsurer as a ceding allowance or expense reimbursement under coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaties. Covers Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) and expense loadings. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; FASB ASC 944 DAC; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: arbitration_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains an arbitration clause requiring disputes to be resolved through arbitration rather than litigation. Relevant for contract management and legal risk assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocessionaire is an authorized (licensed) reinsurer in the applicable jurisdiction. Authorized status allows the ceding reinsurer to take full statutory credit for reinsurance without posting collateral.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: automatic_binding_limit
attributes.description: Maximum face amount or NAR per individual life that may be automatically ceded under this retrocession treaty without facultative underwriting approval. Amounts exceeding this limit require facultative retrocession placement. Expressed in treaty currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: bordereaux_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which bordereaux reports are submitted to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Drives the reporting calendar in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS bordereaux module

attributes.name: bordereaux_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocession treaty requires periodic bordereaux reporting (detailed cession-level data submissions) to the retrocessionaire. Bordereaux are standard in proportional retrocession treaties.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS bordereaux module

attributes.name: ceded_layer_maximum
attributes.description: Upper bound (exhaustion point) of the risk layer ceded to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Defines the maximum liability of the retrocessionaire per occurrence or in aggregate. Expressed in treaty currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_layer_minimum
attributes.description: Lower bound of the risk layer ceded to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. For excess-of-loss treaties, this is the attachment point above which the retrocessionaire is liable. Expressed in treaty currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of eligible risk ceded to the retrocessionaire under quota-share or proportional retrocession arrangements. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Not applicable for excess-of-loss treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SAP

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Current value of collateral posted by the retrocessionaire under this treaty, expressed in treaty currency. Monitored against outstanding retrocession recoverables for RBC credit qualification.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; NAIC RBC Framework

attributes.name: collateral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocessionaire is required to post collateral (e.g., letters of credit, trust funds) to support the retrocession obligations. Required for unauthorized retrocessionaires to qualify for RBC credit.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; NAIC RBC Framework; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the retrocessionaire to secure retrocession obligations. Letter of credit and trust funds are the most common forms accepted by state regulators for unauthorized reinsurer credit.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the retrocession treaty record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts under this retrocession treaty are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retrocession arrangements with international retrocessionaires such as Swiss Re or RGA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: cut_through_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains a cut-through clause allowing the original cedant (direct insurer) to claim directly against the retrocessionaire in the event of the intermediate reinsurer's insolvency.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the retrocession treaty becomes binding and new cessions may be placed. Used for premium calculation, reserve valuation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: experience_refund_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession treaty includes an experience refund provision, whereby favorable mortality or morbidity experience results in a partial return of retrocession premium to the ceding reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the retrocession treaty expires and no new cessions may be placed. Nullable for evergreen or continuous treaties. Critical for runoff management and reserve release timing.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: facultative_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty governs facultative retrocession (True) requiring individual risk submission and acceptance, or automatic retrocession (False) where eligible cessions are placed without prior approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: funds_withheld_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession treaty operates on a funds-withheld basis, where the ceding reinsurer retains assets equal to the retrocession reserve rather than transferring them to the retrocessionaire. Relevant for modified coinsurance and funds-withheld coinsurance structures.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code identifying the legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the retrocession treaty. Determines dispute resolution, regulatory oversight, and contract enforceability.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; State Departments of Insurance; IAIS International Association of Insurance Supervisors

attributes.name: insolvency_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains an insolvency clause ensuring the retrocessionaire's obligations continue in the event of the ceding reinsurer's insolvency. Required under NAIC model regulations for credit for reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: modco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession treaty is structured as modified coinsurance (ModCo), where reserves are retained by the ceding reinsurer and a ModCo adjustment is paid to the retrocessionaire to reflect investment income on withheld reserves.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which retrocession premiums are settled between the ceding reinsurer and the retrocessionaire. Drives bordereaux reporting schedules and cash flow management.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Insurance product line covered by this retrocession treaty. Determines applicable mortality tables, reserve bases, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|annuity|disability_income|long_term_care|group_life — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Requirements; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: rbc_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession treaty qualifies for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit under NAIC RBC framework, reducing the ceding reinsurer's required capital. Requires the retrocessionaire to meet NAIC authorized reinsurer standards or post collateral.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Framework; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: reinstatement_provision
attributes.description: Describes the reinstatement terms for the aggregate limit after a loss event. 'None' means no reinstatement; 'one_time' allows a single reinstatement; 'unlimited' allows unlimited reinstatements; 'paid' requires premium payment for reinstatement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Maximum Net Amount at Risk (NAR) or face amount retained by the ceding reinsurer before retroceding the excess to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Expressed in treaty currency. Fundamental to NAR-based cession calculations and RBC capital optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; RBC Risk-Based Capital Framework; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: retrocession_premium_rate
attributes.description: Rate applied to the ceded NAR or face amount to calculate the retrocession premium payable to the retrocessionaire. For YRT retrocession, expressed as rate per $1,000 of NAR. For coinsurance, expressed as a percentage of gross premium. Sourced from treaty rate schedules in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Yearly Renewable Term pricing standards

attributes.name: retrocession_type
attributes.description: Classification of the retrocession arrangement structure. Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) transfers mortality risk only; coinsurance transfers full risk including reserves; modified coinsurance (ModCo) retains reserves with the ceding party; funds-withheld is a variant of ModCo; quota share cedes a fixed percentage; excess-of-loss provides catastrophe protection above a retention limit.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: retrocessionaire_rating
attributes.description: Financial strength rating of the retrocessionaire as assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., A.M. Best, S&P, Moody's). Used for counterparty credit risk assessment and RBC credit eligibility determination.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; A.M. Best Rating Methodology; ORSA Own Risk and Solvency Assessment

attributes.name: retrocessionaire_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the rating agency that issued the retrocessionaire's financial strength rating. Required for counterparty risk monitoring and regulatory credit for reinsurance qualification.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; A.M. Best; S&P Global Ratings; Moody's

attributes.name: settlement_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which retrocession premiums and claim recoverables are settled. Net settlement offsets premiums against recoverables; gross settlement processes each separately; cash call allows immediate recovery of large claims prior to scheduled settlement.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the retrocession treaty was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from expiry_date (scheduled end) — termination may occur early due to breach, mutual agreement, or regulatory action.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: treaty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the retrocession treaty as agreed between the ceding reinsurer and retrocessionaire. Used in management reporting, bordereaux, and counterparty communications.

attributes.name: treaty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the retrocession treaty, used in bordereaux reporting, settlement statements, and counterparty correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785

attributes.name: treaty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retrocession treaty. Active indicates the treaty is in force and accepting new cessions; runoff indicates no new cessions but existing obligations remain; terminated indicates all obligations are closed.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: treaty_territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory or jurisdictions in which the retrocession treaty applies. Defines the scope of eligible cessions by policyholder domicile or policy issuance state. May be a single country code, list of state codes, or 'worldwide'.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation #785; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: treaty_version
attributes.description: Version or amendment number of the retrocession treaty document, incremented when treaty terms are renegotiated or amended. Supports treaty amendment history and audit trail.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the retrocession treaty record was last modified. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

products.name: retrocession_cession
products.description: Transactional record of individual risk cessions made under retrocession treaties, capturing the further transfer of risk beyond the primary reinsurance layer. Captures originating cession reference, retrocession treaty, retrocessionaire, ceded amount, retrocession premium, effective date, and cession status. Enables end-to-end risk transfer chain tracking from direct policy through reinsurance to retrocession.

attributes.name: retrocession_cession_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retrocession cession record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary reinsurance cession record from which this retrocession cession originates. Enables end-to-end risk transfer chain tracking from direct policy through reinsurance to retrocession.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retrocessionaire (the reinsurer accepting the further-transferred risk) party record. Identifies the counterparty assuming the retroceded risk.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: retrocession_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retrocession treaty under which this cession is made. Governs the terms, limits, and conditions applicable to the risk transfer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: The ceding allowance or expense allowance received from the retrocessionaire to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Applicable under coinsurance and modified coinsurance arrangements.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; GAAP DAC

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: The attained age of the insured at the time of this retrocession cession or as of the cession effective date. Used for YRT rate determination and actuarial NAR calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: automatic_binding_limit
attributes.description: The maximum face amount that can be automatically ceded under the retrocession treaty without individual retrocessionaire approval. Amounts exceeding this limit require facultative placement.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: bordereaux_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession cession record has been included in a bordereaux report submitted to the retrocessionaire for the current reporting period.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The reporting period (YYYY-MM) in which this retrocession cession is included in bordereaux reporting to the retrocessionaire. Supports periodic treaty statement reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The gross face amount (death benefit or sum assured) ceded to the retrocessionaire under this retrocession cession. Represents the maximum exposure transferred.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP

attributes.name: ceded_nar
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the retrocessionaire, calculated as the ceded death benefit less the ceded reserve or account value. The primary basis for YRT retrocession premium calculation and RBC optimization.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RBC guidelines

attributes.name: ceded_reserve
attributes.description: The actuarial reserve amount ceded to the retrocessionaire under coinsurance or modified coinsurance arrangements. Relevant for statutory and GAAP reserve reporting and LDTI compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; SAP

attributes.name: claim_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The amount recoverable from the retrocessionaire for claims paid on retroceded risks. Populated when a claim event occurs on the underlying policy. Key metric for reinsurance recoverable tracking and RBC credit.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP; RBC guidelines

attributes.name: claim_recoverable_status
attributes.description: Current status of the claim recoverable from the retrocessionaire. Tracks the collection lifecycle from claim event through receipt of recoverable payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of collateral posted by the retrocessionaire to secure retrocession obligations. Used for credit for reinsurance and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State Departments of Insurance; RBC guidelines

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: The type of collateral or security arrangement provided by the retrocessionaire to support credit for reinsurance eligibility. Required for unauthorized retrocessionaires under NAIC model regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this retrocession cession record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: credit_for_reinsurance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retrocession cession qualifies for credit for reinsurance under applicable state regulations, enabling the ceding reinsurer to take statutory reserve credit.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this retrocession cession record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency retrocession arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retrocession cession becomes effective and risk transfer commences. Used for premium calculation, recoverable eligibility, and treaty compliance.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: experience_refund_amount
attributes.description: The experience refund receivable from the retrocessionaire based on favorable claims experience under profit-sharing or experience refund provisions of the retrocession treaty.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: flat_extra_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which a temporary flat extra premium expires. After this date, the flat extra is no longer charged in the retrocession premium calculation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: flat_extra_premium
attributes.description: Additional flat extra premium per thousand of face amount applied for temporary or permanent substandard risks (e.g., hazardous occupation, aviation). Included in retrocession premium calculation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: funds_withheld_balance
attributes.description: The balance of funds withheld by the ceding reinsurer under a coinsurance with funds withheld retrocession arrangement. Represents assets held as collateral against retrocession obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: modco_reserve_adjustment
attributes.description: The reserve adjustment amount applicable under modified coinsurance (ModCo) retrocession arrangements, representing the change in ceded reserves held by the ceding company on behalf of the retrocessionaire.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SAP; LDTI
