attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year of the underlying direct policy at the time of this retrocession cession. Used for YRT rate table selection and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The amount of risk retained by the ceding reinsurer (not further retroceded) on the underlying policy. Represents the net risk exposure after retrocession.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RBC guidelines

attributes.name: retrocession_basis
attributes.description: The financial arrangement basis under which risk is retroceded. Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) cedes mortality risk only; coinsurance cedes a proportional share of all policy cash flows; modified coinsurance (ModCo) retains reserves with the ceding company; coinsurance with funds withheld retains assets.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: retrocession_premium
attributes.description: The premium amount payable to the retrocessionaire for assuming the retroceded risk. For YRT basis, calculated from NAR and applicable rate tables; for coinsurance, a proportional share of the direct premium.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP

attributes.name: retrocession_premium_mode
attributes.description: The frequency at which retrocession premiums are remitted to the retrocessionaire. Drives billing cycle and cash flow management.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification of the insured as assigned during policy underwriting. Determines applicable YRT retrocession premium rates and risk assessment.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: source_system_cession_ref
attributes.description: The native cession identifier or reference number as recorded in the originating reinsurance management system (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this retrocession cession record was extracted (e.g., SWISS_RE_IRIS, RGA_AURA). Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Substandard table rating applied to the insured (e.g., Table B, Table 4), indicating elevated mortality risk above standard. Affects retrocession premium loading and NAR calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retrocession cession terminates and risk transfer ceases. Null for active cessions. Populated upon policy lapse, surrender, death, or treaty termination.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The treaty year (policy year relative to the retrocession treaty inception) applicable to this cession. Used for experience period tracking, rate table selection, and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this retrocession cession record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

products.name: nar_calculation
products.description: Stores the periodic Net Amount at Risk (NAR) calculations for each ceded policy, which form the basis for YRT reinsurance premium billing. Captures calculation date, policy reference, death benefit, account value or reserve, NAR amount, calculation method, and effective period. NAR is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance charges and reinsurance premium computation. Supports actuarial and reinsurance premium reconciliation.

attributes.name: nar_calculation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Calculation ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Net Amount at Risk (NAR) calculation record in the reinsurance domain. Primary key for the nar_calculation data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: calculation_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: NAR calculations may be performed by actuarial consulting firms or reinsurance administration platform vendors, especially for complex treaty structures. Tracks the vendor performing calculations - es

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ceded life insurance policy for which the NAR is being calculated. Links to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: NAR calculations require premium schedule data including modal premium amount, billing frequency, and paid-to-date status to compute net amount at risk accurately. Actuaries use this for treaty settle

attributes.name: prior_nar_calculation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous NAR calculation record for the same policy and cession, enabling version chaining for corrections and restatements. Null for the initial calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reinsurance cession record under which this NAR calculation is performed. Links to the cession record in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty (YRT or coinsurance) governing the cession for which NAR is calculated. Determines the applicable COI rates and premium computation rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: NAR calculations are performed for specific reinsurers under treaty arrangements. The table currently has 'reinsurer_code' STRING attribute which is a denormalized reference. Adding reinsurer_id FK pr

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: NAR calculations feed directly into reserve calculations for reinsurance accounting, premium billing, and statutory reporting. NAR is the basis for YRT premium calculation and reserve credit.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: NAR calculations drive reinsurance premium billing and reserve calculations, representing material financial statement impacts. Subject to SOX controls for calculation accuracy, completeness, and prop

attributes.name: account_value_amount
attributes.description: The policyholder account value (AV) as of the calculation date, applicable for universal life (UL), indexed universal life (IUL), and variable universal life (VUL) products. Used as the reserve offset in NAR computation for account-value-based products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: billing_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency at which the reinsurance premium is billed to the reinsurer for this cession. Determines the proration of the annual NAR-based premium across billing cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM formatted reporting period for which this NAR calculation is included in the bordereaux report submitted to the reinsurer. Used for reinsurance premium reconciliation and treaty compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The accounting basis under which the NAR calculation is performed. Statutory (SAP) basis is used for regulatory reporting; GAAP basis for financial reporting under FASB ASC 944; IFRS basis for international reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; LDTI

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the Net Amount at Risk was calculated for the ceded policy. Represents the principal real-world event date for this calculation record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial method used to compute the Net Amount at Risk. Determines how the death benefit and reserve or account value are combined to derive NAR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_amount_at_risk_standard|interpolated_reserve|account_value_offset|modified_coinsurance|coinsurance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: calculation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing any exceptions, manual overrides, or special circumstances associated with this NAR calculation, such as facultative underwriting adjustments or treaty amendment impacts.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: calculation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this NAR calculation record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurance premium reconciliation with reinsurance partners such as RGA and Swiss Re.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

attributes.name: calculation_run_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NAR calculation was produced as part of a scheduled periodic run, an ad hoc request, a correction to a prior calculation, or a restatement for prior-period adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NAR calculation record. Indicates whether the calculation is pending review, completed and approved, revised due to data corrections, voided, or in error state.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross death benefit ceded to the reinsurer under the treaty. May differ from the gross death benefit when only a portion of the risk is ceded (e.g., automatic cession limits apply).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: coi_rate_per_thousand
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Insurance (COI) Rate per Thousand
attributes.description: The YRT cost of insurance (COI) rate per $1,000 of Net Amount at Risk, sourced from the applicable treaty rate table based on attained age, gender, risk class, smoker status, and policy year. Directly used to compute the reinsurance premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; YRT Treaty Rate Tables; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this NAR calculation record (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The gross death benefit (DB) payable under the ceded policy as of the calculation date. Represents the total face amount including any riders such as Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) that are included in the cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Used to determine the applicable YRT reinsurance premium billing period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Defines the close of the billing period for YRT reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: insured_age_at_calculation
attributes.description: The attained age of the insured as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups to determine the applicable cost of insurance (COI) rate per unit of NAR for reinsurance premium billing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: insured_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the insured as used in the YRT rate table lookup. Unisex rates apply where state regulations prohibit gender-distinct pricing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Regulations; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAR calculation pertains to a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the company is acting as a reinsurer ceding risk to a retrocessionaire). Distinguishes direct cession NAR from retrocession NAR in reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The computed Net Amount at Risk (NAR), representing the difference between the ceded death benefit and the policy reserve or account value. This is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance (COI) charges and reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Terms

attributes.name: policy_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial reserve held for the ceded policy as of the valuation date. Used in the NAR calculation as the offset against the death benefit for traditional life products. Derived from the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., AXIS, Prophet).
attributes.references: NAIC PBR; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; SAP

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year in force as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups where rates vary by policy duration, and for actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: The type of life insurance product for the ceded policy. Determines the applicable NAR calculation method (e.g., account value offset for UL/IUL/VUL vs. interpolated reserve for WL/Term). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wl|ul|iul|vul|term|yrt|ltc|di — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: rate_table_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the YRT COI rate table applied in this NAR calculation. Ensures auditability and traceability of rate changes over time for actuarial and reinsurance premium reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: rbc_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurance cession associated with this NAR calculation qualifies for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit under NAIC RBC rules. Supports RBC optimization reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Model Act; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for the effective period, computed as (NAR / 1,000) × COI rate per thousand. This is the primary output of the NAR calculation used in YRT premium billing and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_type
attributes.description: The type of reinsurance treaty under which the NAR is calculated. YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) treaties use NAR directly for premium billing; coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties use NAR for risk monitoring and RBC optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured, which determines the applicable YRT COI rate tier. Preferred classes attract lower reinsurance premiums; substandard or rated classes attract higher rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: Tobacco/smoker status of the insured as used in YRT rate table lookups. Smoker status significantly impacts the COI rate applied to the NAR for reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which the NAR calculation data was originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, AXIS Actuarial Valuation System). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The year of the reinsurance treaty in force at the time of the NAR calculation. Used to identify the applicable rate table version when treaty terms are renegotiated periodically.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was last modified. Tracks revisions, corrections, and restatements for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The actuarial valuation date as of which the policy reserve or account value is measured for NAR computation. Typically aligns with the beginning-of-year (BOY) or end-of-year (EOY) valuation cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC PBR; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

products.name: recapture_event
products.description: Tracks recapture events where Life Insurance exercises its contractual right to reclaim previously ceded risk from a reinsurer, typically triggered by improved mortality experience, treaty renegotiation, or reinsurer credit concerns. Captures recapture date, treaty reference, recaptured ceded amount, recapture penalty if applicable, effective date, and recapture status. Supports treaty management and RBC capital planning.

attributes.name: recapture_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recapture event record in the reinsurance management system. Primary key for the recapture_event data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Recapture decisions have significant RBC and financial statement impact, requiring documented approval authority. Tracks who authorized the recapture for SOX controls, delegation of authority validati

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy whose ceded risk is being recaptured. Links to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Code; Sapiens LifePro Policy Administration Module

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Recapture events require formal notice documents, reinsurer acknowledgment letters, settlement agreements, penalty calculations, and regulatory notifications. Treaty administration and financial settl

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Recapture transactions require GL posting for reserve transfer, RBC impact tracking, and financial statement disclosure. Actuarial and finance teams post recapture entries for statutory reporting, cap

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Business justification: Recapture rights are frequently triggered by regulatory changes affecting treaty economics—RBC factor changes, reserve requirement updates, tax law modifications. Links recapture decisions to their re

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific cession record being recaptured. Identifies the original cession transaction from which risk is being reclaimed by Life Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; RGA AURA Reinsurance Cession Processing Module

attributes.name: reinsurance_dispute_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurance_dispute. Business justification: Recapture events can be disputed by reinsurers, particularly regarding penalty amounts, recapture eligibility dates, or settlement calculations. The table currently has 'dispute_reason' STRING attribu

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which the recapture right is exercised. Links to the treaty master record governing the cession arrangement being recaptured.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) from whom risk is being recaptured. Identifies the party relationship in the reinsurance management system.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Internal approval reference number or authorization code issued by Life Insurance's reinsurance management or finance team authorizing the recapture event. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The bordereaux reporting period (e.g., 2024-Q3 or 2024-06) in which this recapture event is included for submission to the reinsurer. Supports ACORD bordereaux reporting and reinsurer reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Bordereaux Reporting Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recapture event record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944; Swiss Re IRIS Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the recapture takes legal and financial effect, which may differ from the recapture_date if retroactive adjustments are required under the treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: mortality_experience_ratio
attributes.description: The actual-to-expected (A/E) mortality ratio that served as the actuarial basis for a mortality_improvement recapture trigger. A ratio below 1.0000 indicates favorable mortality experience justifying recapture. Sourced from actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); SOA Mortality Experience Studies; AXIS/Prophet Actuarial Valuation System

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, context, or operational notes related to the recapture event, entered by the reinsurance operations team. Supports treaty management and audit documentation.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which Life Insurance formally notified the reinsurer of its intent to recapture, as required by treaty notice provisions. Used to validate compliance with contractual notice periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance notice required by the treaty before the recapture can take effect. Used to validate that the notice_date and recapture_date are compliant with treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: partial_recapture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recapture event represents a partial recapture of the ceded risk (True) or a full recapture of the entire cession (False). Partial recaptures are common in large facultative placements.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Contractual penalty fee payable to the reinsurer upon exercise of the recapture right, as stipulated in the treaty terms. May be zero if the treaty permits penalty-free recapture after a specified duration or under qualifying trigger conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: penalty_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractual recapture penalty has been waived by the reinsurer, typically through negotiation or as a result of a qualifying trigger condition such as reinsurer credit concern.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: rbc_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated change in Risk-Based Capital (RBC) requirement resulting from the recapture of ceded risk. A positive value indicates increased capital requirement as retained risk rises. Supports RBC capital planning and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: recapture_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which Life Insurance formally exercises its contractual right to recapture previously ceded risk from the reinsurer. This is the operative date for treaty and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: recapture_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of the original ceded risk being recaptured, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Applicable when partial_recapture_flag is True. Used to calculate pro-rata reserve and premium adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: recapture_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to the recapture event, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: recapture_right_eligible_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which Life Insurance became contractually eligible to exercise the recapture right under the treaty terms, typically based on a minimum cession duration or treaty anniversary.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: recapture_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recapture event workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|disputed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: recapture_trigger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the business reason that triggered the recapture event. Supports treaty management analytics and RBC capital planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortality_improvement|treaty_renegotiation|reinsurer_credit_concern|treaty_expiry|voluntary|regulatory_requirement — promote to reference product if additional triggers are required]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines

attributes.name: recaptured_face_amount
attributes.description: The gross face amount (death benefit) of the ceded risk being recaptured from the reinsurer. Represents the notional insurance coverage amount returned to Life Insurance's retained book.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: recaptured_nar_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recaptured Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — the difference between the death benefit and the policy reserve — that is being recaptured from the reinsurer. This is the primary quantitative measure of risk reclaimed and is central to RBC capital planning calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: recaptured_premium_amount
attributes.description: The annualized or in-force reinsurance premium amount that will cease to be paid to the reinsurer as a result of the recapture. Used for premium billing reconciliation and financial impact assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: recaptured_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The statutory or GAAP reserve amount associated with the recaptured cession that must be transferred back to Life Insurance's balance sheet upon recapture. Relevant for coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaty types.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; FASB ASC 944; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving) Guidelines; LDTI

attributes.name: reinsurer_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally acknowledged the recapture notice. Populated when reinsurer_acknowledgment_flag is True. Used to track treaty compliance timelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer has formally acknowledged receipt of the recapture notice. Required to confirm the recapture process is proceeding in accordance with treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating of the reinsurer at the time the recapture event was initiated, as assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., A.M. Best, S&P, Moody's). Captured to document the credit concern trigger basis and support ERM reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; ERM Standards; A.M. Best Rating Methodology

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: The rating agency that issued the credit rating captured in reinsurer_credit_rating. Used to contextualize the rating value for ERM and credit risk reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; ERM Standards

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cession being recaptured was part of a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the reinsurer had further ceded the risk to a retrocessionaire). Flags potential downstream settlement complexity.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Retrocession Module

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Net financial settlement amount payable between Life Insurance and the reinsurer to finalize the recapture, accounting for reserve transfers, return premiums, and any applicable penalty. Represents the net cash flow of the recapture transaction.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this recapture event record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements with international reinsurers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial settlement of the recapture event is completed, including reserve transfers and penalty payments. Used for cash flow reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Bordereaux Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this recapture event record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: treaty_anniversary_year
attributes.description: The treaty year (number of years since treaty inception) at the time of recapture. Many treaties permit recapture only after a minimum number of treaty years, and this field documents compliance with that condition.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recapture event record was most recently modified in the reinsurance management system. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944; Swiss Re IRIS Reinsurance Management System

products.name: reinsurer_settlement
products.description: Records periodic financial settlements between Life Insurance and reinsurers, netting reinsurance premiums payable against claim recoverables receivable and experience refunds. Captures settlement period, reinsurer, gross premium amount, gross recoverable amount, experience refund amount, net settlement amount, settlement direction (payable/receivable), settlement date, payment reference, and reconciliation status. Supports accounts payable/receivable reconciliation with the finance domain and provides the financial close record for each reinsurer relationship.

attributes.name: reinsurer_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurer settlement record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the reinsurer_settlement data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Settlement approvals involve material cash flows requiring documented employee authority for financial controls and SOX 404 compliance. Tracks approval chain for audit trails, segregation of duties, a

attributes.name: bordereaux_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.bordereaux. Business justification: Reinsurer settlements reconcile financial positions between Life Insurance and reinsurers, and they reference specific bordereaux submissions as supporting documentation. The table currently has 'bord

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Settlement transactions must link to GL entries for cash reconciliation, intercompany elimination, and financial statement preparation. Treasury and accounting teams reconcile settlement payments to j

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Settlement amounts flow directly to statutory financial statements and must be disclosed in regulatory filings. Critical for Schedule S Part 3 reconciliation and quarterly/annual statement preparation

attributes.name: reinsurance_dispute_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurance_dispute. Business justification: Reinsurer settlements can be disputed regarding net settlement amounts, reconciliation discrepancies, or payment timing. The table currently has 'dispute_reason' STRING and 'dispute_resolution_date' D

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, or facultative) under which this settlement is calculated.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer entity (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) that is the counterparty to this settlement. Links to the reinsurer master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The financial reporting period to which this settlement is attributed, expressed as YYYY-MM for monthly or YYYY-Q# for quarterly periods (e.g., '2024-03' or '2024-Q1'). Used for financial close alignment and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Ceding allowance or expense allowance paid by the reinsurer to offset the ceding company's acquisition and administrative costs. Common in coinsurance and quota share treaties. Reduces the net settlement payable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was formally approved by the authorized approver within Life Insurance prior to payment initiation. Supports SOX internal controls and dual-authorization requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: ceded_nar_amount
attributes.description: Total Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer across all policies in the settlement period. NAR is the death benefit minus the policy reserve and is the basis for YRT premium calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards; NAR (Net Amount at Risk) definition

attributes.name: ceded_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual ceded policies or certificates included in this settlement period's bordereaux. Supports volume reconciliation and treaty capacity monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System. Used for audit trail and financial close reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance arrangements with international reinsurers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a disputed settlement was resolved and agreed upon by both parties. Null if no dispute exists or if the dispute is still open.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert settlement amounts to the functional currency (USD) when the settlement currency differs. Rate is expressed as units of settlement currency per one USD.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: experience_refund_amount
attributes.description: Experience refund or profit commission payable by the reinsurer to the ceding company when actual claims experience is more favorable than the treaty's expected loss ratio. Reduces the net settlement payable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: funds_withheld_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative balance of funds withheld by the ceding company from the reinsurer under a funds-withheld or modified coinsurance arrangement. The ceding company retains assets equal to the ceded reserve and pays interest to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; ALM (Asset Liability Management) standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the net settlement amount is posted in the finance domain. Enables automated journal entry creation and financial close reconciliation under SAP and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: gross_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premiums payable to the reinsurer for the settlement period before any offsets. Represents the ceded premium obligation under the treaty for the period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Total claim recoverables receivable from the reinsurer for the settlement period before any offsets. Represents the reinsurer's share of claims paid or incurred under the treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP; IBNR

attributes.name: ibnr_recoverable_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Recoverable Amount
attributes.description: Reinsurer's estimated share of Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) claims included in the settlement. Represents the actuarially estimated recoverable for claims that have occurred but have not yet been reported or fully adjudicated.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported) actuarial standards; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving)

attributes.name: interest_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Interest credited or charged on funds withheld or late payments under modified coinsurance or funds-withheld arrangements. Positive values indicate interest owed to the ceding company; negative values indicate interest owed to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; ALM (Asset Liability Management) standards

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The net financial obligation after netting gross reinsurance premiums payable against gross claim recoverables receivable, experience refunds, allowances, and interest adjustments. Represents the final amount to be paid or received.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special instructions, or contextual information related to this settlement. Used by reinsurance operations staff to document exceptions, adjustments, or communications with the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was initiated or the funds were transferred. May differ from settlement_date if there is a processing lag between settlement approval and actual funds movement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Wire transfer reference, ACH trace number, or check number associated with the actual payment or receipt of the net settlement amount. Used for bank reconciliation and accounts payable/receivable matching in the finance domain.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FinCEN AML/BSA compliance

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was successfully reconciled against the finance domain's accounts payable/receivable ledger. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accounts payable/receivable reconciliation process for this settlement with the finance domain. 'unreconciled' indicates not yet matched; 'in_progress' indicates active review; 'reconciled' confirms match; 'exception' indicates a discrepancy requiring resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reserve_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment to ceded reserves transferred between the ceding company and reinsurer under coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaties. Reflects changes in policy reserves during the settlement period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: retrocession_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement relates to a retrocession arrangement (True) where the reinsurer cedes risk to another reinsurer, or a standard cession from the primary insurer (False). Supports retrocession tracking and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; RBC (Risk-Based Capital) standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the net settlement amount was paid or received, representing the principal real-world financial event date. Distinct from the settlement period end date and the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: settlement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the net settlement amount is payable by Life Insurance to the reinsurer ('payable') or receivable by Life Insurance from the reinsurer ('receivable'). Drives accounts payable/receivable classification in the finance domain.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed-upon frequency at which settlements are performed under the reinsurance treaty. Drives the settlement period dates and financial close calendar.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this settlement by the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Used in bordereaux reporting and accounts payable/receivable reconciliation with the finance domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the accounting period covered by this settlement. Together with settlement_period_start_date, defines the bordereaux reporting window for premium and recoverable netting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the accounting period covered by this settlement (e.g., first day of the month or quarter). Defines the beginning of the bordereaux reporting window.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement record. 'draft' indicates initial calculation; 'pending' awaits approval; 'approved' is authorized for payment; 'settled' confirms payment has been made or received; 'disputed' indicates a discrepancy raised by either party; 'voided' indicates cancellation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this settlement record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_settlement_reference
attributes.description: The native settlement identifier from the originating Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this settlement record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for financial close processes.

products.name: inforce_cession_snapshot
products.description: Periodic point-in-time snapshot of all active cessions capturing the in-force ceded block as of a valuation date. Stores ceded face amount, NAR, reinsurance reserve credit, ceded premium, plan code, risk class, treaty reference, and reinsurer per cession as of the snapshot date. Primary data source for NAIC Schedule S statutory reporting (Parts 1-6), actuarial ceded reserve valuation, RBC C-1 credit risk calculations, and reinsurance block reconciliation. Distinct from the live cession record — this is the immutable historical valuation record used for period-end reporting.

attributes.name: inforce_cession_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable point-in-time cession snapshot record in the silver layer lakehouse. Serves as the primary key for this valuation record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy associated with this cession. Links the cession snapshot to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Snapshots track inforce cessions by product plan. Essential for Schedule S reporting, RBC calculations, reserve adequacy testing, and product performance monitoring. Plan_code is denormalized; FK enab

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the live cession record in the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance) from which this snapshot was derived. Links the immutable snapshot back to the operational cession record for reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Schedule S

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this cession was placed. Identifies the governing treaty agreement (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, etc.) for this cession record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 1; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re, Munich Re) accepting the ceded risk under this snapshot. Used for reinsurer-level aggregation and counterparty credit risk reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 3; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Inforce cession snapshots are generated as part of valuation runs for Schedule S preparation, RBC credit calculation, and reinsurance reserve reporting. Essential for statutory filing.

attributes.name: valuation_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Inforce valuation and cession snapshots are often produced by actuarial consulting firms or reinsurance admin platforms for statutory reporting. Tracks the vendor performing valuation - required for S

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: The expense allowance or ceding commission received from the reinsurer for the current valuation period, expressed in USD. Applicable to coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties. Offsets the cedant's acquisition and maintenance expenses. Reported in NAIC Schedule S Part 2.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 2; SSAP No. 61R; DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting

attributes.name: automatic_binding_limit
attributes.description: The maximum face amount that can be automatically ceded under the treaty without individual reinsurer approval, expressed in USD. Cessions exceeding this limit require facultative placement. Used for treaty compliance validation in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 1; SSAP No. 61R; ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The reporting period identifier for bordereaux submission to the reinsurer, formatted as YYYY-QN (quarterly) or YYYY-MM (monthly). Used to group cession snapshots for bordereaux report generation and reinsurer reconciliation in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards; NAIC Schedule S

attributes.name: ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The gross face amount (death benefit) ceded to the reinsurer under this cession as of the valuation date, expressed in USD. Represents the reinsurer's share of the total policy face amount. Used in NAIC Schedule S Part 1 and RBC C-1 credit risk calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 1; SSAP No. 61R; RBC C-1

attributes.name: ceded_premium
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for the current valuation period, expressed in USD. For YRT treaties, calculated as NAR multiplied by the applicable YRT rate. For coinsurance, represents the proportional share of gross premium. Used in NAIC Schedule S Part 2 and reinsurance premium reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 2; SSAP No. 61R; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_reserve
attributes.description: The statutory reserve credit taken by the cedant for the ceded portion of the policy as of the valuation date, expressed in USD. Applicable primarily to coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties. Used in actuarial ceded reserve valuation (AXIS, Prophet, MoSes) and NAIC Schedule S Part 4.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 4; SSAP No. 61R; PBR (VM-20); LDTI (ASU 2018-12)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cession snapshot record was first written to the silver layer lakehouse. Represents the ETL ingestion time for this immutable record. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this cession snapshot record (e.g., USD, CAD). Required for multi-currency reinsurance treaties and foreign reinsurer arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: insured_age_at_issue
attributes.description: The age of the insured at the time the policy was issued, expressed in whole years. Used as a key rating variable for YRT reinsurance premium rate determination and actuarial mortality experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Underwriting Standards; SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: insured_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the insured as used for actuarial rating and YRT reinsurance premium calculation. Unisex is used where gender-distinct rating is prohibited by state regulation. Required for mortality experience studies and ceded block segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Data Standards; State DOI regulations

attributes.name: is_modified_coinsurance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession is structured as modified coinsurance (ModCo), where the cedant retains the policy reserves and pays a ModCo reserve adjustment to the reinsurer. True for ModCo arrangements; False for standard coinsurance or YRT. Drives reserve credit and interest adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: SSAP No. 61R; NAIC Schedule S; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession is a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the cedant is itself a reinsurer ceding risk to a retrocessionaire). True for retrocession cessions; False for direct cessions from a primary insurer. Used to distinguish retrocession layers in NAIC Schedule S Part 6.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 6; SSAP No. 61R

attributes.name: modco_reserve_adjustment
attributes.description: The reserve adjustment amount payable under a modified coinsurance arrangement, representing the change in the reinsurer's notional reserve share held by the cedant, expressed in USD. Applicable only when is_modified_coinsurance is True. Required for NAIC Schedule S Part 4 and statutory reserve reporting.
attributes.references: SSAP No. 61R; NAIC Schedule S Part 4; ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards

attributes.name: nar
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer as of the valuation date, expressed in USD. For YRT treaties, NAR equals the ceded death benefit minus the policy reserve. NAR is the primary basis for YRT reinsurance premium calculation and RBC C-1 credit risk exposure measurement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; SSAP No. 61R; RBC C-1; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying life insurance policy was issued by the cedant. Used to determine policy duration, YRT rate band applicability, and treaty vintage for actuarial experience studies and ceded block segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-known policy identifier from the Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro). Included directly on the snapshot for bordereaux reporting and reinsurer reconciliation without requiring a join to the policy master.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: rbc_credit_amount
attributes.description: The Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit attributable to this cession as of the valuation date, expressed in USD. Represents the reduction in C-1 credit risk capital requirement resulting from the reinsurance arrangement. Used in RBC C-1 calculations and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions; ORSA; SSAP No. 61R

attributes.name: reinsurance_basis
attributes.description: The age basis used for calculating YRT reinsurance premiums. Attained age uses the insured's current age each year; original age uses the age at policy issue; issue age uses the age at cession inception. Determines the YRT rate table lookup methodology.
attributes.references: SSAP No. 61R; ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards; SOA YRT Rate Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_authorization_status
attributes.description: The authorization status of the reinsurer in the cedant's state of domicile as of the valuation date. Authorized reinsurers allow full reserve credit; unauthorized reinsurers require collateral (letters of credit or trust funds). Critical for NAIC Schedule S Part 3 and reserve credit eligibility.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 3; SSAP No. 61R; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.description: The five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the reinsurer. Required for NAIC Schedule S statutory filing to identify the assuming reinsurer. Used for reinsurer credit quality assessment and RBC counterparty risk reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; NAIC Company Licensing Database

attributes.name: retained_face_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total policy face amount retained by the cedant (direct writer) after cession, expressed in USD. Retained amount equals total face amount minus ceded face amount. Required for retention limit compliance monitoring and NAIC Schedule S reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 1; SSAP No. 61R

attributes.name: retention_limit
attributes.description: The maximum face amount the cedant retains on any single life under the applicable treaty or company retention schedule, expressed in USD. Used to validate that ceded amounts comply with treaty automatic binding limits and company retention policy.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; SSAP No. 61R; ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured at policy issue, as determined by the Underwriting Workbench (e.g., RGAX AURA, Swiss Re Magnum). Drives YRT reinsurance premium rates and NAR-based cession calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated|uninsurable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: schedule_s_part
attributes.description: The NAIC Schedule S part to which this cession snapshot record contributes. Part 1: Ceded reinsurance; Part 2: Assumed reinsurance; Part 3: Reinsurer details; Part 4: Reserve credits; Part 5: Terminated cessions; Part 6: Retrocessions. Used for statutory filing preparation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; SSAP No. 61R; State DOI Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: The tobacco/smoker classification of the insured as determined at underwriting. Drives YRT reinsurance premium rate selection and mortality risk segmentation. Required for actuarial experience studies and ceded block analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Life Underwriting Standards; SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: snapshot_run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the snapshot extraction process was executed. May differ from valuation_date in cases of late runs, restatements, or retroactive adjustments. Used for lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cession snapshot record was last modified in the silver layer. For immutable snapshot records, this is typically set only on initial load; updates indicate restatements or corrections. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The period-end date as of which this cession snapshot was captured. Represents the immutable point-in-time reference for all financial and risk values in this record. Primary key for snapshot partitioning and NAIC Schedule S statutory reporting periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; FASB ASC 944; LDTI (ASU 2018-12)

attributes.name: yrt_rate_per_thousand
attributes.business_glossary_term: Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) Rate per Thousand
attributes.description: The YRT reinsurance premium rate per $1,000 of Net Amount at Risk (NAR) applicable to this cession as of the valuation date. Sourced from the treaty rate schedule based on insured age, gender, risk class, and smoker status. Used to validate ceded premium calculations.
attributes.references: SSAP No. 61R; ACORD Reinsurance Data Standards; SOA YRT Rate Standards

products.name: reserve
products.description: Stores reinsurance reserve calculations representing the ceded portion of policy reserves held by or credited from reinsurers under coinsurance, modified coinsurance (ModCo), and funds withheld coinsurance treaties. Captures valuation date, treaty reference, reinsurer, ceded reserve basis (GAAP/SAP/IFRS), ceded reserve amount, reserve type (traditional ceded/funds withheld/ModCo adjustment), funds withheld balance amount, credited interest rate, interest credited amount, modified coinsurance reserve adjustment, settlement status, and reserve method. This is the single source of truth for all ceded reserves and funds withheld balances. Supports LDTI, PBR, and IFRS 17 ceded reserve reporting, ALM coordination for withheld asset management, and investment domain integration for credited interest calculations.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance reserve calculation record. Primary key for the reinsurance_reserve data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy for which the ceded reserve is being calculated and reported.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Reserve movements require GL posting for statutory and GAAP reporting, RBC calculation, and external audit. Actuarial teams calculate ceded reserves; finance teams post reserve changes to GL for quart

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves are held per product plan. Critical for statutory reporting, GAAP/IFRS reserve calculations, and product-level reserve adequacy analysis. Product_line is high-level category; FK e

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Ceded reserves are backed by designated investment portfolios in ModCo and funds-withheld arrangements. Business process: reserve valuation, investment income allocation, interest crediting, and ALM g

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific cession record (automatic or facultative) associated with this reserve calculation. Links to the cession processing record.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGA AURA Reinsurance Cession Processing Module

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this ceded reserve is calculated. Links to the treaty master record governing the cession terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) holding or crediting the ceded reserve under this treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves are calculated as part of overall reserve calculations for statutory valuation, RBC credit determination, and GAAP/IFRS17 reporting. Direct business process dependency.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves are material financial statement items subject to SOX controls for valuation accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment. Critical for financial reporting integrity an

attributes.name: statutory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.statutory_filing. Business justification: Ceded reserves are core statutory filing components (Schedule S, balance sheet liability reductions). Filings must reference reserve calculations for modified coinsurance, funds withheld, and credit f

attributes.name: actuarial_assumption_set
attributes.description: The identifier or label of the actuarial assumption set used in the reserve calculation (e.g., 'PBR_2024_Q4', 'LDTI_LOCKED_IN_2023', 'IFRS17_CURRENT_EST'). Enables traceability of reserve calculations to specific assumption vintages used in the Actuarial Valuation System.
attributes.references: NAIC VM-20 PBR; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet; MoSes)

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The accounting or regulatory basis under which the ceded reserve is calculated. 'gaap' = Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (FASB ASC 944/LDTI); 'sap' = Statutory Accounting Principles (NAIC); 'ifrs17' = International Financial Reporting Standards 17; 'pbr' = Principle-Based Reserving (NAIC VM-20/VM-21); 'tax' = IRS tax reserve basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; NAIC VM-20 PBR; IRS IRC Section 807

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The period identifier for the bordereaux report in which this reserve record is included (e.g., Q12024, M032024, FY2023). Bordereaux reports are periodic data submissions to reinsurers summarizing ceded reserves, premiums, and claims. Supports Swiss Re IRIS and RGA AURA bordereaux reporting modules.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the policy face amount (death benefit) ceded to the reinsurer under this treaty. Represents the reinsurer's share of the total death benefit exposure. Used in automatic and facultative cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Cession Processing Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_nar_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer under this treaty as of the valuation date. NAR represents the excess of the death benefit over the policy reserve, and is the basis for YRT reinsurance premium calculations. Critical for RBC optimization and NAR-based cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC (Risk-Based Capital) Framework; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The gross ceded reserve amount transferred to or credited from the reinsurer under the treaty as of the valuation date. Represents the ceding company's share of policy reserves ceded to the reinsurer. Used in LDTI, PBR, and IFRS 17 ceded reserve reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: The amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds, or funds withheld) posted by an unauthorized reinsurer to support the ceded reserve credit. Required for statutory credit for reinsurance when the reinsurer is not authorized in the ceding company's domiciliary state.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: The type of collateral posted by the reinsurer to support the ceded reserve credit for unauthorized reinsurers. 'letter_of_credit' = LOC from an approved bank; 'trust_fund' = assets held in a qualifying trust; 'funds_withheld' = assets retained by ceding company; 'cash_deposit' = cash deposited with the ceding company.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reinsurance reserve record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements for financial reporting records.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate credited by the ceding company to the reinsurer on the funds withheld balance under a funds withheld or ModCo treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%). Drives the interest credited amount calculation and ALM coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this reserve record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaties with international reinsurers such as Swiss Re and RGA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dac_ceded_amount
attributes.description: The Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) amount ceded to the reinsurer under coinsurance treaties. Represents the reinsurer's proportional share of deferred acquisition costs, which offsets the ceding company's DAC asset. Required for GAAP and LDTI financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); GAAP Generally Accepted Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this reinsurance reserve record is effective. Represents the start of the period covered by this reserve calculation, typically aligned with the treaty effective date or policy issue date.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this reinsurance reserve record expires or is superseded. Represents the end of the period covered by this reserve calculation. Null for open-ended or in-force records.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: funds_withheld_balance
attributes.description: The balance of assets withheld by the ceding company on behalf of the reinsurer under a funds withheld coinsurance or ModCo treaty. Represents the liability owed to the reinsurer for assets retained. Critical for ALM coordination and investment domain integration.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: ifrs17_csg_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: IFRS 17 Contractual Service Margin (CSG) Ceded Amount
attributes.description: The ceded Contractual Service Margin (CSM) amount under IFRS 17 for this reinsurance reserve record. Represents the reinsurer's share of unearned profit under IFRS 17 measurement. Required for IFRS 17 ceded reinsurance contract reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS)

attributes.name: ifrs17_ra_ceded_amount
attributes.description: The ceded Risk Adjustment (RA) for non-financial risk under IFRS 17 for this reinsurance reserve record. Represents the reinsurer's share of the risk adjustment, reflecting the compensation required for bearing uncertainty in insurance cash flows.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS)

attributes.name: interest_credited_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of interest credited to the reinsurer on the funds withheld balance for the valuation period. Calculated as the funds withheld balance multiplied by the credited interest rate for the period. Supports investment domain integration and settlement calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: is_authorized_reinsurer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized (licensed) in the ceding company's state of domicile (True) or is an unauthorized/alien reinsurer requiring collateral (False). Affects statutory credit for reinsurance and RBC treatment under NAIC regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve record relates to a retrocession arrangement (True) where the reinsurer further cedes risk to another reinsurer, or a direct reinsurance cession (False). Supports retrocession reserve tracking and RBC reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: modco_reserve_adjustment
