Real business need: portfolio-to-segment mapping for segmented financial reporting and r

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this separate account portfolio to the specific variable product fund (sub-account) it supports for VUL or variable annuity unit value calculations. Null for general account portfolios.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act; FINRA; Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity

attributes.name: actual_duration_years
attributes.description: Current measured modified duration of the portfolio in years as of the valuation date. Compared against target duration to assess ALM duration gap and trigger rebalancing actions.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC C-3 Instructions; ORSA; Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension

attributes.name: actual_market_value
attributes.description: Total Fair Market Value (FMV) of all assets held in the portfolio as of the most recent valuation date. Represents the principal quantitative measure of portfolio size. Used in RBC calculations, NAIC statutory reporting, and performance attribution.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; SAP; LDTI

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of portfolio management responsibility allocated to this manager for performance attribution purposes. For portfolios with multiple managers, allocation percentages sum to 100%. Used in compensation calculations and performance reviews.

attributes.name: alm_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the portfolio's role within the Asset Liability Management (ALM) framework. Indicates whether the portfolio is duration-matched to specific policy reserve liabilities, held as surplus, maintained as a liquidity reserve, or supports variable product unit value calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; ACORD ALM Standards

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class of the portfolio (e.g., fixed income, equity, alternative assets, real estate). Determines investment mandate constraints, NAIC Schedule classification, and RBC investment risk charge category.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions; NAIC Schedule D/E/BA; ACORD Investment Data Standards

attributes.name: assignment_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment committee formally approved this manager assignment. Required for fiduciary responsibility documentation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manager assignment. Active assignments are operational; pending assignments are approved but not yet effective; suspended assignments are temporarily inactive; terminated assignments are historical.

attributes.name: benchmark_ytd_pct
attributes.description: Year-to-date total return percentage of the designated benchmark index as of the most recent valuation date. Used alongside portfolio YTD performance to compute active return (alpha) in performance attribution.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS Standards; Charles River IMS Performance Attribution Module

attributes.name: cdr_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Conditional Default Rate (CDR) tracking is enabled for this portfolio. When true, the portfolio is subject to CDR monitoring for structured credit assets (e.g., RMBS, CMBS, ABS) per NAIC structured securities guidelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Structured Securities Group; NAIC Schedule D; RBC C-1 Instructions

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the portfolio was formally closed and all assets were liquidated or transferred. Null for active portfolios. Used for lifecycle management and historical performance reporting.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the portfolio master record was first created in the investment management system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the portfolio is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency ALM reporting and foreign exchange risk monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manager assignment became effective. Used for succession planning, performance attribution period determination, and regulatory fiduciary responsibility documentation.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manager assignment ended. Null for currently active assignments. Used for historical performance attribution and succession planning analysis.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The date on which the portfolio was formally established and began accepting assets. Used as the start date for performance measurement, GIPS-compliant composite reporting, and DAC amortization schedules.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS Standards; FASB ASC 944; Charles River IMS

attributes.name: investment_committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment committee formally approved the portfolio's investment mandate, strategic asset allocation, and risk parameters. Required for governance documentation and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Investment Guidelines; Corporate Governance Framework

attributes.name: investment_income_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate investment income from this portfolio to insurance product lines or liability segments (e.g., direct attribution to a specific policy block, pro-rata allocation, segmented portfolio method). Impacts GAAP/SAP income statement reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP

attributes.name: investment_mandate
attributes.description: Narrative description of the portfolio's investment mandate, including permitted asset types, credit quality constraints, duration targets, yield objectives, and any ESG or sector restrictions. Governs portfolio manager decision-making and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS Compliance Module; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: is_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the portfolio is currently in compliance with all investment mandate constraints, NAIC investment guidelines, and RBC requirements as of the last compliance check. False triggers a compliance breach workflow in the investment management system.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS Compliance Module; NAIC Investment Guidelines; ORSA; RBC

attributes.name: last_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent automated or manual compliance check was performed against the portfolio's investment mandate and regulatory constraints. Used to ensure compliance monitoring cadence meets NAIC and internal governance requirements.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS Compliance Module; NAIC Investment Guidelines; SOX

attributes.name: last_rebalancing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent rebalancing of the portfolio was executed. Used to determine next scheduled rebalancing date and to assess compliance with rebalancing frequency policy.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the portfolio master record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: manager_role
attributes.description: The specific role this employee plays in managing this portfolio. Distinguishes between lead portfolio managers (primary fiduciary responsibility) and supporting managers (sector specialists, junior PMs). Critical for investment committee reporting and performance attribution.

attributes.name: max_single_issuer_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of portfolio market value that may be invested in securities of a single issuer. Defined in the investment policy statement to manage concentration risk per NAIC investment guidelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines; Charles River IMS Compliance Module; ORSA

attributes.name: min_credit_quality_rating
attributes.description: Minimum permissible credit quality rating (S&P/Moody's equivalent) for assets held in this portfolio, as defined in the investment mandate. Enforced by the compliance monitoring module to prevent below-mandate credit quality drift.
attributes.references: NAIC ELCA (Equivalent Credit Quality); Charles River IMS Compliance Module; S&P; Moody's

attributes.name: naic_schedule_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Schedule Classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the portfolio per NAIC Annual Statement schedules: Schedule D (bonds and stocks), Schedule E (cash and short-term investments), Schedule BA (other long-term invested assets). Required for statutory reporting under SAP.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SAP; NAIC Schedule D/E/BA

attributes.name: performance_ytd_pct
attributes.description: Year-to-date total return percentage for the portfolio as of the most recent valuation date. Calculated gross of fees. Used in performance attribution reporting and investment committee reviews. Not a derived aggregate — sourced directly from the investment management system.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS Standards; Charles River IMS Performance Attribution Module; SimCorp Dimension

attributes.name: portfolio_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the portfolio within the investment management system. Used in trade execution, bordereaux reporting, and regulatory filings (NAIC Schedule D/E/BA).
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Schedule D/E/BA

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the investment portfolio (e.g., 'General Account Fixed Income Core', 'Separate Account Equity Growth'). Used in reporting, performance attribution, and ALM dashboards.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension — Portfolio Management Module

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the portfolio: active (fully operational), pending_approval (awaiting investment committee approval), inactive (temporarily not trading), suspended (regulatory or compliance hold), or closed (terminated). Governs trade execution eligibility.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Classifies the portfolio by account structure: general account (insurer's own assets backing policyholder liabilities), separate account (assets held for variable product policyholders), or alternative asset portfolio. Drives regulatory treatment and RBC charge category.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 817; SEC — Variable Products

attributes.name: primary_manager_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying the lead portfolio manager with primary fiduciary responsibility. Exactly one assignment per portfolio should have this flag set to true at any point in time. Used for regulatory reporting and investment committee documentation.

attributes.name: rbc_charge_category
attributes.description: Designates the Risk-Based Capital (RBC) charge category applicable to this portfolio per NAIC RBC instructions. C-1 covers asset default risk, C-3 covers interest rate and market risk for general account portfolios. Drives capital adequacy calculations and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions; NAIC ORSA Guidance; SAP

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which the portfolio is reviewed and rebalanced to strategic asset allocation targets. May be calendar-based or trigger-based (drift threshold breach). Governs trade execution scheduling.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; Investment Policy Statement

attributes.name: rebalancing_trigger_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage drift from strategic asset allocation targets before a mandatory rebalancing event is triggered. Defined in the investment policy statement and monitored by the compliance module.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS Compliance Module; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: risk_tolerance_tier
attributes.description: Categorical risk tolerance classification assigned to the portfolio by the investment committee. Drives permitted asset allocation ranges, maximum credit quality thresholds, and duration band constraints within the investment mandate.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines; ORSA; ERM Framework; Charles River IMS Compliance Module

attributes.name: strategic_alternative_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Alternative Assets Target Percentage
attributes.description: Long-term strategic target allocation percentage for alternative assets (private equity, hedge funds, real estate, infrastructure) within this portfolio. Subject to NAIC Schedule BA reporting and RBC C-1 charges.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule BA; NAIC RBC Instructions; Charles River IMS

attributes.name: strategic_equity_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Equity Target Percentage
attributes.description: Long-term strategic target allocation percentage for equity assets within this portfolio, as approved by the investment committee. Used in rebalancing trigger calculations and ALM compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: strategic_fixed_income_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Fixed Income Target Percentage
attributes.description: Long-term strategic target allocation percentage for fixed income assets within this portfolio. Core to ALM duration matching and liability-driven investment strategy for general account portfolios.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; NAIC Investment Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: tactical_equity_weight_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) Equity Weight Percentage
attributes.description: Current tactical allocation weight for equity assets, reflecting short-term market views and deviations from the strategic target. Compared against strategic target to compute rebalancing drift.

attributes.name: tactical_fixed_income_weight_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) Fixed Income Weight Percentage
attributes.description: Current tactical allocation weight for fixed income assets, reflecting short-term positioning relative to the strategic target. Used in ALM duration drift monitoring.
attributes.references: Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: target_duration_years
attributes.description: Target modified duration of the portfolio in years, set by the ALM committee to match the duration of corresponding insurance policy reserve liabilities. Core to interest rate risk management and C-3 RBC charge calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC C-3 Instructions; ORSA; ALM Framework; Charles River IMS

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for the most recent Fair Market Value (FMV) or Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation of the portfolio. Critical for statutory reporting, GAAP/IFRS financial statements, and variable product unit value calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820; NAIC Annual Statement; IFRS 13; SAP

products.name: asset_holding
products.description: Represents an individual investment position held within a portfolio at a point in time, covering all asset classes including fixed income, equity, mortgage loans, alternative investments (private equity, hedge funds, real estate, infrastructure), and other Schedule BA assets. Captures CUSIP/ISIN identifier, asset class and subtype, NAIC designation, book value, amortized cost, FMV, par value, quantity/units held, acquisition date, maturity date, coupon/dividend rate, credit rating, NAIC Schedule classification (D-1, D-2, E, BA, B). For mortgage loans: property type, LTV ratio, DSCR, amortization type, loan status, appraisal value. For alternative assets: fund manager, commitment/funded/unfunded amounts, vintage year, investment strategy, liquidity classification, lock-up period. Core operational record for portfolio composition, RBC investment risk charge calculations, and NAIC Schedule reporting across all asset types.

attributes.name: accrued_interest
attributes.description: The interest earned on a fixed income security since the last coupon payment date but not yet received. Included in the total carrying value for NAIC Schedule D reporting and investment income accrual under both SAP and GAAP.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investment position was originally acquired or purchased. Used for holding period calculations, cost basis determination, NAIC Schedule D reporting, and tax lot accounting under IRC Section 1221.

attributes.name: amortized_cost
attributes.description: The acquisition cost of a fixed income security adjusted for the systematic amortization of premium or accretion of discount over the holding period using the effective interest method. Represents the GAAP/SAP carrying value for held-to-maturity and available-for-sale bonds.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 320; NAIC Schedule D; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: as_of_date
attributes.description: The valuation or reporting date as of which this holding record represents the position snapshot. Critical for point-in-time portfolio composition reporting, NAIC Schedule D filing, and RBC calculation. Enables historical position reconstruction.

Used for detailed NAIC Schedule D-1, D-2, E, BA, B classification and RBC charge calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate_bond|government_bond|agency_mbs|cmbs|abs|common_stock|preferred_stock|private_equity|hedge_fund|real_estate|infrastructure|schedule_ba_other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule D, BA, B; NAIC RBC Instructions

attributes.name: book_value
attributes.description: The carrying value of the investment on the company's statutory balance sheet, representing the original cost adjusted for amortization, accretion, and impairments under SAP. Used for statutory financial reporting and RBC calculations.

attributes.name: convexity
attributes.description: The convexity measure of a fixed income security, representing the second-order sensitivity of the bond's price to interest rate changes. Used alongside duration for more precise ALM interest rate risk hedging and scenario analysis in actuarial valuation systems.
attributes.references: ALM Guidelines; NAIC RBC C-3 Instructions; SimCorp Dimension

attributes.name: coupon_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which interest payments are made on a fixed income security. Used for investment income accrual scheduling, cash flow projection, and ALM cash flow matching.
