attributes.description: Risk-Based Capital charge for asset default risk (C-1 component) calculated for this mortgage loan. Based on NAIC designation and property type. Critical for solvency monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) for Insurers Model Act

attributes.name: rbc_factor
attributes.description: RBC factor percentage applied to the outstanding balance to calculate the C-1 risk charge. Varies by NAIC designation and property type.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) for Insurers Model Act

attributes.name: recourse_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is recourse or non-recourse. True if lender has recourse to borrower assets beyond collateral; False if limited to property collateral only. Affects credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this mortgage loan record. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

products.name: derivative_valuation
products.description: Periodic mark-to-market valuation records for each derivative contract. attributes.name: dv01
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dollar Value of One Basis Point (DV01)

attributes.references: Internal ALM Framework, NAIC RBC C-3 Instructions

attributes.name: dva
attributes.description: The adjustment to the derivative fair value to account for own credit risk. Represents the market value of the company's own default risk on derivative liabilities.

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The GAAP ASC 820 fair value hierarchy classification. Level 1: quoted prices in active markets; Level 2: observable inputs; Level 3: unobservable inputs.

attributes.name: fmv

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The GAAP accounting classification for this derivative. Determines income statement and balance sheet presentation.

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: The rate of change of delta with respect to changes in the underlying asset price. Second-order Greek used for convexity risk assessment.

attributes.name: hedge_designation

attributes.name: vega

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: duration_target_years
attributes.description: The target duration in years for this asset class allocation, supporting ALM duration matching objectives.

attributes.name: investment_committee_decision
attributes.description: Summary of the investment committees decision or action regarding this asset allocation (e.g., approved, approved with conditions, rebalancing required, under monitoring).

attributes.name: investment_committee_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investment committee reviewed and approved this asset allocation strategy or snapshot.

attributes.name: maximum_weight_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable allocation percentage for this asset class, defining the upper bound of the allocation corridor.

attributes.name: minimum_weight_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum allowable allocation percentage for this asset class, defining the lower bound of the allocation corridor.

attributes.name: naic_designation_requirement
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Requirement
attributes.description: The minimum NAIC designation or credit quality requirement for securities within this asset class allocation (e.g., NAIC 1, NAIC 2).

attributes.name: rbc_category
attributes.description: The RBC component category for this asset class (e.g., C1, C3), used for regulatory capital charge calculations.

attributes.name: rbc_charge_amount

attributes.name: rebalancing_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable deviation from target weight before rebalancing is required, as defined by investment policy.

attributes.name: rebalancing_trigger_flag

attributes.name: reporting_period

attributes.name: separate_account_flag

attributes.name: target_weight_percentage

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset allocation record was last modified.

products.name: counterparty
products.description: Master record for all investment counterparties including broker-dealers, swap counterparties, custodian banks, fund managers, securities lending agents, and sub-custodians. Captures counterparty legal name, LEI (Legal Entity Identifier), counterparty type, credit rating, ISDA agreement reference, approved trading limits, collateral agreement type (CSA), custodian account details, AML/KYC status, regulatory registration (FINRA, SEC), and relationship manager. SSOT for investment counterparty identity within the investment domain; distinct from policyholder or agent counterparties in other domains.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the investment counterparty. Primary key for the counterparty master record.

attributes.name: affiliated_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Investment counterparties may be affiliated legal entities requiring intercompany elimination, related-party disclosure, and consolidation adjustments for financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Internal employee identifier for the relationship manager responsible for this counterparty. Used for accountability and escalation.

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the counterparty's registered business address. Used for legal correspondence and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the counterparty's registered business address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: aml_kyc_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) Status
attributes.description: Current status of AML and KYC due diligence for this counterparty. Must be compliant before executing transactions.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN AML Requirements, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: approved_asset_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes approved for trading with this counterparty (e.g., fixed_income, equity, derivatives, alternatives). Used for pre-trade compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_income|equity|derivatives|alternatives|real_estate|commodities|structured_products — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Investment Policy Statement, NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_trading_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate exposure amount approved for trading with this counterparty. Enforced by pre-trade compliance checks to manage counterparty concentration risk.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the counterparty's registered business address.

attributes.name: counterparty_status

attributes.name: counterparty_type

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_rating

attributes.name: csa_type

attributes.name: custodian_account_number
attributes.description: Account number assigned by the custodian bank for holding securities. Applicable when counterparty_type is custodian_bank or sub_custodian.

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: FATCA classification status for foreign counterparties. Determines withholding and reporting obligations under US tax law.

attributes.name: finra_registration_number

attributes.name: form_expiration_date

attributes.name: isda_agreement_date

attributes.name: isda_agreement_flag

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date

attributes.name: kyc_review_date

attributes.description: Date of the most recent KYC review. Used to trigger periodic re-verification workflows per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: lei
attributes.description: ISO 17442 standard 20-character Legal Entity Identifier used for global counterparty identification in financial transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: limit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the approved trading limit. Typically USD for US-domiciled insurers.

attributes.name: naic_designation_override
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Override

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional information about the counterparty, special handling instructions, or historical context.

attributes.name: onboarding_date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the counterparty's registered business address.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person. Used for trade confirmations, settlement instructions, and operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for urgent operational matters and trade execution.

attributes.name: rating_agency
attributes.description: The rating agency that provided the credit rating. Multiple agencies may rate the same counterparty; this field captures the primary rating source used for risk decisions.
attributes.references: NAIC SVO, SEC Nationally Recognized Statistical Rating Organizations (NRSRO)

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: The date when the current credit rating became effective. Used to track rating staleness and trigger review workflows.

attributes.name: rbc_concentration_factor
attributes.description: RBC concentration adjustment factor applied to positions with this counterparty. Higher factors increase capital charges for concentrated exposures.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions, C-1 Asset Risk Component

attributes.name: sec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: SEC registration number for investment advisers, broker-dealers, or fund managers. Used to verify regulatory standing.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or common name used for operational purposes and system displays.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the counterparty's registered business address. Two-letter state code for US addresses.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number (EIN for US entities, equivalent for foreign entities). Used for tax reporting and IRS Form 1099 generation.

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for terminating the counterparty relationship (e.g., credit downgrade, regulatory action, business decision, counterparty request).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: w8_w9_form_on_file_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid IRS Form W-8 (for foreign entities) or W-9 (for US entities) is on file. Required for tax withholding compliance.

products.name: securities_lending
products.description: Records securities lending transactions where portfolio assets are lent to borrowers in exchange for collateral and lending fees. Supports investment income enhancement tracking, NAIC Schedule D securities lending disclosure, and counterparty exposure monitoring.

products.name: gain_loss_event
products.description: Records all investment accounting events that affect the carrying value of securities, including realized capital gains and losses from sale/maturity/disposal, other-than-temporary impairments (OTTI), and credit loss assessments (CECL). Captures event date, event type (realized gain/loss, impairment, credit loss), security and portfolio reference, proceeds (for sales), book/amortized cost basis, gain/loss or impairment amount, holding period classification, tax lot identification method (FIFO, specific identification), SAP/GAAP classification, impairment subtype (credit loss component, non-credit OCI component), recovery amounts, NAIC designation impact, and ASC 326 CECL provision. Supports NAIC Schedule D Part 4 realized gain/loss reporting, GAAP/SAP impairment reporting, LDTI credit loss assumptions, tax reporting, and investment income statement preparation.

attributes.name: gain_loss_event_id

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTTI|credit_loss|intent_to_sell|CECL_provision|temporary_decline|fair_value_hedge|market_value_decline — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 326, FASB ASC 320, NAIC SAP

attributes.name: intent_to_sell_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether management has the intent to sell the security before recovery of its amortized cost basis, triggering full impairment recognition.

attributes.name: investment_committee_decision
attributes.description: Summary of the investment committee's decision regarding the impairment, including any remediation actions or hold/sell decisions.

attributes.name: investment_committee_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investment committee reviewed and approved the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: ldti_credit_loss_assumption
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Credit Loss Assumption
attributes.description: Credit loss assumption rate used in Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) liability valuation, influenced by this impairment assessment.

attributes.name: more_likely_than_not_sale_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: More Likely Than Not Sale Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether it is more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell the security before recovery, per GAAP ASC 320 guidance.

attributes.name: naic_designation_change_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Change Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the NAIC designation changed as a result of the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: naic_designation_post_impairment
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Post-Impairment
attributes.description: NAIC designation of the security after the impairment event, reflecting updated credit quality assessment.

attributes.name: naic_designation_pre_impairment
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Pre-Impairment
attributes.description: NAIC designation of the security before the impairment event, ranging from 1 (highest quality) to 6 (lowest quality).

attributes.name: naic_schedule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Schedule Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific NAIC Annual Statement schedule and line item where the impairment is reported (e.g., Schedule D Part 1, Line 10).

attributes.name: non_credit_loss_component
attributes.description: Portion of the impairment attributable to non-credit factors such as interest rate changes or market liquidity, recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) under GAAP.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments regarding the impairment assessment, supporting documentation, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: oci_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Amount reclassified from accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) to earnings as part of the impairment recognition.

attributes.name: post_impairment_carrying_value
attributes.description: Adjusted book value or amortized cost of the security after the impairment charge has been applied.

attributes.name: pre_impairment_carrying_value
attributes.description: Book value or amortized cost of the security immediately before the impairment charge was recorded.

attributes.name: rbc_c1_charge_impact
attributes.description: Change in the Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C1 asset risk charge resulting from the impairment and any associated NAIC designation change.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the factors and circumstances leading to the impairment determination, including credit events, market conditions, or management intent.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered subsequent to impairment recognition, representing reversal or partial recovery of previously recognized credit losses.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which a recovery of previously impaired value was recognized.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the impairment was reported to regulatory authorities or included in statutory financial statements.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this record represents a reversal of a previously recognized impairment.

attributes.name: sap_classification
attributes.description: Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) classification of the security for NAIC Annual Statement reporting.

attributes.name: separate_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the impaired security is held in a separate account supporting variable annuity or variable life products.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the impairment record was last modified.

products.name: investment_transaction
products.description: Records all investment cash movements and settlement events including trade settlements (delivery vs. payment), coupon and dividend receipts, margin calls and collateral transfers, securities lending fee receipts, mortgage loan principal and interest payments, capital calls for alternative assets, and custodian fee debits. Captures transaction date, settlement date, transaction type, amount, currency, counterparty, custodian account, portfolio, related trade or asset reference, and reconciliation status. SSOT for investment cash flow tracking, custodian reconciliation, and statutory investment income/expense reporting.

products.name: hierarchy_node
products.description: Represents a single node in the multi-level distribution hierarchy — from individual writing agents up through supervisory levels, GAs, MGAs, BGAs, and broker-dealers. Each node captures the participant, their hierarchy level, parent node reference (enabling tree traversal), effective and termination dates, override eligibility flag, and hierarchy type (captive, independent, brokerage). Self-referencing parent-child structure enables roll-up reporting, commission override chain calculations, and organizational charting across distribution tiers.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hierarchy node. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency. Business justification: Hierarchy nodes can represent either individual producers or agency entities in the distribution hierarchy. When a node represents an agency (BGA, MGA, GA), this FK links to the agency master record.

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent node in the distribution hierarchy. Self-referencing foreign key enabling tree traversal and roll-up reporting. Null for top-level nodes.

attributes.name: primary_hierarchy_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or distribution participant represented by this hierarchy node. Links to the agent master record.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification for this hierarchy node. Career represents captive career agents. Independent represents independent agents and agencies. Worksite represents employer-sponsored distribution. Financial institution represents bank and credit union channels. Broker-dealer represents securities-licensed distribution for variable products.

attributes.name: child_node_count
attributes.description: Number of direct child nodes reporting to this hierarchy node. Used for span-of-control analysis and organizational structure metrics. Zero for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: commission_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node participates in commission calculation and override chains. True for nodes eligible for commission processing. False for reporting-only or inactive nodes.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference to the commission rate schedule applicable to this hierarchy node. Determines first-year commission (Annual Premium Equivalent (APE)), renewal commission, and override rates. Links to commission rate tables.

attributes.name: commission_split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of commission allocated to this hierarchy node when multiple nodes share commission on the same policy. Used in split-commission scenarios and joint-writing arrangements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Legal relationship type between the company and this hierarchy node. W2 employee represents captive career agents. 1099 contractor represents independent agents. Corporate entity represents agency corporations. Partnership represents multi-owner agencies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: depth_level
attributes.description: Calculated depth of this node from the root of the hierarchy tree. Root nodes have depth 0. Used for tree traversal algorithms and organizational chart rendering.

attributes.name: descendant_node_count
attributes.description: Total number of descendant nodes (children, grandchildren, etc.) under this hierarchy node. Used for organizational size metrics and production roll-up calculations. Zero for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node became active and operational. Used for temporal queries and commission eligibility determination.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the distribution hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents top-level nodes (e.g., Brokerage General Agency (BGA)), higher numbers represent deeper levels (e.g., writing agents). Enables depth-based queries and organizational charting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path representing the full lineage from root to this node, typically formatted as slash-delimited node IDs (e.g., /1/45/203/). Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution hierarchy structure. Captive represents company-owned distribution, independent represents non-exclusive agents, brokerage represents broker-dealer channels, hybrid represents mixed models, direct represents company-direct sales, reinsurance represents reinsurance intermediary chains.

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Version number for this hierarchy node configuration. Incremented when node attributes change. Supports temporal hierarchy analysis and historical commission recalculations.

attributes.name: leaf_node_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy tree. True for individual writing agents. False for supervisory and management levels with downstream agents.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code for this hierarchy node. Used for reporting, commission processing, and system integration. May align with legacy system codes or external partner identifiers.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Business name or label for this hierarchy node. May represent the agent name, agency name, Managing General Agent (MGA) name, General Agent (GA) name, or Brokerage General Agency (BGA) name depending on hierarchy level.

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the hierarchy node. Active indicates the node is operational and eligible for commission processing. Inactive indicates temporary suspension. Terminated indicates permanent closure. Pending indicates awaiting approval or activation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text notes and comments about this hierarchy node. Used for documenting special arrangements, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: organizational_unit
attributes.description: Business division, region, or organizational unit to which this hierarchy node belongs. Used for management reporting, territory assignment, and organizational charting.

attributes.name: override_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is eligible to receive override commissions from downstream production. True for supervisory and management levels (Managing General Agent (MGA), General Agent (GA), Brokerage General Agency (BGA)). False for individual writing agents.

attributes.name: production_credit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of production volume credited to this hierarchy node for quota and performance tracking. Used in split-credit scenarios and joint-production arrangements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: reporting_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node participates in management reporting hierarchies. True for nodes used in executive dashboards and performance reporting. False for commission-only or administrative nodes.

attributes.name: roll_up_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production from this node should roll up to parent nodes for reporting and commission calculations. Typically true for all nodes except top-level organizational units.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence for this node among siblings in the hierarchy tree. Used for consistent organizational chart rendering and report ordering.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node was terminated or deactivated. Null for active nodes. Used for historical reporting and commission cutoff calculations.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for hierarchy node termination. Voluntary indicates agent-initiated departure. Involuntary indicates company-initiated termination. Restructure indicates organizational change. Compliance indicates regulatory or policy violation. Performance indicates failure to meet production targets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|involuntary|restructure|merger|acquisition|compliance|performance|retirement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic or market territory assigned to this hierarchy node. Used for territory management, lead assignment, and market penetration analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: eo_coverage_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer is required to maintain Errors and Omissions insurance as a condition of the contract.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the producer contract expires or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: finra_registration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer must be FINRA-registered to sell variable products under this contract. True for contracts authorizing variable life or variable annuity sales.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the distribution hierarchy. Level 1 typically represents direct agents; higher levels represent MGAs, BGAs, or GAs who manage downline producers.

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contracting application is Not In Good Order due to missing documentation, incomplete information, or compliance issues. True means the contract is incomplete and requires remediation.

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the contracting application is flagged as NIGO. Describes missing documents, compliance gaps, or information deficiencies.

attributes.name: nigo_resolution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Resolution Date
attributes.description: Date when all NIGO issues were resolved and the contract moved to good order status.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all onboarding requirements were completed and the producer was fully activated in the system.

attributes.name: product_line_authorization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product lines the producer is authorized to sell under this contract (e.g., life, annuity, variable products, long-term care). Defines the scope of selling authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory reporting obligations for this contract termination. Tracks whether required notifications to NAIC, state DOI, and FINRA have been completed.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the Agent and Commission Management System module that originated this contracting record (e.g., Sapiens Commission Onboarding, Annocera Contracting).

attributes.name: state_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier notified the state Department of Insurance about the contract termination.

attributes.name: state_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is required to notify state Departments of Insurance about this contract termination per state regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the producer contract was terminated and the producer lost selling authority.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for contract termination (e.g., performance issues, compliance violation, business closure, retirement, voluntary resignation).

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances and reasons for contract termination.

attributes.name: termination_type
attributes.description: Classification of contract termination. Voluntary indicates producer-initiated termination; carrier-initiated indicates the carrier ended the contract; regulatory indicates termination due to regulatory action; mutual indicates both parties agreed to end the contract.

attributes.name: u5_confirmation_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Termination Notice for Securities Industry Registration (U5) Confirmation Number
attributes.description: FINRA-issued confirmation number for the U5 filing, serving as proof of submission.

attributes.name: u5_filing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Termination Notice for Securities Industry Registration (U5) Filing Date
attributes.description: Date when the FINRA Form U5 was filed to report the termination of the producer's securities registration.

attributes.name: u5_filing_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Termination Notice for Securities Industry Registration (U5) Filing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a FINRA Form U5 filing is required for this termination. Required when the producer was registered to sell variable products and the contract is terminated.

attributes.name: unearned_commission_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of unearned commissions that must be returned by the producer upon termination.

attributes.name: unearned_commission_return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer is required to return unearned commissions upon contract termination. Typically applies when policies lapse or are cancelled shortly after issue.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contracting record was last modified in the system.

products.name: eo_policy
products.description: Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance coverage records for producers. Tracks E&O carrier, policy number, coverage amount, effective and expiration dates, coverage status, and compliance verification date. E&O coverage is a mandatory prerequisite for producer contracting and appointment in most states. Supports automated compliance checks during onboarding and renewal workflows.

attributes.name: eo_policy_id
attributes.description: Primary key for eo_policy

attributes.name: carrier_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: E&O insurance carriers (Chubb, Hiscox, Travelers) are vendors providing insurance coverage to the agent network. Insurance operations, finance, and compliance need this link for premium payment proces

attributes.name: certificate_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the stored COI document in the document management system.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the producer (agent, broker, BGA, MGA, GA) to whom this E&O coverage applies.

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total amount the E&O policy will pay for all claims during the policy period, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O coverage was cancelled, if applicable. Cancellation triggers immediate appointment termination in most states.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for E&O coverage cancellation, if applicable.

attributes.name: carrier_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Carrier Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code uniquely identifying the E&O insurance carrier.

attributes.name: certificate_of_insurance_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Insurance (COI) has been received and filed for this E&O coverage. COI is typically required for producer contracting.

attributes.name: certificate_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the Certificate of Insurance was received and filed.

attributes.name: claims_made_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the E&O policy is claims-made (covers claims filed during the policy period) or occurrence-based (covers incidents that occurred during the policy period). Most E&O policies are claims-made.

attributes.name: compliance_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O coverage was last verified for compliance with carrier and state DOI requirements. Used in automated onboarding and renewal workflows.

attributes.name: compliance_verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the compliance officer or system that performed the most recent E&O verification.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total coverage limit (per occurrence or aggregate) provided by the E&O policy, expressed in USD. Minimum coverage amounts are often mandated by state DOI or carrier contracting requirements.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current status of the E&O coverage. Active coverage is required for producer appointment and contracting in most states.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of E&O coverage: individual (single producer), group (multiple producers under one policy), agency (agency-level coverage), or corporate (entity-level coverage).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this E&O coverage record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Deductible amount the insured producer must pay before E&O coverage applies, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O coverage becomes active and binding. Producer appointments cannot be processed before this date.

attributes.name: erp_duration_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extended Reporting Period (ERP) Duration in Months
attributes.description: Duration of the Extended Reporting Period in months, if applicable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O coverage terminates. Producers must renew coverage before this date to maintain appointment status.

attributes.name: extended_reporting_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy includes an Extended Reporting Period (tail coverage) that allows claims to be reported after the policy expires for incidents that occurred during the policy period.

attributes.name: finra_coverage_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Coverage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FINRA-compliant E&O coverage is required for this producer due to variable product sales authority.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent E&O policy renewal.

attributes.name: lines_of_authority_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of authority (LOA) covered by this E&O policy (e.g., Life, Accident and Health, Property and Casualty, Variable Products). Some carriers require separate E&O coverage for variable products.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the producer must renew the E&O coverage to avoid lapse. Used for automated renewal reminder workflows.

attributes.name: original_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O policy was first issued to the producer, regardless of subsequent renewals.

attributes.name: per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the E&O policy will pay for a single claim or occurrence, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The unique policy number assigned by the E&O insurance carrier. This is the externally-known identifier for the coverage.

attributes.name: policy_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the E&O policy term in months (typically 12 or 24 months).

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount paid by the producer for the E&O coverage, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: premium_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent E&O premium payment was received by the carrier.

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the producer pays the E&O premium.

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer is eligible to reinstate the E&O coverage after cancellation or lapse.

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent renewal reminder was sent to the producer. Used in automated compliance workflows to prevent coverage lapse.

attributes.name: retroactive_date
attributes.description: For claims-made policies, the earliest date of an incident that will be covered. Incidents before this date are not covered even if the claim is filed during the policy period.

attributes.name: state_filing_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number issued by the state DOI upon successful filing of the E&O coverage.

attributes.name: state_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the E&O coverage was filed with the state DOI, if required.

attributes.name: state_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the E&O coverage must be filed with the state Department of Insurance (DOI) as part of the producer appointment process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this E&O coverage record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: variable_products_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the E&O policy covers variable life insurance and variable annuity products. FINRA-registered representatives selling variable products typically require enhanced E&O coverage.

products.name: finra_registration
products.description: FINRA registration records for producers authorized to sell variable products (VUL, variable annuities). Tracks CRD number, registration status, registered representative type, broker-dealer affiliation, registration date, U4/U5 filing status, and disclosure event flags. Required for SEC/FINRA compliance for all variable product sales per FINRA Rule 1220.

attributes.name: finra_registration_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FINRA registration record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or producer who holds this FINRA registration. Links to the agent master record.

attributes.name: u4_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: FINRA U4 and U5 forms are regulatory filings requiring retention. FINRA audits, disclosure event investigations, and termination processing require access to filed U4/U5 documents. Links FINRA registr

attributes.name: background_check_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check has been completed as part of the FINRA registration process. Required for all new registrations.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check was completed for the agent's FINRA registration. Used for compliance documentation and audit trail.

attributes.name: broker_dealer_crd_number
attributes.description: CRD number of the broker-dealer firm. Used to verify the firm's registration status with FINRA.

attributes.name: broker_dealer_name
attributes.description: Name of the broker-dealer firm through which the agent is registered to sell variable products. Required for SEC and FINRA compliance.

attributes.name: continuing_education_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is current with FINRA continuing education requirements (Regulatory Element and Firm Element). Non-compliance can result in registration suspension.

attributes.name: crd_number
attributes.description: Unique CRD number assigned by FINRA to the registered representative. This is the primary identifier for securities industry registration and is required for all variable product sales.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FINRA registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disclosure_event_count
attributes.description: Total number of disclosure events reported on the agent's CRD record. Used for risk assessment and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: disclosure_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has any reportable disclosure events on their CRD record (customer complaints, regulatory actions, criminal charges, civil judgments, etc.). True if disclosure events exist.

attributes.name: fingerprint_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when fingerprints were submitted to FINRA as part of the registration process. Fingerprinting is required for all registered representatives.

attributes.name: last_continuing_education_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent last completed required FINRA continuing education training. Used to track compliance with ongoing education requirements.

attributes.name: last_disclosure_event_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent disclosure event reported on the agent's CRD record. Used to track recency of compliance issues.

attributes.name: next_continuing_education_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the agent must complete their next continuing education requirement. Regulatory Element is required every three years on the anniversary of initial registration.

attributes.name: registered_representative_type
attributes.description: Type of registered representative designation held by the agent. Variable contracts representative (Series 6) or general securities representative (Series 7) are common for life insurance variable product sales.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent's FINRA registration became effective. This is the date from which the agent is authorized to sell variable products.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the FINRA registration expires. Agents must maintain active registration to continue selling variable products. Nullable for registrations without fixed expiration.

attributes.name: registration_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to the FINRA registration. Used for compliance documentation and internal tracking.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the FINRA registration. Active status is required for the agent to sell variable life insurance and variable annuity products.

attributes.name: sec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: SEC registration number for the agent or their broker-dealer, if applicable. Required for certain variable product sales activities.

attributes.name: series_63_exam_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent passed the Series 63 exam. Used to verify state-level securities qualification.

attributes.name: series_63_exam_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has passed the Series 63 (Uniform Securities Agent State Law) exam. Required in most states for securities registration.

attributes.name: series_65_exam_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent passed the Series 65 exam. Used to verify investment adviser qualification.

attributes.name: series_65_exam_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has passed the Series 65 (Uniform Investment Adviser Law) exam. May be required for agents providing investment advice on variable products.

attributes.name: series_6_exam_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent passed the Series 6 exam. Used to verify qualification timeline and continuing education requirements.

attributes.name: series_6_exam_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has passed the Series 6 (Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Representative) exam. Required for selling variable annuities and variable life insurance.

attributes.name: series_7_exam_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent passed the Series 7 exam. Used to verify qualification timeline and continuing education requirements.

attributes.name: series_7_exam_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has passed the Series 7 (General Securities Representative) exam. Series 7 qualifies the agent to sell a broader range of securities including variable products.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this FINRA registration record originated (e.g., Agent and Commission Management System, CRD system feed). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the FINRA registration was terminated. Populated when the agent leaves the broker-dealer or the registration is otherwise ended.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for termination of the FINRA registration. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: u4_filing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Application for Securities Industry Registration (Form U4) Filing Date
attributes.description: Date when the Form U4 was filed with FINRA to register the agent. Form U4 is the initial registration application required for all securities industry registrations.

attributes.name: u4_filing_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the Form U4 filing. Tracks the application through FINRA review and approval process.

attributes.name: u5_filing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Termination Notice for Securities Industry Registration (Form U5) Filing Date
attributes.description: Date when the Form U5 was filed with FINRA to terminate the agent's registration. Form U5 must be filed within 30 days of termination.

attributes.name: u5_filing_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the Form U5 termination filing. Tracks the termination notice through FINRA review process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FINRA registration record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: variable_product_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is currently authorized to sell variable life insurance and variable annuity products based on their FINRA registration status. True if authorized.

products.name: onboarding_case
products.description: Tracks the end-to-end producer onboarding workflow from initial application through contracting, licensing verification, E&O validation, background screening, and system provisioning. Captures onboarding stage, NIGO reason codes, assigned reviewer, AML training completion, and overall onboarding completion date. Includes embedded background check tracking: screening vendor, check type (criminal, credit, regulatory history), submission date, result status (clear, flagged, pending), adverse action flags, MIB inquiry reference, and regulatory disqualification indicators. Supports periodic re-screening workflows and maintains historical screening records with unique background_check_id references. Satisfies NAIC background check requirements and FINRA suitability obligations. Sourced from the Agent and Commission Management System onboarding module.

attributes.name: onboarding_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the producer onboarding case. Primary key for tracking the complete onboarding workflow from initial application through contracting and system provisioning.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency. Business justification: Onboarding cases track the producer onboarding workflow, which often involves joining a specific agency. This FK links the onboarding case to the agency the producer is joining. No columns removed bec

attributes.name: background_check_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary background check record associated with this onboarding case. Links to detailed screening results including criminal, credit, and regulatory history checks.

attributes.name: contracting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.contracting. Business justification: Onboarding cases track the end-to-end producer onboarding workflow, which culminates in a contracting record. This FK links the onboarding case to the resulting contracting record. Populated when onbo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Onboarding activities incur recruiting costs (background checks, training, licensing fees, system provisioning) that must be capitalized or expensed to cost centers for producer acquisition cost analy

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: FK to agent.distribution_channel

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal staff member assigned to review and process this onboarding case. Used for workload management and accountability.

attributes.name: eo_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.eo_policy. Business justification: Onboarding cases validate E&O coverage. Currently onboarding_case has eo_policy_number (STRING) and eo_expiration_date but no FK to eo_policy table. Adding eo_policy_id FK links the onboarding case to

attributes.name: finra_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.finra_registration. Business justification: Onboarding cases verify FINRA registration for producers authorized to sell variable products. Currently onboarding_case has finra_crd_number (STRING) but no FK to finra_registration table. Adding fin

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.license. Business justification: Onboarding cases track license verification status. Currently onboarding_case has nipr_number (STRING) but no FK to the license table. Adding license_id FK links the onboarding case to the specific li

attributes.name: onboarding_document_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_package. Business justification: Producer onboarding requires tracking complete documentation packages (licenses, background checks, E&O certificates, training records). Onboarding workflow depends on document package completeness ve

attributes.name: primary_onboarding_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or producer being onboarded. Links to the agent master record once created during the onboarding process.

attributes.name: adverse_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action (denial or termination based on background check results) was taken or is being considered. True if adverse action applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: aml_training_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has completed required Anti-Money Laundering training. True if completed, False otherwise. Required for compliance with Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act.

attributes.name: aml_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the producer completed AML training. Used for compliance tracking and periodic re-training requirements.

attributes.name: application_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the producer submitted the initial onboarding application. Marks the start of the onboarding workflow and is used for SLA tracking.

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Type of onboarding application: new agent appointment, transfer from another carrier, reappointment after termination, or upgrade to higher authority level.

attributes.name: assigned_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the internal staff member assigned to review this onboarding case. Provides quick reference without requiring a join to the employee table.

attributes.name: background_check_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check results were received from the screening vendor. Marks completion of the screening phase.

attributes.name: background_check_result_status
attributes.description: Overall result status of the background screening: pending (not yet complete), clear (no issues found), flagged (issues requiring review), or adverse action (disqualifying issues found).

attributes.name: background_check_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check request was submitted to the screening vendor. Used for tracking turnaround time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: background_check_type
attributes.description: Type of background check performed: criminal history only, credit check, regulatory history (state DOI and FINRA), or comprehensive (all checks combined).

attributes.name: background_screening_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor used to conduct the background screening. Examples include LexisNexis, Sterling, or Checkr.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique case number assigned to the onboarding workflow. Used for tracking and communication with the applicant and internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: contracting_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or carrier with which the producer is contracting. Supports multi-carrier and multi-entity operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding case record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: eo_coverage_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Errors and Omissions insurance coverage is required for this producer based on their distribution channel and product authority. True if required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: eo_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the E&O insurance validation. Indicates whether the producers E&O coverage has been verified to meet carrier requirements.

attributes.name: finra_registration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FINRA registration is required for this producer based on their intended product authority (variable life, variable annuities). True if required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: finra_verification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Verification Status
attributes.description: Status of FINRA registration verification. Indicates whether the producers FINRA registration has been validated through BrokerCheck.

attributes.name: license_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the producers licenses were successfully verified. Used for compliance tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: license_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the license verification process. Indicates whether the producers state licenses have been validated through NIPR or state DOI systems.

attributes.name: mib_inquiry_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for any MIB inquiry conducted as part of the background screening. Used for producers who will sell life insurance products requiring underwriting knowledge.

attributes.name: nigo_date
attributes.description: Date when the application was marked as Not In Good Order. Used for tracking resolution time and applicant communication.

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application has been flagged as Not In Good Order due to missing or incomplete documentation. True if NIGO, False otherwise.

attributes.name: nigo_reason_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason the application was marked NIGO. Examples include missing license copy, incomplete background check authorization, or missing E&O certificate.

attributes.name: nigo_reason_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the application was marked NIGO. Provides specific guidance to the applicant on what is needed to move forward.

attributes.name: onboarding_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the entire onboarding process was completed and the producer was fully appointed and ready to transact business. Used for time-to-productivity metrics and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the onboarding case in the workflow. Tracks progression from initial application through final approval or rejection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|nigo|under_review|pending_background|pending_licensing|approved|rejected|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_disqualification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has any regulatory disqualifications that would prevent appointment. Examples include state DOI sanctions, FINRA bars, or federal convictions. True if disqualified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the onboarding application was formally rejected. Used for tracking and adverse action notification timing.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for onboarding rejection. Examples include failed background check, license issues, or regulatory disqualification.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the onboarding application was rejected. Provides context for the rejection decision and supports adverse action communication.

attributes.name: suitability_training_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has completed required suitability and best interest training for annuity sales. True if completed, False otherwise. Required for NAIC Model Regulation 275 compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: suitability_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the producer completed suitability training. Used for compliance tracking and state reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: system_provisioning_date
attributes.description: Date when system access was successfully provisioned for the producer. Marks readiness for production activity.

attributes.name: system_provisioning_status
attributes.description: Status of system access provisioning for the producer. Indicates whether user accounts, POS system access, and portal credentials have been created.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding case record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: producer_training
products.description: Records of mandatory and elective training completions for producers — including AML/BSA training, product-specific training (IUL, FIA, GMWB), suitability training, CE credits, and carrier-specific certification programs. Tracks course name, provider, completion date, score, CE credit hours awarded, expiration date, and compliance status. Supports DOL fiduciary training requirements and state CE mandates.
products.reference: CE Credit Record / AML Training Compliance

attributes.name: producer_training_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the producer training record.

attributes.name: certificate_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Training completion certificates must be retained for regulatory compliance and CE credit verification. State DOI audits require production of training certificates. Links training records to stored c

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.license. Business justification: Producer training records often satisfy continuing education (CE) requirements for specific state licenses. This FK links the training record to the license for which CE credit is being applied. The s

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the producer who completed the training. Links to the producer master record.

attributes.name: training_provider_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Training providers (Kaplan Financial Education, ExamFX, WebCE) are vendors delivering CE and compliance training courses. Finance needs this link for invoice reconciliation (matching training completi

attributes.name: attempts_count
attributes.description: Number of attempts the producer made to complete or pass the training course.

attributes.name: ce_credit_hours_awarded
attributes.description: Number of continuing education credit hours awarded to the producer upon successful completion of the training.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act, State CE Requirements

attributes.name: ce_credit_type
attributes.description: Type or category of continuing education credit awarded, such as general, ethics, product-specific, law, annuity, or long-term care.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act, State CE Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: Date the training certificate or credential was issued to the producer.

attributes.name: certification_number

Tracks event type, source authority (state DOI, FINRA, FinCEN), event date, severity, resolution status, remediation action required, and downstream impact on contracting or appointment status. products.name: agent_bulk_comm_recipient
products.description: This association product represents the delivery event between a producer and a bulk communication campaign. It captures the operational record of each producer's inclusion in a bulk correspondence campaign, tracking dispatch status, delivery outcomes, engagement metrics, and opt-out preferences. Each record links one producer to one bulk_comm_campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific campaign delivery.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, bulk communication campaigns (regulatory notices, compliance alerts, product updates) are dispatched to multiple producers simultaneously, and each producer receives multiple campaigns over their lifecycle. The correspondence domain actively manages recipient lists, tracks delivery status per producer-campaign pair, monitors engagement metrics, and maintains opt-out preferences. This is an operational M:N relationship where the business creates, monitors, and reports on individual recipient records.

products.name: producer_product_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization relationship between producers and product plans. It captures state-specific selling permissions, training requirements, commission schedules, and underwriting authority levels. Each record links one producer to one product plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance distribution, producers are authorized to sell multiple product plans, and each product plan is sold by multiple producers. The authorization relationship is actively managed by the business through state-specific permissions, product-specific training requirements, commission schedule assignments, and underwriting authority levels. This is not a simple reference but an operational business entity that compliance, sales operations, and commission systems actively create, update, and query.

Limited indicates authority up to a certain face amount or simplified issue only. Standard indicates normal authority. Enhanced indicates higher limits. Full indicates maximum authority including jumbo cases. Authority levels vary by producer experience, production history, and product complexity.

products.name: program_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between producers and incentive programs. It captures the operational record of a producer's enrollment, qualification tracking, and award achievement within a specific incentive program. Each record links one producer to one incentive program with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, including qualification status, production amounts, tier achievement, and award details.. Existence Justification: In life insurance distribution, producers routinely participate in multiple incentive programs simultaneously (e.g., a producer can be enrolled in a Q1 sales contest, an annual Presidents Club qualification, and a product-specific bonus program all at the same time). Conversely, each incentive program has hundreds or thousands of producer participants. The business actively manages these participation relationships as operational entities, tracking each producer's qualification progress, status, production amounts, tier achievement, and award payouts for each program independently.

products.name: agent_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between a producer and a training course. It captures the regulatory and operational record of each instance when a licensed producer completes a compliance training course. Each record links one producer to one training course with completion-specific attributes including date, score, pass/fail status, certificate number, and expiration tracking. This serves as the single source of truth for demonstrating regulatory compliance with AML, HIPAA, suitability, ethics, and continuing education requirements.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, producers must complete multiple training courses over their career (initial onboarding, annual CE requirements, product-specific training, AML/HIPAA renewals), and each training course is completed by many producers across the distribution network. The business actively manages training completion as a distinct operational entity with its own lifecycle: completion records are created when producers finish courses, tracked for expiration, queried for compliance audits, and used to determine producer licensing eligibility.
