domains.name: commission
domains.description: Manages all agent and broker compensation calculations, payment processing, and incentive tracking. Owns first-year (FYC) and renewal commission schedules, hierarchy-based overrides, chargeback rules, bonus and incentive programs, 1099 tax reporting, commission statement generation, and commission disputes/adjustments for policy changes and lapses. Directly references agent hierarchy from the agent domain for multi-level payout calculations tied to NBV and policy sales.

products.name: schedule
products.description: Master reference entity defining commission rate structures, granular rate tiers, and compensation schedules for life insurance and annuity products. Each schedule contains one or more rate rows specifying exact percentage or flat-dollar commission payable per policy year, premium band, product code, agent tier, and distribution channel. Stores FYC (First-Year Commission) rates, renewal rates, excess interest credits, override rate tables, and modal factors with effective date ranges. Supports heaped, level, and hybrid compensation structures across WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, SPIA, and annuity product lines. Consolidates both schedule-level metadata and individual rate-row detail as a single authoritative rate source. Owned by the Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera).

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commission schedule record. Primary key for the commission_schedule data product.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: admin_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Life insurers outsource commission calculation/administration to TPAs or service vendors. Tracking which vendor administers each schedule supports vendor performance monitoring, invoice reconciliation

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Commission schedules must comply with compensation policies governing anti-rebating laws, suitability-based compensation restrictions, FINRA rules, and state regulations. Real business process: compli

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Commission schedules are mapped to cost centers for expense allocation, product line P&L, and budget management. Distribution channel and product-specific commission structures require cost center ass

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business approver (e.g., VP of Distribution, Chief Actuary) who authorized this commission schedule for use. Supports governance, audit trail, and SOX compliance requirements for compensation schedule approvals.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Commission schedules are directly derived from actuarial pricing basis assumptions. Product profitability analysis, pricing reviews, and regulatory rate filings require linking commission structures t

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider_definition. Business justification: Riders have distinct commission schedules separate from base products. Rider_code may exist in product_code but explicit rider_definition_id FK enables rider-specific commission rate lookup and rider

attributes.name: source_schedule_id
attributes.description: The native identifier of this commission schedule record in the originating source system (e.g., Sapiens Commission internal schedule ID). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse record and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission_schedule_id of the successor schedule that replaced this schedule. Populated when schedule_status = 'superseded'. Enables schedule version lineage tracking and ensures continuity of commission governance.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: agent_tier
attributes.description: The agent classification tier or hierarchy level to which this schedule applies (e.g., 'Tier 1', 'Senior Producer', 'GA', 'MGA', 'BGA'). Supports multi-level payout calculations tied to New Business Value (NBV) and production thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|ga|mga|bga|override — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: ape_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) production threshold an agent must achieve to qualify for this commission schedule or bonus tier. Expressed in USD. Used in production-based tiered compensation structures. Null if no APE threshold applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commission schedule was formally approved by the designated business authority. Distinct from the effective_date (when the schedule becomes operative). Required for regulatory audit trails and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies written under this commission schedule are eligible for bonus and incentive programs (e.g., production bonuses, persistency bonuses, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) bonuses). True = eligible; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months during which a commission chargeback may be assessed if the policy lapses or is surrendered. Defines the chargeback window for FYC recovery. After this period, no chargeback is applied. Typically ranges from 12 to 24 months for life products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: chargeback_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of previously paid commission subject to recovery (chargeback) upon policy lapse or surrender within the chargeback period. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 100.0000 = full chargeback, 50.0000 = partial). Governs chargeback rules for policy changes and lapses.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: compensation_basis
attributes.description: Defines how the commission amount is calculated. 'percent_of_premium' applies the rate to the premium paid; 'flat_dollar' pays a fixed dollar amount per policy; 'percent_of_account_value' applies to Account Value (AV) for UL/annuity products; 'percent_of_nav' applies to Net Asset Value (NAV) for VUL sub-accounts.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); FINRA Rule 2341 (for variable products)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission schedule record was first created in the system of record. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which commission rates and amounts under this schedule are denominated (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency operations for international or cross-border distribution arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel for which this commission schedule is applicable. Differentiates compensation structures across career agents, independent agents, Brokerage General Agencies (BGA), Managing General Agents (MGA), bank distribution, direct-to-consumer, Third Party Administrators (TPA), and worksite/employer channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent|bga|mga|bank|direct|tpa|worksite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this commission schedule becomes effective and applicable to new policy sales. Policies issued on or after this date are subject to the rates defined in this schedule. Part of the effective date range governing schedule applicability.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: excess_interest_credit_rate
attributes.description: The excess interest credit rate applicable to UL and annuity products, representing additional compensation tied to credited interest rates above the guaranteed minimum. Expressed as a percentage. Null for products where excess interest credits do not apply.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commission schedule ceases to apply to new policy sales (inclusive). Null for open-ended schedules with no defined end date. Policies issued after this date will be governed by a successor schedule. Part of the effective date range.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: finra_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission schedule applies to variable products (VUL, variable annuities) subject to FINRA oversight and compensation disclosure requirements. True = FINRA reporting obligations apply; False = not subject to FINRA reporting.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI); FINRA Broker-Dealer Oversight

attributes.name: fyc_rate
attributes.description: The First-Year Commission (FYC) rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 55.0000 = 55%) or flat-dollar amount per the compensation_basis. Represents the commission payable in the first policy year. Core field for heaped and hybrid compensation structures across WL, UL, IUL, and annuity product lines.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: modal_factor_annual
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on an annual basis. Used to adjust the commission base for modal premium payments. Typically 1.000000 for annual mode. Part of the modal factor set used in commission calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_monthly
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a monthly basis (e.g., 0.950000). Adjusts the commission base for monthly modal premium payments. Monthly mode is the most common payment frequency and often carries the lowest modal factor.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_quarterly
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a quarterly basis (e.g., 0.970000). Adjusts the commission base for quarterly modal premium payments in commission calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_semi_annual
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a semi-annual basis. Adjusts the commission base for semi-annual modal premium payments (e.g., 0.980000). Used in commission calculations to account for the timing difference in premium collection.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: The override commission rate payable to a supervising agent, GA, MGA, or BGA in the hierarchy above the writing agent. Expressed as a percentage of premium or AV per the compensation_basis. Supports multi-level hierarchy-based payout calculations tied to NBV and policy sales.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: persistency_bonus_rate
attributes.description: Additional commission rate payable as a persistency bonus when the policy remains in force beyond a defined duration threshold. Expressed as a percentage of premium or AV. Incentivizes agents to write quality, long-duration business. Null if no persistency bonus applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: policy_year_from
attributes.description: The starting policy year (inclusive) for which this commission rate row is applicable. Used to define rate tiers by policy duration (e.g., policy year 1 for FYC, years 2-10 for renewal, year 11+ for trail). Enables granular multi-year commission schedules.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_year_to
attributes.description: The ending policy year (inclusive) for which this commission rate row is applicable. Null indicates the rate applies indefinitely beyond the policy_year_from. Paired with policy_year_from to define the policy duration band for this rate tier.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_band_max
attributes.description: The maximum annualized premium amount (exclusive) defining the upper bound of the premium band for this rate tier. Null indicates no upper limit (open-ended band). Paired with premium_band_min to define the premium volume tier.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: premium_band_min
attributes.description: The minimum annualized premium amount (inclusive) defining the lower bound of the premium band for this rate tier. Enables tiered commission rates based on premium volume. Expressed in USD. Null if no premium banding applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance or annuity product line to which this commission schedule applies (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity, Term, DI — Disability Income, LTC — Long-Term Care). Drives which policies are eligible for this schedule. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|Term|DI|LTC|Annuity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Classification; ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: renewal_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate applicable to renewal years (policy year 2 and beyond) expressed as a percentage or flat-dollar amount per the compensation_basis. Used in level and hybrid compensation structures. May vary by policy year band as defined in rate tier rows.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: requires_state_filing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission schedule requires regulatory filing with one or more State Departments of Insurance prior to use. True = state filing required; False = no filing required. Supports compliance tracking for state-specific commission rate approvals.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission schedule within the Agent and Commission Management System (e.g., 'WL-FYC-TIER1-2024'). Used in bordereaux reporting, agent statements, and system integrations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: schedule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the commission schedule, including its business purpose, applicable product lines, special conditions, and any notes relevant to commission calculation or agent communication. Used in commission statements and internal documentation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the commission schedule (e.g., 'Whole Life First-Year Heaped Schedule 2024'). Used in agent-facing commission statements and internal reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission schedule. 'active' schedules are applied to new and in-force policies; 'superseded' schedules have been replaced by a newer version but may still govern existing policies; 'draft' schedules are under review and not yet applied.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the compensation structure of the schedule. 'heaped' concentrates commission in the first year (FYC); 'level' spreads commission evenly across policy years; 'hybrid' combines both; 'override' applies to hierarchy-based override rates; 'bonus' covers incentive/bonus programs; 'trailer' applies to ongoing trail commissions on annuity and investment products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this commission schedule record originated (e.g., 'SAPIENS_COMM', 'ANNOCERA'). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) indicating the jurisdiction for which this commission schedule is approved and applicable. Null if the schedule applies nationally across all states. Supports state-specific commission rate filings required by State Departments of Insurance.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC State Filing Requirements

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions paid under this schedule are subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting requirements. True = commissions are reportable on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC; False = not subject to 1099 reporting (e.g., W-2 employee agents). Governs 1099 tax reporting obligations.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC / 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15-A; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission schedule record was most recently modified. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version number for this commission schedule, incremented each time the schedule is revised or superseded. Enables version history tracking and audit trail for regulatory compliance. Version 1 is the original schedule.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: vested_after_months
attributes.description: The number of months after policy issue after which the agent's commission is fully vested and no longer subject to chargeback. Supports partial vesting schedules where chargeback_rate decreases over time. Null if no vesting schedule applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

products.name: rate
products.description: Granular rate rows within a commission schedule, specifying the exact percentage or flat-dollar commission payable per policy year, premium band, product code, and agent tier. Captures FYC rates, renewal rates, excess interest credits, and override rates. Supports heaped, level, and hybrid compensation structures used across WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, and annuity product lines.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a commission rate row within a commission schedule. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business approver (e.g., VP of Distribution, Chief Actuary) who authorized this commission rate row. Required for SOX compliance and internal audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Commission rates are product-specific; product_code exists but plan_id FK enables proper rate table joins for commission calculation, product eligibility validation, and commission schedule management

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider_definition. Business justification: Rider-specific commission rates differ from base product rates. Explicit rider_definition_id FK enables accurate rider commission calculation, rider rate table joins, and rider-specific commission rul

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commission schedule that owns this rate row. Links the rate to its governing schedule definition.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: agent_tier_code
attributes.description: Agent or broker compensation tier designation (e.g., GA, MGA, BGA, career agent, broker) that determines which rate row applies. Supports multi-level hierarchy payout calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission rate row was formally approved by the designated business authority. Supports regulatory audit trails and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The base upon which the commission rate or flat amount is calculated: target_premium = target/planned premium for UL/IUL; modal_premium = actual modal premium paid; annualized_premium = APE basis; account_value = AV for trailer commissions on annuities; face_amount = death benefit face; deposit = single premium deposit for SPIAs/FIAs.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel for which this rate applies: career = captive career agents; broker = independent brokers; bga = Brokerage General Agency (BGA); mga = Managing General Agent (MGA); ga = General Agent (GA); bank = bank distribution; direct = direct-to-consumer; tpa = Third Party Administrator (TPA). Supports channel-specific compensation strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career|broker|bga|mga|ga|bank|direct|tpa — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which a commission chargeback applies if the policy lapses or is surrendered. After this period, the commission is considered fully earned. Critical for lapse administration and commission recovery.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: chargeback_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the original commission subject to chargeback upon policy lapse or surrender within the chargeback period. May be a full 100% recapture or a graded percentage depending on the schedule. Stored as a decimal fraction.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: compensation_structure
attributes.description: Describes the commission compensation design: heaped = large FYC with low renewals; level = uniform rate across all policy years; hybrid = combination of heaped and level; graded = rate steps down over defined policy years.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission rate row was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the commission rate (e.g., USD). Required for flat_dollar_amount rows and for multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: dac_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions under this rate row qualify as Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) for GAAP accounting purposes under FASB ASC 944 (LDTI). True = commission is deferrable as DAC; False = expensed immediately. Critical for actuarial reserving and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements); GAAP

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this commission rate row becomes active and applicable to new business or in-force policy calculations. Part of the rate versioning mechanism.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: excess_premium_rate_percent
attributes.description: Commission rate applicable to premium paid above the target premium level for UL/IUL products. Typically lower than the target premium rate. Stored as a decimal fraction. Null if not applicable to this product type.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this commission rate row is no longer applicable to new calculations. Null indicates the rate is open-ended with no scheduled expiry. Supports rate versioning and schedule amendments.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: flat_dollar_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar commission amount payable per policy or per unit, used when compensation is not percentage-based. Mutually exclusive with rate_percent; one must be populated and the other null. Common in certain annuity and group products.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level within the agent distribution hierarchy at which this rate applies (e.g., 1 = writing agent, 2 = GA, 3 = MGA, 4 = BGA). Supports multi-level override and upline commission calculations tied to New Business Value (NBV).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: issue_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum insured issue age (in years) for this commission rate row to apply. Used with issue_age_min to define age-banded commission structures. Null if no upper age restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance

attributes.name: issue_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum insured issue age (in years) for this commission rate row to apply. Some products offer differentiated commission rates by age band (e.g., juvenile policies, senior market). Null if no age restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance

attributes.name: max_face_amount
attributes.description: Maximum policy face amount (death benefit) for which this commission rate row applies. Null indicates no upper cap. Used in conjunction with min_face_amount to define face amount bands.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: min_face_amount
attributes.description: Minimum policy face amount (death benefit) required for this commission rate row to apply. Used to differentiate rates for jumbo or high-face-amount policies. Null if no minimum face amount restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: nbv_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions calculated under this rate row are included in New Business Value (NBV) reporting and multi-level hierarchy payout calculations. True = eligible for NBV-linked override calculations; False = excluded.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IFRS 17; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, exceptions, or conditions associated with this commission rate row (e.g., 'Applies only to 1035 Exchange business', 'Excludes MEC policies', 'Subject to STOLI review'). Not used for calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: override_rate_percent
attributes.description: Additional override commission rate percentage payable to upline hierarchy levels (GA, MGA, BGA) on top of the writing agent's base rate. Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.02000 = 2%). Null if this row does not carry an override component.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: payment_mode
attributes.description: Premium payment frequency mode for which this rate applies: annual, semi_annual, quarterly, or monthly. Commission rates may be adjusted by payment mode to account for modal loading factors in the Billing and Premium Collection System.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: Commission rate expressed as a percentage of the applicable premium or account value (AV). Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.05500 = 5.5%). Mutually exclusive with flat_dollar_amount; one must be populated and the other null.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: persistency_bonus_rate_percent
attributes.description: Additional commission rate awarded as a persistency bonus when a policy remains in force beyond a defined duration. Incentivizes agents to place quality, long-duration business. Stored as a decimal fraction. Null if no persistency bonus applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: policy_year_from

attributes.name: policy_year_to
attributes.description: Ending policy year (inclusive) for which this rate row is applicable. A null value indicates the rate applies indefinitely beyond policy_year_from. Supports graded and level structures.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum annualized premium amount (in USD) for this rate row to apply. Null indicates no upper cap on the premium band. Used with premium_band_min to define the qualifying premium range.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: premium_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum annualized premium amount (in USD) for this rate row to apply. Enables banded commission schedules where higher premium volumes attract different rates. Null if no lower band threshold applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Insurance product code to which this commission rate applies (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, SPIA, Term). Aligns with the product catalog in the Policy Administration System.

attributes.name: product_line

attributes.name: product_subtype

attributes.references: NAIC Product Codes; ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this commission rate row: active = currently in use for calculations; inactive = no longer applied; pending = approved but not yet effective; superseded = replaced by a newer rate version; draft = under review and not yet approved.

attributes.name: rate_type

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for which this rate row applies. Commission rates may vary by state due to regulatory requirements from State Departments of Insurance. Null indicates the rate applies to all states unless overridden.

attributes.name: target_premium_indicator

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions calculated under this rate row are subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting. True = commissions are reportable on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC; False = not reportable (e.g., salary-based or excluded compensation).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission rate row. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this commission rate row within its schedule. Incremented each time the rate is amended. Supports rate versioning, audit trails, and historical rate lookups for in-force policy calculations.

attributes.name: vesting_period_months

products.name: commission_transaction
products.description: Core transactional record capturing every individual commission and compensation earning event tied to a policy or annuity contract. Records all transaction types via discriminator: standard commissions (FYC, renewal, trailer), override commissions, persistency credits (with milestone and credit type), service/trail fees (with fee type, fee basis, fee rate, and calculation period for RIA/TPA/broker-dealer asset-based compensation), advance commissions (with advance basis, repayment schedule, outstanding balance, and repayment status), and split commissions (with split percentage, co-agent references, split type, and approval status). Captures gross amount, net-of-chargeback amount, calculation basis (APE, modal premium, account value, NAV), policy year, and payment status. Primary audit trail for all commission payables. attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: commission_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to an open or resolved commission dispute record associated with this payment. Populated when the payment is under dispute or was adjusted as a result of a dispute resolution. Null for undisputed payments.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: commission_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying commission_transaction record that this payment settles. Supports reconciliation between earned commission and disbursed payment amounts.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy or annuity contract that generated the commission earning underlying this payment. Null for bonus, incentive, or service fee payments not tied to a specific policy.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST / Sapiens LifePro); NAIC Policy Form Filing Requirements

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Commission payments are cash disbursements requiring GL posting for expense recognition, tax withholding liability, and cash account reconciliation. Payment runs generate batch journal entries for fin

attributes.name: notification_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Commission payments trigger automated payment confirmation communications to producers. Real business process: payment notification delivery via email/mail, required for producer reconciliation and di

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Payments need product context for 1099 tax reporting (product categorization for IRS compliance), commission reconciliation by product, and product-specific payment rule application in payment process

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_bill. Business justification: Commission payments reconcile against specific premium bills for audit and financial reporting. Auditors and finance teams trace commission payments to originating premium bills to validate payment ac

attributes.name: processor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Commission payments are frequently disbursed through third-party payment processors, payroll service vendors, or banking platforms. Linking payment to processor vendor enables payment reconciliation,

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent, broker, BGA, MGA, GA, or corporate entity receiving this compensation disbursement. Links to the agent hierarchy for multi-level payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Agent Licensing and Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Commission payments are reported in regulatory filings (Form 1099-MISC to IRS, state producer compensation reports to DOI). Direct operational link: every 1099-reportable payment must be traceable to

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Commission payments must be tracked by reporting period for cash flow statements, statutory exhibit preparation (Schedule F - Commissions), expense recognition under GAAP/SAP, and tax year reporting.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the batch payment run that generated this disbursement. Groups all payments processed together in a single payroll-cycle execution within Sapiens Commission / Annocera.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule (first-year or renewal rate table) applied to calculate the earned commission amount included in this payment. Supports audit traceability of rate application.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission statement on which this payment line item appears. Links the disbursement to the agent-facing remittance advice document generated by the commission system.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Statement Generation Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: DAC accounting under LDTI/IFRS17 requires commission payments to be tied to specific valuation runs for proper acquisition cost amortization. Essential for quarterly financial close, DAC balance recon

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: 15-digit NACHA ACH trace number assigned by the originating depository financial institution (ODFI) for ACH payment transactions. Used for payment tracing, return item processing, and bank reconciliation. Null for check or wire payments.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules and Guidelines — ACH Trace Number Requirements

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any manual adjustment applied to this payment amount. Populated when the payment differs from the system-calculated amount due to dispute resolution, rate correction, retroactive schedule change, or manual override by commission operations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; SOX Section 404 — Manual Adjustment Controls

attributes.name: annualized_premium_equivalent
attributes.description: Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) of the policy or policies underlying this commission payment. Calculated as 100% of regular annual premiums plus 10% of single premiums. Used for production credit, commission schedule tier determination, and sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS backup withholding at the statutory rate (currently 24%) was applied to this payment due to missing, incorrect, or IRS-notified TIN. True = backup withholding applied; False = no backup withholding.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1281 — Backup Withholding; IRC Section 3406; IRS CP2100 Notice

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the payee's bank account on file used for ACH or wire disbursement. Stores a non-sensitive token or last-4 digits only; full account details are held in the secure payment vault. Null for check payments.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0 — Payment Data Security; FinCEN BSA/AML Requirements

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period during which the agent accumulated qualifying production to earn this bonus payment. Populated only when payment_type is 'bonus' or 'incentive'.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Incentive Tracking Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period during which the agent accumulated qualifying production to earn this bonus payment. Populated only when payment_type is 'bonus' or 'incentive'.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Incentive Tracking Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: chargeback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record represents a chargeback (recovery of previously paid commission due to policy lapse, surrender, or cancellation within the chargeback period). True = chargeback debit; False = standard credit payment.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: chargeback_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a commission chargeback was applied: 'lapse' (policy lapsed for non-payment), 'surrender' (policyholder surrendered the policy), 'cancellation' (policy cancelled within free-look or chargeback period), 'not_in_good_order' (NIGO — application rejected), 'rescission' (policy rescinded), 'other'. Null when chargeback_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lapse|surrender|cancellation|not_in_good_order|rescission|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Sequential check number printed on the physical commission check issued to the payee. Used for check reconciliation, stop-payment processing, and positive pay bank file matching. Null for ACH or wire payments.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; SOX Section 404 — Disbursement Controls

attributes.name: commission_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the commission was earned (not necessarily the payment year). Used for 1099 tax year assignment, DAC amortization schedules, and annual production reporting. Four-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; FASB ASC 944-40 — Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission payment record was first created in the source commission system. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment denomination (e.g., 'USD' for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency operations for international reinsurance intermediaries or cross-border distribution arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the gross payment under backup withholding rules (IRS 24% backup withholding rate) or voluntary withholding agreements. Zero if no federal withholding applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1281 — Backup Withholding; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 3406

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total compensation amount before any tax withholding deductions. Represents the full earned commission, bonus, incentive, persistency credit, or service fee amount prior to federal and state withholding. Denominated in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; FASB ASC 944-40 — Insurance Acquisition Costs; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: nbv_basis_amount
attributes.description: The New Business Value (NBV) amount used as the basis for calculating commission on new policy sales. Represents the present value of future profits attributable to new business production tied to this payment. Used for production reporting and commission schedule application.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 — Insurance Acquisition Costs; IFRS 17 — Insurance Contracts; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the payee after deducting federal and state tax withholding from the gross payment amount. This is the amount that appears on the remittance advice and is transferred via ACH, check, or wire.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: override_level
attributes.description: Hierarchy level at which this payment is being made within the agent distribution hierarchy: 'direct' (writing agent), 'ga' (General Agent override), 'mga' (Managing General Agent override), 'bga' (Brokerage General Agent override), 'corporate' (corporate entity or home office override). Supports multi-level commission payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the commission disbursement was released to the payee. Used for 1099 tax year assignment, cash flow reporting, and payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SOX Section 404 — Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement instrument used to transfer funds to the payee: 'ACH' (Automated Clearing House electronic transfer), 'check' (physical check mailed to payee), 'wire' (domestic or international wire transfer for large or international payments).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules and Guidelines; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the commission system (e.g., PAY-0000123456). Used on remittance advices, commission statements, and 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission payment disbursement: 'pending' (scheduled but not yet released), 'processed' (submitted to payment processor), 'paid' (confirmed settled to payee), 'reversed' (payment recalled or reversed), 'voided' (cancelled before processing), 'on_hold' (suspended pending dispute or compliance review).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the nature of the compensation disbursement: 'commission' for standard first-year (FYC) or renewal commissions, 'bonus' for program-based bonus awards, 'incentive' for sales contest or incentive awards, 'persistency' for persistency credits on in-force policies, 'service_fee' for administrative service fee payments.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the commission earning period covered by this payment. Together with payment_period_start_date, defines the full earning window for reconciliation against commission_transaction records.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the commission earning period covered by this payment. Defines the start of the calculation window for commissions, persistency credits, or service fees included in this disbursement.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: source_system_payment_ref
attributes.description: Native payment identifier assigned by the originating commission system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera) before ingestion into the lakehouse. Preserves the source system key for lineage tracing, reconciliation, and re-processing scenarios.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage Controls

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the gross payment per applicable state withholding requirements. Zero if no state withholding applies. State jurisdiction determined by agent's state of domicile or state of licensure.
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue Withholding Requirements; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: IRS tax reporting year to which this payment is attributed for 1099-NEC reporting purposes. May differ from commission_year for payments made in January covering prior-year earnings. Four-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15-A; IRC Section 6041

attributes.name: tin_on_file
attributes.description: The IRS Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) — either SSN for individual agents or EIN for corporate entities — on file at time of payment. Used for 1099-NEC tax reporting and IRS backup withholding compliance. Stored as masked or tokenized value per data security policy.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Classification of the TIN on file: 'SSN' (Social Security Number for individual agents), 'EIN' (Employer Identification Number for corporate entities, BGAs, MGAs), 'ITIN' (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number for non-resident alien agents).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1281; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission payment record in the source system. Tracks reversals, status changes, adjustments, and dispute resolutions. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Audit Trail

attributes.name: wire_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned reference number for wire transfer payments. Used for wire confirmation, reconciliation, and tracing with the receiving financial institution. Null for ACH or check payments.
attributes.references: SWIFT gpi Standards; Fedwire Funds Service Operating Circular; SOX Section 404

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Transactional and reference entity managing commission recapture events and the rules governing them. Transaction records capture chargebacks triggered by policy lapse, surrender, not-taken, or early termination — including original commission transaction reference, chargeback amount, reason code (lapse, surrender, NTO, rescission), chargeback period remaining, recovery method (deduction from future commissions or direct repayment), and resolution status. Rule records define chargeback parameters by product type, distribution channel, and policy duration — specifying chargeback period length (months), recapture percentage schedule by policy month, minimum premium threshold, and applicable distribution tiers. Uses record_type discriminator to distinguish transaction vs rule entries. Critical for managing FYC recapture on early-lapse policies. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine and chargeback processing module.

attributes.name: chargeback_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each chargeback transaction or rule record within the commission chargeback module.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
