attributes.name: chargeback_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chargeback rule record that governs the recapture parameters applied to this transaction. Null for rule records themselves.

attributes.name: grace_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.grace_period. Business justification: Chargebacks initiated during grace periods require tracking which grace period triggered the recapture for regulatory compliance and producer communication. Grace period duration and resolution outcom

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy that triggered the chargeback event (lapse, surrender, not-taken, or rescission). Links the chargeback to the underlying insured contract.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); NAIC

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Chargebacks reverse commission expense and trigger DAC/NBV adjustments that must be journalized. Financial statements require offsetting entries for previously recognized costs. Critical for accurate

attributes.name: notice_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Chargebacks require formal notification to producers explaining recapture reason and amount. Real business process: chargeback notification letter/email delivery, contractual and regulatory requiremen

attributes.name: original_commission_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original commission payment transaction that is being recaptured. Provides the audit trail linking the chargeback back to the specific FYC or renewal commission disbursement.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Chargebacks are product-specific with different rules per product; product_type exists but plan_id FK enables proper chargeback rule application, product-specific recapture percentage lookup, and accu

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_bill. Business justification: Chargebacks are triggered by billing failures (NSF, lapse, non-payment). Operations require direct reference to the failed or reversed premium bill to calculate recapture amounts and validate chargeba

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the writing agent or broker whose first-year commission (FYC) or renewal commission is subject to recapture. Central party reference for multi-level payout calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Policy lapses triggering chargebacks often coincide with reinsurance recapture events. Linking chargeback to cession enables coordinated accounting for commission recovery and reinsurance recapture, e

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Chargebacks impact financial results in specific reporting periods and must be tracked for DAC amortization adjustments, GAAP/SAP reconciliation, and statutory exhibit preparation. Essential for accur

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: Chargebacks from early policy termination trigger reserve releases and DAC write-offs that must be reflected in reserve calculations. Required for reserve adequacy testing, experience variance analysi

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The net dollar amount to be recaptured from the agent based on the applicable recapture percentage schedule and the policy duration at time of lapse or surrender. This is the primary monetary fact of the chargeback transaction.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the commission operations manager or supervisor who approved the chargeback initiation, waiver, or write-off decision. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: chargeback_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the chargeback event or rule by the commission system. Used in agent statements, dispute correspondence, and 1099 reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback record: pending (initiated, not yet in recovery), in_recovery (deductions or repayments in progress), recovered (fully recaptured), waived (management decision to forgive), disputed (agent has filed a dispute), written_off (deemed unrecoverable).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC

attributes.name: commission_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original commission subject to chargeback was disbursed to the agent. Used for aging analysis and DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; GAAP ASC 944 DAC

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of commission being recaptured: FYC (First-Year Commission), renewal, override (hierarchy-level override commission), or bonus. Critical for FYC recapture tracking on early-lapse policies.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chargeback record was first created in the commission system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this chargeback record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution.

attributes.name: dac_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) asset adjustment triggered by the chargeback event. When a policy lapses and commission is recaptured, the corresponding DAC balance must be reversed for GAAP and SAP reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has formally disputed the chargeback. When True, the chargeback is placed in a disputed state pending review and resolution by the commission operations team.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the agent's stated reason for disputing the chargeback (e.g., policy reinstated, incorrect trigger date, rule misapplication). Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the policy was sold (e.g., career agent, brokerage, BGA, MGA, direct, bank). Chargeback period length and recapture percentage schedules vary by channel.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC

attributes.name: distribution_tier
attributes.description: The distribution tier classification of the agent or agency (e.g., Tier 1 top producer, Tier 4 standard). Chargeback rules and recapture schedules may vary by distribution tier as part of producer incentive agreements.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the chargeback rule or transaction record is effective. For rule records, this is the date the rule parameters became active. For transaction records, this aligns with the trigger event date.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: expected_recovery_date
attributes.description: The projected date by which the full chargeback amount is expected to be recovered, based on the recovery method and scheduled deduction plan. Used for cash flow forecasting and accounts receivable aging.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback rule record expires and is no longer applicable to new transactions. Null for open-ended rules. Supports rule versioning and temporal validity management.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level in the agent distribution hierarchy at which the chargeback applies: writing agent, GA (General Agent), MGA (Managing General Agent), BGA (Brokerage General Agency), or carrier. Supports multi-level chargeback payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback was formally initiated in the commission system following detection of the trigger event. Marks the start of the recovery process.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: minimum_premium_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum annualized or modal premium amount required for the chargeback rule to apply. Policies with premiums below this threshold may be exempt from chargeback. Applies primarily to rule records.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: nbv_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated impact of the chargeback on the New Business Value (NBV) metric for the associated policy sale. Used in sales performance reporting and agent scorecard analytics tied to NBV and policy sales.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera; IFRS 17; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: original_commission_amount
attributes.description: The gross commission amount originally paid to the agent for the policy that is now subject to chargeback. Denominated in USD. Serves as the basis for calculating the recapture amount.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining dollar amount of the chargeback not yet recovered (chargeback_amount minus recovered_amount). Drives accounts receivable reporting and agent balance management.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: period_months
attributes.description: The total number of months during which a commission is subject to chargeback recapture per the applicable rule. Typically 12–24 months for FYC on life products. Applies to rule records; populated on transaction records from the governing rule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: period_remaining_months
attributes.description: The number of months remaining in the chargeback period at the time the trigger event occurred. Used to calculate the recapture amount and schedule recovery deductions.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: policy_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of months the policy had been in force at the time the chargeback trigger event occurred. Used to look up the applicable recapture percentage from the chargeback rule schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying insurance policy was issued and placed in force. Used to calculate policy duration at trigger and validate chargeback period applicability.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); NAIC

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance or annuity product associated with the chargeback (e.g., Whole Life, Term, Universal Life, Fixed Indexed Annuity). Determines which chargeback rule schedule applies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|Term|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|DI|LTC|Annuity — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recapture_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the original commission to be recaptured, determined by the chargeback rule schedule based on the policy duration month at time of trigger event. For example, a policy lapsing in month 6 may have a 75% recapture rate.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: recapture_schedule
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the month-by-month recapture percentage schedule (e.g., '100,100,75,75,50,50,25,25,0,0,0,0' for a 12-month schedule). Applies to rule records. Defines the declining recapture rate as policy duration increases.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field distinguishing between a chargeback transaction event (recapture of previously paid commission) and a chargeback rule record (parameters governing recapture logic). Drives downstream processing and reporting branching.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount of the chargeback that has been successfully recaptured to date through commission deductions or direct repayment. Used to track recovery progress against the total chargeback amount.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the chargeback amount will be recaptured: commission_deduction (withheld from future commission payments), direct_repayment (agent remits payment directly), offset (netted against other payables), or write_off (deemed unrecoverable and expensed).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback was fully resolved — either through complete recovery, waiver, write-off, or dispute settlement. Null if still open.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this chargeback record was sourced (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera, manual entry, policy administration system). Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: trigger_event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the triggering business event (lapse, surrender, NTO, rescission) occurred on the policy. This is the principal real-world event date driving the chargeback calculation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: trigger_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business event that triggered the chargeback: lapse (policy lapsed for non-payment), surrender (policyholder surrendered the policy), NTO (not-taken, policy returned during free-look), rescission (policy voided), death (death claim within chargeback period), or maturity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this chargeback record (e.g., status change, recovery posting, dispute filing). Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chargeback has been formally waived by management (e.g., due to agent hardship, policy reinstatement, or contractual exception). When True, no further recovery action is taken.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Description of the business justification for waiving the chargeback (e.g., policy reinstated within grace period, agent deceased, contractual exception). Populated only when waiver_flag is True.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

products.name: chargeback_rule
products.description: Reference master defining chargeback rules by product type, distribution channel, and policy duration. Specifies chargeback period length (months), recapture percentage schedule by policy month, minimum premium threshold, and applicable distribution tiers. Governs when and how much commission is recaptured upon early policy termination. Managed within Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine.

attributes.name: chargeback_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the chargeback rule record within the commission management system (Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission Rules Engine

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Chargeback rules implement compliance policies around commission recovery, consumer protection (free-look rights), and fair dealing standards. Business process: policy governance ensures chargeback pr

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Chargeback rules are defined per product with product-specific recapture percentages and chargeback periods. Product_type_code exists but plan_id FK enables precise rule-to-product mapping and accurat

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_chargeback_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chargeback_rule_id of the newer rule that replaced this rule when it was superseded. Enables forward-chaining of rule version history for audit and compliance purposes. NULL if this rule has not been superseded.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this chargeback rule received final business approval and was authorized for activation in the commission rules engine.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this chargeback rule within the commission governance process. Rules must be approved before activation. 'under_review' indicates the rule is being evaluated by compliance or actuarial teams.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the business owner or compliance officer who approved this chargeback rule for activation. Required for SOX audit trail and commission governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of policy months during which a commission chargeback may be triggered upon early policy termination or lapse. After this period expires, no commission recapture is applied. Typically ranges from 12 to 36 months for life products.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission Rules Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chargeback rule record was first created in the commission management system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and NAIC market conduct standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary thresholds and amounts defined in this chargeback rule (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international life insurance products.

attributes.name: dac_impact_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) Impact Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission chargebacks under this rule affect the Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) balance recorded in the general ledger. True = DAC amortization schedule is adjusted upon chargeback processing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-30 (DAC); LDTI; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: death_claim_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated due to insured death are exempt from commission chargeback under this rule. True = death-triggered terminations do not trigger recapture. Standard industry practice to exempt death claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: disability_waiver_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated due to activation of a disability waiver of premium (AWL) rider are exempt from commission chargeback. True = AWL-triggered terminations are excluded from recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel to which this chargeback rule applies. Channels include career agents, Brokerage General Agencies (BGA), Managing General Agents (MGA), General Agents (GA), direct-to-consumer, Third Party Administrators (TPA), bank/financial institution, and worksite/employer-sponsored. Different channels carry distinct commission and chargeback structures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|bga|mga|ga|direct|tpa|bank|worksite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: distribution_tier
attributes.description: Specific tier or level within the distribution channel hierarchy to which this rule applies (e.g., Tier 1 BGA, Tier 2 MGA, Standard Agent). Enables differentiated chargeback schedules for high-volume or preferred distribution partners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|standard|preferred|elite — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this chargeback rule is effective and applicable to new policy terminations. Policies issued on or after this date are subject to this rule's recapture schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: exchange_1035_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated via a tax-free 1035 Exchange to another policy within the same carrier are exempt from commission chargeback. True = internal 1035 exchanges do not trigger recapture.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Tax Compliance; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this chargeback rule is no longer applicable to new policy terminations. NULL indicates the rule has no defined end date and remains active until explicitly superseded or deactivated.

attributes.name: free_look_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated during the state-mandated free-look period (typically 10–30 days) are exempt from commission chargeback under this rule. True = free-look terminations are excluded from recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Free Look Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: fyc_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of First-Year Commission (FYC) that can be recaptured upon policy termination within the chargeback period. Represents the starting recapture rate at policy month 1 before any earned-down schedule is applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_scope
attributes.description: Specifies which levels of the agent commission hierarchy are subject to chargeback under this rule. 'writing_agent' recaptures only from the producing agent; 'all_levels' recaptures proportionally across the full hierarchy including GA, MGA, and BGA overrides.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: installment_recapture_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chargeback amount may be recovered from the agent in installments (deducted from future commission payments) rather than as a single lump-sum deduction. True = installment recovery is permitted under this rule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: max_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar cap on the commission amount that can be recaptured under this rule for a single policy termination event. Prevents disproportionate recapture on high-face-value policies. NULL indicates no cap applies.

attributes.name: max_installment_months
attributes.description: Maximum number of monthly commission payment cycles over which a chargeback amount may be recovered via installment deductions from future commissions. Applicable only when installment_recapture_allowed is True.

attributes.name: min_premium_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum annualized premium amount (in USD) that a policy must have paid before this chargeback rule is applicable. Policies with premiums below this threshold may be exempt from chargeback or subject to a different rule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: nbv_adjustment_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Business Value (NBV) Adjustment Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether chargebacks under this rule trigger a corresponding adjustment to the New Business Value (NBV) metric reported for the originating sales period. True = NBV is restated when chargeback is applied.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: override_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of hierarchy override commissions (paid to GA, MGA, BGA levels) that are recaptured upon early policy termination. May differ from the writing agent FYC recapture rate.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module

attributes.name: policy_month_12_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 12 (end of first policy year). A key milestone in the chargeback schedule as FYC is typically fully earned after year one.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Recapture Schedule; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: policy_month_1_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates in its first policy month. Typically the highest recapture rate in the schedule, often 100% of FYC paid.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Recapture Schedule; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: policy_month_24_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 24. Represents the renewal commission recapture rate at the end of the second policy year.

attributes.name: policy_month_36_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 36. Typically the final step in a 36-month chargeback schedule; after this point no recapture applies.

attributes.name: policy_month_6_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 6. Represents an intermediate point in the earned-down schedule.

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: Insurance product type to which this chargeback rule applies (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, Term, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity, DI — Disability Income, LTC — Long-Term Care). Drives rule applicability during commission recapture processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|TERM|FIA|SPIA|DI|LTC|ANNUITY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; IRC Section 7702; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the declining recapture percentage over the chargeback period. 'straight_line' reduces recapture evenly each month; 'step_down' applies tiered reductions at defined intervals; 'pro_rata' is proportional to remaining period; 'flat' applies a constant rate; 'custom_schedule' references a separate recapture schedule table.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: renewal_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of renewal commissions that can be recaptured upon early policy termination within the chargeback period. Renewal recapture schedules are typically less aggressive than FYC recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this chargeback rule within the commission rules engine. Used in bordereaux reporting and commission statements to reference the applicable recapture schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explaining the business rationale, applicability conditions, and recapture mechanics of this chargeback rule. Supports compliance documentation and agent dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; DOL ERISA Fiduciary Standards

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the chargeback rule (e.g., 'Term Life 24-Month FYC Recapture — BGA Tier'). Used in commission statements and agent communications.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback rule within the rules engine. 'active' rules are applied to new policy terminations; 'superseded' rules remain for historical recapture calculations on in-force policies.

attributes.name: source_rule_reference
attributes.description: Native rule identifier or reference key from the originating commission management system (Sapiens Commission / Annocera). Enables traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the operational system rule definition.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this chargeback rule was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_COMMISSION, ANNOCERA). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) indicating the state jurisdiction for which this chargeback rule is applicable. NULL or 'ALL' indicates the rule applies across all jurisdictions. State-specific rules may override national defaults per state Department of Insurance requirements.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: termination_reason_scope
attributes.description: Defines which policy termination reasons trigger this chargeback rule. 'lapse_only' applies only to policies lapsed for non-payment; 'surrender_only' applies to voluntary surrenders; 'all' applies to any early termination regardless of reason.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this chargeback rule record. Used to detect rule changes and trigger downstream recalculation of in-flight chargeback obligations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this chargeback rule, incremented each time the rule is modified and re-approved. Enables historical tracking of rule changes and ensures correct rule version is applied to policies issued under prior schedules.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

products.name: override_commission
products.description: Transactional and reference entity for hierarchy-based override commissions earned by upline agents, BGAs, MGAs, and GAs on the production of their downline agents. Transaction records capture override earnings including override level (BGA, MGA, GA, regional), override percentage, base commission reference, producing agent reference, and override amount. Rule records define hierarchy override parameters by product type and policy year — specifying override percentages, maximum override caps, eligibility criteria (minimum downline production, licensing requirements), and effective date ranges. Uses record_type discriminator to distinguish transaction vs rule entries. Supports multi-level payout calculations tied to NBV and policy sales as required by the agent hierarchy from the agent domain.

attributes.description: Reference to the upline agent, BGA, MGA, or GA entity in the agent hierarchy who is the recipient of this override commission. Used for multi-level payout calculations.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission processing run batch that calculated and generated this override commission record. Enables traceability and reprocessing of commission calculation cycles.

attributes.description: The Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE) of the policy generating this override commission. Used as the production volume basis for override eligibility thresholds and minimum downline production requirements.

attributes.name: base_commission_amount

attributes.name: chargeback_amount

attributes.name: chargeback_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for the override commission chargeback, such as policy lapse, surrender, cancellation, non-payment of premium, or rescission. Required for chargeback dispute resolution and audit trails.

attributes.name: commission_event_date
attributes.description: The real-world business date on which the override commission was earned, corresponding to the premium payment, policy issuance, or renewal event that triggered the base commission. Used for period-end accruals and DAC amortization.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; FASB ASC 944 Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC)

attributes.name: commission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the override commission record. Tracks progression from initial calculation through approval, payment, and potential reversal or dispute. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|calculated|approved|paid|reversed|disputed|voided — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the override commission: First-Year Commission (FYC), renewal, bonus, incentive, or standard override. Determines the applicable schedule and tax treatment for 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this override commission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record. Typically USD for domestic life insurance operations. Required for multi-currency reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the upline agent or agency for disputing the override commission calculation or payment amount. Used in dispute adjudication and audit trails.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Tracks the dispute resolution status for this override commission record. Populated when the upline agent or agency contests the calculated or paid override amount.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: For rule records: the date from which the override commission rule parameters (percentage, cap, eligibility criteria) become effective. For transaction records: the date from which the override commission obligation is recognized.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: For rule records: the date after which the override commission rule parameters are no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no defined end date. Supports versioned rule management.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_number
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the override recipient in the agent hierarchy relative to the producing agent (e.g., 1 = direct upline, 2 = two levels up). Used for multi-level override payout calculations and hierarchy analytics.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Denormalized string representation of the full agent hierarchy chain from the producing agent up to the override recipient (e.g., 'Agent > GA > MGA > BGA'). Supports multi-level payout tracing and hierarchy reporting without recursive joins.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: is_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the upline agent or agency met all eligibility criteria (minimum downline production, active licensing, hierarchy position) to receive this override commission at the time of calculation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: licensing_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the upline agent's or agency's state insurance license was verified as active and in good standing at the time the override commission was calculated. Regulatory compliance requirement for commission payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; State Departments of Insurance; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — agent licensing module

attributes.name: min_downline_production
attributes.description: For rule records: the minimum aggregate downline production volume (in APE or premium) required for the upline agent or agency to qualify for this override commission tier. Eligibility criterion defined in the override rule.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: nbv_amount
attributes.description: The New Business Value (NBV) attributed to the producing agent's policy sale that underlies this override commission. NBV is a key performance metric used to determine override eligibility and tier qualification in the agent hierarchy.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_override_amount
attributes.description: The final net override commission amount payable after applying any cap, chargeback adjustments, or reversals. This is the amount included in the commission payment run and reflected on the commission statement.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; SOX Section 404; IRS Form 1099-MISC reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, manual adjustment explanations, or exception handling comments related to this override commission record. Used by commission administrators for audit documentation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module

attributes.name: override_amount
attributes.description: The gross override commission amount earned by the upline agent or agency, calculated as base_commission_amount multiplied by override_percentage. Denominated in USD. Subject to maximum override cap rules.

attributes.name: override_cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum override commission amount payable to the upline agent or agency for a given period or transaction, as defined in the override rule record. Prevents excessive payouts beyond contractual limits.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: override_commission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the override commission record, used in commission statements, dispute resolution, and 1099 tax reporting. Assigned by the Agent and Commission Management System.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: override_level
attributes.description: The hierarchy tier of the upline agent or agency receiving the override commission. Values include Brokerage General Agency (BGA), Managing General Agency (MGA), General Agent (GA), regional, or national. Determines applicable override percentage schedules.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: override_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the base commission amount to calculate the override commission earned by the upline agent or agency. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Sourced from the applicable override rule record.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the override commission was or is scheduled to be disbursed to the upline agent or agency. Used for cash flow management, commission statement generation, and 1099 tax reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module; IRS Form 1099-MISC; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used to pay the override commission to the upline agent or agency. Options include ACH direct deposit, check, wire transfer, or credit memo applied against a balance.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year of the policy in force at the time the override commission is earned. Override percentage schedules typically differ between first-year (FYC) and renewal years, making this a critical determinant of the applicable override rate.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The insurance or annuity product type associated with the policy generating the override commission. Used to apply the correct override schedule.
