attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; IRS IRC Section 7702; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field distinguishing between a transaction record (an actual override commission earned event) and a rule record (a configuration defining override parameters by product type and policy year). Drives downstream processing logic.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system of record that originated this override commission record (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this override commission record in the originating source system (e.g., Sapiens Commission internal transaction ID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this override commission amount is subject to IRS 1099-MISC tax reporting requirements. Drives inclusion in annual 1099 statement generation for the upline agent or agency.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the upline agent or agency receiving the override commission. Required for IRS 1099-MISC reporting and AML/KYC compliance. May be an SSN or EIN.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this override commission record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, status changes, dispute updates, and chargeback processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

products.name: bonus_program
products.description: Master entity defining agent and broker bonus and incentive programs including production bonuses, persistency bonuses, new business value (NBV) bonuses, and sales contest awards. Stores program name, eligibility criteria, qualification period, bonus structure (flat, tiered, percentage of APE), target product lines, minimum production thresholds, and program effective dates. Managed within Sapiens Commission / Annocera incentive tracking module.

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the agent or broker bonus and incentive program record within the Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Bonus programs must comply with compensation policies prohibiting incentives for unsuitable sales, FINRA rules on contests and non-cash compensation, and Regulation Best Interest standards. Business p

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the business authority (e.g., VP of Distribution, Chief Actuary) who formally approved this bonus program for deployment. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Bonus programs target specific products; target_product_line exists but plan_id FK enables precise product eligibility validation, product-specific threshold application, and accurate bonus qualificat

attributes.name: program_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Bonus program terms and conditions must be documented for producer disclosure, compliance verification, and audit defense. Real business process: program rule publication, agent communication, regulat

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bonus program received formal business approval to proceed. Supports SOX audit trail and compensation governance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for the bonus program: pending (awaiting review), approved (authorized for distribution), rejected (not approved), withdrawn (pulled back after initial submission). Supports SOX compliance controls over compensation program authorization.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: award_form
attributes.description: The form in which the bonus is delivered to qualifying agents: cash (direct payment), non_cash (gift cards, merchandise), points (redeemable reward points), travel (conference or trip award), merchandise (physical goods). Affects 1099 tax reporting obligations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Publication 15-B (Fringe Benefits); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: bonus_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to the qualifying base (APE or NBV) to calculate the bonus payout when bonus_structure_type is 'ape_percentage' or 'nbv_percentage'. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 2.5000 = 2.5%).
attributes.references: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); IRC Section 6041; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: bonus_structure_type
attributes.description: Defines the calculation methodology for the bonus payout: flat (fixed dollar amount), tiered (escalating rates by production band), ape_percentage (percentage of Annual Premium Equivalent), nbv_percentage (percentage of New Business Value), points_based (points redeemable for awards).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total financial budget allocated for bonus payouts under this program across all qualifying agents. Used for financial planning, DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) tracking, and expense management. Expressed in the program's currency.
attributes.references: DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost); FASB ASC 944; GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: chargeback_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bonus amounts paid under this program are subject to chargeback (recoupment) if qualifying policies lapse or are surrendered within a defined period after the bonus payment date.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months following bonus payment during which a policy lapse or surrender triggers a chargeback of the bonus amount. Applicable only when chargeback_applicable is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bonus program record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts defined in this bonus program (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bonus program becomes active and agents begin accumulating qualifying production or activity toward the program's thresholds.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; IRC Section 162; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: eligible_agent_type
attributes.description: Category of agent or distribution channel eligible to participate in this bonus program: captive_agent, independent_agent, mga (Managing General Agent), bga (Brokerage General Agency), broker, ga (General Agent). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: captive_agent|independent_agent|mga|bga|broker|ga — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; MGA (Managing General Agent); BGA (Brokerage General Agency); GA (General Agent); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bonus program ends and no further production qualifies toward the program. Null for open-ended programs.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; IRC Section 162; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: flat_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount awarded to qualifying agents when the bonus_structure_type is 'flat'. Null for non-flat structures. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041 (1099 Reporting); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which bonus expense payments under this program are posted for financial reporting under GAAP and SAP accounting standards.
attributes.references: GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); FASB ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_eligibility
attributes.description: Specifies which level(s) of the agent hierarchy are eligible to earn bonuses under this program: writing_agent (direct producer), supervisor, manager, regional_director, or all levels. Drives multi-level payout calculations in the commission hierarchy.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bonuses earned under this program can be combined (stacked) with bonuses from other active programs for the same agent during the same qualification period. False means the program is mutually exclusive with other programs.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: is_tiered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bonus program uses a tiered payout structure where higher production levels earn progressively higher bonus rates or amounts. When True, tier details are stored in the associated bonus_program_tier child entity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: max_bonus_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total bonus payout amount an individual agent or broker may earn under this program during the qualification period, regardless of production achieved. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041 (1099 Reporting); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: min_agent_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months an agent must have been actively contracted with the company to be eligible to participate in this bonus program. Zero means no tenure requirement.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Agent Licensing Module

attributes.name: min_production_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying production amount (in APE, NBV, or premium dollars) an agent must achieve during the qualification period to become eligible for any bonus payout under this program.
attributes.references: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which earned bonus amounts are disbursed to qualifying agents or brokers following the close of the qualification period.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041 (1099 Reporting); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: persistency_measurement_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which policy persistency is measured to determine eligibility for a persistency bonus. Typically 12 or 13 months per NAIC persistency reporting conventions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: persistency_rate_required
attributes.description: Minimum policy persistency rate (as a percentage) an agent must maintain during the qualification period to remain eligible for a persistency bonus. Applicable when program_type is 'persistency_bonus'. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the bonus program, used in commission statements, bordereaux reporting, and agent communications (e.g., 'PROD-BONUS-2024', 'PERSIST-Q1-2024').
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the bonus program's objectives, eligibility rules, qualification criteria, and payout mechanics as communicated to agents and distribution management.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the bonus or incentive program as displayed to agents, brokers, and distribution management (e.g., 'Q1 2024 Production Bonus', 'Annual Persistency Award', 'NBV Champions Contest').
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bonus program: draft (being configured), active (open for qualification), suspended (temporarily halted), closed (no new qualifications accepted), expired (past effective period).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bonus program by its incentive purpose: production_bonus (volume-based), persistency_bonus (policy retention), nbv_bonus (New Business Value target), sales_contest (time-limited competition), recruiting_bonus (agent recruitment), conservation_bonus (lapse prevention). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production_bonus|persistency_bonus|nbv_bonus|sales_contest|recruiting_bonus|conservation_bonus — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_version
attributes.description: Version number of the bonus program definition, incremented each time material changes are made to eligibility criteria, payout structure, or thresholds. Supports audit trail and historical comparison of program terms.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the measurement window during which agent production, persistency, or NBV activity is tracked for bonus qualification purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement window during which agent production, persistency, or NBV activity is tracked for bonus qualification purposes. May differ from the program effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this bonus program record was sourced (e.g., 'SAPIENS_COMM', 'ANNOCERA'). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_program_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this bonus program record in the originating operational system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Best Practices; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: state_availability
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of US state codes (e.g., 'CA,TX,NY,FL') where this bonus program is available to agents. 'ALL' indicates nationwide availability. Supports state-level regulatory compliance for producer compensation disclosures.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: target_product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line(s) whose sales count toward qualification for this bonus program (e.g., 'WL', 'UL', 'IUL', 'FIA', 'Term', 'Annuity', 'All'). Multiple values may be stored as a delimited string. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|Term|DI|LTC|Annuity|All — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WL (Whole Life); UL (Universal Life); IUL (Indexed Universal Life); FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity); SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity); NAIC Product Filing Standards

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bonus payments under this program must be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC for independent contractor agents. True for cash bonuses; may be False for non-cash awards below IRS de minimis thresholds.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: threshold_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure used to evaluate whether an agent has met the minimum production threshold: ape (Annual Premium Equivalent), nbv (New Business Value), premium (collected premium dollars), policy_count (number of issued policies), face_amount (total face amount of issued policies).
attributes.references: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bonus program record in the system of record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: bonus_qualification
products.description: Transactional record tracking an agent's progress toward bonus program qualification thresholds during a qualification period. Captures cumulative APE, policy count, NBV, persistency rate, and qualification status (in-progress, qualified, disqualified) per bonus program per agent per period. Enables real-time incentive tracking and agent motivation reporting.

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bonus qualification tracking record. Primary key for the bonus_qualification data product.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bonus or incentive program for which qualification is being tracked (e.g., annual sales contest, quarterly production bonus, convention qualifier).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: cash_flow_projection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.cash_flow_projection. Business justification: Bonus programs use NBV (New Business Value) thresholds calculated from actuarial cash flow projections. Required for bonus program design, agent compensation planning, and profitability tracking to en

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent's position within the distribution hierarchy (e.g., agent, GA, MGA, BGA) at the time of qualification tracking, which may determine applicable bonus tier.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Qualifications are measured against product-specific thresholds (APE, NBV vary by product). Product_line exists but plan_id FK enables accurate product-specific threshold lookup and qualification meas

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or broker whose progress toward bonus qualification is being tracked. Links to the agent master record in the agent domain.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — agent licensing module

attributes.name: qualification_notification_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Bonus qualification status changes trigger notifications to producers (achievement alerts, threshold updates). Real business process: incentive program communication for motivation and transparency. L

attributes.name: qualification_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the defined measurement period (e.g., calendar year, quarter, contest window) during which the agent's production is evaluated for bonus eligibility.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any manual adjustment applied to this qualification record. Required when manual_adjustment_flag is True. Supports audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: all_thresholds_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the agent has simultaneously satisfied all mandatory qualification thresholds (APE, policy count, NBV, and persistency where applicable) as of the as_of_date. True triggers downstream bonus payment processing.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: ape_attainment_pct
attributes.description: The ratio of cumulative APE to the APE threshold, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75% attainment). Used for real-time progress tracking and agent motivation dashboards.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: ape_gap_to_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) Gap to Threshold
attributes.description: The remaining APE production the agent must generate to reach the APE threshold by the end of the qualification period (ape_threshold minus cumulative_ape). Negative values indicate the threshold has been exceeded. Used in agent coaching and motivation reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: ape_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum APE production level the agent must achieve within the qualification period to satisfy the APE component of the bonus program. Sourced from the bonus program's qualification schedule.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: as_of_date
attributes.description: The business date through which cumulative production metrics in this record have been calculated. Enables point-in-time snapshots for real-time incentive tracking and agent motivation reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: bonus_tier
attributes.description: The incentive tier level the agent is currently tracking toward or has achieved within the bonus program (e.g., bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond). Higher tiers correspond to greater production thresholds and larger bonus payouts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bronze|silver|gold|platinum|diamond — promote to reference product if tiers vary significantly by program]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the agent operates (e.g., career, independent, BGA, MGA, bank, direct). Bonus program eligibility and thresholds may vary by channel.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bonus qualification record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: cumulative_ape
attributes.description: Total Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) accumulated by the agent within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. APE normalizes single and regular premium business to an annualized basis (single premium / 10 + regular premium) and is the primary production metric for bonus qualification in life insurance.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: cumulative_nbv
attributes.description: Total New Business Value (NBV) generated by the agent within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. NBV represents the present value of future profits from new policies and is used in value-based bonus programs tied to profitability rather than volume.
attributes.references: IFRS 17; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: cumulative_policy_count
attributes.description: Total number of new business (NB) policies issued and in-force that the agent has placed within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. Used as a secondary qualification metric alongside APE.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has formally disputed the qualification status or production metrics recorded in this record. When True, the record is placed under review and bonus payment may be held pending resolution.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal dispute regarding this qualification record was resolved. Null if no dispute has been filed or if the dispute remains open.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: disqualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent was determined to have failed to meet one or more mandatory qualification thresholds, resulting in disqualification from the bonus program for the period.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason the agent was disqualified from the bonus program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: persistency_below_threshold|ape_shortfall|policy_count_shortfall|compliance_violation|license_lapse|e_o_violation|voluntary_withdrawal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; DOL ERISA fiduciary standards

attributes.name: estimated_bonus_amount
attributes.description: The projected bonus payout amount the agent would receive if current qualification status is maintained through the end of the period. Calculated based on current tier attainment and the bonus program's payout schedule. Used for agent motivation and financial accrual purposes.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; FASB ASC 944 (DAC and commission accruals)

attributes.name: manual_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any production metrics or qualification status in this record have been manually adjusted by a commission administrator (e.g., to correct a data error or apply a business exception). Triggers audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: nbv_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum NBV the agent must generate within the qualification period to satisfy the NBV component of the bonus program. Applicable only to programs that include a value-based qualification criterion.
attributes.references: IFRS 17; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: override_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is eligible to receive hierarchy-based override bonuses in addition to direct production bonuses, based on their position in the distribution hierarchy (e.g., GA, MGA, BGA overrides on downline production).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the bonus qualification measurement window. Production activity after this date is not counted toward the current period's thresholds.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the bonus qualification measurement window during which the agent's production activity is counted toward threshold attainment.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: persistency_rate
attributes.description: The proportion of the agent's in-force policies that have remained active (not lapsed or surrendered) during the qualification period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92%). Persistency is a key quality-of-business metric used in bonus qualification to discourage churning.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance Illustrations; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: persistency_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum persistency rate the agent must maintain during the qualification period to satisfy the persistency component of the bonus program. Falling below this threshold may result in disqualification.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance Illustrations; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: policy_count_gap
attributes.description: The remaining number of new business policies the agent must place to reach the policy count threshold (policy_count_threshold minus cumulative_policy_count). Negative values indicate the threshold has been exceeded.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: policy_count_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of new business policies the agent must place within the qualification period to satisfy the policy count component of the bonus program.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line(s) whose new business production counts toward this bonus qualification (e.g., life, annuity, disability, long_term_care, all). Some bonus programs are product-line specific.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: projected_qualification_date
attributes.description: Estimated date by which the agent is projected to meet all bonus qualification thresholds based on current production pace. Used in agent motivation reporting and coaching conversations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the agent satisfied all required thresholds and achieved qualified status for the bonus program. Null if qualification has not yet been achieved.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this bonus qualification record, used in agent statements, incentive reports, and dispute resolution (e.g., BQ-2024-00123456).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the agent's bonus qualification for this program and period. 'in_progress' indicates the period is active and thresholds not yet met or missed; 'qualified' indicates all thresholds have been satisfied; 'disqualified' indicates a threshold was permanently missed or a compliance violation occurred; 'pending_review' indicates manual review is required; 'forfeited' indicates the agent voluntarily or contractually relinquished eligibility.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this bonus qualification record originated (e.g., SAPIENS_COMMISSION, ANNOCERA). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bonus qualification record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every recalculation of cumulative metrics or status change.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

products.name: bonus_payment
products.description: Transactional record of bonus and incentive award disbursements to agents and brokers upon successful qualification. Captures bonus program reference, qualification period, bonus amount, payment date, payment method, tax withholding, and net payment. Feeds 1099 tax reporting and is reconciled against bonus_qualification records. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera incentive tracking module.

attributes.name: bonus_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bonus payment disbursement record. Primary key for the bonus_payment data product.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bonus or incentive program under which this payment was awarded, linking to the program definition including eligibility rules, tiers, and payout schedules.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bonus_qualification record that triggered this payment, enabling reconciliation between qualification events and actual disbursements.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Bonus payments are compensation expenses requiring GL entries for accrual accounting, tax withholding, and cash disbursement. Incentive compensation must be journalized separately from base commission

attributes.name: notification_communication_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bonus Payment Notification Communication Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Bonus payments trigger congratulatory notifications and payment confirmations to producers. Real business process: incentive payment notification delivery, program recognition communication. Links bon

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment run batch in which this bonus disbursement was processed, enabling batch-level reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: primary_bonus_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or broker receiving this bonus payment. Used for multi-level hierarchy payout calculations and 1099 tax reporting.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Agent Hierarchy Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Bonus payments must be recognized in specific reporting periods for expense accrual, tax reporting (1099-MISC), and statutory filings. Required for matching compensation expense to the correct account

attributes.name: reversed_payment_bonus_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original bonus_payment record that this record reverses or corrects. Populated only for reversal or adjustment transactions, enabling full audit chain of payment corrections.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission statement on which this bonus payment appears. Links the disbursement to the agent-facing statement for reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: The unique trace number assigned by the originating financial institution for ACH payment transactions. Used for payment tracing, reconciliation, and dispute resolution with the agent's bank.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve ACH Network

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bonus payment was formally approved for disbursement by the authorized approver.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the bonus payment prior to disbursement. Payments above defined thresholds may require manager or finance approval before processing.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or finance officer who approved this bonus payment for disbursement. Supports SOX audit trail requirements for compensation approvals.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: backup_withholding_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS backup withholding was applied to this bonus payment due to missing or incorrect TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) on file for the agent.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 3406; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the agent's bank account number used for ACH or direct deposit disbursement. Stored for payment verification and audit purposes without retaining full account details.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Data Security Standard; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: The qualifying production amount (e.g., APE, NBV, or premium volume) upon which the bonus calculation was applied. Represents the agent's measured performance metric for the qualification period.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: bonus_basis
attributes.description: The metric upon which the bonus amount was calculated. Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) and New Business Value (NBV) are common bases for life insurance production bonuses; policy_count and points are used for contest-based programs.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: bonus_rate
attributes.description: The percentage or multiplier applied to the basis amount to calculate the gross bonus. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5%). Derived from the applicable bonus program tier.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: bonus_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bonus award by its business purpose. Production bonuses reward new business volume (NBV); persistency bonuses reward policy retention; recruiting bonuses reward agent growth; contest bonuses are time-limited incentive campaigns; override bonuses are hierarchy-based; special bonuses are discretionary awards.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number assigned when the bonus payment is disbursed via physical check. Used for check reconciliation, stop-payment processing, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bonus payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the bonus payment amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the gross bonus payment, applied when backup withholding is required or elected. Reported on IRS Form 1099-NEC for the applicable tax year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding)

attributes.name: gross_bonus_amount
attributes.description: The total bonus amount earned before any tax withholding, adjustments, or deductions. Represents the full incentive award as calculated by the bonus program rules.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The agent's position in the distribution hierarchy at the time of this bonus payment. Determines override bonus eligibility and multi-level payout calculations. MGA = Managing General Agent, GA = General Agent, BGA = Brokerage General Agency.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bonus payment must be included in the agent's IRS Form 1099-NEC filing. Payments to incorporated entities (corporations) may be exempt from 1099 reporting under IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 6041; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount disbursed to the agent after deducting federal and state tax withholding from the gross bonus amount. This is the amount reflected on the agent's commission statement and payment.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or context related to this bonus payment. Used by commission administrators for exception handling and dispute documentation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the bonus payment was disbursed to the agent or broker. Used for 1099 tax year assignment and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement method used to deliver the bonus payment to the agent. ACH and direct deposit are most common for recurring payments; wire for large awards; check for agents without electronic banking setup.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this bonus payment disbursement, used for reconciliation, agent statements, and 1099 tax reporting. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera incentive tracking module.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bonus payment disbursement. Tracks progression from pending approval through paid or cancelled/reversed states.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period during which the agent qualified for this bonus. Together with qualification_period_start, defines the full evaluation window.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period during which the agent qualified for this bonus. Defines the window of production activity evaluated for eligibility.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for reversing or cancelling a previously issued bonus payment. Common reasons include policy lapse, qualification recalculation, agent termination, or data correction.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for disbursement of the bonus payment, before any processing delays or holds. Enables variance analysis between scheduled and actual payment dates.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this bonus payment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this bonus payment record in the originating operational system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the gross bonus payment, based on the agent's state of residence or the state's withholding requirements. Supports state-level 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: State Department of Revenue Regulations; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year to which this bonus payment is attributed for IRS 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Determines the tax reporting period for the agent's compensation.

attributes.name: tin_on_file
attributes.description: The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) — either SSN or EIN — on file for the agent at the time of payment. Masked for display (e.g., XXXXX1234). Required for IRS 1099-NEC reporting and backup withholding determination.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 6109; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bonus payment record was last modified. Tracks changes to payment status, amounts, or approval state for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

products.name: statement
products.description: Periodic commission statement issued to agents, brokers, BGAs, MGAs, and GAs summarizing all commission earnings, chargebacks, adjustments, bonuses, and net payment for a statement period. Captures statement period start/end dates, total gross commissions, total chargebacks, total adjustments, total bonuses, net payable amount, and statement delivery status. Serves as the official compensation record for agent reconciliation and dispute initiation.

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commission statement record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: delivery_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Commission statements are delivered as communications (email, secure portal, mail). Real business process: monthly/quarterly statement delivery to producers, regulatory requirement for compensation tr

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Commission statements are regulatory documents requiring retention, e-delivery tracking, and audit trails. Real business process: statement generation, electronic delivery consent verification, DOI co

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment run batch that generated and funded this commission statement. Links the statement to the disbursement cycle.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — commission calculation module

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Commission statements contain sensitive producer financial data (SSN, earnings, bank details); breaches must be tracked as privacy incidents. Business process: incident response for statement data exp

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent, broker, BGA, MGA, or GA for whom this commission statement is issued. Drives multi-level hierarchy payout calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — agent licensing module

attributes.name: advance_recoupment_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from this statement to recoup previously advanced commissions that have not yet been earned. Reduces net payable amount. Tracks outstanding advance balances per agent.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); GAAP ASC 944-40

attributes.name: agent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payee entity type: Agent (captive or independent), Broker, Brokerage General Agency (BGA), Managing General Agent (MGA), or General Agent (GA). Determines applicable commission schedule and hierarchy override rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the commission operations manager or system process that approved this statement for payment. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the commission statement was formally approved for payment processing. Null if not yet approved. Part of the SOX-compliant approval audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS backup withholding at the statutory rate (24%) was applied to this statement due to a missing, incorrect, or flagged TIN. True = backup withholding applied; False = no withholding required.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 3406; IRS Form 1099-NEC; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Total bonus and incentive compensation earned during the statement period, including production bonuses, persistency bonuses, and sales contest awards. Tracked separately from base commissions for incentive program reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission statement record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field used for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement (e.g., USD). Life insurance operations are predominantly USD; multi-currency support required for international business.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the commission statement is delivered to the agent: email, agent portal (self-service), physical mail, EDI transmission to BGA/MGA systems, or suppressed (no delivery). Tracks statement distribution compliance.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the commission statement to the agent: Pending (not yet sent), Delivered (successfully transmitted), Failed (delivery attempt unsuccessful), Acknowledged (agent confirmed receipt via portal).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the commission statement was successfully delivered to the agent via the designated delivery channel. Null if delivery is pending or failed.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: dispute_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the agent may file a formal dispute against the commission amounts on this statement, per the contractual dispute window (typically 30–90 days from statement date). Enforces dispute eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC producer agreement standards

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has initiated a formal dispute against any commission amounts on this statement. True = dispute filed; False = no dispute. Triggers dispute workflow in the commission management system.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC producer compensation dispute resolution guidelines

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Periodicity at which this statement is generated for the agent. Determines the cadence of commission payment cycles (e.g., monthly for renewal commissions, bi-weekly for FYC).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: fyc_amount
attributes.description: Portion of gross commissions attributable to first-year commission (FYC) earnings on new business (NB) policies issued during the statement period. Key metric for new business value (NBV) tracking and DAC amortization.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); GAAP ASC 944-40 DAC; NAIC

attributes.name: gross_commission_amount
attributes.description: Total gross commission earned by the agent during the statement period before any chargebacks, adjustments, or withholdings. Includes first-year commissions (FYC), renewal commissions, and override commissions.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); GAAP ASC 944-40 (Deferred Acquisition Costs); NAIC

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the agent within the distribution hierarchy (e.g., 1 = writing agent, 2 = GA, 3 = MGA, 4 = BGA). Used to apply tiered override commission rates in multi-level payout calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the net paid amount on this statement contributes to the agent's IRS Form 1099-NEC reportable compensation for the tax year. True if the agent is a non-employee and cumulative YTD payments meet or exceed the IRS reporting threshold ($600).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 6041A; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount payable to the agent after applying all chargebacks, adjustments, advance recoupments, and withholdings to gross commissions. This is the actual disbursement amount. Formula: gross_commission_amount + bonus_amount + service_fee_amount - total_chargeback_amount +/- total_adjustment_amount - advance_recoupment_amount - withholding_amount.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS Form 1099-NEC; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: override_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission earned by this agent as a hierarchy override on production written by downline agents. Applicable to GA, MGA, and BGA levels in multi-level distribution structures.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — hierarchy management module

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which the net payable amount was or will be disbursed to the agent. Used for cash flow management and agent payment tracking.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NACHA ACH settlement rules

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the net payable amount is disbursed to the agent: ACH (direct deposit), check, wire transfer, offset against a debit balance, or held pending resolution. Drives payment processing routing.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NACHA ACH rules

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this statement. Defines the inclusive upper bound of the period for which commissions are summarized.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this statement. Defines the inclusive lower bound of the period for which commissions are summarized.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS Publication 15-A (compensation period reporting)

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct policies contributing to commission earnings on this statement. Used for production reporting and persistency analysis.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC

attributes.name: renewal_commission_amount
attributes.description: Portion of gross commissions attributable to renewal-year commissions earned on in-force policies during the statement period. Reflects persistency-based compensation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC producer compensation guidelines

attributes.name: service_fee_amount
attributes.description: Service fees earned by the agent or broker for policy servicing activities during the statement period, distinct from sales-based commissions. Common in annuity and UL/IUL product lines.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native statement identifier from the originating commission management system (e.g., Sapiens Commission or Annocera statement ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); SOX Section 404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the commission statement was generated and issued to the agent or broker. Used as the reference date for dispute windows and 1099 tax reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS Form 1099-MISC/NEC reporting requirements

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable statement reference number assigned by the commission management system (e.g., CS-2024-03-000142). Used by agents for reconciliation and dispute initiation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission statement. Draft: being assembled; Generated: finalized but not yet approved; Approved: cleared for payment; Paid: disbursement completed; Disputed: agent has raised a formal dispute; Voided: cancelled and replaced.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC producer compensation guidelines

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar tax year to which the commission earnings on this statement are attributed for IRS 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Typically matches the statement period year but may differ for year-end adjustments.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: IRS Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the agent or agency entity as recorded at statement generation time. May be an SSN (individual) or EIN (agency). Required for 1099 tax reporting and AML/KYC compliance. Stored as masked or tokenized value per data security policy.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 6109; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA (if SSN used); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Type of TIN associated with the agent payee: SSN (Social Security Number for individual agents), EIN (Employer Identification Number for agency entities), or ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number for non-resident aliens).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 6109; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net total of all manual and system-generated commission adjustments applied during the statement period (positive or negative). Includes corrections for prior-period errors, rate changes, and policy endorsements.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); SOX Section 404 (financial adjustments audit trail)

attributes.name: total_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Total commission chargebacks applied during the statement period due to policy lapses, surrenders, or early terminations within the chargeback recapture window. Reduces net payable amount.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC producer compensation guidelines

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual commission transactions (FYC, renewals, overrides, chargebacks, adjustments) included in this statement. Used for statement reconciliation and audit verification.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission statement record was most recently modified. Updated on any status change, adjustment, dispute filing, or delivery status update. Used for incremental ETL processing and audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the commission payment for backup withholding or other tax withholding obligations (e.g., IRS backup withholding at 24% for missing TIN). Required for 1099 tax reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 3406 (backup withholding); IRS Form 1099-NEC/MISC; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: ytd_gross_commission_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative gross commission earned by the agent from the beginning of the calendar year through the end of this statement period. Required for IRS 1099-NEC annual reporting threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: ytd_net_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative net commission amount actually paid to the agent from the beginning of the calendar year through the end of this statement period. Used for 1099 tax form preparation and agent reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of manual or system-generated corrections to commission amounts outside of normal calculation cycles. Captures adjustment type (correction, retroactive rate change, policy change, reinstatement, 1035 exchange credit), original commission transaction reference, adjustment amount (positive or negative), adjustment reason, approver, and effective date. Supports audit trail for all post-calculation commission modifications.

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission adjustment record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the commission_adjustment data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Adjustment Module

attributes.name: adjustment_override_agent_producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervising agent or manager entitled to an override commission on this adjustment. Populated when the adjustment cascades up the distribution hierarchy to affect override compensation.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module

attributes.name: adjustment_producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the licensed agent or broker whose commission is being adjusted. Used for multi-level hierarchy payout recalculations and 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; ACORD Data Standards; Annocera — Agent Licensing Module

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Commission adjustments correct errors or apply retroactive changes to commissions on specific annuity contracts. Adjustment processing, audit trails, and producer dispute resolution require linking ad

attributes.name: commission_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to an open or resolved commission dispute record if this adjustment was initiated as a result of a formal agent dispute. Null for system-generated corrections not tied to a dispute.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards; Annocera — Commission Dispute Module

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.compliance_event. Business justification: Commission adjustments frequently result from compliance events (licensing lapses, E&O coverage gaps, regulatory sanctions, AML violations). Business process requires linking adjustment to triggering

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the individual who approved this commission adjustment. Required for SOX-compliant segregation of duties and four-eyes approval controls on commission modifications.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the life insurance policy or annuity contract associated with this commission adjustment. Links the adjustment to the underlying insured risk for NBV impact tracking.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens LifePro — Policy Administration Module

attributes.name: original_commission_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source commission transaction record that this adjustment corrects or modifies. Establishes the audit trail linking the adjustment back to the originating commission calculation event.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission — Commission Transaction Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission payment run batch in which this adjustment was included for disbursement. Null if the adjustment has not yet been included in a payment run.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission — Payment Processing Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Adjustments require product context to recalculate correct commission amounts using product-specific rates, validate adjustment eligibility, and apply product-specific adjustment rules in commission c

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_bill. Business justification: Commission adjustments frequently result from billing corrections, premium adjustments, or billing disputes. Operations require direct link to the corrected premium bill to recalculate commission basi

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Reinsurance premium adjustments (NAR recalculations, treaty amendments, recapture events) trigger corresponding commission adjustments on the retained portion. This link ensures commission adjustments

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original commission_adjustment record that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag = True. Enables full reversal chain tracing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; GAAP ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule (FYC or renewal rate table) applicable after the adjustment. Used to validate that the corrected rate aligns with the contractual schedule in effect.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission — Commission Schedule Module

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission statement on which this adjustment appears. Links the adjustment to the agent-facing statement document for transparency and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission — Statement Generation Module
