attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total federal income tax withheld from commission and compensation payments to the payee during the tax year, reported in Box 4 of IRS Form 1099-NEC or Box 4 of 1099-MISC. Applies when backup withholding is required (e.g., missing or incorrect TIN per IRS B-Notice procedures).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding); IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the 1099 tax report record. 'draft' indicates the record is being prepared; 'filed' indicates submission to the IRS; 'corrected' indicates a correction filing was submitted; 'void' indicates the record was voided; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a corrected filing; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting compliance review before filing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|corrected|void|superseded|pending_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099 General Instructions

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique control number assigned to this 1099 filing record, used for IRS submission tracking and payee statement identification. Typically formatted as a sequential alphanumeric code per tax year and payee.

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: The specific IRS 1099 form type applicable to this tax report. '1099-NEC' is used for non-employee compensation (primary form for agent commissions post-2020); '1099-MISC' for miscellaneous income; '1099-R' for retirement/annuity distributions; '1099-INT' for interest income; '1099-DIV' for dividend income.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRS Form 1099-MISC Instructions

attributes.name: irs_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this 1099 record was electronically submitted to the IRS via the FIRE system or paper-filed. IRS deadline is January 31 for 1099-NEC and February 28 (paper) / March 31 (electronic) for 1099-MISC.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS FIRE System; IRC Section 6071

attributes.name: irs_submission_reference
attributes.description: The IRS-assigned or internally-assigned reference number for the electronic submission batch in which this 1099 record was filed. Used for IRS FIRE (Filing Information Returns Electronically) system tracking and audit trail. Populated after successful IRS submission.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS FIRE System; IRS Publication 3609

attributes.name: is_corrected
attributes.description: Indicates whether this 1099 record is a corrected filing (True) or an original filing (False). The IRS requires the 'CORRECTED' checkbox to be marked on corrected 1099 forms. Drives the correction indicator in IRS electronic submission files.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099 General Instructions — Corrected Returns

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee's identity and TIN have been verified through the KYC process (True) prior to 1099 filing. Supports FinCEN AML/BSA compliance and IRS TIN matching requirements for agent and broker payees.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; KYC Requirements; IRS TIN Matching Program; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: nonemployee_compensation_amount
attributes.description: Total non-employee compensation paid to the agent or broker during the tax year, reported in Box 1 of IRS Form 1099-NEC. Includes first-year commissions (FYC), renewal commissions, override commissions, bonuses, and incentive payments aggregated from commission_payment records. The primary reportable amount for IRS purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRC Section 6041A; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: original_form_number
attributes.description: The form_number of the original 1099 filing that this corrected record supersedes. Null for original filings. Used to link correction chains and maintain audit trail of IRS submission history.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099 General Instructions — Corrected Returns

attributes.name: payee_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the payee as it must appear on the 1099 form for IRS filing. Required for paper and electronic 1099 submissions per IRS Publication 1220.

attributes.name: payee_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, apartment, unit number) of the payee for 1099 filing purposes. Optional field used when the payee address requires a second line.

attributes.name: payee_city
attributes.description: City of the payee's mailing address as required for IRS 1099 filing. Must match the address on the payee's W-9 on file.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form W-9 Instructions

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the agent, broker, or entity receiving the 1099 compensation as it must appear on the IRS filing. For individuals, this is the legal name matching the TIN/SSN on file. For entities, this is the registered business name.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form W-9 Instructions; IRC Section 6041

attributes.name: payee_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the payee's mailing address. Used for both IRS federal filing and state tax authority reporting. Drives state withholding reporting obligations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS State Abbreviations; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: payee_statement_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the 1099 payee copy was delivered to the agent or broker. 'mail' for paper statement mailed to payee address; 'electronic' for electronic delivery via agent portal (requires prior consent per IRS regulations); 'both' for dual delivery.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Reg. Section 31.6051-1; Treas. Reg. 1.6041-2

attributes.name: payee_statement_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the 1099 payee copy was sent or made available to the agent or broker. IRS requires payee copies to be furnished by January 31 of the year following the tax year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions

attributes.name: payee_tin
attributes.description: The IRS-issued Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) of the payee as reported on the 1099 form. Nine-digit numeric string without dashes. Used for IRS matching and FinCEN AML/BSA compliance. Must match the TIN on the payee's W-9 on file.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6109; FinCEN AML/BSA; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: payee_zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP code (5-digit or ZIP+4 format) of the payee's mailing address for IRS 1099 filing and state tax reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USPS ZIP Code Standards

attributes.name: payer_ein
attributes.description: The IRS-issued Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the life insurance company filing the 1099. Nine-digit numeric string without dashes. Required on all 1099 filings as the payer's federal tax identification number.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6109; IRS Form SS-4

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the life insurance company or entity acting as the payer on this 1099 filing. This is the company name that appears in the payer box of the IRS 1099 form and must match the payer's EIN registration with the IRS.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRC Section 6041

attributes.name: sox_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this 1099 tax report record has been reviewed and approved as part of the SOX internal controls process (True) for financial reporting accuracy and completeness. Supports SOX compliance for commission expense reporting.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302 and 404; FASB ASC 944; SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: state_id_number
attributes.description: The payer's state tax identification number used for state-level 1099 reporting. Required by certain state tax authorities for combined federal/state filing under the IRS Combined Federal/State Filing (CF/SF) program.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220 — Combined Federal/State Filing Program; State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: state_income_amount
attributes.description: The portion of total compensation allocated to the payee's state for state income tax reporting purposes. May differ from the federal nonemployee_compensation_amount if the payee operates across multiple states or if state-specific allocation rules apply.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; State Departments of Insurance; State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total state income tax withheld from commission and compensation payments to the payee during the tax year. Reported in the state tax section of the 1099 form. Amount varies by state withholding requirements and payee state of residence.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; State Departments of Insurance; State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year (e.g., 2024) for which this 1099 report is generated. All commission, bonus, and incentive payments aggregated into this record must fall within this tax year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6041; IRC Section 6041A

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of taxpayer identification number provided by the payee. 'SSN' (Social Security Number) for individual agents; 'EIN' (Employer Identification Number) for business entities such as BGAs or MGAs; 'ITIN' (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) for non-resident alien agents.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6109; IRS Form W-9 Instructions

attributes.name: total_bonus_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total bonus and incentive compensation payments included in the nonemployee_compensation_amount for this tax year. Includes production bonuses, persistency bonuses, and sales contest awards paid to the agent or broker. Supports compensation analytics and IRS reportable income breakdown.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions

attributes.name: total_fyc_amount
attributes.description: Total first-year commission (FYC) payments included in the nonemployee_compensation_amount for this tax year. Represents commissions earned on new business (NB) policy sales in the first policy year. Provides breakdown of compensation type for internal analytics and NBV reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Commission Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: total_override_amount
attributes.description: Total override commission payments included in the nonemployee_compensation_amount for this tax year. Represents hierarchy-based override commissions earned by upline agents on downline production. Supports multi-level payout reconciliation and NBV analytics.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Commission Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: total_renewal_commission_amount
attributes.description: Total renewal commission payments included in the nonemployee_compensation_amount for this tax year. Represents commissions earned on in-force policy renewals beyond the first policy year. Supports commission type breakdown for DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting and analytics.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944 (DAC); NAIC Commission Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1099 tax report record was last modified, including status changes, corrections, or amount adjustments. Audit trail field for tracking the full lifecycle of the tax report from draft through filed or corrected states.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: w9_on_file_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form W-9 On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid, signed IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) is on file for this payee (True). Required before commission payments are made and before 1099 filing. Absence triggers backup withholding obligations.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9 Instructions; IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent valid IRS Form W-9 was received from the payee. Used to determine the effective period of TIN certification and to assess backup withholding applicability for payments made before W-9 receipt.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9 Instructions; IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281

products.name: run
products.description: Operational master record representing a scheduled commission calculation and payment processing cycle. Captures run type (regular, off-cycle, adjustment), run period start/end dates, run status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, failed), total policies processed, total commission calculated, total chargebacks applied, total net payable, and run completion timestamp. Provides the operational control record for each commission processing cycle in Sapiens Commission / Annocera.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each commission calculation and payment processing cycle record in the Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The name or user identifier of the manager or supervisor who authorized the commission run for payment release. Required for SOX dual-control compliance and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Commission runs are executed by specific legal entities for regulatory reporting (NAIC company code), tax filing (EIN), and consolidated financial statements. Multi-entity insurers require entity-leve

attributes.name: prior_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding commission run that this run supersedes, corrects, or is linked to (e.g., for adjustment or reversal run types). Enables run lineage tracing and prior-period reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Commission runs are executed for specific reporting periods and drive commission expense accrual in financial statements. This is the primary operational link between commission processing cycles and

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The financial accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this commission run's payables are posted in the general ledger. Aligns commission expense recognition with GAAP ASC 944 and SAP statutory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 — Financial Services Insurance; NAIC SAP; GAAP

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the commission calculation engine began processing this run. Used for performance monitoring, SLA compliance, and audit trail of processing timelines.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: advance_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The total amount recovered in this run against outstanding commission advances previously paid to agents. Deducted from gross commission before net payable calculation. Tracks advance repayment progress across run cycles.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: agents_processed_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct agent and broker records for which commission calculations were performed in this run. Used for run completeness validation and agent payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the commission run was formally approved for payment release by an authorized manager. Null until approval is granted. Supports SOX audit trail and dual-control documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: bonus_incentive_amount
attributes.description: The total bonus and incentive compensation calculated in this run, including production bonuses, persistency bonuses, and contest awards. Separate from base commission for expense categorization and 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Incentive Tracking Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the commission run finished processing, whether successfully completed or failed. Null if the run has not yet concluded. Used for SLA measurement and downstream payment release gating.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this commission run record was first created in the system. Serves as the immutable audit creation marker for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this commission run (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The agent distribution channel segment processed in this commission run. Determines applicable commission schedules, hierarchy override rules, and regulatory disclosure requirements. BGA = Brokerage General Agency; MGA = Managing General Agent; TPA = Third Party Administrator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent_agent|bga|mga|broker_dealer|direct|tpa|bank — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 2040 — Payments to Unregistered Persons

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: The total number of error conditions encountered during this commission run that prevented individual transaction calculations from completing successfully. A non-zero value requires investigation before payment release.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Summary description of the primary error or failure reason when the run status is 'failed'. Provides operational context for troubleshooting and reprocessing decisions. Null for successful runs.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled recurrence cadence for this commission run type. Drives the run calendar configuration in Sapiens Commission / Annocera and determines payment cycle expectations for agents and brokers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|bi_weekly|semi_monthly|monthly|quarterly|annual|ad_hoc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: fyc_amount
attributes.description: The total first-year commission (FYC) component of gross commission calculated in this run, representing commissions earned on new business policies issued within their first policy year. Key metric for new business value (NBV) reporting and DAC amortization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 — Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC); NAIC SAP; ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: gross_commission_amount
attributes.description: The total gross commission calculated across all agents and policies in this run before chargebacks, adjustments, or withholdings are applied. Represents the sum of all first-year (FYC), renewal, override, and bonus commissions earned in the period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 — Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC); NAIC SAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_test_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission run was executed as a simulation or test cycle (True) rather than a production run (False). Test runs calculate commissions but do not generate actual payment transactions or 1099 reportable amounts.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount payable to agents and brokers in this commission run, calculated as gross commission minus chargebacks plus/minus adjustments. This is the amount released to the payment processing system for disbursement.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; FASB ASC 944; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: override_commission_amount
attributes.description: The total hierarchy-based override commission calculated in this run, representing additional compensation paid to upline agents (GA, MGA, BGA) based on the production of their downline agents. Supports multi-level payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which commission payments from this run were approved and released to the payment processing system for disbursement to agents and brokers. Null until payments are released.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_release_status
attributes.description: The approval and release status of commission payments generated by this run. Payments move from pending (run completed) to approved (management sign-off) to released (sent to payment system). Held or rejected statuses require remediation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404 Dual-Control Requirements

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive end boundary for policy transactions, premiums, and events eligible for commission calculation in this cycle.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive start boundary for policy transactions, premiums, and events eligible for commission calculation in this cycle.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: policies_processed_count
attributes.description: The total number of policy records evaluated and processed during this commission run. Includes all policies with commission-eligible events within the run period. Used for run reconciliation and volume reporting.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line segment included in this commission run. Determines applicable commission rate schedules and regulatory reporting requirements. LTC = Long-Term Care. 'all' indicates a cross-product run.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Requirements; ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: renewal_commission_amount
attributes.description: The total renewal commission component of gross commission calculated in this run, representing commissions earned on in-force policies beyond their first policy year. Distinct from FYC for DAC and expense ratio analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 — Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC); NAIC SAP

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the commission run, formatted as CR-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used in commission statements, audit trails, and dispute references.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission run within the processing workflow. Transitions: scheduled → in_progress → completed or failed. Cancelled and on_hold are terminal or paused states requiring manual intervention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission processing cycle indicating its business purpose. Regular runs are scheduled periodic cycles; off-cycle runs are unscheduled; adjustment runs correct prior period errors; reversal runs undo a prior run; bonus runs process incentive payouts; supplemental runs handle additional payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|off_cycle|adjustment|reversal|bonus|supplemental — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: scheduled_run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this commission run was originally scheduled to execute. Used for SLA tracking, run calendar management, and reconciliation against actual execution date.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this commission run record. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and reconciliation between source systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_run_ref
attributes.description: The native run identifier or batch reference number assigned by the originating source system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables direct traceability back to the operational system record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year (YYYY) to which commission payments in this run are attributed for 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Critical for year-end tax reporting reconciliation and FinCEN AML compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net sum of all manual corrections, dispute resolutions, and prior-period adjustments applied in this commission run. May be positive (additional payment) or negative (reduction). Distinct from chargebacks which are rule-driven recaptures.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: total_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate amount of commission chargebacks applied in this run due to policy lapses, surrenders, cancellations, or other recapture events. Reduces gross commission to arrive at net payable.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate federal and state income tax withheld from agent commission payments in this run, applicable for agents subject to backup withholding. Required for IRS 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Employer's Tax Guide; IRS Form 1099-NEC; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: transactions_generated_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual commission transaction records created by this run, including first-year commissions (FYC), renewals, overrides, and service fees. Used for run output validation and downstream reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this commission run record was most recently modified. Tracks status transitions, corrections, and any updates to run metadata for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: The total number of warning conditions flagged during this commission run that did not prevent processing but require review (e.g., missing licensing data, rate schedule gaps, hierarchy mismatches).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

products.name: payee
products.description: Master entity representing all commission payees — individual agents, brokers, BGAs, MGAs, GAs, RIAs, TPAs, broker-dealers, and corporate entities — eligible to receive commission and fee payments. Captures payee legal name, payee type (individual, corporation, partnership, LLC), TIN/SSN, banking details (ACH routing/account number), payment preference (ACH, check, wire), W-9 certification status, backup withholding flag, 1099 reporting classification, and payee active/inactive status. This is the financial disbursement identity — distinct from the agent domain's agent record which owns licensing, appointment, and hierarchy data. Cross-referenced to agent domain via agent identifier for operational linkage.

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commission payee record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the payee master entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_case. Business justification: Payees (producers) may be subjects of AML investigations for suspicious commission patterns, structuring to avoid reporting thresholds, identity fraud, or OFAC violations. Real business process: AML m

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Payee master data governance requires employee tracking for fraud prevention and SOX compliance. Operations staff create/maintain payee records; audit trail must identify creator for fraud investigati

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Payees may have product-specific licensing and appointment requirements (not all agents can sell all products). Plan_id FK enables product-specific agent authorization validation and product appointme

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Payee PII breaches (SSN exposure, W-9 data leaks, TIN compromise, bank account information disclosure) are privacy incidents requiring notification and remediation. Real business process: breach notif

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this payee to the corresponding agent record in the agent domain. Enables operational linkage between the financial disbursement identity (payee) and the licensing/appointment/hierarchy record (agent). Nullable for non-agent payees such as corporate BGAs or TPAs with no direct agent record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model

attributes.name: ach_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number at the payee's financial institution for ACH direct deposit of commission payments. Required when payment_method is ACH. May be checking or savings account. Stored in encrypted/tokenized form per PCI DSS requirements. Only the last four digits are displayed in operational interfaces.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: ach_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account used for ACH commission payment deposits. Checking accounts are most common for business payees; savings accounts may be used by individual agents. Required for ACH payment file generation per NACHA formatting standards.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ach_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the payee's financial institution for ACH direct deposit of commission payments. Required when payment_method is ACH. Validated against the Federal Reserve's routing number database. Stored in encrypted form per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: advance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is eligible to receive commission advances — upfront payment of future expected commissions against new business production. Eligibility is typically based on production history, chargeback record, and contractual agreement. When True, the commission system may process advance payments subject to advance repayment tracking.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model

attributes.name: advance_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding commission advance balance permitted for this payee at any point in time. Expressed in the payee's payment currency. Enforced by the commission management system to limit financial exposure from advance chargebacks. Null if advance_eligible is False.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is subject to mandatory IRS backup withholding on commission payments. Set to True when the IRS notifies the company of a TIN mismatch, when the payee fails to certify their TIN on Form W-9, or when the payee has underreported income. When True, the payment processing system must withhold the statutory backup withholding rate from all reportable payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281; IRS CP2100 Notice

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the payee holds the account designated for commission payment deposits. Used for payment reconciliation, remittance advice generation, and ACH return resolution. Stored for operational reference alongside the routing and account numbers.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: commission_statement_delivery
attributes.description: Payee's preferred delivery method for periodic commission statements. Electronic = PDF delivered via secure portal or email; Paper = printed statement mailed to mailing address; Both = electronic and paper. Drives statement generation and distribution workflows in the commission management system.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: crd_number
attributes.description: FINRA-assigned Central Registration Depository (CRD) number for payees who are registered representatives or broker-dealers selling variable life insurance or variable annuity products. Required for FINRA regulatory reporting and suitability compliance for variable product commissions.
attributes.references: FINRA Rules; SEC Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI); FINRA BrokerCheck

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payee record was first created in the commission management system. Represents the business onboarding event time, not the ETL load time. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and payee lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the payee operates, if different from the legal name. Common for BGAs, MGAs, and GAs operating under a brand name distinct from their legal entity name. Used on commission statements and correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee record became active and eligible to receive commission payments. Typically corresponds to the date the payee's contract with the company was executed and all onboarding requirements (W-9, KYC, banking) were satisfied.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the payee used for electronic commission statement delivery, payment notifications, W-9 re-certification requests, and compliance communications. For entity payees, this is typically the accounts payable or finance contact email.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; GDPR Article 4 (if applicable); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Position of the payee within the multi-level commission hierarchy used for override commission calculations. Determines eligibility for first-year commission (FYC), renewal commissions, and hierarchy-based override payments. Writing Agent = direct producer; Field Manager = first-level override; Regional Manager = second-level override; BGA/MGA = wholesale distribution override levels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: writing_agent|field_manager|regional_manager|bga|mga|home_office|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status for the payee as required by FinCEN AML/BSA regulations. Verified = identity confirmed and AML screening passed; Pending = verification in progress; Failed = identity verification or AML screening failed, payments blocked; Exempt = entity type exempt from KYC requirements (e.g., publicly traded corporations). Payments must not be processed to payees with Failed KYC status.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; USA PATRIOT Act Section 326; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's KYC identity verification and AML screening was most recently completed and approved. Used to determine KYC currency and trigger periodic re-verification workflows per the company's AML compliance program.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payee as registered with the IRS and state authorities. For individuals, this is the name on the W-9 form. For entities, this is the registered business name. Used for 1099 tax reporting, ACH payment files, and check issuance. Must match the name associated with the TIN on file.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: license_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the payee holds their primary insurance producer license. Used to validate appointment status and commission payment eligibility per state-specific insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for mailing commission checks, 1099 tax forms, and commission statements to the payee. For individuals, this is typically a home or office address. For entities, this is the registered business address.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220 (1099 mailing requirements); USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, unit, floor, or PO Box information for the payee's mailing address. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient to fully specify the delivery location.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City component of the payee's mailing address. Used for check mailing, 1099 form delivery, and commission statement distribution.

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the payee's mailing address. Defaults to USA for domestic payees. Required for international wire transfer payees and cross-border distribution arrangements. Drives FATCA and FBAR reporting obligations for foreign payees.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IRS FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); FinCEN FBAR Requirements

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the payee's mailing address. Used for check delivery, 1099 form mailing, and geographic analytics on distribution channel coverage.

attributes.name: mailing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the payee's mailing address. Used for state income tax withholding determination, state-level 1099 reporting, and compliance with state Department of Insurance requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC State Reporting Requirements; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: NAIC-assigned National Producer Number (NPN) uniquely identifying the payee as an insurance producer across all US states. Used for cross-state license verification via the NAIC NIPR database, appointment validation, and regulatory reporting. Mandatory for all licensed producer payees.
attributes.references: NAIC National Producer Number (NPN) Standard; NAIC NIPR Database; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: ofac_last_screened_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee was most recently screened against OFAC sanctions lists. Used to enforce periodic re-screening requirements and ensure ongoing compliance with US sanctions regulations before each payment run.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; 31 CFR Part 501

attributes.name: ofac_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has been screened against the OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Must be True before any commission payment is disbursed. Payments to OFAC-listed entities are prohibited by US law.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; USA PATRIOT Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; 31 CFR Part 501

attributes.name: payee_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier assigned to the payee by the Agent and Commission Management System (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera). Used on commission statements, 1099 forms, and payment remittance advices to uniquely identify the payee across operational systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRS Publication 1220 (1099 Reporting)

attributes.name: payee_role
attributes.description: Distribution channel role of the payee within the life insurance and annuity sales ecosystem. Drives commission schedule selection, hierarchy override eligibility, and regulatory reporting. BGA = Brokerage General Agency; MGA = Managing General Agent; GA = General Agent; RIA = Registered Investment Advisor; TPA = Third Party Administrator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agent|broker|bga|mga|ga|ria|tpa|broker_dealer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; FINRA Rules (for broker-dealers); DOL ERISA Fiduciary Standards

attributes.name: payee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payee record in the commission management system. Active = eligible to receive commission payments; Inactive = no current production but record retained; Suspended = payments on hold pending investigation or compliance review; Pending = onboarding in progress, W-9 or banking not yet verified; Terminated = permanently closed, no further payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; SOX Internal Controls; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the payee for tax reporting and payment processing purposes. Determines W-9 federal tax classification, 1099 reporting obligations, and backup withholding rules. Individual = natural person agent/broker; Corporation = incorporated entity; Partnership = general or limited partnership; LLC = limited liability company; Trust = ILIT or other trust entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|partnership|llc|trust|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding); IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for commission payment disbursements to this payee. Defaults to USD for domestic US payees. May be CAD or other currencies for cross-border distribution arrangements. Drives currency conversion logic in the commission payment run.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for disbursing commission payments to this payee. ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic funds transfer (most common); Check = paper check mailed to payee address; Wire = domestic or international wire transfer for large or international payees. Drives payment run processing logic in the commission management system.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules (ACH); Federal Reserve Regulation J (Wire); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the payee. Used for payment issue resolution, W-9 certification follow-up, and commission dispute communications. For entity payees, this is the main business phone number.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this payee record was sourced (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera, Salesforce Financial Services Cloud). Used for data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and issue resolution in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Native primary key or unique identifier of this payee record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Sapiens Commission internal payee ID, Annocera agent code). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system for reconciliation and issue resolution.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: Primary state insurance producer license number for the payee. For individual agents and brokers, this is the license number in their primary state of appointment. For entity payees (BGAs, MGAs), this is the entity license number. Used to validate commission payment eligibility — commissions may only be paid to licensed producers per state insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements; NAIC NIPR Database

attributes.name: tax_classification_1099
attributes.description: IRS 1099 form type classification for annual tax reporting of commission and fee payments to this payee. 1099-NEC = non-employee compensation for individual agents/brokers; 1099-MISC = miscellaneous income for certain entity payees; 1099-R = distributions from retirement/annuity contracts; Exempt = corporations exempt from 1099 reporting per IRS rules; Not Reportable = payments below IRS reporting threshold or otherwise excluded.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Form 1099-MISC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's commission payment eligibility was terminated. Null for active payees. After this date, no new commission payments are processed except for renewal commissions or chargebacks governed by the payee's contract terms. Used in conjunction with payee_status to manage the full payee lifecycle.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: IRS-issued Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) used for 1099 tax reporting and backup withholding determination. For individuals, this is the Social Security Number (SSN); for entities, this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN). Stored in masked or encrypted form per PCI/PII data protection requirements. Must match the name on the W-9 certification.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA (if applicable)

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TIN on file is a Social Security Number (SSN) for individual payees or an Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entity payees. Drives IRS 1099 form type selection (1099-NEC vs 1099-MISC) and backup withholding logic.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 3406

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the payee record in the commission management system. Tracks changes to banking details, W-9 status, KYC status, payment preferences, or any other payee attributes. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse ETL pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: w9_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's most recent IRS Form W-9 was signed and certified. Used to determine W-9 currency and trigger re-certification workflows when the form is stale or when payee information changes (e.g., name change, TIN change).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1281; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: w9_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has submitted a valid, signed IRS Form W-9 certifying their TIN and federal tax classification. Payments to payees without a certified W-9 are subject to mandatory backup withholding at the IRS-prescribed rate. Required before any commission disbursement can be processed.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding); IRS Publication 1281

products.name: hierarchy_override_rule
products.description: Reference master defining the rules governing multi-level commission override calculations across the agent distribution hierarchy. Specifies hierarchy level (GA, MGA, BGA, regional director), override percentage by product type and policy year, maximum override cap, eligibility criteria (minimum downline production, licensing requirements), and effective date range. Drives the override_commission calculation engine for multi-level payout tied to NBV and sales.
products.reference: Override Commission Rule / Hierarchy Compensation Rule

attributes.name: hierarchy_override_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each hierarchy override rule record in the commission management system. Primary key for the hierarchy_override_rule reference master.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Override compensation rules must comply with FINRA supervision requirements, anti-pyramiding regulations, state compensation disclosure laws, and internal compliance policies. Real business process: c

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who approved this override rule for activation. Supports internal audit trail and segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Override rules are product-specific with different override percentages per product. Product_type_code exists but plan_id FK enables accurate product-specific override rule application and override ra

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_hierarchy_override_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hierarchy_override_rule_id of the newer rule that replaces this one when rule_status is 'superseded'. Enables forward-chaining of rule version history for audit and retroactive commission recalculation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: appointment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the upline agent must hold a current carrier appointment with the issuing insurance company for this override rule to be applicable. Distinct from licensing — appointment is a carrier-specific authorization.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this override rule received final approval for activation. Used in conjunction with approved_by for audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this override rule prior to activation. Rules must be approved before they can be applied in commission calculations. Supports internal controls and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The financial basis on which the override percentage is applied to derive the override commission amount (e.g., base commission amount, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), New Business Value (NBV), target premium). Drives the override_commission calculation engine.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module)

attributes.name: chargeback_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether override commissions earned under this rule are subject to chargeback upon policy lapse, surrender, or cancellation. When true, the chargeback_rule engine will apply recapture logic to override amounts.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of commission to which this override rule applies. First-Year Commission (FYC) overrides typically differ from renewal overrides. Drives correct application of the rule in the override_commission calculation engine.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this override rule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary thresholds and cap amounts defined in this rule (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: dac_impact_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) Impact Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether override commissions under this rule are included in Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) calculations for GAAP financial reporting under FASB ASC 944. Affects DAC amortization schedules and financial statement presentation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (Long-Duration Targeted Improvements — LDTI); GAAP

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the producing agent operates, scoping the applicability of this override rule (e.g., career agent, independent brokerage, bank distribution). Ensures channel-specific override schedules are correctly applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: e_o_insurance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Requirement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the upline agent is required to maintain active Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance as a condition of eligibility for this override rule.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this override rule becomes active and applicable to commission calculations. Defines the start of the rule's validity window. Used with expiration_date to determine applicability at any point in time.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this override rule ceases to be applicable. NULL indicates an open-ended rule with no scheduled expiration. Used with effective_date to enforce time-bounded override schedules.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The distribution hierarchy tier to which this override rule applies. Identifies the upline agent level (e.g., General Agent (GA), Managing General Agent (MGA), Brokerage General Agency (BGA), Regional Director) that earns the override commission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GA|MGA|BGA|regional_director|national_director|district_manager — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: licensing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the upline agent must hold a valid, active state insurance license in the jurisdiction of the producing policy for this override rule to apply. Enforces regulatory licensing compliance as an eligibility criterion.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: max_hierarchy_levels
attributes.description: The maximum number of upline hierarchy levels eligible to receive override commissions under this rule. Caps the depth of multi-level override payout chains to prevent excessive compensation stacking.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: max_override_cap_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar ceiling on the override commission payable under this rule per commission event or period. Applies when a percentage-based cap would still yield an excessive dollar amount. Complements max_override_cap_pct.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: max_override_cap_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable override percentage for this hierarchy level and product type, regardless of any negotiated or scheduled rate. Prevents total override payouts from exceeding regulatory or contractual limits. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10.00%).
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation on Agent Compensation

attributes.name: measurement_period_months
attributes.description: The rolling or fixed number of months over which downline production is measured to assess eligibility for this override rule (e.g., 12 months for annual qualification). Used in conjunction with min_downline_production_amount.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: min_downline_production_amount
attributes.description: Minimum annualized premium or New Business Value (NBV) that the upline agent's downline must produce within the measurement period for the override rule to be eligible. Enforces production-based eligibility thresholds for override compensation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: min_downline_production_basis
attributes.description: The metric basis used to measure downline production for eligibility (e.g., Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), New Business Value (NBV), annualized premium, face amount, or policy count). Determines how min_downline_production_amount is evaluated.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: nbv_weighted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the override percentage is applied to New Business Value (NBV) rather than gross premium or base commission amount. When true, the override_commission calculation engine uses NBV as the calculation basis.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: override_level_number
attributes.description: Numeric position of the hierarchy level in the multi-level override payout chain (e.g., 1 = immediate upline, 2 = second-level upline). Drives the hierarchy_path traversal in the override_commission calculation engine for multi-level payout.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: override_pct
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the base commission amount to calculate the override commission earned by the upline agent at this hierarchy level. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Core driver of the override_commission calculation engine.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module)

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which override commissions calculated under this rule are paid to the upline agent (e.g., monthly, quarterly, per commission event). Drives payment run scheduling in the commission management system.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module)

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which override commission payments are disbursed to the upline agent (e.g., ACH direct deposit, check, wire transfer, or offset against outstanding balances). Drives payment processing in the commission management system.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module)

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy duration year (1 = first year, 2 = second year, etc.) to which this override percentage applies. Distinguishes first-year commission (FYC) override rates from renewal override rates across the policy lifecycle.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: Insurance product type to which this override rule applies. Drives differentiated override percentages by product line (e.g., Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Indexed Universal Life (IUL), Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|term|FIA|SPIA|annuity|DI|LTC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; ACORD data standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this override rule within the commission management system. Used for cross-system reference and bordereaux reporting (e.g., 'OVR-GA-WL-001').
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the override rule's purpose, scope, and application logic. Supports audit review and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the hierarchy override rule (e.g., 'GA Whole Life Year-1 Override — Southeast Region'). Used in commission statements and reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the override rule governing whether it is applied in commission calculations. 'active' = currently in use; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'pending_approval' = awaiting compliance sign-off.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this override rule was sourced (e.g., 'SAPIENS_COMM', 'ANNOCERA'). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — hierarchy management module); ETL data lineage standards

attributes.name: stacking_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether multiple override rules at the same hierarchy level can be stacked (combined) for a single commission event. When false, only the highest applicable override rate is applied, preventing double-counting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera — commission calculation module); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the jurisdiction in which this override rule applies. Supports state-specific override schedules required by varying state insurance regulations. NULL indicates the rule applies across all jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states plus territories); NAIC

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether override commissions calculated under this rule are subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting requirements. Drives 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC generation for upline agents receiving override compensation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this override rule record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this override rule, incremented each time the rule is modified and re-approved. Supports audit trail and historical rule reconstruction for commission dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

products.name: persistency_credit
products.description: Transactional record of persistency-based commission credits awarded to agents when policies remain in-force beyond defined duration thresholds. Captures policy reference, persistency milestone (12-month, 24-month, 36-month), credit amount, credit type (cash, commission offset), calculation basis, and payment status. Incentivizes agents to place quality business and supports lapse management objectives.

attributes.name: persistency_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each persistency credit record in the commission domain. Primary key for the persistency_credit data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Persistency credits are bonus commissions earned when annuity contracts remain in force past milestone durations (e.g., 13 months, 25 months). Persistency tracking, bonus calculations, and lapse risk

attributes.name: commission_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commission transaction record in commission.commission_transaction that this persistency credit is associated with, enabling reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: dac_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.dac_asset. Business justification: Persistency credits are deferred acquisition costs tied to policy retention milestones. LDTI requires linking persistency incentives to DAC assets for cohort-level amortization and assumption updates.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the in-force life insurance or annuity policy that triggered the persistency credit. Links to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; EXL; Sapiens LifePro; Oracle Insurance Policy Administration); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: milestone_notification_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.communication. Business justification: Persistency milestone achievements trigger congratulatory notifications and credit confirmations to producers. attributes.description: The financial accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this persistency credit is attributed for GAAP and SAP reporting purposes. Used for DAC amortization, expense allocation, and period-end close.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any adjustments applied to the gross credit, including pro-ration for partial policy years, corrections for premium changes, or manual overrides. Negative values indicate reductions.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the persistency credit was formally approved for payment. Marks the transition from 'pending' to 'approved' status in the credit lifecycle.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the commission operations staff member who approved this persistency credit record. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The financial base used to compute the persistency credit amount. Common bases include Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE), modal premium, face amount, Account Value (AV), or New Business Value (NBV). Aligns with the commission schedule definition.

attributes.name: calculation_basis_amount
attributes.description: The dollar value of the calculation basis (e.g., annualized premium, account value) used to derive the persistency credit amount. Represents the financial exposure or premium base at the time of milestone evaluation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this persistency credit record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: credit_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the persistency credit record, used in agent statements, commission reports, and dispute references. Format: PC-{YYYY}-{sequence}.

attributes.name: credit_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the calculation basis amount to derive the gross persistency credit amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.005000 = 0.5%). Sourced from the applicable commission schedule.

attributes.name: credit_status
