attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the persistency credit is delivered to the agent: as a direct cash payment, an offset against outstanding chargebacks, a bonus credit, or a deferred credit applied in a future period.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this persistency credit record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international life insurance products.

attributes.name: dac_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) adjustment amount associated with this persistency credit. Persistency credits reduce DAC amortization expense; this field captures the DAC impact for GAAP and LDTI reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this persistency credit record is currently under dispute by the agent or agency. When true, the credit is placed on hold pending resolution.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the persistency credit dispute, as submitted by the agent or agency. Populated only when dispute_flag is true.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the policy was sold. Influences the applicable persistency credit schedule and rates. Channels include career agents, independent agents, Brokerage General Agencies (BGA), Managing General Agents (MGA), bank channel, and direct. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent_agent|bga|mga|bank|direct — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: gross_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total persistency credit amount before any adjustments, offsets, or withholdings. Calculated as calculation_basis_amount multiplied by credit_rate. Represents the agent's earned credit at the milestone date.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The agent hierarchy level of the recipient agent for this persistency credit. Determines override eligibility and multi-level payout calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: writing_agent|field_manager|regional_manager|general_agent|national_account — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: lapse_risk_score
attributes.description: A numeric score (0–100) representing the assessed lapse risk of the policy at the time of milestone evaluation. Derived from actuarial models and used to prioritize persistency credit programs and lapse management interventions.
attributes.references: Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet); NAIC Lapse Management Guidelines

attributes.name: milestone_duration_months
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the persistency milestone in months (e.g., 12, 24, 36). Used for calculations, reporting, and sorting when the milestone is expressed as a duration.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: milestone_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the policy was evaluated against the persistency milestone threshold. Represents the principal business event date — the point in time when the policy's in-force duration was confirmed to meet the credit trigger.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: nbv_basis_amount
attributes.description: The New Business Value (NBV) amount associated with the policy at the time of persistency credit calculation. Used for profitability analysis and to validate that the policy meets minimum NBV thresholds for credit eligibility.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: net_credit_amount
attributes.description: The final payable persistency credit amount after all adjustments. Equals gross_credit_amount plus adjustment_amount. This is the amount included in the agent's commission payment or statement.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: override_credit_amount
attributes.description: The persistency credit amount payable to the upline override agent identified in override_agent_id. Calculated based on the override percentage defined in the commission schedule hierarchy.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the persistency credit was or is scheduled to be paid to the agent. Populated when credit_status transitions to 'paid'.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRS 1099 Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: persistency_milestone
attributes.description: The policy duration threshold that triggered this persistency credit (e.g., 12-month, 24-month, 36-month). Defined in the commission schedule and aligned with lapse management objectives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 12_month|24_month|36_month|48_month|60_month|other — promote to reference product if additional milestones are needed]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Lapse Management Guidelines

attributes.name: policy_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of months the policy has been continuously in-force as of the milestone evaluation date. Confirms that the policy meets the minimum duration threshold for the persistency credit.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Lapse Management Guidelines

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the policy as recorded in the Policy Administration System. Used to calculate policy duration in months and confirm milestone eligibility at the time of credit evaluation.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; EXL; Sapiens LifePro); NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1, 2, 3, etc.) in which the persistency milestone falls. Used to apply the correct credit rate from the commission schedule and for DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); FASB ASC 944 (DAC); SAP

attributes.name: product_type

attributes.name: reversal_date

products.name: hold
products.description: Operational record capturing commissions that have been calculated but withheld from payment pending resolution of a blocking condition. Captures hold reason (pending chargeback resolution, licensing deficiency, compliance review, NIGO application, AML/KYC hold, E&O insurance lapse, appointment pending), hold amount, affected commission transaction references, hold start date, expected release date, hold status (active, released, expired, written-off), releasing authority, and release date. Supports compliance and risk management controls within the commission payment workflow and prevents improper disbursement to non-compliant producers. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module.

attributes.name: aml_kyc_case_reference

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount of commission withheld from payment under this hold record. Represents the total compensation blocked pending resolution of the hold condition. Expressed in the currency indicated by currency_code.

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Type of commission compensation subject to this hold. FYC — First Year Commission on new business; renewal — renewal/persistency commission on in-force policies; override — hierarchy-based override commission; bonus — incentive or bonus program payment; service_fee — ongoing service fee compensation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission hold record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event for the hold. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this hold record (hold_amount, released_amount, written_off_amount). Typically USD for domestic US life insurance operations.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the producer formally filed a dispute against this commission hold. Populated when dispute_flag is True. Initiates the dispute resolution SLA clock.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FINRA Rule 4530

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has formally disputed this commission hold. True = dispute filed; False = no dispute. Triggers the commission dispute resolution workflow and may affect hold_status transitions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FINRA Rule 4530; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: eo_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the producer's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance coverage at the time the hold was initiated. Populated when hold_reason_code is EO_INSURANCE_LAPSE. Used to track when E&O coverage must be reinstated to release the hold.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commission hold was escalated to senior management, legal, or regulatory affairs. Populated when escalation_flag is True. Used for escalation aging and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission hold has been escalated to senior management, legal, or regulatory affairs due to complexity, producer dispute, or regulatory inquiry. True = escalated; False = standard resolution workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: expected_release_date
attributes.description: Anticipated calendar date by which the blocking condition is expected to be resolved and the held commission released for payment. Used for cash flow forecasting, producer communication, and SLA monitoring. May be updated as the resolution timeline evolves.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Maximum date beyond which the hold will automatically expire if not resolved or extended. Enforces time-bound compliance controls and prevents indefinite withholding of producer compensation. Distinct from expected_release_date which is the anticipated resolution date.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Department of Insurance regulations; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the commission hold record. Used in producer communications, compliance reports, and dispute correspondence. Format: CH-{YYYY}-{sequence}.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission hold. 'active' — hold is in effect and payment is blocked; 'released' — blocking condition resolved and payment authorized; 'expired' — hold lapsed without resolution per hold expiry rules; 'written_off' — hold amount deemed unrecoverable and written off; 'pending_review' — hold is under compliance or management review.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the commission hold by its governing domain. 'compliance' — holds triggered by AML/KYC, E&O, or regulatory review; 'financial' — holds triggered by chargeback resolution or financial reconciliation; 'licensing' — holds triggered by producer licensing or appointment deficiencies; 'administrative' — holds triggered by NIGO applications or data quality issues.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: licensing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the jurisdiction in which the producer's license or appointment is deficient, when hold_reason_code is LICENSING_DEFICIENCY or APPOINTMENT_PENDING. Used to route resolution to the appropriate state Department of Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: nigo_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Application Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the Not In Good Order (NIGO) application deficiency record in the new business processing system, when hold_reason_code is NIGO_APPLICATION. Links to the new business application requiring correction before commission can be released.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Year of the policy in-force at the time the commission was calculated and subsequently held. Policy year 1 indicates a First Year Commission (FYC); years 2+ indicate renewal commissions. Used to apply the correct chargeback recapture schedule and commission rate tier.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the commission hold for resolution workflow management. 'critical' — regulatory or legal deadline imminent; 'high' — significant producer impact or escalated complaint; 'medium' — standard resolution timeline; 'low' — minor administrative hold with minimal producer impact.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Internal Commission Operations Policy

attributes.name: producer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the producer was formally notified of the commission hold. Populated when producer_notified_flag is True. Used to measure compliance with state-mandated producer notification timelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: producer_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected producer (agent or broker) has been formally notified of the commission hold and its reason. True = notification sent; False = notification pending. Required for producer relations compliance and state regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance; FINRA Rule 4530

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Life insurance or annuity product type associated with the policy generating the held commission (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, Term, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity). Supports product-level hold analysis and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|TERM|FIA|SPIA|DI|LTC|ANNUITY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; IRC Section 7702; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific blocking condition that triggered the commission hold. CHARGEBACK_PENDING — unresolved chargeback against the agent; LICENSING_DEFICIENCY — producer license not active or not appointed in the policy state; COMPLIANCE_REVIEW — internal compliance investigation; NIGO_APPLICATION — Not In Good Order (NIGO) application pending correction; AML_KYC_HOLD — Anti-Money Laundering (AML) / Know Your Customer (KYC) review; EO_INSURANCE_LAPSE — Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance coverage lapsed; APPOINTMENT_PENDING — state appointment not yet confirmed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CHARGEBACK_PENDING|LICENSING_DEFICIENCY|COMPLIANCE_REVIEW|NIGO_APPLICATION|AML_KYC_HOLD|EO_INSURANCE_LAPSE|APPOINTMENT_PENDING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA; FINRA Rule 3110; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the hold reason beyond the standardized hold_reason_code. Captures case-specific details such as the specific licensing state deficiency, the nature of the compliance finding, or the NIGO correction required.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the resolution of the blocking condition and the basis for releasing the commission hold. Captures evidence of compliance clearance, licensing reinstatement, NIGO correction, or chargeback settlement. Required for audit and regulatory examination purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: released_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the held commission that has been authorized for payment following resolution of the blocking condition. May be less than hold_amount in cases of partial release or write-off. Populated when hold_status transitions to 'released'.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who authorized and executed the release of this commission hold. Populated when hold_status transitions to 'released'. Provides accountability and audit trail for commission disbursement authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: releasing_authority
attributes.description: Name or role identifier of the individual, team, or system authorized to release this commission hold. Examples: 'Compliance Officer', 'Commission Manager', 'Automated Licensing Verification System'. Supports segregation of duties and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FINRA Rule 3110

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this commission hold record originated. SAPIENS_COMMISSION — Sapiens Commission platform; ANNOCERA — Annocera commission management system; MANUAL — manually entered hold by compliance or commission operations staff.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: source_system_hold_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier or reference number assigned to this hold record by the originating operational system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer data product and the system of record for reconciliation and issue resolution.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the commission hold was initiated and payment was blocked. Represents the principal business event date for the hold lifecycle. Used for aging analysis and SLA tracking of hold resolution.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera compliance module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: tax_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the held commission amount is subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting upon release. True = reportable on Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC; False = not reportable (e.g., return of advance, non-taxable adjustment). Supports year-end tax reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRC Section 6041; SOX

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar tax year in which the held commission amount will be reported for IRS 1099 purposes upon release. Determines the tax reporting period for the compensation when the hold is resolved. Relevant when hold spans multiple calendar years.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 6041; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission hold record was last modified. Tracks the most recent status change, amount update, or resolution event. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: written_off_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the held commission deemed unrecoverable and written off rather than released to the producer. Applicable when the hold cannot be resolved (e.g., terminated agent with unresolved compliance issue). Populated when hold_status is 'written_off'.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.references: IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: calculation_period_end
attributes.description: The last date of the period over which the service fee is calculated. Together with calculation_period_start, defines the billing interval for the fee.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Rule 12b-1; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2)

attributes.name: calculation_period_start
attributes.description: The first date of the period over which the service fee is calculated. For trail fees and asset-based fees, this is typically the first day of the billing month or quarter.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Rule 12b-1; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this service fee record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this service fee record. Typically USD for domestic life and annuity products.

attributes.name: dac_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee is classified as a deferred acquisition cost (DAC) under FASB ASC 944-30 or LDTI (ASU 2018-12). Relevant for asset-based fees that may qualify as incremental direct acquisition costs for variable products.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-30; LDTI (ASU 2018-12); SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee record is currently under dispute by the payee or has been flagged for review. Triggers the dispute resolution workflow in the Agent and Commission Management System.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; Internal Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the service fee dispute, such as incorrect fee rate applied, wrong fee basis amount, incorrect calculation period, or unauthorized fee deduction. Populated when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; Internal Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the policy or annuity contract was sold and through which the service fee arrangement is maintained. Determines applicable fee schedules and regulatory disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SEC Fee Disclosure

attributes.name: earning_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the service fee is considered earned, typically the last day of the calculation period or the valuation date for asset-based fees. Used for revenue recognition and DAC amortization under FASB ASC 944 / LDTI.

attributes.name: fee_agreement_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the underlying service fee agreement or selling agreement between the insurance company and the payee (RIA, TPA, or broker-dealer). Used to validate fee rates and terms against the contracted arrangement.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Rule 12b-1; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2)

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The financial measure upon which the service fee rate is applied. Account value (AV) and contract value are common for annuity products; net asset value (NAV) and fund assets apply to variable products with separate account sub-funds; premium basis applies to certain service arrangements.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; FINRA Fee Disclosure; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: fee_basis_amount
attributes.description: The dollar value of the fee basis (account value, NAV, fund assets, or premium) as of the calculation date used to compute the service fee. This is the base upon which fee_rate is applied.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; FINRA Fee Disclosure; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: fee_frequency
attributes.description: The recurring payment frequency for this service fee arrangement. Determines how often the fee is calculated and disbursed within a contract year.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2); Agent and Commission Management System

attributes.name: fee_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the service fee transaction, formatted as SVC- followed by a 10-digit sequence. Used in fee statements, remittance advices, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; FINRA Fee Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: The annualized fee rate expressed as a decimal percentage applied to the fee basis (e.g., account value, NAV, fund assets) to calculate the periodic service fee amount. For example, 0.0025 represents 25 basis points (bps). Subject to SEC/FINRA fee disclosure requirements for registered products.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; FINRA Rule 2341; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2)

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service fee record. Tracks progression from calculation through approval, payment, and any post-payment adjustments or disputes.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service fee arrangement. Trail fees and asset-based fees are recurring compensation tied to account value (AV) or net asset value (NAV). 12b-1 fees are mutual fund distribution fees. Sub-TA fees are sub-transfer-agency fees paid to broker-dealers. Plan admin fees apply to employer-sponsored plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trail_fee|asset_based_fee|service_fee|12b1_fee|sub_ta_fee|plan_admin_fee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; FINRA Rule 2341; DOL ERISA Section 408(b)(2); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: finra_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee is subject to FINRA fee disclosure and reporting requirements, applicable to 12b-1 fees, sub-TA fees, and other compensation paid in connection with variable products sold through registered broker-dealers.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; FINRA Rule 5110; SEC Rule 12b-1

attributes.name: gross_fee_amount
attributes.description: The total calculated service fee amount before any adjustments, reversals, or tax withholding. Computed as fee_rate multiplied by fee_basis_amount, prorated for the calculation period.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Fee Disclosure; FASB ASC 944-20

attributes.name: net_fee_amount
attributes.description: The final payable service fee amount after applying all adjustments. Equals gross_fee_amount plus adjustment_amount. This is the amount disbursed in the payment run.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Fee Disclosure; FASB ASC 944-20

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity receiving the service fee. Registered investment advisers (RIAs) receive asset-based and trail fees; third-party administrators (TPAs) receive plan administration fees; broker-dealers receive 12b-1 and sub-TA fees; managing general agents (MGAs) and brokerage general agencies (BGAs) may receive service fees on FIA products.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act of 1940; FINRA Rule 2341; DOL ERISA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the net service fee amount was disbursed to the payee (RIA, TPA, or broker-dealer). Used for cash flow reporting and 1099 tax year assignment.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099-MISC; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the payment period in which the service fee is disbursed. Used for payment reconciliation and 1099 tax reporting period assignment.

attributes.name: payment_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the payment period in which the service fee is disbursed. May differ from the calculation period due to processing lag or payment cycle timing.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1, 2, 3, etc.) in which the service fee is earned, measured from the policy issue date. Some fee schedules vary by policy year, particularly for trail fees that step down after the first few years.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission)

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product identifier code from the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST) identifying the specific product form on which the service fee applies. Used for fee schedule lookup and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Product Filing Requirements

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The insurance or annuity product type associated with the service fee. Variable life, variable annuity, and fixed indexed annuity (FIA) products are the primary product types subject to recurring service fee arrangements. Variable universal life (VUL) and universal life (UL) also applicable.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Classification; SEC Registration Requirements; FINRA Rule 2330

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee record represents a reversal of a previously paid fee. True when the record is a corrective reversal entry, typically triggered by policy lapse, surrender, contract termination, or fee calculation error.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Section 404; Internal Audit Controls

attributes.name: sec_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee must be disclosed in SEC filings (e.g., Form N-1A, Form ADV, or variable product prospectus). Applicable to 12b-1 fees and asset-based fees on registered separate account products.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; Investment Company Act of 1940; SEC Form N-1A

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this service fee record originated. Primarily the Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission, Annocera) or Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity) for annuity-based trail fees.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native transaction or record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Sapiens Commission fee transaction ID, Annocera service fee reference). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the policy situs (state of issue) for the underlying contract. Determines applicable state insurance department regulations and any state-specific fee disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC State Filing Requirements; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: sub_account_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the separate account sub-fund or investment option within a variable life or variable annuity contract on which the asset-based or 12b-1 fee is assessed. Relevant for fund-level fee calculations and sub-TA fee arrangements.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 12b-1; Investment Company Act of 1940; FINRA Rule 2341

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service fee payment is subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting requirements. True for most service fee payments to RIAs, TPAs, and broker-dealers that exceed the annual reporting threshold.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRC Section 6041

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The IRS Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the payee on file at the time of payment. Used for 1099 tax reporting and backup withholding determination. May be an EIN for entities or SSN for individual RIAs.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 3406; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this service fee record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks post-creation updates such as status changes, dispute resolutions, or adjustment postings. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

products.name: compensation_contract

Captures contract type, contracted commission schedule references, override entitlements, bonus program eligibility, chargeback terms, advance provisions, effective date, termination date, and contract status. attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bonus or incentive program applicable to this compensation contract. Governs production thresholds, qualification periods, and bonus payout structures.

attributes.name: chargeback_rule_id

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Contracts specify product line eligibility; product_line exists but plan_id FK enables granular product authorization validation, product-specific contract term application, and agent product appointm

products.name: schedule_product_rate
products.description: This association product represents the rate assignment between commission schedules and product plans in the life insurance commission system. It captures product-specific commission rate overrides, effective date ranges, and schedule priority when multiple schedules could apply to the same product. Each record links one commission schedule to one product plan with rate and timing attributes that exist only in the context of this specific schedule-product pairing.. Existence Justification: In life insurance commission management, commission schedules are designed to apply across multiple product plans (e.g., a Career Agent Schedule 2024 covers 50+ products including WL, UL, IUL, VUL, and annuity products), and each product plan can be compensated under multiple commission schedules depending on distribution channel, agent tier, and market segment (e.g., a Term product has separate schedules for career agents, brokers, and IMOs). The business actively manages these schedule-product assignments with product-specific rate overrides, effective date ranges, and priority rankings to handle overlapping schedule applicability.

attributes.name: schedule_product_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this schedule-product rate assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the product plan for which this commission schedule applies with product-specific rate overrides

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Schedule Product Rate - Commission Schedule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commission schedule that defines the base rate structure and compensation rules

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for assigning this commission schedule to this product with these specific rates. Examples: 'New product launch promotion', 'Regulatory compliance adjustment', 'Competitive market positioning', 'Legacy product wind-down'. Used for audit and business analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this schedule-product rate assignment record was created. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commission schedule becomes effective for this specific product plan. Allows different products to adopt the same schedule at different times based on regulatory approval or business rollout strategy.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commission schedule ceases to be effective for this specific product plan. Null indicates the assignment is currently active with no planned end date. Used when products are retired or commission structures are changed.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the compensation analyst who last modified this schedule-product rate assignment. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this schedule-product rate assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Specific product identifier from the Policy Administration System to which this schedule applies. Enables granular schedule assignment at the product level rather than only at the product line level. May be null if the schedule applies to an entire product line. [Moved from commission_schedule: The product_code attribute in commission_schedule appears to link a schedule to a specific product, which contradicts the M:N relationship. If schedules truly apply to multiple products, this attribute should either be removed from commission_schedule or represents a default/primary product. In the M:N model, the specific product linkage is captured in the association via the plan_id FK, making product_code in the schedule table redundant or potentially misleading.]
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST / Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: product_specific_fyc_rate
attributes.description: Product-specific override of the First-Year Commission (FYC) rate for this schedule-product combination. When populated, this rate supersedes the base FYC rate defined in the commission schedule for this particular product. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 60.0000 = 60%). Null indicates the base schedule rate applies.

attributes.name: product_specific_renewal_rate
attributes.description: Product-specific override of the renewal commission rate for this schedule-product combination. When populated, this rate supersedes the base renewal rate defined in the commission schedule for this particular product. Expressed as a percentage. Null indicates the base schedule rate applies.

attributes.name: schedule_priority
attributes.description: The priority rank used to resolve conflicts when multiple commission schedules could apply to the same product for a given agent and distribution channel. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest priority). Used by the commission calculation engine to determine which schedule to apply when overlapping assignments exist.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the compensation analyst who created this schedule-product rate assignment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: schedule_regulatory_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance relationship between commission schedules and state-specific insurance regulations. It captures the state-by-state approval status, effective dates, expiration dates, and variance justifications for each commission schedule operating under each state's regulatory framework. Each record links one commission schedule to one state regulation with compliance tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, commission schedules must obtain regulatory approval from each state jurisdiction where they will be used, and each state regulation governs multiple commission schedules across carriers and product lines. Compliance teams actively manage state-by-state approval status, track effective and expiration dates, document variance justifications, and maintain filing reference numbers for each schedule-state combination. This is an operational compliance tracking relationship, not an analytical correlation.

Captures benefit formula parameters, floor and ceiling values, and IRC 7702 compliance constraints. This is the single source of truth for ALL product benefit definitions — no other product in this domain stores benefit structures or DI benefit parameters.

products.name: premium_rate_table
products.description: SSOT for all actuarially determined premium, cost-of-insurance (COI), and mortality charge rate tables across all product lines. For traditional life products (WL, term): base premium rates per unit segmented by underwriting class, gender, tobacco status, issue age, policy duration, face amount band, and payment mode, with modal factors and flat extra amounts. For universal life products (UL, IUL, VUL): monthly COI rates per $1,000 of net amount at risk (NAR) by attained age, gender, tobacco status, and underwriting class, with guaranteed maximum and current rate schedules. For annuity products: mortality charges and guaranteed annuitization rates. Captures mortality table basis (2001 CSO, 2017 CSO), rate effective dates, table ratings, rate schedule type (guaranteed vs current), and rate band breakpoints. This is the single source of truth for ALL product-level rate data including COI schedules — no other product in this domain stores rate schedules or COI rates.
products.reference: Actuarial Rate Manual / NAIC Rate Filing

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.underwriting_class. Business justification: coi_rate_schedule.underwriting_class is currently a STRING attribute storing class codes. This should be normalized to a FK to the underwriting_class reference table. COI rates vary by underwriting cl

attributes.name: actuarial_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for actuarial comments, assumptions, or special considerations related to this COI rate schedule.

attributes.name: attained_age_max
attributes.description: The maximum attained age (in years) for which this COI rate schedule is applicable.

attributes.name: attained_age_min
attributes.description: The minimum attained age (in years) for which this COI rate schedule is applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this COI rate schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COI rate schedule becomes effective for new policies and in-force policy administration.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COI rate schedule expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates the schedule is currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender classification for which this COI rate schedule applies. Unisex rates are used in jurisdictions prohibiting gender-based pricing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: illustration_usage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COI rate schedule is approved for use in policy illustrations shown to prospective buyers. True if approved for illustrations, false if for internal use only.

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COI rate schedule meets the requirements of IRC Section 7702 for life insurance tax qualification. True if compliant, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_current_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule represents the current COI rates being charged to policyholders. True for current rate schedules, false for guaranteed or historical rates.

attributes.name: is_guaranteed_maximum
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule represents the guaranteed maximum COI rates contractually promised in the policy. True for guaranteed maximum schedules, false for current or other rate types.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this COI rate schedule record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: mortality_table_basis
attributes.description: The actuarial mortality table used as the foundation for this COI rate schedule (e.g., 2001 CSO, 2017 CSO).

attributes.name: profitability_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the expected profitability of policies using this COI rate schedule, used for product management and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplier applied to base mortality rates to derive the final COI rates in this schedule. Used for substandard risk classes or experience-based adjustments.

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The time period basis for the COI rate (monthly, annual, or quarterly). Most universal life products use monthly rates.

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years for which the COI rates in this schedule are guaranteed not to increase, if applicable. Null indicates no guarantee period.

attributes.name: rate_per_thousand_nar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate Per Thousand Net Amount at Risk (NAR)
attributes.description: The monthly COI rate expressed per $1,000 of net amount at risk. This is the core pricing element used in policy administration to calculate monthly COI charges.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this COI rate schedule was retired from active use and is no longer available for new policies. Null indicates the schedule is still active.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Business explanation for why this COI rate schedule was retired (e.g., regulatory change, product discontinuation, experience-based repricing).

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the COI rate schedule, used in policy administration and illustrations.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the COI rate schedule for business users and reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the COI rate schedule indicating whether it represents guaranteed maximum rates, current rates, or rates for specific underwriting classes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: guaranteed_maximum|current|preferred|standard|substandard|smoker|non_smoker — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: state_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state insurance department approved this COI rate schedule for use in that jurisdiction.

attributes.name: state_approval_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the insurance department jurisdiction that approved this COI rate schedule for use.

attributes.name: state_filing_number
attributes.description: The official filing number assigned by the state insurance department for this COI rate schedule approval.

attributes.name: tobacco_status
attributes.description: Tobacco use classification for which this COI rate schedule applies (tobacco user, non-tobacco user, or not applicable).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this COI rate schedule, incremented with each revision or update to the schedule.

products.name: underwriting_class
products.description: SSOT reference catalog of all underwriting risk classification categories used across product plans — preferred plus non-tobacco, preferred non-tobacco, standard plus non-tobacco, standard non-tobacco, preferred tobacco, standard tobacco, and substandard table ratings (Table A through Table P). Captures class code, class name, mortality loading factor, premium loading percentage, eligibility criteria summary, applicable product lines, and effective dates. Governs risk segmentation for premium rating, COI calculation, and reinsurance cession. This is the product domain's SSOT for underwriting class definitions; the underwriting domain references these classes during risk assessment and the reinsurance domain uses them for treaty eligibility.

attributes.name: underwriting_class_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underwriting risk classification category. Primary key.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_actuary_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By Actuary Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Underwriting class definitions require actuarial approval for mortality loading factors and risk classification. Critical for risk management governance, pricing adequacy, and regulatory compliance wi

attributes.name: actual_profit_margin
attributes.description: Actual achieved profit margin percentage for in-force business in this underwriting class, based on most recent financial close. Compared against target margin to assess pricing adequacy and competitive position. Null if insufficient in-force experience. Confidential business metric.
attributes.references: Company Financial Reporting, GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, Internal Management Reporting Standards

attributes.name: age_band_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum issue age (in years) for which this underwriting class is available. Null if no maximum restriction. Preferred classes often have lower maximum ages than standard classes due to underwriting complexity at advanced ages.
attributes.references: Product Filing Documents, Company Underwriting Manual, NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: age_band_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum issue age (in years) for which this underwriting class is available. Null if no minimum restriction. Used to enforce product design rules and underwriting guidelines during new business processing.
attributes.references: Product Filing Documents, Company Underwriting Manual, NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: applicable_product_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product line codes or categories where this underwriting class is available (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, DI). Some classes may be restricted to specific product types based on underwriting complexity or reinsurance treaty terms.
attributes.references: Product Filing Documents, Reinsurance Treaty Schedules, Company Product Catalog

attributes.name: approved_states_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-letter state codes where this underwriting class is approved for use (e.g., CA,NY,TX,FL). Maintained for quick jurisdiction eligibility checks during new business processing and agent quoting.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Approval Letters, NAIC Jurisdictional Database, Company Compliance System

attributes.name: cash_value_accumulation_test_factor
attributes.description: Actuarial factor used in IRC Section 7702 Cash Value Accumulation Test for this underwriting class. Alternative to GPT for determining tax qualification. Used primarily for traditional whole life and universal life products.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702, IRS Revenue Procedure 2005-25, Company Actuarial Tax Compliance Memorandum

attributes.name: class_category
attributes.description: High-level risk category grouping for the underwriting class. Preferred classes represent lowest mortality risk, standard represents average risk, substandard represents elevated risk requiring table ratings, and declined represents uninsurable risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk Classification Guidelines, SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the underwriting class (e.g., PPNT, PNT, SPNT, SNT, PT, ST, TBL-A through TBL-P). Used as the business identifier across policy administration, underwriting, and reinsurance systems.
attributes.references: NAIC Uniform Classification Standards, ACORD Life Insurance Standards

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the underwriting class (e.g., Preferred Plus Non-Tobacco, Standard Tobacco, Table D). Human-readable label used in policy documents, illustrations, and agent-facing systems.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, Company Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this underwriting class record. Used for audit trail, accountability, and regulatory compliance. Typically an actuarial or product management user.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule, Company Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this underwriting class record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance. Immutable after initial insert.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule, Company Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this underwriting class definition became effective for new business. Policies issued on or after this date may use this class. Critical for rate guarantee periods and product filing compliance.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Approval, NAIC Rate Filing Standards, Product Filing Documents

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the health, lifestyle, and risk criteria required to qualify for this underwriting class (e.g., excellent health, no tobacco use, normal BMI, no adverse family history, no hazardous occupations). Detailed criteria maintained in underwriting rules engine; this field provides business-user-facing overview.
attributes.references: Company Underwriting Manual, NAIC Model Unfair Trade Practices Act, MIB Guidelines

attributes.name: experience_study_mortality_ratio
attributes.description: Most recent actual-to-expected mortality ratio from company experience studies for policies in this underwriting class. Ratio less than 1.0 indicates better-than-expected mortality; greater than 1.0 indicates worse. Used for pricing reviews and reserve adequacy testing. Null if insufficient experience data.
attributes.references: SOA Experience Study Standards, NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA), Company Actuarial Experience Study Report

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this underwriting class definition expires and is no longer available for new business. Null for currently active classes. Existing policies continue under original class; this affects new issue only.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Approval, NAIC Rate Filing Standards, Product Retirement Schedule

attributes.name: face_amount_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum death benefit face amount allowed for this underwriting class under automatic underwriting or treaty reinsurance. Amounts above this threshold may require facultative reinsurance or senior underwriter approval. Null if no maximum.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Treaty Agreement, Company Underwriting Authority Limits, NAIC Large Case Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: face_amount_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum death benefit face amount required to qualify for this underwriting class. Expressed in policy currency (typically USD). Preferred classes often require higher minimums to justify underwriting expense. Null if no minimum.
attributes.references: Product Filing Documents, Company Underwriting Manual, Reinsurance Treaty Terms

attributes.name: gender_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this underwriting class has gender-specific mortality assumptions and premium rates. True if separate male/female rates apply; False if unisex or gender-neutral. Some states mandate unisex rating; this flag supports compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Unfair Trade Practices Act, State Unisex Rating Laws, SOA Gender-Distinct Mortality Tables

attributes.name: guideline_premium_test_factor
attributes.description: Actuarial factor used in IRC Section 7702 Guideline Premium Test calculations for this underwriting class. Derived from mortality assumptions and interest rates. Used to determine maximum premium corridor and prevent Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) violations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702, IRS Notice 2009-47, Company Actuarial Tax Compliance Memorandum

attributes.name: inforce_policy_count
attributes.description: Current number of active policies in this underwriting class as of most recent valuation date. Used for experience credibility assessment, reserve calculations, and portfolio risk management. Confidential business metric.
attributes.references: Company Policy Administration System, NAIC Annual Statement Exhibit 5, Internal Management Reporting

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium rates and COI charges for this underwriting class meet IRC Section 7702 definition of life insurance for tax qualification. All classes must be compliant for products to maintain tax-advantaged status. False would trigger immediate remediation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702, IRS Revenue Rulings, Company Tax Qualification Testing Memorandum

attributes.name: last_experience_study_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent actuarial experience study that included mortality analysis for this underwriting class. Experience studies typically performed annually or biennially. Used to assess data recency for pricing and reserving decisions.
attributes.references: SOA Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 23, Company Actuarial Experience Study Policy

attributes.name: mortality_loading_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor applied to base mortality rates for this underwriting class. Preferred classes have factors less than 1.0 (e.g., 0.75), standard classes typically 1.0, substandard classes greater than 1.0 (e.g., Table A = 1.25, Table B = 1.50). Used in actuarial reserve calculations and COI determination.
attributes.references: SOA Valuation Basic Tables (VBT), NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20, Company Actuarial Memorandum

attributes.name: new_business_volume_last_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Business (NB) Policy Count Last Year
attributes.description: Number of new policies issued in this underwriting class during the most recent calendar year. Used to assess class popularity, distribution effectiveness, and underwriting capacity planning. Confidential business metric.
attributes.references: Company New Business Reporting, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule T, Internal Management Reporting

attributes.name: premium_loading_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to base premium rates for this underwriting class. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., -15.00 for preferred discount, +50.00 for Table B surcharge). Used in premium billing calculations and policy illustrations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Rate Filings, NAIC Rate Filing Requirements, Company Pricing Memorandum

attributes.name: principle_based_reserving_category
attributes.description: Risk category assignment for this underwriting class under NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20 Principle-Based Reserving framework. Determines stochastic modeling requirements, deterministic reserve floors, and capital requirements. High-risk classes require more extensive modeling.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20, SOA PBR Practice Note, Company Actuarial Valuation Policy

attributes.name: profitability_target_margin
attributes.description: Target profit margin percentage for new business issued in this underwriting class, expressed as percentage of premium or present value of profits. Used in product pricing, performance monitoring, and strategic planning. Confidential business metric.
attributes.references: Company Pricing Policy, GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, Internal Management Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies issued in this underwriting class are eligible for automatic reinsurance cession under treaty terms. Some substandard classes or experimental classes may require facultative reinsurance or may be retained 100% by the ceding company.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Treaty Agreement, NAIC Reinsurance Model Law, Company Reinsurance Policy

attributes.name: reinsurance_retention_limit
attributes.description: Maximum Net Amount at Risk (NAR) the company will retain for policies in this underwriting class before ceding to reinsurers. Expressed in policy currency (typically USD). Null if class is not reinsurance-eligible or retention varies by treaty.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Treaty Schedule, NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Requirements, Company Reinsurance Manual

attributes.name: state_approval_count
attributes.description: Number of US states (and territories) where this underwriting class has received regulatory approval for use. Life insurance is state-regulated; a class may be approved in some jurisdictions but not others. Used to determine geographic availability.
attributes.references: NAIC State Approval Tracking, State Insurance Department Records, Company Compliance Database

attributes.name: superseded_by_class_code
attributes.description: Class code of the underwriting class that replaced this class, if status is superseded. Used to maintain historical lineage and support policy conversion or re-rating initiatives. Null if class is still active or was withdrawn without replacement.
attributes.references: Company Product Governance Policy, NAIC Rate Filing Requirements, Product Change Management System

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Substandard table rating designation for elevated mortality risk (Table A through Table P, where each letter typically represents 25% mortality loading increment). NONE for standard and preferred classes. Used to calculate premium surcharges and reinsurance cession rates.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual, Reinsurance Treaty Schedules, SOA Table Rating Standards

attributes.name: tobacco_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriting class applies to tobacco users, non-tobacco users, or is tobacco-neutral. Critical for premium rating and Cost of Insurance (COI) calculation. Non-tobacco typically defined as no tobacco use in past 12-36 months per company guidelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation Section 4, IRC Section 7702, Company Underwriting Manual

attributes.name: underwriting_class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the underwriting class. Active classes are available for new business. Pending approval classes are filed but awaiting state approval. Inactive/withdrawn classes are no longer offered. Superseded classes have been replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements, Company Product Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this underwriting class record. Used for audit trail, change management, and regulatory compliance. Updated on each modification.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule, Company Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this underwriting class record was last modified. Updated on any change to class attributes, status, or configuration. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization across systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Model Audit Rule, Company Data Governance Policy

products.name: state_approval
products.description: SSOT for the full regulatory filing, document workflow, and approval lifecycle for each product plan version across all US states and territories. Covers the complete workflow from initial filing preparation through state-level approval: filing reference number, SERFF tracking number, filing type (new product, rate revision, form amendment), submitted forms list, actuarial memorandum reference, filing date, target states, filing status, objection history, DOI examiner correspondence, approval correspondence, and document workflow tracking. Tracks per-state approval outcomes: state code, approval date, approval number, form number, effective date in state, and withdrawal date. Supports NAIC state filing coordination, SEC filings for variable products, and DOI examination responses. Governs which product plans can be sold in each jurisdiction and enforces distribution channel compliance. This is the single source of truth for ALL product regulatory filing and approval data — no other product in this domain stores filing metadata or approval records.
products.reference: NAIC State Filing / SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing)

attributes.name: plan_version_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: State approvals for insurance products are driven by specific regulatory obligations (e.g., NAIC model law requirements, state-specific filing mandates). The state_approval product currently lacks a d

attributes.name: actuarial_memorandum_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the actuarial memorandum supporting this filing, including rate justification, reserve adequacy, and compliance with state actuarial standards.

attributes.name: approval_conditions
attributes.description: Any special conditions, requirements, or stipulations imposed by the state DOI as part of the approval. Must be satisfied for continued sale in the jurisdiction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the state Department of Insurance officially approved the product filing for this jurisdiction. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Official approval number or reference issued by the state DOI upon approval. Used for compliance documentation and audit trails.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state approval record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_restrictions
attributes.description: State-specific restrictions on which distribution channels (career agents, brokers, banks, direct-to-consumer) are permitted to sell this product in this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: doi_examiner_correspondence
attributes.description: Reference to all correspondence exchanged with the state DOI examiner, including information requests, clarifications, and responses. Links to document management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the approved product plan becomes effective and available for sale in this state jurisdiction. May differ from approval date based on state requirements.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the filing was officially submitted to the state Department of Insurance (DOI) or SERFF system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the filing lifecycle.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: Internal company reference number assigned to this regulatory filing for tracking and correspondence purposes.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory filing across all target states. Tracks the overall workflow from preparation through final disposition. attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory filing indicating the nature of the submission: new product introduction, rate revision, form amendment, rider addition, benefit modification, or product withdrawal.

attributes.name: finra_review_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires FINRA advertising and sales material review due to variable product features and broker-dealer distribution.

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: State-assigned form number for the approved policy form, rider, or rate schedule. Required for policy issuance and compliance verification.

attributes.name: free_look_period_days
attributes.description: State-mandated free look or right to examine period in days during which the policyholder can cancel for a full refund. Varies by state and product type.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: State-mandated grace period in days for premium payment before policy lapse. Typically 30-31 days but may vary by state regulation.

attributes.name: illustration_actuary_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether state regulations require actuarial certification of policy illustrations for this product. Applies to products with non-guaranteed elements.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Illustrations Model Regulation

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliance_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Compliance Confirmed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product design has been confirmed to meet IRC Section 7702 life insurance tax qualification requirements. Critical for tax-advantaged treatment.

attributes.name: maximum_face_amount
attributes.description: State-approved maximum death benefit or face amount for this product in this jurisdiction. May be limited by state capacity or regulatory constraints.

attributes.name: maximum_issue_age
attributes.description: State-approved maximum age at which this product can be issued in this jurisdiction. Enforces state-specific age requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_face_amount
attributes.description: State-approved minimum death benefit or face amount for this product in this jurisdiction. Enforces state-specific product design requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_issue_age
attributes.description: State-approved minimum age at which this product can be issued in this jurisdiction. Enforces state-specific age requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next regulatory review or rate filing update required by the state. Used for compliance calendar and proactive filing management.

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_options_approved
attributes.description: State-approved nonforfeiture options available to policyholders upon lapse or surrender, including cash surrender value (CSV), reduced paid-up insurance, and extended term insurance.

attributes.name: objection_history
attributes.description: Narrative log of all objections, questions, or concerns raised by the state DOI examiner during the review process, including dates and resolution status.

attributes.name: policy_loan_provisions_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether state-approved policy loan provisions are included in this product for this jurisdiction. True if policy loans are available per state requirements.

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months for which premium rates are guaranteed as approved by the state. Applicable to term life and other products with rate guarantee provisions.

attributes.name: replacement_regulations_apply
attributes.description: Indicates whether state replacement regulations apply to this product, requiring specific disclosures and procedures when replacing existing coverage.

attributes.name: sec_filing_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Filing Reference
attributes.description: SEC filing reference number for variable products requiring securities registration. Null for non-variable products not subject to SEC oversight.

attributes.name: sec_filing_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Filing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires SEC registration and filing due to variable product features (VUL, variable annuities). True for variable products subject to securities regulation.

attributes.name: serff_tracking_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) Tracking Number
attributes.description: NAIC SERFF system tracking number assigned when the filing is submitted through the electronic filing portal. Used for multi-state coordination and DOI communication.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code where this approval applies. Each state approval record represents one jurisdiction's approval outcome.

attributes.name: state_specific_exclusions
attributes.description: State-mandated or state-specific policy exclusions, limitations, or restrictions that differ from the base product design. Critical for policy administration compliance.

attributes.name: state_specific_riders_approved
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of optional riders and benefits approved for attachment to this product in this state, including form numbers and effective dates.

attributes.name: submitted_forms_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all policy forms, riders, rate schedules, and amendments included in this filing submission. References document management system for full form text.

attributes.name: target_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all US state and territory codes where this filing was submitted. Used for multi-state filing coordination and tracking.

attributes.name: underwriting_class_restrictions
attributes.description: State-specific restrictions or requirements on underwriting classes, rate bands, or risk classification methods approved for this product in this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state approval record was last modified. Tracks changes to filing status, approval outcomes, and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was withdrawn from sale in this state, either voluntarily by the company or mandated by the state DOI. Null if still active.
