attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the executive or product management authority who approved the retirement decision. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the product plan being retired. Enables version-level retirement tracking.

attributes.name: retirement_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product plan being retired. Links to the master product plan catalog.

attributes.name: retirement_replacement_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the successor product plan that replaces this retired product. Supports product migration analysis and sales transition planning.

attributes.name: agent_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when distribution partners and agents were formally notified of the product retirement. Critical for managing sales pipeline and commission expectations.
attributes.references: FINRA Suitability Standards, Internal Distribution Standards

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the product retirement was officially announced to internal stakeholders, distribution channels, and regulatory authorities. Critical for compliance timeline tracking.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the retirement decision was formally approved by authorized management. Critical audit trail element for governance and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Governance Standards

attributes.name: closed_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the retired product in-force block is designated as a closed block for actuarial and financial reporting purposes. Critical for GAAP and Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: closed_block_transition_date
attributes.description: Date when the in-force block formally transitions to closed block status for actuarial valuation and asset segregation purposes. Relevant for demutualization and block management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Closed Block Guidance

attributes.name: communication_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document location for the stakeholder communication plan governing retirement announcements to agents, policyholders, regulators, and internal teams.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created this retirement record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this product retirement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specification of distribution channels from which the product is being withdrawn (e.g., career agents, independent brokers, direct-to-consumer). Supports selective channel retirement strategies.

attributes.name: effective_retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the product retirement becomes fully effective and the product is formally closed to new business across all channels and jurisdictions.

attributes.name: inforce_continuation_policy
attributes.description: Strategy for managing existing in-force policies after retirement. Defines service level, administrative approach, and block management methodology for the closed book of business.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Closed Block Management

attributes.name: inforce_face_amount_at_retirement
attributes.description: Total face amount (death benefit) of all in-force policies at retirement execution. Measured in USD. Critical for risk exposure and reserve adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: inforce_policy_count_at_retirement
attributes.description: Number of active policies in force at the time of retirement execution. Snapshot metric for closed block sizing and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: inforce_reserve_amount_at_retirement
attributes.description: Total statutory reserves held for the in-force block at retirement execution. Measured in USD. Supports closed block financial tracking and Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles, Valuation Manual

attributes.name: last_new_business_date
attributes.description: Final date on which new applications for this product plan can be issued. After this date, no new policies may be written. Critical for sales cutoff enforcement and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who most recently modified this retirement record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this product retirement record was most recently modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or operational notes related to the retirement. Supports knowledge transfer and operational continuity.

attributes.name: profitability_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Summary of the expected financial and profitability impact of the retirement decision, including New Business Value (NBV) loss, expense savings, and capital relief considerations.

attributes.name: reason_category
attributes.description: Primary business driver for the product retirement decision. High-level categorization for strategic analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: reason_detail
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the specific circumstances, business rationale, and strategic considerations driving the retirement decision. Supports actuarial and management reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory authority granted approval for the product retirement. Null if approval was not required or is still pending.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit regulatory approval is required before executing the retirement. Certain jurisdictions or product types may require prior approval for market withdrawal.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for regulatory filings submitted to state insurance departments notifying them of the product retirement. Supports audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether state insurance department filings or notifications are required for this product retirement. Drives compliance workflow and filing obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: reinsurance_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product retirement affects existing reinsurance treaties or requires treaty amendments. Critical for reinsurance administration and recoverables management.

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty or treaties affected by this product retirement. Supports coordination with reinsurance partners and treaty administration.

attributes.name: retirement_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the retirement event. Used for tracking and reporting purposes across systems.

attributes.name: retirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product retirement. Tracks progression from announcement through execution.

attributes.name: retirement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the retirement approach. Distinguishes between complete discontinuation, selective market withdrawal, or channel-specific restrictions.

attributes.name: state_withdrawal_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state jurisdictions from which the product is being withdrawn. Supports partial market exit scenarios where retirement is state-specific rather than nationwide.

products.name: profitability_assumption
products.description: Stores the product-level profitability and pricing assumptions used in actuarial pricing studies and NBV (New Business Value) calculations, including target internal rate of return (IRR), target return on equity (ROE), lapse rate assumptions by policy year, mortality improvement assumptions, expense loading factors, investment yield assumptions, DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) amortization basis, and pricing mortality table. Captures assumption set version, pricing actuary sign-off, and effective date. Supports product profitability tracking and repricing decisions.
products.reference: Actuarial Pricing Memorandum / GAAP ASC 944 / LDTI

attributes.name: profitability_assumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profitability assumption set record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created this profitability assumption record.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity product for which these profitability assumptions apply.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Profitability assumptions are version-specific pricing inputs (target IRR, lapse rates, expense loadings). Each version is priced with specific assumptions. The assumption_set_version and effective_da

attributes.name: superseded_by_assumption_profitability_assumption_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profitability assumption set that supersedes this version, enabling version lineage tracking; nullable if this is the current active version.

attributes.name: acquisition_expense_per_policy
attributes.description: Assumed per-policy acquisition expense amount covering underwriting, medical exams, agent commissions, and policy issuance costs.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the profitability assumption set was formally approved by the pricing actuary and management for use in pricing studies.

attributes.name: approved_by_role
attributes.description: Role or title of the individual or committee that approved the profitability assumption set, such as Chief Actuary, Pricing Committee, or Product Development Officer.

attributes.name: assumption_basis_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the basis for the profitability assumptions, including data sources, experience studies, industry benchmarks, and judgment factors applied.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 56 - Modeling; ASOP No. 41 - Actuarial Communications

attributes.name: assumption_category
attributes.description: Classification of the assumption set purpose: pricing for new products, repricing for existing products, experience study analysis, valuation, strategic planning, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: assumption_set_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the profitability assumption set, used in actuarial pricing studies and New Business Value (NBV) calculations.

attributes.name: assumption_set_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the profitability assumption set for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: assumption_set_version
attributes.description: Version number of the assumption set, tracking revisions and updates to pricing assumptions over time.

attributes.name: assumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profitability assumption set: draft (under development), approved (ready for use), active (currently in use), superseded (replaced by newer version), or retired (no longer valid).

attributes.name: commission_rate_renewal_percent
attributes.description: Assumed renewal commission rate percentage paid to agents or brokers on renewal premiums in subsequent policy years.

attributes.name: commission_rate_year_1_percent
attributes.description: Assumed first-year commission rate percentage paid to agents or brokers on new business premium, used in profitability calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profitability assumption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dac_amortization_basis
attributes.description: Method used for amortizing Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) under GAAP: premium-based, gross profit-based, benefit ratio method, or level amortization.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: dac_amortization_period_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) Amortization Period in Years
attributes.description: Number of years over which Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) are amortized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: Discount rate percentage used to calculate present value of future cash flows in New Business Value (NBV) and profitability metrics, typically aligned with cost of capital or hurdle rate.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this profitability assumption set becomes effective for pricing and New Business Value (NBV) calculations.

attributes.name: expense_loading_percent
attributes.description: Percentage loading factor applied to premiums to cover acquisition, maintenance, and overhead expenses in the pricing model.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this profitability assumption set is no longer valid for new pricing studies; nullable for open-ended assumption sets.

attributes.name: investment_yield_assumption_percent
attributes.description: Assumed annual investment yield percentage on general account assets backing policy reserves, reflecting expected portfolio returns net of defaults and investment expenses.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 7 - Analysis of Life, Health, or Property/Casualty Insurer Cash Flows; Asset Liability Management (ALM) Standards

attributes.name: lapse_rate_ultimate_percent
attributes.description: Assumed ultimate policy lapse rate percentage for policy years beyond year 10, representing long-term steady-state lapse behavior.

attributes.name: lapse_rate_year_1_percent
attributes.description: Assumed policy lapse rate percentage for the first policy year, reflecting expected voluntary terminations and surrenders during the initial period.

attributes.name: lapse_rate_year_2_5_percent
attributes.description: Assumed policy lapse rate percentage for policy years 2 through 5, capturing early-duration lapse behavior after the initial year.

attributes.name: lapse_rate_year_6_10_percent
attributes.description: Assumed policy lapse rate percentage for policy years 6 through 10, reflecting mid-duration persistency patterns.

attributes.name: last_updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who most recently modified this profitability assumption record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profitability assumption record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: maintenance_expense_per_policy
attributes.description: Assumed annual per-policy maintenance expense amount covering policy servicing, billing, customer service, and administrative overhead.

attributes.name: mortality_improvement_assumption
attributes.description: Description of mortality improvement assumptions applied over the projection period, including improvement scale references such as Scale G2, Scale AA, or custom improvement factors.
attributes.references: SOA Mortality Improvement Scales; ASOP No. 56

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context regarding the profitability assumption set, including special considerations or limitations.

attributes.name: peer_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the profitability assumption set underwent peer review by a qualified actuary independent of the pricing team.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 41 - Actuarial Communications; Internal Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: pricing_actuary_credential
attributes.description: Professional actuarial credential of the pricing actuary: Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA), Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS), Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA), Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS), Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA), or Fellow of the Institute of Actuaries (FIA).
attributes.references: SOA Credentialing Standards; AAA Qualification Standards

attributes.name: pricing_actuary_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified actuary responsible for developing and signing off on the profitability assumption set.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 41 - Actuarial Communications; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: pricing_mortality_table
attributes.description: Name of the mortality table used for pricing assumptions, such as 2017 Commissioners Standard Ordinary (CSO), Society of Actuaries (SOA) tables, or company-specific experience tables.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-20); SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: reinsurance_allowance_percent
attributes.description: Assumed reinsurance allowance percentage received from reinsurers to offset ceded acquisition and maintenance expenses.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_percent
attributes.description: Assumed percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under quota share or coinsurance treaties, impacting net retained profitability.

attributes.name: sensitivity_test_performed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether sensitivity testing was performed on key assumptions to assess profitability variability under alternative scenarios.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 56 - Modeling; Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA)

attributes.name: target_irr_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Percentage
attributes.description: Target internal rate of return percentage used in product pricing to achieve desired profitability hurdle rates for new business.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 56 - Modeling; Corporate Finance Standards

attributes.name: target_roe_percent
attributes.description: Target return on equity percentage used in pricing to ensure adequate returns relative to required capital under Risk-Based Capital (RBC) and Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) frameworks.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Framework; ASOP No. 56

attributes.name: tax_rate_percent
attributes.description: Assumed corporate income tax rate percentage applied to pre-tax profits in New Business Value (NBV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR) calculations.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Count of pricing studies or New Business Value (NBV) calculations that have utilized this profitability assumption set, supporting impact analysis and assumption governance.

products.name: separate_account_fund
products.description: Master catalog of separate account investment funds available within variable universal life (VUL) and variable annuity products, including fund name, fund code, fund family, investment objective, asset class, benchmark index, fund manager, expense ratio (M&E charge), minimum and maximum allocation percentage, fund availability by product plan, and SEC registration number. Captures fund status (active, closed to new allocations, liquidating) and prospectus reference. Governs VUL and variable annuity sub-account investment options.
products.reference: SEC Investment Company Act / FINRA Variable Product Fund Disclosure / ACORD Fund Catalog

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Primary key for separate_account_fund

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Variable annuity separate account funds require dedicated GL structure per SAP rules (separate account assets/liabilities reported off-balance-sheet). Essential for statutory Annual Statement Exhibit

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that created this fund record, used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: fund_manager_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Fund managers are external asset management vendors. Critical for vendor due diligence, performance monitoring, fee negotiation, and regulatory oversight of separate account investment options. Role p

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific variable universal life or variable annuity product plan for which this fund is available as an investment option.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Separate account fund availability can change between product versions (new funds added, funds closed). Each version may offer different fund lineups. The effective_date, termination_date, and closed_

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class category of the fund's investment holdings, used for portfolio diversification analysis and asset allocation modeling.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is currently available for policyholder selection within variable products. Restricted funds may be available only to existing investors; discontinued funds are closed to all new and additional investments.

attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: Market index used as the performance benchmark for the fund (e.g., S&P 500, Russell 2000, Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate Bond Index), against which fund returns are measured.

attributes.name: closed_to_new_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund was closed to new allocations while continuing to service existing investments. Used to track fund capacity management decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this fund record was first created in the separate account fund catalog.

attributes.name: cusip
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) Number
attributes.description: Nine-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the fund for securities trading and settlement purposes.

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is eligible for automatic dollar cost averaging programs where systematic transfers are made from a stable value fund into this investment option over time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this fund became available for selection within the company's variable product separate accounts.

attributes.name: expense_ratio_percent
attributes.description: Annual fund operating expense ratio expressed as a percentage of average net assets, representing the cost charged to policyholders for fund management, administrative services, and other operational expenses.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the separate account fund across all systems and product lines. Used as the operational identifier for fund selection and allocation processing.

attributes.name: fund_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the fund's investment strategy, holdings, risk profile, and suitability for different investor types. Used in policyholder communications and prospectus materials.

attributes.name: fund_family
attributes.description: Name of the investment management company or fund family that manages the separate account fund (e.g., Fidelity, Vanguard, BlackRock, PIMCO).

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the separate account investment fund as registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and disclosed in product prospectuses.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the separate account fund indicating availability for new allocations and existing account management. Active funds accept new investments; closed funds maintain existing positions but accept no new money; liquidating funds are winding down.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund was first established and began operations, used for calculating fund age and historical performance metrics.

attributes.name: investment_objective
attributes.description: Primary investment goal of the fund as stated in the prospectus, describing the fund's strategy and target outcomes (e.g., long-term capital appreciation, current income, capital preservation).

attributes.name: investment_style
attributes.description: Investment management style or approach employed by the fund manager, indicating whether the fund follows active management, passive indexing, growth-oriented, or value-oriented strategies.

attributes.name: last_updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that most recently modified this fund record, used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this fund record was most recently modified, used for change tracking and data quality auditing.

attributes.name: maximum_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of total account value that may be allocated to this fund, used to enforce diversification limits and manage concentration risk in policyholder portfolios.

attributes.name: maximum_transfers_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfers allowed into or out of this fund within a calendar year, enforced to prevent excessive trading and market timing.

attributes.name: minimum_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of total account value that must be allocated to this fund if the policyholder chooses to invest in it. Used to enforce diversification requirements and operational minimums.

attributes.name: minimum_initial_investment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount required for the initial allocation to this fund when a policyholder first selects it as an investment option.

attributes.name: morningstar_category
attributes.description: Morningstar fund classification category used for peer group comparison and performance benchmarking (e.g., Large Blend, Intermediate Bond, Foreign Large Growth).

attributes.name: morningstar_rating
attributes.description: Morningstar's proprietary star rating for the fund (1-5 stars), based on risk-adjusted returns relative to peer funds. Used for fund selection and marketing materials.

attributes.name: mortality_expense_charge_percent
attributes.description: Mortality and expense risk charge assessed by the insurance company on variable product separate account values, covering insurance guarantees and administrative costs. Expressed as an annual percentage of account value.

attributes.name: nav_calculation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the fund's net asset value per unit is calculated and published, determining how often policyholder account values are updated.

attributes.name: performance_inception_date
attributes.description: Date from which fund performance is calculated and reported. May differ from fund inception date if the fund underwent reorganization or name change.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is available for Variable Universal Life (VUL) products, variable annuity products, or both product lines.

attributes.name: prospectus_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the current fund prospectus, indicating when the disclosed fund information was last updated and filed with the SEC.

attributes.name: prospectus_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document location for the fund prospectus, which contains detailed investment objectives, risks, fees, and performance information required by SEC regulations.

attributes.name: rebalancing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund can be included in automatic portfolio rebalancing programs that periodically adjust allocations back to target percentages.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the fund's investment risk level based on volatility, asset allocation, and investment strategy. Used for suitability analysis and investor education.

attributes.name: sec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: SEC registration number assigned to the investment company or fund, used for regulatory tracking and compliance reporting. Format: 811-XXXXX.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund was removed from availability or ceased operations. Null for active funds.

attributes.name: ticker_symbol
attributes.description: Stock market ticker symbol for the fund, used for public market identification and price quotation.

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund has restrictions on the frequency or timing of transfers in and out, used to prevent market timing abuse and protect long-term investors.

products.name: expense_charge
products.description: Defines all expense charges embedded within product plans — premium load percentages, per-policy administrative fees, per-unit expense charges, mortality and expense (M&E) risk charges for variable products, fund management fees, and surrender processing fees. Captures charge type, charge basis (percentage of premium, flat dollar, per $1,000 face), guaranteed maximum charge, current charge, and effective dates. Supports policy illustration compliance and in-force expense charge administration.
products.reference: NAIC Life Insurance Cost Disclosure / ACORD Expense Charge Definition

attributes.name: expense_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product expense charge record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this expense charge record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product plan to which this expense charge applies. Links to the product catalog.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Product expense charges (premium loads, admin fees) are version-specific. Expense charge changes may trigger new versions. The charge_version_number and predecessor_charge_id suggest version-level tra

attributes.name: predecessor_charge_expense_charge_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous version of this charge configuration that this record supersedes. Null for initial charge configurations. Enables version history tracking.

attributes.name: applicable_product_line
attributes.description: The product line category to which this expense charge applies. Certain charges are specific to product types (e.g., M&E charges only apply to variable products). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_life|universal_life|indexed_universal_life|variable_universal_life|term_life|fixed_annuity|variable_annuity|fixed_indexed_annuity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for creating this charge version. Examples include regulatory requirement, competitive positioning, profitability improvement, or product enhancement.

attributes.name: charge_basis
attributes.description: Defines how the charge amount is calculated. Percentage of premium applies a rate to premium payments; flat dollar is a fixed amount; per thousand face applies a rate per $1,000 of coverage; percentage of account value or fund value applies to variable and indexed products.

attributes.name: charge_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying the specific expense charge type within the product. Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the expense charge purpose, calculation methodology, and applicability conditions. Used for compliance documentation and customer disclosure.

attributes.name: charge_frequency
attributes.description: Defines how often the charge is assessed. One-time charges apply at policy issue or specific events; periodic charges apply on a recurring schedule; per-transaction charges apply each time a specific action occurs.

attributes.name: charge_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the expense charge for display in policy illustrations, statements, and administrative systems.

attributes.name: charge_timing
attributes.description: Specifies when within the frequency period the charge is assessed. In advance means charged before the coverage period; in arrears means charged after; at transaction means charged when event occurs.

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expense charge category. Premium load applies to incoming premiums; policy fee is a flat administrative charge; per unit charge applies per thousand of face amount; mortality and expense (M&E) charges apply to variable products; fund management fees cover investment administration; surrender charges apply upon policy termination.

attributes.name: charge_version_number
attributes.description: Version number tracking changes to this charge configuration over time. Increments with each modification to rates, basis, or structure. Supports audit trail and historical analysis.

attributes.name: competitive_benchmark_rate
attributes.description: Industry competitive benchmark rate for this charge type, used for pricing strategy and market positioning analysis. Confidential competitive intelligence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this expense charge record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_charge_rate
attributes.description: The actual charge rate currently being applied to in-force policies. Must be less than or equal to the guaranteed maximum charge rate. Subject to change based on company discretion within guaranteed limits.

attributes.name: dac_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is considered in Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) calculations for financial reporting under GAAP and LDTI standards. True for charges that offset acquisition expenses.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this expense charge configuration becomes active for new business and, if applicable, in-force policy updates. Must align with product plan effective dates and regulatory approval.

attributes.name: expense_charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this expense charge configuration. Active means currently in use; pending approval means awaiting regulatory or internal approval; superseded means replaced by newer version; retired means no longer applicable to any policies.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this expense charge configuration is superseded or retired. Null indicates the charge is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: filing_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the state insurance department approved this charge structure for use. Must precede the effective date.

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: The state insurance department filing reference number under which this charge structure was approved. Required for audit and regulatory examination purposes.

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_percentage
attributes.description: For surrender charges, the percentage of account value that can be withdrawn annually without incurring surrender charges. Commonly 10% for annuities. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).
attributes.references: Product Design Standard, NAIC Annuity Suitability Standard

attributes.name: gaap_revenue_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Revenue Classification
attributes.description: Classification of this charge for GAAP financial statement revenue recognition. Determines how the charge is reported in income statements under ASC 944 and LDTI.

attributes.name: guaranteed_charge_rate
attributes.description: The maximum charge rate guaranteed in the policy contract that cannot be exceeded regardless of company experience. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5.00%) or dollar amount depending on charge basis. Critical for IRC Section 7702 compliance and policy illustration.

attributes.name: illustration_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this charge must be explicitly disclosed in policy illustrations and sales materials. True for charges material to policy performance projections.

attributes.name: illustration_display_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the order in which charges are displayed in policy illustrations and fee schedules. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge structure meets IRC Section 7702 requirements for life insurance tax qualification. Critical for ensuring policy death benefits remain income-tax-free.

attributes.name: last_updated_by_user
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Updated By User Identifier
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that most recently modified this expense charge record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this expense charge record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: maximum_charge_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount that can be assessed for this charge in a single assessment period. Used to cap charges on high-premium or high-face-amount policies.

attributes.name: minimum_charge_amount
attributes.description: The minimum dollar amount that will be assessed for this charge, regardless of calculated amount. Commonly used for policy fees to ensure administrative cost recovery.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special instructions, or business notes related to this expense charge configuration. Used for operational documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: profitability_target_margin
attributes.description: The target profit margin this charge is designed to achieve, expressed as a percentage. Used in product pricing, profitability analysis, and experience studies. Confidential business metric.

attributes.name: reinsurance_ceded_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a portion of this charge is ceded to reinsurers under treaty agreements. True means reinsurance expense allowances or ceding commissions apply.

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this specific charge configuration applies. Used when state_variation_indicator is true. Null indicates charge applies to all states where product is approved.

attributes.name: state_variation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this charge has state-specific variations due to regulatory requirements or filing approvals. True means charge rates or structures differ by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: statutory_accounting_treatment
attributes.description: Classification of this charge for statutory accounting and NAIC Annual Statement reporting. Determines the line item in the statutory financial statement where this charge is reported.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: surrender_charge_duration_years
attributes.description: The number of policy years during which surrender charges apply. After this period, no surrender charges are assessed. Commonly ranges from 5 to 15 years for annuities and universal life products.

attributes.name: surrender_charge_schedule_type
attributes.description: For surrender charges, defines the pattern of charge reduction over time. Level means constant rate; declining means gradual reduction; step means discrete reductions at intervals; none means no surrender charge applies.

attributes.name: waiver_conditions
attributes.description: Business rules defining circumstances under which the charge is waived. Examples include waiver upon death, disability, nursing home confinement, or Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) withdrawals for annuities.

products.name: suitability_rule
products.description: Defines product-level suitability and best-interest compliance rules under NAIC Model 275 (Suitability in Annuity Transactions), Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI), and DOL fiduciary standards. Captures minimum suitability criteria (age, income, net worth, risk tolerance, investment horizon, liquidity needs), product complexity classification, required disclosure documents, best-interest obligation level, and state-specific rule overrides. These are product-configuration rules that define what suitability checks must pass before a product can be recommended — distinct from the compliance domain's transaction-level suitability evaluation records. Governs point-of-sale compliance for annuity and life product recommendations.
products.reference: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation 275 / DOL Fiduciary Rule / SEC Regulation Best Interest

attributes.name: suitability_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product suitability rule record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the compliance officer or authority who approved this suitability rule.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity product to which this suitability rule applies. Links to the product catalog.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Product suitability rules can change between versions (age limits, income requirements, complexity classification). Each version may have different suitability requirements. The rule_version_number an

attributes.name: predecessor_rule_suitability_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous version of this suitability rule that this version supersedes. Enables rule lineage tracking.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this suitability rule was approved by compliance or legal authority for implementation.

attributes.name: best_interest_obligation_level
attributes.description: The level of care and diligence standard required when recommending this product. Determines the depth of analysis and documentation required.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation Best Interest, DOL Fiduciary Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suitability rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this suitability rule becomes effective and must be applied to product recommendations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this suitability rule expires or is superseded by a new version. Null if the rule is currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: investment_experience_required
attributes.description: Minimum level of investment experience or financial sophistication required for the customer to be suitable for this product. Relevant for variable and indexed products.

attributes.name: investment_objective_alignment
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of customer investment objectives that align with this product (e.g., INCOME|GROWTH|PRESERVATION|LEGACY). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INCOME|GROWTH|PRESERVATION|LEGACY|TAX_DEFERRAL|ESTATE_PLANNING|RETIREMENT_INCOME — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suitability rule record was last modified.

attributes.name: liquidity_needs_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal assessment of the customer's liquidity needs is required before recommending this product. True for products with significant surrender charges or restricted access.

attributes.name: maximum_age
attributes.description: Maximum age of the customer for this product to be considered suitable. Part of age-based suitability criteria.

attributes.name: maximum_premium_as_percent_of_income
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Premium as Percentage of Income
attributes.description: Maximum allowable premium payment as a percentage of the customer's annual income for suitability purposes. Prevents over-commitment of resources.

attributes.name: maximum_premium_as_percent_of_net_worth
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Premium as Percentage of Net Worth
attributes.description: Maximum allowable premium payment as a percentage of the customer's net worth for suitability purposes. Particularly relevant for single-premium annuities.

attributes.name: minimum_age
attributes.description: Minimum age of the customer for this product to be considered suitable. Part of age-based suitability criteria.

attributes.name: minimum_annual_income
attributes.description: Minimum annual income threshold required for the customer to meet suitability criteria for this product. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: minimum_investment_horizon_years
attributes.description: Minimum investment time horizon in years required for suitability. Critical for products with surrender charges or long-term accumulation features.

attributes.name: minimum_liquid_net_worth
attributes.description: Minimum liquid net worth (assets easily convertible to cash) required for suitability. Critical for annuity products with surrender charges. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: minimum_net_worth
attributes.description: Minimum net worth threshold required for the customer to meet suitability criteria for this product. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: product_complexity_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the product complexity level for suitability assessment purposes. Determines the depth of suitability analysis required.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The primary regulatory framework or standard that mandates this suitability rule. Determines the compliance obligation level.
attributes.references: NAIC Model 275, SEC Regulation Best Interest, DOL Fiduciary Rule, FINRA Rule 2111

attributes.name: replacement_transaction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suitability rule applies specifically to replacement transactions (1035 exchanges or policy replacements), which have heightened suitability requirements.

attributes.name: required_disclosure_documents
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of disclosure document codes that must be provided to the customer before sale (e.g., prospectus, buyer's guide, product illustration, Form CRS).
attributes.references: NAIC Model 275, SEC Reg BI, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: risk_tolerance_required
attributes.description: The minimum risk tolerance profile required for the customer to be suitable for this product. Aligns with customer risk assessment.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying this suitability rule configuration. Used for operational reference and system integration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model 275, Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI)

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the suitability rule, including the business rationale and compliance requirements it addresses.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the suitability rule for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes providing additional context, implementation guidance, or special considerations for this suitability rule.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the suitability rule. Determines whether the rule is actively enforced in point-of-sale systems.

attributes.name: rule_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this suitability rule configuration. Incremented when rule parameters are updated to maintain audit trail.

attributes.name: senior_investor_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enhanced suitability protections for senior investors (typically age 65+) apply to this product under state or federal regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model 275, State Senior Protection Laws

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for which this suitability rule applies. Allows for state-specific rule overrides to comply with varying state regulations.

attributes.name: state_specific_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule represents a state-specific override of the default national suitability rule for the product.

attributes.name: suitability_questionnaire_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal suitability questionnaire must be completed and documented before recommending this product.

attributes.name: supervisory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supervisory or managerial approval is required before finalizing the sale of this product based on its complexity or risk profile.

attributes.name: tax_status_eligibility
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of customer tax status categories for which this product is suitable (e.g., QUALIFIED|NON_QUALIFIED|IRA|ROTH_IRA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALIFIED|NON_QUALIFIED|IRA|ROTH_IRA|401K|403B|SEP|SIMPLE — promote to reference product]

products.name: rate_action
products.description: Tracks in-force rate actions applied to existing product blocks — COI rate changes, credited interest rate adjustments, expense charge modifications, and dividend scale changes. Captures action type, effective date, impacted product plan and version, regulatory filing reference, actuarial justification, advance notice period, state notification requirements, and policyholder communication plan. Records the business event of a rate action distinct from the static rate schedule definition.
products.reference: NAIC In-Force Rate Action Guidelines / State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product rate action event. Primary key for this table.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who initiated this rate action. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product plan affected by this rate action. Links to the product plan master.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific plan version affected by this rate action. Links to the plan version master.

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_rate_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous rate action that this action supersedes or modifies. Null if this is the first rate action for the product block.

attributes.name: actuarial_justification
attributes.description: Detailed actuarial rationale and supporting analysis for the rate action. Includes references to experience studies, mortality trends, expense analysis, or investment performance that justify the change.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum Regulation, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements

attributes.name: actuarial_memorandum_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the formal actuarial memorandum supporting this rate action. Links to document management system.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum Regulation

attributes.name: advance_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice provided to policyholders before the rate action becomes effective. Required by state regulations and policy contracts.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, NAIC Model Regulation XXX

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate action was announced to internal stakeholders, distribution channels, and policyholders.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate action was approved by the state insurance department or regulatory authority. Null if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: approved_by_authority
attributes.description: Name of the state insurance department or regulatory authority that approved this rate action. May include multiple jurisdictions for multi-state filings.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who provided internal approval for this rate action. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: average_rate_change_percent
attributes.description: Average percentage change in rates across all affected policies. Positive values indicate increases, negative values indicate decreases. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5.00% increase).

attributes.name: communication_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to communicate the rate action to policyholders. May include direct mail, email, policy statement insert, agent notification, website posting, or multiple channels.

attributes.name: communication_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when policyholder communications regarding this rate action were sent or initiated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate action record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate action becomes effective and applies to in-force policies. Critical for policy administration and billing systems.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation XXX, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate action was filed with the state insurance department or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Filing Requirements, NAIC SERFF System

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Official filing number assigned by the state insurance department or regulatory authority for this rate action. Used for compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Filing Requirements, NAIC SERFF System

attributes.name: financial_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated annual financial impact of this rate action on company revenues or expenses. Expressed in USD. Positive values indicate revenue increase or expense decrease, negative values indicate revenue decrease or expense increase.

attributes.name: guaranteed_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new rates established by this action are guaranteed (cannot be changed further) or non-guaranteed (subject to future adjustment). True if guaranteed, False if non-guaranteed.

attributes.name: impacted_face_amount_total
attributes.description: Total face amount (death benefit) across all policies affected by this rate action. Expressed in USD. Used for financial impact analysis.

attributes.name: impacted_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of in-force policies affected by this rate action. Used for impact analysis and communication planning.

attributes.name: irc_7702_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate action has potential impact on IRC Section 7702 life insurance tax qualification. True if the action may affect guideline premium test (GPT) or cash value accumulation test (CVAT) compliance, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate action record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments regarding this rate action. May include implementation details, special considerations, or historical context.

attributes.name: opt_out_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether policyholders have the option to opt out of the rate action (e.g., by surrendering the policy or converting to a different product). True if opt-out is available, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: opt_out_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last date by which policyholders can exercise their opt-out option if available. Null if no opt-out is available.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: policyholder_communication_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the communication plan document detailing how policyholders will be notified of this rate action. Links to document management system.
attributes.references: Internal Product Communication Standards, State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: profitability_impact_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the expected impact on product profitability, including effects on internal rate of return (IRR), new business value (NBV), and embedded value.

attributes.name: rate_action_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying this rate action event. Used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: rate_action_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the rate action event for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rate_action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate action. Tracks progression from draft through regulatory approval to implementation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|PENDING_APPROVAL|APPROVED|FILED|EFFECTIVE|WITHDRAWN|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rate_action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate action event. Indicates the type of rate or charge being modified: Cost of Insurance (COI) rate changes, credited interest rate adjustments, expense charge modifications, dividend scale changes, mortality table updates, or premium rate adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation XXX, State Insurance Department Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_change_direction
attributes.description: Overall direction of the rate change. Increase indicates rates are going up (higher cost to policyholders), Decrease indicates rates are going down, Mixed indicates some rates increase while others decrease, No Change indicates administrative action without rate impact.

attributes.name: reinsurance_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate action affects reinsurance treaties or cession calculations. True if reinsurance agreements must be updated or renegotiated, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Treaty Terms, Internal Reinsurance Management Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the reinsurance treaty or treaties affected by this rate action. Null if no reinsurance impact.

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state jurisdictions where this rate action applies. Uses two-letter state codes (e.g., NY, CA, TX). May be ALL for nationwide actions.

attributes.name: state_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether state insurance department notification is required for this rate action. True if regulatory notification is mandatory, False otherwise.

products.name: di_benefit_definition
products.description: Defines the disability income (DI) product benefit parameters including own-occupation vs. any-occupation definition of disability, elimination period options (30, 60, 90, 180 days), benefit period options (2-year, 5-year, to age 65, lifetime), monthly benefit maximum, partial disability provisions, residual disability benefit, cost of living adjustment (COLA) rider parameters, social insurance substitute benefit, and return-to-work incentive provisions. Captures DI-specific underwriting occupation classes and benefit offset rules.
products.reference: NAIC Disability Income Model Regulation / ACORD DI Product Definition

attributes.name: di_benefit_definition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the disability income benefit definition record. Primary key.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: designed_by_actuary_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Designed By Actuary Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Disability insurance benefit definitions require actuarial design for elimination periods, benefit periods, and offset rules. Critical for product governance, pricing adequacy, and regulatory complian

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent DI product in the product catalog. Links this benefit definition to the specific disability income insurance product offering.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: DI benefit definitions are version-specific (elimination periods, benefit periods, disability definitions). Each version may have different DI benefit parameters. The effective_date and termination_da

attributes.name: benefit_definition_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying this benefit definition configuration. Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: benefit_definition_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the benefit definition including coverage scope, limitations, and key features.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: benefit_definition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit definition, describing the benefit structure and key parameters.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: benefit_offset_rules
attributes.description: Description of how other income sources reduce the DI benefit payment. Specifies which sources are offset (e.g., Social Security, workers compensation, other group disability, retirement income) and the offset calculation method.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 14

attributes.name: benefit_period_duration_months
attributes.description: Maximum number of months benefits will be paid for fixed-duration benefit periods. Common values: 24 (2 years), 60 (5 years), 120 (10 years). Null for to-age or lifetime benefit periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: benefit_period_to_age
attributes.description: The attained age at which benefit payments cease for to-age benefit periods. Common values: 65, 67, 70. Null for fixed-duration or lifetime benefit periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: benefit_period_type
attributes.description: Classification of how long benefits will be paid: fixed duration (e.g., 2 years, 5 years), to a specific age (e.g., age 65, age 67), or lifetime.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 6

attributes.name: cola_adjustment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which COLA adjustments are applied to benefit payments. Null if COLA rider is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: cola_adjustment_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate at which benefits increase under the COLA rider. Common values: 3%, 4%, or CPI-linked. Null if COLA rider is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: cola_cap_percent
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative percentage increase allowed under the COLA rider over the life of the claim. Null if no cap applies or COLA is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: cola_rider_available_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) Rider Available Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Cost of Living Adjustment rider is available with this benefit definition to protect against inflation during long-term disability claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit definition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: di_benefit_definition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this benefit definition. Active means available for new business; inactive means withdrawn but policies remain inforce; pending approval means awaiting regulatory approval; superseded means replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: disability_definition_type
attributes.description: The standard used to determine whether an insured qualifies as disabled. Own-occupation means inability to perform duties of the insured's specific occupation; any-occupation means inability to perform duties of any occupation for which the insured is reasonably suited by education, training, or experience.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 4

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit definition became available for new business. Represents the start of this benefit configuration's lifecycle.

attributes.name: elimination_period_days
attributes.description: The waiting period in days from the onset of disability before benefit payments begin. Common values include 30, 60, 90, 180, or 365 days. Functions as a deductible period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 5

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Regulatory filing reference number associated with this benefit definition. Used to track state insurance department approvals and compliance.

attributes.name: income_replacement_ratio_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of pre-disability income that the benefit is designed to replace. Typically ranges from 50% to 70% to maintain work incentive.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 8

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit definition record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: maximum_issue_age
attributes.description: Maximum age at which an applicant can be issued this DI benefit definition. Typically ranges from 55 to 65 years depending on benefit period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: minimum_issue_age
attributes.description: Minimum age at which an applicant can be issued this DI benefit definition. Typically 18 or 21 years.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: monthly_benefit_maximum_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monthly benefit amount payable under this benefit definition. Represents the ceiling for total disability benefits before any offsets or reductions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 7

attributes.name: monthly_benefit_minimum_amount
attributes.description: Minimum monthly benefit amount that can be issued under this benefit definition. Ensures adequate coverage levels.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: other_group_di_offset_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Other Group Disability Income (DI) Offset Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether benefits from other group disability income policies are offset against this DI benefit payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: own_occupation_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which the own-occupation definition of disability applies before transitioning to any-occupation definition. Null if pure own-occupation or any-occupation policy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: partial_disability_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether partial disability benefits are available under this definition. Partial disability typically means the insured can perform some but not all duties of their occupation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 9

attributes.name: partial_disability_benefit_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the full monthly benefit payable for partial disability. Typically 50% of the total disability benefit. Null if partial disability is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: renewable_provision_type
attributes.description: Specifies the renewal rights of the policy. Noncancellable means premiums and benefits cannot change; guaranteed renewable means the insurer must renew but can adjust premiums by class; conditionally renewable allows the insurer to non-renew under specified conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 16

attributes.name: residual_benefit_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate residual disability benefits. Income-loss formula bases benefit on percentage of income lost; time-loss formula bases benefit on percentage of time unable to work; hybrid uses both factors.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: residual_disability_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether residual disability benefits are available. Residual disability pays benefits proportional to the loss of income due to disability, even if the insured returns to work in a reduced capacity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 10

attributes.name: return_to_work_incentive_available_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return to Work Incentive Available Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether return-to-work incentive provisions are included. These provisions encourage disabled insureds to attempt returning to work by continuing partial benefits during the transition period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 13

attributes.name: return_to_work_trial_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which the insured can attempt to return to work while maintaining eligibility for full benefits if the attempt is unsuccessful. Null if return-to-work incentive is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: sis_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Additional monthly benefit amount payable under the Social Insurance Substitute provision when government benefits are denied. Null if SIS is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: sis_benefit_period_months
attributes.description: Maximum number of months the SIS benefit will be paid. Typically 12 or 24 months. Null if SIS is not available.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: social_insurance_substitute_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Social Insurance Substitute benefit is available. SIS provides additional benefits if the insured is denied Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) or other government disability benefits.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 12

attributes.name: ssdi_offset_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) Offset Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Social Security Disability Insurance benefits are offset against the DI benefit payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: state_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes where this benefit definition is approved and available for sale. Example: CA,NY,TX,FL. Used to enforce geographic eligibility rules.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit definition was withdrawn from new business. Null if still active. Existing policies continue under their original terms.

attributes.name: underwriting_occupation_class_structure
attributes.description: Description of the occupation classification system used for underwriting and rating this DI product. Typically ranges from Class 1 (lowest risk professional occupations) to Class 6 (highest risk manual labor occupations), with specific occupation examples for each class.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 15

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether waiver of premium provision is automatically included in this benefit definition. When included, premiums are waived during periods of total disability after a specified waiting period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance Section 17

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of continuous total disability required before premium waiver takes effect. Common values: 90, 180 days. Null if waiver of premium is not included.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

attributes.name: workers_comp_offset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers compensation benefits are offset against the DI benefit payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Disability Income Insurance

products.name: tax_qualification
products.description: Tracks the tax qualification status and parameters for each product plan under applicable IRC sections — IRC 7702 (life insurance definition), IRC 7702A (MEC testing), IRC 72 (annuity taxation), IRC 401/403/408 (qualified plan and IRA eligibility), and ERISA applicability. Captures qualification type, applicable IRC sections, tax reporting code (1099-R, 1099-INT), withholding requirements, RMD applicability flag, and IRS private letter ruling references. Governs tax reporting and policyholder tax disclosure obligations.
products.reference: IRC Section 7702 / IRC Section 72 / IRC Section 401 / IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: tax_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product tax qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this tax qualification record.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product plan for which this tax qualification applies.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Tax qualification status can change between product versions (IRA eligibility, qualified plan status, MEC status). Each version may have different tax treatment. The effective_date and expiration_date

attributes.name: catch_up_contribution_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional catch-up contributions are allowed for participants age 50 and older under IRC Section 414(v).

attributes.name: catch_up_contribution_limit
attributes.description: The additional annual contribution amount allowed for participants age 50 and older, if catch-up contributions are eligible.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
