products.name: plan_rider_configuration
products.description: This association product represents the configuration and eligibility rules governing which riders can be attached to which product plans. It captures plan-specific rider parameters, eligibility constraints, pricing overrides, and lifecycle management for rider availability. Each record links one product plan to one rider definition with attributes that define how that specific rider behaves when attached to that specific plan.. Existence Justification: In life insurance product management, product plans and riders have a genuine many-to-many relationship. A single product plan (e.g., Universal Life) can offer multiple riders (ADB, waiver of premium, LTC rider), and a single rider definition (e.g., Accidental Death Benefit) can be attached to multiple product plans across the portfolio. Product managers actively configure which riders are available on each plan, set plan-specific pricing and eligibility rules, and manage the lifecycle of rider availability independently for each plan-rider combination.

attributes.name: plan_rider_configuration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this plan-rider configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to product_plan. Identifies which product plan this configuration applies to.

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to rider_definition. Identifies which rider is being configured for this plan.

attributes.name: default_selection_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this rider should be pre-selected by default in the application workflow for this plan. Used to guide sales and underwriting systems.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this rider became available for attachment to this specific product plan. May differ from the rider_definition.effective_date if the rider was added to this plan after initial rider creation.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this rider is mandatory for all policies issued under this product plan. Mandatory riders are automatically included and cannot be declined by the customer.

attributes.name: maximum_benefit_amount_override
attributes.description: Plan-specific override of the maximum benefit amount for this rider when attached to this plan. Overrides rider_definition.maximum_benefit_amount if specified. Used when plan characteristics require different benefit limits.

attributes.name: maximum_issue_age_override
attributes.description: Plan-specific override of the maximum issue age for this rider when attached to this plan. Overrides rider_definition.maximum_issue_age if specified. Used when plan characteristics require different age eligibility.

attributes.name: minimum_issue_age_override
attributes.description: Plan-specific override of the minimum issue age for this rider when attached to this plan. Overrides rider_definition.minimum_issue_age if specified. Used when plan characteristics require different age eligibility.

attributes.name: rider_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status of this rider for this specific plan. AVAILABLE means optional and eligible, MANDATORY means required for all policies under this plan, RESTRICTED means available only under special conditions, DISCONTINUED means no longer available for new attachments.

attributes.name: rider_premium_rate
attributes.description: Plan-specific premium rate override for this rider. Expressed as rate per thousand of coverage or flat amount depending on premium_basis. Overrides default rider pricing when this rider is attached to this specific plan.

attributes.name: state_availability_override
attributes.description: Plan-specific override of state availability for this rider. Comma-separated list of state codes where this rider is available for THIS PLAN. May be more restrictive than rider_definition.state_availability if plan-specific regulatory approvals differ.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this rider was discontinued for new attachments to this specific product plan. Null for currently available configurations. May differ from rider_definition.termination_date if the rider was removed from this plan but remains available on other plans.

products.name: plan_template_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between product_plan and document_template. It captures the business rules governing which document templates are required or optional for each product plan, including state-specific template requirements, distribution channel applicability, and template version control. Each record links one product_plan to one document_template with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, a single product plan requires multiple document templates across different contexts: policy contracts, illustrations, applications, state-specific disclosure forms, rider amendments, and correspondence templates. Each template can be reused across multiple product plans (e.g., a standard term life application template used for multiple term products). The business actively manages these assignments with state-specific rules, distribution channel requirements, mandatory vs. optional flags, and effective date controls for template version transitions.

products.name: vendor_service
products.description: This association product represents the service contract between product_plan and vendor. It captures the specific services provided by each vendor for each product plan, including service category (illustration software, form printing, actuarial consulting, reinsurance intermediary), contract dates, service scope, and performance tier. Each record links one product_plan to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this service relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, a single product plan requires multiple vendors to support its full lifecycle: illustration software vendors for sales tools, form printing vendors for policy documents, actuarial consulting vendors for pricing and reserve analysis, and reinsurance intermediaries for risk transfer. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., an illustration software provider) serves multiple product plans across the portfolio (whole life, universal life, variable products). The business actively manages these service relationships with contract dates, service scope definitions, and performance tiers specific to each product-vendor combination.

products.name: plan_obligation_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between product_plan and regulatory_obligation. It captures the specific compliance status, filing history, and responsibility assignment for each product plan's adherence to each applicable regulatory obligation. Each record links one product plan to one regulatory obligation with attributes that track filing dates, compliance status, and responsible parties that exist only in the context of this specific plan-obligation combination.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, each product plan must comply with multiple ongoing regulatory obligations across different jurisdictions (annual statement reporting, rate filing requirements, form maintenance, suitability rules, reserve calculations). Simultaneously, each regulatory obligation applies to multiple product plans based on product type, state approvals, and business characteristics. The business actively manages this relationship by tracking compliance status, filing dates, and responsible parties for each plan-obligation combination as part of core regulatory compliance operations.

attributes.description: The end date of the reporting or filing period covered by this obligation instance (e.g., December 31 for an annual filing). Together with filing_period_start_date, defines the data scope for the filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRS Tax Year Definitions; SEC Fiscal Year Reporting

attributes.name: filing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting or filing period covered by this obligation instance (e.g., January 1 for an annual filing). Defines the data scope for the filing and aligns with the statutory reporting period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRS Tax Year Definitions; SEC Fiscal Year Reporting

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body that mandates this obligation (e.g., NAIC, SEC, FINRA, IRS, DOL, FinCEN, FASB, State DOI — California, IAIS). Drives routing of filings and escalation contacts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAIC|SEC|FINRA|IRS|DOL|FinCEN|FASB|State DOI|IAIS|ACORD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; SEC; FINRA; IRS; DOL ERISA; FinCEN AML/BSA; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the statutory due date within which the obligation may still be fulfilled without incurring a penalty, as permitted by the governing body. Zero if no grace period is allowed. Used in escalation threshold calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRS Publication 509; State DOI Filing Rules

attributes.name: hipaa_relevance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Relevance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation involves HIPAA Privacy Rule or Security Rule compliance, including protected health information (PHI) handling, breach notification, or business associate agreement requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HIPAA Security Rule; HITECH Act

attributes.name: internal_preparation_deadline
attributes.description: Enterprise-set internal deadline for completing all preparation, review, and approval activities prior to the statutory due date. Provides buffer time for quality review, legal sign-off, and executive attestation. Typically set 5–15 business days before the statutory due date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: is_attestation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation requires a formal officer or executive attestation (e.g., SOX CEO/CFO certification, ORSA officer sign-off). When true, the compliance workflow must include an attestation step before submission.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC ORSA Model Regulation #505

attributes.name: is_external_filing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation requires submission of a document or report to an external regulatory body (true) or is an internal compliance activity only (false), such as an internal audit or training completion record.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; IRS e-file; FinCEN BSA E-Filing

attributes.name: is_material_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is classified as material for SOX, ORSA, or ERM reporting purposes. Material obligations receive heightened monitoring, executive visibility, and are included in the Board-level compliance dashboard.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC ORSA Model Regulation #505; FASB ASC 944 LDTI

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is imposed at the federal, state, multi-state, or international level. Drives routing to the appropriate legal and compliance team and determines which state DOI contacts are relevant.
attributes.references: NAIC; SEC; IRS; DOL ERISA; State Departments of Insurance; IAIS

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: The date on which the underlying regulation or rule governing this obligation was most recently amended or updated by the governing body. Triggers a compliance review to assess whether the obligation scope, format, or deadline has changed.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation Amendment History; IRS Revenue Rulings; SEC Rule Amendments

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this regulatory obligation record was most recently modified in the compliance registry. Used to detect stale records, trigger re-review workflows, and support audit trail requirements under SOX and NAIC market conduct standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: ldti_relevance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Relevance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is related to FASB ASC 944-40 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) accounting standard compliance, including updated reserve calculations, discount rate assumptions, and enhanced disclosures for long-duration insurance contracts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 LDTI; GAAP; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: obligation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this regulatory obligation within the enterprise compliance calendar (e.g., NAIC-ORSA-ANN, IRS-7702-QTR, SEC-N-CEN-ANN). Used as the business-facing identifier in filings, dashboards, and audit correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: obligation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the regulatory obligation as recognized by the governing body (e.g., 'Annual ORSA Summary Report', 'Form N-CEN Annual Report', 'NAIC Risk-Based Capital Report'). Used in compliance calendars, executive dashboards, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SEC Reporting Requirements; IRS Publication 535

attributes.name: obligation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance team annotations, regulatory guidance interpretations, special instructions, or contextual notes relevant to fulfilling this obligation. May include references to regulatory guidance letters, no-action letters, or internal legal opinions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory obligation within the enterprise compliance registry. 'active' = currently enforceable; 'suspended' = temporarily waived by regulator; 'retired' = no longer applicable; 'pending_effective' = enacted but not yet in force; 'under_review' = applicability being assessed by compliance team.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the compliance obligation. 'filing' = periodic regulatory report submission; 'examination' = market conduct or financial exam; 'attestation' = SOX/officer certification; 'disclosure' = required customer or public disclosure; 'training' = mandatory compliance training; 'audit' = internal or external audit; 'notification' = event-triggered regulatory notice; 'registration' = product or entity registration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filing|examination|attestation|disclosure|training|audit|notification|registration — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 302/404; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: orsa_erm_relevance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment / Enterprise Risk Management (ORSA/ERM) Relevance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is part of the ORSA or ERM reporting framework, including the annual ORSA Summary Report submitted to state regulators. Used to scope the ERM compliance calendar and Board risk reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Regulation #505; IAIS Insurance Core Principles; ERM Framework

attributes.name: pbr_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is related to NAIC Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) compliance, including VM-20 (life insurance reserves), VM-21 (variable annuity reserves), and VM-31 (PBR actuarial report) requirements. Used to scope actuarial compliance activities.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20; NAIC Valuation Manual VM-21; NAIC Valuation Manual VM-31; PBR

attributes.name: penalty_amount_usd
attributes.description: Maximum or standard monetary penalty in US dollars that may be assessed for non-compliance with this obligation. Used in risk quantification, ERM reporting, and prioritization of compliance resources. Null if penalty is non-monetary (e.g., license suspension).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; IRS Penalty Provisions; SEC Enforcement Actions; State DOI Penalty Schedules

attributes.name: penalty_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the regulatory penalties, fines, or sanctions that may be imposed for non-compliance or late filing (e.g., '$100 per day late fee', 'license suspension', 'cease and desist order'). Informs risk prioritization and escalation urgency.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; IRS Penalty Provisions; SEC Enforcement Actions; State DOI Penalty Schedules

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Enterprise-assigned priority classification for this obligation based on regulatory risk, penalty severity, and business impact. 'critical' = Board-level visibility, zero tolerance for non-compliance; 'high' = executive escalation required if at risk; 'medium' = standard compliance monitoring; 'low' = routine administrative obligation.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Regulation #505; ERM Framework; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: rbc_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation is directly related to NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) reporting or solvency compliance. Used to prioritize obligations in the actuarial and finance compliance calendar and to scope RBC-related remediation activities.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Instructions; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Formal legal or regulatory citation for the rule or statute that creates this obligation (e.g., 'IRC Section 7702', 'NAIC Model Regulation #820', 'ERISA Section 404', 'ASC 944-40 LDTI', 'FinCEN 31 CFR Part 1010'). Enables precise traceability to source regulation for audit and legal review.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulations; DOL ERISA; FASB ASC 944; FinCEN 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: renewal_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months in the renewal or recurrence cycle for this obligation (e.g., 12 for annual, 3 for quarterly, 1 for monthly). Used by the compliance calendar engine to auto-generate future obligation instances. Null for one-time or event-triggered obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRS Filing Deadlines; SEC Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Name of the internal department or business unit primarily responsible for fulfilling this obligation (e.g., 'Actuarial', 'Legal & Compliance', 'Finance', 'Tax', 'Operations', 'Investment Management'). Used for workload assignment and escalation routing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this obligation record originates or is primarily managed (e.g., 'Compliance Calendar System', 'Policy Administration System', 'Actuarial Valuation System'). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Section 404 IT Controls

attributes.name: statutory_due_date
attributes.description: The legally mandated deadline by which this obligation must be fulfilled as specified by the governing body or regulation. For recurring obligations, this represents the due date for the current or next filing period. Failure to meet this date may result in regulatory penalties.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IRS Filing Deadlines; SEC Reporting Calendar; DOL ERISA Filing Deadlines

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: The required or preferred method by which this obligation must be submitted to the governing body. 'electronic' = NAIC SERFF or similar; 'portal' = regulator-specific web portal (e.g., SEC EDGAR, IRS e-file); 'api' = machine-to-machine submission; 'paper' = physical mailing.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF; SEC EDGAR; IRS e-file; FinCEN BSA E-Filing System

attributes.name: submission_format
attributes.description: The required data format or form number for the filing submission (e.g., 'NAIC Annual Statement Blank', 'Form N-CEN', 'Form 5500', 'SAR FinCEN 111', 'ACORD XML'). Ensures the compliance team prepares the filing in the correct format required by the governing body.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC Form N-CEN; DOL Form 5500; FinCEN SAR; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: regulatory_filing
products.description: Transactional record of every regulatory filing submitted to governing bodies — NAIC annual/quarterly statements, state DOI market conduct filings, SEC Form N-4/N-6 for variable products, FINRA filings, IRS Form 1099-R/5498, FinCEN SAR/CTR filings, ORSA reports, ERISA Form 5500 filings, and all other statutory submissions. Captures filing type, jurisdiction, submission date, due date, filing status (draft, submitted, accepted, rejected), filing period, preparer, approver, and submission confirmation reference. For ORSA filings: includes risk categories assessed, capital adequacy conclusion, stress test scenarios, board approval date, and lead state designation. For ERISA filings: includes plan sponsor, plan type (group life, 401k annuity, pension), fiduciary designation, prohibited transaction exemption (PTE) references, and DOL filing date. Serves as the single transactional record for all regulatory submissions regardless of filing type or governing body.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory filing record in the compliance data product. Primary key for the regulatory_filing table.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the governing body formally accepted or acknowledged the filing as complete and compliant. Null if the filing has not yet been accepted. Distinguishes submission date from regulatory acceptance, which may differ for filings requiring review.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2

attributes.name: aml_transaction_type
attributes.description: For FinCEN filings, identifies whether this is a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) or Currency Transaction Report (CTR). Applicable only to FinCEN/BSA filings. Null for non-AML filing types. Supports AML/BSA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Instructions; FinCEN CTR Instructions; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); 31 CFR Part 1010

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the designated approver formally signed off on the filing prior to submission. Required for SOX internal control documentation and NAIC officer certification.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Annual Statement Officer Certification

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the officer or compliance official who approved the filing. Retained for audit trail and regulatory examination purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Annual Statement Officer Certification

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company's Board of Directors formally approved the filing prior to submission. Required for ORSA reports and certain NAIC annual statement certifications. Null for filings that do not require board-level approval.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; NAIC Annual Statement Officer Certification

attributes.name: capital_adequacy_conclusion
attributes.description: The conclusion reached in the ORSA or RBC filing regarding the insurer's capital adequacy relative to its risk profile (e.g., adequate, inadequate, marginal). Applicable to ORSA and RBC-related filings. Null for non-capital filings.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; NAIC RBC Instructions; IAIS Insurance Core Principles

attributes.name: confirmation_reference
attributes.description: The acknowledgment or confirmation number returned by the governing body's filing system upon successful receipt of the submission (e.g., NAIC confirmation number, SEC accession number, DOL EFAST2 confirmation, FinCEN BSA tracking number). Serves as the authoritative proof of submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Accession Number; DOL EFAST2; FinCEN BSA E-Filing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this regulatory filing record was first created in the compliance system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the filing lifecycle. Aligns with SOX internal control documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for any monetary amounts reported in this filing (e.g., 'USD'). Primarily USD for domestic US regulatory filings. Required when penalty_amount or other monetary fields are populated.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the filing was submitted after the statutory due date. Zero or negative if filed on time. Used to assess late-filing penalties and regulatory exposure. Calculated as submission_date minus due_date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Late Filing Rules; DOL EFAST2

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The statutory or regulatory deadline by which this filing must be submitted to the governing body. Used to calculate timeliness, trigger escalation workflows, and assess late-filing penalties. Derived from the regulatory calendar for the applicable filing type and jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: erisa_plan_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Type
attributes.description: Classification of the ERISA-covered plan reported in this DOL Form 5500 filing (e.g., group life, 401k annuity, pension, welfare). Applicable only to ERISA filings. Null for non-ERISA filing types.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA; DOL Form 5500 Instructions; IRC Section 401

attributes.name: examination_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this filing to a related state DOI market conduct examination or regulatory inquiry. Applicable when the filing is submitted in response to or in connection with a regulatory examination. Null if not examination-related.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement (MCAS); State DOI Market Conduct Examination Guidelines

attributes.name: fiduciary_designation
attributes.description: Name or role of the designated fiduciary responsible for the ERISA plan covered by this filing. Required for DOL Form 5500 and DOL fiduciary compliance under ERISA. Null for non-ERISA filing types.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Section 3(21); DOL Form 5500 Instructions

attributes.name: filing_channel
attributes.description: The transmission method used to submit the filing to the governing body (e.g., electronic via NAIC SERFF, SEC EDGAR, DOL EFAST2, FinCEN BSA E-Filing portal, or paper submission). Relevant for audit trail and submission confirmation tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2; FinCEN BSA E-Filing

attributes.name: filing_form_name
attributes.description: The official name or designation of the regulatory form used for this filing (e.g., 'NAIC Life/Health Annual Statement', 'SEC Form N-4', 'IRS Form 1099-R', 'FinCEN Form 112 CTR', 'DOL Form 5500', 'ORSA Summary Report'). Provides precise identification of the statutory instrument.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC Forms N-4/N-6; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN Form 112; DOL Form 5500

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the filing — either generated internally or assigned by the receiving regulatory body upon submission (e.g., NAIC filing reference, SEC accession number, DOL confirmation number). Used for tracking and correspondence with regulators.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Filing System; DOL EFAST2

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the regulatory filing submission. Tracks progression from internal preparation (draft) through submission to the regulator and final disposition (accepted, rejected, withdrawn). Drives compliance workflow and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2; FinCEN BSA E-Filing

attributes.name: filing_system_source
attributes.description: Name of the internal operational system or platform from which the filing data was sourced or generated (e.g., 'Policy Administration System', 'Actuarial Valuation System', 'Claims Management System'). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: filing_version
attributes.description: Version or amendment number of this filing submission (e.g., 'original', 'amendment_1', 'corrected'). Tracks whether this is the initial submission or a subsequent amendment/correction filed with the governing body.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Amendment Rules; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is an amendment or correction to a previously submitted filing. True if this is an amended submission; False if this is the original filing. Used to distinguish original from corrected statutory submissions.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Amendment Rules; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this regulatory filing record was most recently modified in the compliance system. Tracks the most recent status change, amendment, or data correction. Supports audit trail and SOX change management controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: late_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing was submitted after the statutory due date. True if submission_date exceeds due_date; False if filed on time. Used for compliance monitoring, penalty assessment, and regulatory examination preparation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR Late Filing Rules; DOL EFAST2; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: lead_state_code
attributes.description: Two-character US state code identifying the lead state regulator for ORSA filings and multi-state regulatory submissions. The lead state coordinates review among all states where the insurer is licensed. Applicable primarily to ORSA and group-level filings.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; NAIC Group Supervision Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to record supplemental context, internal commentary, regulator correspondence notes, or remediation instructions related to this filing. Not transmitted to the regulator; for internal compliance workflow use only.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: orsa_risk_categories
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Risk Categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of risk categories assessed in the ORSA filing (e.g., 'insurance_risk, market_risk, credit_risk, operational_risk, liquidity_risk'). Applicable only to ORSA filings. Null for non-ORSA filing types. Supports ERM and ORSA reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; IAIS Insurance Core Principles

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed by the governing body for late or deficient filing, expressed in USD. Null if no penalty was assessed. Used for financial reporting, regulatory expense tracking, and SOX control monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC Late Filing Penalties; DOL ERISA Penalty Rules; IRS Penalty Provisions

attributes.name: plan_sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer or organization sponsoring the retirement or group benefit plan covered by this ERISA filing (DOL Form 5500). Applicable only to ERISA filings. Null for non-ERISA filing types.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Section 103; DOL Form 5500 Instructions

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual responsible for preparing the regulatory filing. Retained for audit trail and regulatory examination purposes even if the employee record changes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: pte_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any Prohibited Transaction Exemption (PTE) cited in the ERISA filing (e.g., PTE 84-24, PTE 2020-02). Applicable to ERISA filings where prohibited transaction exemptions are claimed. Null for non-ERISA filing types.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Section 408; DOL PTE 84-24; DOL PTE 2020-02

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the governing body formally rejected the filing. Populated only when filing_status is 'rejected'. Triggers remediation workflow and resubmission tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Textual description or regulator-provided code explaining why the filing was rejected. Populated when filing_status is 'rejected'. Used to drive remediation actions and resubmission preparation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2

attributes.name: stress_test_scenarios
attributes.description: Description or comma-separated list of stress test scenarios included in the ORSA or actuarial filing (e.g., 'interest_rate_shock, pandemic_mortality, equity_market_decline'). Applicable to ORSA and actuarial valuation filings. Null for non-ORSA filing types.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the filing was transmitted to the governing body. Compared against due_date to determine timeliness and potential late-filing exposure. Populated upon successful transmission.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2; FinCEN BSA E-Filing

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the filing was electronically transmitted to the governing body. Provides audit-grade evidence of timely submission, particularly for filings with intraday deadlines (e.g., FinCEN CTR 15-day rule).
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA E-Filing; SEC EDGAR; DOL EFAST2

products.name: market_conduct_exam
products.description: Comprehensive record of state DOI market conduct examinations, their associated findings, and finding-level detail. Captures examination type (routine, targeted, multi-state), initiating state DOI, scope, lead examiner, examination period, status, and outcome. Includes embedded finding records: finding description, regulatory citation violated, severity classification (critical, major, minor), affected policy counts, examiner recommendations, company response, finding status (open, disputed, remediated, closed), and corrective action deadlines. Supports the full examination lifecycle from notification through finding closure and repeat-finding trend analysis across examination cycles.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the primary jurisdiction governing notification obligations for this incident. Determines which state data breach notification law applies and the applicable notification deadline.
attributes.references: State Data Breach Notification Laws (all 50 states + DC); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the privacy incident record. Supports audit trail integrity and change management tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR § 164.312(b))

attributes.name: media_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which notification was provided to prominent media outlets in the affected state(s). Required within 60 days of discovery for breaches affecting 500+ residents of a state.
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.406(b)); HHS OCR Guidance

attributes.name: media_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether notification to prominent media outlets is required. Triggered when a confirmed breach affects 500 or more residents of a single state or jurisdiction.
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.406); HHS OCR Guidance

attributes.name: multi_state_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident involves affected individuals across multiple states, triggering notification obligations under multiple state data breach notification laws simultaneously.
attributes.references: State Data Breach Notification Laws (all 50 states); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law

attributes.name: no_breach_rationale
attributes.description: Documented justification when the incident is determined NOT to constitute a reportable breach, referencing the four-factor risk assessment outcome (nature/extent of PHI, unauthorized person, whether PHI was actually acquired/viewed, extent of risk mitigation). Required for HIPAA documentation obligations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.402(2)); HHS OCR Guidance

attributes.name: notification_deadline_date
attributes.description: Calculated deadline by which all required notifications (HHS OCR, individuals, media, state AG, DOI) must be completed. Derived from discovery_date plus the applicable regulatory notification window (e.g., 60 days under HIPAA, 30–72 hours under NAIC model law). Stored for deadline monitoring and escalation.
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.404–408); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law § 5; State Data Breach Notification Laws

attributes.name: phi_data_elements_exposed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Data Elements Exposed
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of PHI or PII data element categories involved in the incident (e.g., name, SSN, date_of_birth, diagnosis, policy_number, financial_account, biometric). Required for HHS OCR breach report and state AG notifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: name|ssn|date_of_birth|diagnosis|treatment|policy_number|financial_account|biometric|address|email|phone — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.408(b)(1)); HHS OCR Breach Reporting Portal

attributes.name: remediation_actions_taken
attributes.description: Narrative description of corrective and remediation actions taken in response to the privacy incident (e.g., system access revoked, encryption implemented, workforce retrained, BA agreement updated, policy revised). Required for HIPAA documentation and regulatory examination.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.530(i)); HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D)); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law § 4

attributes.name: remediation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which all remediation actions were confirmed as completed. Supports closure of the incident record and regulatory documentation of corrective action.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.530(i)); SOX Section 302; NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which all remediation actions must be completed. Used for compliance tracking and escalation management.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.530(i)); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law § 4

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the privacy incident was formally reported to the compliance or privacy office. Establishes the internal reporting timeline for SOX controls and HIPAA workforce training obligations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.530(j)); SOX Section 302/906

attributes.name: risk_assessment_score
attributes.description: Overall risk level determined by the four-factor HIPAA breach risk assessment: (1) nature and extent of PHI involved, (2) identity of unauthorized person, (3) whether PHI was actually acquired or viewed, (4) extent to which risk has been mitigated. Drives breach determination and notification decisions.
attributes.references: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (45 CFR § 164.402(2)); HHS OCR Guidance on Risk Assessment

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause of the privacy incident. Used for trend analysis, remediation prioritization, and regulatory reporting to HHS OCR and state DOIs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_error|malicious_insider|external_attack|system_failure|vendor_error|process_failure|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2; HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR § 164.308(a)(1)); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law

attributes.name: state_ag_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which notification was submitted to the State Attorney General. Deadline varies by state (e.g., 30 days in some states, 60 days in others).
attributes.references: State Data Breach Notification Laws; NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law § 5

attributes.name: state_ag_notification_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether notification to the State Attorney General is required under applicable state data breach notification law. Requirements vary by state.
attributes.references: State Data Breach Notification Laws (all 50 states + DC); NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law § 5

attributes.name: business_process
attributes.description: The core business process to which this control belongs (e.g., 'Policy Underwriting and Risk Assessment', 'Premium Billing and Collection', 'Claims Adjudication and Settlement', 'Actuarial Valuation and Reserving'). Aligns to the enterprise process taxonomy.

attributes.name: control_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is executed manually by a person, fully automated by an IT system, relies on IT-generated reports (IT-dependent manual), or is a combination. Drives testing approach and reliance on IT general controls (ITGCs).

attributes.name: control_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric control identifier used in audit workpapers, risk and control matrices (RCM), and regulatory filings. Follows the enterprise control numbering convention (e.g., SOX-PREM-0042 for premium billing controls).
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the control objective, the specific procedure performed, the population covered, and the financial statement assertion addressed (existence, completeness, accuracy, valuation, presentation).

attributes.name: control_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level at which the control operates: 'entity_level' covers company-wide controls (e.g., tone at the top, code of conduct); 'process_level' covers a specific business process (e.g., premium billing); 'transaction_level' covers individual transactions.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title of the internal control (e.g., 'Premium Revenue Recognition Review', 'DAC Amortization Approval'). Used in dashboards, audit reports, and management attestation packages.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title of the control owner (e.g., 'VP of Actuarial', 'Controller', 'Chief Compliance Officer'). Used for escalation routing and management attestation sign-off workflows.

attributes.name: control_performer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who executes the control on a day-to-day basis. May differ from the control owner (e.g., a senior analyst performs the control while the VP owns it).
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the control. 'active' indicates the control is in operation; 'inactive' indicates it has been suspended; 'under_review' indicates it is being reassessed; 'retired' indicates it has been decommissioned.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control by its operational mechanism: 'preventive' stops errors or fraud before they occur; 'detective' identifies errors or irregularities after the fact; 'corrective' remedies identified deficiencies.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOX control record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for control inventory management and supports SOX Section 802 record retention requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 802; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: deficiency_rating
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency: 'none' (no deficiency), 'control_deficiency' (minor gap), 'significant_deficiency' (important enough to merit attention but not material), 'material_weakness' (reasonable possibility of material misstatement — requires CEO/CFO disclosure under SOX Section 302/404).
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302 and 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business department or organizational unit responsible for executing and owning this control (e.g., 'Actuarial', 'Finance', 'Compliance', 'Claims', 'Underwriting', 'Investment Management').
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this control became effective and operational. Used to determine the period of reliance for annual SOX assessments and to track control design changes over time.

attributes.name: evidence_retention_years
attributes.description: Number of years that control evidence must be retained per SOX Section 802 and company records retention policy. SOX mandates a minimum of 7 years for audit workpapers and related records.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 802; SEC Rule 17a-4; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of exceptions or deviations identified during the most recent test of operating effectiveness. A non-zero value triggers deficiency evaluation and potential escalation to significant deficiency or material weakness classification.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the external auditor (independent registered public accounting firm) has elected to rely on this control as part of their integrated audit under PCAOB AS 2201. Controls with reliance receive direct testing by the external auditor.

attributes.name: financial_statement_area
attributes.description: The financial statement line item or account area that this control protects (e.g., 'Premium Revenue', 'Policy Reserves', 'DAC Asset', 'Claims Liability', 'Investment Income'). Links the control to GAAP/SAP financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium_revenue|policy_reserves|dac_asset|claims_liability|investment_income|commission_expense|reinsurance_recoverable|annuity_liability — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: financial_statement_assertion
attributes.description: The management assertion addressed by this control per PCAOB standards: 'existence' (assets/liabilities exist), 'completeness' (all transactions recorded), 'accuracy' (correct amounts), 'valuation' (appropriate measurement), 'cutoff' (correct period), 'presentation' (proper disclosure).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; FASB ASC 944; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed. Drives the testing sample size per PCAOB guidance (e.g., daily controls require larger samples than annual controls) and the scheduling of control execution reminders.

attributes.name: is_itgc
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is an IT General Control (ITGC) covering access management, change management, computer operations, or program development. ITGCs underpin the reliability of automated application controls.

attributes.name: is_key_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is designated as a key control — one whose failure could result in a material misstatement in the financial statements. Key controls receive enhanced testing rigor and are included in the external auditor's reliance scope.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this control was tested for operating effectiveness. Used to monitor testing currency and ensure controls are tested within required intervals per the annual SOX testing plan.

attributes.name: last_test_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent test of operating effectiveness: 'effective' means the control operated as designed with no exceptions; 'ineffective' means one or more exceptions were identified; 'not_tested' means testing has not yet been completed for the current period.

attributes.name: management_assessment_conclusion
attributes.description: Management's formal conclusion on the operating effectiveness of this control as part of the annual SOX Section 404(a) management assessment. 'effective' supports the CEO/CFO certification; 'ineffective' requires disclosure in the annual report.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302 and 404(a); PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: next_scheduled_test_date
attributes.description: The planned date for the next test of operating effectiveness based on the annual SOX testing calendar and control frequency. Used by internal audit to manage workload scheduling and ensure all key controls are tested before year-end.

attributes.name: related_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the internal policy, procedure, or standard that this control implements or supports (e.g., 'FIN-POL-007 Reserve Estimation Policy', 'COMP-POL-012 AML Compliance Program'). Links controls to the governance framework.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the remediation action was completed and validated. Null if remediation is still in progress. Compared against remediation_due_date to assess timeliness of corrective actions.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the corrective action plan to address identified control deficiencies. Includes root cause analysis, specific remediation steps, and process or system changes required to restore control effectiveness.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the remediation action plan must be completed and the control must be retested to confirm effectiveness. Monitored by the compliance function and reported to the Audit Committee.

attributes.name: remediation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remediation action plan is required for this control based on identified deficiencies. True triggers the creation of a remediation tracking record and escalation to the control owner and compliance leadership.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this control was retired or decommissioned. Null for active controls. Populated when a control is replaced, merged, or eliminated due to process changes or system automation.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Inherent risk rating of the financial reporting area this control addresses. 'high' risk areas (e.g., actuarial reserves, DAC) require more rigorous testing; 'low' risk areas may qualify for reduced testing procedures.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO ERM Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions or instances selected for testing in the most recent test execution. Sample sizes are determined by control frequency per PCAOB guidance (e.g., 25 for monthly, 60 for daily controls).

attributes.name: sox_scope_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this control is in scope for SOX Section 404 assessment and external auditor reliance. Controls may be added or removed from scope each year based on materiality and risk assessments.

attributes.name: supporting_system

attributes.name: test_approach
attributes.description: The audit testing methodology applied to evaluate operating effectiveness: 'inquiry' (interviews), 'observation' (watching the control), 'inspection' (reviewing evidence), 'reperformance' (independently re-executing), 'walkthrough' (end-to-end process trace).

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual (internal audit staff, external auditor, or co-sourced provider) who performed the most recent test of operating effectiveness. Required for audit trail and independence documentation.

attributes.name: tester_type
attributes.description: Identifies who performed the test: 'internal_audit' (company's internal audit function), 'external_auditor' (independent registered public accounting firm), 'management' (control owner self-assessment), 'co_sourced' (third-party firm assisting internal audit).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the attestation record, used in regulatory correspondence, audit trails, and examination submissions. Format: ATT-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; SOX Section 302/906

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory authority to which this attestation is directed or submitted. Determines submission channel, format requirements, and examination authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAIC|STATE_DOI|SEC|FINRA|IRS|DOL|FINCEN|FASB|IAIS — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; SEC; FINRA; IRS; DOL; FinCEN; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific statutory, regulatory, or rule citation that this attestation certifies compliance with (e.g., IRC Section 7702, SOX Section 302, 31 CFR Part 1010, HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164). Enables precise regulatory mapping.
attributes.references: IRS IRC 7702; SOX Sections 302/906; FinCEN 31 CFR Part 1010; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which all identified exceptions must be remediated and re-attested. Populated when remediation_required_flag is True. Drives compliance calendar and escalation management.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls Framework; NAIC Market Conduct Corrective Action Standards

attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal remediation plan is required as a result of exceptions identified in this attestation. Triggers the remediation tracking workflow and assignment of a remediation owner.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: repeat_exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any exception noted in this attestation was also identified in the prior attestation period, signaling a persistent control deficiency. Repeat exceptions receive elevated regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 302; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the designated reviewer completed their review of the attestation prior to submission. Supports audit trail and segregation of duties documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific compliance obligations, controls, processes, or regulatory requirements covered by this attestation. Provides context for audit examination and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; FinCEN AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final sign-off was granted or denied by the reviewing authority. Marks the completion of the internal approval workflow prior to regulatory submission.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual

attributes.name: sign_off_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the attestation sign-off workflow, reflecting whether the designated reviewer has approved, rejected, or escalated the attestation for further review.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; Internal Audit Standards (IIA)

attributes.name: significant_deficiency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any identified exception constitutes a significant deficiency in internal controls, which is less severe than a material weakness but still requires communication to the Audit Committee under SOX/PCAOB standards.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the completed attestation was formally submitted to the regulatory authority, internal audit committee, or designated compliance repository.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; FinCEN AML Program Requirements

products.name: training_course
products.description: Master catalog of compliance training courses with integrated individual completion records. Captures course name, regulatory requirement driving the training (AML, HIPAA, suitability, STOLI, ethics), target audience, delivery method, duration, passing score threshold, renewal frequency, and course version. Includes individual completion records: employee or agent identifier, completion date, score achieved, pass/fail status, certificate number, expiration date, training delivery platform, and renewal tracking. Serves as the single source of truth for both training curriculum management and regulatory demonstration that all required AML, HIPAA, suitability, and ethics training obligations are met for licensed producers and employees.
products.reference: NAIC Producer Licensing / AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each compliance training course record in the master catalog. Serves as the primary key for the training_course data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240 (Continuing Education)

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commission.bonus_program. Business justification: Training courses on specific bonus programs cover eligibility rules, compliance requirements, prohibited practices, and suitability standards. Real business process: producer education on incentive pr

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Training courses implement compliance policy requirements. The policy defines the regulatory requirement and authority that mandates the training.

attributes.name: content_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Compliance training content is frequently purchased from external vendors (CE providers, LMS vendors, content publishers). Tracks vendor providing course content for licensing, renewal, and vendor per

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Training program costs (course development, delivery platform, instructor fees) are allocated to cost centers for budgeting and expense management. Finance needs cost center attribution for training R

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or licensed producer who completed or is enrolled in this training course. Links the completion record to the individual's HR or agent profile for compliance tracking, regulatory reporting, and license renewal management.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: guideline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.investment_guideline. Business justification: Training courses educate staff on investment guidelines and compliance requirements. Real business process: compliance training, investment policy education, staff certification. Standard insurance in

attributes.name: report_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_definition. Business justification: Compliance training courses cover preparation of specific regulatory reports (e.g., NAIC Annual Statement training). Links course to the report it trains on for regulatory reporting competency managem

attributes.name: aml_course_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) training requirements under FinCEN regulations. True triggers AML compliance tracking and annual completion verification for all applicable employees and producers.
attributes.references: FinCEN 31 CFR §1010.210; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the compliance officer or manager who approved a training waiver or exemption. Required for SOX control documentation and regulatory examination evidence when a mandatory training requirement is waived.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/906; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for the learner's assessment on this course version (1 = first attempt). Tracked against max_attempts_allowed to enforce compliance escalation rules when a learner repeatedly fails a mandatory regulatory training course.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: ce_approval_number
attributes.description: State-issued CE course approval number assigned by the Department of Insurance. Required for CE credit reporting to state regulators upon producer completion. May be a composite of state code and approval number (e.g., 'TX-CE-2024-00123').
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: ce_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education (CE) credit hours awarded upon successful completion of this course. Applicable to licensed insurance producers subject to state CE requirements. Zero for non-CE courses. Reported to state Departments of Insurance for producer license renewal compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI CE Requirements; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued to the learner upon successful completion of the course. Serves as the primary evidence identifier for regulatory examinations, producer licensing audits, and AML/HIPAA compliance demonstrations.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State DOI Producer Licensing Requirements; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: completion_certificate_template
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of the certificate template used to generate completion certificates for this course. Certificates are issued to learners upon passing and may be required as evidence during regulatory examinations or producer licensing audits.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; State DOI Producer Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the learner successfully completed the training course and achieved a passing score. This is the principal business event date for compliance tracking, CE credit reporting, and renewal expiration calculation.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the training course in the compliance training catalog and on certificates of completion (e.g., AML-101, HIPAA-202, SUIT-301). Used for regulatory reporting and cross-system reference.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the course content, learning objectives, and regulatory topics covered (e.g., AML red flags, HIPAA minimum necessary standard, suitability analysis under NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation). Used in the compliance training catalog and regulatory examination documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: course_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the compliance training course as it appears in the learning management system and on certificates (e.g., 'Anti-Money Laundering Fundamentals for Insurance Producers', 'HIPAA Privacy and Security for Life Insurance Operations').
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course in the compliance curriculum. 'active' courses are available for enrollment; 'retired' courses are superseded by newer versions; 'draft' courses are under development; 'pending_approval' courses await regulatory or compliance officer sign-off.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: Classification of the course as mandatory (required for all or a defined audience by regulation or company policy), elective (optional professional development), remedial (assigned following a compliance finding or exam failure), or refresher (periodic renewal of a previously completed mandatory course).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: course_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the course content (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Tracks curriculum updates driven by regulatory changes, new NAIC model regulations, IRS rule changes, or updated AML/BSA guidance. Completion records must reference the version in effect at time of completion.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training course record was first created in the compliance training catalog. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX, NAIC market conduct examination standards, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/906; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The modality through which the training course is delivered to learners. Determines scheduling, platform requirements, and completion tracking mechanisms. 'assessment_only' applies to courses where learners test out of content.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: delivery_platform
attributes.description: Name of the learning management system (LMS) or platform through which the course is delivered and completion records are tracked (e.g., Cornerstone OnDemand, Workday Learning, SAP SuccessFactors, Absorb LMS). Used for system-of-record reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated or required seat time for the training course expressed in minutes. Used for scheduling, continuing education (CE) credit hour calculations, and regulatory reporting of training hours completed.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240 (CE Credit Hours)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the training course becomes effective and available for enrollment. Completions recorded on or after this date are credited against the current version. Aligns with regulatory effective dates for updated compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Training Requirements; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: ethics_course_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies ethics training requirements for licensed producers or employees. Ethics CE credits are separately tracked and reported to state Departments of Insurance for producer license renewal.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Ethics CE Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the learner's completion credit for this course expires and renewal is required to maintain compliance. Calculated as completion_date plus renewal_frequency_months. Null for one-time completion courses. Drives automated renewal reminder and compliance gap reporting.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Annual Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: hipaa_course_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Course Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule training requirements under 45 CFR §164.530(b). True triggers HIPAA compliance tracking and periodic completion verification for all workforce members with access to protected health information (PHI).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(b); HHS Office for Civil Rights

attributes.name: is_ce_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course has been approved by one or more state Departments of Insurance for continuing education (CE) credit toward producer license renewal. True triggers CE credit reporting workflows upon completion.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI CE Requirements

attributes.name: is_renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic renewal of this training course is required to maintain compliance. True for recurring mandatory courses such as annual AML/BSA and biennial HIPAA training; False for one-time completion courses.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: jurisdiction_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes or 'ALL' indicating the jurisdictions for which this course satisfies a regulatory training requirement. Supports state-specific CE credit reporting to Departments of Insurance and multi-state compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training course record was most recently modified. Tracks curriculum updates, version changes, and status transitions for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/906; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance line of business to which this training course applies. Determines which licensed producers or employees are required to complete the course. 'variable' applies to variable life and variable annuity products subject to SEC/FINRA oversight.
attributes.references: NAIC Lines of Business Classification; SEC Variable Products; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a learner may attempt the course assessment before escalation or remedial action is required. Null indicates unlimited attempts. Supports compliance enforcement workflows for mandatory regulatory training.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the learner's course assessment. 'pass' indicates the passing_score_threshold was met; 'fail' triggers remedial assignment; 'incomplete' indicates the course was started but not finished; 'waived' indicates a regulatory or management-approved exemption from completion.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Training Requirements; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum assessment score (expressed as a percentage, e.g., 70.00 = 70%) required to achieve a passing status and receive credit for course completion. Used to validate compliance with regulatory training standards and to trigger remedial assignment if not met.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months after initial completion before the course must be retaken to maintain compliance (e.g., 12 for annual AML refresher, 24 for biennial HIPAA training). Null indicates a one-time completion requirement with no renewal obligation.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Annual Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the training course is retired and no longer available for new enrollments. Completions after this date are not credited. Null if the course is currently active with no planned retirement.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: score_achieved
attributes.description: Percentage score achieved by the learner on the course assessment (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Compared against passing_score_threshold to determine pass/fail status. Retained for regulatory examination evidence and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: stoli_course_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) Training Course Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course covers Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) awareness and prevention training. STOLI training is required for producers in states with NAIC Life Insurance Consumer Disclosure Model Regulation compliance obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Consumer Disclosure Model Regulation; State DOI STOLI Regulations

attributes.name: suitability_course_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies suitability training requirements for annuity and life insurance product sales under the NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation #275 or FINRA Rule 2111. True triggers suitability compliance tracking for licensed producers.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation #275; FINRA Rule 2111; SEC Regulation Best Interest

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended audience for this course, specifying roles, departments, or license types required to complete it (e.g., 'All licensed producers', 'Claims adjusters', 'New business underwriters', 'All employees with access to PHI'). Used to drive automated training assignment workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

attributes.name: variable_product_course_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is specific to variable life (VUL) or variable annuity products subject to SEC and FINRA oversight. True requires completion tracking for FINRA-registered representatives and broker-dealer compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Variable Products Regulations; FINRA Rule 1240; FINRA Rule 2111

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for waiving the training completion requirement for a specific learner (e.g., 'Equivalent training completed at prior employer', 'Subject matter expert exemption', 'Regulatory grandfather provision').
