Required when pass_fail_status is 'waived' for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; SOX Section 302; FinCEN AML Training Requirements

products.name: compliance_training_completion
products.description: Transactional record of an individual's completion of a required compliance training course. Captures the employee or agent, course completed, completion date, score achieved, pass/fail status, certificate number, expiration date, and training delivery platform. Supports regulatory demonstration that AML, HIPAA, suitability, and ethics training obligations are met for all licensed producers and employees.

attributes.name: compliance_training_completion_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each compliance training completion record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SOX Section 302/404; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: certificate_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Training completions generate CE certificates, course completion documentation, and credit reporting records required for license maintenance and regulatory compliance. Essential for producer licensin

attributes.name: certificate_outbound_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.outbound_notice. Business justification: Training completions trigger certificate delivery notices and CE credit reporting communications to employees and state regulators. Real business process: compliance training certificate distribution

attributes.name: delivery_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: When training is vendor-delivered, tracking the vendor is essential for CE credit reporting, audit trails, and vendor performance evaluation. Tracks vendor delivering training for completion record va

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.license. Business justification: CE credits earned through training apply to specific state licenses for renewal. License_id links training completion to the license being renewed, enabling automated CE compliance tracking and renewa

attributes.name: primary_compliance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual (employee or licensed producer/agent) who completed the training course. Links to the party master for the trainee.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; DOL ERISA fiduciary training requirements

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the compliance training course that was completed. Links to the course master record containing course details, regulatory mapping, and required passing criteria.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this training course by the trainee. A value greater than 1 indicates a retake following a prior failed attempt. Used to track remediation compliance and identify trainees requiring additional support.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: ce_credit_reported_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CE credit hours were reported to the state Department of Insurance or NIPR. Populated when ce_credit_reported_flag is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; NIPR

attributes.name: ce_credit_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CE credit hours for this completion have been reported to the applicable state Department of Insurance or NIPR. True = reported; False = pending reporting. Drives CE reporting workflow and compliance gap identification.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; NIPR

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued by the training platform or regulatory body upon successful course completion. Serves as the primary proof-of-completion identifier for regulatory audits and market conduct examinations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the trainee completed the training course. This is the principal business event date used for regulatory compliance demonstration, continuing education credit reporting, and obligation fulfillment tracking.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: completion_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this training completion record, typically generated by the Learning Management System (LMS) or compliance training platform. Used for audit trail and regulatory demonstration purposes.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training completion record. 'completed' indicates the trainee passed; 'failed' indicates the trainee did not meet the passing threshold; 'in_progress' indicates the course is underway; 'waived' indicates a regulatory waiver was granted; 'overdue' indicates the deadline has passed without completion; 'withdrawn' indicates the enrollment was cancelled.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: Regulatory or functional category of the training course. Drives compliance obligation tracking and regulatory reporting. AML_BSA maps to FinCEN requirements; HIPAA maps to 45 CFR §164; suitability maps to NAIC Model Regulation; fiduciary maps to DOL ERISA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AML_BSA|HIPAA|suitability|ethics|continuing_education|product_training|fiduciary|cybersecurity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; DOL ERISA; FINRA Rule 1240; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: course_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total seat time or duration of the training course in minutes as defined by the course design. Used for CE credit hour calculation and regulatory reporting of training hours.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; State Departments of Insurance CE requirements

attributes.name: course_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the training course content completed by the trainee. Ensures regulatory compliance is demonstrated against the correct content version, particularly important when course content is updated to reflect regulatory changes.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; NAIC Model Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training completion record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation point for SOX and regulatory examination purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 4511 (books and records)

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education (CE) credit hours awarded upon successful completion of the course. Used for state DOI producer license renewal reporting and FINRA CE compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training was delivered to the trainee. Distinguishes between self-paced eLearning, virtual instructor-led, in-person classroom, blended, on-the-job, and externally-provided training. Relevant for CE credit eligibility and regulatory acceptance.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; State Departments of Insurance CE requirements

attributes.name: delivery_platform
attributes.description: Name of the learning management system (LMS) or training delivery platform through which the course was administered (e.g., Cornerstone OnDemand, Workday Learning, LIMRA eLearning, RegEd, Kaplan Financial). Used for system-of-record reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit code of the trainee at the time of training completion. Used for compliance reporting by department, cost allocation, and organizational analytics.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory or organizational deadline by which the training must be completed. Used for overdue tracking, escalation workflows, and compliance gap reporting.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trainee was enrolled or assigned to the training course. Used to calculate time-to-completion and to track compliance with mandatory enrollment deadlines.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training certification or credit expires and recertification is required. Drives renewal obligation scheduling and producer license maintenance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA Annual Training Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is mandatory for the trainee based on their role, license type, or regulatory obligation. True = mandatory compliance training; False = voluntary or elective training.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training completion satisfies a specific external regulatory requirement (True) as opposed to an internal organizational policy requirement only (False). Drives regulatory reporting and examination evidence packages.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulations; FINRA Rule 1240; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; SOX Section 302; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: job_role_code
attributes.description: Code representing the trainee's job role or position at the time of training completion (e.g., AGENT, UNDERWRITER, CLAIMS_ADJ, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER). Determines applicable mandatory training curriculum and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; DOL ERISA; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction whose continuing education or compliance training requirement this completion satisfies. Relevant for state DOI-mandated producer continuing education and state-specific AML training requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of assessment attempts permitted for this course as defined by the training policy or regulatory requirement. Captured at completion for audit immutability.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: NAIC-assigned National Producer Number (NPN) uniquely identifying the licensed producer across all states. Used for multi-state CE credit reporting to state DOIs and NIPR (National Insurance Producer Registry) reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; NIPR (National Insurance Producer Registry); State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Binary outcome of the training assessment indicating whether the trainee met the minimum passing score threshold. 'not_applicable' is used for awareness-only courses with no scored assessment.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score percentage required to pass the training course assessment, as defined by the regulatory body or organizational policy at the time of completion. Captured at completion for audit immutability.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework or governing body whose training obligation this completion satisfies (e.g., AML_BSA for FinCEN requirements, HIPAA for privacy training, SOX for internal controls attestation, ERISA for fiduciary training). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AML_BSA|HIPAA|SOX|ERISA|FINRA|NAIC|IRS_7702|SEC|state_DOI|ORSA_ERM — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; SOX Section 302/404; DOL ERISA; FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Model Regulations; SEC; IRS IRC §7702

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the trainee on the course assessment, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used to determine pass/fail status against the minimum passing score threshold and to document regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Suitability Model Regulation; FinCEN AML/BSA Program Requirements

attributes.name: time_spent_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes the trainee spent engaged with the training course content, as recorded by the LMS. May differ from course duration for self-paced courses. Used for CE credit validation and engagement analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; State Departments of Insurance CE requirements

attributes.name: trainee_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who completed the training course. Captured at time of completion for audit and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164; FINRA Rule 1240; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: trainee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the individual completing the training, distinguishing between internal employees, licensed producers/agents, registered representatives, TPAs, and contractors. Determines applicable regulatory training obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employee|licensed_producer|broker|registered_representative|third_party_administrator|contractor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; DOL ERISA; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this training completion record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards; FINRA Rule 4511

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the compliance officer or supervisor who approved the training waiver. Required for SOX control documentation and regulatory examination evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal waiver was granted exempting the trainee from completing this training course. When True, waiver_reason must be populated. Used for regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for granting a training waiver, such as equivalent prior certification, regulatory exemption, or role change. Required when waiver_flag is True. Supports regulatory examination evidence.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; FINRA Rule 1240; State Departments of Insurance

products.name: policy_form_approval
products.description: Master record of state DOI filings for policy forms, rider forms, endorsement forms, and premium rate schedules. For form filings: captures form number, form type (base policy, rider, endorsement, application), product line, filing method (prior approval, file-and-use, use-and-file), state, submission/approval dates, approval reference, and form status. For rate filings: captures filing type (new rate, rate revision, LTC rate increase), actuarial justification reference, proposed effective date, approval status, rate change percentage, and DOI response details. Ensures only approved forms and rates are used in each jurisdiction, supports state rate regulation compliance, and serves as the single source of truth for all form and rate approval status across all jurisdictions.

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each policy form or rate filing approval record. Primary key for the policy_form_approval data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Form filing costs (actuarial review, legal counsel, state filing fees) are tracked by product development cost center for product profitability analysis and budget management.

attributes.name: filing_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Form filing services (SERFF filing agents, actuarial consultants for rate justification, legal counsel for regulatory review) are commonly outsourced. Tracks vendor providing form filing and actuarial

attributes.name: form_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Form approvals require the actual policy form documents, rate manuals, actuarial certifications, and DOI approval letters. Essential for state form filing workflow and approved form library management

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ifrs17_contract_group. Business justification: Form approvals determine product features that drive IFRS 17 contract grouping (profitability classification, cohort year, measurement model, coverage period). Product design determines IFRS 17 accoun

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Form approvals are entity-specific (each legal entity must file for approval in each jurisdiction where it operates). Fundamental regulatory filing requirement for product distribution.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Form approvals are state-specific approvals of product plans for sale in each jurisdiction. Each approval record ties to the plan being approved. Critical for determining which plans can be sold in wh

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Form approvals are version-specific - when a plan version changes (benefits, rates, terms), new state approvals are required. More granular than plan-level linking. Essential for version control, stat

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Policy form approvals are regulatory filings that fulfill specific state DOI obligations. The obligation defines the filing type and requirements.

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Policy form approvals must comply with state-specific insurance regulations. The approval describes the filing, while the regulation describes the state-specific rules governing form approval.

attributes.name: acord_form_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Association for Cooperative Operations Research and Development (ACORD) Form Reference
attributes.description: The ACORD standard form number or reference that corresponds to this filing, if the filed form is based on or aligned with an ACORD industry-standard form template. Supports interoperability with industry data exchange standards.

attributes.name: actuarial_justification_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the actuarial memorandum or actuarial certification document that supports the rate filing, including loss ratio analysis, experience data, and rate adequacy demonstration. Required for rate filings per state DOI requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); State DOI Rate Filing Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state DOI formally approved the form or rate filing. Null if the filing is pending, disapproved, or withdrawn.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the form or rate filing with the state DOI. Drives whether the form or rate may be used in the jurisdiction. Deemed approved applies when the DOI has not acted within the statutory review period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: company_filing_reference
attributes.description: Internal company-assigned reference number used to track the filing within the company's compliance and policy administration systems, independent of the SERFF or DOI reference numbers.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Filing Standards; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: company_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company submitted its formal response to DOI objections or requests for additional information. Tracks responsiveness within the regulatory review cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: conditional_approval_conditions
attributes.description: Description of conditions or modifications required by the DOI as part of a conditional approval. The company must satisfy these conditions before or concurrent with use of the form or rate. Populated only when approval_status is 'conditionally_approved'.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy form approval record was first created in the compliance data product, capturing the initial data entry or system ingestion event.

attributes.name: deemed_approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the filing is deemed approved by operation of law because the DOI did not act within the statutory review period. Calculated as submission_date plus review_period_days. Null if the DOI acted before the deadline.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: disapproval_reason
attributes.description: The stated reason provided by the state DOI for disapproving the form or rate filing. Populated only when approval_status is 'disapproved'. Used to guide remediation and refiling efforts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: doi_approval_reference
attributes.description: The official approval reference number, certificate number, or acknowledgment identifier issued by the state Department of Insurance (DOI) upon approval of the filing. Used to evidence regulatory compliance during market conduct examinations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: doi_objection_details
attributes.description: Narrative description of objections, deficiency letters, or requests for additional information issued by the state DOI during the review process. Captures the substance of regulatory concerns requiring company response.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approved form or rate schedule becomes effective for use in new policy issuance or in-force policy administration within the jurisdiction. For rate filings, this is the proposed or approved rate effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the form or rate approval expires or is superseded, after which the form or rate may no longer be used for new business. Null for approvals with no defined expiration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the purpose and scope of the filing, including key changes from prior versions, new product features, benefit modifications, or regulatory compliance updates driving the submission.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF Filing Requirements; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: The regulatory filing method required by the jurisdiction for this form or rate filing. Prior approval requires DOI approval before use; file-and-use allows use upon filing; use-and-file allows use before filing; informational is for notice only.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal compliance officer, actuary, or product manager responsible for managing this filing through the regulatory approval process.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the filing submission, as issued by the state Department of Insurance (DOI) or the company's internal filing tracking system (e.g., SERFF tracking number or company-assigned filing ID).
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing); State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: form_edition_date
attributes.description: The edition date printed on the form document, typically in MM-YYYY format, identifying the specific version of the form. Used to distinguish between successive revisions of the same form number.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: The official form number assigned by the company to uniquely identify the policy form, rider form, endorsement form, application form, or rate schedule document. Used to reference the specific document version in policy administration systems.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Standards; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: form_title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the policy form, rider, endorsement, or rate schedule as it appears on the filed document (e.g., 'Term Life Insurance Policy', 'Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) Rider', 'Long-Term Care (LTC) Inflation Protection Endorsement').

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: Classification of the filed document indicating whether it is a base policy form, rider, endorsement, application form, rate schedule, or amendment. Determines the regulatory review pathway and approval requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filed policy form has been reviewed and confirmed to comply with IRC Section 7702 life insurance tax qualification requirements, including the Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) or Guideline Premium Test (GPT). Critical for life insurance tax treatment.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 7702; IRS Revenue Ruling; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_currently_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the form or rate is currently approved and authorized for use in the jurisdiction as of the current date. Derived from approval_status and effective/expiration dates; serves as the operational compliance gate for policy issuance systems.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: is_in_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether the form or rate schedule is actively being used in new business issuance or in-force policy administration within the jurisdiction. Distinguishes approved-but-not-deployed forms from actively deployed ones.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code identifying the jurisdiction in which this form or rate filing was submitted to the Department of Insurance. Ensures only approved forms and rates are used in each specific jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC State DOI Filing Requirements; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: ltc_rate_increase_percentage
attributes.description: For Long-Term Care (LTC) insurance rate increase filings, the specific percentage increase in LTC premiums requested from the DOI. Subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny and actuarial justification requirements under NAIC LTC model regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI LTC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: mec_test_type
attributes.description: Identifies the IRC Section 7702 compliance test methodology applied to the policy form: Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) or Guideline Premium Test (GPT). Determines Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) status thresholds. Not applicable for annuity or non-life products.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 7702; IRS IRC Section 7702A; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: naic_product_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Product Code
attributes.description: The NAIC standardized product code assigned to the insurance product type associated with this filing. Used for regulatory reporting, market conduct analysis, and cross-state filing coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Coding Matrix; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: outside_counsel_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the external legal counsel or regulatory affairs firm engaged to support the filing, if applicable. Used for complex or contested filings requiring specialized regulatory legal expertise.

attributes.name: prior_form_number
attributes.description: The form number of the previously approved version that this filing supersedes or replaces. Enables traceability of form revision history and supports grandfathering analysis for in-force policies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line to which the filed form or rate schedule applies (e.g., Term Life, Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Variable Universal Life (VUL), Annuity, Long-Term Care (LTC), Disability Income (DI), Group Life). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|indexed_universal_life|fixed_indexed_annuity|variable_annuity|ltc|disability_income|group_life|spia — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Line Classifications; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: For rate filings, the percentage change in premium rates proposed or approved relative to the current in-force rates. Positive values indicate a rate increase; negative values indicate a rate decrease. Null for form-only filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Regulation

attributes.name: rate_filing_type
attributes.description: For rate filings, classifies the nature of the rate action: new rate schedule introduction, revision to existing rates, Long-Term Care (LTC) rate increase filing, or withdrawal of a rate schedule. Null for pure form filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: review_period_days
attributes.description: The statutory or regulatory maximum number of days the DOI has to review and act on the filing before it is deemed approved (for prior approval states). Varies by state and product line.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: sec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: For variable product filings, the SEC registration number (e.g., Form S-1, Form N-4 registration) associated with the product. Required for variable life and variable annuity products subject to SEC registration. Null for non-variable products.
attributes.references: SEC Securities Act of 1933; SEC Form N-4; FINRA Rules

attributes.name: serff_tracking_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) Tracking Number
attributes.description: The unique tracking number assigned by the NAIC's System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) platform when the filing is submitted electronically. Primary cross-reference identifier for SERFF-based filings.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF System; State DOI Electronic Filing Requirements

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the form or rate filing was formally submitted to the state Department of Insurance. Marks the start of the regulatory review clock for prior approval filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy form approval record was most recently updated, reflecting any changes to filing status, approval dates, DOI responses, or other attributes.

attributes.name: variable_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filed form or rate applies to a variable insurance or annuity product subject to SEC and FINRA oversight in addition to state DOI regulation. Triggers additional compliance requirements for variable product filings.
attributes.references: SEC Securities Act of 1933; FINRA Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company voluntarily withdrew the filing from DOI review. Populated only when approval_status is 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

products.name: rate_filing
products.description: Record of premium rate and non-forfeiture value filings submitted to state DOIs for approval or notification. Captures product line, filing type (new rate, rate revision, LTC rate increase), filing method (prior approval, file-and-use), state, actuarial justification reference, proposed effective date, DOI submission date, approval status, approved effective date, and rate change percentage. Supports compliance with state rate regulation requirements.

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate filing record in the compliance domain. Primary key for the rate_filing data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: actuarial_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Rate filings require actuarial certification, often from external consulting actuaries. Tracks third-party actuarial firm providing rate justification, loss ratio analysis, and actuarial memorandum fo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Rate filing preparation costs (actuarial analysis, regulatory filings, legal review) are significant and tracked by cost center for product line profitability and pricing adequacy analysis.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Rate filings are made by specific legal entities in specific jurisdictions. Fundamental regulatory filing requirement - rates must be approved for each entity in each state.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance product (e.g., term life, whole life, LTC, annuity) for which the rate filing is submitted. Links the filing to the specific product line subject to rate regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Regulation

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: Rate filings reference specific approved policy forms (rate changes apply to approved form numbers). Links rate filing to the form approval for product launch coordination and regulatory compliance va

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Rate filings fulfill regulatory obligations for premium rate approval. The obligation defines the filing type and jurisdiction requirements.

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Rate filings must comply with state-specific rate filing regulations. The filing describes the submission, while the regulation describes the state-specific rules governing rate approval.

attributes.name: affected_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of in-force policies in the filing jurisdiction that will be affected by the proposed rate change. Required for LTC rate increase filings and used by the DOI to assess consumer impact. Derived from policy administration system counts at time of filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Rate Increase Impact Assessment Requirements

attributes.name: annual_premium_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total annual premium impact (in USD) of the proposed rate change across all affected in-force policies in the filing jurisdiction. Used by the DOI to assess the financial impact on policyholders and by the company for financial planning.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Increase Impact Assessment Requirements

attributes.name: approved_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DOI-approved rates become effective for use. May differ from the proposed effective date if the DOI modifies the requested effective date as a condition of approval. Null until the filing reaches approved status.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: approved_rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: The rate change percentage as finally approved by the state DOI, which may differ from the originally proposed rate_change_percentage if the DOI required modifications as a condition of approval. Null until the filing is approved.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: certifying_actuary_credential
attributes.description: Professional actuarial credential of the certifying actuary (e.g., FSA — Fellow of the Society of Actuaries, MAAA — Member of the American Academy of Actuaries). Validates the actuary's qualification to certify the rate filing.
attributes.references: American Academy of Actuaries (AAA) Qualification Standards; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: certifying_actuary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified actuary (Fellow of the Society of Actuaries or equivalent) who certified the actuarial memorandum and rate justification supporting this filing. Required by most state DOIs as part of the rate filing package.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Actuarial Certification Requirements

attributes.name: consumer_notice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate filing requires individual policyholder notification of the rate change (e.g., LTC rate increases, in-force rate revisions). Triggers the consumer notification workflow in the policy administration system.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Consumer Notification Requirements; HIPAA

attributes.name: consumer_notice_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which policyholder notification letters were sent for the rate change. Required for LTC rate increases and other in-force rate revisions requiring consumer notice. Null if consumer_notice_required_flag is false.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Consumer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate filing record was first created in the compliance system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: disapproval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the state Department of Insurance (DOI) formally disapproved the rate filing. Null for filings that are approved, pending, or withdrawn. Triggers the company's obligation to respond or refile.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: disapproval_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the state DOI's stated reason(s) for disapproving the rate filing. Null for approved or pending filings. Used to guide refiling strategy and actuarial revisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: doi_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the state Department of Insurance (DOI) formally approved the rate filing. Null for filings that are pending, disapproved, or withdrawn. Distinct from the approved effective date, which is when rates go into use.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: doi_objection_count
attributes.description: Number of formal objections or deficiency letters issued by the state DOI during the review of this rate filing. Each objection requires a company response and may extend the review timeline. Tracks regulatory engagement complexity.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: doi_objection_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company submitted its response to the DOI's most recent objection or deficiency letter. Used to track compliance with DOI response deadlines and filing timeline management.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: doi_objection_response_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the company's response to the most recent DOI objection or deficiency letter. Failure to respond by this date may result in automatic disapproval or withdrawal of the filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: experience_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the actuarial experience period used to develop the loss ratios, claim costs, and other actuarial assumptions supporting the rate filing. Together with the start date, defines the historical data window underlying the actuarial justification.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: experience_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the actuarial experience period used to develop the loss ratios, claim costs, and other actuarial assumptions supporting the rate filing. Defines the historical data window underlying the actuarial justification.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: external_counsel_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of external legal counsel engaged to support the rate filing, if applicable. Relevant for contested filings, LTC rate increase hearings, or filings requiring regulatory negotiation.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the rate filing, summarizing the nature of the rate change, the affected policy forms, the actuarial basis, and any special circumstances (e.g., LTC rate stabilization, experience deterioration, regulatory mandate). Used for internal compliance tracking and DOI correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: Regulatory filing method required by the state for this rate filing. Prior approval requires DOI approval before use; file-and-use allows immediate use upon filing; use-and-file requires filing after use; no-filing-required states are exempt. Determines the compliance timeline and approval workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Regulation Framework; State DOI Rate Filing Statutes

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the rate filing, typically generated by the company or the state DOI system (e.g., SERFF tracking number or company-assigned filing reference). Used for cross-referencing with state DOI portals and internal compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing); State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal compliance or actuarial staff member responsible for preparing and submitting the rate filing. Used for accountability tracking and DOI correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate filing with the state DOI. Tracks the filing from initial draft through submission, regulatory review, and final disposition (approved, disapproved, or withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|pending_review|approved|disapproved|withdrawn|conditionally_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the DOI public or administrative hearing for this rate filing. Null if hearing_required_flag is false. Tracks the regulatory hearing calendar for compliance management.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Administrative Hearing Procedures

attributes.name: hearing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state DOI has required a public hearing or administrative hearing as part of the rate filing review process. Hearings are common for large LTC rate increases and may significantly extend the approval timeline.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Administrative Hearing Procedures

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code identifying the state Department of Insurance (DOI) to which this rate filing is submitted. Each state has independent rate regulation authority; a single product rate change may require separate filings per state.
attributes.references: NAIC State DOI Jurisdiction; ISO 3166-2:US State Codes

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Regulatory line of business classification for the rate filing as defined by NAIC and state DOI reporting standards. Determines the applicable rate regulation statutes and actuarial certification requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line of Business Definitions; State DOI Rate Regulation

attributes.name: loss_ratio_current
attributes.description: The current (pre-filing) loss ratio for the affected product line and policy forms, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 = 85%). A key actuarial metric supporting the rate change justification; high loss ratios indicate inadequate current rates.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: loss_ratio_projected
attributes.description: The projected loss ratio following implementation of the proposed rate change, expressed as a decimal. Demonstrates to the DOI that the revised rates will achieve actuarial adequacy and rate stability.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: ltc_rate_increase_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is a Long-Term Care (LTC) rate increase filing, which is subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny, consumer notification requirements, and actuarial certification standards under the NAIC LTC Insurance Model Regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation (#641); State DOI LTC Rate Increase Requirements

attributes.name: policy_form_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of policy form numbers (as approved by the DOI) to which the rate filing applies. Policy forms are the standardized contract templates approved by the state DOI; rate filings are tied to specific approved forms.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Form Filing Requirements; State DOI Form Approval Standards

attributes.name: prior_filing_number
attributes.description: Filing number of the immediately preceding approved rate filing for the same product line and jurisdiction. Establishes the rate revision history chain and allows comparison of current vs. prior approved rates.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Broad insurance product line classification for the rate filing (e.g., Term Life, Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Long-Term Care (LTC), Annuity). Determines applicable regulatory framework and actuarial standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|ltc|annuity|disability_income|accidental_death — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Line Classifications; State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: proposed_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company proposes the new or revised rates to become effective for new business or in-force policies. Subject to DOI approval for prior approval states; may differ from the approved effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in premium rates proposed in this filing relative to the currently approved rates. Positive values indicate a rate increase; negative values indicate a rate decrease. Critical metric for actuarial justification and DOI review. For LTC rate increase filings, subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Rate Increase Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: rate_change_type
attributes.description: Directional classification of the rate change proposed in this filing. Distinguishes between rate increases, decreases, no-change filings (e.g., non-forfeiture value updates), and new rate filings for newly introduced products.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: rate_stability_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filing includes an actuarial certification of rate stability as required by the NAIC LTC Insurance Model Regulation. Rate stability certifications attest that the proposed rates are not expected to require future increases.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation (#641); Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: serff_tracking_number
attributes.description: Tracking number assigned by the NAIC System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) upon submission of the rate filing to the state DOI. Serves as the authoritative cross-reference between the company's internal records and the state regulatory portal.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF System; State DOI Electronic Filing Requirements

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate filing was formally submitted to the state Department of Insurance (DOI). Marks the start of the regulatory review clock for prior approval states and establishes the compliance timeline for file-and-use states.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate filing record was most recently updated in the compliance system. Supports audit trail requirements, change tracking, and data lineage for the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company voluntarily withdrew the rate filing from DOI review. Null for filings not withdrawn. Withdrawal may occur due to actuarial revisions, regulatory feedback, or business strategy changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

products.name: orsa_report
products.description: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) report record capturing the enterprise's internal assessment of risk and capital adequacy per NAIC ORSA Model Act. Tracks report year, filing jurisdiction (lead state), risk categories assessed (insurance risk, market risk, credit risk, operational risk, liquidity risk), capital adequacy conclusion, stress test scenarios applied, board approval date, and submission date to lead state DOI. Supports ERM program documentation.

attributes.name: orsa_report_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Report ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ORSA report record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: consulting_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: ORSA reports frequently use external actuarial consultants for stress testing, capital modeling, ERM framework design, and report preparation. Tracks vendor providing ORSA actuarial and consulting ser

attributes.name: embedded_value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.embedded_value. Business justification: ORSA risk assessment informs embedded value calculations (risk discount rates, required capital, cost of capital). Both are forward-looking valuation exercises requiring consistent risk assumptions.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: ORSA reports are filed by lead state for specific legal entities or insurance groups. Regulatory filing requirement - each entity must conduct own risk and solvency assessment.

attributes.name: prior_year_report_orsa_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ORSA report record from the immediately preceding report year. Enables year-over-year comparison of risk profiles, capital adequacy conclusions, and stress test results for trend analysis and regulatory continuity review.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: rbc_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rbc_calculation. Business justification: ORSA reports cite RBC ratios and capital adequacy conclusions. Direct business relationship - ORSA is qualitative risk assessment, RBC is quantitative capital measurement. Both filed to same regulator

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: ORSA reports fulfill regulatory obligations for enterprise risk assessment reporting. The obligation defines the submission deadline.

attributes.name: report_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: ORSA produces comprehensive risk assessment reports, board presentations, and regulatory submissions to lead state. Essential for enterprise risk reporting and regulatory compliance. Replaces text ref

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: ORSA reports are prepared for specific annual assessment periods aligned with report_period definitions. Links ORSA to the period for enterprise risk management reporting calendar. Replaces denormaliz

attributes.name: report_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_version. Business justification: ORSA reports are versioned documents (draft, board-approved, filed). Links ORSA to the report version for approval workflow, version control, and regulatory submission tracking.

attributes.name: actuarial_valuation_system
attributes.description: Name of the actuarial valuation system used to generate reserve calculations, cash flow projections, and capital adequacy models supporting the ORSA (e.g., MoSes, AXIS, Prophet). Supports model governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Actuarial Guideline XLVIII; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company's Board of Directors formally approved the ORSA report. Board approval is a mandatory prerequisite for regulatory submission under the NAIC ORSA Model Act and demonstrates governance oversight of the ERM program.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Act (#305)

attributes.name: capital_adequacy_conclusion
attributes.description: Overall conclusion of the ORSA regarding the company's capital adequacy relative to its risk profile. Reflects the board-approved determination of whether current and projected capital levels are sufficient to support the risk exposures identified across all assessed risk categories.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 3; NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Framework

attributes.name: confidentiality_protection_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company has requested confidential treatment of the ORSA report under NAIC ORSA Model Act Section 5, which provides that the ORSA report is a privileged and confidential document not subject to public disclosure or subpoena.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505) Section 5; State DOI Confidentiality Provisions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ORSA report record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX controls and NAIC corporate governance standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Act (#305)

attributes.name: credit_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit risk (counterparty default, reinsurer credit risk, bond issuer default) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: erm_program_owner
attributes.description: Name or title of the senior executive responsible for the ERM program and the ORSA process (e.g., Chief Risk Officer). Establishes accountability for the risk assessment and capital adequacy conclusions documented in the report.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual; IAIS Insurance Core Principles (ICP 16)

attributes.name: insurance_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether insurance risk (mortality, morbidity, longevity, lapse, catastrophe) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report. Insurance risk is a primary risk category under the NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual Section 2.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ORSA report record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions through the drafting, review, and approval lifecycle for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Act (#305)

attributes.name: ldti_impact_disclosed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Impact Disclosed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ORSA report includes disclosure of the financial impact of FASB ASC 944 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) on the company's capital position and reserve adequacy. Relevant for companies reporting under GAAP.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: lead_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the lead state Department of Insurance (DOI) to which the ORSA report is filed. The lead state is the domiciliary state of the insurance holding company group per NAIC ORSA Model Act.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Insurance Holding Company System Regulatory Act (#440)

attributes.name: liquidity_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether liquidity risk (cash flow mismatches, surrender spikes, asset liquidation constraints) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report. Particularly relevant for life insurers with annuity and UL/IUL product lines.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: market_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether market risk (interest rate, equity, credit spread, currency, real estate) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report. Critical for life insurers with significant investment portfolios and ALM exposures.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2; IAIS ICP 16

attributes.name: material_risk_changes
attributes.description: Narrative description of material changes to the company's risk profile since the prior ORSA report, including new risk exposures, changes in risk concentrations, or significant shifts in the business mix (e.g., new FIA product launch, reinsurance treaty restructuring, ALM repositioning).
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: naic_group_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Group Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC-assigned group code identifying the insurance holding company group for which the ORSA is filed. Used for regulatory cross-referencing with NAIC financial filings and the NAIC Financial Data Repository.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Company Licensing and Financial Analysis

attributes.name: operational_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether operational risk (process failures, system outages, fraud, third-party vendor risk, cyber risk) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: pbr_compliance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ORSA report confirms compliance with NAIC Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) requirements under VM-20 (life) and VM-21 (annuities). PBR compliance is a key component of the ORSA capital adequacy assessment for life and annuity writers.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual (VM-20, VM-21); NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: projection_horizon_years
attributes.description: Number of years covered by the forward-looking capital adequacy projection in ORSA Section 3. NAIC guidance recommends a minimum 3-year projection horizon; life insurers with long-duration liabilities typically use 5 years.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505) Section 3; NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: rbc_ratio_current
attributes.description: Current Risk-Based Capital (RBC) ratio as of the assessment period end date, expressed as a percentage of Total Adjusted Capital (TAC) to Authorized Control Level (ACL) RBC. A key capital adequacy metric required in ORSA Section 3 capital projections. Classified confidential as a sensitive financial indicator.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Model Act; NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505) Section 3; NAIC Life RBC Instructions

attributes.name: rbc_ratio_projected
attributes.description: Projected RBC ratio over the forward-looking planning horizon (typically 3–5 years) under the base scenario. Supports ORSA Section 3 prospective solvency assessment requirements demonstrating capital adequacy under normal business conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505) Section 3; NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Model Act; NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: regulatory_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead state DOI formally acknowledged acceptance of the ORSA report submission. Null if the report has not yet been accepted or was rejected.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_feedback_notes
attributes.description: Narrative notes capturing the substance of regulatory feedback or follow-up inquiries received from the lead state DOI following ORSA report submission. Null if no feedback has been received.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); State DOI Examination and Filing Procedures

attributes.name: regulatory_feedback_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead state DOI has provided formal feedback or follow-up inquiries regarding the submitted ORSA report. Triggers the regulatory response workflow when set to True.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); State DOI Examination and Filing Procedures

attributes.name: reinsurance_risk_mitigation_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ORSA report includes disclosure of reinsurance arrangements used as risk mitigation tools, including YRT, coinsurance, and modified coinsurance treaties, and their impact on net retained risk and capital requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Reinsurance Model Law (#785); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ORSA report, typically formatted as ORSA-{YEAR}-{STATE}-{SEQUENCE}. Used for regulatory correspondence and filing tracking with the lead state Department of Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ORSA report, tracking progression from internal drafting through board approval to regulatory submission and acceptance by the lead state DOI. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|board_approved|submitted|accepted|rejected|superseded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Version number of the ORSA report document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented when material revisions are made following board review, regulatory feedback, or resubmission after rejection.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: report_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the ORSA assessment is conducted and reported. NAIC ORSA Model Act requires annual filing; this field identifies the reporting period year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

attributes.name: reputational_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether reputational risk (brand damage, regulatory sanctions, social media exposure, market conduct violations) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: risk_appetite_statement_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Board-approved Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) referenced in this ORSA report. Links the ORSA risk assessment to the governing risk appetite framework, demonstrating alignment between risk tolerances and capital adequacy conclusions.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 1; IAIS ICP 16

attributes.name: risk_tolerance_breaches
attributes.description: Number of risk tolerance limit breaches identified during the ORSA assessment period. A non-zero value triggers mandatory disclosure in the ORSA report and requires documentation of management actions taken to remediate the breach.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 1; IAIS ICP 16

attributes.name: strategic_risk_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether strategic risk (competitive positioning, M&A execution, distribution channel risk, product development risk) was formally assessed and documented in this ORSA report.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2; IAIS ICP 16

attributes.name: stress_test_count
attributes.description: Total number of stress test scenarios applied in the ORSA assessment. Includes both deterministic stress scenarios and stochastic scenario sets used to evaluate capital adequacy under adverse conditions per NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual Section 2.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2; IAIS ICP 16

attributes.name: stress_test_scenarios_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the key stress test scenarios applied in the ORSA, including scenario names and brief descriptions (e.g., 'Interest rate shock +300bps, Pandemic mortality shock 150% of base, Equity market decline -40%, Mass lapse event'). Supports ERM documentation and regulatory review.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual Section 2

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ORSA report was formally submitted to the lead state Department of Insurance. Must occur within the regulatory deadline (typically within 60 days of fiscal year-end or upon request by the lead state commissioner).
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505); State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: worst_case_rbc_ratio
attributes.description: Lowest RBC ratio observed across all stress test scenarios applied in the ORSA. Represents the most adverse capital position under the defined stress scenarios and is a key indicator of capital resilience for regulatory review.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Model Act (#505) Section 2; NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Model Act; NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment Guidance Manual

products.name: erisa_plan_filing
products.description: Record of ERISA-governed employer-sponsored plan filings and compliance activities managed by the company for group life and annuity products. Captures plan sponsor, plan type (group life, 401k annuity, pension), Form 5500 filing reference, plan year, DOL filing date, fiduciary designation, prohibited transaction exemption (PTE) references, and compliance status. Supports DOL fiduciary rule compliance and ERISA reporting obligations.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_filing_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Filing ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ERISA plan filing record in the compliance domain. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: ERISA (29 U.S.C. § 1001 et seq.); DOL ERISA Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: form_5500_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: ERISA filings generate Form 5500 documents, plan documents, Schedule A, and DOL correspondence. Critical for ERISA compliance and DOL filing workflow. Replaces text reference with structured FK.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: ERISA filings are made by the legal entity that is the insurance carrier for the plan. DOL filing requirement is entity-specific - carrier entity must file Form 5500 Schedule A.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer or organization that sponsors the ERISA-governed plan, responsible for plan administration and fiduciary obligations.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent regulatory filing record in the compliance.regulatory_filing product that captures the broader DOL submission context for this ERISA plan filing.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Reporting Requirements; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: ERISA plan filings (Form 5500, etc.) fulfill specific DOL regulatory obligations. The obligation defines the due date and filing requirements.

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: ERISA plan filings (Form 5500) are prepared for specific plan years that map to report_period. Links filing to the period for employee benefit plan reporting calendar. Replaces denormalized dates.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_provision. Business justification: ERISA plan tax treatment (qualified vs non-qualified) affects tax provision. ERISA compliance impacts tax deductibility of contributions and tax treatment of plan assets.

attributes.name: tpa_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: ERISA filings often involve third-party administrators (TPAs) for plan administration, Form 5500 preparation, and DOL filing. Tracks TPA vendor responsible for ERISA plan compliance and filing service

attributes.name: active_participant_count
attributes.description: Number of currently employed participants actively accruing benefits or eligible to participate in the plan as of the plan year end date, as reported on Form 5500.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103; DOL Form 5500 Schedule H/I Instructions

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized plan administrator or fiduciary approved the Form 5500 filing for submission to the DOL.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized plan administrator or fiduciary who reviewed and approved the Form 5500 filing prior to DOL submission, as required by ERISA Section 104.

attributes.name: audit_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent qualified public accounting firm engaged to perform the ERISA-required plan audit. Reported on Form 5500 Schedule H when audit is required.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103(a)(3)(A); DOL Form 5500 Schedule H Instructions

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance determination for this ERISA plan filing, reflecting whether all DOL, IRS, and fiduciary requirements have been satisfied or whether remediation actions are pending.
attributes.references: ERISA (29 U.S.C. § 1001 et seq.); DOL Enforcement; IRS Employee Plans Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ERISA plan filing record was first created in the compliance data product, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts reported in this filing record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency plan reporting for multinational plan sponsors.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the filing was submitted past the applicable due date. Used to calculate DOL penalty exposure under the Delinquent Filer Voluntary Compliance (DFVC) program.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 502(c)(2); DOL DFVC Program; DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2560.502c-2

attributes.name: dfvc_program_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Delinquent Filer Voluntary Compliance (DFVC) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing was submitted under the DOL's Delinquent Filer Voluntary Compliance (DFVC) program to reduce penalties for late Form 5500 filings.
