attributes.references: DOL DFVC Program; ERISA Section 502(c)(2); DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2560.502c-2

attributes.name: dol_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Department of Labor formally accepted the Form 5500 filing as complete and compliant via the EFAST2 system.

attributes.name: dol_filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Form 5500 or related ERISA filing was submitted to the Department of Labor via the EFAST2 electronic filing system.
attributes.references: DOL EFAST2 System; ERISA Section 104(a)(1); DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2520.104a-5

attributes.name: dol_rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Department of Labor rejected the Form 5500 filing, requiring resubmission. Populated only when filing_status is 'rejected'.

attributes.name: erisa_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the fidelity bond required under ERISA Section 412 to protect the plan against losses due to fraud or dishonesty by plan officials who handle plan funds.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 412; DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2550.412-1; DOL Form 5500 Schedule H

attributes.name: extension_due_date
attributes.description: Extended deadline for Form 5500 submission when a Form 5558 extension has been granted. Applicable only when extension_filed_flag is True.

attributes.name: extension_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Form 5558 extension of time to file was submitted to the IRS for this plan year, granting an additional 2.5 months beyond the original due date.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5558; ERISA Section 104(a)(1); DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2520.104a-5

attributes.name: fiduciary_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the fiduciary role assigned under ERISA for this plan. Identifies whether the company acts as named fiduciary, investment manager, plan administrator, trustee, or co-fiduciary, determining the scope of fiduciary liability.
attributes.references: ERISA Sections 3(21), 402, 403; DOL Fiduciary Rule (29 CFR 2510.3-21)

attributes.name: fiduciary_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity designated as the named fiduciary for the plan under ERISA Section 402, responsible for plan management and investment decisions.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to this ERISA plan filing, used for cross-referencing with DOL submissions, internal compliance tracking, and audit trails.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Form 5500 Filing Requirements; NAIC Compliance Standards

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ERISA plan filing submission. Tracks the filing from initial preparation through DOL acceptance or rejection and any subsequent amendments.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Form 5500 Filing Requirements; NAIC Compliance Standards

attributes.name: form_5500_type
attributes.description: Specific variant of the DOL Form 5500 filed for this plan. Form 5500 is for large plans (100+ participants), 5500-SF for small plans, and 5500-EZ for one-participant plans.
attributes.references: DOL Form 5500 Instructions; ERISA Section 104; IRC Section 6058

attributes.name: independent_audit_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent Qualified Public Accountant (IQPA) Audit Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an independent qualified public accountant (IQPA) audit is required for this plan filing. Required for large plans (generally 100+ participants) under ERISA Section 103(a)(3)(A).
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103(a)(3)(A); DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2520.103-1; DOL Form 5500 Instructions

attributes.name: insurance_contract_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance or annuity contract held by the plan and reported on Form 5500 Schedule A (Insurance Information). Identifies the nature of the company's product involvement in the plan.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103; DOL Form 5500 Schedule A Instructions

attributes.name: late_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Form 5500 was submitted after the applicable due date (original or extended), triggering potential DOL penalty assessment under ERISA Section 502(c)(2).
attributes.references: ERISA Section 502(c)(2); DOL Delinquent Filer Voluntary Compliance (DFVC) Program

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Total number of plan participants (active, retired, and separated with vested benefits) as of the beginning of the plan year, used to determine Form 5500 variant (large vs. small plan) and applicable audit requirements.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103; DOL Form 5500 Instructions; DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2520.103-1

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed by the DOL for late or deficient Form 5500 filing under ERISA Section 502(c)(2). May be reduced through the DFVC program.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 502(c)(2); DOL DFVC Program; DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2560.502c-2

attributes.name: plan_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity designated as plan administrator under ERISA Section 3(16)(A), responsible for Form 5500 filing obligations and participant disclosures.

attributes.name: plan_assets_amount
attributes.description: Total fair market value of plan assets as of the end of the plan year, as reported on Form 5500 Schedule H or I. Used for large-plan audit threshold determination and DOL financial reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103(b); DOL Form 5500 Schedule H; FASB ASC 960

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Official name of the ERISA-governed employer-sponsored plan as registered with the DOL and referenced in Form 5500 filings (e.g., 'ABC Corp Group Life Insurance Plan').

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned by the plan sponsor to uniquely identify the plan within the sponsor's portfolio, as required on DOL Form 5500 filings.

attributes.name: plan_sponsor_ein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) for the plan sponsor, required on Form 5500 filings and used for tax compliance and DOL identification purposes.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Requirements; DOL Form 5500 Instructions; IRC Section 6109

attributes.name: plan_sponsor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the employer or organization sponsoring the ERISA-governed plan. Used for DOL filings, Form 5500 reporting, and fiduciary compliance documentation.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ERISA-governed plan by benefit structure and product type. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, Form 5500 schedules, and fiduciary obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: group_life|group_annuity|401k_annuity|pension|defined_benefit|defined_contribution — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA Sections 3(2), 3(3); DOL Form 5500 Schedule Guidance

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or firm responsible for preparing the Form 5500 filing on behalf of the plan sponsor or plan administrator.

attributes.name: pte_reference
attributes.description: Reference number(s) for any DOL Prohibited Transaction Exemption (PTE) applicable to this plan filing, permitting otherwise prohibited transactions under ERISA Section 406. Common PTEs include PTE 84-24 and PTE 2020-02.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 406; DOL PTE 84-24; DOL PTE 2020-02; DOL Reg. 29 CFR 2550

attributes.name: pte_type
attributes.description: Identifies the specific type or category of Prohibited Transaction Exemption (PTE) claimed for this plan, such as PTE 84-24 (insurance and annuity transactions) or PTE 2020-02 (investment advice fiduciary).
attributes.references: ERISA Section 406; DOL PTE 84-24; DOL PTE 2020-02

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason(s) provided by the DOL EFAST2 system for rejecting the Form 5500 filing, used to guide resubmission and remediation.

attributes.name: schedule_a_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Form 5500 Schedule A (Insurance Information) must be attached to this filing because the plan holds insurance contracts or annuity contracts issued by an insurance company.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103; DOL Form 5500 Schedule A Instructions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ERISA plan filing record, used for change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: jurisdiction_license
products.description: Master record of the company's Certificate of Authority (COA) and licenses to transact insurance business in each state and territory. Captures jurisdiction, license type (life, annuity, variable life, variable annuity), license number, effective date, renewal date, renewal status, authorized lines of business, and any license conditions or restrictions imposed by the DOI. Ensures the company only writes business in jurisdictions where it is properly licensed.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_license_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each jurisdiction license record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the jurisdiction_license data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Data Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Licenses are issued to legal entities. Fundamental regulatory relationship - each legal entity must be licensed in jurisdictions where it operates. Required for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Jurisdiction licenses are maintained to satisfy regulatory obligations for authority to transact insurance business. The license describes the authority granted, while the obligation describes the req

attributes.name: admitted_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is admitted (licensed and subject to state guaranty fund protection), non-admitted, or writing on a surplus lines basis in the jurisdiction. Affects policyholder protections and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Surplus Lines Model Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: annual_statement_filing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the company must file its NAIC Annual Statement (statutory financial statement) with the DOI for this jurisdiction. Typically March 1 for most states but may vary. Drives the regulatory filing calendar.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Filing Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: authorized_lines_of_business
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the specific lines of business authorized under this license (e.g., Life, Annuity, Variable Life, Variable Annuity, Accident and Health). Governs which product types may be sold in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Lines of Business Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company's designated compliance officer or regulatory contact responsible for managing the license and DOI relationship in this jurisdiction. Used for regulatory correspondence and examination coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: domicile_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS code for the state in which the company is domiciled (chartered). Distinguishes the home state license from foreign state licenses and determines which state's insurance laws govern the company's primary regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Holding Company Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Authority or license became effective and the company was first authorized to transact the specified line of business in the jurisdiction. Marks the start of the binding authorization period.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current license term expires and renewal is required to maintain authorization. Null for perpetual licenses that do not require periodic renewal. Drives the renewal calendar and compliance alerts.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: The Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) of the company as registered with the IRS. Required on certain state DOI filings and tax-related regulatory submissions. Also known as Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN).
attributes.references: IRS TIN Requirements; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: guaranty_fund_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is a member of the state life and health guaranty association for this jurisdiction. Admitted carriers are typically required to be members. Relevant for policyholder protection disclosures and NAIC reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Association Model Act; State Guaranty Fund Requirements

attributes.name: is_domestic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license is a domestic (home state) license (True) or a foreign state license (False). Domestic licenses are issued by the state of domicile; foreign licenses are issued by other states where the company is admitted to transact business.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Holding Company Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body that issued the license (e.g., California Department of Insurance, New York State Department of Financial Services). Identifies the specific DOI or equivalent authority responsible for the license.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: issuing_authority_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (address, phone, or email) for the issuing DOI or regulatory authority. Used for correspondence, renewal submissions, and regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: State DOI Contact Directories; NAIC State Contact Registry

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the state or territory jurisdiction (e.g., California, New York, Puerto Rico, District of Columbia). Complements the state code for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Jurisdiction Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state or territory code identifying the jurisdiction in which the license is held (e.g., CA, NY, TX, PR, DC). Used to validate that the company is authorized to write business in the state before policy issuance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC Jurisdiction Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: last_examination_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent market conduct or financial examination conducted by the DOI in this jurisdiction. Used to track examination cycles and anticipate upcoming examinations per NAIC examination standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: license_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DOI has imposed any conditions, restrictions, or limitations on this license. When True, the license_conditions field contains the details. Conditions may restrict product types, distribution channels, or require enhanced reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or limitations imposed by the DOI on this license. Examples include restrictions on writing new business, requirements for enhanced consumer disclosures, or limitations on specific product features. Populated only when license_condition_flag is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The official license or Certificate of Authority (COA) number assigned by the state Department of Insurance (DOI) to the company for the given jurisdiction. This is the externally-known business identifier used in regulatory filings and correspondence with the DOI.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the jurisdiction license as maintained by the state DOI. Active indicates the company is authorized to transact business. Suspended or revoked statuses trigger immediate cessation of new business writing in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance license by product line authorized. Determines which lines of business the company is permitted to transact in the jurisdiction. Variable product types are subject to additional SEC/FINRA oversight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: life|annuity|variable_life|variable_annuity|accident_health|disability_income — promote to reference product if additional lines are added]
attributes.references: NAIC Lines of Business Codes; IRC Section 7702; SEC Variable Products Regulation

attributes.name: minimum_capital_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum capital and surplus amount required by the jurisdiction's DOI for the company to maintain its license, denominated in USD. Linked to Risk-Based Capital (RBC) requirements and solvency monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Instructions; State DOI Capital Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: The five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the insurer. Used in all NAIC regulatory filings, state financial examinations, and market conduct reporting to uniquely identify the company across all jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Licensing Database; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: next_examination_due_date
attributes.description: The anticipated or scheduled date for the next DOI examination in this jurisdiction. Typically every 3-5 years per NAIC standards. Used for compliance planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional compliance notes, DOI correspondence summaries, or internal observations related to the license. Used by the compliance team to document material events not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: original_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company was first granted a license in this jurisdiction for this license type, regardless of subsequent renewals. Establishes the historical tenure of authorization in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: rbc_action_level
attributes.description: The current Risk-Based Capital (RBC) action level applicable to the company in this jurisdiction. Determines the degree of regulatory intervention required. Company Action Level triggers internal remediation; higher levels trigger DOI intervention.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) for Life and Health Insurers Model Act; State DOI RBC Requirements

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this jurisdiction license record was first created in the compliance data product. Provides audit trail for record provenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this jurisdiction license record was most recently updated in the compliance data product. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: registered_agent_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the registered agent for service of process in the jurisdiction. Required for legal and regulatory correspondence. Maintained as confidential business contact information.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; State Corporation Law

attributes.name: registered_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the company's registered agent for service of process in the jurisdiction. Required by most states as a condition of licensure. The registered agent receives legal notices and regulatory correspondence on behalf of the company.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; State Corporation Law

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended or lapsed license was reinstated by the DOI. Null if the license has never been reinstated. Marks the resumption of authorization to transact business.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company submitted the renewal application to the state DOI. Used to confirm timely filing and to calculate days-before-expiration for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application and associated fees must be submitted to the DOI to avoid lapse of authorization. May differ from expiration_date where the DOI requires advance filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount paid or payable to the state DOI for license renewal, denominated in USD. Tracked for budgeting, accounts payable, and regulatory expense reporting.
attributes.references: State DOI Fee Schedules; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the renewal process for the license. Tracks whether the renewal application has been submitted, is under DOI review, approved, or has lapsed. Critical for compliance monitoring to ensure continuous authorization.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the type of restriction or condition imposed on the license by the DOI. Enables structured reporting and monitoring of restricted licenses across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DOI permanently revoked the license, if applicable. Null for active or suspended licenses. A revoked license requires a new application process to re-enter the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: statutory_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The amount of securities or cash deposited with the state treasury or DOI as a condition of licensure in the jurisdiction, denominated in USD. Required by certain states as a financial security requirement for admitted carriers.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Deposit Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: statutory_deposit_type
attributes.description: Type of asset held on deposit with the state as a condition of licensure. Determines the nature of the financial security arrangement and applicable valuation methods under SAP.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Deposit Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DOI suspended the license, if applicable. Null for licenses that have never been suspended. Triggers immediate cessation of new business writing and notification to the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason provided by the DOI for suspending the license. Populated only when suspension_date is not null. Used for regulatory response planning and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: variable_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license authorizes the sale of variable insurance products (variable life or variable annuity) that are subject to SEC and FINRA oversight in addition to state DOI regulation. True triggers additional compliance checks.
attributes.references: SEC Variable Products Regulation; FINRA Rules; NAIC Model Variable Annuity Regulation

products.name: compliance_policy
products.description: Master record of internal compliance policies, procedures, and standards governing the enterprise's regulatory obligations. Captures policy name, policy category (AML, HIPAA, suitability, SOX, ORSA, market conduct), regulatory driver, policy owner, effective date, review cycle, last review date, next review date, approval authority, and policy status (draft, active, under review, retired). Serves as the authoritative compliance policy inventory for the enterprise.

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance_policy_id of the newer policy that replaces this one when status is 'superseded'. Enables forward-chaining of policy version history for audit and regulatory examination purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: comm_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.comm_template. Business justification: Compliance policies define required communication templates for privacy notices, disclosures, and regulatory notifications. Real business process: policy-driven communication standards ensuring consis

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Policy ownership by department implies cost center responsibility for compliance program costs (policy maintenance, training, monitoring). Finance needs cost attribution for compliance program budgeti

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Compliance policies are themselves documents requiring version control, approval documentation, and distribution tracking. Essential for policy lifecycle management and regulatory examination support.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Compliance policies are often entity-specific (different entities may have different policy versions based on domicile jurisdiction, lines of business, regulatory requirements). Required for policy go

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Compliance policies require employee ownership for review cycles, approval workflows, attestation management, and regulatory examination responses. Policy owner accountability is essential for governa

attributes.name: secondary_prior_policy_compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance_policy_id of the immediately preceding version of this policy. Enables backward-chaining of policy version history for complete audit trail and regulatory examination evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: aml_program_element
attributes.description: For AML/BSA category policies, identifies which of the five required BSA/AML program pillars this policy addresses: Internal Controls, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) Reporting, Training, or Independent Testing. Null for non-AML policies.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements 31 U.S.C. 5318; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The individual, role, or governance body authorized to approve this compliance policy (e.g., 'Board of Directors', 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Audit Committee', 'Chief Risk Officer'). Required for SOX and ORSA governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; DOL ERISA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current version of this compliance policy was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Required for SOX control documentation and regulatory examination evidence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual

attributes.name: associated_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Document management reference or identifier for the operational procedures and standards that implement this compliance policy. Links the high-level policy to its supporting procedural documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: attestation_frequency_months
attributes.description: The required frequency of compliance attestation associated with this policy, expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual attestation). Null if attestation_required is False.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: attestation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic compliance attestation by designated employees, officers, or agents is required under this policy. Supports SOX Section 302 CEO/CFO certifications and annual compliance attestation workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: board_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance policy requires formal approval by the Board of Directors or its Audit/Risk Committee. True for policies mandated by ORSA, SOX, or state DOI requirements to have board-level governance.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; SOX Section 302/404; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance policy record was first created in the enterprise compliance policy inventory system. Supports audit trail requirements and record lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance policy becomes or became binding and enforceable across the enterprise. Marks the start of the policy's active lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: erisa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance policy applies to employer-sponsored retirement plans and group products subject to DOL ERISA fiduciary standards. True for policies governing qualified plan products, fiduciary obligations, and prohibited transaction exemptions.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA Section 404; DOL Fiduciary Rule; NAIC

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance policy ceases to be effective, if applicable. Null for open-ended policies. Used to manage policy sunset and replacement workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: external_audit_subject
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance policy and its associated controls are subject to external audit review (e.g., SOX external auditor testing, state DOI market conduct examination, or independent AML program audit).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN BSA/AML Independent Testing

attributes.name: hipaa_safeguard_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Safeguard Type
attributes.description: For HIPAA category policies, classifies the type of HIPAA safeguard the policy implements: Administrative (workforce training, access management), Physical (facility access controls), or Technical (encryption, audit controls). Null for non-HIPAA policies.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Security Rule; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: irc_7702_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance policy governs IRC Section 7702 life insurance tax qualification requirements, including the Guideline Premium Test (GPT) and Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) for life insurance products.
attributes.references: IRS IRC Section 7702; IRS IRC Section 72; NAIC

attributes.name: jurisdiction_scope
attributes.description: The geographic or regulatory jurisdictions to which this compliance policy applies. May be 'Federal', a specific state code (e.g., 'NY', 'CA'), 'All States', or a comma-separated list of state codes. Supports multi-state compliance management.
attributes.references: NAIC; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states plus territories)

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent formal review of this compliance policy was completed and documented. Used to track review currency and regulatory compliance with review cycle requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance policy record was most recently modified in the enterprise compliance policy inventory system. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: lines_of_business_scope
attributes.description: The insurance lines of business or product types to which this compliance policy applies (e.g., 'Life Insurance', 'Annuity', 'Variable Products', 'All Lines'). Enables targeted policy applicability filtering for underwriting, claims, and product teams.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the next formal review of this compliance policy must be completed. Derived from last_review_date plus review_cycle_months but stored explicitly to support calendar-driven compliance workflows and escalation alerts.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: orsa_risk_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Risk Category
attributes.description: The ORSA/ERM risk category to which this compliance policy is mapped, indicating which enterprise risk domain the policy governs. Supports ORSA reporting to state regulators and the enterprise ERM framework.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; IAIS Insurance Core Principles

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: The organizational department or business unit responsible for owning and maintaining this compliance policy (e.g., 'Legal & Compliance', 'AML Compliance', 'Privacy Office', 'Internal Audit').
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: policy_category
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or functional category governing the compliance policy. Classifies the policy by its principal regulatory driver. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AML_BSA|HIPAA|Suitability|SOX|ORSA_ERM|Market_Conduct|Tax_Compliance|Fiduciary_ERISA|Privacy|Fraud_Prevention — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; FinCEN; HIPAA; SOX; DOL ERISA; IRS IRC 7702; SEC/FINRA

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the compliance policy's purpose, scope, and key requirements. Provides business context for the policy and supports search and discovery in the enterprise compliance policy inventory.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Official title of the compliance policy document as it appears in the enterprise policy register (e.g., 'Anti-Money Laundering Program Policy', 'HIPAA Privacy Policy', 'Suitability Review Policy').
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the compliance policy document, used for cross-referencing in regulatory filings, audit reports, and examination responses. Distinct from insurance policy numbers.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the compliance policy document. 'draft' indicates the policy is being authored; 'active' indicates it is in force; 'under_review' indicates a scheduled or triggered review is in progress; 'retired' indicates the policy has been decommissioned; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the document type within the compliance policy hierarchy: 'policy' (high-level directive), 'standard' (specific requirements), 'procedure' (step-by-step instructions), 'guideline' (recommended practices), or 'framework' (overarching governance structure).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; SOX Section 302; ISO 19600 Compliance Management

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The primary governing body or regulatory authority whose requirements this policy addresses (e.g., NAIC, State DOI, SEC, FINRA, IRS, DOL, FinCEN). Drives routing of policy updates when regulatory guidance changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAIC|State_DOI|SEC|FINRA|IRS|DOL|FASB|FinCEN|IAIS|ACORD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC; SEC; FINRA; IRS; DOL; FinCEN; FASB ASC 944 LDTI

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: The specific regulation, statute, or regulatory body requirement that mandates or drives this compliance policy (e.g., 'Bank Secrecy Act 31 U.S.C. 5318', 'HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164', 'IRC Section 7702', 'NAIC Model Regulation 275', 'DOL ERISA Section 404'). Provides the authoritative legal basis for the policy.
attributes.references: NAIC; FinCEN BSA; HIPAA; IRS IRC; DOL ERISA; SEC Rule 17a-4; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: The mandated frequency of periodic policy review expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial). Drives the compliance policy review calendar and next review date calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: review_trigger
attributes.description: The event or condition that triggered the most recent policy review. 'scheduled' for routine periodic reviews; 'regulatory_change' for reviews driven by new or amended regulations; 'exam_finding' for reviews triggered by market conduct examination findings; 'incident' for reviews triggered by compliance incidents; 'merger_acquisition' for reviews triggered by corporate transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN BSA/AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The enterprise risk rating assigned to this compliance policy based on the severity of regulatory exposure and potential financial or reputational impact of non-compliance. Drives prioritization of monitoring, testing, and remediation activities.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual; IAIS Insurance Core Principles; ERM Framework

attributes.name: training_frequency_months
attributes.description: The required frequency of compliance training associated with this policy, expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual training). Null if training_required is False. Drives training calendar scheduling.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Training Requirements; FINRA Rule 1250; NAIC

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether mandatory compliance training is required for employees and/or agents as part of this policy's implementation and ongoing compliance. Drives training curriculum assignment and completion tracking.
attributes.references: FinCEN BSA/AML Training Requirements; FINRA Rule 1250; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook

attributes.name: variable_product_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance policy applies to variable life insurance or variable annuity products subject to SEC and FINRA oversight. True for policies governing VUL, variable annuity, and registered products.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; FINRA Rule 2330; NAIC

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier of the compliance policy document following a major.minor versioning convention (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Enables version tracking across the policy lifecycle and supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: violation_consequence
attributes.description: Description of the regulatory, financial, or disciplinary consequences for violation of this compliance policy, including potential penalties, fines, license revocation, or corrective action requirements. Supports risk-based prioritization of policy enforcement.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Handbook; FinCEN Civil Money Penalties; SOX Section 906

products.name: regulatory_change
products.description: Master record tracking regulatory changes, new legislation, and rule amendments that impact the company's operations. Captures regulation name, issuing body (NAIC, state DOI, SEC, FINRA, IRS, DOL, FinCEN, FASB), change type (new regulation, amendment, guidance, model law adoption), effective date, comment period deadline, impacted business areas, impact assessment status, implementation owner, and implementation deadline. Enables proactive regulatory change management.

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each regulatory change record. Primary key for the regulatory_change data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Data Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
