attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency in which the amount is recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217, FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this line item is posted. Represents the specific account in the chart of accounts (e.g., asset, liability, revenue, expense account).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry line represents an intercompany transaction that must be eliminated during consolidation.

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the intercompany partner legal entity for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: journal_entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry type: standard (routine operational entries), adjusting (period-end adjustments), closing (year-end closing entries), reversing (entries that reverse in the next period), reclassification (reclassifying between accounts), or elimination (intercompany elimination entries).

attributes.name: journal_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or module that originated this journal entry line (e.g., policy administration, claims, billing, actuarial, investment management). Enables source system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the business purpose and nature of this journal entry line item. Provides context for financial statement users and auditors.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items within a single journal entry.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry line record was last modified. Enables change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this journal entry line was posted to the general ledger. Determines the financial reporting period in which the transaction is recognized.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance product line (e.g., term life, whole life, universal life, annuities) to which this transaction relates. Enables product-level profitability analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Product Line Reporting

attributes.name: reinsurance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents direct business, ceded reinsurance, or assumed reinsurance. Critical for statutory reporting and reinsurance recoverables tracking.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this journal entry line translated into the reporting currency for consolidated financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the reporting currency for consolidated financial statements (typically the parent company currency).
attributes.references: ISO 4217, FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry line is a reversal of a previous entry. Used to track corrections and adjustments.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry line is subject to SOX internal control testing and certification requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier from the source transaction system that originated this journal entry line. Enables drill-back to source transaction detail.

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master reference for the enterprise chart of accounts hierarchy. Defines account codes, account names, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, contra), normal balance (debit/credit), financial statement line mapping, SAP vs. GAAP classification, IFRS 17 insurance finance income/expense designation, RBC line mapping, and account active/inactive status. Governs all COA governance and change management processes.
products.reference: Chart of Accounts — NAIC SAP, FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chart of accounts entry. Primary key for the chart of accounts master reference.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying the general ledger account. This is the externally-known business identifier used in all financial transactions and reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger account. Human-readable label used in financial statements and reports.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the account type (e.g., current asset, fixed asset, long-term liability, operating expense).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account. Determines the account's position in the balance sheet or income statement and its behavior in the accounting equation.

attributes.name: approval_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether changes to this account definition require formal approval workflow due to materiality, regulatory impact, or SOX controls.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Control Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: budget_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account participates in the annual budgeting process and budget vs. actual variance reporting.

attributes.name: cash_flow_statement_category
attributes.description: The section of the cash flow statement (operating, investing, or financing activities) where transactions in this account are classified.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows, GAAP

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_description
attributes.description: Extended business description of the account's purpose, usage guidelines, and the types of transactions that should be posted to this account.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chart of accounts entry. Active accounts are available for posting; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting but closed to new transactions.

attributes.name: cost_center_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a cost center dimension is required when posting transactions to this account for expense tracking and allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for accounts denominated in a specific currency. Null for accounts that aggregate multi-currency balances.

attributes.name: dac_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is eligible for deferred acquisition cost (DAC) asset tracking and amortization under insurance accounting standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this account became active and available for use in the general ledger. Supports chart of accounts change management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this account was or will be inactivated and closed to new postings. Null for accounts that remain active indefinitely.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The mapping code used to translate this internal account to external regulatory reporting formats (NAIC Annual Statement, SEC 10-K, state insurance department filings).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: financial_statement_line
attributes.description: The specific line item on the financial statement (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) where this account's balance is reported.

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The classification of this account under US GAAP for external financial reporting and SEC filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth level of this account in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level summary accounts; higher numbers represent more detailed sub-accounts.

attributes.name: ifrs17_classification
attributes.description: The classification of this account under IFRS 17 insurance contracts standard for international financial reporting. Includes insurance finance income/expense designation.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts, International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is used for intercompany transactions requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: ldti_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is impacted by FASB ASC 944 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) accounting standard changes effective 2023.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI)

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this chart of accounts entry. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was last modified. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Assets and expenses typically have debit balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit balances.

attributes.name: parent_account_code
attributes.description: The account code of the parent account in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Used to build roll-up structures for financial reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: posting_allowed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether direct journal entry postings are allowed to this account. Summary accounts typically do not allow direct posting.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Control Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: product_line_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a product line dimension is required when posting transactions to this account for product profitability analysis.

attributes.name: rbc_line_mapping
attributes.description: The specific line item on the NAIC Risk-Based Capital calculation where this account's balance is reported for regulatory capital adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Instructions, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for formal reconciliation of this account balance to supporting documentation or sub-ledgers.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Control Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account requires formal balance sheet reconciliation as part of the monthly or quarterly financial close process.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Control Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: rollup_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a summary/rollup account that aggregates balances from child accounts, or a detail/posting account that receives direct journal entries.

attributes.name: sap_classification
attributes.description: The classification of this account under NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles for regulatory financial reporting to state insurance departments.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: sox_control_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is subject to enhanced Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal controls and audit procedures due to materiality or risk.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category
attributes.description: The classification of this account for federal and state tax return preparation and IRS reporting under IRC Section 7702 and other tax regulations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702, IRS Tax Regulations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this chart of accounts entry. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master entity for enterprise cost center management and expense allocation. Defines organizational cost centers aligned to business units, functional departments, product lines, and distribution channels. Captures cost center code, description, responsible manager, parent cost center hierarchy, allocation basis (headcount, premium volume, policy count, AUM), allocation method (direct, step-down, reciprocal), budget entity flag, legal entity assignment, and effective date range. Supports expense allocation rule definition, budget vs. actual variance reporting, management reporting by organizational unit, product profitability analysis, and statutory expense exhibit reporting to NAIC.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master entity.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit or division that owns this cost center. Used for management reporting and segment analysis.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: cost_center has gl_account_code (STRING) representing the default GL account for postings to this cost center. FK to chart_of_accounts provides referential integrity for expense allocation rules.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel associated with this cost center. Used for channel profitability and commission expense tracking. Null for non-distribution cost centers.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager responsible for budget management and expense approval for this cost center.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity to which this cost center belongs. Required for statutory reporting and intercompany settlement.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Supports roll-up reporting and hierarchical expense allocation. Null for top-level cost centers.

attributes.name: product_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product line associated with this cost center. Used for product profitability analysis and management reporting. Null for shared service cost centers.

attributes.name: queue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.correspondence_queue. Business justification: Cost centers own correspondence queues for expense allocation, budgeting, and operational management. Customer service departments are cost centers managing queues. Essential for operational expense t

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The basis used for allocating expenses from this cost center to other cost centers or products. Determines the driver for expense distribution in management accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used for allocating expenses from this cost center. Direct assigns to final cost objects; step-down cascades through service centers; reciprocal handles mutual services; activity-based uses cost drivers.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year. Used for budget vs. actual variance reporting.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amount. Supports multi-currency budget management.

attributes.name: budget_entity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is a budget-holding entity with its own budget allocation and variance tracking. True if budget is assigned at this level.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the cost center used in financial reporting and general ledger posting. Externally visible code used across financial systems.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, Chart of Accounts Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organizational structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center for reporting and identification purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Only active cost centers accept expense postings.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional category. Determines expense allocation rules and reporting hierarchy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dac_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this cost center are eligible for deferral as acquisition costs under GAAP ASC 944 and LDTI standards. True if DAC-eligible.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cost center becomes active and can accept expense postings. Start of the cost center's validity period.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cost center becomes inactive and no longer accepts expense postings. Null for cost centers with no planned end date.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: Code used for external regulatory and statutory reporting to NAIC, SEC, or other governing bodies. May differ from internal cost center code.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the budget amount is applicable. Four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gaap_expense_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Expense Category
attributes.description: GAAP financial statement expense category for this cost center. Used for ASC 944 and LDTI reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code associated with this cost center for expense posting. Used in chart of accounts mapping.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Level 1 is top-level, increasing numbers indicate deeper nesting. Used for roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_settlement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses from this cost center require intercompany settlement and elimination entries. True if intercompany settlement applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the cost center for internal reference and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: rbc_category
attributes.description: NAIC Risk-Based Capital category for expenses from this cost center. Used in RBC calculation and capital adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: sap_expense_exhibit
attributes.description: NAIC Annual Statement expense exhibit line item to which expenses from this cost center are reported for statutory accounting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: sox_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX internal control requirements for financial close and reporting. True if SOX-controlled.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master record for all legal entities within the insurance holding company structure. Captures legal entity name, domicile state/jurisdiction, NAIC company code, FEIN/TIN, entity type (life insurer, holding company, reinsurer, broker-dealer, service company), state of domicile, RBC filing entity flag, SEC registrant flag, FINRA member flag, intercompany elimination group, consolidation method (full, proportional, equity method), and functional currency. Supports statutory filing by entity, GAAP consolidation hierarchy, intercompany settlement and elimination, and regulatory capital reporting. Serves as the reference master for all finance products requiring legal entity context.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity within the insurance holding company structure. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent legal entity in the holding company organizational hierarchy. Null for the ultimate parent holding company.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent entity in the holding company structure for consolidated reporting purposes.

attributes.name: am_best_rating
attributes.description: Current A.M. Best financial strength rating assigned to the entity, if applicable. Uses A.M. Best rating scale (e.g., A++, A+, A, A-, B++, etc.).

attributes.name: am_best_rating_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the current A.M. Best financial strength rating.

attributes.name: consolidation_method

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: domicile_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country of domicile for the legal entity.

attributes.name: domicile_state
attributes.description: The state or jurisdiction where the entity is legally domiciled and subject to primary regulatory oversight. Uses two-letter state code for US states or jurisdiction name for non-US entities.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this legal entity record became effective in the enterprise system of record.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current operational and legal status of the entity within the holding company structure.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity based on its primary business function within the holding company structure.

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (also known as Taxpayer Identification Number or TIN) issued by the IRS for tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: finra_member_flag

attributes.name: functional_currency

attributes.name: gaap_reporting_entity_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reporting Entity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity prepares standalone GAAP financial statements or is included only in consolidated GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: ifrs17_reporting_entity_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 17 Reporting Entity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is subject to IFRS 17 insurance contracts accounting standard for international financial reporting.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was incorporated or established under applicable law.

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the group of entities for which intercompany transactions and balances must be eliminated during consolidation.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the entity as registered with regulatory authorities and appearing on statutory filings.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier code issued by a Local Operating Unit under the Global LEI System for financial transaction reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: lei_registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the LEI code was initially registered for this entity.

attributes.name: lei_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the LEI code must be renewed to maintain active status.

attributes.name: license_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory license or certificate of authority became effective.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory license or certificate of authority expires, if applicable.

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners for statutory reporting and regulatory identification.

attributes.name: primary_regulator
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory body with oversight authority over this entity (e.g., state insurance department, SEC, FINRA).

attributes.name: rbc_filing_entity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entity is required to file Risk-Based Capital reports with state insurance regulators.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal registered address of the entity as filed with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the legal registered address (suite, floor, building name, etc.).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state
attributes.description: State or province of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: regulatory_license_number
attributes.description: Primary license or certificate of authority number issued by the domicile state or primary regulator.

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the currency used for external financial reporting and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: sap_reporting_entity_flag

attributes.name: sec_registrant_flag

attributes.name: short_name

attributes.name: sox_scope_entity_flag

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was last modified in the system.

products.name: dac_asset
products.description: SSOT for Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) assets and all periodic amortization transactions by policy cohort, product line, issue year, legal entity, and accounting period. Captures DAC capitalized amount, amortization method (GAAP interest-related vs. LDTI straight-line), scheduled and actual periodic amortization amounts, cumulative amortization balance, unamortized DAC balance, VOBA (Value of Business Acquired) component and amortization, shadow DAC adjustment for unrealized gains/losses, IFRS 17 insurance acquisition cash flow asset and release, interest accretion, DAC impairment indicators, LDTI cohort grouping, and variance from prior period. Owns both the asset position and the transactional amortization history. Supports FASB ASC 944 / LDTI DAC amortization schedules, IFRS 17 acquisition cost reporting, and actuarial-to-finance reconciliation.

attributes.name: dac_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DAC asset record. Primary key for the DAC asset entity.

attributes.name: actuarial_assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the actuarial assumption set used for DAC amortization calculations, including mortality, lapse, expense, and interest rate assumptions.

attributes.name: cohort_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the LDTI cohort grouping for DAC amortization purposes. Cohorts are defined by product line, issue year, and underwriting characteristics.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy or policy cohort to which this DAC asset is associated.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: dac_asset has legal_entity_code (STRING) and should FK to legal_entity. DAC assets are owned by legal entities; FK is essential for statutory reporting, RBC calculations, and consolidation.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: DAC assets are capitalized and amortized by product for GAAP reporting. Required for LDTI cohort tracking, financial statement preparation, and product profitability analysis. Links DAC balance to spe

attributes.name: supporting_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: DAC calculations require retention of original policy illustrations, commission schedules, and actuarial memoranda per GAAP/LDTI requirements. Annual DAC amortization audits and assumption change docu

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the actuarial valuation run that produced this DAC asset position and amortization schedule.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM) for which this DAC asset position and amortization are recorded.

attributes.name: actual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Actual amortization expense recognized in the current accounting period. May differ from scheduled due to experience adjustments, policy lapses, or surrenders.

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: Method used to amortize the DAC asset. GAAP Interest-Related follows pre-LDTI guidance; LDTI Straight-Line follows ASU 2018-12; IFRS 17 CSM-Based follows IFRS 17 insurance acquisition cash flow guidance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DAC asset record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_amortization_balance
attributes.description: Total cumulative amortization recognized from policy issuance through the current accounting period.

attributes.name: dac_asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DAC asset. Active indicates ongoing amortization; Fully Amortized indicates complete amortization; Impaired indicates recognized impairment; Terminated indicates policy lapse or surrender.

attributes.name: dac_capitalized_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of acquisition costs capitalized as a DAC asset at policy issuance or acquisition. Includes commissions, underwriting costs, policy issuance expenses, and other directly attributable costs.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DAC asset record became effective, typically the policy issue date or acquisition date.

attributes.name: external_audit_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this DAC asset has been reviewed by external auditors in the current audit cycle.

attributes.name: gaap_reporting_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reporting Basis
attributes.description: Accounting reporting basis under which this DAC asset is recorded. US GAAP follows FASB ASC 944; IFRS follows IFRS 17; Statutory follows NAIC SAP.

attributes.name: ifrs17_acquisition_cash_flow_asset
attributes.business_glossary_term: IFRS 17 Insurance Acquisition Cash Flow Asset
attributes.description: Insurance acquisition cash flow asset recognized under IFRS 17 for acquisition costs directly attributable to a group of insurance contracts.

attributes.name: ifrs17_acquisition_cash_flow_release
attributes.business_glossary_term: IFRS 17 Insurance Acquisition Cash Flow Release
attributes.description: Amount of insurance acquisition cash flow asset released to profit or loss in the current period under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an impairment indicator exists for this DAC asset. True if adverse experience, policy lapses, or other factors suggest the asset may not be recoverable.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: Impairment loss recognized in the current period if the DAC asset is determined to be unrecoverable.

attributes.name: interest_accretion_amount
attributes.description: Interest accretion recognized on the DAC asset balance for the current period under interest-related amortization methods.

attributes.name: issue_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the underlying policies were issued. Used for cohort grouping and amortization tracking.

attributes.name: last_amortization_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amortization transaction for this DAC asset.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DAC asset record was last modified.

attributes.name: ldti_cohort_grouping_key
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Cohort Grouping Key
attributes.description: Composite key identifying the LDTI cohort grouping for this DAC asset. Cohorts are defined by product type, issue year, underwriting class, and other contract characteristics.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product line (e.g., Term Life, Whole Life, Universal Life, Variable Annuity) to which this DAC asset belongs.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the actuarial-to-finance reconciliation for this DAC asset. Reconciled indicates agreement between actuarial and finance systems; Variance Identified indicates discrepancies requiring resolution.

attributes.name: scheduled_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Planned or scheduled amortization amount for the current accounting period based on the amortization method and actuarial assumptions.

attributes.name: shadow_dac_adjustment
attributes.description: Shadow DAC adjustment for unrealized gains or losses on available-for-sale securities or other comprehensive income items that affect DAC amortization under GAAP.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this DAC asset record originated (e.g., actuarial valuation system, policy administration system, general ledger).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this DAC asset is subject to SOX financial reporting controls. True for material DAC balances requiring enhanced audit and control procedures.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DAC asset was fully amortized, impaired, or terminated due to policy lapse or surrender. Null if still active.

attributes.name: unamortized_dac_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unamortized DAC asset balance as of the accounting period end. Calculated as capitalized amount minus cumulative amortization.

attributes.name: variance_from_prior_period
attributes.description: Variance in unamortized DAC balance from the prior accounting period. Calculated as current period unamortized balance minus prior period unamortized balance.

attributes.name: voba_amortization_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value of Business Acquired (VOBA) Amortization Amount
attributes.description: Amortization expense recognized in the current period for the VOBA component of the DAC asset.

attributes.name: voba_component_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value of Business Acquired (VOBA) Component Amount
attributes.description: Value of Business Acquired component included in the DAC asset, arising from business combinations or block acquisitions. Amortized separately from internally generated DAC.

products.name: dac_amortization
products.description: Transactional record of periodic DAC amortization entries by cohort and accounting period. Captures scheduled amortization amount, actual amortization posted, cumulative amortization balance, LDTI cohort grouping, interest accretion component, shadow DAC adjustment, VOBA amortization, and variance from prior period. Supports FASB ASC 944 / LDTI DAC amortization schedules, IFRS 17 insurance acquisition cash flow release, and actuarial-to-finance reconciliation.

attributes.name: dac_amortization_id
attributes.description: Primary key for dac_amortization

attributes.name: actuarial_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the actuarial valuation run that produced the amortization schedule and assumptions used for this DAC amortization calculation.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: dac_amortization has gl_account_code (STRING) and should FK to chart_of_accounts. Amortization entries post to specific GL accounts; FK is essential for financial statement mapping and audit trail.

attributes.name: cohort_definition_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Cohort ID
attributes.description: Reference to the LDTI cohort grouping for this DAC amortization. Cohorts group contracts issued in the same year with similar characteristics per FASB ASC 944 LDTI requirements.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: dac_amortization has cost_center_code (STRING) and should FK to cost_center. Amortization is allocated to cost centers for expense management; FK is essential for cost allocation and variance analysis

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy associated with this DAC amortization entry.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) for which this DAC amortization entry is recorded.

attributes.name: actual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: The actual DAC amortization amount posted to the general ledger for this period. May differ from scheduled due to true-ups or adjustments.

attributes.name: adjustment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the reason for any adjustment or variance from scheduled amortization, providing audit trail and business context.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for this DAC amortization entry. Scheduled entries are routine periodic amortization; other codes indicate adjustments or corrections.

attributes.name: amortization_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the DAC amortization was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate DAC amortization for this entry. Common methods include straight-line, proportional to premium revenue, proportional to estimated gross profits (EGP), or proportional to estimated gross margin.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this DAC amortization entry. Entries must be approved before posting to the general ledger per SOX controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the finance manager or controller who approved this DAC amortization entry for posting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DAC amortization entry was approved for posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DAC amortization record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_amortization_balance
attributes.description: The total cumulative DAC amortization balance from policy inception through the current period. Represents the total amount of DAC that has been expensed to date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this DAC amortization record.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1-4) to which this DAC amortization entry belongs, used for quarterly financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this DAC amortization entry belongs, used for annual financial reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: gaap_amortization_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Amortization Amount
attributes.description: The DAC amortization amount calculated under GAAP accounting standards (FASB ASC 944), used for financial statement reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this DAC amortization expense is posted. Typically an expense account in the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: ifrs17_amortization_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 17 Amortization Amount
attributes.description: The insurance acquisition cash flow amortization amount under IFRS 17 accounting standard, representing the release of acquisition costs allocated to the contractual service margin.

attributes.name: interest_accretion_amount
attributes.description: The interest accretion component applied to the DAC asset balance for this period, representing the time value of money on deferred costs.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DAC amortization record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DAC amortization entry was successfully posted to the general ledger system.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line category for which this DAC amortization applies. Different product lines may have different amortization patterns and regulatory treatment. attributes.name: remaining_dac_balance
attributes.description: The unamortized DAC asset balance remaining on the balance sheet after this period's amortization. Calculated as original DAC less cumulative amortization.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this DAC amortization entry is a reversal of a prior period entry. True if this is a reversal transaction, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sap_amortization_amount
attributes.description: The DAC amortization amount calculated under Statutory Accounting Principles for regulatory reporting to state insurance departments. SAP typically expenses acquisition costs immediately rather than deferring them.

attributes.name: scheduled_amortization_amount
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled DAC amortization amount for this period based on actuarial projections and amortization schedules.

attributes.name: shadow_dac_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment to DAC amortization for unrealized gains or losses on investments backing insurance liabilities, ensuring consistency between asset and liability measurement under shadow accounting principles.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system that generated this DAC amortization entry (e.g., actuarial valuation system, policy administration system, or manual entry).

attributes.name: variance_from_prior_period
attributes.description: The difference between current period actual amortization and prior period actual amortization, used for trend analysis and variance reporting.

attributes.name: voba_amortization_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value of Business Acquired (VOBA) Amortization Amount
attributes.description: The amortization amount for Value of Business Acquired intangible asset, tracked separately from DAC but often managed in parallel for acquired blocks of business.

products.name: statutory_reserve
products.description: SSOT for finance-booked statutory (SAP) reserve balances by policy cohort, product line, valuation basis, legal entity, and reporting period. Captures statutory reserve amount, PBR (Principle-Based Reserving) reserve per VM-20 (life) and VM-21 (variable annuity), CARVM reserve (annuity), CRVM reserve (life), reserve basis (CSO mortality table, valuation interest rate), reinsurance ceded reserve, net amount at risk (NAR), and reserve adequacy margin. Reported to state DOIs and NAIC on the annual statement Exhibits 5-8. Distinct from actuarial domain reserve calculations which are the source computations — this product owns the finance-booked statutory reserve position after actuarial hand-off and management sign-off.
products.reference: Statutory Reserve — NAIC SAP, VM-20, VM-21, CARVM

attributes.name: actuarial_sign_off_date

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total statutory reserve amount booked by finance for this policy cohort and reporting period, expressed in USD. This is the finance-booked position after actuarial hand-off and management sign-off.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Exhibit 5, Exhibit 6, Exhibit 7, Exhibit 8

attributes.name: appointed_actuary_name
attributes.description: The name of the appointed actuary who certified the reserve adequacy for this reporting period. Required for NAIC actuarial opinion filing.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference

attributes.name: booking_date

attributes.name: carvm_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method (CARVM) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: The CARVM reserve component for annuity contracts calculated using Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method. Null if not applicable to the product line.

attributes.name: cohort_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the policy cohort grouping used for reserve aggregation. Cohorts are typically defined by issue year, product type, and underwriting class for reserve modeling purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this statutory reserve record was first created in the finance system. Part of the audit trail for record lineage.

attributes.name: crvm_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commissioners Reserve Valuation Method (CRVM) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: The CRVM reserve component for life insurance policies calculated using Commissioners Reserve Valuation Method. Null if not applicable to the product line.

attributes.name: cso_mortality_table_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commissioners Standard Ordinary (CSO) Mortality Table Code
attributes.description: The CSO mortality table used for statutory reserve valuation. Values: 2017CSO (2017 Commissioners Standard Ordinary), 2001CSO (2001 CSO), 1980CSO (1980 CSO), 2012IAM (2012 Individual Annuity Mortality), CUSTOM (Custom approved table).

attributes.name: deficiency_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Additional reserve held when the statutory reserve basis produces a reserve lower than the net premium reserve, ensuring reserve adequacy. Required under NAIC guidelines when deficiency exists.

attributes.name: exhibit_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line number on the NAIC annual statement exhibit (Exhibit 5, 6, 7, or 8) where this reserve is reported. Used for regulatory filing reconciliation.

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: The reserve amount calculated under GAAP (FASB ASC 944) for financial statement reporting. Differs from statutory reserve due to different recognition and measurement principles.

attributes.name: ifrs17_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards 17 (IFRS 17) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: The reserve amount calculated under IFRS 17 for international financial reporting. Applicable for companies reporting under IFRS standards.

attributes.name: management_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when management approved the statutory reserve amount for booking in the general ledger. Part of the SOX-controlled financial close process.

attributes.name: net_amount_at_risk
attributes.description: The net amount at risk (NAR) for life insurance policies, calculated as death benefit minus account value or cash surrender value. Represents the insurance company's exposure to mortality risk.

attributes.name: net_statutory_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The net statutory reserve amount after reinsurance ceded, calculated as statutory_reserve_amount minus reinsurance_ceded_reserve_amount. This is the net position reported on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: pbr_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The PBR reserve component calculated per VM-20 (life) or VM-21 (variable annuity) for policies subject to principle-based reserving. Null if policy is not subject to PBR.

attributes.name: prior_period_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The statutory reserve amount from the prior reporting period for this same policy cohort. Used for reserve movement analysis and variance reporting.

attributes.name: product_line_code

Values: WL (Whole Life), UL (Universal Life), IUL (Indexed Universal Life), VUL (Variable Universal Life), TERM (Term Life), SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity), FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity), VA (Variable Annuity), LTCI (Long-Term Care Insurance), DI (Disability Income). attributes.name: rbc_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The contribution of this reserve to the company's Risk-Based Capital (RBC) calculation. Used for regulatory capital adequacy assessment under NAIC RBC framework.

attributes.name: reinsurance_ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The portion of statutory reserve ceded to reinsurers under reinsurance treaties. Reduces the net statutory reserve position of the ceding company.

attributes.name: reserve_adequacy_margin

attributes.name: reserve_basis_code
attributes.description: The statutory reserve methodology basis. Values: PBR (Principle-Based Reserving per VM-20/VM-21), CRVM (Commissioners Reserve Valuation Method for life), CARVM (Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method), NET_PREMIUM (Net Premium Reserve), MODIFIED_RESERVE (Modified Reserve Method).
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20, VM-21, VM-A

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_method_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reserve calculation methodology applied, including any company-specific adjustments or assumptions beyond standard statutory methods.

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: High-level reserve category for NAIC annual statement exhibit classification. Values: LIFE (life insurance reserves), ANNUITY (annuity reserves), ACCIDENT_HEALTH (accident and health reserves), DEPOSIT_TYPE (deposit-type contract reserves).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Exhibit 5, Exhibit 6, Exhibit 7, Exhibit 8

attributes.name: reserve_change_amount
attributes.description: The change in statutory reserve from the prior period to the current period, calculated as statutory_reserve_amount minus prior_period_reserve_amount. Represents reserve strengthening or release.

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: The status of the statutory reserve booking. Values: PRELIMINARY (initial actuarial calculation), FINAL (management approved and booked), ADJUSTED (post-close adjustment), RESTATED (prior period restatement).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: tax_reserve_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: valuation_interest_rate

products.name: ifrs17_contract_group
products.description: SSOT for IFRS 17 insurance contract group definitions and periodic measurement roll-forwards. Defines the unit of account: portfolio identifier, cohort year, profitability classification (onerous, not onerous, remaining coverage), measurement model (GMM, PAA, VFA), and reinsurance contract group linkage. Records all periodic measurement roll-forwards: opening/closing fulfilment cash flows (FCF), contractual service margin (CSM) opening/closing balance, release pattern, and movement analysis, risk adjustment for non-financial risk and movement, loss component for onerous groups, insurance revenue recognized, insurance service expense, insurance finance income/expense, OCI vs. P&L allocation election, experience variance, assumption change impact, and reinsurance held measurement. Serves as SSOT for IFRS 17 contract group definitions, measurement disclosures, and statement of financial position / profit or loss reporting.
