attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement relates to the liability for remaining coverage or the liability for incurred claims.

attributes.name: coverage_units_closing
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units at the end of the period after adjustments for service provided and changes in expected coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_units_opening
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units at the beginning of the period, used to determine the pattern of CSM release. Coverage units represent the quantity of service provided by the contracts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract group record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csm_assumption_change_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) Assumption Change Impact
attributes.description: Adjustments to CSM resulting from changes in estimates of future cash flows relating to future service, excluding changes in financial assumptions when the entity has chosen to disaggregate insurance finance income or expense.

attributes.name: csm_currency_exchange_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) Currency Exchange Impact
attributes.description: The effect of changes in foreign exchange rates on the CSM for contracts denominated in foreign currencies.

attributes.name: csm_experience_variance
attributes.description: Adjustments to CSM for differences between expected and actual cash flows relating to future service.

attributes.name: csm_interest_accretion
attributes.description: The interest accreted on the CSM balance during the period using discount rates determined at initial recognition.

attributes.name: csm_new_business_addition
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) New Business Addition
attributes.description: The CSM arising from new contracts added to the group during the period.

attributes.name: csm_release_amount
attributes.description: The amount of CSM recognized as insurance revenue in the current period based on coverage units provided.

attributes.name: derecognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract group was derecognized from the statement of financial position, when all rights and obligations are extinguished or transferred.

attributes.name: discount_rate_closing
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to the fulfilment cash flows at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: discount_rate_opening
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to the fulfilment cash flows at the beginning of the reporting period, reflecting the time value of money and financial risk.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates for this contract group.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the contract group: active (in force), closed (no longer accepting new contracts but existing contracts remain), or derecognized (fully extinguished).

attributes.name: initial_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract group was first recognized in the financial statements, typically the earliest of: beginning of coverage period, first payment due, or when the group becomes onerous.

attributes.name: insurance_finance_income_expense
attributes.description: The change in the carrying amount of the group of insurance contracts arising from the time value of money, financial risk, and changes in financial risk.

attributes.name: insurance_revenue_recognized
attributes.description: The amount of insurance revenue recognized in profit or loss during the period, comprising the release of CSM, risk adjustment, and expected incurred claims.

attributes.name: insurance_service_expense
attributes.description: The total insurance service expenses recognized in profit or loss, including incurred claims, other incurred expenses, amortization of insurance acquisition cash flows, and losses on onerous contracts.

attributes.name: loss_component_closing
attributes.description: The closing balance of the loss component for onerous contract groups after movements during the period.

attributes.name: loss_component_opening
attributes.description: The opening balance of the loss component for onerous contract groups. Represents the extent to which the fulfilment cash flows exceed the carrying amount of the liability for remaining coverage.

attributes.name: measurement_model
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to this contract group: General Measurement Model (GMM), Premium Allocation Approach (PAA), or Variable Fee Approach (VFA) for direct participating contracts.

attributes.name: oci_amount
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in other comprehensive income when the entity has elected to disaggregate insurance finance income or expense.

attributes.name: oci_pl_allocation_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) vs Profit or Loss (P&L) Allocation Election
attributes.description: The accounting policy choice for presenting insurance finance income or expense: entirely in profit or loss, or disaggregated between profit or loss and OCI.

attributes.name: opening_csm_balance
attributes.description: The unearned profit component at the beginning of the reporting period. Represents the unearned profit the entity will recognize as it provides services under the insurance contracts.

attributes.name: opening_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows at the beginning of the reporting period. Comprises estimates of future cash flows, discount rate adjustment, and risk adjustment for non-financial risk.

attributes.name: profitability_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the contract group based on initial recognition assessment: onerous (expected to be loss-making), not onerous (profitable), or no significant possibility of becoming onerous.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the contract group measurements are reported.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period for which this contract group measurement applies.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the reporting period for which this contract group measurement applies.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_closing
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment for Non-Financial Risk Closing Balance
attributes.description: The compensation the entity requires for bearing the uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows from non-financial risk at the end of the period.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_opening
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment for Non-Financial Risk Opening Balance
attributes.description: The compensation the entity requires for bearing the uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows from non-financial risk at the beginning of the period.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_release
attributes.description: The amount of risk adjustment recognized in profit or loss as the entity is released from risk during the period.

attributes.name: transition_approach
attributes.description: The transition method applied when IFRS 17 was first adopted for this contract group: full retrospective application, modified retrospective approach, or fair value approach.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract group record was last modified.

products.name: ifrs17_measurement
products.description: Periodic IFRS 17 measurement roll-forward by insurance contract group and reporting period. Captures opening/closing fulfilment cash flows (FCF), contractual service margin (CSM) movement, risk adjustment movement, insurance revenue recognized, insurance service expense, insurance finance income/expense, OCI vs. P&L allocation, experience variance, assumption change impact, and reinsurance held measurement. Supports IFRS 17 statement of financial position and statement of profit or loss disclosures.

attributes.name: ifrs17_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IFRS 17 measurement record.

attributes.name: actuarial_report_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: CSM releases and risk adjustment changes require supporting actuarial reports and assumption change documentation. Quarterly IFRS 17 measurement and disclosure processes depend on linking measurements

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the insurance contract group to which this measurement applies. Contract groups are portfolios of insurance contracts managed together under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the financial reporting period (month, quarter, year) to which this measurement applies.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial valuation run that produced this measurement, linking to the actuarial system for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: acquisition_expense
attributes.description: Expenses incurred during the reporting period for acquiring new insurance contracts, including commissions and underwriting costs.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who approved this measurement for financial reporting, supporting SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement was approved for financial reporting.

attributes.name: assumption_change_impact
attributes.description: The total impact on the insurance contract liability from changes in actuarial assumptions during the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_csm
attributes.description: The closing balance of the Contractual Service Margin at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The closing balance of the present value of future cash flows at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The closing balance of the risk adjustment for non-financial risk at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: The year in which the insurance contracts in this group were initially recognized, used for cohort-based measurement under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: coverage_units
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units provided during the reporting period, used to allocate CSM release. Coverage units reflect the quantity of benefits provided under the insurance contracts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csm_assumption_change
attributes.description: Adjustment to CSM arising from changes in estimates of future cash flows that relate to future service (e.g., changes in mortality, lapse, expense assumptions).

attributes.name: csm_experience_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment to CSM arising from differences between actual experience and previous estimates (experience variances) that relate to future service.

attributes.name: csm_interest_accretion
attributes.description: The interest accreted on the CSM balance during the reporting period, calculated using the discount rate locked in at initial recognition.

attributes.name: csm_release_for_service
attributes.description: The amount of CSM released to profit or loss as insurance revenue during the reporting period, reflecting the insurance service provided.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the measurement amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to future cash flows for this measurement, reflecting the time value of money and characteristics of the cash flows.

attributes.name: experience_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual experience and previous estimates during the reporting period, recognized immediately in profit or loss for past service.

attributes.name: finance_oci_component
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) during the reporting period, when the entity elects the OCI option.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Disaggregation of Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: finance_pl_component
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Disaggregation of Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: incurred_claims
attributes.description: The amount of claims incurred during the reporting period, including claims paid and changes in claims liabilities.

attributes.name: insurance_finance_expense
attributes.description: Finance expense recognized during the reporting period from the unwinding of discount on insurance contract liabilities and changes in discount rates.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: insurance_finance_income
attributes.description: Finance income recognized during the reporting period from the unwinding of discount on insurance contract liabilities and changes in discount rates.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: insurance_revenue
attributes.description: Total insurance revenue recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period, comprising CSM release, risk adjustment release, and expected claims and expenses.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Statement of Profit or Loss

attributes.name: insurance_service_expense
attributes.description: Total insurance service expenses recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period, including incurred claims, acquisition expenses, and other directly attributable expenses.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Statement of Profit or Loss

attributes.name: loss_component
attributes.description: The loss component balance for onerous contract groups, tracked separately to determine the allocation of subsequent changes in fulfilment cash flows.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the IFRS 17 measurement is performed, typically the reporting period end date.

attributes.name: measurement_model
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to this contract group: General Measurement Model (GMM), Premium Allocation Approach (PAA), or Variable Fee Approach (VFA).
attributes.value_regex: General Measurement Model|Premium Allocation Approach|Variable Fee Approach

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: The status of this measurement record in the financial close process: Draft (work in progress), Preliminary (under review), Final (approved for reporting), or Restated (corrected after initial reporting).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement record was last modified.

attributes.name: onerous_contract_loss
attributes.description: Loss recognized immediately in profit or loss when a group of insurance contracts becomes onerous (i.e., the fulfilment cash flows exceed any remaining CSM).

attributes.name: opening_csm
attributes.description: The opening balance of the Contractual Service Margin at the beginning of the reporting period. CSM represents the unearned profit that will be recognized as insurance revenue over the coverage period.

attributes.name: opening_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The opening balance of the present value of future cash flows (estimates of future cash inflows and outflows) at the beginning of the reporting period.

attributes.name: opening_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The opening balance of the risk adjustment for non-financial risk at the beginning of the reporting period. Risk adjustment represents the compensation required for bearing uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_csm
attributes.description: The CSM for reinsurance contracts held, representing the unearned benefit from reinsurance coverage.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_fcf
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows for reinsurance contracts held, representing the reinsurance asset or liability.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The risk adjustment for non-financial risk on reinsurance contracts held.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_change
attributes.description: Change in risk adjustment during the period due to changes in estimates of non-financial risk.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_release
attributes.description: The amount of risk adjustment released to profit or loss during the reporting period as risk is reduced through the passage of time and claim settlement.

products.name: rbc_calculation
products.description: Risk-Based Capital (RBC) calculation records by legal entity and reporting period. Captures total adjusted capital (TAC), authorized control level (ACL) RBC, company action level (CAL) RBC, C-0 (asset default) risk, C-1 (asset risk), C-2 (insurance/pricing risk), C-3 (interest rate/market risk), C-4 (business risk), covariance adjustment, RBC ratio, and regulatory action level trigger flags. Supports NAIC RBC filing, state DOI capital adequacy reporting, and ORSA capital planning.

attributes.name: rbc_calculation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the RBC calculation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: filing_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: RBC filings require supporting schedules, investment listings, and reinsurance attestations filed with state regulators. Annual RBC filing and regulatory compliance depend on linking calculations to f

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity for which RBC is calculated. Links to the legal entity master.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: RBC C2 insurance risk component is calculated by product line for regulatory capital adequacy reporting. Required for Annual Statement Schedule S filing, capital planning, and product pricing. Links R

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: RBC calculations are statutory regulatory filings to state insurance departments requiring appointed actuary or qualified preparer signature. Regulatory accountability mandates employee tracking. Repl

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reporting period (quarter/year) for this RBC calculation.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: RBC C2 insurance risk component calculations depend on actuarial reserve valuations (statutory reserves, PBR reserves). Direct link enables reconciliation between RBC filings and actuarial memorandums

attributes.name: action_level_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates which regulatory action level threshold has been triggered based on the RBC ratio (no_action, company_action, regulatory_action, authorized_control, mandatory_control).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: audit_opinion
attributes.description: The auditor's opinion on the RBC calculation if reviewed (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer, not_audited).

attributes.name: auditor_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RBC calculation has been reviewed by external auditors as part of the financial statement audit.

attributes.name: authorized_control_level_rbc
attributes.description: The authorized control level RBC amount. Represents the minimum capital threshold below which regulatory control is authorized.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: c0_asset_risk_affiliates
attributes.description: RBC charge for asset risk related to investments in affiliates and subsidiaries.

attributes.name: c1_asset_risk_equity
attributes.description: RBC charge for asset risk on equity investments and common stock.

attributes.name: c1_asset_risk_fixed_income
attributes.description: RBC charge for asset default risk on fixed income securities (bonds, mortgages).

attributes.name: c1_asset_risk_other
attributes.description: RBC charge for asset risk on other invested assets not classified elsewhere.

attributes.name: c1_asset_risk_real_estate
attributes.description: RBC charge for asset risk on real estate holdings and property investments.

attributes.name: c2_insurance_risk
attributes.description: RBC charge for underwriting and pricing risk related to insurance liabilities and reserves.

attributes.name: c3_interest_rate_risk
attributes.description: RBC charge for interest rate and asset-liability mismatch risk.

attributes.name: c3_market_risk
attributes.description: RBC charge for market risk on variable annuity guarantees and other market-sensitive products.

attributes.name: c4_business_risk
attributes.description: RBC charge for general business risk including administrative expenses and guaranty fund assessments.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RBC calculation was performed.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used for RBC calculation (formula_based, scenario_based, stochastic, hybrid).

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RBC calculation (draft, preliminary, final, filed, amended, superseded).

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Type of RBC calculation based on insurance line of business (life, property/casualty, health).
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions by Line of Business

attributes.name: company_action_level_rbc
attributes.description: The company action level RBC amount. Represents the threshold at which the company must submit a corrective action plan.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: covariance_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment factor applied to recognize diversification benefits across risk categories using the NAIC covariance formula.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RBC calculation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: filed_with_regulator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RBC calculation has been officially filed with the state insurance regulator.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RBC report was filed with the state insurance department.

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: Method used to file the RBC report with the regulator (electronic, paper, exempt).

attributes.name: mandatory_control_level_rbc
attributes.description: The mandatory control level RBC amount. Represents the threshold at which the regulator must place the company under regulatory control.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this RBC calculation record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RBC calculation record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and commentary regarding the RBC calculation, including assumptions, adjustments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: orsa_alignment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Alignment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RBC calculation aligns with the company's ORSA capital assessment and risk management framework.

attributes.name: rbc_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of Total Adjusted Capital to Authorized Control Level RBC, expressed as a percentage. Key metric for regulatory capital adequacy.

attributes.name: regulator_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The state or jurisdiction code of the primary insurance regulator (e.g., NY, CA, TX).

attributes.name: regulatory_action_level_rbc
attributes.description: The regulatory action level RBC amount. Represents the threshold at which the regulator may take corrective action.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: reporting_quarter
attributes.description: The quarter within the reporting year (1-4). Null for annual-only calculations.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which RBC is being reported.

attributes.name: total_adjusted_capital
attributes.description: Total adjusted capital available to support risk. Calculated as statutory capital and surplus plus other adjustments per NAIC formula.

attributes.name: total_rbc_after_covariance
attributes.description: Total RBC requirement after applying the covariance adjustment for diversification.

attributes.name: total_rbc_before_covariance
attributes.description: Sum of all RBC risk components (C-0 through C-4) before applying the covariance adjustment.

attributes.name: trend_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the RBC trend test comparing current year to prior year capital adequacy (pass, fail, not_applicable).

products.name: intercompany_settlement
products.description: Records intercompany financial transactions and settlements between legal entities within the holding company group. Captures originating legal entity, receiving legal entity, transaction type (expense allocation, reinsurance premium, investment income transfer, management fee, capital contribution), settlement amount, settlement currency, netting indicator, elimination entry reference, and settlement status. Supports intercompany elimination in GAAP consolidation and statutory intercompany balances reporting.
products.reference: Intercompany Settlement — GAAP Consolidation, NAIC SAP

attributes.name: intercompany_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany settlement transaction record.

attributes.name: agreement_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Intercompany transactions require service agreements, transfer pricing documentation, and settlement confirmations. Monthly intercompany reconciliation and tax compliance depend on linking settlements

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: intercompany_settlement has gl_account_code (STRING) and should FK to chart_of_accounts. Settlements post to GL accounts; FK is essential for intercompany elimination entries and consolidation.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the insurance claim associated with this intercompany settlement, applicable when the transaction relates to claim reinsurance or claim expense allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Reporting Standards, FASB ASC 944-605

attributes.name: communication_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the transaction in the source system, enabling traceability back to the originating system for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements, Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intercompany_settlement has cost_center_code (STRING) and should FK to cost_center. Settlements are allocated to cost centers for transfer pricing and expense allocation; FK is essential.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the insurance policy or annuity contract associated with this intercompany settlement, if the transaction is policy-specific.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Reporting Standards, FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: investment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investment transaction associated with this intercompany settlement, applicable when transaction type is investment income transfer or investment management fee.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Reporting Standards, FASB ASC 320

attributes.name: netting_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the netting group or pool to which this settlement belongs, used to aggregate offsetting intercompany balances for consolidated settlement.
attributes.references: GAAP Consolidation Standards, Intercompany Netting Agreements

attributes.name: originating_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity initiating or originating the intercompany transaction within the holding company group.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, GAAP Consolidation Standards

attributes.name: receiving_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity receiving or benefiting from the intercompany transaction within the holding company group.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, GAAP Consolidation Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reinsurance treaty associated with this intercompany settlement, applicable when transaction type is reinsurance premium or reinsurance recoverable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Attestation Requirements, FASB ASC 944-605

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Intercompany settlements are recorded in specific accounting periods for consolidation reporting. Required for intercompany elimination entries, consolidated financial statement preparation, and trans

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Intercompany transactions may involve external vendors providing shared services across legal entities (e.g., TPA serving multiple subsidiaries). Required for transfer pricing, intercompany reconcilia

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the intercompany settlement transaction was approved by authorized personnel, as required by SOX internal control procedures.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, GAAP Authorization Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the authorized individual who approved the intercompany settlement transaction for processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code associated with the originating side of the intercompany settlement for segment reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting, Management Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this intercompany settlement record was first created in the data platform, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements, GAAP Documentation Standards

attributes.name: elimination_entry_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this intercompany settlement to the corresponding consolidation elimination journal entry in GAAP consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation, SOX Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert settlement amount from settlement currency to functional currency, if currencies differ.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830, GAAP Foreign Currency Translation Standards

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Settlement amount converted to the functional currency of the originating legal entity for consolidated financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters, IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this intercompany settlement transaction is posted in the originating legal entity's chart of accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts Standards, SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: intercompany_settlement_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the intercompany settlement transaction, providing business context and explanation of the financial flow.

attributes.name: netting_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this settlement transaction is subject to intercompany netting arrangements where offsetting balances are consolidated before settlement.
attributes.references: GAAP Consolidation Standards, NAIC Intercompany Pooling Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments related to the intercompany settlement, capturing special circumstances, exceptions, or follow-up actions required.
attributes.references: GAAP Documentation Standards, Internal Control Documentation

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment system reference number or wire transfer confirmation number for intercompany settlements executed via cash transfer.
attributes.references: Treasury Operations Standards, Bank Reconciliation Guidelines

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Product line or line of business code associated with the intercompany settlement, used for profitability analysis and product-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Exhibit Requirements, Management Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the intercompany settlement was reconciled and confirmed by both originating and receiving legal entities.
attributes.references: SOX Reconciliation Controls, GAAP Intercompany Balancing Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process for this intercompany settlement, tracking whether balances have been confirmed and agreed by both parties.
attributes.references: SOX Reconciliation Controls, GAAP Intercompany Balancing Standards

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the intercompany settlement transaction in the settlement currency, representing the gross amount transferred or allocated between legal entities.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the intercompany settlement is denominated and executed.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the intercompany settlement transaction was executed or is scheduled to be executed, representing the effective date of the financial transfer.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards, FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the intercompany settlement is executed, indicating whether it involves actual cash movement, accounting entry only, or offsetting arrangement.
attributes.references: GAAP Cash Management Standards, Treasury Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique reference number or code for the intercompany settlement transaction, used for tracking and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Control Standards, GAAP Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany settlement transaction indicating its position in the settlement and reconciliation workflow.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Control Standards, GAAP Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this intercompany settlement transaction originated, supporting data lineage and audit requirements.

attributes.name: statutory_line_of_business
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) Line of Business
attributes.description: Statutory line of business classification for this intercompany settlement as required for NAIC Annual Statement reporting and statutory accounting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SAP Codification

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the tax treatment of this intercompany settlement for income tax and transfer pricing purposes, ensuring compliance with IRS regulations.

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget master with integrated variance tracking and reforecasting by cost center, legal entity, product line, and GL account. Captures budget version (original, revised, forecast), budget year/period, budgeted amounts by line item (premium income, claims, operating expense, investment income, DAC capitalization, reserve movement), budget approval status, and budget owner. Records periodic budget vs. actual variance: actual amount posted, variance amount and percentage, favorable/unfavorable indicator, variance explanation narrative, reforecast amount, and management commentary. Supports financial planning, budget vs. actual variance analysis, CFO reporting, board-level financial oversight, and management action tracking on unfavorable variances.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: budget_category

attributes.name: budgeted_amount

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line item represents a capital expenditure (True) or an operating expense (False). Supports capital budgeting and asset tracking.

attributes.name: is_controllable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line item is controllable by the budget owner (True) or is a non-controllable allocation or corporate charge (False). Supports performance evaluation and accountability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: line_item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the budget line item, providing additional context beyond the GL account name. Supports granular budget tracking and management commentary.

attributes.name: management_commentary

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or assumptions related to this budget line item. Supports budget documentation and audit trail.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the budget owner for communication regarding variances and reforecasts.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role responsible for this budget line item. Supports budget accountability and variance resolution tracking.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Product line or line of business (e.g., Term Life, Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Indexed Universal Life (IUL), Variable Universal Life (VUL), Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA), Single Premium Immediate Annuity (SPIA)) to which this budget applies. Supports product-level profitability and budget analysis.

attributes.name: reforecast_amount
attributes.description: Updated forecast amount for this line item and period, reflecting revised expectations based on actual performance and business conditions. Supports dynamic financial planning and rolling forecasts.

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis for this budget line item: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 17, or Tax basis. Supports multi-basis financial reporting and Risk-Based Capital (RBC) calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC SAP, IFRS 17, IRS Tax Code

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute variance between actual and budgeted amounts (actual minus budget). Positive values indicate over-budget (unfavorable for expenses, favorable for revenue); negative values indicate under-budget.

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by the budget owner or finance team describing the root cause of the variance. Supports management action tracking and board-level financial oversight.

attributes.name: variance_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of variance favorability. Favorable: actual revenue exceeds budget or actual expense is below budget. Unfavorable: actual revenue is below budget or actual expense exceeds budget. Neutral: variance within acceptable tolerance. Not Applicable: variance assessment not meaningful for this line item.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual and budgeted amounts, calculated as (actual - budget) / budget * 100. Enables relative variance comparison across line items of different magnitudes.

attributes.name: version_code
attributes.description: Version type of the budget: original annual budget, revised budget, forecast, reforecast, or board-approved version. Supports multi-version budget tracking and variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

products.name: budget_variance

Captures budgeted amount, actual amount posted, variance amount, variance percentage, favorable/unfavorable indicator, variance explanation narrative, reforecast amount, and management commentary. Supports financial performance management, CFO reporting, and board-level financial oversight. Distinct from budget (the plan) as this captures the comparison outcome.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dac_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the expenses in this variance record are eligible for deferral as Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) under GAAP. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: favorable_unfavorable_indicator

attributes.name: gaap_expense_category

attributes.name: reforecast_amount

attributes.name: sox_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget variance record is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements. True if SOX-controlled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget variance record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, SOX Audit Requirements

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute variance amount calculated as the difference between actual and budget (actual_amount - budget_amount). Positive values indicate over-budget, negative values indicate under-budget.

attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the budget amount. Calculated as (variance_amount / budget_amount) * 100. Enables relative performance comparison across cost centers.

attributes.name: variance_status
attributes.description: The current workflow status of the budget variance record. Tracks the review and approval lifecycle from initial identification through management closure.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance amount or percentage exceeds the predefined management threshold requiring escalation or additional review. True if threshold exceeded, False otherwise.

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Income tax provision records by legal entity and reporting period. Captures current tax expense, deferred tax expense/benefit, effective tax rate, deferred tax asset (DTA) balance, deferred tax liability (DTL) balance, valuation allowance, uncertain tax position (UTP) reserve under ASC 740-10, temporary difference components (DAC, reserves, unrealized gains), IRC Section 7702 tax compliance impact, and tax return-to-provision true-up. Supports GAAP income tax footnote disclosure and statutory tax exhibit.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the income tax provision record. Primary key for the tax provision entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity for which this tax provision is recorded. Each legal entity files separate tax returns and maintains separate tax positions.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax provisions require named preparer for SOX compliance and audit trails. IRS and state tax filings mandate accountability. Replaces denormalized prepared_by text with proper employee FK for regulato

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Tax provisions are calculated for specific accounting periods as part of financial statement close. Required for GAAP financial reporting, effective tax rate calculation, and deferred tax position dis

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of tax authority audit or examination for this tax period. Tracks IRS or state tax authority review lifecycle.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision calculation was performed. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this tax provision record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to taxes currently payable or refundable for the reporting period. Represents cash tax impact.

attributes.name: dac_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference arising from DAC capitalization for GAAP versus immediate deduction for tax. Major source of deferred tax liability for life insurance companies.
attributes.references: IRC Section 848 Capitalization of Policy Acquisition Expenses

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities. Positive values represent expense; negative values represent benefit.

attributes.name: dta_balance
attributes.description: Total deferred tax asset balance as of the reporting period end. Represents future tax benefits from temporary differences, NOL carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards.

attributes.name: dtl_balance
attributes.description: Total deferred tax liability balance as of the reporting period end. Represents future tax obligations from temporary differences such as accelerated depreciation and DAC capitalization.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of total income tax expense to pretax income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Key metric for tax efficiency analysis and rate reconciliation disclosure.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision has been reviewed by external auditors as part of financial statement audit procedures.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this tax provision applies (e.g., 2024). Used for multi-year tax analysis and trend reporting.

attributes.name: foreign_tax_expense
attributes.description: Income tax expense attributable to foreign jurisdictions. Includes taxes paid to foreign governments on international operations and investments.

attributes.name: gaap_reporting_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reporting Basis
attributes.description: The accounting framework under which this tax provision was prepared (US GAAP, IFRS, or Statutory Accounting Principles).

attributes.name: irc_7702_adjustment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Tax Compliance Adjustment
attributes.description: Tax provision adjustment related to IRC Section 7702 life insurance contract qualification testing. Ensures products meet tax-favored treatment requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702 Life Insurance Contract Defined

attributes.name: ldti_tax_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Tax Impact
attributes.description: Tax provision impact from FASB ASU 2018-12 LDTI implementation. Captures deferred tax effects of changes in insurance liability measurement and DAC amortization.
attributes.references: ASC 944-40 LDTI and ASC 740-10 Tax Effects

attributes.name: net_deferred_tax_position
attributes.description: Net deferred tax asset or liability, calculated as DTA balance minus DTL balance. Positive values indicate net asset; negative values indicate net liability.

attributes.name: nol_carryforward
attributes.description: Tax net operating loss carryforward available to offset future taxable income. Generates deferred tax asset based on expected utilization and statutory tax rate.
attributes.references: IRC Section 172 Net Operating Loss Deduction

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting significant assumptions, judgments, tax planning strategies, or unusual items affecting the tax provision. Supports audit documentation requirements.

attributes.name: permanent_difference_adjustment
attributes.description: Tax provision impact from permanent book-tax differences that do not reverse over time (e.g., tax-exempt interest, non-deductible expenses, dividends received deduction).

attributes.name: pretax_income
attributes.description: Income before income taxes per GAAP financial statements. Used as the base for effective tax rate calculation.

attributes.name: provision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax provision was calculated and recorded. Represents the business event timestamp for this tax calculation.

attributes.name: provision_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the tax provision for interim periods. Discrete method treats each period independently; annual effective rate method estimates full-year rate.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax provision record. Tracks progression from initial draft through final audited state.

attributes.name: rate_change_impact
attributes.description: Impact on deferred tax balances from changes in enacted tax rates. Requires remeasurement of deferred tax assets and liabilities at new rates.

attributes.name: reserve_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference between GAAP insurance reserves and tax reserves. Reflects differences in reserve calculation methodologies between financial reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: return_to_provision_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment to reconcile prior period tax provision estimates to actual amounts reported on filed tax returns. Recorded when tax returns are finalized.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior tax professional who reviewed and approved this tax provision. Required for segregation of duties.

attributes.name: sox_control_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision has been reviewed and certified under SOX Section 404 internal control requirements. Required for public companies.

attributes.name: state_tax_expense
attributes.description: Income tax expense attributable to state and local jurisdictions. Tracked separately from federal tax for rate reconciliation and multi-state tax planning.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance Tax Regulations

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The federal statutory corporate income tax rate applicable to the reporting period (e.g., 0.2100 for 21% under IRC Section 11). Starting point for effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_credit_carryforward
attributes.description: Tax credits available to reduce future tax liabilities, including general business credits, foreign tax credits, and alternative minimum tax credits. Generates deferred tax asset.

attributes.name: tax_return_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax return for this period has been filed with tax authorities. True when return is filed; False when provision is estimated.

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: Total income tax expense for the period, calculated as the sum of current tax expense and deferred tax expense. Reported on the GAAP income statement.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference from unrealized gains and losses on investments recognized in GAAP financial statements but not yet taxable. Includes available-for-sale securities and fair value adjustments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1001 Realization of Gain or Loss

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was last modified. Tracks all subsequent changes after initial creation.

attributes.name: utp_reserve
attributes.description: Reserve for unrecognized tax benefits under ASC 740-10 (formerly FIN 48). Represents tax positions that do not meet the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold.

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: Contra-asset account reducing deferred tax assets to the amount that is more-likely-than-not to be realized. Reflects management judgment on future taxable income sufficiency.

products.name: reinsurance_recoverable
products.description: SSOT for finance-booked reinsurance recoverable balances from ceded reinsurance treaties. Captures reinsurer name, treaty reference, recoverable type (ceded reserve, ceded claim, ceded premium), gross recoverable amount, allowance for uncollectible reinsurance, net recoverable balance, credit quality of reinsurer (AM Best rating), collateral held (LOC, trust, funds withheld), SAP vs. GAAP recoverable basis, and aging of recoverable. Supports statutory balance sheet Schedule F reporting, GAAP reinsurance accounting under ASC 944, and counterparty credit risk management. Distinct from reinsurance domain treaty administration — this product owns the finance-booked recoverable position for financial statement presentation.

products.name: embedded_value
products.description: Embedded value and Market Consistent Embedded Value (MCEV) reporting by legal entity, product line, and reporting period. Captures value of in-force (VIF), adjusted net worth (ANW), cost of required capital, time value of financial options and guarantees (TVFOG), frictional costs, new business value (NBV), and movement analysis (opening to closing EV). Supports international reporting standards (CFO Forum MCEV Principles), investor disclosures, and management value-based performance metrics for life insurance operations.

attributes.name: embedded_value_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the embedded value record. Primary key for the embedded value data product.

attributes.name: actuarial_report_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Embedded value calculations require detailed actuarial reports, assumption documentation, and board presentation materials. Annual EV reporting for investor disclosure depends on linking calculations

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (typically CFO, Chief Actuary, or designated approver) who approved this embedded value calculation for reporting.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity for which embedded value is calculated. Links to the legal entity master data.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Embedded value calculations are product-specific for investor reporting and M&A valuations. Required for value of in-force (VIF) calculation, new business value reporting, and strategic product portfo

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reporting period for this embedded value calculation. Links to the reporting period dimension.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the actuarial valuation run that produced the cash flow projections and assumptions used in this embedded value calculation.

attributes.name: adjusted_net_worth
attributes.description: The market value of shareholders' net assets allocated to the covered business, adjusted for inadmissible assets and other regulatory restrictions. Represents the tangible equity supporting the in-force business.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this embedded value calculation was formally approved by management or the appointed actuary for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: assumption_change_impact
attributes.description: The change in embedded value resulting from updates to actuarial assumptions (mortality tables, lapse rates, expense levels, discount rates) applied to the in-force business.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the embedded value calculation in the approval workflow. Tracks progression from draft through review, approval, and publication.

attributes.name: capital_movements
attributes.description: Net capital injections or distributions during the reporting period, including dividends paid, capital contributions, and intercompany transfers affecting embedded value.

attributes.name: closing_embedded_value
attributes.description: The embedded value at the end of the reporting period. Sum of adjusted net worth and value of in-force business.

attributes.name: cost_of_required_capital
attributes.description: The cost of holding required capital above the risk-free rate, reflecting the frictional cost of capital that cannot be freely distributed. Deducted from VIF calculation.

attributes.name: covered_business_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this business segment is included in the embedded value covered business scope. True if included in EV calculation, False if excluded.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this embedded value record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the embedded value amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary values in this record are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: economic_variance
attributes.description: The change in embedded value due to changes in economic conditions, including interest rate movements, equity market performance, credit spreads, and foreign exchange rates.

attributes.name: expected_return
attributes.description: The expected increase in embedded value from unwinding of discount rates and expected in-force business performance, assuming no changes in assumptions or experience.

attributes.name: experience_variance
attributes.description: The change in embedded value due to differences between actual experience and expected assumptions (mortality, lapse, expense, investment returns) during the reporting period.

attributes.name: external_audit_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this embedded value calculation has been reviewed by external auditors. True if audited, False if not yet reviewed.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter within the year for this embedded value calculation (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Some companies report embedded value quarterly, others annually.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this embedded value calculation applies, typically matching the calendar year for insurance companies.

attributes.name: free_surplus
attributes.description: The portion of adjusted net worth that exceeds required capital and is available for distribution to shareholders or investment in new business.

attributes.name: frictional_costs
attributes.description: The present value of costs associated with holding required capital, including investment management expenses, tax on investment income, and other costs that reduce distributable earnings.

attributes.name: investor_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this embedded value calculation has been publicly disclosed to investors in financial reports or investor presentations. True if disclosed, False if internal only.

attributes.name: new_business_value
attributes.description: The value added from new business written during the reporting period, calculated as the present value of future profits from new policies net of required capital costs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, explanations of significant movements, methodology notes, or other relevant information about this embedded value calculation.

attributes.name: opening_embedded_value
attributes.description: The embedded value at the beginning of the reporting period. Starting point for the embedded value movement analysis.

attributes.name: other_operating_variance
attributes.description: Changes in embedded value from other operating items not classified elsewhere, including model changes, methodology refinements, and one-time adjustments.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product line segment for which embedded value is reported (e.g., term life, whole life, universal life, annuities, group insurance).

attributes.name: reference_rate
attributes.description: The risk-free reference rate used to discount future cash flows in the embedded value calculation, typically based on government bond yields or swap rates.

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: The embedded value methodology applied: Market Consistent Embedded Value (MCEV), European Embedded Value (EEV), Traditional Embedded Value, or Appraisal Value.

attributes.name: required_capital_amount
attributes.description: The amount of capital required to support the in-force business, based on regulatory requirements (RBC), economic capital models, or internal capital adequacy standards.

attributes.name: risk_discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to non-hedgeable risks in the embedded value calculation, reflecting the cost of capital for insurance risk, operational risk, and other non-market risks.

attributes.name: sensitivity_test_performed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sensitivity testing has been performed on this embedded value calculation to assess impact of assumption changes and economic shocks. True if sensitivity analysis completed.

attributes.name: stochastic_scenario_count
attributes.description: The number of stochastic economic scenarios used to calculate the time value of financial options and guarantees (TVFOG). Typically 1,000 to 10,000 scenarios for market-consistent valuation.

attributes.name: time_value_financial_options_guarantees
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time Value of Financial Options and Guarantees (TVFOG)
attributes.description: The market-consistent value of embedded options and guarantees in insurance contracts (e.g., minimum death benefits, guaranteed annuity rates, surrender options), calculated using stochastic modeling.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this embedded value record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to the calculation.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which the embedded value is calculated. Typically the end of a reporting period (quarter-end or year-end).

attributes.name: value_of_in_force
attributes.description: The present value of future distributable earnings from the in-force covered business, net of cost of required capital and frictional costs. Core component of embedded value representing future profit streams.

attributes.name: prior_period_embedded_value_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on embedded_value (prior_period_embedded_value_id)

products.name: entity_vendor_contract
products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between a legal entity within the insurance holding company structure and an external vendor or service provider. It captures entity-specific contract terms, payment arrangements, service scope, and spend tracking. Each record links one legal entity to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement, supporting multi-entity vendor management, consolidated spend reporting, and regulatory vendor oversight.. Existence Justification: In life insurance holding company structures, multiple legal entities (life insurers, reinsurers, broker-dealers, service companies) routinely contract with the same vendors (medical exam providers, TPAs, custodians, data providers) for services, and each vendor serves multiple legal entities across the holding company. Each legal entity-vendor relationship has distinct contract terms, payment arrangements, service scope, and spend tracking requirements driven by separate legal liability, entity-specific regulatory reporting, and statutory accounting by entity.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this specific legal entity-vendor contract

attributes.name: service_category

attributes.name: spend_amount

products.name: cost_center_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the operational engagement relationship between cost centers and vendors in the life insurance enterprise. It captures departmental vendor assignments, budget allocations, spend tracking, service categorization, and approval authority for vendor relationships at the cost center level. Each record links one cost center to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement relationship, supporting expense allocation, vendor management, and departmental procurement oversight.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, cost centers (departments, business units, product lines, distribution channels) engage multiple vendors for different services - IT may use multiple software vendors, underwriting may use multiple medical exam providers, and investment operations may use multiple custodians. Conversely, vendors serve multiple cost centers across the enterprise - ExamOne provides services to multiple underwriting departments, a reinsurance intermediary serves multiple product lines, and an IT vendor supports multiple business units. The business actively manages these relationships with cost center-specific budgets, spend tracking, service categorization, and approval authorities.

attributes.name: spend_amount

domains.name: document
domains.description: Manages the full lifecycle of insurance documents — policy contracts, illustrations, applications, APS records, beneficiary change forms, endorsements, rider documents, regulatory filings, claim correspondence, and disclosure documents. Owns document metadata, version control, e-delivery consent, NIGO tracking for incomplete applications, document imaging, retention schedules aligned with state DOI requirements, and ACORD forms management.

products.name: document
products.description: Master registry of all insurance documents managed across the enterprise — policy contracts, applications, illustrations, endorsements, rider documents, claim correspondence, regulatory filings, and disclosure documents. Serves as the authoritative catalog entry for every document object with metadata including document type classification (FK to type), origination channel, source system, retention category, confidentiality level, and lifecycle status (draft, active, superseded, archived, destroyed). This is the SSOT for document identity and metadata within the document domain. All other domain entities (version, signature, access_log, workflow, delivery_event, legal_hold) reference this master record.

attributes.name: checksum_hash

attributes.name: effective_date

products.name: request
products.description: Operational record of outbound requests for documents needed to complete a business transaction — APS orders to physicians, requests for missing application forms from agents, requests for proof of loss from beneficiaries, and requests for replacement policy documents. Captures request type, requestor, recipient, requested document type, request date, due date, follow-up schedule, request status (sent, acknowledged, received, overdue, cancelled), and the business transaction driving the request (application, claim, policy service). Supports SLA tracking for outstanding document requests across NB, claims, and servicing workflows.

attributes.name: cancellation_date

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: external_reference_number

attributes.name: follow_up_count

attributes.name: follow_up_schedule

attributes.name: last_follow_up_date

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: received_date

attributes.name: recipient_address_line1

attributes.name: recipient_phone

attributes.name: recipient_postal_code

attributes.name: recipient_state

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Category of recipient to whom the document request is sent. TPA = Third Party Administrator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|agent|beneficiary|policyholder|TPA|medical_facility|financial_institution — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date the document request was initiated and prepared for transmission.

attributes.name: request_number

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current status of the document request in its lifecycle. Sent = request transmitted to recipient, acknowledged = recipient confirmed receipt, received = requested document delivered, overdue = past due date without receipt, cancelled = request voided, pending = request prepared but not yet sent.

attributes.name: requested_document_type_code

attributes.name: requestor_name

attributes.name: requestor_role
attributes.description: Business role of the individual initiating the document request.

attributes.name: sent_timestamp

attributes.name: sla_met_flag

attributes.name: sla_target_days

attributes.name: source_system
