products.name: correspondence_link
products.description: Association record linking a document to its originating correspondence communication record in the correspondence domain. Enables traceability from document artifacts back to the communication event that generated or received them.

attributes.name: correspondence_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the correspondence-to-document association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: annuity_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the annuity contract associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables direct navigation to the annuity context when the correspondence and document relate to a specific annuity contract.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the new business application associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables direct navigation to the application context when the correspondence and document relate to a specific underwriting case.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the insurance claim associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables direct navigation to the claim context when the correspondence and document relate to a specific claim.

attributes.name: communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the originating correspondence communication record in the correspondence domain. Links this document artifact back to the communication event that generated or received it.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the document record in the document domain. Identifies the specific document artifact associated with this correspondence event.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the insurance policy associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables direct navigation to the policy context when the correspondence and document relate to a specific policy.

attributes.name: legal_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the legal hold record if this correspondence-document link is subject to litigation hold. Null if no legal hold applies.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the policyholder or customer associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables direct navigation to the customer context when the correspondence and document relate to a specific individual or entity.

attributes.name: primary_correspondence_linked_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that created the correspondence-document association. Supports audit trail and accountability for link creation.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the insurance agent or producer associated with this correspondence-document link. Enables tracking of agent-related correspondence and documents for commission, compliance, and servicing purposes.

attributes.name: attachment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document was physically attached to or embedded within the correspondence communication. True if the document was an attachment; false if the document is referenced or generated separately.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the detailed audit trail log for this correspondence-document link. Supports compliance and forensic investigation by providing access to the complete history of actions taken on this association record.

attributes.name: business_context
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason or context for the correspondence-document association. Provides additional narrative detail about why this document is linked to this correspondence event.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level for this correspondence-document association. Public indicates no restrictions; internal indicates company-internal use only; confidential indicates sensitive business information; restricted indicates highly sensitive data requiring special handling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this correspondence-document link record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the correspondence flow. Inbound indicates the correspondence and document were received from an external party; outbound indicates the correspondence and document were sent to an external party.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this correspondence-document link is subject to a legal hold order that prevents destruction or modification. True if under legal hold; false if normal retention rules apply.

attributes.name: link_method
attributes.description: Describes how the correspondence-document association was established. Manual indicates user-initiated linking; automatic indicates system-generated linking based on business rules; batch indicates bulk linking process; API indicates linking via external system integration; workflow indicates linking as part of a business process workflow.

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the correspondence-document association. Active indicates the link is current and valid; inactive indicates the link has been deactivated; archived indicates the link is retained for historical purposes; deleted indicates the link has been logically removed; pending indicates the link is awaiting validation or approval.

attributes.name: link_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the relationship between the correspondence and the document. Generated indicates the correspondence produced the document; received indicates the document was received via the correspondence; attached indicates the document was included with the correspondence; referenced indicates the correspondence mentions the document; superseded indicates the correspondence replaces the document; related indicates a general association.

attributes.name: linked_by_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system or application that created the correspondence-document link. Examples include Policy Administration System, Claims Management System, CRM Platform, or Document Management System.

attributes.name: linked_date
attributes.description: The business date when the document was associated with the correspondence event. May differ from the correspondence date or document creation date if the link was established retroactively.

attributes.name: linked_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the document-correspondence association record was created in the system. Provides audit trail for when the linkage was established.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, annotations, or contextual information about the correspondence-document association. Used by business users to capture details not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: primary_document_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is the primary or main document associated with the correspondence event. True if this is the principal document; false if this is a supporting or secondary document.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this correspondence-document link represents a communication or document that must be reported to regulatory authorities such as state Departments of Insurance (DOI), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), or Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA). True if reportable; false otherwise.

attributes.name: retention_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this correspondence-document link and its associated records are eligible for purging or archival based on retention policies. Calculated from the linked date plus applicable retention period, unless overridden by legal hold.

attributes.name: retention_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard document retention schedule has been overridden for this correspondence-document link due to legal hold, regulatory investigation, or other special circumstances. True if retention rules are overridden; false if standard retention applies.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this document within the correspondence event when multiple documents are associated with a single correspondence. Used to maintain the order of attachments or generated documents.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this correspondence-document link record was last modified. Provides audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: superseded_correspondence_link_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on correspondence_link (superseded_correspondence_link_id)

attributes.name: imaging_required_flag

attributes.name: retention_trigger

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of document types in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: state_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document type must be filed with state Department of Insurance for approval before use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document type indicating whether it is actively used in business operations.

attributes.name: template_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a standard template exists for generating this document type in document composition systems.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this document type record was last modified.

attributes.name: version_control_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document type requires formal version tracking and audit trail of changes.

attributes.name: parent_document_type_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on document_type (parent_document_type_id)

domains.name: correspondence

Owns communication templates, delivery tracking, and regulatory correspondence requirements.

Serves as the SSOT for communication identity, direction, channel, subject, status, and lifecycle. Each record represents one discrete communication artifact tied to a policyholder, agent, claimant, or other stakeholder. Supports sponsor relationship

products.name: queue
products.description: Operational master record representing a named work queue within the correspondence processing workflow — e.g., inbound mail triage, complaint handling, regulatory response, returned mail processing, escalation review. Defines queue identity, owning business unit, SLA targets (acknowledgment within 2 business days, resolution within 30 days per state DOI requirements), queue type, priority rules, and current capacity metrics. Enables workload management and SLA compliance monitoring across all correspondence handling units.

attributes.name: queue_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the correspondence queue. Primary key for the correspondence queue entity.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Operational audit: track which employee established each correspondence queue for organizational change management, capacity planning analysis, and workflow governance. Queue setup is a controlled adm

attributes.name: escalation_queue_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the target queue to which items are escalated when they exceed the escalation threshold or require senior review.

attributes.name: active_agent_count
attributes.description: Current number of agents actively assigned to process work items in this queue. Updated as agents log in/out or are reassigned.

attributes.name: assignment_algorithm
attributes.description: Method used to distribute work items to agents: round_robin (sequential rotation), skill_based (matched to agent expertise), workload_balanced (assigned to agent with lowest current workload), manual (supervisor assigns).

attributes.name: auto_assignment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether work items entering this queue are automatically assigned to available agents based on workload balancing rules (True) or require manual assignment by a supervisor (False).

attributes.name: average_handling_time_minutes
attributes.description: Historical average time in minutes required to process and resolve a single work item in this queue. Used for capacity planning and staffing decisions.

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel through which correspondence items enter this queue: mail (postal mail), email (electronic mail), phone (call center), fax (facsimile), web_portal (online customer portal), mobile_app (mobile application).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this queue record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_item_count
attributes.description: Current number of active work items in the queue awaiting processing or resolution. Updated in real-time as items are added or completed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this queue became operational and began accepting work items.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of business hours after which unresolved items in this queue are automatically escalated to a supervisor or higher-priority queue.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this queue record was last updated, including changes to configuration, SLA targets, or staffing.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the queue manager for escalation notifications and operational communications.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual responsible for managing the queue, including workload distribution, SLA monitoring, and escalation handling.

attributes.name: max_queue_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of work items that can be held in this queue simultaneously before triggering overflow or escalation procedures. Used for capacity planning and workload management.

attributes.name: open_hours
attributes.description: Business hours during which this queue is actively staffed and processing work items (e.g., Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST). Items arriving outside these hours are queued for next business day.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit responsible for managing and processing work items in this queue (e.g., Customer Service Operations, Compliance Department, Claims Administration).

attributes.name: owning_department
attributes.description: Specific department within the business unit that owns this queue and is accountable for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Default priority level assigned to work items entering this queue. Critical queues handle regulatory inquiries and escalated complaints; high priority handles time-sensitive customer requests; medium handles standard correspondence; low handles informational requests.

attributes.name: quality_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completed work items from this queue require quality assurance review before final closure (True for regulatory and complaint queues, False for routine correspondence).

attributes.name: quality_sample_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of completed work items from this queue that are randomly selected for quality assurance review. Null if quality_review_required is False.

attributes.name: queue_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the queue for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: queue_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the queues purpose, scope, and types of correspondence items it handles. Used for training and operational documentation.

attributes.name: queue_name
attributes.description: Business name of the correspondence queue (e.g., Inbound Mail Triage, Complaint Handling, Regulatory Response, Returned Mail Processing, Escalation Review).

attributes.name: queue_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the queue. Active queues accept new work items; inactive queues are temporarily disabled; suspended queues are paused pending review; archived queues are retired but retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: queue_type
attributes.description: Classification of the queue based on correspondence workflow type: inbound (incoming mail/email triage), outbound (outgoing correspondence processing), complaint (complaint handling), regulatory (regulatory response), escalation (escalated items requiring senior review), returned_mail (undeliverable mail processing).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category code used for regulatory reporting purposes when items from this queue are included in state DOI complaint reports or NAIC market conduct filings. Null if requires_regulatory_tracking is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement (MCAS), State DOI Complaint Reporting Standards

attributes.name: requires_regulatory_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this queue must be tracked and reported to regulatory authorities (True for complaint queues, regulatory response queues) or are internal operational items only (False).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, State DOI Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: sla_acknowledgment_hours
attributes.description: Target number of business hours within which correspondence items in this queue must be acknowledged. Typical regulatory requirement is 2 business days (16 hours) per state Department of Insurance (DOI) standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, State DOI Complaint Handling Requirements

attributes.name: sla_compliance_rate_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Historical percentage of work items in this queue that were resolved within the defined SLA targets. Calculated over the most recent reporting period (typically 30 or 90 days).

attributes.name: sla_resolution_days
attributes.description: Target number of business days within which correspondence items in this queue must be fully resolved. Typical regulatory requirement is 30 business days per state DOI requirements for complaint resolution.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, State DOI Complaint Handling Requirements

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes supported by this queue (e.g., en,es,zh,fr). Null if supports_multi_language is False.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes, State Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: supports_multi_language
attributes.description: Indicates whether this queue is staffed to handle correspondence in multiple languages (True) or English only (False). Critical for compliance with state language access requirements.
attributes.references: State Language Access Requirements, NAIC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this queue was retired or archived and stopped accepting new work items. Null for active queues.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone in which the queue operates, using IANA time zone database format (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago). Used for SLA calculations and business hours enforcement.

attributes.name: parent_queue_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on queue (parent_queue_id)

attributes.name: assignment_date

attributes.name: assignment_method

attributes.name: assignment_status

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the correspondence item was assigned to the queue and representative.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the correspondence was received, such as email, phone, postal mail, web portal, mobile app, or fax.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: The claim number associated with the correspondence item, if applicable, enabling linkage to the relevant insurance claim.

attributes.name: completion_date

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the assigned representative completed processing of the correspondence item.

attributes.name: correspondence_type
attributes.description: The type or category of correspondence item being assigned, such as complaint, inquiry, service request, claim correspondence, policy change request, or regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of the escalation level for this assignment. Zero indicates initial assignment, higher numbers indicate successive escalations to senior representatives or management.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for escalation, such as SLA breach, complexity, regulatory sensitivity, or customer request.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active assignment for the correspondence item. False if the item has been reassigned to another representative or queue.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: workload_balance_score

Critical for NAIC market conduct examination defense and state DOI audit response.

attributes.name: statutory_filing_id

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of the notice delivery: compliant (delivered on time), late (delivered after deadline but within cure period), missed (deadline missed, no delivery), cured (late delivery remediated), pending_confirmation (dispatched, awaiting delivery confirmation).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance log record was first created in the system, capturing the moment the notice requirement was logged.

attributes.name: cure_action_taken

attributes.name: cure_completion_date

attributes.name: days_to_deadline
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the triggering event and the required delivery date, as mandated by regulation (e.g., 30 days for replacement notice, 10 days for free look).

attributes.name: days_variance
attributes.description: Number of days by which the actual dispatch date differed from the required delivery date. Negative values indicate early dispatch; positive values indicate late dispatch.

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which delivery of the notice was confirmed (e.g., postal delivery confirmation, email open receipt, certified mail signature). Null if delivery has not yet been confirmed.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the notice was dispatched: postal_mail, certified_mail, email, secure_portal, fax, or sms.

attributes.name: delivery_tracking_number

attributes.name: exception_flag

attributes.name: exception_reason

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: notice_type

products.name: secure_message
products.description: Transactional record of every secure portal message exchanged between policyholders, agents, or beneficiaries and Life Insurance through the authenticated online portal or mobile application. Captures message thread identity, sender, recipient, subject, message body reference, sent timestamp, read timestamp, and associated policy or service request. Distinct from call_record (phone channel) and inbound_correspondence (physical/email channel) — this entity owns the authenticated digital messaging channel interactions.

attributes.name: comm_template_id

attributes.name: complaint_id

attributes.name: group_sponsor_id

attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this secure message. Links the message to the specific policy context being discussed.

attributes.name: parent_message_secure_message_id
attributes.description: Reference to the message being replied to. Null for initial messages in a thread. Enables hierarchical conversation structure.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Policyholders with variable products use secure portal messaging to inquire about portfolio performance, request fund transfers, review investment elections, and ask allocation questions. Portfolio co

attributes.description: Number of file attachments included with this message. Zero indicates no attachments. Actual attachment metadata stored in related attachment entity.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag

attributes.description: Date and time when compliance review was completed for this message. Null if review has not occurred or is not required. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.description: Date and time when the message record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the message data. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.description: Date and time when the message was successfully delivered to the recipient's inbox. Null if delivery has not yet occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

products.name: sla
products.description: Reference master defining the service level agreement (SLA) standards governing correspondence handling timeframes by correspondence type, channel, and jurisdiction. Captures the correspondence category (complaint acknowledgment, regulatory inquiry response, inbound service letter, DOI inquiry), the required acknowledgment window (e.g., 2 business days), the required resolution window (e.g., 30 calendar days), the applicable state or federal regulation mandating the SLA, and escalation trigger thresholds. Used by queue_assignment and escalation entities to enforce and monitor compliance with correspondence handling obligations.

attributes.name: sla_id

attributes.description: Number of business days within which the correspondence must be acknowledged (e.g., 2 business days for complaint acknowledgment).

attributes.name: acknowledgment_window_unit
attributes.description: Unit of time for the acknowledgment window (business days, calendar days, or hours).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA definition was formally approved.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA definition requires formal approval before activation (True/False).

attributes.name: auto_escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether correspondence matching this SLA should be automatically escalated when the escalation threshold is reached (True/False).

attributes.name: business_hours_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether SLA time calculations should only count business hours (True) or run continuously (False).

attributes.name: correspondence_category
attributes.description: The category of correspondence to which this SLA applies (e.g., complaint acknowledgment, regulatory inquiry response, inbound service letter, DOI inquiry).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SLA definition becomes effective and applicable to correspondence.

attributes.description: Code identifying the work queue to which correspondence should be escalated when the threshold is reached.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the resolution deadline at which the correspondence should be escalated to management or specialized teams.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of time for the escalation threshold (business days, calendar days, or hours).

attributes.name: exclude_holidays_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether holidays should be excluded from SLA time calculations (True/False).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA definition expires or is superseded by a new version. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or jurisdiction code where the SLA applies (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Federal regulations use 'US'.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this SLA definition.

attributes.name: notification_template_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the notification template to be used for acknowledgment or escalation communications.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Default priority level assigned to correspondence matching this SLA category (critical, high, medium, low).

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the state or federal regulation mandating this SLA (e.g., CA Insurance Code Section 790.03, NAIC Model Regulation 42).

attributes.name: requires_compliance_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether correspondence matching this SLA requires compliance department review (True/False).

attributes.name: requires_legal_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether correspondence matching this SLA requires legal department review (True/False).

attributes.name: requires_management_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether correspondence matching this SLA requires mandatory management review before closure (True/False).

attributes.name: resolution_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the correspondence must be fully resolved or responded to (e.g., 30 calendar days for regulatory inquiry response).

attributes.name: resolution_window_unit

attributes.name: resend_correspondence_bulk_comm_recipient_id

products.name: comm_channel
products.description: Reference master defining all communication channels supported by the correspondence domain — physical mail (USPS standard, USPS certified), email, SMS/text, secure portal message, fax, and outbound call. Captures channel code, channel name, channel category (electronic vs. physical), e-delivery consent requirement flag, regulatory acceptance status (whether the channel satisfies state DOI notice delivery requirements), and operational availability status. Used by outbound notice generation and delivery tracking to enforce channel eligibility rules.

attributes.name: comm_channel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the communication channel. Primary key for the communication channel reference master.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who most recently updated the communication channel record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls), NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel meets accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1 for electronic channels, large print options for physical mail) to ensure communications are accessible to policyholders with disabilities. True if accessibility compliant; False if not compliant.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1

attributes.name: aml_kyc_verification_supported_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Know Your Customer (KYC) Verification Supported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports identity verification and authentication mechanisms required for AML and KYC compliance (e.g., secure portal with multi-factor authentication). True if AML/KYC verification is supported; False if not supported.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN AML Requirements, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: average_delivery_time_hours
attributes.description: Average time in hours from dispatch to delivery for this channel, based on historical delivery tracking data. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) planning and channel selection optimization.

attributes.name: batch_processing_supported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports batch processing of multiple communications in a single transmission (e.g., bulk mail, batch email campaigns). True if batch processing is supported; False if only individual communications are supported.

attributes.name: channel_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the communication channel distinguishing between electronic delivery (email, SMS, portal), physical delivery (postal mail, fax), and voice (outbound call). Used for channel grouping and reporting.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the communication channel (e.g., USPS_STD, EMAIL, SMS, PORTAL, FAX, CALL). Used as a business key for channel lookup and routing logic.

attributes.name: channel_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the communication channel (e.g., United States Postal Service Standard Mail, Email, SMS Text Message, Secure Portal Message, Fax, Outbound Call).

attributes.name: channel_usage_restriction
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions or limitations on the use of this channel (e.g., only for non-regulatory notices, requires policyholder consent, not available in certain states, only for specific policy types). Null if no restrictions apply.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security, State DOI Notice Requirements

attributes.name: cost_per_communication
attributes.description: Average cost in US dollars (USD) to send a single communication via this channel, including postage, vendor fees, and processing costs. Used for cost analysis and channel optimization. All costs are in USD as the company operates in the US market.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the communication channel record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls), NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the communication is delivered: push (sent directly to recipient), pull (recipient retrieves from portal), or interactive (real-time conversation such as phone call).

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of communication channels in user interfaces and channel selection lists. Lower values appear first. Used to prioritize preferred channels.

attributes.name: e_delivery_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel requires explicit policyholder consent for electronic delivery under state insurance regulations and NAIC model laws (e.g., E-SIGN Act compliance). True if consent is required; False if not required (e.g., physical mail does not require e-delivery consent).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act on Electronic Transactions, E-SIGN Act (15 USC 7001)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the communication channel became or will become available for use in the correspondence system.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: encryption_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether communications sent via this channel must be encrypted to meet data security and privacy requirements (e.g., NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security, HIPAA for health-related communications). True if encryption is required; False if not required.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security, HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164)

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel meets HIPAA compliance requirements for transmitting Protected Health Information (PHI) in disability income and long-term care insurance communications. True if HIPAA compliant; False if not compliant.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the communication channel record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls), NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: max_attachment_size_mb
attributes.description: Maximum total size in megabytes (MB) of attachments that can be sent via this channel. Null if attachments are not supported or if there is no size limit.

attributes.name: multi_language_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports delivery of communications in multiple languages to accommodate diverse policyholder populations. True if multi-language support is available; False if only English is supported.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special instructions, or operational notes about the communication channel. Used for internal documentation and knowledge sharing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational availability status of the communication channel. Active means the channel is available for use; Inactive means temporarily unavailable; Suspended means administratively disabled; Deprecated means the channel is being phased out and should not be used for new communications.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: priority_routing_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports expedited or priority delivery for urgent communications (e.g., certified mail, priority email routing). True if priority routing is available; False if not available.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel provides verifiable proof of delivery (e.g., certified mail tracking, email read receipts, portal access logs). True if proof of delivery is available; False if not available.

attributes.name: regulatory_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel satisfies state Department of Insurance (DOI) notice delivery requirements for regulatory and statutory communications. Accepted means the channel is fully compliant for all notice types; Conditional means the channel is acceptable only under specific circumstances (e.g., with consent); Not Accepted means the channel does not meet regulatory standards for certain notice types.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security, State DOI Notice Requirements

attributes.name: return_receipt_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel provides return receipt or delivery confirmation signed by the recipient (e.g., USPS certified mail return receipt, email read receipt). True if return receipt is available; False if not available.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target delivery time in hours as defined in the service level agreement for this channel. Used to measure channel performance against contractual commitments.

attributes.name: supports_attachments_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports sending attachments or supplementary documents along with the primary communication. True if attachments are supported; False if not supported.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the communication channel was or will be retired from operational use. Null if the channel is still active or has no planned termination.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: tracking_capability
attributes.description: Level of delivery tracking available for the channel. Full tracking provides detailed delivery status and timestamps; Partial tracking provides limited status updates; None indicates no tracking capability.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract or agreement reference number with the vendor providing the communication channel service. Used for vendor management and contract compliance tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or service provider that facilitates delivery for this channel (e.g., United States Postal Service, email service provider, SMS gateway provider). Null if the channel is managed internally.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Data Security

attributes.name: parent_comm_channel_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on comm_channel (parent_comm_channel_id)

products.name: suppression_list
products.description: Master record managing communication suppression rules for specific parties, policies, or communication categories. Captures the suppressed party or policy, the suppression type (legal hold — no contact, litigation in progress, deceased — no marketing, opt-out — electronic only, regulatory restriction), the suppression effective date, expiration date, and the authorizing source (legal department, compliance, policyholder request). Ensures outbound notice generation and bulk campaign engines respect all active suppression rules before dispatching correspondence.

attributes.name: suppression_list_id

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the policy subject to suppression rules. Null if suppression applies to a party across all policies.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the party (policyholder, beneficiary, agent) subject to suppression. Null if suppression applies to a specific policy only.

attributes.name: primary_suppression_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created or approved the suppression record.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the suppression was authorized and entered into the system.

attributes.name: authorizing_source
attributes.description: Department or entity that authorized the suppression rule. Legal department for litigation holds; compliance for regulatory mandates; policyholder request for opt-outs; regulatory order for government directives; customer service for complaints; fraud investigation for suspicious activity.

attributes.name: blocked_communication_count
attributes.description: Total number of outbound communications that have been blocked by this suppression rule since activation. Updated by correspondence dispatch systems.

attributes.name: campaign_exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific campaign codes or identifiers that this suppression rule blocks. Null if suppression applies to all campaigns within the category.

attributes.name: channel_exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of communication channels blocked by this suppression (e.g., email, SMS, phone, postal mail, fax). Null if all channels within the category are suppressed.
attributes.references: TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act, Internal Channel Management Standards

attributes.name: consent_revocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suppression represents a revocation of previously granted communication consent. True requires removal from all active consent-based campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this suppression record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: Date of death for the party, if deceased indicator is true. Used for death benefit claims and escheatment timelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Death Master File Standards, State Escheatment Laws

attributes.name: deceased_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suppression is due to confirmed death of the party. True triggers escheatment workflows and death benefit processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Death Master File Standards, State Escheatment Laws

attributes.name: dmf_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party was matched against the Social Security Administration Death Master File. True confirms official death record.
attributes.references: SSA Death Master File, NAIC Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the suppression rule becomes active and begins blocking communications.

attributes.name: enforcement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the suppression rule was deactivated and stopped blocking correspondence. Null for currently active suppressions.

attributes.name: enforcement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the suppression rule was activated in outbound communication systems and began blocking correspondence.

attributes.name: escheatment_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suppression is associated with potential unclaimed property that may need to be escheated to the state. True triggers escheatment due diligence workflows.
attributes.references: State Escheatment Laws, NAIC Unclaimed Property Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the suppression rule automatically expires and ceases to block communications. Null for indefinite suppressions.

attributes.name: last_blocked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this suppression rule most recently blocked an outbound communication attempt.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this suppression was most recently reviewed and validated by compliance or legal.

attributes.name: legal_case_number
attributes.description: Court case or legal matter reference number associated with the suppression, if applicable. Used for litigation holds and regulatory orders.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance or legal review of this suppression rule. Null if no review is required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or case-specific details related to the suppression. Used by compliance and customer service teams.

attributes.name: opt_out_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the party submitted the opt-out or suppression request. Web portal for online submissions; phone call for IVR or agent; written request for postal mail; email request for electronic; in-person for branch; third-party service for aggregators.

attributes.name: opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the opt-out or suppression request was received and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suppression can be manually overridden for urgent or regulatory-required communications. True allows override with proper authorization; false enforces absolute suppression.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance and Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: override_authorization_level
attributes.description: Minimum authority level required to override this suppression rule. None means no override permitted; higher levels require escalating approval.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency and importance of enforcing this suppression rule. Critical for legal holds and regulatory orders; high for fraud and deceased; medium for opt-outs; low for preference changes.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the suppression. Deceased for confirmed death; litigation for legal proceedings; regulatory mandate for government orders; customer opt-out for voluntary requests; fraud suspected for investigation; privacy request for data protection; complaint escalation for service issues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deceased|litigation|regulatory_mandate|customer_opt_out|fraud_suspected|privacy_request|complaint_escalation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards, TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the suppression was applied, including case numbers, complaint references, or legal citations.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Government or regulatory body order or directive number that mandates the suppression, if applicable.
attributes.references: NAIC Regulatory Reporting Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suppression must be reported to regulatory bodies (e.g., state DOI, NAIC). True for suppressions resulting from regulatory orders or market conduct issues.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Reporting, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suppression requires periodic review or renewal. True for temporary suppressions that need ongoing validation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system or application that originated this suppression record (e.g., CRM, Policy Admin, Legal Case Management).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this suppression record in the source system, used for reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: suppression_category
attributes.description: Scope of communications affected by the suppression. All communications blocks everything; marketing only allows transactional notices; electronic only suppresses email/SMS; phone only blocks calls; mail only stops postal correspondence; specific campaign targets individual campaigns.
attributes.references: TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: suppression_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the suppression rule. Active rules are enforced; expired rules are no longer in effect; suspended rules are temporarily inactive; cancelled rules were terminated early; pending review awaits approval.

attributes.name: suppression_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the suppression record, used for tracking and reference in correspondence systems.

attributes.name: suppression_type
attributes.description: Category of suppression rule applied. Legal hold prevents all contact during legal proceedings; litigation in progress restricts marketing; deceased no marketing stops promotional communications; opt-out electronic blocks email/SMS; regulatory restriction enforces compliance mandates; do not contact is a blanket prohibition.
attributes.references: TCPA, CAN-SPAM Act, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this suppression record was most recently modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: superseded_suppression_list_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on suppression_list (superseded_suppression_list_id)

products.name: comm_audit_trail
products.description: Immutable audit log capturing every significant state change, action, and access event for communications, complaints, and regulatory correspondence managed by the correspondence domain. Records the entity type and ID affected, the action performed (created, dispatched, delivered, returned, escalated, closed, accessed, modified), the actor identity, the timestamp, and the before/after state snapshot. Supports NAIC market conduct examination evidence production, SOX audit requirements, and internal quality assurance reviews. This is a business audit record — not an IT system log.

attributes.name: comm_audit_trail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each audit trail record. Primary key for the communication audit trail entity.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the claim associated with the audited correspondence entity, if applicable. Enables claim-level audit trail reporting.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the policy associated with the audited correspondence entity, if applicable. Enables policy-level audit trail reporting.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the policyholder or customer associated with the audited correspondence entity. Enables customer-level audit trail reporting.

attributes.name: primary_comm_employee_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the user, system, or agent who performed the action. May be a human user ID, system account, or automated process identifier.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the user session or application session during which the action was performed.

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to correspondence.correspondence_sla. Business justification: Link audit trail to SLA context when audit event is SLA-related. Essential for SLA compliance auditing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_comm_exception_approval_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the exception action.

attributes.name: action_reason_code
attributes.description: A standardized code indicating the business reason or trigger for the action (e.g., POLICY_CHANGE, CUSTOMER_REQUEST, REGULATORY_REQUIREMENT, SYSTEM_CORRECTION).

attributes.name: action_reason_description
attributes.description: A free-text description providing additional context or explanation for why the action was performed.

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the audited action occurred. This is the business event timestamp, not the record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The specific action or state change that occurred on the entity (e.g., created, dispatched, delivered, returned, escalated, closed, accessed, modified). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|updated|dispatched|delivered|returned|escalated|closed|accessed|viewed|modified|deleted|archived — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: actor_name
attributes.description: The display name or full name of the user or system that performed the action.

attributes.name: actor_role
attributes.description: The business role or job function of the actor at the time of the action (e.g., Customer Service Representative, Claims Adjuster, System Administrator, Automated Process).

attributes.name: after_state_snapshot
attributes.description: A JSON or structured text representation of the entity's state immediately after the action was performed. Captures key field values for comparison and audit purposes.

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to this audit event. May include context, observations, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: before_state_snapshot
attributes.description: A JSON or structured text representation of the entity's state immediately before the action was performed. Captures key field values for comparison and audit purposes.

attributes.name: changed_fields
attributes.description: A comma-separated list or structured representation of the specific fields that were modified during this action. Empty for non-update actions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit trail record was created in the data platform. This is the record insertion timestamp, distinct from the action_timestamp.

attributes.name: entity_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the specific correspondence entity (communication_id, complaint_id, escalation_id, etc.) that was affected by this audit event.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: The type of correspondence domain entity that this audit record pertains to (e.g., communication, complaint, escalation, call record, delivery tracking, returned mail).

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit event represents an exception to normal business processes or policy (e.g., manual override, expedited processing, policy waiver).

attributes.name: exception_justification
attributes.description: A free-text explanation of why the exception was necessary and the business justification for the action.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the action was initiated. Used for security audit and fraud detection purposes.

attributes.name: qa_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this audit event was reviewed by the quality assurance team.

attributes.name: qa_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the quality assurance reviewer regarding this audit event.

attributes.name: qa_review_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the quality assurance review (e.g., compliant, non-compliant, exception approved, pending review).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit event has been flagged for quality assurance review or internal audit sampling.

attributes.name: record_hash

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: A reference number or case identifier assigned by a regulatory body for tracking this audit event or related investigation.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit event is subject to regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., NAIC market conduct examination, state insurance department inquiry).

attributes.name: retention_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this audit record is eligible for archival or deletion per retention policy.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years this audit record must be retained per regulatory or internal policy requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the system that originated the audited action (e.g., Policy Administration System, CRM, Claims Management System, Customer Portal).

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction or request identifier from the source system that triggered this audit event. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: sox_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit event is relevant for SOX compliance and internal control testing.

attributes.name: prior_comm_audit_trail_id

products.name: template_translation
products.description: This association product represents the translation service engagement between a communication template and a vendor. It captures the operational record of vendor translation services for specific templates, including translation quality metrics, cost, turnaround time, and language-specific certifications. Each record links one comm_template to one vendor for a specific translation engagement, tracking the business relationship for vendor selection, cost optimization, and quality management.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, communication templates require translation into multiple languages for different jurisdictions and customer populations, and this translation work is performed by multiple specialized vendors. A single template (e.g., premium reminder) may be translated by different vendors for different languages (Vendor A translates to Spanish, Vendor B to French), and each vendor translates multiple templates across the template catalog. The business actively manages these vendor-template translation relationships to track quality, cost, and turnaround time for vendor selection and cost optimization.

products.name: queue_vendor_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment contract between correspondence queues and third-party vendors who service those queues. It captures vendor capacity commitments, SLA targets, cost structures, and service periods for each queue-vendor pairing. Each record links one correspondence queue to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this service relationship — enabling workload distribution, vendor performance monitoring, cost allocation, and capacity planning across the correspondence processing workflow.. Existence Justification: In life insurance correspondence operations, queues (claims intake, policy service, complaints, regulatory response) are serviced by multiple vendors simultaneously in different roles — primary processor, backup vendor, overflow capacity provider. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., a BPO firm specializing in correspondence handling) services multiple queues across different business units. The business actively manages these assignments with specific SLA targets, cost structures, volume commitments, and service periods for each queue-vendor pairing.
