products.name: job_role
products.description: Reference catalog of all job roles and job families used across the Life Insurance enterprise. Defines role code, role title, job family (underwriting, actuarial, claims, finance, IT, operations, compliance), job level band, minimum and maximum grade, required competencies, required licenses or designations (FSA, MAAA, CPCU, CLU, ChFC), and whether the role is subject to FINRA registration requirements for variable product sales. Provides the classification taxonomy for position and employee assignment.

attributes.name: job_role_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job role. Primary key for the job role reference catalog.

attributes.name: background_check_level
attributes.description: Level of pre-employment background screening required for the role based on access to sensitive data, financial authority, or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), FINRA Rule 3110, Internal Security Policy

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours
attributes.description: Annual or biennial continuing education hours required to maintain licenses and designations for the role. Null if no CE requirement.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance, NAIC, Professional Designation Bodies

attributes.name: core_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of essential skills and competencies required for successful role performance (e.g., risk assessment, financial analysis, regulatory compliance, customer service, data analytics).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the job role record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 job category classification for the role. Required for federal EEO-1 reporting to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive_senior_level_officials_and_managers|first_mid_level_officials_and_managers|professionals|technicians|sales_workers|administrative_support_workers|craft_workers|operatives|laborers_and_helpers|service_workers — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) EEO-1 Component 1 Report

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the job role definition became or will become effective for use in the organization.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment classification for the role indicating full-time, part-time, contract, or other employment arrangement.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standards, Department of Labor (DOL) Guidelines

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the job role definition is no longer effective. Null for currently active roles with no planned end date.

attributes.name: fiduciary_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role has fiduciary responsibilities under ERISA or state insurance fiduciary standards, requiring adherence to duty of care and loyalty standards.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA), Department of Labor (DOL) Fiduciary Standards

attributes.name: finra_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role requires FINRA registration for selling variable life insurance or variable annuity products. Triggers Series 6, 7, or 63 licensing requirements.
attributes.references: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

attributes.name: finra_series_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of FINRA series examinations required for the role (e.g., Series 6, Series 7, Series 63, Series 24). Applicable only when FINRA registration is required.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the role is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), Department of Labor (DOL) Regulations

attributes.name: grade_band
attributes.description: Compensation grade band assigned to the role defining the salary range and benefits tier. Used for pay equity analysis and budgeting.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles by function and skill set. Aligns with core business processes and organizational structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: underwriting|actuarial|claims|finance|information_technology|operations|compliance|legal|human_resources|marketing|sales|customer_service|investment_management|product_development|risk_management|audit — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Job Family Framework, NAIC Organizational Standards

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the role within the organization indicating seniority, scope of responsibility, and decision-making authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|intermediate|senior|lead|principal|manager|senior_manager|director|senior_director|vice_president|senior_vice_president|executive_vice_president|c_level — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Compensation and Job Architecture Framework

attributes.name: job_sub_family
attributes.description: Specialized sub-category within the job family providing finer classification granularity (e.g., within actuarial: pricing, valuation, reserving).

attributes.name: maximum_grade
attributes.description: Highest numeric grade level within the grade band for this role. Defines the ceiling for compensation progression.

attributes.name: minimum_grade
attributes.description: Lowest numeric grade level within the grade band for this role. Defines the entry point for compensation.

attributes.name: preferred_designations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional designations or certifications preferred but not required for the role. Enhances candidate competitiveness.
attributes.references: Society of Actuaries (SOA), American Academy of Actuaries (AAA), The Institutes (CPCU), American College of Financial Services (CLU/ChFC)

attributes.name: preferred_education_level
attributes.description: Preferred educational attainment for optimal role performance. May exceed minimum requirements.

attributes.name: preferred_experience_years
attributes.description: Preferred number of years of relevant professional experience for optimal role performance.

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements based on job requirements and organizational policy.

attributes.name: required_designations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional designations or certifications required for the role (e.g., FSA, MAAA, CPCU, CLU, ChFC, CFP, CFA, CPA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to designation_type reference product for granular tracking]
attributes.references: Society of Actuaries (SOA), American Academy of Actuaries (AAA), The Institutes (CPCU), American College of Financial Services (CLU/ChFC)

attributes.name: required_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational attainment required for the role. Used for candidate screening and workforce planning.

attributes.name: required_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the role.

attributes.name: required_licenses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional licenses or state insurance licenses required for the role (e.g., state insurance producer license for underwriters and agents). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to license_type reference product for granular tracking]
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance, NAIC Licensing Standards

attributes.name: role_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the job role across the enterprise. Used for position classification and reporting.
attributes.references: ACORD HR Standards, Internal Job Classification Framework

attributes.name: role_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the job role including primary responsibilities, scope of authority, and key deliverables.

attributes.name: role_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job role in the enterprise catalog. Active roles are available for position creation and employee assignment.

attributes.name: role_title
attributes.description: Official job title for the role as used in position postings, organizational charts, and employee records.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role is classified as safety-sensitive, requiring drug and alcohol testing under Department of Transportation (DOT) or company policy.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Regulations, Internal Safety Policy

attributes.name: sec_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role requires SEC registration as an investment adviser representative for managing variable product investments.

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification code for the role. Used for labor market analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) SOC System

attributes.name: span_of_control_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of direct reports expected for this supervisory role. Null for non-supervisory roles.

attributes.name: span_of_control_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of direct reports expected for this supervisory role. Null for non-supervisory roles.

attributes.name: succession_criticality
attributes.description: Criticality rating for succession planning indicating the business impact of vacancy and urgency of maintaining a talent pipeline for the role.

attributes.name: supervisory_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role has direct supervisory or management responsibility for other employees.

attributes.name: technical_skills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of technical skills and tools required for the role (e.g., SQL, Python, Excel, actuarial software, policy administration systems).

attributes.name: travel_requirement_pct
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring business travel. Used for role planning and candidate expectations.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the job role record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the job role record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: parent_job_role_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on job_role (parent_job_role_id)

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Master record for every organizational unit (department, division, business unit, team) within the Life Insurance enterprise hierarchy. Captures org unit code, org unit name, org unit type (division, department, team, cost center), parent org unit for hierarchy traversal, effective date, end date, owning legal entity, and assigned cost center. Supports multi-level organizational hierarchy modeling for reporting, expense allocation, and workforce capacity planning.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit within the Life Insurance enterprise hierarchy.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the owning legal entity for statutory reporting and regulatory compliance purposes.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy, enabling multi-level organizational structure traversal for reporting and workforce planning.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in USD for expense planning and financial management.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the annual budget amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of employees assigned to this organizational unit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became active or when the current configuration became effective.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for this organizational unit.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit was dissolved, merged, or otherwise became inactive. Null for active units.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary functional area or business domain that this organizational unit supports within the Life Insurance enterprise. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: underwriting|claims|actuarial|sales|distribution|operations|finance|compliance|technology|human_resources — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory served by this organizational unit (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, National).

attributes.name: headcount_capacity
attributes.description: Authorized headcount capacity for this organizational unit, used for workforce capacity planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this organizational unit within the enterprise hierarchy (1=top level, increasing for each level down).

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from root to this organizational unit, typically represented as slash-separated org unit codes for efficient hierarchy queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last modified.

attributes.name: location_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the physical location of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: location_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, building) for the physical location of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City where this organizational unit is physically located.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the physical location of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: location_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the physical location of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: location_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where this organizational unit is physically located.
attributes.references: USPS Address Standards, NAIC State Jurisdiction Codes

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: Mission statement or charter defining the strategic purpose and objectives of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: org_unit_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the organizational unit, used in financial reporting and expense allocation systems.

attributes.name: org_unit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the organizational unit's purpose, responsibilities, and scope within the Life Insurance enterprise.

attributes.name: org_unit_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the organizational unit (e.g., Individual Life Underwriting, Claims Operations, Actuarial Valuation).

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit within the enterprise hierarchy.

attributes.name: org_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit within the enterprise hierarchy structure.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for this organizational unit.

attributes.name: profit_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is designated as a profit center (True) or cost center (False) for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is subject to direct regulatory reporting requirements (True/False).

products.name: employment_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing each employment event in an employee's lifecycle — hire, rehire, transfer, promotion, demotion, leave of absence, return from leave, and termination. Stores event type, effective date, prior position, new position, prior org unit, new org unit, prior job grade, new job grade, reason code, action initiator, and approver. Provides the immutable audit trail of all employment status changes and job movements for an employee throughout their tenure.

attributes.name: employment_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each employment event record in an employee's lifecycle. Primary key for the employment record table.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or authority who approved this employment action. May be a senior manager, HR director, or executive depending on the event type and organizational policy. Required for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: primary_employment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the subject of this employment event. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: primary_employment_prior_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, branch) where the employee was assigned before this event. Null for initial hire. Enables organizational movement tracking and workforce planning.

attributes.name: primary_employment_prior_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's position before this employment event. Null for initial hire events. Used to track career progression and organizational movement.

attributes.name: quaternary_employment_new_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's direct supervisor or manager after this event. Null for termination. Critical for organizational hierarchy and management reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_employment_prior_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's direct supervisor or manager before this event. Null for initial hire. Enables organizational hierarchy tracking and reporting line analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this employment action was formally approved by the designated authority. Used for audit trail and compliance verification. May differ from the effective date.

attributes.name: benefits_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employment event triggers a change in the employee's benefits eligibility or enrollment. True if benefits package changed due to employment type, status, or organizational policy; false otherwise. Used to trigger benefits administration workflows.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special circumstances related to this employment event. Used by HR administrators to document non-standard situations, approvals, or business justifications.

attributes.name: compensation_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employment event includes a change in the employee's base compensation. True if salary or hourly rate changed; false otherwise. Used to trigger compensation record updates and payroll adjustments.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this employment event becomes effective and the employee's status, position, or organizational assignment changes. This is the business-effective date, not the system record date.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: The type of employment action or event being recorded: hire (initial employment), rehire (return after previous termination), transfer (lateral move), promotion (upward movement), demotion (downward movement), leave of absence (temporary separation), return from leave (resumption after leave), or termination (end of employment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hire|rehire|transfer|promotion|demotion|leave_of_absence|return_from_leave|termination — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_working_date
attributes.description: The final date on which the employee physically worked or was on active duty. Populated for termination and leave_of_absence events. May differ from the effective date if there is a notice period or transition period. Used for payroll cutoff and benefits termination.

attributes.name: leave_expected_return_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leave of Absence Expected Return Date
attributes.description: The anticipated date on which the employee is expected to return from leave. Populated for leave_of_absence events. May be updated if leave is extended. Used for workforce capacity planning.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which a leave of absence begins. Populated only for leave_of_absence event types. Used to track leave duration and return-to-work planning.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: The category of leave being taken. Populated for leave_of_absence events. Values include medical (health-related), parental (maternity/paternity), personal (unpaid personal leave), military (service obligation), disability (short-term or long-term disability), or sabbatical (extended professional development leave). Required for compliance with FMLA and state leave laws.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), Department of Labor (DOL), State Leave Laws

attributes.name: licensing_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employment event impacts the employee's professional licensing requirements or status. True if the new position requires different licenses (e.g., moving from underwriting to agent role) or if termination requires license surrender; false otherwise. Critical for insurance industry compliance with state Department of Insurance regulations.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance, NAIC Licensing Standards

attributes.name: new_employment_status
attributes.description: The employee's employment status after this event. Reflects the current state resulting from this employment action.

attributes.name: new_employment_type
attributes.description: The employee's employment type classification after this event. Used for benefits eligibility, compensation calculations, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Department of Labor (DOL) FLSA Standards, ERISA

attributes.name: new_job_grade
attributes.description: The employee's job grade or level after this employment event. Null for termination. Used to track career progression and compensation changes.

attributes.name: new_work_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical work location (office, branch, home office) where the employee is based after this event. Null for termination. Used for workspace allocation and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days of notice provided for this employment event. Commonly used for voluntary resignations and some terminations. Null if no notice period applies. Used for transition planning and compliance with employment contracts.
attributes.references: Internal Human Resources Standards, Employment Contract Standards

attributes.name: prior_employment_status
attributes.description: The employee's employment status before this event. Null for initial hire. Values include active (working), on_leave (temporary absence), suspended (disciplinary or administrative hold), or terminated (employment ended).

attributes.name: prior_employment_type
attributes.description: The employee's employment type classification before this event. Null for initial hire. Distinguishes between full-time, part-time, contractor, temporary, and intern classifications for benefits and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Department of Labor (DOL) FLSA Standards, ERISA

attributes.name: prior_job_grade
attributes.description: The employee's job grade or level before this employment event. Null for initial hire. Job grades typically represent compensation bands and organizational hierarchy levels (e.g., G1, G2, M1, E1).

attributes.name: prior_work_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical work location (office, branch, home office) where the employee was based before this event. Null for initial hire. Supports geographic workforce analytics and real estate planning.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for this employment event. Examples include voluntary resignation, involuntary termination, retirement, reorganization, performance-based promotion, business need transfer, medical leave, parental leave, etc. Used for workforce analytics and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Human Resources Guidelines, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or details about the reason for this employment event. Supplements the standardized reason code with case-specific information.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: The system user ID or name of the person who created this employment record in the system. Provides accountability and audit trail for data entry. May be an HR administrator, system interface, or automated process.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this employment record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance. Distinct from the effective_date which represents the business event date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: The system user ID or name of the person who last modified this employment record. Provides accountability for changes and supports audit trail requirements. Updated with each modification to the record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this employment record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail, data quality monitoring, and change tracking. Updated whenever any field in the record is changed.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: rehire_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire by the organization. Populated for termination events. True if the employee left in good standing and may be considered for future employment; false if the employee is ineligible due to performance, conduct, or policy violations. Used in applicant screening and background checks.
attributes.references: Internal Human Resources Standards, FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act)

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this employment record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for reconciliation, audit, and troubleshooting purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this employment record originated. Examples include HRIS (Human Resources Information System), payroll system, or talent management platform. Used for data lineage tracking and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: system_access_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employment event requires changes to the employee's system access rights and permissions. True if access must be provisioned, modified, or revoked; false otherwise. Used to trigger IT security workflows and ensure SOX compliance for segregation of duties.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal IT Security Standards

attributes.name: termination_type
attributes.description: The classification of employment termination. Populated only for termination event types. Values include voluntary (employee-initiated resignation), involuntary (employer-initiated termination), retirement (age or service-based exit), death (deceased employee), or end_of_contract (natural expiration of fixed-term contract). Critical for unemployment claims, severance calculations, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: NAIC Human Resources Guidelines, State Unemployment Insurance Laws

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employment event triggers mandatory training requirements. True if the employee must complete onboarding, role-specific training, compliance training, or system training as a result of this event; false otherwise. Used to initiate training workflows and track compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Training and Development Standards, FINRA Continuing Education Requirements

attributes.name: prior_employment_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on employment_record (prior_employment_record_id)

products.name: compensation
products.description: Master record of the current and historical compensation package for each employee. Captures base salary, hourly rate, pay grade, pay band, compensation type (salary, hourly, commission-eligible), effective date, end date, currency, annualized base, target bonus percentage, target total compensation, last merit increase date, last merit increase percentage, and compensation review cycle. SSOT for employee pay data supporting payroll processing, compensation benchmarking, and regulatory pay equity reporting.

attributes.name: compensation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation record. Primary key for the compensation data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Compensation expense must be allocated to cost centers for GL posting, budget variance analysis, and financial reporting. Payroll journal entries require cost_center_id for proper expense classificati

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee to whom this compensation record applies. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: job_role_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_role. Business justification: Compensation records reference job_code (STRING) which should be normalized to job_role.role_code. This enables joining to the job_role catalog for grade bands, FLSA classification, and market referen

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Compensation packages are often tied to authorized positions (headcount slots) in addition to individual employees. This links compensation to the position being filled, enabling position-based salary

attributes.name: annualized_base
attributes.description: The annualized equivalent of the base compensation, calculated for both salaried and hourly employees. For hourly employees, this is computed based on standard full-time hours. Enables consistent comparison across compensation types.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation arrangement was formally approved. Supports audit trails and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the manager or HR representative who approved this compensation arrangement. Supports audit trails and compliance with approval authority policies.

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: The fixed annual salary amount for salaried employees. Null for hourly or commission-only employees. Represents the guaranteed base compensation before bonuses or incentives.

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee is eligible to earn commission-based compensation in addition to base pay. Applies primarily to sales and producer roles.

attributes.name: commission_plan_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the specific commission plan under which the employee earns commissions. Null if commission_eligible is false. Links to commission plan reference data.

attributes.name: compa_ratio
attributes.description: The comparative ratio of the employee's actual compensation to the midpoint of the pay range for their job grade. A value of 1.00 indicates compensation at the midpoint; values above or below indicate positioning within the range. Used for pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: compensation_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this compensation record. Active indicates the current compensation arrangement; superseded indicates a historical record replaced by a newer one; pending indicates an approved future change not yet effective.

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: The classification of the compensation structure. Indicates whether the employee is paid a fixed salary, hourly wage, commission-based, or other arrangement.
attributes.references: FLSA, DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which compensation is denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this compensation arrangement becomes active and binding. Marks the start of the compensation period.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation arrangement ceases to be active. Null for current/open-ended compensation records.

attributes.name: equity_grant_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee is eligible to receive equity-based compensation such as stock options or restricted stock units. Typically applies to executive and senior leadership roles.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is exempt or non-exempt from overtime provisions under the Fair Labor Standards Act. Critical for payroll compliance and overtime eligibility.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 USC 201, DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The full-time equivalency percentage representing the proportion of a full-time schedule this employee works. 100.00 for full-time, less than 100.00 for part-time. Used for workforce capacity planning and benefits eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy, ACA Employer Mandate

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The hourly wage rate for hourly employees. Null for salaried employees. Used to calculate gross pay based on hours worked.
attributes.references: FLSA, DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: last_merit_increase_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent merit-based salary increase for this employee. Used to track compensation review cycles and eligibility for future increases.

attributes.name: last_merit_increase_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage increase applied during the last merit review. Supports compensation history analysis and pay equity reviews.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the geographic location or office where the employee is based. Used for geographic pay differentials and compliance with local wage laws.

attributes.name: long_term_incentive_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee is eligible for long-term incentive plans that vest over multiple years. Supports retention and long-term performance alignment.

attributes.name: market_reference_percentile
attributes.description: The percentile of the external market salary data at which this employee's compensation is positioned (e.g., 50th percentile, 75th percentile). Supports competitive pay positioning and market benchmarking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or explanatory notes related to this compensation record. May include details on negotiated terms, special arrangements, or exceptions.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee is eligible to receive overtime pay. Typically aligns with FLSA non-exempt status but may reflect additional company policies.

attributes.name: pay_band
attributes.description: The pay band or salary range category within which the employee's compensation falls. Supports compensation planning and market alignment.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee receives regular paychecks. Drives payroll processing schedules and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: State Wage Payment Laws, Internal Payroll Policy

attributes.name: pay_grade

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Master and transactional record of each employee's benefit plan elections. Captures benefit plan type (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, LTD, STD, 401k, HSA, FSA, EAP), plan name, coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), election effective date, election end date, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, enrollment source (open enrollment, new hire, qualifying life event), and waiver indicator. attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who made this benefit election. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Continuation Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this enrollment represents COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event such as termination of employment or reduction in hours. True if COBRA continuation, False if active employee coverage.
attributes.references: COBRA (Title X of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985)

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event

attributes.references: COBRA (Title X of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985)

attributes.name: cobra_qualifying_event_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Qualifying Event Date
attributes.description: Date on which the COBRA qualifying event occurred, if applicable. Used to determine COBRA continuation period and eligibility. Null if not a COBRA enrollment.
attributes.references: COBRA (Title X of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985)

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted and remitted for this benefit plan.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face amount or benefit limit of the elected coverage, applicable primarily to life insurance, Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D), and disability plans. Expressed in USD. Null for plans without a defined coverage amount.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected indicating who is covered under the benefit plan: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, employee plus family, or employee plus domestic partner.

attributes.description: Date on which payroll deductions for employee contributions end for this benefit enrollment. Null for ongoing active enrollments.

attributes.name: deduction_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which payroll deductions for employee contributions begin for this benefit enrollment.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this benefit enrollment, applicable when coverage tier includes spouse, children, or family.

attributes.description: Date on which the benefit election becomes effective and coverage begins.

attributes.name: election_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit election ends and coverage terminates. Null for ongoing active enrollments.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the employee contributes per pay period toward the cost of this benefit plan. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the employer contributes per pay period toward the cost of this benefit plan. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which enrollment confirmation documentation was sent to the employee, either electronically or via mail.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee submitted or completed the benefit enrollment election.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the employee completed the benefit enrollment. Online portal is web-based self-service; paper form is manual submission; phone is telephonic enrollment; benefits counselor is assisted enrollment; mobile app is smartphone application; kiosk is on-site terminal.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this benefit enrollment, such as carrier-specific requirements, pending documentation, or enrollment exceptions.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment confirmation number provided to the employee upon successful benefit election.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The triggering event or process that initiated this benefit enrollment. Open enrollment is the annual election period; new hire is initial enrollment upon employment; qualifying life event (QLE) includes marriage, birth, adoption, divorce, or loss of other coverage; annual reenrollment is passive continuation; rehire is re-employment enrollment; leave return is enrollment upon return from leave; benefit change is mid-year plan modification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_enrollment|new_hire|qualifying_life_event|annual_reenrollment|rehire|leave_return|benefit_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Provisions, IRS Section 125 Change in Status Rules

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. attributes.name: eoi_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Evidence of Insurability underwriting process, if required. Not required indicates no EOI needed; pending indicates awaiting submission; in review indicates carrier is evaluating; approved indicates coverage granted; declined indicates coverage denied.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required

attributes.name: plan_type

attributes.name: pre_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether employee contributions for this benefit plan are deducted on a pre-tax basis under Section 125 cafeteria plan rules. True if pre-tax, False if post-tax.

attributes.name: qle_type
attributes.description: Specific type of qualifying life event that permitted mid-year enrollment or change, if applicable. Examples include marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, death of dependent, loss of other coverage, change in employment status. Null if enrollment was not triggered by a QLE.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Provisions, IRS Section 125

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this benefit enrollment record was last modified in the system.

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee self-identified as a tobacco user, which may affect premium rates for certain benefit plans such as life insurance or medical coverage. True if tobacco user, False otherwise.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium cost per pay period for this benefit plan, representing the sum of employee and employer contributions. Expressed in USD.

attributes.description: Reason provided by the employee for waiving the benefit plan, if applicable. Common reasons include coverage under spouse plan, coverage under parent plan, cost, or other coverage. Null if benefit was not waived.

Captures course code, course title, delivery method (ILT, vILT, eLearning, OJT), duration hours, passing score threshold, recurrence frequency, and whether completion is mandatory for a given job role.

attributes.name: staff_training_id

attributes.name: course_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee responsible for course content, updates, and quality assurance. Typically a subject matter expert or training manager.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who last modified the course record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the professional organization or regulatory body that has accredited or approved this course for CE credit (e.g., Society of Actuaries, LOMA, state insurance departments).

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Unique accreditation or approval number issued by the accrediting body, required for CE credit reporting to state insurance departments.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Type of evaluation used to measure course completion and competency. None indicates no formal assessment required.

attributes.name: average_completion_rate_pct
attributes.description: Historical average percentage of enrolled participants who successfully complete the course. Used for course effectiveness evaluation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: average_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Mean participant satisfaction rating from post-course evaluations, typically on a 1-5 scale. Used for continuous improvement and vendor performance assessment.

attributes.name: ce_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education credit hours awarded upon successful completion, applicable for licensed professionals (agents, actuaries, underwriters) who must maintain state or professional certifications.

attributes.name: ce_credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of CE credit for regulatory reporting. Ethics credits often have separate hour requirements per NAIC and state insurance departments.

attributes.name: certification_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal certificate of completion is issued upon successful course completion. Used for compliance documentation and employee development records.

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Average cost to deliver the training per participant, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, and vendor charges. Used for training budget planning and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the training course type. Technical includes underwriting, actuarial, and claims training; compliance is tracked separately in compliance.training_course.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the training course in the Learning Management System (LMS). Used for course catalog lookup and enrollment processing.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the course objectives, content outline, learning outcomes, and target audience. Used in course catalog and enrollment communications.

attributes.name: course_materials_url
attributes.description: Web link or LMS path to access course materials, handouts, reference documents, and supplementary resources.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the training course. Active courses are available for enrollment; inactive courses are temporarily unavailable; retired courses are archived and no longer offered.

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the training course as displayed in the course catalog and on completion certificates.

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: Functional classification indicating the purpose and target audience scope of the training course.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the course record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost_per_participant (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Instructional delivery format. ILT (Instructor-Led Training) is in-person classroom; vILT (virtual Instructor-Led Training) is live online; eLearning is asynchronous digital; OJT (On-the-Job Training) is hands-on mentorship; blended combines multiple methods.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total instructional time required to complete the course, measured in hours. Used for capacity planning and Continuing Education (CE) credit calculation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the course is retired or no longer available for new enrollments. Null for courses with indefinite availability.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the course becomes available for enrollment and delivery. Used for course catalog publishing and scheduling.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this course is required for one or more job roles. True if mandatory for at least one role; false if entirely optional.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language of course delivery and materials (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish, FRA for French).

attributes.name: last_content_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent content accuracy and relevance review. Used to ensure training materials remain current with regulatory changes, product updates, and industry best practices.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the course record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: learning_objectives
attributes.description: Structured list of specific skills, knowledge, or competencies participants will acquire upon successful completion. Used for competency mapping and skills gap analysis.

attributes.name: max_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants allowed per course session. Applicable primarily to ILT and vILT courses with instructor or facility constraints. Null for self-paced eLearning.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory content review. Ensures training materials are periodically updated to reflect regulatory changes (NAIC, state insurance departments) and business process evolution.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score (percentage or points) required to successfully complete the course and receive credit. Null for courses without formal assessment.

attributes.name: prerequisite_courses

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required re-certifications or refresher training. Null for one-time courses. Common values: 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), 36 (triennial).

attributes.name: target_job_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job role codes for which this training is designed or required (e.g., 'UW01,UW02' for underwriter roles, 'ACT01' for actuaries, 'CLM01' for claims adjusters).

attributes.name: vendor_course_code
attributes.description: External vendor's unique identifier for the course, used for integration with third-party Learning Management Systems (LMS) and completion tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training vendor or content provider if the course is sourced externally. Null for internally developed courses.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier for the course content (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented when course materials are updated. Used for audit trail and completion record accuracy.

attributes.name: prerequisite_staff_training_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on staff_training (prerequisite_staff_training_id)

Provides the individual training completion history for each employee supporting skills gap analysis, mandatory training compliance, and career development tracking.

attributes.name: primary_training_employee_id

attributes.name: attendance_percentage

attributes.name: certificate_expiration_date

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag

attributes.name: certificate_number

attributes.name: ceu_awarded
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education Units awarded for professional licensing or certification maintenance upon successful completion.

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee successfully completed the training course and met all requirements.

attributes.name: completion_percentage

attributes.name: compliance_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the employee must complete the training to meet regulatory or organizational compliance requirements.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this training enrollment, including tuition, materials, instructor fees, and facility costs.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center or department code to which the training expense is allocated for financial reporting and budgeting.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_hours_awarded

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: enrollment_date

attributes.name: enrollment_number

products.name: workforce_performance_review
products.description: Master and transactional record of each formal employee performance evaluation cycle. Captures review period (annual, mid-year, probationary), review type, overall rating (e.g., exceeds expectations, meets expectations, needs improvement), individual goal ratings, competency ratings, manager comments, employee self-assessment indicator, calibration status, final rating approval date, and performance improvement plan (PIP) indicator. Supports merit increase decisions, promotion eligibility, and workforce development planning.

attributes.name: workforce_performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each formal employee performance evaluation record. Primary key for the workforce performance review entity.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational unit (department, division, cost center) to which the employee belonged during the review period. Links to the org_unit master record.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the position held by the employee at the time of review. Links to the position master record.

attributes.name: primary_workforce_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee being reviewed. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: quaternary_workforce_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who initiated the performance review record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: quinary_workforce_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who most recently modified the performance review record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the senior manager or HR business partner who reviewed and approved the performance rating during calibration. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_workforce_final_approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the executive or HR leader who provided final approval for the review and associated compensation decisions. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: bonus_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee qualifies for a performance bonus based on this review rating. True if eligible, False otherwise. Drives incentive compensation decisions.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the calibration session was completed and ratings were finalized across the organizational unit.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the review rating has been through the calibration process where managers collectively review and normalize ratings across teams to ensure consistency and fairness.

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employees demonstration of core competencies, behavioral standards, and role-specific skills (e.g., leadership, technical expertise, customer focus).

attributes.name: competency_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for competency assessment component (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0 scale). Contributes to overall rating calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process timing analysis.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation. Required for compliance and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has formally acknowledged the performance review. True if acknowledged, False if pending. Tracks completion of the review communication process.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Self-assessment narrative provided by the employee reflecting on their own performance, accomplishments, challenges, and development needs during the review period.

attributes.name: employee_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has formally disputed or disagreed with the performance rating. True if dispute was filed, False otherwise. Triggers HR review and potential appeals process.

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee completed a self-assessment as part of the review process. True if self-assessment was submitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the final rating and all associated decisions (merit increase, bonus, PIP) were formally approved by senior management or HR leadership.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employees success in achieving individual performance goals and objectives set at the beginning of the review period.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for goal achievement component (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0 scale). Contributes to overall rating calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was most recently updated. Tracks the latest change to any field in the review.

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Detailed narrative feedback provided by the manager regarding the employees performance, strengths, areas for development, and specific examples supporting the ratings.

attributes.name: merit_increase_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee qualifies for a merit-based salary increase based on this review rating. True if eligible, False otherwise. Drives compensation planning decisions.

attributes.name: merit_increase_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage salary increase awarded to the employee based on their performance rating. Null if no increase was granted. Used for compensation budget tracking and equity analysis.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The final, holistic performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period. Drives compensation decisions, promotion eligibility, and performance improvement plans.

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score corresponding to the overall rating (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0 scale). Used for quantitative analysis, merit increase calculations, and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: pip_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Performance Improvement Plan was initiated as a result of this review. True if PIP was triggered, False otherwise. Used to track employees requiring formal performance intervention.

attributes.name: pip_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the Performance Improvement Plan officially commenced. Null if no PIP was initiated.

attributes.name: promotion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for promotion consideration based on this review rating. True if eligible, False otherwise. Typically requires meeting or exceeding performance expectations.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was finalized and communicated to the employee. Marks the official completion of the review cycle.

attributes.name: review_cycle_year
attributes.description: The calendar year or fiscal year in which the performance review cycle occurred. Used for year-over-year performance trending and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance evaluation period being assessed (e.g., December 31 for annual reviews).

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the performance evaluation period being assessed (e.g., January 1 for annual reviews).

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the performance review process. Tracks progression from employee self-assessment through final approval. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|manager_review|calibration|approved|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: The category of performance review being conducted. Determines the review cycle, criteria, and business impact (e.g., annual reviews drive merit increases, probationary reviews determine employment continuation).

attributes.name: prior_period_workforce_performance_review_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Period Workforce Performance Review Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on workforce_performance_review (prior_period_workforce_performance_review_id)

products.name: performance_goal
products.description: Master record of individual performance goals set for an employee within a performance review cycle. Captures goal title, goal description, goal category (financial, operational, development, compliance), target metric, target value, actual value, weight percentage, goal status (draft, active, completed, cancelled), alignment to corporate objective, and cascade source (manager-assigned vs. employee-created). Supports MBO (Management by Objectives) frameworks and OKR-style goal alignment across the enterprise.

attributes.name: performance_goal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance goal record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this performance goal record.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this performance goal record.

attributes.name: linked_development_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee development plan or training program linked to this goal, if the goal is development-focused.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee to whom this performance goal is assigned.

attributes.name: tertiary_performance_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or Human Resources (HR) representative who approved this goal.

attributes.name: workforce_performance_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.workforce_performance_review. Business justification: Performance goals are set within the context of a formal performance review cycle. The existing performance_cycle_id (BIGINT) references a non-existent product; workforce_performance_review is the act

attributes.name: achievement_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of goal achievement, typically (actual_value / target_value) * 100, used for performance rating and bonus calculation.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the goal was completed or closed.

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: Numeric actual value achieved by the employee for the specified metric at the time of measurement or review.

attributes.name: alignment_to_corporate_objective
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate strategic objective or Key Result (KR) to which this goal is aligned, supporting cascading goal frameworks such as Objectives and Key Results (OKR) or Management by Objectives (MBO).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the goal was formally approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the goal: pending (awaiting manager or Human Resources (HR) approval), approved (finalized), rejected (not accepted), revision_requested (sent back for changes).

attributes.name: cascade_source
attributes.description: Origin of the goal: manager_assigned (cascaded from manager), employee_created (self-initiated), hr_initiated (Human Resources (HR) driven), or system_generated (auto-populated from templates or corporate objectives).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from the employee, manager, or Human Resources (HR) regarding goal progress, challenges, or achievements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance goal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: goal_category
attributes.description: Classification of the goal by business focus area: financial (revenue, cost), operational (efficiency, quality), development (skills, career), compliance (regulatory, policy), strategic (transformation, innovation), or customer (satisfaction, retention).

attributes.name: goal_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the performance goal, including expected outcomes and success criteria.

attributes.name: goal_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique number or code assigned to this performance goal for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: goal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance goal: draft (not yet finalized), active (approved and in effect), in_progress (being worked on), completed (achieved or closed), cancelled (no longer applicable), deferred (postponed to future cycle).

attributes.name: goal_title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the performance goal.

attributes.name: goal_type
attributes.description: Scope of the goal: individual (employee-specific), team (shared by a team), departmental (division-level), or corporate (enterprise-wide cascade).

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goal is mandatory (required for all employees in a role or level) or optional.

attributes.name: is_stretch_goal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a stretch goal (aspirational, beyond normal expectations) versus a standard performance goal.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review or check-in for this goal.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating assigned to the goal achievement: exceeds (surpassed target), meets (achieved target), partially_meets (made progress but did not fully achieve), does_not_meet (failed to achieve), not_rated (not yet evaluated).

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which progress toward this goal is formally reviewed: monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually, or continuous (ongoing tracking).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance goal becomes effective and tracking begins.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which the goal should be achieved or reviewed.

attributes.name: target_metric_name
attributes.description: Name of the key performance indicator (KPI) or metric being measured for this goal (e.g., New Business (NB) Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), Claims Adjudication Cycle Time, Underwriting Accuracy Rate).

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Numeric target value the employee is expected to achieve for the specified metric.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the target and actual values are expressed (e.g., USD, percentage, count, days, policies).

attributes.name: weight_percentage

Supports FMLA compliance tracking and workforce availability planning.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each employee leave request transaction. Primary key for the leave request record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the leave request record in the system (typically the employee or HR administrator).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: org_unit_id

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the position held by the employee at the time of the leave request. Used for workforce capacity planning and backfill analysis.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_substitute_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee assigned to cover the absent employees responsibilities during the leave period. Used for workforce continuity planning.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the leave request was approved by the manager. Used for tracking approval timeliness and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_end_date

attributes.name: approved_start_date

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: denial_reason

attributes.name: fmla_eligible_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for FMLA protection for this leave request based on tenure, hours worked, and employer size requirements.

attributes.name: fmla_qualifying_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Qualifying Reason
