products.name: interview_event
products.description: Transactional record of each interview conducted as part of the talent acquisition process for a requisition. Captures interview date, interview type (phone screen, technical, behavioral, panel, final), interviewer employee IDs, candidate ID, requisition ID, interview format (in-person, video, phone), overall interview rating, hire recommendation (yes, no, maybe), interviewer feedback summary, and disposition reason. Supports structured interview process compliance and hiring decision audit trails.

attributes.name: interview_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each interview event conducted as part of the talent acquisition process.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate being interviewed.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or recruiter who created this interview event record.

attributes.name: interview_notes_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document management system identifier for detailed interview notes and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: interview_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized interview scorecard or evaluation template used for this interview.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Modified By User Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who most recently modified this interview event record.

attributes.name: primary_interviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who served as the lead or primary interviewer for this interview event.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job requisition for which this interview was conducted.

attributes.name: rescheduled_from_interview_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original interview event ID if this interview is a rescheduled version of a previous interview.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the interview concluded.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the interview began, which may differ from the scheduled start time.

attributes.name: behavioral_competency_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the candidate's behavioral attributes, soft skills, cultural fit, and alignment with company values.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the interview was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., 'candidate withdrew', 'position closed', 'scheduling conflict').

attributes.name: communication_skills_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the candidate's verbal and written communication effectiveness, clarity, and professionalism.

attributes.name: concerns_noted
attributes.description: Specific concerns, weaknesses, or areas of improvement identified during the interview.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this interview event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cultural_fit_rating
attributes.description: Rating of how well the candidate's values, work style, and personality align with the organization's culture.

attributes.name: disposition_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or explanation for the interview outcome or status change (e.g., 'candidate declined', 'skills mismatch', 'position filled', 'proceeding to next round').

attributes.name: diversity_panel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interview included a diverse panel of interviewers as part of the organization's diversity and inclusion hiring practices.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total length of the interview in minutes, calculated from actual start and end times.

attributes.name: hire_recommendation
attributes.description: The interviewer's recommendation on whether to proceed with hiring this candidate (strong yes, yes, maybe, no, strong no).

attributes.name: interview_format
attributes.description: The delivery method or medium through which the interview was conducted (in-person, video conference, phone call, or asynchronous recorded).

attributes.name: interview_location
attributes.description: Physical location, office address, or virtual meeting platform URL where the interview took place.

attributes.name: interview_panel_employee_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee IDs representing all interviewers who participated in this interview event, including the primary interviewer.

attributes.name: interview_round_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which round of interviews this represents in the hiring process (e.g., 1 for first round, 2 for second round).

attributes.name: interview_status
attributes.description: Current status of the interview event in its lifecycle (scheduled, completed, cancelled by company or candidate, candidate no-show, or rescheduled).

attributes.name: interview_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interview based on its purpose and structure (phone screen, technical assessment, behavioral interview, panel interview, final interview, or case study).

attributes.name: interviewer_feedback_summary
attributes.description: Consolidated textual summary of the interviewer's observations, comments, and assessment of the candidate's performance during the interview.

attributes.name: interviewer_training_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary interviewer has completed required interviewer training and certification to conduct compliant, bias-free interviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this interview event record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: next_step_action
attributes.description: Recommended or planned next action in the hiring process following this interview (e.g., 'schedule final interview', 'extend offer', 'send rejection', 'request additional references').

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Composite numerical rating assigned to the candidate based on interview performance, typically on a scale such as 1.00 to 5.00.

attributes.name: problem_solving_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the candidate's analytical thinking, problem-solving approach, and ability to handle complex scenarios.

attributes.name: rating_scale
attributes.description: Description of the rating scale used for evaluation (e.g., '1-5 scale where 5 is excellent', 'Strong Hire/Hire/No Hire').

attributes.name: recording_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate provided explicit consent for the interview to be recorded (audio or video), as required by applicable privacy laws.

attributes.name: recording_url
attributes.description: Secure storage location or URL where the interview recording is archived, if recording was conducted and consented to.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the interview was originally scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the interview was scheduled to end.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the interview was scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: strengths_noted
attributes.description: Specific strengths, positive attributes, or standout qualities observed during the interview.

attributes.name: structured_interview_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interview followed the organization's structured interview process and standardized question set to ensure fairness and legal compliance.
attributes.references: EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures

attributes.name: technical_competency_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the candidate's technical skills and job-specific competencies relevant to the position (e.g., actuarial knowledge, underwriting expertise, claims adjudication skills).

attributes.name: follow_up_interview_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on interview_event (follow_up_interview_event_id)

products.name: offer
products.description: Transactional record of each employment offer extended to a candidate. Captures offer date, offer expiration date, position title, base salary offered, sign-on bonus offered, target bonus percentage, start date proposed, offer status (pending, accepted, declined, rescinded, expired), decline reason code, and counter-offer indicator. Provides the formal offer management record linking the talent acquisition process to the employee onboarding and employment record creation.

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employment offer record. Primary key for the offer entity.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who received this employment offer. Links to the talent acquisition candidate record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user who created the offer record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user who last modified the offer record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: letter_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document template used to generate the offer letter. Supports audit trail and template version control.

attributes.name: offer_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who provided final approval for the offer. Typically a senior leader or HR business partner.

attributes.name: offer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the hiring manager for this position. Responsible for offer approval and candidate selection.

attributes.name: offer_recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal recruiter or talent acquisition specialist who managed the recruitment process and offer generation.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position being offered. Links to the organizational position structure.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job requisition for which this offer was extended. Links to the approved position opening.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate formally accepted the employment offer. Null if offer has not been accepted.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the offer was formally approved by the authorized approver. Precedes the offer date.

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check is required as a condition of employment. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Annual base salary offered to the candidate. For hourly positions, this represents the annualized equivalent based on standard hours.

attributes.name: contingent_offer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer is contingent upon successful completion of background check, drug screening, or other conditions. True if contingent, false if unconditional.

attributes.name: counter_offer_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate submitted a counter-offer requesting modified terms. True if counter-offer was received, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the offer record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decline_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate formally declined the employment offer. Null if offer has not been declined.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code indicating why the candidate declined the offer. Used for talent acquisition analytics and offer competitiveness assessment. Null if offer was not declined.

attributes.name: decline_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about why the candidate declined the offer. Null if offer was not declined or no additional notes captured.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Name of the department or organizational unit where the candidate will be employed. Captured at offer time for candidate communication.

attributes.name: drug_screening_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-employment drug screening is required. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement being offered. Determines benefits eligibility and employment terms.

attributes.name: equity_grant_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for equity compensation such as stock options or restricted stock units. True if eligible, false otherwise.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date by which the candidate must accept or decline the offer. After this date, the offer is automatically expired unless extended.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: FLSA overtime eligibility classification for the position. Exempt employees are not eligible for overtime pay; non-exempt employees are eligible.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Hourly wage rate for non-exempt or hourly positions. Null for salaried positions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the offer record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: letter_sent_date
attributes.description: Date the formal offer letter document was sent to the candidate. Used for tracking offer communication timeline.

attributes.name: license_requirement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any insurance licenses, actuarial credentials, or FINRA registrations required for the position. Null if no special licensing required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special arrangements, or negotiation details related to the offer.

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: Date the employment offer was formally extended to the candidate. Represents the official offer event timestamp for lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: offer_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique offer reference number used for tracking and communication with candidates and hiring managers.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employment offer in its lifecycle. Tracks the offer from extension through final disposition.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of salary payments. Determines payroll cycle for the employee.

attributes.name: proposed_start_date
attributes.description: Proposed first day of employment for the candidate if the offer is accepted. Used for onboarding planning and workforce capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: relocation_amount
attributes.description: Total relocation assistance amount offered to the candidate. Null if no relocation assistance is provided.

attributes.name: relocation_assistance_offered
attributes.description: Indicates whether relocation assistance or reimbursement is included in the offer. True if relocation support is provided, false otherwise.

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base salary amount. Typically USD for US-based positions.

attributes.name: sign_on_bonus_amount
attributes.description: One-time sign-on bonus offered to the candidate. Typically used to attract high-demand talent or offset candidate losses from prior employer. Null if no sign-on bonus offered.

attributes.name: target_bonus_percentage
attributes.description: Target annual bonus as a percentage of base salary. Represents the expected bonus at 100% performance achievement. Null if position is not bonus-eligible.

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Primary work location or office site for the position. May include remote, hybrid, or specific office location details.

attributes.name: revised_offer_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on offer (revised_offer_id)

products.name: disciplinary_action
products.description: Transactional record of formal disciplinary actions taken against an employee. Captures action type (verbal warning, written warning, performance improvement plan, suspension, termination for cause), action date, policy violation description, prior warnings count, action issued by (manager/HR), employee acknowledgment date, appeal filed indicator, appeal outcome, and action status (active, resolved, expunged). Supports employee relations case management, termination documentation, and regulatory compliance for licensed insurance staff.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the disciplinary action record. Primary key for the disciplinary action entity.

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Disciplinary actions cite specific policy violations for documentation, pattern analysis, and regulatory reporting (market conduct exams, producer oversight). Policy linkage is essential for tracking

attributes.name: primary_disciplinary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who is the subject of the disciplinary action. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: quaternary_disciplinary_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Modified By User Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: User identifier of the system user who last modified this disciplinary action record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: tertiary_disciplinary_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the system user who created this disciplinary action record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disciplinary action was formally issued or taken against the employee.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the disciplinary action case, used for tracking and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the disciplinary action record in its lifecycle. Active indicates the action is in effect; resolved indicates completion; expunged indicates removal from record per policy or legal requirement.
attributes.references: Internal HR Record Retention Policy, State Employment Law

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disciplinary action taken. Indicates the severity and nature of the corrective measure applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: verbal_warning|written_warning|final_warning|performance_improvement_plan|suspension|termination_for_cause|demotion|probation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Licensing, State Employment Law

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee filed a formal appeal or grievance. Null if no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has filed a formal appeal or grievance against the disciplinary action.
attributes.references: Internal HR Grievance Policy, Employment Law

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the employee appeal or grievance process. Indicates whether the original disciplinary action was upheld, overturned, or modified.

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal or grievance was formally resolved. Null if no appeal was filed or if still pending.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective actions, performance improvement steps, or behavioral expectations required of the employee to resolve the issue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disciplinary action record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: documentation_location
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or physical location where the complete disciplinary action documentation is stored.
attributes.references: Internal Document Management Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the disciplinary action becomes effective and enforceable. May differ from action_date if there is a notice period.
attributes.references: State Employment Law, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee acknowledged receipt and understanding of the disciplinary action documentation.
attributes.references: Internal HR Documentation Standards, Employment Law

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the employee acknowledged the disciplinary action (e.g., physical signature, electronic signature, verbal acknowledgment, or refusal to sign).

attributes.name: employee_statement
attributes.description: Written statement or comments provided by the employee in response to the disciplinary action. Confidential employee relations data.
attributes.references: Internal HR Documentation Standards, Employment Law

attributes.name: expungement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the disciplinary action record was expunged or removed from the employee's permanent record, typically after a specified clean period or per legal requirement.
attributes.references: Internal HR Record Retention Policy, State Employment Law

attributes.name: expungement_reason
attributes.description: Reason for expunging the disciplinary action from the employee record (e.g., clean record period elapsed, appeal overturned, legal requirement).

attributes.name: hr_case_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the broader HR case or investigation file associated with this disciplinary action. Used for cross-referencing with employee relations case management systems.

attributes.name: improvement_deadline_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the employee must demonstrate improvement or complete corrective actions. Applicable for performance improvement plans and probationary periods.

attributes.name: issuing_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the department or business unit from which the disciplinary action was issued.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disciplinary action record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal department completed its review of the disciplinary action. Null if legal review was not required.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disciplinary action required review and approval by the legal department prior to issuance, typically for terminations or high-risk actions.

attributes.name: license_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disciplinary action impacts the employee's professional licenses or registrations (e.g., insurance producer license, actuarial credentials, FINRA registration).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards, FINRA Registration Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional confidential notes, context, or follow-up information related to the disciplinary action. Used for internal HR reference and case management.

attributes.name: prior_warnings_count
attributes.description: Number of prior disciplinary warnings or actions on record for this employee at the time this action was issued. Used to track progressive discipline.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name or code of the regulatory body to which the disciplinary action was reported (e.g., state insurance department, FINRA, SEC).

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the disciplinary action was reported to the applicable regulatory authority. Null if reporting is not required or not yet completed.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards, FINRA Rule 4530

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disciplinary action must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., state insurance departments for licensed staff, FINRA for registered representatives).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Standards, FINRA Rule 4530, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the suspension period if the disciplinary action includes a suspension. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: State Employment Law, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: suspension_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Applicable only when action_type is suspension.
attributes.references: State Employment Law, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the suspension period if the disciplinary action includes a suspension. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: State Employment Law, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Effective date of employment termination if the disciplinary action results in termination for cause. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: State Employment Law, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the reason for termination. Used for regulatory reporting and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Internal HR Termination Standards, EEOC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the policy or conduct violation that triggered the disciplinary action. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attendance|conduct|performance|policy_violation|compliance_breach|safety_violation|ethics_violation|fraud|harassment — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Code of Conduct, NAIC Compliance Standards

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific policy violation, misconduct, or performance issue that led to the disciplinary action. Contains sensitive employee relations information.
attributes.references: Internal HR Documentation Standards, Employment Law

attributes.name: witness_employee_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee identifiers who witnessed the incident or were present during the disciplinary meeting. Confidential employee relations data.

attributes.name: escalated_from_disciplinary_action_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on disciplinary_action (escalated_from_disciplinary_action_id)

products.name: succession_plan
products.description: Master record for succession planning for key positions and critical roles within the Life Insurance enterprise. Captures target position, incumbent employee, succession readiness horizon (ready now, 1-2 years, 3-5 years), identified successor employees, successor readiness rating, development gap assessment, retention risk rating, and plan review date. Supports business continuity planning for critical actuarial, underwriting, and executive roles where specialized insurance expertise creates significant key-person risk.

attributes.name: succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the succession plan record. Primary key for the succession plan entity.

attributes.name: development_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal individual development plan created for successors to address identified competency gaps and prepare them for the target position.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the succession plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who most recently modified the succession plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit or department that owns the target position and succession plan. Used for reporting and governance.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR business partner or executive responsible for maintaining and executing the succession plan.

attributes.name: primary_successor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary identified successor employee for the target position. This is the top-ranked candidate in the succession plan.

attributes.name: target_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the critical position or role for which succession planning is being conducted. Links to the position master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_succession_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the executive or senior leader who formally approved the succession plan.

attributes.name: tertiary_successor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tertiary identified successor employee for the target position. This is the third-ranked candidate in the succession plan.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan was formally approved by executive leadership.

attributes.name: business_impact_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the business impact if the target position becomes vacant without a ready successor. Reflects the criticality of the role to business operations, regulatory compliance, and strategic objectives.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the confidentiality level for the succession plan, as succession planning information is typically highly sensitive and restricted to executive leadership and HR.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the succession plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_competencies_required
attributes.description: List or description of the critical competencies, skills, and qualifications required for the target position. May include actuarial credentials, insurance licenses, FINRA registrations, or specialized technical expertise.

attributes.name: development_gap_assessment
attributes.description: Detailed narrative assessment of the skills, experience, and competency gaps that identified successors need to address before being ready for the target position. Informs individual development plans.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_plan_exists
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an emergency contact and communication plan exists for immediate activation if the incumbent unexpectedly departs.

attributes.name: key_person_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether this succession plan addresses a key-person risk where specialized insurance expertise (actuarial, underwriting, claims) creates significant organizational vulnerability.

attributes.name: knowledge_transfer_plan_exists
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a formal knowledge transfer plan exists to capture and transfer critical institutional knowledge from the incumbent to successors.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the succession plan record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan was most recently reviewed and updated by HR and business leadership.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the succession plan, typically formatted as SP-XXXXXX for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: plan_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan becomes active and effective for business continuity planning purposes.

attributes.name: plan_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan expires or is scheduled to be closed, typically aligned with anticipated transition dates or organizational restructuring.

attributes.name: plan_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about the succession plan, including special considerations, external candidate options, or organizational changes affecting the plan.

attributes.name: plan_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review and update of the succession plan. Ensures plans remain current with organizational changes and successor development progress.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the succession plan indicating its stage in the planning and approval workflow.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the succession plan based on urgency and purpose: emergency (immediate need), planned (anticipated transition), development (long-term talent pipeline), or retention (key person risk mitigation).

attributes.name: primary_successor_readiness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the primary successor's current readiness level to assume the target position, based on skills, experience, and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: readiness_horizon
attributes.description: Time horizon indicating when identified successors are expected to be ready to assume the target position. Critical for business continuity planning and talent development prioritization.

attributes.name: retention_risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that the incumbent or identified successors may leave the organization, creating succession continuity risk. Critical for key-person risk management in specialized insurance roles.

attributes.name: secondary_successor_readiness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the secondary successor's current readiness level to assume the target position.

attributes.name: tertiary_successor_readiness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the tertiary successor's current readiness level to assume the target position.

attributes.name: superseded_succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on succession_plan (superseded_succession_plan_id)

products.name: work_schedule
products.description: Master record defining the standard work schedules and shift patterns assigned to employees or org units. Captures schedule name, schedule type (standard, flex, compressed, shift-based), standard hours per week, work days pattern, shift start time, shift end time, overtime eligibility, remote work eligibility percentage, and effective date range. Supports time and attendance management, FLSA overtime calculations, and workforce capacity planning for claims processing centers and customer service operations.

attributes.name: work_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the HR or management personnel who approved this work schedule for use.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this work schedule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this work schedule record.

attributes.name: applicable_departments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of departments or organizational units that use this schedule (e.g., Claims Operations, Customer Service, Underwriting).

attributes.name: applicable_job_families
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job families or roles this schedule is designed for (e.g., Claims Adjusters, Customer Service Representatives, Underwriters, Actuaries).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this work schedule was formally approved for implementation.

attributes.name: capacity_planning_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier used in workforce capacity planning to convert headcount to available work hours. Accounts for breaks, meetings, and non-productive time.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Notes regarding compliance considerations for this schedule, including state-specific labor law requirements, union contract provisions, or FLSA considerations.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), State Labor Law Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_hours
attributes.description: Standard number of hours per work day for this schedule. Used for daily overtime calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this work schedule becomes effective and can be assigned to employees or organizational units.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this work schedule is no longer valid for new assignments. Null for schedules with no planned end date.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: FLSA classification typically associated with this schedule. Exempt = salaried, not eligible for overtime; Non-exempt = hourly, eligible for overtime.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions or locations where this schedule is applicable. Used to ensure compliance with state-specific labor laws.

attributes.name: holiday_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the holiday calendar applicable to this work schedule. Determines which holidays are observed and how holiday pay is calculated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work schedule record was last updated.

attributes.name: lunch_break_minutes
attributes.description: Standard unpaid lunch break duration in minutes. Used to calculate net working hours and compliance with state labor laws.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are eligible for overtime pay under Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) regulations. True for non-exempt positions.

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours per week after which overtime pay applies. Typically 40 hours under FLSA, but may vary by state or schedule type.

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total paid rest break time per day in minutes. Includes short breaks mandated by labor regulations.

attributes.name: pto_accrual_basis
attributes.description: Basis for calculating PTO accrual for employees on this schedule. Hours-worked = accrual per hour worked, Pay-period = fixed accrual per pay period, Annual = annual grant.

attributes.name: remote_work_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule supports remote or hybrid work arrangements. Used for workspace capacity planning and technology provisioning.

attributes.name: remote_work_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work time that can be performed remotely under this schedule (0-100). Used for hybrid work planning and office space allocation.

attributes.name: rotation_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the rotation cycle for shift-based schedules (e.g., 14 for a two-week rotation, 28 for a four-week rotation). Null for non-rotating schedules.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the work schedule used in HR systems and reporting. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each schedule pattern.

attributes.name: schedule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work schedule including any special conditions, rotation patterns, or business context for its use.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the work schedule (e.g., Standard 40-Hour Week, Compressed 4/10, Claims Night Shift).

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work schedule. Active = in use, Inactive = not currently assigned, Pending = approved but not yet effective, Deprecated = phased out.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work schedule pattern. Standard = traditional fixed hours, Flex = flexible start/end times, Compressed = longer days with fewer workdays, Shift-based = rotating or fixed shifts, Part-time = reduced hours, On-call = variable availability.

attributes.name: shift_differential_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are eligible for shift differential pay (e.g., evening, night, or weekend premium).

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional pay rate multiplier for shift differential (e.g., 0.15 for 15% premium). Null if shift differential is not applicable.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Standard end time for the work shift in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Null for flex schedules without fixed end time.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Standard start time for the work shift in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Null for flex schedules without fixed start time.

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard number of hours per week defined by this schedule. Used for Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) calculations and overtime eligibility determination.

attributes.name: time_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule must track time via time clock or timesheet system. Typically true for non-exempt employees.

attributes.name: weekend_work_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule includes regular weekend work days (Saturday or Sunday). Used for staffing planning and shift differential calculations.

attributes.name: work_days_pattern
attributes.description: Pattern of work days in the schedule (e.g., Mon-Fri, Mon-Thu, rotating 4-on-3-off, weekend shift). Describes which days of the week or rotation cycle are work days.

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance review must be reported to regulatory authorities. True if the review contains findings or outcomes requiring disclosure to state insurance departments or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: NAIC Third-Party Oversight Guidelines, State Insurance Department Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: key_findings
attributes.description: Summary of key findings from the performance review. Captures notable strengths, weaknesses, trends, and observations identified during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next performance review. Defines when the subsequent evaluation of vendor performance is required.

attributes.name: overall_performance_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate performance rating assigned to the vendor for the review period. Summarizes the vendor's overall performance across all evaluation dimensions.

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric overall performance score assigned to the vendor. Typically on a scale of 0-100 or 0-5, representing the weighted aggregate of individual dimension scores.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Performance score for quality dimension. Evaluates accuracy, completeness, and reliability of vendor deliverables and services.

attributes.name: regulatory_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of regulatory compliance findings or violations identified during the review period. Quantifies vendor non-compliance with insurance industry regulations and standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Third-Party Oversight Guidelines, State Insurance Department Standards

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Performance score for responsiveness dimension. Evaluates vendor communication effectiveness, issue resolution speed, and escalation handling.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was conducted or completed. Represents the business event date when the evaluation was finalized.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the performance review. Externally-known reference number used in vendor communications, audit trails, and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome decision resulting from the performance review. Indicates the strategic action to be taken regarding the vendor relationship based on performance evaluation results.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the conclusion of the time window during which vendor performance is being assessed.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the beginning of the time window during which vendor performance is being assessed.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance review. Tracks the review workflow from initiation through completion and approval.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review based on frequency and trigger. Indicates whether this is a scheduled periodic review or an event-driven evaluation.

attributes.name: reviewer_department
attributes.description: Department or business unit of the reviewer. Identifies the organizational area responsible for conducting the vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who conducted the performance review. Provides human-readable identification of the reviewer for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: risk_management_score
attributes.description: Performance score for risk management dimension. Evaluates vendor controls, business continuity planning, disaster recovery capabilities, and risk mitigation effectiveness.
attributes.references: NAIC Third-Party Oversight Guidelines, Internal Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Standards

attributes.name: sla_compliance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments met by the vendor during the review period. Quantifies vendor adherence to contractual performance targets.

attributes.name: strengths_identified
attributes.description: Specific strengths and positive performance areas identified during the review. Documents vendor capabilities and performance aspects that exceeded expectations.

attributes.name: timeliness_score
attributes.description: Performance score for timeliness dimension. Evaluates vendor adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA), delivery schedules, and response time commitments.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance review record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for regulatory compliance and data governance.

attributes.name: weaknesses_identified
attributes.description: Specific weaknesses and performance deficiencies identified during the review. Documents areas requiring improvement or remediation.

attributes.name: prior_period_vendor_performance_review_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Period Vendor Performance Review Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vendor_performance_review (prior_period_vendor_performance_review_id)

products.name: vendor_risk_assessment
products.description: Master and transactional record of third-party risk assessments conducted on vendors as part of Life Insurance's vendor risk management (VRM) program. Captures assessment date, risk domains evaluated (operational, financial, cybersecurity, regulatory/compliance, concentration, reputational), individual risk ratings, overall inherent and residual risk tier, assessment methodology, assessor identity, and next scheduled review date. Required for NAIC Model Audit Rule compliance and state DOI oversight of outsourced insurance operations. Tracks SOC 2 report review status, financial stability review, and business continuity plan (BCP) adequacy.
products.reference: Third-Party Risk Assessment (TPRA) / Vendor Risk Management (VRM)

attributes.name: vendor_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor risk assessment record. Primary key for the vendor risk assessment entity.

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Risk management staff conduct vendor risk assessments per enterprise risk management framework. Links assessment to qualified assessor for accountability, expertise validation, and regulatory audit re

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Vendor risk assessments must evaluate compliance with regulatory obligations (HIPAA for BAAs, state insurance regulations for TPAs, SOX for financial system vendors). Tracks primary regulatory obligat

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Risk assessments are performed on reporting period schedules for SOX certification and operational risk reporting. Annual SOX assessment and quarterly risk committee reporting require assessments alig

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being assessed. Links to the master vendor record in the vendor management system.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor risk assessment was formally approved by management. Represents the completion of the assessment lifecycle.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who formally approved the completed vendor risk assessment, typically a senior risk management officer, Chief Risk Officer (CRO), or compliance officer.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor risk assessment was conducted or completed. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology or approach used to conduct the vendor risk assessment: questionnaire (vendor self-assessment), onsite_audit (physical site visit and inspection), document_review (review of vendor-provided documentation), hybrid (combination of methods), third_party_report (reliance on external audit or certification), continuous_monitoring (automated ongoing assessment).

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the risk assessment, typically formatted as VRA-YYYYNNNN for external reference and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk assessment: draft (initial creation), in_progress (assessment underway), pending_review (awaiting management review), completed (assessment finished), approved (management approved), rejected (assessment rejected or vendor failed).

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment based on the trigger or schedule: initial (first assessment of new vendor), annual (scheduled periodic review), triggered (event-driven reassessment), ad_hoc (unscheduled review), renewal (contract renewal assessment), material_change (assessment due to significant vendor change).

attributes.name: bcp_adequacy_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the adequacy and effectiveness of the vendors business continuity plan and disaster recovery capabilities. Ratings: adequate (BCP meets requirements and tested), needs_improvement (BCP exists but has gaps), inadequate (BCP insufficient or untested), not_reviewed (BCP not assessed in this review).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment)

attributes.name: bcp_last_test_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Business Continuity Plan (BCP) Last Test Date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor last conducted a formal test or exercise of their business continuity plan. Used to assess the currency and reliability of BCP capabilities.

attributes.name: concentration_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for concentration risk domain, assessing the degree of dependency on this vendor and the potential impact of vendor failure or service disruption. Considers whether the vendor is a single point of failure, the availability of alternative providers, and the criticality of services provided.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor risk assessment record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: cybersecurity_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for cybersecurity and information security domain, assessing the vendors data protection controls, incident response capabilities, vulnerability management, and compliance with security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001

attributes.name: data_access_level
attributes.description: Classification of the level of access this vendor has to the insurers data and systems: none (no data access), limited (access to non-sensitive operational data), moderate (access to some confidential or PII data), extensive (access to highly sensitive data including PHI, PCI, or core systems).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), GDPR, HIPAA

attributes.name: financial_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial stability review was completed. May differ from the overall assessment date if financial review was conducted separately.

attributes.name: financial_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for financial stability domain, evaluating the vendors financial health, solvency, liquidity, and ability to remain a going concern. Based on financial statement review, credit ratings, and financial ratios.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: financial_stability_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal financial stability review was conducted as part of this risk assessment, including analysis of financial statements, credit ratings, and financial ratios.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: inherent_risk_tier
attributes.description: Overall inherent risk classification before considering mitigating controls. Tier 1 represents highest inherent risk (critical vendors with access to sensitive data or critical operations), Tier 4 represents lowest inherent risk (non-critical vendors with minimal data access). Drives assessment frequency and oversight intensity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ERM (Enterprise Risk Management)

attributes.name: key_findings
attributes.description: Summary of the most significant findings, observations, and concerns identified during the vendor risk assessment. Includes both strengths and weaknesses relevant to risk management decision-making.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic vendor risk assessment. Assessment frequency is typically driven by the vendors risk tier: Tier 1 (annual), Tier 2 (every 2 years), Tier 3 (every 3 years), Tier 4 (as needed).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or context relevant to this vendor risk assessment that do not fit into structured fields. May include special circumstances, follow-up actions, or historical context.

attributes.name: operational_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for operational risk domain, assessing the vendors ability to deliver services reliably, maintain business continuity, and meet service level agreements (SLAs). Ratings: low (minimal operational risk), moderate (manageable operational concerns), high (significant operational weaknesses), critical (severe operational deficiencies).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment)

attributes.name: overall_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numerical risk score calculated from individual risk domain ratings, typically on a scale of 0-100 where higher scores indicate greater risk. Used for vendor risk ranking and portfolio analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ERM (Enterprise Risk Management)

attributes.name: recommendations
attributes.description: Specific recommendations for managing or mitigating identified vendor risks, including suggested contractual protections, monitoring activities, or alternative vendor considerations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ERM (Enterprise Risk Management)

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for regulatory and compliance domain, evaluating the vendors adherence to applicable insurance regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, HIPAA), anti-money laundering (AML) requirements, and industry standards (NAIC, state DOI requirements).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), GDPR, HIPAA, AML/BSA

attributes.name: remediation_plan_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which a formal remediation plan must be submitted by the vendor or vendor management team to address identified deficiencies. Null if no remediation is required.

attributes.name: remediation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment identified deficiencies or gaps that require formal remediation actions by the vendor or the insurers vendor management team.

attributes.name: reputational_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for reputational risk domain, evaluating the potential impact on the insurers brand and reputation from association with this vendor. Considers vendor public perception, past controversies, ethical practices, and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ERM (Enterprise Risk Management)

attributes.name: residual_risk_tier
attributes.description: Overall residual risk classification after considering the effectiveness of mitigating controls, contractual protections, and vendor risk management activities. Represents the net risk exposure the insurer accepts by engaging this vendor.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ERM (Enterprise Risk Management)

attributes.name: service_criticality
attributes.description: Classification of the criticality of services provided by this vendor to the insurers operations: low (non-essential services), medium (important but not critical), high (significant impact if disrupted), critical (essential to core business operations or regulatory compliance).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment)

attributes.name: soc2_opinion
attributes.business_glossary_term: System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) Auditor Opinion
attributes.description: The auditors opinion from the SOC 2 report: unqualified (clean opinion, controls effective), qualified (controls effective with exceptions), adverse (controls not effective), disclaimer (auditor unable to form opinion), not_applicable (no SOC 2 report).

attributes.name: soc2_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) Report Date
attributes.description: The date or period end date of the most recent SOC 2 report reviewed. Used to assess the currency and relevance of the audit findings.

attributes.name: soc2_report_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) Report Reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a SOC 2 Type I or Type II audit report was reviewed as part of this risk assessment. SOC 2 reports provide independent assurance on security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy controls.
attributes.references: AICPA SOC 2, NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: soc2_report_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) Report Type
attributes.description: Type of SOC 2 report reviewed: Type 1 (point-in-time assessment of control design), Type 2 (assessment of control design and operating effectiveness over a period), not_applicable (no SOC 2 report available or required).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this vendor risk assessment record was last modified in the system. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: prior_vendor_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vendor_risk_assessment (prior_vendor_risk_assessment_id)

products.name: risk_finding
products.description: Individual risk finding or control deficiency identified during a vendor risk assessment. Captures finding title, risk domain, finding description, severity level (critical, high, medium, low), recommended remediation action, vendor-committed remediation date, actual remediation date, and finding status (open, in remediation, closed, accepted). Enables tracking of open risk items across the vendor portfolio and supports escalation workflows for critical findings affecting insurance operations.

attributes.name: risk_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor risk finding record. Primary key for the vendor risk finding entity.

attributes.name: exam_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.exam_finding. Business justification: Vendor risk findings may be identified during regulatory market conduct exams or may contribute to exam findings (e.g., TPA claims handling deficiencies). Links vendor deficiency to regulatory exam fi

attributes.name: identified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Risk analysts identify vendor risk findings during assessments and audits. Tracks who identified finding for follow-up, expertise validation, and regulatory audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Risk findings are often specific to a contract's scope, terms, or service delivery obligations. Linking vendor_risk_finding to vendor_contract provides context for remediation planning and contract am

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor entity for which this risk finding was identified during assessment.

attributes.name: vendor_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor risk assessment engagement during which this finding was identified.

attributes.name: actual_remediation_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the remediation action was completed and validated, marking the closure of the finding.

attributes.name: affected_service
attributes.description: The specific vendor service, product, or business function impacted by this risk finding (e.g., medical exam processing, policy administration, claims adjudication).

attributes.name: business_impact_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the potential business impact if the risk finding is not remediated, including operational, financial, regulatory, and reputational consequences.

attributes.name: control_deficiency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control deficiency as a design flaw (control not properly designed), operating effectiveness issue (control not operating as designed), or both.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor risk finding record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the finding was escalated to higher management levels or governance committees.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this finding has been escalated to senior management, risk committee, or board of directors due to severity or remediation delays.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for escalating the finding, such as missed remediation deadlines, increased risk severity, or vendor non-responsiveness.

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the risk finding, including the observed condition, the control deficiency, and the potential impact to insurance operations.

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique identifier or tracking number for the risk finding, typically formatted as assessment-year-sequence (e.g., VRA-2024-001).

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk finding, tracking progression from identification through remediation to closure or acceptance.

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Concise title or summary of the risk finding or control deficiency identified during the vendor assessment.

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk finding was first identified and documented during the vendor risk assessment process.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score representing the inherent risk level before considering mitigating controls, typically on a scale of 1-25 or 1-100 depending on organizational framework.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent review or follow-up on this finding to assess remediation progress and update status.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next follow-up review of this finding to monitor remediation progress and validate completion.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the finding, remediation efforts, vendor communications, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: recommended_remediation
attributes.description: Detailed recommendation for remediation action to address the risk finding, including specific controls, process changes, or technology implementations required.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this finding has potential regulatory compliance implications requiring notification to state insurance departments, NAIC, or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: remediation_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the vendor contact or internal stakeholder responsible for coordinating and completing the remediation action.

attributes.name: remediation_validation_method
attributes.description: Method used to validate that the remediation action was effectively implemented (e.g., document review, control testing, on-site inspection, vendor attestation).

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score representing the residual risk level after considering existing mitigating controls and planned remediation actions.

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_approver
attributes.description: Name or title of the executive or risk committee member who approved the risk acceptance decision for findings that will not be fully remediated.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Policy, ERM Framework

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk acceptance decision was formally approved and documented.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Policy, ERM Framework

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the organization has formally accepted the risk without full remediation, typically requiring executive approval for high or critical findings.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Policy, ERM Framework

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and justification for accepting the risk without full remediation, including cost-benefit analysis and compensating controls.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Policy, ERM Framework

attributes.name: risk_domain
attributes.description: Primary risk category or domain to which this finding belongs, enabling classification and aggregation of findings by risk type.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the risk domain, providing detailed categorization of the specific risk area (e.g., access control, data encryption, contract compliance).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Risk severity classification indicating the potential impact and urgency of the finding. Critical findings require immediate escalation and remediation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Audit Rule, Internal Risk Rating Framework

attributes.name: target_remediation_date
attributes.description: Internal target date by which the organization expects the finding to be remediated, which may differ from the vendor committed date based on risk severity and business requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor risk finding record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: validation_evidence
attributes.description: Description or reference to the evidence collected to validate remediation completion, such as updated policies, test results, screenshots, or audit reports.

attributes.name: vendor_committed_date
attributes.description: Date by which the vendor has formally committed to complete the remediation action, as documented in the vendor response or remediation plan.

attributes.name: vendor_response
attributes.description: Vendor's formal response to the finding, including their acknowledgment, proposed remediation plan, and any disagreement or alternative approach.

attributes.name: escalated_from_risk_finding_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_finding (escalated_from_risk_finding_id)

products.name: credential
products.description: Master record tracking all licenses, certifications, accreditations, and regulatory credentials held by a vendor that are required to perform contracted services. Captures credential type (state insurance license, HIPAA Business Associate certification, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NCQA accreditation for exam vendors, state TPA license), issuing authority, credential number, issue date, expiration date, and renewal status. Supports compliance verification that outsourced vendors maintain required authorizations to operate in each jurisdiction where Life Insurance does business.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor credential record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Compliance officers verify vendor credentials (licenses, certifications) to ensure regulatory compliance. Tracks who performed verification for audit trail and accountability in insurance regulatory e

attributes.name: attestation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must provide periodic attestation or self-certification of continued compliance with this credential. True if attestation is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording significant events, changes, or compliance notes related to this credential over its lifecycle.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is a mandatory regulatory or contractual requirement for the vendor to perform services for Life Insurance. True if required, False if optional or supplementary.

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of continuing education hours the vendor must complete within the renewal period to maintain this credential.

attributes.name: continuing_education_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must complete continuing education or training requirements to maintain this credential. True if CE is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: NAIC Licensing Standards, State Department of Insurance Requirements, Professional Certification Bodies

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor credential record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the credential as issued by the authority (e.g., 'Certified Information Systems Auditor', 'State of California Third Party Administrator License').

attributes.name: credential_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuing authority for this credential (e.g., license number, certificate number, accreditation ID).

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credential. Indicates whether the vendor is currently authorized under this credential.

attributes.name: credential_type

attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, HIPAA Privacy Rule, SOC 2 Framework (AICPA), ISO/IEC 27001, NCQA Standards, State TPA Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: document_url

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: product_line_applicability

attributes.name: regulatory_body

attributes.references: NAIC, State Departments of Insurance, FINRA, SEC, AICPA, ISO, NCQA

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously suspended or revoked credential was reinstated and returned to active status.
attributes.references: NAIC Licensing Standards, State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential was last renewed. Tracks renewal history for compliance verification.
attributes.references: NAIC Licensing Standards, State Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal business unit, department, or individual responsible for monitoring and managing this vendor credential.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential was permanently revoked by the issuing authority. Null if never revoked.
attributes.references: NAIC Licensing Standards, State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: revocation_reason

attributes.name: risk_rating

attributes.name: scope_of_authorization

products.name: baa
products.description: Master record for HIPAA Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) executed with vendors who access, process, or transmit Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of Life Insurance. Captures BAA execution date, effective period, covered PHI categories, permitted uses and disclosures, subcontractor provisions, breach notification obligations, data return/destruction requirements, and BAA status. Required for all medical exam vendors (ExamOne, APPS), MIB, prescription database providers, and any TPA handling medical underwriting data. Supports HIPAA compliance audit and privacy incident response.

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id

Links BAA to privacy incident for breach notification timeline enforcement a

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date

attributes.description: Timestamp when this BAA record was last modified in the system.

products.name: tpa_agreement

Distinct from vendor_contract (which covers all vendor MSAs) — tpa_agreement captures the insurance-specific regulatory and operational parameters unique to TPA relationships subject to state insurance department oversight.
