attributes.name: baa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.baa. Business justification: TPAs handle PHI and require HIPAA Business Associate Agreements. The tpa_agreement table has hipaa_baa_signed flag but no FK to the actual BAA record. Linking tpa_agreement to baa enables tracking the

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: TPA agreements must address regulatory obligations including state DOI filings, claims authority limits, licensing requirements, and regulatory reporting. Tracks primary regulatory obligation governin

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: TPA agreements are specialized vendor contracts governing outsourced insurance administration. The tpa_agreement table duplicates many contract-level attributes (effective_date, expiration_date, termi

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record representing the TPA entity. Links to the vendor product for core vendor information.

attributes.name: administered_functions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of insurance administration functions delegated to the TPA, such as claims processing, billing administration, policy servicing, group enrollment, premium collection, customer service.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the TPA agreement based on the scope of outsourced functions. Full service covers all administration; specialty TPAs handle specific functions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Minimum frequency in months at which the insurer will conduct operational and financial audits of the TPA under this agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: audit_rights_provision
attributes.description: Scope of the insurers right to audit TPA operations, records, and systems. Full access allows unannounced audits; scheduled-only requires advance notice.

attributes.name: claims_authority_limit

attributes.name: customer_service_sla_hours

attributes.name: delegated_authority_scope

attributes.name: disaster_recovery_plan_on_file

attributes.name: eo_certificate_on_file

attributes.name: eo_expiration_date

attributes.name: eo_insurance_required

attributes.name: fee_schedule_reference

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date

attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute

attributes.name: next_performance_review_date

attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_terms_days

attributes.name: performance_rating

attributes.name: performance_sla_reference

attributes.name: product_lines_covered

attributes.name: registered_states

attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #225 Third-Party Administrator Statute

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: exam_vendor_order
products.description: Transactional record of each paramedical or medical examination ordered from an exam vendor (ExamOne, APPS, or equivalent) as part of the life insurance underwriting process. Captures order date, exam vendor assigned, exam type (paramedical, full medical, EKG, treadmill, cognitive), applicant scheduling status, scheduled exam date and location, examiner identity, specimen collection details (blood, urine, oral fluid), exam completion date, and results transmission status. Links to underwriting.paramedical_exam for the clinical results. Provides the vendor-side operational record for exam fulfillment tracking and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: exam_vendor_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exam vendor order record. Primary key for this transactional entity tracking paramedical and medical examination orders placed with third-party exam vendors during the life insurance underwriting process.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: insured_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.insured. Business justification: Paramedical exam orders are placed for specific insureds during underwriting. Exam results (blood work, vitals, medical history) must be matched to the correct insured record for underwriting risk cla

attributes.name: ordered_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Underwriters order medical exams through vendor portals during underwriting process. Links order to underwriter for case assignment, workload tracking, and underwriting authority validation.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance applicant (proposed insured) who will undergo the medical examination. Links to the policyholder or insured party master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new business application that triggered this exam order. Links this exam order to the underwriting case and policy application being evaluated.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Application Standards

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Exam vendor orders are executed under master exam vendor contracts that define pricing, SLA terms, and service levels. The exam_vendor_order table has vendor_id but no contract_id. Linking exam_vendor

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exam vendor (ExamOne, APPS, or equivalent) assigned to fulfill this examination order. Links to the vendor master record for the medical examination service provider.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address provided to the vendor for applicant communication regarding exam scheduling, confirmation, and preparation instructions. Enables digital appointment management and reduces phone tag.
attributes.references: ACORD Contact Standards, NAIC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: applicant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number provided to the vendor for contacting the applicant to schedule the examination. Critical for successful appointment coordination and reducing no-show rates.
attributes.references: ACORD Contact Standards, NAIC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: blood_specimen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether blood specimen collection is required for this examination. Blood tests are standard for comprehensive underwriting and test for cholesterol, glucose, liver function, and other health markers.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the exam order was cancelled. Used for tracking wasted vendor capacity and analyzing cancellation patterns to improve scheduling efficiency.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the exam order was cancelled if status is cancelled. Common reasons include applicant withdrawal, policy declined before exam, applicant no-show, or underwriting requirements changed. Used for process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exam vendor order record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: exam_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the examination was completed by the examiner. Marks the end of the field examination phase and triggers the results processing workflow. Used for vendor SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: exam_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the examination was completed. Provides granular timing for operational analytics and end-to-end cycle time measurement from order to completion.

attributes.name: exam_location_address
attributes.description: Full address where the examination will take place. For home exams, this is the applicant's residence. For clinic exams, this is the vendor facility address. Used for examiner routing and applicant confirmation.

attributes.name: exam_location_city
attributes.description: City where the examination will be conducted. Used for geographic analysis of vendor coverage and examiner assignment optimization.

attributes.name: exam_location_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code of the examination location. Used for examiner assignment based on geographic proximity and vendor service area validation.

attributes.name: exam_location_state
attributes.description: State or province where the examination will be conducted. Important for vendor licensing compliance and regional performance analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Address Standards, NAIC State Jurisdiction Standards

attributes.name: exam_location_type
attributes.description: Type of location where the examination will be conducted. Impacts scheduling logistics, examiner assignment, and applicant convenience. Mobile and home exams are common for life insurance underwriting.

attributes.name: exam_package_code
attributes.description: Vendor-specific code identifying the bundled exam package ordered (e.g., basic paramedical, comprehensive medical with EKG, senior package). Maps to vendor pricing schedules and defines the specific tests and specimens included.

attributes.name: exam_type
attributes.description: Type of medical examination ordered based on underwriting requirements. Determines the scope of medical evaluation, specimen collection, and clinical tests to be performed. Drives vendor pricing and scheduling complexity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paramedical|full_medical|ekg|treadmill|cognitive|aps|inspection — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Guidelines, ACORD Medical Exam Standards

attributes.name: examiner_name
attributes.description: Name of the paramedical examiner or medical professional who conducted the examination. Provides accountability and quality assurance traceability.

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total amount invoiced by the vendor for this exam order. Includes all charges for examination services, specimen collection, lab processing, and result transmission. Used for cost analysis and budget tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amount. Typically USD for US-based vendors but may vary for international exam vendors.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number provided by the exam vendor for this order. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and cost tracking. Links exam orders to vendor billing records.

attributes.name: oral_fluid_specimen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether oral fluid (saliva) specimen collection is required. Oral fluid testing is a less invasive alternative for certain health markers and drug screening.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the exam order was placed with the vendor. Represents the business event timestamp when the underwriter requested the medical examination. Used for SLA tracking and aging analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the exam order, typically assigned by the underwriting workbench or vendor management system. Used for tracking and reconciliation with vendor invoices and results transmission.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exam order. Tracks progression from initial order placement through scheduling, exam completion, and results receipt. Critical for operational tracking and SLA monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ordered|scheduled|in_progress|completed|cancelled|failed|results_received — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the exam order was submitted to the vendor system. Provides granular timing for operational analytics and vendor performance measurement.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this exam order. Expedited and rush orders require faster scheduling and results turnaround, often at premium pricing. Used for high-value cases or competitive situations.

attributes.name: results_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the exam results were received from the vendor. Marks the completion of the vendor fulfillment cycle and enables underwriting decision progression. Used for total turnaround time calculation.

attributes.name: results_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the exam results were received and logged in the underwriting system. Enables detailed SLA tracking and vendor performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: results_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the exam results transmission from vendor to the insurance company underwriting system. Tracks whether clinical results and lab findings have been successfully delivered and integrated into the underwriting workbench.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical examination appointment is scheduled to occur. Set after applicant scheduling coordination. Used for applicant communication and vendor resource planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_time
attributes.description: Time of day when the examination appointment is scheduled. Stored as string to accommodate various time formats and time zone considerations across vendor systems.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special instructions to the vendor or examiner. May include applicant accessibility needs, language preferences, scheduling constraints, or specific clinical requirements beyond the standard exam package.

attributes.name: specimen_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when biological specimens were collected from the applicant. Critical for lab result validity and turnaround time tracking. Specimens must be processed within specific timeframes to ensure accuracy.

attributes.name: specimen_collection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether biological specimen collection (blood, urine, oral fluid) is required as part of this exam order. Determines lab processing requirements and impacts turnaround time.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days from order placement to results receipt. Key performance indicator for vendor service quality and underwriting cycle time optimization. Used for vendor scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this exam vendor order record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Updated whenever order status or other attributes change.

attributes.name: urine_specimen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether urine specimen collection is required. Urine tests screen for drug use, kidney function, and other health indicators relevant to mortality risk assessment.

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the exam vendor to track this order in their system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and vendor support inquiries. May differ from the insurance company order number.

attributes.name: reorder_exam_vendor_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on exam_vendor_order (reorder_exam_vendor_order_id)

products.name: custodian_account
products.description: Master record for investment custodian accounts maintained with external custodians (e.g., State Street, BNY Mellon, Northern Trust) holding general account and separate account assets on behalf of Life Insurance. Captures custodian name, account number, account type (general account, separate account, securities lending), asset classes held, custody fee schedule, settlement instruction defaults, and account status. Distinct from investment.portfolio (which tracks the investment management view) — custodian_account tracks the legal custody and safekeeping relationship with the external custodian entity.

attributes.name: custodian_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the custodian account record. Primary key for the custodian_account product.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Investment operations staff manage custodian account relationships for asset custody. Links account to responsible manager for escalation, reconciliation ownership, and NAIC Schedule D reporting accou

attributes.name: report_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_definition. Business justification: Custodian accounts feed Schedule D (investments) and other statutory investment schedules. Quarterly/annual statutory filing requires custodian-held asset reporting for NAIC Annual Statement investmen

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Custodian accounts are established under custody agreements (a type of vendor contract). The custodian_account table has contract_start_date and contract_end_date but no FK to the governing contract.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the custodian vendor entity (e.g., State Street, BNY Mellon, Northern Trust) that provides custody services for this account.

attributes.name: account_closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which this custodian account was officially closed. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The business name or title assigned to this custodian account for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number assigned by the external custodian to identify this custody account. This is the custodian's external identifier for the account.

attributes.name: account_opening_date
attributes.description: The date on which this custodian account was officially opened and became operational.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the custodian account. Active accounts are fully operational; inactive accounts are closed; pending_opening accounts are in setup; pending_closure accounts are being wound down; suspended accounts have temporary holds; restricted accounts have operational limitations.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the custodian account based on its purpose and the type of assets held. General account holds assets backing general account liabilities; separate account holds assets for variable products; securities lending accounts facilitate lending programs; collateral accounts hold pledged assets; transition accounts are temporary holding accounts during asset transfers.

attributes.name: asset_classes_held
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes held in this custodian account (e.g., equities, fixed_income, real_estate, alternatives, cash_equivalents, derivatives). Provides a high-level view of the account's investment composition.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: The primary currency in which the custodian account is denominated and reported, using ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: collateral_pledging_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this custodian account may be pledged as collateral for derivatives, securities lending, or other purposes. True if pledging is allowed; False if not allowed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this custodian account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: custodian_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the custodian institution providing custody services (e.g., State Street Bank and Trust Company, The Bank of New York Mellon, Northern Trust Company). Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: custody_fee_basis
attributes.description: The method by which custody fees are calculated for this account. Basis_points fees are calculated as a percentage of assets under custody; flat_fee is a fixed periodic amount; tiered uses different rates for different asset levels; transaction_based charges per transaction; hybrid combines multiple methods.

attributes.name: custody_fee_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated fee rate for custody services. For basis_points fee structures, this represents the annual rate in basis points (e.g., 0.000500 = 5 basis points). For flat_fee structures, this represents the periodic fee amount. For tiered structures, this may represent the base tier rate.

attributes.name: fee_calculation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which custody fees are calculated and assessed for this account.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The amount of fidelity bond or insurance coverage maintained by the custodian to protect assets in this account against loss, theft, or fraud.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the custodian's fidelity bond or insurance coverage protecting this account.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent internal or external audit of this custodian account and its controls.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent successful reconciliation between internal investment records and the custodian's records for this account.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the Life Insurance entity that owns this custodian account (e.g., ABC Life Insurance Company, XYZ Separate Account A). Important for legal ownership and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: naic_schedule_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Schedule Classification
attributes.description: The NAIC Annual Statement Schedule(s) to which assets in this custodian account are reported (e.g., Schedule D Part 1 for bonds, Schedule D Part 2 for stocks, Schedule BA for other invested assets). Multiple schedules may apply and should be comma-separated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this custodian account relationship, fee structure, and service quality.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or important information about this custodian account that does not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: The most recent performance rating assigned to the custodian for services provided to this account, based on service quality, accuracy, timeliness, and responsiveness.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary relationship manager or contact person at the custodian for this account.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary relationship manager or contact person at the custodian for this account.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary relationship manager or contact person at the custodian for this account.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: The primary regulatory accounting framework under which assets in this custodian account are reported. Statutory follows NAIC SAP; GAAP follows US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles; IFRS follows International Financial Reporting Standards; tax_basis follows IRS tax accounting rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual

attributes.name: safekeeping_location
attributes.description: The physical or legal jurisdiction where the assets in this custodian account are held in safekeeping (e.g., Boston MA, London UK, Luxembourg). Important for regulatory reporting and legal jurisdiction purposes.

attributes.name: securities_lending_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether securities lending is authorized for assets held in this custodian account. True if securities lending is permitted; False if not permitted.

attributes.name: settlement_bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number used for cash settlement of transactions associated with this custodian account.

attributes.name: settlement_bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the bank used for cash settlement of transactions in this custodian account.

attributes.name: settlement_bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The ABA routing number or SWIFT code for the settlement bank account, used to facilitate electronic funds transfers.

attributes.name: settlement_instruction_method
attributes.description: Default settlement instruction method for securities transactions in this account. DVP (Delivery Versus Payment) for securities purchases; RVP (Receive Versus Payment) for securities sales; FOP (Free Of Payment) for transfers without payment; against_payment for cash-settled transactions.

attributes.name: soc2_report_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent SOC 2 Type II audit report received from the custodian.

attributes.name: soc2_report_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Organization Control 2 (SOC2) Report On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current SOC 2 Type II audit report is on file for the custodian providing services to this account. True if report is on file and current; False otherwise.

attributes.name: subcustodian_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary custodian uses subcustodians (local custodians in foreign markets) to hold assets in this account. True if subcustodians are used; False if all assets are held directly by the primary custodian.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The tax identification number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) associated with the legal entity that owns this custodian account. Used for tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this custodian account record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: successor_custodian_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on custodian_account (successor_custodian_account_id)

products.name: incident
products.description: Transactional record of operational incidents, service failures, data breaches, or compliance violations involving a vendor. Captures incident date, vendor, incident type (service outage, data breach, PHI exposure, SLA breach, regulatory violation, fraud), severity level, business impact description, affected policies or underwriting cases, incident status, root cause, and resolution details. Supports vendor risk management escalation, HIPAA breach notification workflows, regulatory reporting obligations, and contract penalty enforcement.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor incident record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal user or team responsible for managing and resolving the vendor incident.

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_issue. Business justification: Vendor incidents (service failures, SLA breaches, security events) often create compliance issues requiring formal tracking, remediation, and regulatory reporting. Links vendor incident to compliance

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Vendor incidents involving PHI/PII exposure trigger formal privacy incident reporting obligations under HIPAA and state breach notification laws. Links vendor incident to privacy incident record for r

attributes.name: report_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_period. Business justification: Incidents must be tracked by reporting period for operational risk disclosures and management reporting. Quarterly operational risk reporting to regulators and board requires incident aggregation by f

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.service_order. Business justification: Many incidents originate from specific service orders (e.g., failed exam order, delayed report, data quality issue). Linking vendor_incident to service_order provides root cause traceability and enabl

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Incidents occur in the context of specific contracts. Linking vendor_incident to vendor_contract enables tracking which contract was in effect during the incident, supports contract penalty assessment

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor involved in this incident.

attributes.name: affected_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of insurance claims impacted by the vendor incident, used to quantify the scope of claims processing disruption.

attributes.name: affected_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of insurance policies impacted by the vendor incident, used to quantify the scope of business disruption.

attributes.name: affected_underwriting_case_count
attributes.description: Number of underwriting cases impacted by the vendor incident, used to quantify the scope of new business processing disruption.

attributes.name: business_impact_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the business impact caused by the vendor incident, including affected business processes, operational disruptions, financial losses, and reputational damage.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident record was formally closed after verification of resolution and completion of all documentation and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: contract_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty amount assessed against the vendor for this incident per contractual terms, used for vendor performance management and cost recovery.

attributes.name: contract_penalty_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether contractual penalties or financial remedies are applicable to the vendor as a result of this incident per the vendor contract terms.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions and remediation steps implemented or planned by the vendor to prevent recurrence of similar incidents.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this vendor incident record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: detected_by_method
attributes.description: The method or channel through which the vendor incident was detected: vendor notification (vendor self-reported), internal audit (discovered during audit), automated monitoring (system alert), customer complaint (policyholder or claimant report), regulatory inquiry (regulator notification), or third party alert (external notification).

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident was escalated to a higher management level due to severity or complexity.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation level of the vendor incident within the organization: none (handled at operational level), management (escalated to department management), executive (escalated to C-suite), or board (escalated to Board of Directors).

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial loss incurred by the organization due to the vendor incident, including direct costs, remediation expenses, and potential penalties.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident occurred or was first detected. This is the principal business event timestamp for the incident.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique incident tracking number assigned to this vendor incident for reference and communication purposes.

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor incident: reported (incident logged), investigating (root cause analysis in progress), contained (immediate threat mitigated), resolved (corrective actions completed), or closed (incident fully remediated and documented).

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor incident type: service outage (vendor system unavailable), data breach (unauthorized data access), PHI exposure (Protected Health Information disclosure), SLA breach (Service Level Agreement violation), regulatory violation (non-compliance with regulations), or fraud (fraudulent activity detected).
attributes.references: NAIC Vendor Risk Management Guidelines, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.308

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or observations related to the vendor incident for internal reference and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: phi_exposed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information was exposed or compromised during the vendor incident, triggering HIPAA breach notification requirements.

attributes.name: phi_record_count
attributes.description: Number of Protected Health Information records exposed or compromised during the vendor incident, used for HIPAA breach notification threshold determination.

attributes.name: pii_exposed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Personally Identifiable Information was exposed or compromised during the vendor incident, triggering state breach notification requirements.

attributes.name: pii_record_count
attributes.description: Number of Personally Identifiable Information records exposed or compromised during the vendor incident, used for state breach notification requirements.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor incident is a recurrence of a previously reported and resolved incident with the same vendor, signaling potential systemic issues.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body to which the vendor incident was reported (e.g., State Department of Insurance, HHS Office for Civil Rights, SEC, FINRA, FinCEN).
attributes.references: NAIC, State Departments of Insurance, HHS, SEC, FINRA, FinCEN

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident was formally reported to the applicable regulatory authority.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, HIPAA Breach Notification Rule

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor incident must be reported to regulatory authorities (state insurance departments, SEC, FINRA, HHS for HIPAA breaches, FinCEN for AML violations).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, HIPAA Breach Notification Rule, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or system that reported the vendor incident (vendor contact, internal employee, automated monitoring system).

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident was formally reported to the organization by the vendor or discovered internally.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor incident was fully resolved and all corrective actions were completed.

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours elapsed from incident detection to full resolution, used to measure incident management efficiency.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the vendor incident: human error (personnel mistake), system failure (technology malfunction), process gap (inadequate procedures), security vulnerability (exploited weakness), third party dependency (cascading failure), or natural disaster (force majeure event).

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the root cause analysis findings for the vendor incident, documenting the underlying factors that led to the incident occurrence.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business impact severity classification of the vendor incident: critical (major business disruption or regulatory exposure), high (significant impact to operations), medium (moderate impact with workarounds available), or low (minimal business impact).

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor incident constitutes a breach of contractual Service Level Agreement terms, potentially triggering contract penalties or remedies.

attributes.name: sla_metric_breached
attributes.description: Specific SLA metric that was breached during the vendor incident (e.g., uptime percentage, response time, turnaround time, accuracy rate).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this vendor incident record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_response_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours elapsed between incident detection and the vendors initial response or acknowledgment, used to measure vendor responsiveness.

attributes.name: related_incident_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on incident (related_incident_id)

products.name: onboarding
products.description: Master and transactional record tracking the end-to-end vendor onboarding workflow from initial sourcing through contract execution and activation. Captures onboarding request date, requestor business unit, vendor type, onboarding stage (sourcing, due diligence, risk assessment, legal review, contract negotiation, BAA execution, system setup, activation), stage completion dates, approvals required, and overall onboarding status. Ensures all compliance gates (risk assessment, credential verification, BAA, insurance certificate) are completed before a vendor is activated for service delivery.

attributes.name: onboarding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor onboarding record. Primary key for tracking the end-to-end onboarding workflow from initial sourcing through contract execution and activation.

attributes.name: baa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.baa. Business justification: BAA execution is a critical milestone in vendor onboarding for vendors who will access PHI. The vendor_onboarding table has baa_completed_flag and baa_execution_start_date/completion_date but no FK to

attributes.name: onboarding_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the individual who provided final approval for the vendor onboarding. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: onboarding_requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the individual who submitted the vendor onboarding request. Used for accountability and follow-up communications.

attributes.name: resulting_vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Vendor onboarding processes culminate in contract execution. The vendor_onboarding table tracks contract_negotiation_start_date and contract_negotiation_completion_date but has no FK to the resulting

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being onboarded. Links to the master vendor record in the vendor management system.

attributes.name: vendor_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_risk_assessment. Business justification: Risk assessment is a mandatory step in vendor onboarding. The vendor_onboarding table has risk_assessment_start_date/completion_date and risk_assessment_completed_flag but no FK to the actual assessme

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was formally activated for service delivery. Marks the completion of all onboarding gates and the start of operational service delivery.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when final management approval was granted for the vendor onboarding. Marks the authorization to proceed with vendor activation.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal management approval is required for this vendor onboarding. Typically true for critical or high-risk vendors requiring executive-level sign-off.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the management approval process for this vendor onboarding. Tracks whether required approvals have been obtained.

attributes.name: baa_execution_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Execution Completion Date
attributes.description: Date when the Business Associate Agreement (BAA) execution stage was completed. Indicates that the BAA has been fully executed by all parties and is in effect.

attributes.name: baa_execution_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Execution Start Date
attributes.description: Date when the Business Associate Agreement (BAA) execution stage began. Marks the start of HIPAA-compliant BAA preparation and signing process for vendors with access to Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor onboarding process was cancelled or terminated. Indicates that the onboarding did not proceed to completion.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the vendor onboarding process was cancelled or terminated. Provides context for audit and process improvement purposes.

attributes.name: contract_negotiation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract negotiation stage was completed. Indicates that all parties have agreed to final contract terms and the contract is ready for execution.

attributes.name: contract_negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract negotiation stage began. Marks the start of formal negotiations on contract terms, pricing, service levels, and legal provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor onboarding record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credential_verification_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor credential and license verification compliance gate has been completed. Ensures vendor holds all required professional licenses, certifications, and registrations.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: due_diligence_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the due diligence stage was completed. Indicates that all background checks and capability assessments have been finalized and documented.

attributes.name: due_diligence_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the due diligence stage began. Marks the start of comprehensive vendor background checks, financial stability assessment, and capability verification.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance certificate compliance gate has been completed. Ensures vendor maintains required liability, errors and omissions, and other insurance coverage.

attributes.name: legal_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the legal review stage was completed. Indicates that legal counsel has approved the vendor relationship and contract terms.

attributes.name: legal_review_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the legal review stage began. Marks the start of legal department review of vendor contracts, terms, and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional information, special instructions, or context related to the vendor onboarding process. Used for documenting exceptions, issues, or important details.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current overall status of the vendor onboarding workflow. Reflects the highest-level state of the onboarding process from initiation through activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|sourcing|due_diligence|risk_assessment|legal_review|contract_negotiation|baa_execution|system_setup|activation|completed|cancelled|on_hold|rejected — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the vendor onboarding request. Determines the urgency and resource allocation for completing the onboarding process.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor onboarding request was formally submitted. Marks the start of the onboarding timeline and is used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the onboarding request. Used for tracking and reference in communications and approvals.

attributes.name: requestor_business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or department that initiated the vendor onboarding request. Identifies the internal sponsor and primary beneficiary of the vendor relationship.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment stage was completed. Indicates that all risk evaluations have been finalized and risk mitigation strategies have been documented.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment stage began. Marks the initiation of formal risk evaluation including operational, financial, cybersecurity, and compliance risks.

attributes.name: soc2_audit_completed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC2) Audit Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC2) audit review compliance gate has been completed. Required for vendors with access to sensitive data or critical systems.

attributes.name: sourcing_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing stage was completed. Indicates that vendor selection has been finalized and the onboarding process can proceed to due diligence.

attributes.name: sourcing_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing stage began. Marks the initiation of vendor identification and preliminary evaluation activities.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the vendor onboarding workflow. Represents the specific phase of work currently in progress. Each stage must be completed before advancing to the next. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sourcing|due_diligence|risk_assessment|legal_review|contract_negotiation|baa_execution|system_setup|activation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: system_setup_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the system setup stage was completed. Indicates that all technical integration and system configuration activities have been finalized and tested.

attributes.name: system_setup_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the system setup stage began. Marks the start of technical integration activities including system access provisioning, data connectivity configuration, and interface testing.

attributes.name: target_activation_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date for vendor activation. Used for project planning and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking throughout the onboarding process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor onboarding record was last modified. Used for audit trail and tracking the most recent changes to the onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: restarted_onboarding_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on onboarding (restarted_onboarding_id)

products.name: insurance_cert
products.description: Master record tracking certificates of insurance (COIs) provided by vendors as evidence of their own insurance coverage — general liability, professional liability (E&O), cyber liability, workers compensation, and umbrella coverage. Captures certificate number, issuing insurer, coverage type, policy number, coverage limits, effective and expiration dates, additional insured status, and certificate status. Required for all vendors performing on-site services, handling PHI, or providing technology services. Supports vendor risk management and contract compliance verification.

attributes.name: insurance_cert_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor insurance certificate record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: primary_insurance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who verified the certificate authenticity and compliance. Links to the user or employee master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_insurance_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last updated this certificate record. Links to the user or employee master record for audit purposes.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contract. Business justification: Insurance certificates are required by specific contracts to satisfy indemnification and liability provisions. The vendor_insurance_cert table has contract_requirement_met_flag but no FK to the contra

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor providing this certificate of insurance. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: additional_insured_endorsement
attributes.description: Specific endorsement number or form that adds the company as an additional insured. Common forms include CG 20 10, CG 20 37.

attributes.name: additional_insured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is named as an additional insured on the vendors policy. True means the company has direct coverage under the vendors policy.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice the certificate holder will receive if the policy is cancelled. Typically 30 or 10 days depending on cancellation reason.

attributes.name: certificate_holder_address
attributes.description: Full mailing address of the certificate holder. Used for certificate delivery and legal notices.

attributes.name: certificate_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity to whom the certificate is issued. Typically the companys legal name.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the certificate of insurance was issued by the producer. May differ from the coverage effective date.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number assigned by the insurance broker or agent issuing the certificate of insurance. This is the externally-known identifier for the COI document.

attributes.name: certificate_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the company received the certificate from the vendor. Used to track vendor compliance with certificate submission requirements.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage documented by this certificate. Categorizes the primary coverage class. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general_liability|professional_liability|cyber_liability|workers_compensation|umbrella|commercial_auto|property|crime|fiduciary — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_requirement_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certificate meets all insurance requirements specified in the vendor contract. True means the certificate is compliant with contractual terms.

attributes.name: coverage_limit_aggregate
attributes.description: Maximum total amount the insurer will pay for all claims during the policy period. Expressed in the policy currency.

attributes.name: coverage_limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the coverage limits. Typically USD for US-domiciled vendors.

attributes.name: coverage_limit_per_occurrence
attributes.description: Maximum amount the insurer will pay for a single claim or occurrence under this policy. Expressed in the policy currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certificate record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount the insured vendor must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage applies. Expressed in the policy currency.

attributes.name: document_storage_location
attributes.description: File path or URI where the physical certificate document is stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the insurance coverage documented by this certificate becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the insurance coverage documented by this certificate terminates. Critical for tracking certificate renewal requirements.

attributes.name: insurance_cert_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certificate of insurance. Indicates whether the certificate is currently valid and enforceable.

attributes.name: issuing_insurer_am_best_rating
attributes.description: AM Best financial strength rating of the issuing insurance carrier at the time of certificate issuance. Used to assess carrier creditworthiness.

attributes.name: issuing_insurer_naic_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Issuing Insurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Number
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code uniquely identifying the insurance carrier. Used to verify carrier legitimacy and financial strength.

attributes.name: issuing_insurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing the underlying coverage documented in this certificate.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the certificate, verification process, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number under which the coverage is provided. References the underlying insurance contract.

attributes.name: primary_noncontributory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendors insurance is primary and noncontributory to any insurance carried by the company. True means the vendors policy pays first.

attributes.name: producer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific contact person at the insurance broker or agency for certificate inquiries.

attributes.name: producer_email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the insurance broker or agent for electronic certificate delivery and correspondence.

attributes.name: producer_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance broker or agent who issued the certificate on behalf of the insurer.

attributes.name: producer_phone_number
attributes.description: Phone number of the insurance broker or agent for certificate verification and renewal coordination.

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when a renewal reminder was sent to the vendor requesting an updated certificate prior to expiration.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special provisions, endorsements, or coverage modifications noted on the certificate that require attention.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certificate record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the certificate verification process. Indicates whether the certificate authenticity and coverage details have been confirmed with the insurer.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the certificate was verified for authenticity and contract compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_of_subrogation_flag

products.name: contract_amendment
products.description: Transactional record of each formal amendment, addendum, or change order executed against an existing vendor contract. Captures amendment number, amendment type (scope change, pricing adjustment, term extension, SLA modification, regulatory update), effective date, description of changes, financial impact, approval chain, and execution status. Maintains the complete amendment history for each vendor contract, enabling reconstruction of the full contractual terms at any point in time for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: contract_amendment_id

attributes.name: parent_amendment_contract_amendment_id

attributes.name: primary_contract_requested_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee who initiated or requested the amendment. Used for tracking accountability and approval workflows.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_amendment_contract_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to a later amendment that supersedes or replaces this amendment. Used for tracking amendment chains and ensuring correct contract term reconstruction.

attributes.name: quaternary_contract_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who created this amendment record. Used for audit trail and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: quinary_contract_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who last modified this amendment record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: tertiary_contract_rejected_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who rejected the amendment. Used for audit trail and decision tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor contract being amended. Links this amendment to the original contract record.

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the changes being made by this amendment. Includes the business rationale, specific clauses modified, and impact on existing contract terms.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential or hierarchical identifier for this amendment within the contract (e.g., Amendment 001, A-1, 2023-01). Used for ordering and referencing amendments in legal and operational contexts.

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the amendment. Tracks the amendment through drafting, approval, execution, and potential rejection or supersession by later amendments.

attributes.name: amendment_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title or subject line for the amendment (e.g., 'Pricing Adjustment for 2024', 'Addition of MIB Services'). Provides quick identification of the amendment purpose.

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment based on the nature of the change being made to the contract. Determines the approval workflow and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment received final internal approval and was authorized for execution. Critical milestone in the amendment lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_level_required
attributes.description: Highest organizational level required to approve this amendment based on financial impact, risk assessment, and contract governance policies.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal approval workflow is required for this amendment based on financial thresholds, risk level, or contract governance policies.

attributes.name: company_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company signed the amendment. Used for tracking execution timeline and ensuring all parties have executed before the amendment becomes binding.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this amendment record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the executed amendment document. Critical for audit, compliance, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment terms become binding and enforceable. Critical for reconstructing contract terms at any point in time for audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties signed the amendment, making it legally binding. May differ from effective date if the amendment specifies a future effective date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment terms expire or are superseded. Nullable for amendments that permanently modify the contract without a defined end date.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net financial impact of the amendment on the total contract value. Positive values indicate increased cost, negative values indicate savings. Used for budget tracking and financial planning.

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures proper currency handling for multi-currency vendor relationships.

attributes.name: initiated_by_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party initiated the amendment request. Used for tracking amendment patterns and negotiation dynamics.

attributes.name: legal_review_completed_date

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: pricing_adjustment_percentage

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_reason

attributes.name: rejection_date

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the amendment was rejected by either party. Applicable when amendment_status is rejected. Used for lessons learned and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date on which the amendment was formally requested by either party. Marks the beginning of the amendment negotiation and approval process.

attributes.name: revised_contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total contract value after applying this amendment. Represents the cumulative contract value including all prior amendments and this current amendment.

attributes.name: revised_expiration_date

attributes.name: scope_change_description

attributes.name: sla_modification_description

attributes.description: Number of months by which the contract term is extended. Applicable when amendment_type is term_extension. Positive values extend the contract, negative values shorten it.

attributes.description: System timestamp when this amendment record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vendor_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor signed the amendment. Used for tracking execution timeline and ensuring all parties have executed before the amendment becomes binding.

attributes.name: superseded_contract_amendment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on contract_amendment (superseded_contract_amendment_id)

products.name: contract_credential_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the compliance requirement relationship between vendor contracts and vendor credentials. It captures which credentials are required by which contracts, when requirements become effective, verification status, and waiver provisions. Each record links one vendor_contract to one vendor_credential with attributes that exist only in the context of this contractual compliance requirement.. Existence Justification: In life insurance vendor management, contracts routinely require multiple credentials (state licenses, HIPAA certification, SOC 2, TPA licenses, etc.), and a single credential (e.g., a state insurance license) is required by multiple contracts across different service agreements. The business actively manages a compliance matrix tracking which credentials are required by which contracts, when requirements were added (often via amendments), verification status, waiver provisions, and expiration tracking. This is a core operational function in vendor risk management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this contract credential requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific vendor credential required by the contract

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Credential Requirement - Vendor Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor contract that imposes this credential requirement

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which compliance with this credential requirement was verified by vendor management or compliance team.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is absolutely mandatory for contract performance (true) or preferred but not required (false).

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next verification of this credential requirement must be completed to maintain continuous compliance monitoring.

attributes.description: Contractual consequence or remediation action if vendor fails to maintain this credential (e.g., suspend services, terminate contract, cure period granted).

attributes.description: Date on which this credential requirement becomes effective for the contract. May differ from contract effective date if added via amendment.

attributes.name: requirement_expiration_date

attributes.name: requirement_source
attributes.description: Source document or event that established this credential requirement (original contract, subsequent amendment, regulatory mandate, etc.).

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the granted waiver expires and the credential requirement becomes mandatory again. Null if no waiver granted.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary waiver has been granted for this credential requirement, allowing the vendor to perform services without the credential for a limited period.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for granting a waiver to this credential requirement (e.g., credential renewal in progress, alternative credential accepted, limited scope services).

products.name: policy_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between compliance policies and vendors. It captures the applicability of specific compliance policies to individual vendors, tracking compliance status, attestation dates, and exceptions. Each record links one compliance_policy to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory oversight relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, a single compliance policy (e.g., data protection, SOX, information security) applies to multiple vendors across different service categories, and each vendor is subject to multiple compliance policies based on their vendor type, risk tier, and services provided. The compliance team actively manages vendor-policy applicability, tracks compliance status, collects attestations, grants exceptions, and schedules periodic reviews for each vendor-policy combination.

attributes.name: report_period_id

attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding reporting period of the same type (e.g., prior quarter for quarterly periods, prior month for monthly periods). Used for period-over-period comparisons and variance analysis.

attributes.name: calendar_days_in_period

attributes.name: calendar_quarter

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: period_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reporting period was officially closed and no further transactions were accepted. Null if the period is still open.

attributes.name: period_code

attributes.name: period_description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive text providing context about this reporting period, including any special circumstances, restatements, or reporting exceptions.

attributes.name: period_lock_date

attributes.name: reporting_framework

products.name: report_approval

Manages the multi-level sign-off chain required for statutory filings, GAAP financials, and IFRS 17 disclosures.

attributes.name: report_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each report approval event in the sign-off workflow. Primary key for the report approval transaction.

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_approval_report_approval_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding approval event in the workflow chain for this report instance. Enables reconstruction of the complete approval sequence.

attributes.name: primary_report_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the individual who performed this approval action. Links to the enterprise identity management system.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, Internal Access Control Policy

attributes.name: report_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the report definition being approved. Links to the report_definition product to identify which report template or configuration is subject to this approval event.

attributes.name: report_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific report execution or generation instance being approved. Distinguishes between multiple runs of the same report definition and version.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reporting.report_version. Business justification: Each approval event approves a specific report_version in a multi-stage workflow. Cardinality: 1 approval → 1 version, 1 version → many approvals. Adding FK links approval to the artifact being approv

attributes.name: approval_action
attributes.description: The decision or action taken by the approver at this stage. Determines whether the report progresses to the next approval level, is sent back for corrections, or is rejected.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments, notes, or feedback provided by the approver regarding their decision. May include reasons for rejection, conditions for approval, or clarifications requested.

attributes.name: approval_due_date
attributes.description: Target or deadline date by which this approval stage must be completed. Used for workflow management and escalation triggers to ensure timely regulatory filing.

attributes.name: approval_duration_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours between when the approval request was sent and when the approval action was completed. Used for workflow performance analysis and SLA (Service Level Agreement) monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_method
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the approval was submitted (e.g., web portal, mobile app, email workflow, API integration). Tracks user experience and system integration patterns.

attributes.name: approval_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this approval event within the overall workflow for this report instance. Enables tracking of the chronological progression through the approval chain.

attributes.name: approval_stage

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: approver_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the approver. Used for notification, audit trail, and contact purposes in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: approver_name

attributes.name: approver_title

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference

attributes.name: delegated_approval_flag

attributes.name: approver_name
